<a id="p-023"></a>

#### Beginner’s Guide｜初學者指南

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/beginners_guide.html>

##### Beginner’s Guide｜初學者指南

|   |
| --- |
| [Starting, Stopping, and Reloading Configuration](#p-023)<br>[Configuration File’s Structure](#p-023)<br>[Serving Static Content](#p-023)<br>[Setting Up a Simple Proxy Server](#p-023)<br>[Setting Up FastCGI Proxying](#p-023)<br>[啟動、停止與重新載入設定](#p-023)<br>[設定檔的結構](#p-023)<br>[提供靜態內容](#p-023)<br>[設定簡單代理伺服器](#p-023)<br>[設定FastCGI程式](#p-023) |

This guide gives a basic introduction to nginx and describes some simple tasks that can be done with it. It is supposed that nginx is already installed on the reader’s machine. If it is not, see the [Installing nginx](#p-115) page. This guide describes how to start and stop nginx, and reload its configuration, explains the structure of the configuration file and describes how to set up nginx to serve out static content, how to configure nginx as a proxy server, and how to connect it with a FastCGI application.

本指南對 nginx 進行了基本介紹，並描述了一些可以用它完成的簡單任務。假設讀者的機器上已經安裝了 nginx。如果不是，請參閱[安裝nginx](#p-115)頁面。本指南介紹如何啟動和停止 nginx、重新載入其配置、解釋設定檔的結構並介紹如何設定 nginx 來提供靜態內容、如何將 nginx 配置為代理伺服器以及如何將其與 FastCGI 應用程式連接。

nginx has one master process and several worker processes. The main purpose of the master process is to read and evaluate configuration, and maintain worker processes. Worker processes do actual processing of requests. nginx employs event-based model and OS-dependent mechanisms to efficiently distribute requests among worker processes. The number of worker processes is defined in the configuration file and may be fixed for a given configuration or automatically adjusted to the number of available CPU cores (see [worker\_processes](#p-125)).

nginx有一個master行程和多個worker行程。主進程的主要目的是讀取和評估配置，以及維護工作進程。工作進程實際處理請求。 nginx 採用基於事件的模型和OS依賴機制在工作進程之間有效地分配請求。工作進程的數量在設定檔中定義，對於給定配置可以是固定的，也可以自動調整為可用 CPU 核心的數量（請參閱 [worker\_processes](#p-125)）。

The way nginx and its modules work is determined in the configuration file. By default, the configuration file is named `nginx.conf` and placed in the directory `/usr/local/nginx/conf`, `/etc/nginx`, or `/usr/local/etc/nginx`.

nginx 及其模組的工作方式是在設定檔中決定的。預設情況下，設定檔名稱為`nginx.conf`，放置在目錄`/usr/local/nginx/conf`, `/etc/nginx`或`/usr/local/etc/nginx`中。

**Starting, Stopping, and Reloading Configuration｜啟動、停止和重新載入配置**

To start nginx, run the executable file. Once nginx is started, it can be controlled by invoking the executable with the `-s` parameter. Use the following syntax:

若要啟動 nginx，請執行可執行檔。一旦 nginx 啟動，就可以透過使用 `-s` 參數呼叫可執行檔來控制它。使用以下語法：

> ```
> nginx -s signal
>
> nginx -s 訊號
> ```

Where *signal* may be one of the following:

其中*訊號*可能是以下之一：

-   `stop` — fast shutdown  
    `stop` — 快速關閉
-   `quit` — graceful shutdown  
    `quit` — 優雅關閉
-   `reload` — reloading the configuration file  
    `reload` — 重新載入設定檔
-   `reopen` — reopening the log files  
    `reopen` — 重新開啟日誌文件

For example, to stop nginx processes with waiting for the worker processes to finish serving current requests, the following command can be executed:

例如，要停止 nginx 進程並等待工作進程完成目前請求的服務，可以執行下列命令：

> ```
> nginx -s quit
>
> nginx -s 退出
> ```

> This command should be executed under the same user that started nginx.
>
> 該指令應在啟動 nginx 的相同使用者下執行。

Changes made in the configuration file will not be applied until the command to reload configuration is sent to nginx or it is restarted. To reload configuration, execute:

在將重新載入設定的命令傳送到 nginx 或重新啟動之前，設定檔中所做的變更將不會套用。若要重新載入配置，請執行：

> ```
> nginx -s reload
>
> nginx -s 重新載入
> ```

Once the master process receives the signal to reload configuration, it checks the syntax validity of the new configuration file and tries to apply the configuration provided in it. If this is a success, the master process starts new worker processes and sends messages to old worker processes, requesting them to shut down. Otherwise, the master process rolls back the changes and continues to work with the old configuration. Old worker processes, receiving a command to shut down, stop accepting new connections and continue to service current requests until all such requests are serviced. After that, the old worker processes exit.

一旦主進程收到重新載入配置的訊號，它就會檢查新設定檔的語法有效性，並嘗試套用其中提供的配置。如果成功，主進程將啟動新的工作進程並向舊工作進程發送訊息，請求它們關閉。否則，主進程將回滾更改並繼續使用舊配置。舊的工作進程收到關閉命令，停止接受新連線並繼續服務當前請求，直到所有此類請求都得到服務。之後，舊的工作進程退出。

A signal may also be sent to nginx processes with the help of Unix tools such as the `kill` utility. In this case a signal is sent directly to a process with a given process ID. The process ID of the nginx master process is written, by default, to the `nginx.pid` in the directory `/usr/local/nginx/logs` or `/var/run`. For example, if the master process ID is 1628, to send the QUIT signal resulting in nginx’s graceful shutdown, execute:

訊號也可以在 Unix 工具（例如 `kill` 實用程式）的幫助下傳送到 nginx 進程。在這種情況下，訊號直接發送到具有給定進程ID的進程。 nginx主進程的進程ID預設寫入`/usr/local/nginx/logs`或`/var/run`目錄下的`nginx.pid`。例如，如果主進程ID是1628，要發送QUIT訊號導致nginx正常關閉，請執行：

> ```
> kill -s QUIT 1628
>
> 殺死 -s QUIT 1628
> ```

For getting the list of all running nginx processes, the `ps` utility may be used, for example, in the following way:

為了獲取所有正在運行的 nginx 進程的列表，可以使用 `ps` 實用程序，例如，透過以下方式：

> ```
> ps -ax | grep nginx
>
> ps-ax | grep nginx
> ```

For more information on sending signals to nginx, see [Controlling nginx](#p-026).

有關向 nginx 發送訊號的更多信息，請參閱[控制 nginx](#p-026)。

**Configuration File’s Structure｜設定檔的結構**

nginx consists of modules which are controlled by directives specified in the configuration file. Directives are divided into simple directives and block directives. A simple directive consists of the name and parameters separated by spaces and ends with a semicolon (`;`). A block directive has the same structure as a simple directive, but instead of the semicolon it ends with a set of additional instructions surrounded by braces (`{` and `}`). If a block directive can have other directives inside braces, it is called a context (examples: [events](#p-125), [http](#p-056), [server](#p-056), and [location](#p-056)).

nginx 由由設定檔中指定的指令控制的模組組成。指令分為簡單指令和區塊指令。一個簡單的指令由名稱和參數組成，名稱和參數之間用空格分隔，並以分號 (`;`) 結尾。塊指令具有與簡單指令相同的結構，但它不是以分號結尾，而是以一組用大括號括起來的附加指令（`{` 和 `}`）結尾。如果區塊指令可以在大括號內包含其他指令，則稱為上下文（例如：[events](#p-125)、[http](#p-056)、[server](#p-056) 和 [location](#p-056)）。

Directives placed in the configuration file outside of any contexts are considered to be in the [main](#p-125) context. The `events` and `http` directives reside in the `main` context, `server` in `http`, and `location` in `server`.

放置在任何上下文之外的設定檔中的指令都被視為位於 [main](#p-125) 上下文中。 `events` 和 `http` 指令位於 `main` 上下文中，`server` 位於`http` 中，`location` 位於`server` 中。

The rest of a line after the `#` sign is considered a comment.

`#` 符號之後的其餘行視為註解。

**Serving Static Content｜提供靜態內容**

An important web server task is serving out files (such as images or static HTML pages). You will implement an example where, depending on the request, files will be served from different local directories: `/data/www` (which may contain HTML files) and `/data/images` (containing images). This will require editing of the configuration file and setting up of a [server](#p-056) block inside the [http](#p-056) block with two [location](#p-056) blocks.

一項重要的 Web 伺服器任務是提供檔案（例如圖片或靜態HTML 頁面）。您將實作一個範例，其中根據請求，將從不同的本機目錄提供檔案：`/data/www`（可能包含HTML檔案）和`/data/images`（包含影像）。這將需要編輯設定檔並在 [http](#p-056) 區塊內設定一個 [server](#p-056) 區塊以及兩個 [location](#p-056) 區塊。

First, create the `/data/www` directory and put an `index.html` file with any text content into it and create the `/data/images` directory and place some images in it.

首先，建立`/data/www`目錄並放入一個包含任何文字內容的`index.html`文件，然後建立`/data/images`目錄並在其中放置一些圖像。

Next, open the configuration file. The default configuration file already includes several examples of the `server` block, mostly commented out. For now comment out all such blocks and start a new `server` block:

接下來，開啟設定檔。預設設定檔已包含 `server` 區塊的幾個範例，大部分已註解掉。現在註解掉所有此類區塊並開始一個新的 `server` 區塊：

> ```
> http {
>
> http{
>     server {
>
>     伺服器{
>     }
> }
> ```

Generally, the configuration file may include several `server` blocks [distinguished](#p-111) by ports on which they [listen](#p-056) to and by [server names](#p-112). Once nginx decides which `server` processes a request, it tests the URI specified in the request’s header against the parameters of the `location` directives defined inside the `server` block.

一般來說，設定檔可能包含多個`server`區塊[區分](#p-111)，按它們[偵聽](#p-056)的連接埠和[伺服器名稱](#p-112)。一旦 nginx 決定由哪個 `server` 處理請求，它就會根據 `server` 區塊內定義的 `location` 指令的參數來測試請求標頭中指定的 URI。

Add the following `location` block to the `server` block:

將以下`location`塊加到`server`塊：

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     root /data/www;
>
>     根/數據/www；
> }
> ```

This `location` block specifies the “`/`” prefix compared with the URI from the request. For matching requests, the URI will be added to the path specified in the [root](#p-056) directive, that is, to `/data/www`, to form the path to the requested file on the local file system. If there are several matching `location` blocks nginx selects the one with the longest prefix. The `location` block above provides the shortest prefix, of length one, and so only if all other `location` blocks fail to provide a match, this block will be used.

此`location`塊指定與請求中的URI相比的「`/`」前綴。對於符合的請求，URI將會被加入到[root](#p-056)指令中指定的路徑，即`/data/www`，形成請求檔案在本機檔案系統的路徑。如果有多個匹配的`location`塊，nginx會選擇具有最長前綴的那個。上面的`location`塊提供了長度為1的最短前綴，因此只有當所有其他`location`塊無法提供匹配時，才會使用該塊。

Next, add the second `location` block:

接下來，新增第二個`location`塊：

> ```
> location /images/ {
>
> 位置/圖像/ {
>     root /data;
>
>     根/數據；
> }
> ```

It will be a match for requests starting with `/images/` (`location /` also matches such requests, but has shorter prefix).

它將匹配以 `/images/` 開頭的請求（`location /` 也匹配此類請求，但前綴較短）。

The resulting configuration of the `server` block should look like this:

`server` 塊的最終配置應如下所示：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         root /data/www;
>
>         根/數據/www；
>     }
> 
>     location /images/ {
>
>     位置/圖像/ {
>         root /data;
>
>         根/數據；
>     }
> }
> ```

This is already a working configuration of a server that listens on the standard port 80 and is accessible on the local machine at `http://localhost/`. In response to requests with URIs starting with `/images/`, the server will send files from the `/data/images` directory. For example, in response to the `http://localhost/images/example.png` request nginx will send the `/data/images/example.png` file. If such file does not exist, nginx will send a response indicating the 404 error. Requests with URIs not starting with `/images/` will be mapped onto the `/data/www` directory. For example, in response to the `http://localhost/some/example.html` request nginx will send the `/data/www/some/example.html` file.

這已經是伺服器的工作配置，該伺服器偵聽標準連接埠 80，並且可以在本機電腦上透過`http://localhost/`進行存取。為了回應 URI 以 `/images/` 開頭的請求，伺服器將從 `/data/images` 目錄發送檔案。例如，為了回應 `http://localhost/images/example.png` 請求，nginx 將發送 `/data/images/example.png` 檔案。如果該檔案不存在，nginx將發送404錯誤回應。 URI 不以`/images/` 開頭的請求將會對應到`/data/www` 目錄。例如，為了回應 `http://localhost/some/example.html` 請求，nginx 將發送 `/data/www/some/example.html` 檔案。

To apply the new configuration, start nginx if it is not yet started or send the `reload` signal to the nginx’s master process, by executing:

若要套用新配置，請啟動 nginx（如果尚未啟動）或將 `reload` 訊號傳送到 nginx 的主進程，方法是執行：

> ```
> nginx -s reload
>
> nginx -s 重新載入
> ```

> In case something does not work as expected, you may try to find out the reason in `access.log` and `error.log` files in the directory `/usr/local/nginx/logs` or `/var/log/nginx`.
>
> 如果出現問題，您可以嘗試在`/usr/local/nginx/logs`或`/var/log/nginx`目錄下的`access.log`和`error.log`文件中找出原因。

**Setting Up a Simple Proxy Server｜設定簡單的代理伺服器**

One of the frequent uses of nginx is setting it up as a proxy server, which means a server that receives requests, passes them to the proxied servers, retrieves responses from them, and sends them to the clients.

nginx 的常見用途之一是將其設定為代理伺服器，這意味著伺服器接收請求，將它們傳遞到代理伺服器，檢索它們的回應，然後將它們傳送到客戶端。

We will configure a basic proxy server, which serves requests of images with files from the local directory and sends all other requests to a proxied server. In this example, both servers will be defined on a single nginx instance.

我們將配置一個基本的代理伺服器，它服務於本地目錄中的帶有檔案的映像請求，並將所有其他請求傳送到代理伺服器。在此範例中，兩個伺服器都將在單一 nginx 實例上定義。

First, define the proxied server by adding one more `server` block to the nginx’s configuration file with the following contents:

首先，透過在 nginx 的設定檔中新增一個`server`區塊來定義代理伺服器，其內容如下：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen 8080;
>
>     聽8080；
>     root /data/up1;
>
>     根/數據/up1；
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>     }
> }
> ```

This will be a simple server that listens on the port 8080 (previously, the `listen` directive has not been specified since the standard port 80 was used) and maps all requests to the `/data/up1` directory on the local file system. Create this directory and put the `index.html` file into it. Note that the `root` directive is placed in the `server` context. Such `root` directive is used when the `location` block selected for serving a request does not include its own `root` directive.

這將是一個簡單的伺服器，偵聽連接埠 8080（之前，由於使用了標準連接埠 80，因此尚未指定 `listen` 指令）並將所有請求對應到本機檔案系統上的 `/data/up1` 目錄。建立該目錄並將`index.html`檔案放入其中。請注意，`root`指令放置在`server`上下文中。當選擇用於服務請求的`location`塊不包含其自己的`root`指令時，使用此類`root`指令。

Next, use the server configuration from the previous section and modify it to make it a proxy server configuration. In the first `location` block, put the [proxy\_pass](#p-085) directive with the protocol, name and port of the proxied server specified in the parameter (in our case, it is `http://localhost:8080`):

接下來，使用上一節中的伺服器配置並修改它以使其成為代理伺服器配置。在第一個 `location` 區塊中，放置 [proxy\_pass](#p-085) 指令，並在參數中指定代理伺服器的協定、名稱和連接埠（在我們的範例中為 `http://localhost:8080`）：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;
>     }
> 
>     location /images/ {
>
>     位置/圖像/ {
>         root /data;
>
>         根/數據；
>     }
> }
> ```

We will modify the second `location` block, which currently maps requests with the `/images/` prefix to the files under the `/data/images` directory, to make it match the requests of images with typical file extensions. The modified `location` block looks like this:

我們將修改第二個`location`塊，該塊目前將帶有`/images/`前綴的請求映射到`/data/images`目錄下的文件，以使其匹配具有典型文件副檔名的圖像的請求。修改後的`location`塊如下圖所示：

> ```
> location ~ \.(gif|jpg|png)$ {
>
> 位置 ~ \.(gif|jpg|png)$ {
>     root /data/images;
>
>     根/數據/圖像；
> }
> ```

The parameter is a regular expression matching all URIs ending with `.gif`, `.jpg`, or `.png`. A regular expression should be preceded with `~`. The corresponding requests will be mapped to the `/data/images` directory.

參數是符合所有以`.gif`, `.jpg`或`.png`結尾的URI的正規表示式。正規表示式前面應帶有 `~`。相應的請求將被映射到`/data/images`目錄。

When nginx selects a `location` block to serve a request it first checks [location](#p-056) directives that specify prefixes, remembering `location` with the longest prefix, and then checks regular expressions. If there is a match with a regular expression, nginx picks this `location` or, otherwise, it picks the one remembered earlier.

當 nginx 選擇一個 `location` 區塊來服務請求時，它首先檢查指定前綴的 [location](#p-056) 指令，記住具有最長前綴的 `location`，然後檢查正規表示式。如果與正規表示式匹配，nginx 會選擇這個 `location`，否則，它會選擇先前記住的那個。

The resulting configuration of a proxy server will look like this:

代理伺服器的最終配置將如下所示：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         proxy_pass http://localhost:8080/;
>     }
> 
>     location ~ \.(gif|jpg|png)$ {
>
>     位置 ~ \.(gif|jpg|png)$ {
>         root /data/images;
>
>         根/數據/圖像；
>     }
> }
> ```

This server will filter requests ending with `.gif`, `.jpg`, or `.png` and map them to the `/data/images` directory (by adding URI to the `root` directive’s parameter) and pass all other requests to the proxied server configured above.

該伺服器將過濾以`.gif`, `.jpg`或`.png`結尾的請求，並將它們對應到`/data/images`目錄（透過將URI加到`root`的參數），並將所有其他代理伺服器傳遞到上面配置的伺服器。

To apply new configuration, send the `reload` signal to nginx as described in the previous sections.

若要套用新配置，請按照前面部分所述向 nginx 發送 `reload` 訊號。

There are many [more](#p-085) directives that may be used to further configure a proxy connection.

有許多[更多](#p-085)指令可用於進一步配置代理連接。

**Setting Up FastCGI Proxying｜設定 FastCGI 代理**

nginx can be used to route requests to FastCGI servers which run applications built with various frameworks and programming languages such as PHP.

nginx 可用於將請求路由到 FastCGI 伺服器，該伺服器運行使用各種框架和程式語言（例如PHP）建構的應用程式。

The most basic nginx configuration to work with a FastCGI server includes using the [fastcgi\_pass](#p-060) directive instead of the `proxy_pass` directive, and [fastcgi\_param](#p-060) directives to set parameters passed to a FastCGI server. Suppose the FastCGI server is accessible on `localhost:9000`. Taking the proxy configuration from the previous section as a basis, replace the `proxy_pass` directive with the `fastcgi_pass` directive and change the parameter to `localhost:9000`. In PHP, the `SCRIPT_FILENAME` parameter is used for determining the script name, and the `QUERY_STRING` parameter is used to pass request parameters. The resulting configuration would be:

使用 FastCGI 伺服器的最基本的 nginx 配置包括使用 [fastcgi\_pass](#p-060) 指令而不是 `proxy_pass` 指令，以及 [fastcgi\_param](#p-060) 指令來設定傳送給 FastCGI GI 的參數。假設可以在 `localhost:9000` 上存取 FastCGI 伺服器。以上一節的代理配置為基礎，將`proxy_pass`指令替換為`fastcgi_pass`指令，並將參數改為`localhost:9000`。 PHP中，`SCRIPT_FILENAME`參數用於決定腳本名稱，`QUERY_STRING`參數用於傳遞請求參數。最終的配置將是：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         fastcgi_pass  localhost:9000;
>
>         fastcgi_pass 本機：9000；
>         fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME $document_root$fastcgi_script_name;
>         fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING    $query_string;
>
>         fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING $query_string;
>     }
> 
>     location ~ \.(gif|jpg|png)$ {
>
>     位置 ~ \.(gif|jpg|png)$ {
>         root /data/images;
>
>         根/數據/圖像；
>     }
> }
> ```

This will set up a server that will route all requests except for requests for static images to the proxied server operating on `localhost:9000` through the FastCGI protocol.

這將設定一個伺服器，該伺服器將透過 FastCGI 協定將除靜態映像請求之外的所有請求路由到在 `localhost:9000` 上運行的代理伺服器。

---

<a id="p-024"></a>

#### Building nginx from Sources｜從原始碼建構 nginx

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/configure.html>

##### Building nginx from Sources｜從原始碼建構 nginx

The build is configured using the `configure` command. It defines various aspects of the system, including the methods nginx is allowed to use for connection processing. At the end it creates a `Makefile`.

使用 `configure` 指令配置建置。它定義了系統的各個方面，包括允許 nginx 用於連接處理的方法。最後它創建了一個`Makefile`。

The `configure` command supports the following parameters:

`configure`指令支援以下參數：

`--help`

prints a help message.

列印幫助訊息。

`` --prefix=`*path*` ``

`` --prefix=`*路徑*` ``

defines a directory that will keep server files. This same directory will also be used for all relative paths set by `configure` (except for paths to libraries sources) and in the `nginx.conf` configuration file. It is set to the `/usr/local/nginx` directory by default.

定義一個保存伺服器檔案的目錄。該目錄也將用於 `configure` 設定的所有相對路徑（庫來源的路徑除外）和 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中。預設為`/usr/local/nginx`目錄。

`` --sbin-path=`*path*` ``

`` --sbin-path=`*路徑*` ``

sets the name of an nginx executable file. This name is used only during installation. By default the file is named `` `*prefix*`/sbin/nginx ``.

設定 nginx 可執行檔的名稱。此名稱僅在安裝期間使用。預設情況下，檔案名稱為「` `*prefix*`/sbin/nginx `」。

`` --modules-path=`*path*` ``

`` --modules-path=`*路徑*` ``

defines a directory where nginx dynamic modules will be installed. By default the `` `*prefix*`/modules `` directory is used.

定義將安裝 nginx 動態模組的目錄。預設使用 `` `*prefix*`/modules `` 目錄。

`` --conf-path=`*path*` ``

`` --conf-path=`*路徑*` ``

sets the name of an `nginx.conf` configuration file. If needs be, nginx can always be started with a different configuration file, by specifying it in the command-line parameter `` -c `*file*` ``. By default the file is named `` `*prefix*`/conf/nginx.conf ``.

設定`nginx.conf`設定檔的名稱。如果需要，nginx 始終可以透過在命令列參數 `` -c `*file*` ``. By default the file is named `` `*prefix*`/conf/nginx.conf `` 中指定不同的設定檔來啟動。

`` --error-log-path=`*path*` ``

`` --error-log-path=`*路徑*` ``

sets the name of the primary error, warnings, and diagnostic file. After installation, the file name can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [error\_log](#p-125) directive. By default the file is named `` `*prefix*`/logs/error.log ``.

設定主要錯誤、警告和診斷文件的名稱。安裝後，始終可以使用 [error\_log](#p-125) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更檔案名稱。預設情況下，檔案名稱為「` `*prefix*`/logs/error.log `」。

`` --pid-path=`*path*` ``

`` --pid-path=`*路徑*` ``

sets the name of an `nginx.pid` file that will store the process ID of the main process. After installation, the file name can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [pid](#p-125) directive. By default the file is named `` `*prefix*`/logs/nginx.pid ``.

設定儲存主進程的進程ID的`nginx.pid`檔案的名稱。安裝後，始終可以使用 [pid](#p-125) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更檔案名稱。預設情況下，檔案名稱為「` `*prefix*`/logs/nginx.pid `」。

`` --lock-path=`*path*` ``

`` --lock-path=`*路徑*` ``

sets a prefix for the names of lock files. After installation, the value can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [lock\_file](#p-125) directive. By default the value is `` `*prefix*`/logs/nginx.lock ``.

設定鎖定檔案名稱的前綴。安裝後，始終可以使用 [lock\_file](#p-125) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更該值。預設值為`` `*前綴*`/logs/nginx.lock ``。

`` --user=`*name*` ``

`` --user=`*名字*` ``

sets the name of an unprivileged user whose credentials will be used by worker processes. After installation, the name can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [user](#p-125) directive. The default user name is nobody.

設定非特權使用者的名稱，其憑證將由工作進程使用。安裝後，始終可以使用 [user](#p-125) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更名稱。預設使用者名稱是nobody。

`` --group=`*name*` ``

`` --group=`*名字*` ``

sets the name of a group whose credentials will be used by worker processes. After installation, the name can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [user](#p-125) directive. By default, a group name is set to the name of an unprivileged user.

設定工作進程將使用其憑證的群組的名稱。安裝後，始終可以使用 [user](#p-125) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更名稱。預設情況下，群組名稱設定為非特權使用者的名稱。

`` --build=`*name*` ``

`` --build=`*名字*` ``

sets an optional nginx build name.

設定可選的 nginx 建置名稱。

`` --builddir=`*path*` ``

`` --builddir=`*路徑*` ``

sets a build directory.

設定建置目錄。

`--with-select_module`  
`--without-select_module`

enables or disables building a module that allows the server to work with the `select()` method. This module is built automatically if the platform does not appear to support more appropriate methods such as kqueue, epoll, or /dev/poll.

啟用或停用建置允許伺服器使用`select()`方法的模組。如果平台似乎不支援更合適的方法（例如 kqueue、epoll 或 /dev/poll），則會自動建立此模組。

`--with-poll_module`  
`--without-poll_module`

enables or disables building a module that allows the server to work with the `poll()` method. This module is built automatically if the platform does not appear to support more appropriate methods such as kqueue, epoll, or /dev/poll.

啟用或停用建置允許伺服器使用`poll()`方法的模組。如果平台似乎不支援更合適的方法（例如 kqueue、epoll 或 /dev/poll），則會自動建立此模組。

`--with-control-api`

enables the use of [nginx control REST API](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx/admin-guide/basic-functionality/runtime-control#control-api) (1.31.5), see also the [`-l`](#p-166) command-line parameter.

啟用 [nginx 控制REST API](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx/admin-guide/basic-functionality/runtime-control#control-api) (1.31.5)，另請參閱 [`-l`](#p-166) 命令列參數。

`--with-threads`

enables the use of [thread pools](#p-125).

允許使用[線程池](#p-125)。

`--with-file-aio`

enables the use of [asynchronous file I/O](#p-056) (AIO) on FreeBSD and Linux.

允許在 FreeBSD 和 Linux 上使用 [非同步檔案 I/O](#p-056) (AIO)。

`--with-http_ssl_module`

enables building a module that adds the [HTTPS protocol support](#p-098) to an HTTP server. This module is not built by default. The OpenSSL library is required to build and run this module.

允許建構一個模組，將[HTTPS協定支援](#p-098)加入到HTTP伺服器。預設情況下不建置此模組。建置和運行此模組需要 OpenSSL 庫。

`--with-http_v2_module`

enables building a module that provides support for [HTTP/2](#p-108). This module is not built by default.

允許建構支援 [HTTP/2](#p-108) 的模組。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_v3_module`

enables building a module that provides support for [HTTP/3](#p-109). This module is not built by default. The OpenSSL library that provides HTTP/3 support is required to build and run this module.

允許建構支援 [HTTP/3](#p-109) 的模組。預設情況下不建置此模組。建置和運行此模組需要提供 HTTP/3 支援的 OpenSSL 庫。

`--with-http_realip_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_realip\_module](#p-088) module that changes the client address to the address sent in the specified header field. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_realip\_module](#p-088) 模組，將客戶端位址變更為在指定標頭欄位中傳送的位址。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_addition_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_addition\_module](#p-047) module that adds text before and after a response. This module is not built by default.

允許建構 [ngx\_http\_addition\_module](#p-047) 模組，在回應之前和之後加入文字。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_xslt_module`  
`--with-http_xslt_module=dynamic`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_xslt\_module](#p-110) module that transforms XML responses using one or more XSLT stylesheets. This module is not built by default. The [libxml2](http://xmlsoft.org/) and [libxslt](http://xmlsoft.org/XSLT/) libraries are required to build and run this module.

允許建構 [ngx\_http\_xslt\_module](#p-110) 模組，該模組使用一個或多個 XSLT 樣式表轉換 XML 回應。預設情況下不建置此模組。建置和執行此模組需要 [libxml2](http://xmlsoft.org/) 和 [libxslt](http://xmlsoft.org/XSLT/) 函式庫。

`--with-http_image_filter_module`  
`--with-http_image_filter_module=dynamic`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_image\_filter\_module](#p-070) module that transforms images in JPEG, GIF, PNG, and WebP formats. This module is not built by default.

允許建構 [ngx\_http\_image\_filter\_module](#p-070) 模組，該模組可將影像轉換為 JPEG, GIF, PNG 和 WebP 格式。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_geoip_module`  
`--with-http_geoip_module=dynamic`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_geoip\_module](#p-063) module that creates variables depending on the client IP address and the precompiled [MaxMind](http://www.maxmind.com/) databases. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_geoip\_module](#p-063) 模組，該模組根據客戶端 IP 位址和預先編譯的 [MaxMind](http://www.maxmind.com/) 資料庫建立變數。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_sub_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_sub\_module](#p-101) module that modifies a response by replacing one specified string by another. This module is not built by default.

允許建構 [ngx\_http\_sub\_module](#p-101) 模組，該模組透過用另一個指定字串取代一個指定字串來修改回應。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_dav_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_dav\_module](#p-057) module that provides file management automation via the WebDAV protocol. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_dav\_module](#p-057) 模組，該模組透過 WebDAV 協定提供檔案管理自動化。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_flv_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_flv\_module](#p-061) module that provides pseudo-streaming server-side support for Flash Video (FLV) files. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_flv\_module](#p-061) 模組，為 Flash 視訊 (FLV) 檔案提供偽流伺服器端支援。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_mp4_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_mp4\_module](#p-081) module that provides pseudo-streaming server-side support for MP4 files. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_mp4\_module](#p-081) 模組，為 MP4 檔案提供偽流伺服器端支援。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_gunzip_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_gunzip\_module](#p-065) module that decompresses responses with “`Content-Encoding: gzip`” for clients that do not support “gzip” encoding method. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_gunzip\_module](#p-065) 模組，為不支援「gzip」編碼方法的客戶端使用「`Content-Encoding: gzip`」解壓縮回應。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_gzip_static_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_gzip\_static\_module](#p-067) module that enables sending precompressed files with the “`.gz`” filename extension instead of regular files. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_gzip\_static\_module](#p-067) 模組，該模組允許發送帶有「`.gz`」檔案副檔名的預壓縮檔案而不是常規檔案。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_auth_request_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_auth\_request\_module](#p-051) module that implements client authorization based on the result of a subrequest. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_auth\_request\_module](#p-051) 模組，該模組根據子請求的結果實現客戶端授權。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_random_index_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_random\_index\_module](#p-087) module that processes requests ending with the slash character (‘`/`’) and picks a random file in a directory to serve as an index file. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_random\_index\_module](#p-087) 模組，該模組處理以斜槓字元（‘`/`’）結尾的請求，並在目錄中選擇一個隨機檔案作為索引檔案。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_secure_link_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_secure\_link\_module](#p-092) module. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_secure\_link\_module](#p-092) 模組。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_degradation_module`

enables building the `ngx_http_degradation_module` module. This module is not built by default.

能夠建造`ngx_http_degradation_module`模組。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_slice_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_slice\_module](#p-094) module that splits a request into subrequests, each returning a certain range of response. The module provides more effective caching of big responses. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_slice\_module](#p-094) 模組，該模組將請求拆分為子請求，每個子請求傳回一定範圍的回應。此模組提供更有效的大響應快取。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_stub_status_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_stub\_status\_module](#p-100) module that provides access to basic status information. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_stub\_status\_module](#p-100) 模組，該模組提供對基本狀態資訊的存取。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-http_json_module`

enables building the [ngx\_http\_json\_module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_json_module.html) module that creates variables with values extracted from a JSON document. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_http\_json\_module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_json_module.html) 模組，該模組使用從 JSON 文件中提取的值建立變數。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--without-http_charset_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_charset\_module](#p-055) module that adds the specified charset to the “Content-Type”（內容類型） response header field and can additionally convert data from one charset to another.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_charset\_module](#p-055) 模組，該模組將指定的字元集新增至 “Content-Type”（內容類型） 回應頭字段，並且還可以將資料從一種字元集轉換為另一種字元集。

`--without-http_gzip_module`

disables building a module that [compresses responses](#p-066) of an HTTP server. The zlib library is required to build and run this module.

禁用建置[壓縮回應]HTTP伺服器的(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_gzip_module.html)的模組。建置和運行該模組需要 zlib 庫。

`--without-http_ssi_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_ssi\_module](#p-097) module that processes SSI (Server Side Includes) commands in responses passing through it.

禁用建置 [ngx\_http\_ssi\_module](#p-097) 模組，該模組處理通過它的回應中的 SSI（伺服器端包含）命令。

`--without-http_userid_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_userid\_module](#p-106) module that sets cookies suitable for client identification.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_userid\_module](#p-106) 模組來設定適合用戶端辨識的 cookie。

`--without-http_access_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_access\_module](#p-045) module that allows limiting access to certain client addresses.

禁用建置允許限制對某些客戶端位址的存取的 [ngx\_http\_access\_module](#p-045) 模組。

`--without-http_auth_basic_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_auth\_basic\_module](#p-049) module that allows limiting access to resources by validating the user name and password using the “HTTP Basic Authentication”（HTTP 基本驗證） protocol.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_auth\_basic\_module](#p-049) 模組，該模組允許透過使用 “HTTP Basic Authentication”（HTTP 基本驗證） 協定驗證使用者名稱和密碼來限制對資源的存取。

`--without-http_mirror_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_mirror\_module](#p-080) module that implements mirroring of an original request by creating background mirror subrequests.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_mirror\_module](#p-080) 模組，該模組透過建立後台鏡像子請求來實現原始請求的鏡像。

`--without-http_autoindex_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_autoindex\_module](#p-053) module that processes requests ending with the slash character (‘`/`’) and produces a directory listing in case the [ngx\_http\_index\_module](#p-071) module cannot find an index file.

禁用建置 [ngx\_http\_autoindex\_module](#p-053) 處理以斜線字元結尾的請求的模組（‘`/`’）並產生目錄列表，以防 [ngx\_http\_index\_module](#p-071) 模組找不到索引檔。

`--without-http_geo_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_geo\_module](#p-062) module that creates variables with values depending on the client IP address.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_geo\_module](#p-062) 模組，該模組根據客戶端 IP 位址建立其值的變數。

`--without-http_map_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_map\_module](#p-078) module that creates variables with values depending on values of other variables.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_map\_module](#p-078) 模組，該模組建立其值取決於其他變數值的變數。

`--without-http_split_clients_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_split\_clients\_module](#p-096) module that creates variables for A/B testing.

停用建置為 A/B 測試建立變數的 [ngx\_http\_split\_clients\_module](#p-096) 模組。

`--without-http_referer_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_referer\_module](#p-089) module that can block access to a site for requests with invalid values in the “Referer”（推薦人） header field.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_referer\_module](#p-089) 模組，該模組可以阻止對 “Referer”（推薦人） 標頭欄位中具有無效值的請求存取網站。

`--without-http_rewrite_module`

disables building a module that allows an HTTP server to [redirect requests and change URI of requests](#p-090). The PCRE library is required to build and run this module.

停用建置允許HTTP伺服器[重定向請求並更改請求的URI](#p-090)的模組。建置和運行此模組需要PCRE庫。

`--without-http_proxy_module`

disables building an HTTP server [proxying module](#p-085).

禁用建置HTTP伺服器[代理模組](#p-085)。

`--without-http_fastcgi_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_fastcgi\_module](#p-060) module that passes requests to a FastCGI server.

停用建置將請求傳遞至 FastCGI 伺服器的 [ngx\_http\_fastcgi\_module](#p-060) 模組。

`--without-http_uwsgi_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_uwsgi\_module](#p-107) module that passes requests to a uwsgi server.

停用建置將請求傳遞到 uwsgi 伺服器的 [ngx\_http\_uwsgi\_module](#p-107) 模組。

`--without-http_scgi_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_scgi\_module](#p-091) module that passes requests to an SCGI server.

停用建置將請求傳遞到 SCGI 伺服器的 [ngx\_http\_scgi\_module](#p-091) 模組。

`--without-http_grpc_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_grpc\_module](#p-064) module that passes requests to a gRPC server.

停用建置將請求傳遞到 gRPC 伺服器的 [ngx\_http\_grpc\_module](#p-064) 模組。

`--without-http_tunnel_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_tunnel\_module](#p-102) module that handles HTTP/1.1 CONNECT requests and establishes an end-to-end virtual connection.

停用建置處理 HTTP/1.1 CONNECT 請求並建立端對端虛擬連線的 [ngx\_http\_tunnel\_module](#p-102) 模組。

`--without-http_memcached_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_memcached\_module](#p-079) module that obtains responses from a memcached server.

停用建置從 memcached 伺服器取得回應的 [ngx\_http\_memcached\_module](#p-079) 模組。

`--without-http_limit_conn_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_limit\_conn\_module](#p-075) module that limits the number of connections per key, for example, the number of connections from a single IP address.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_limit\_conn\_module](#p-075) 模組，該模組限制每個鍵的連接數，例如來自單一 IP 位址的連接數。

`--without-http_limit_req_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_limit\_req\_module](#p-076) module that limits the request processing rate per key, for example, the processing rate of requests coming from a single IP address.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_limit\_req\_module](#p-076) 模組，該模組限制每個金鑰的請求處理速率，例如來自單一 IP 位址的請求的處理速率。

`--without-http_empty_gif_module`

disables building a module that [emits single-pixel transparent GIF](#p-058).

禁用建置[發出單像素透明GIF](#p-058)的模組。

`--without-http_browser_module`

disables building the [ngx\_http\_browser\_module](#p-054) module that creates variables whose values depend on the value of the “User-Agent”（使用者代理） request header field.

停用建置 [ngx\_http\_browser\_module](#p-054) 模組，該模組建立其值取決於 “User-Agent”（使用者代理） 請求標頭欄位的值的變數。

`--without-http_upstream_hash_module`

disables building a module that implements the [hash](#p-105) load balancing method.

停用建置實作 [hash](#p-105) 負載平衡方法的模組。

`--without-http_upstream_ip_hash_module`

disables building a module that implements the [ip\_hash](#p-105) load balancing method.

停用建置實作 [ip\_hash](#p-105) 負載平衡方法的模組。

`--without-http_upstream_least_conn_module`

disables building a module that implements the [least\_conn](#p-105) load balancing method.

停用建置實作 [least\_conn](#p-105) 負載平衡方法的模組。

`--without-http_upstream_least_time_module`

disables building a module that implements the [least\_time](#p-105) load balancing method.

停用建置實作 [least\_time](#p-105) 負載平衡方法的模組。

`--without-http_upstream_random_module`

disables building a module that implements the [random](#p-105) load balancing method.

停用建置實作 [random](#p-105) 負載平衡方法的模組。

`--without-http_upstream_keepalive_module`

disables building a module that provides [caching of connections](#p-105) to upstream servers.

停用建置向上游伺服器提供[連線快取](#p-105)的模組。

`--without-http_upstream_zone_module`

disables building a module that makes it possible to store run-time state of an upstream group in a shared memory [zone](#p-105).

停用建置一個模組，該模組可以將上游群組的運行時狀態儲存在共享記憶體[區域](#p-105)中。

`--without-http_upstream_sticky_module`

disables building a module that provides [session affinity](#p-105) to upstream servers.

停用建置向上游伺服器提供[會話關聯](#p-105)的模組。

`--with-http_perl_module`  
`--with-http_perl_module=dynamic`

enables building the [embedded Perl module](#p-084). This module is not built by default.

允許建構[嵌入式 Perl 模組](#p-084)。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`` --with-perl_modules_path=`*path*` ``

`` --with-perl_modules_path=`*路徑*` ``

defines a directory that will keep Perl modules.

定義一個儲存 Perl 模組的目錄。

`` --with-perl=`*path*` ``

`` --with-perl=`*路徑*` ``

sets the name of the Perl binary.

設定 Perl 二進位檔案的名稱。

`` --http-log-path=`*path*` ``

`` --http-log-path=`*路徑*` ``

sets the name of the primary request log file of the HTTP server. After installation, the file name can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [access\_log](#p-077) directive. By default the file is named `` `*prefix*`/logs/access.log ``.

設定HTTP伺服器的主請求日誌檔案的名稱。安裝後，始終可以使用 [access\_log](#p-077) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更檔名。預設情況下，檔案名稱為「` `*prefix*`/logs/access.log `」。

`` --http-client-body-temp-path=`*path*` ``

`` --http-client-body-temp-path=`*路徑*` ``

defines a directory for storing temporary files that hold client request bodies. After installation, the directory can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [client\_body\_temp\_path](#p-056) directive. By default the directory is named `` `*prefix*`/client_body_temp ``.

定義一個目錄，用於儲存保存客戶端請求主體的暫存檔案。安裝後，始終可以使用 [client\_body\_temp\_path](#p-056) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更目錄。預設情況下，該目錄名為「` `*prefix*`/client_body_temp `」。

`` --http-proxy-temp-path=`*path*` ``

`` --http-proxy-temp-path=`*路徑*` ``

defines a directory for storing temporary files with data received from proxied servers. After installation, the directory can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [proxy\_temp\_path](#p-085) directive. By default the directory is named `` `*prefix*`/proxy_temp ``.

定義一個目錄，用於儲存帶有從代理伺服器接收到的資料的暫存檔案。安裝後，始終可以使用 [proxy\_temp\_path](#p-085) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更目錄。預設情況下，該目錄名為「` `*prefix*`/proxy_temp `」。

`` --http-fastcgi-temp-path=`*path*` ``

`` --http-fastcgi-temp-path=`*路徑*` ``

defines a directory for storing temporary files with data received from FastCGI servers. After installation, the directory can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [fastcgi\_temp\_path](#p-060) directive. By default the directory is named `` `*prefix*`/fastcgi_temp ``.

定義目錄，用於儲存從 FastCGI 伺服器接收的資料的暫存檔案。安裝後，始終可以使用 [fastcgi\_temp\_path](#p-060) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更目錄。預設情況下，該目錄名為「` `*prefix*`/fastcgi_temp `」。

`` --http-uwsgi-temp-path=`*path*` ``

`` --http-uwsgi-temp-path=`*路徑*` ``

defines a directory for storing temporary files with data received from uwsgi servers. After installation, the directory can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [uwsgi\_temp\_path](#p-107) directive. By default the directory is named `` `*prefix*`/uwsgi_temp ``.

定義一個目錄，用於儲存從 uwsgi 伺服器接收的資料的暫存檔案。安裝後，始終可以使用 [uwsgi\_temp\_path](#p-107) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更目錄。預設情況下，該目錄名為「` `*prefix*`/uwsgi_temp `」。

`` --http-scgi-temp-path=`*path*` ``

`` --http-scgi-temp-path=`*路徑*` ``

defines a directory for storing temporary files with data received from SCGI servers. After installation, the directory can always be changed in the `nginx.conf` configuration file using the [scgi\_temp\_path](#p-091) directive. By default the directory is named `` `*prefix*`/scgi_temp ``.

定義目錄，用於儲存從SCGI伺服器接收到的資料的暫存檔案。安裝後，始終可以使用 [scgi\_temp\_path](#p-091) 指令在 `nginx.conf` 設定檔中變更目錄。預設情況下，該目錄名為「` `*prefix*`/scgi_temp `」。

`--without-http`

disables the [HTTP](#p-056) server.

禁用 [HTTP](#p-056) 伺服器。

`--without-http-cache`

disables HTTP cache.

禁用 HTTP 快取。

`--with-mail`  
`--with-mail=dynamic`

enables POP3/IMAP4/SMTP [mail proxy](#p-117) server.

啟用POP3/IMAP4/SMTP[郵件代理](#p-117)伺服器。

`--with-mail_ssl_module`

enables building a module that adds the [SSL/TLS protocol support](#p-123) to the mail proxy server. This module is not built by default. The OpenSSL library is required to build and run this module.

允許建構一個將[SSL/TLS協定支援](#p-123)加入到郵件代理伺服器的模組。預設情況下不建置此模組。建置和運行此模組需要 OpenSSL 庫。

`--without-mail_pop3_module`

disables the [POP3](#p-119) protocol in mail proxy server.

禁用郵件代理伺服器中的 [POP3](#p-119) 協定。

`--without-mail_imap_module`

disables the [IMAP](#p-118) protocol in mail proxy server.

禁用郵件代理伺服器中的 [IMAP](#p-118) 協定。

`--without-mail_smtp_module`

disables the [SMTP](#p-122) protocol in mail proxy server.

禁用郵件代理伺服器中的 [SMTP](#p-122) 協定。

`--with-stream`  
`--with-stream=dynamic`

enables building the [stream module](#p-142) for generic TCP/UDP proxying and load balancing. This module is not built by default.

啟用建置[流模組](#p-142)以實現通用TCP/UDP代理和負載平衡。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-stream_ssl_module`

enables building a module that adds the [SSL/TLS protocol support](#p-160) to the stream module. This module is not built by default. The OpenSSL library is required to build and run this module.

允許建構一個將 [SSL/TLS 協定支援](#p-160) 新增到流模組的模組。預設情況下不建置此模組。建置和運行此模組需要 OpenSSL 庫。

`--with-stream_realip_module`

enables building the [ngx\_stream\_realip\_module](#p-156) module that changes the client address to the address sent in the PROXY protocol header. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_stream\_realip\_module](#p-156) 模組，將客戶端位址變更為在 PROXY 協定頭中傳送的位址。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-stream_geoip_module`  
`--with-stream_geoip_module=dynamic`

enables building the [ngx\_stream\_geoip\_module](#p-144) module that creates variables depending on the client IP address and the precompiled [MaxMind](http://www.maxmind.com/) databases. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_stream\_geoip\_module](#p-144) 模組，該模組根據客戶端 IP 位址和預先編譯的 [MaxMind](http://www.maxmind.com/) 資料庫建立變數。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--with-stream_ssl_preread_module`

enables building the [ngx\_stream\_ssl\_preread\_module](#p-161) module that allows extracting information from the [ClientHello](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5246#section-7.4.1.2) message without terminating SSL/TLS. This module is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_stream\_ssl\_preread\_module](#p-161) 模組，該模組允許從 [ClientHello](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5246#section-7.4.1.2) 訊息中提取訊息，而無需終止 SSL/TLS。預設情況下不建置此模組。

`--without-stream_limit_conn_module`

disables building the [ngx\_stream\_limit\_conn\_module](#p-147) module that limits the number of connections per key, for example, the number of connections from a single IP address.

停用建置 [ngx\_stream\_limit\_conn\_module](#p-147) 模組，該模組限制每個金鑰的連接數，例如來自單一 IP 位址的連接數。

`--without-stream_access_module`

disables building the [ngx\_stream\_access\_module](#p-141) module that allows limiting access to certain client addresses.

禁用建置允許限制對某些客戶端位址的存取的 [ngx\_stream\_access\_module](#p-141) 模組。

`--without-stream_geo_module`

disables building the [ngx\_stream\_geo\_module](#p-143) module that creates variables with values depending on the client IP address.

停用建置 [ngx\_stream\_geo\_module](#p-143) 模組，該模組根據客戶端 IP 位址建立其值的變數。

`--without-stream_map_module`

disables building the [ngx\_stream\_map\_module](#p-149) module that creates variables with values depending on values of other variables.

停用建置 [ngx\_stream\_map\_module](#p-149) 模組，該模組建立其值取決於其他變數值的變數。

`--without-stream_split_clients_module`

disables building the [ngx\_stream\_split\_clients\_module](#p-159) module that creates variables for A/B testing.

停用建置為 A/B 測試建立變數的 [ngx\_stream\_split\_clients\_module](#p-159) 模組。

`--without-stream_return_module`

disables building the [ngx\_stream\_return\_module](#p-157) module that sends some specified value to the client and then closes the connection.

停用建置 [ngx\_stream\_return\_module](#p-157) 模組，該模組將某些指定值傳送至客戶端，然後關閉連線。

`--without-stream_pass_module`

disables building the [ngx\_stream\_pass\_module](#p-153) module that passes accepted connections to other listening sockets.

停用建置 [ngx\_stream\_pass\_module](#p-153) 模組，該模組將接受的連接傳遞到其他偵聽套接字。

`--without-stream_set_module`

disables building the [ngx\_stream\_set\_module](#p-158) module that sets a value for a variable.

停用建構為變數設定值的 [ngx\_stream\_set\_module](#p-158) 模組。

`--without-stream_upstream_hash_module`

disables building a module that implements the [hash](#p-163) load balancing method.

停用建置實作 [hash](#p-163) 負載平衡方法的模組。

`--without-stream_upstream_least_conn_module`

disables building a module that implements the [least\_conn](#p-163) load balancing method.

停用建置實作 [least\_conn](#p-163) 負載平衡方法的模組。

`--without-stream_upstream_least_time_module`

disables building a module that implements the [least\_time](#p-163) load balancing method.

停用建置實作 [least\_time](#p-163) 負載平衡方法的模組。

`--without-stream_upstream_random_module`

disables building a module that implements the [random](#p-163) load balancing method.

停用建置實作 [random](#p-163) 負載平衡方法的模組。

`--without-stream_upstream_zone_module`

disables building a module that makes it possible to store run-time state of an upstream group in a shared memory [zone](#p-163).

停用建置一個模組，該模組可以將上游群組的運行時狀態儲存在共享記憶體[區域](#p-163)中。

`--with-google_perftools_module`

enables building the [ngx\_google\_perftools\_module](#p-126) module that enables profiling of nginx worker processes using [Google Performance Tools](https://github.com/gperftools/gperftools). The module is intended for nginx developers and is not built by default.

允許建置 [ngx\_google\_perftools\_module](#p-126) 模組，該模組允許使用 [Google Performance Tools](https://github.com/gperftools/gperftools) 對 nginx 工作流程進行分析。此模組適用於 nginx 開發人員，預設不建置。

`--with-cpp_test_module`

enables building the `ngx_cpp_test_module` module.

能够构建`ngx_cpp_test_module`模块。

`` --add-module=`*path*` ``

`` --add-module=`*路徑*` ``

enables an external module.

啟用外部模組。

`` --add-dynamic-module=`*path*` ``

`` --add-dynamic-module=`*路径*` ``

enables an external dynamic module.

启用外部动态模块。

`--with-compat`

enables dynamic modules compatibility.

启用动态模块兼容性。

`` --with-cc=`*path*` ``

`` --with-cc=`*路径*` ``

sets the name of the C compiler.

设置 C 编译器的名称。

`` --with-cpp=`*path*` ``

`` --with-cpp=`*路径*` ``

sets the name of the C preprocessor.

設定 C 預處理器的名稱。

`` --with-cc-opt=`*parameters*` ``

`` --with-cc-opt=`*参数*` ``

sets additional parameters that will be added to the CFLAGS variable. When using the system PCRE library under FreeBSD, `--with-cc-opt="-I /usr/local/include"` should be specified. If the number of files supported by `select()` needs to be increased it can also be specified here such as this: `--with-cc-opt="-D FD_SETSIZE=2048"`.

設定將會加入 CFLAGS 變數的附加參數。在FreeBSD下使用系統PCRE函式庫時，需指定`--with-cc-opt="-I /usr/local/include"`。如果需要增加`select()`支援的檔案數量，也可以在這裡指定，例如：`--with-cc-opt="-D FD_SETSIZE=2048"`。

`` --with-ld-opt=`*parameters*` ``

`` --with-ld-opt=`*參數*` ``

sets additional parameters that will be used during linking. When using the system PCRE library under FreeBSD, `--with-ld-opt="-L /usr/local/lib"` should be specified.

设置链接期间将使用的附加参数。在FreeBSD下使用系統PCRE函式庫時，需指定`--with-ld-opt="-L /usr/local/lib"`。

`` --with-cpu-opt=`*cpu*` ``

`` --with-cpu-opt=`*CPU*` ``

enables building per specified CPU: `pentium`, `pentiumpro`, `pentium3`, `pentium4`, `athlon`, `opteron`, `sparc32`, `sparc64`, `ppc64`.

允許按照指定的CPU: `pentium`, `pentiumpro`, `pentium3`, `pentium4`, `athlon`, `opteron`, `sparc32`, `sparc64`, `ppc64`進行建造。

`--without-pcre`

disables the usage of the PCRE library.

禁用PCRE庫的使用。

`--with-pcre`

forces the usage of the PCRE library.

強制使用PCRE庫。

`` --with-pcre=`*path*` ``

`` --with-pcre=`*路径*` ``

sets the path to the sources of the PCRE library. The library distribution needs to be downloaded from the [PCRE](http://www.pcre.org/) site and extracted. The rest is done by nginx’s `./configure` and `make`. The library is required for regular expressions support in the [location](#p-056) directive and for the [ngx\_http\_rewrite\_module](#p-090) module.

設定PCRE庫的來源路徑。庫發行版需從 [PCRE](http://www.pcre.org/) 網站下載並解壓縮。剩下的由nginx的`./configure`和`make`完成。 [location](#p-056) 指令和 [ngx\_http\_rewrite\_module](#p-090) 模組中的正規表示式支援需要該函式庫。

`` --with-pcre-opt=`*parameters*` ``

`` --with-pcre-opt=`*參數*` ``

sets additional build options for PCRE.

為 PCRE 設定附加建置選項。

`--with-pcre-jit`

builds the PCRE library with “just-in-time compilation” support (1.1.12, the [pcre\_jit](#p-125) directive).

建構具有「即時編譯」支援的PCRE函式庫（1.1.12，[pcre\_jit](#p-125)指令）。

`--without-pcre2`

disables use of the PCRE2 library instead of the original PCRE library (1.21.5).

禁用使用 PCRE2 庫而不是原始 PCRE 庫 (1.21.5)。

`` --with-zlib=`*path*` ``

`` --with-zlib=`*路徑*` ``

sets the path to the sources of the zlib library. The library distribution needs to be downloaded from the [zlib](http://zlib.net/) site and extracted. The rest is done by nginx’s `./configure` and `make`. The library is required for the [ngx\_http\_gzip\_module](#p-066) module.

設定 zlib 庫來源的路徑。庫發行版需要從 [zlib](http://zlib.net/) 網站下載並解壓縮。剩下的由nginx的`./configure`和`make`完成。 [ngx\_http\_gzip\_module](#p-066) 模組需要該函式庫。

`` --with-zlib-opt=`*parameters*` ``

`` --with-zlib-opt=`*參數*` ``

sets additional build options for zlib.

為 zlib 設定附加建置選項。

`` --with-zlib-asm=`*cpu*` ``

`` --with-zlib-asm=`*CPU*` ``

enables the use of the zlib assembler sources optimized for one of the specified CPUs: `pentium`, `pentiumpro`.

允許使用針對指定 CPU 之一最佳化的 zlib 組譯器來源：`pentium`, `pentiumpro`。

`--with-libatomic`

forces the libatomic\_ops library usage.

強制使用 libatomic\_ops 庫。

`` --with-libatomic=`*path*` ``

`` --with-libatomic=`*路徑*` ``

sets the path to the libatomic\_ops library sources.

設定 libatomic\_ops 庫來源的路徑。

`` --with-openssl=`*path*` ``

`` --with-openssl=`*路徑*` ``

sets the path to the OpenSSL library sources.

設定 OpenSSL 庫來源的路徑。

`` --with-openssl-opt=`*parameters*` ``

`` --with-openssl-opt=`*參數*` ``

sets additional build options for OpenSSL.

為 OpenSSL 設定附加建置選項。

`--with-debug`

enables the [debugging log](#p-027).

啟用[調試日誌](#p-027)。

Example of parameters usage (all of this needs to be typed in one line):

參數使用範例（所有這些都需要在一行中輸入）：

> ```
> ./configure
>
> ./配置
>     --sbin-path=/usr/local/nginx/nginx
>     --conf-path=/usr/local/nginx/nginx.conf
>     --pid-path=/usr/local/nginx/nginx.pid
>     --with-http_ssl_module
>     --with-pcre=../pcre2-10.39
>     --with-zlib=../zlib-1.3
> ```

After configuration, nginx is compiled and installed using `make`.

配置完成後，使用`make`編譯並安裝nginx。

[GitHub](https://github.com/) is used to store source code. The [repository](https://github.com/nginx/nginx) can be cloned with the following command:

**Formatting Changes｜格式更改**

Changes should be formatted according to the [code style](#p-028) used by nginx. Sometimes, there is no clear rule; in such cases examine how existing nginx sources are formatted and mimic this style. Changes will more likely be accepted if style corresponds to the surrounding code.

更改的格式應根據 nginx 使用的[程式碼風格](#p-028)。有時，沒有明確的規則；在這種情況下，請檢查現有 nginx 來源的格式並模仿這種風格。如果樣式與周圍的程式碼相對應，則變更將更有可能被接受。

[Commit](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/about-commits) the changes in your nginx GitHub fork. Please ensure that the specified [e-mail](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/getting-started-with-git/setting-your-username-in-git) address and real name of the author are correct.

[提交](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/about-commits) nginx GitHub 分支中的變更。請確保指定的[電子郵件](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/getting-started-with-git/setting-your-username-in-git)地址和作者真實姓名正確。

The commit message should have a single-line synopsis followed by verbose description after an empty line. Limit the subject and commit message body lines to 72 characters. The resulting commit can be obtained using the `git show` command:

提交訊息應該有一個單行概要，空行後面跟著詳細描述。將主題和提交訊息正文行限制為 72 個字元。可以使用 `git show` 指令取得結果提交：

> commit 067d766f210ee914b750d79d9284cbf8801058f3

>

>

> diff --git a/src/http/ngx_http_core_module.c b/src/http/ngx_http_core_module.c
> index 0c46106db..53ddf39bb 100644
>
> 索引 0c46106db..53ddf39bb 100644
> --- a/src/http/ngx_http_core_module.c

>      sr->method = NGX_HTTP_GET;
>

> +    sr->port = r->port;  
       sr->連接埠 = r->連接埠；

**Before Submitting｜提交前**

Several points are worth to consider before submitting changes:

在提交更改之前，有幾點值得考慮：

-   The proposed changes should work properly on a wide range of [supported platforms](#p-176).  
    提議的更改應該在廣泛的[支援的平台](#p-176)上正常工作。
-   Try to make it clear why the suggested change is needed, and provide a use case, if possible.  
    嘗試闡明為什麼需要建議的更改，並提供用例（如果可能）。
-   Passing your changes through the test suite is a good way to ensure that they do not cause a regression. The [repository](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-tests) with tests can be cloned with the following command:  
    透過測試套件傳遞您的更改是確保它們不會導致回歸的好方法。可以使用以下命令克隆帶有測試的[存儲庫](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-tests)：

    > ```

建議的變更應作為 [pull request](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/proposing-changes-to-your-work-with-pull-requests/creating-a-pull-request-from-a-fork) 從您的 fork 提交到 [nginx 儲存庫](https://github.com/nginx/nginx)。

<a id="p-026"></a>

#### Controlling nginx｜控制 Nginx

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/control.html>

##### Controlling nginx｜控制 Nginx

|   |
| --- |
| [Changing Configuration](#p-026)<br>[Rotating Log-files](#p-026)<br>[Upgrading Executable on the Fly](#p-026)<br>[更改設定](#p-026)<br>[輪替日誌檔](#p-026)<br>[動態升級執行檔](#p-026) |

nginx can be controlled with signals. The process ID of the master process is written to the file `/usr/local/nginx/logs/nginx.pid` by default. This name may be changed at configuration time, or in `nginx.conf` using the [pid](#p-125) directive. The master process supports the following signals:

nginx可以用訊號來控制。主進程的進程ID預設寫入檔案`/usr/local/nginx/logs/nginx.pid`。此名稱可以在設定時更改，或在 `nginx.conf` 中使用 [pid](#p-125) 指令更改。主進程支援以下信號：

> |   |   |
> | --- | --- |
> | TERM, INT | fast shutdown<br>快速關機 |
> | QUIT | graceful shutdown<br>優雅關機 |
> | HUP | changing configuration, keeping up with a changed time zone (only for FreeBSD and Linux), starting new worker processes with a new configuration, graceful shutdown of old worker processes<br>更改配置、跟上更改的時區（僅適用於 FreeBSD 和 Linux）、使用新配置啟動新工作進程、正常關閉舊工作進程 |
> | USR1 | re-opening log files<br>重新開啟日誌檔 |
> | USR2 | upgrading an executable file<br>升級執行檔 |
> | WINCH | graceful shutdown of worker processes<br>工作進程的正常關閉 |

Individual worker processes can be controlled with signals as well, though it is not required. The supported signals are:

單一工作進程也可以透過訊號進行控制，但這不是必要的。支援的訊號有：

> |   |   |
> | --- | --- |
> | TERM, INT | fast shutdown<br>快速關機 |
> | QUIT | graceful shutdown<br>優雅關機 |
> | USR1 | re-opening log files<br>重新開啟日誌檔 |
> | WINCH | abnormal termination for debugging (requires [debug\_points](#p-125) to be enabled)<br>調試異常終止（需啟用 [debug\_points](#p-125)） |

**Changing Configuration｜更改配置**

In order for nginx to re-read the configuration file, a HUP signal should be sent to the master process. The master process first checks the syntax validity, then tries to apply new configuration, that is, to open log files and new listen sockets. If this fails, it rolls back changes and continues to work with old configuration. If this succeeds, it starts new worker processes, and sends messages to old worker processes requesting them to shut down gracefully. Old worker processes close listen sockets and continue to service old clients. After all clients are serviced, old worker processes are shut down.

為了讓nginx重新讀取設定文件，需要向master進程發送一個HUP訊號。主程序首先檢查語法有效性，然後嘗試套用新的配置，即開啟日誌檔案和新的監聽套接字。如果失敗，它將回滾更改並繼續使用舊配置。如果成功，它將啟動新的工作進程，並向舊的工作進程發送訊息，請求它們正常關閉。舊的工作程序關閉監聽套接字並繼續為舊客戶端提供服務。為所有客戶端提供服務後，舊的工作進程將會關閉。

Let’s illustrate this by example. Imagine that nginx is run on FreeBSD and the command

讓我們透過例子來說明這一點。想像 nginx 在 FreeBSD 上運行並且命令

> ```
> ps axw -o pid,ppid,user,%cpu,vsz,wchan,command | egrep '(nginx|PID)'
>
> ps axw -o pid,ppid,用戶,%cpu,vsz,wchan,指令 | egrep '(nginx|PID)'
> ```

produces the following output:

產生以下輸出：

> ```
>   PID  PPID USER    %CPU   VSZ WCHAN  COMMAND
> 33126     1 root     0.0  1148 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 33126 1 root 0.0 1148 暫停 nginx：主進程 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 33127 33126 nobody   0.0  1380 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33127 33126 無人0.0 1380 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> 33128 33126 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33128 33126 無人0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> 33129 33126 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33129 33126 無人0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> ```

If HUP is sent to the master process, the output becomes:

如果HUP傳送到主進程，則輸出變為：

> ```
>   PID  PPID USER    %CPU   VSZ WCHAN  COMMAND
> 33126     1 root     0.0  1164 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 33126 1 root 0.0 1164 暫停 nginx：主進程 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 33129 33126 nobody   0.0  1380 kqread nginx: worker process is shutting down (nginx)
>
> 33129 33126 無人0.0 1380 kqread nginx：工作進程正在關閉（nginx）
> 33134 33126 nobody   0.0  1368 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33134 33126 無人0.0 1368 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> 33135 33126 nobody   0.0  1368 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33135 33126 無人0.0 1368 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> 33136 33126 nobody   0.0  1368 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33136 33126 無人0.0 1368 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> ```

One of the old worker processes with PID 33129 still continues to work. After some time it exits:

具有 PID 33129 的舊工作進程之一仍在繼續工作。一段時間後退出：

> ```
>   PID  PPID USER    %CPU   VSZ WCHAN  COMMAND
> 33126     1 root     0.0  1164 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 33126 1 root 0.0 1164 暫停 nginx：主進程 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 33134 33126 nobody   0.0  1368 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33134 33126 無人0.0 1368 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> 33135 33126 nobody   0.0  1368 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33135 33126 無人0.0 1368 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> 33136 33126 nobody   0.0  1368 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33136 33126 無人0.0 1368 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> ```

**Rotating Log-files｜輪換日誌文件**

In order to rotate log files, they need to be renamed first. After that USR1 signal should be sent to the master process. The master process will then re-open all currently open log files and assign them an unprivileged user under which the worker processes are running, as an owner. After successful re-opening, the master process closes all open files and sends the message to worker process to ask them to re-open files. Worker processes also open new files and close old files right away. As a result, old files are almost immediately available for post processing, such as compression.

為了輪換日誌文件，需要先重命名它們。之後USR1訊號應該發送到主進程。然後，主進程將重新開啟所有目前開啟的日誌文件，並為它們分配一個非特權用戶，工作進程在該用戶下作為所有者執行。成功重新開啟後，主進程關閉所有開啟的文件，並向工作進程發送訊息，要求它們重新開啟文件。工作進程也開啟新檔案並立即關閉舊檔案。因此，舊檔案幾乎可以立即用於後期處理，例如壓縮。

**Upgrading Executable on the Fly｜即時升級可執行檔**

In order to upgrade the server executable, the new executable file should be put in place of an old file first. After that USR2 signal should be sent to the master process. The master process first renames its file with the process ID to a new file with the `.oldbin` suffix, e.g. `/usr/local/nginx/logs/nginx.pid.oldbin`, then starts a new executable file that in turn starts new worker processes:

為了升級伺服器可執行文件，應先將新的可執行檔取代舊文件。之後USR2訊號應該發送到主進程。主進程首先將其進程ID的文件重新命名為帶有`.oldbin`後綴的新文件，例如`/usr/local/nginx/logs/nginx.pid.oldbin`，然後啟動一個新的可執行文件，該文件又啟動新的工作進程：

> ```
>   PID  PPID USER    %CPU   VSZ WCHAN  COMMAND
> 33126     1 root     0.0  1164 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 33126 1 root 0.0 1164 暫停 nginx：主進程 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 33134 33126 nobody   0.0  1368 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33134 33126 無人0.0 1368 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> 33135 33126 nobody   0.0  1380 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33135 33126 無人0.0 1380 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> 33136 33126 nobody   0.0  1368 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 33136 33126 無人0.0 1368 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> 36264 33126 root     0.0  1148 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 36264 33126 root 0.0 1148 暫停 nginx：主程序 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 36265 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36265 36264 無人 0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> 36266 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36266 36264 無人0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> 36267 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36267 36264 無人0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> ```

After that all worker processes (old and new ones) continue to accept requests. If the WINCH signal is sent to the first master process, it will send messages to its worker processes, requesting them to shut down gracefully, and they will start to exit:

之後，所有工作流程（舊的和新的）繼續接受請求。如果WINCH訊號傳送到第一個主進程，它會向其工作進程發送訊息，請求它們正常關閉，然後它們將開始退出：

> ```
>   PID  PPID USER    %CPU   VSZ WCHAN  COMMAND
> 33126     1 root     0.0  1164 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 33126 1 root 0.0 1164 暫停 nginx：主進程 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 33135 33126 nobody   0.0  1380 kqread nginx: worker process is shutting down (nginx)
>
> 33135 33126 無人0.0 1380 kqread nginx：工作進程正在關閉（nginx）
> 36264 33126 root     0.0  1148 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 36264 33126 root 0.0 1148 暫停 nginx：主程序 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 36265 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36265 36264 無人0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作流程（nginx）
> 36266 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36266 36264 無人0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> 36267 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36267 36264 無人 0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> ```

After some time, only the new worker processes will process requests:

一段時間後，只有新的工作流程才會處理請求：

> ```
>   PID  PPID USER    %CPU   VSZ WCHAN  COMMAND
> 33126     1 root     0.0  1164 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 33126 1 root 0.0 1164 暫停 nginx：主進程 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 36264 33126 root     0.0  1148 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 36264 33126 root 0.0 1148 暫停 nginx：主程序 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 36265 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36265 36264 無人0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> 36266 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36266 36264 無人 0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> 36267 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36267 36264 無人 0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> ```

It should be noted that the old master process does not close its listen sockets, and it can be managed to start its worker processes again if needed. If for some reason the new executable file works unacceptably, one of the following can be done:

應該注意的是，舊的主進程不會關閉其偵聽套接字，並且可以在需要時再次啟動其工作進程。如果由於某種原因新的可執行檔無法正常運作，可以執行下列操作之一：

-   Send the HUP signal to the old master process. The old master process will start new worker processes without re-reading the configuration. After that, all new processes can be shut down gracefully, by sending the QUIT signal to the new master process.  
    向舊主進程發送HUP訊號。舊的主進程將啟動新的工作進程，而無需重新讀取配置。之後，透過向新的主進程發送 QUIT 訊號，所有新進程都可以正常關閉。
    
-   Send the TERM signal to the new master process. It will then send a message to its worker processes requesting them to exit immediately, and they will all exit almost immediately. (If new processes do not exit for some reason, the KILL signal should be sent to them to force them to exit.) When the new master process exits, the old master process will start new worker processes automatically.  
    向新的主進程發送TERM訊號。然後它會向其工作進程發送一條訊息，請求它們立即退出，它們幾乎都會立即退出。 （如果新進程因某種原因沒有退出，則應向其發送KILL訊號以強制其退出。）當新的master進程退出時，舊的master進程將自動啟動新的工作進程。
    

If the new master process exits then the old master process discards the `.oldbin` suffix from the file name with the process ID.

如果新的主進程退出，則舊的主進程會丟棄進程 ID 的檔案名稱中的 `.oldbin` 後綴。

If upgrade was successful, then the QUIT signal should be sent to the old master process, and only new processes will stay:

如果升級成功，那麼QUIT訊號應該發送到舊的主進程，只有新進程會留下來：

> ```
>   PID  PPID USER    %CPU   VSZ WCHAN  COMMAND
> 36264     1 root     0.0  1148 pause  nginx: master process /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
>
> 36264 1 root 0.0 1148 暫停 nginx：主進程 /usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
> 36265 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36265 36264 無人0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> 36266 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36266 36264 無人0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> 36267 36264 nobody   0.0  1364 kqread nginx: worker process (nginx)
>
> 36267 36264 無人 0.0 1364 kqread nginx：工作進程（nginx）
> ```

<a id="p-027"></a>

#### A debugging log｜偵錯日誌

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/debugging_log.html>

##### A debugging log｜偵錯日誌

|   |
| --- |
| [Debugging log for selected clients](#p-027)<br>[Logging to a cyclic memory buffer](#p-027)<br>[選定客戶端的偵錯日誌](#p-027)<br>[記錄到循環記憶體緩衝區](#p-027) |

To enable a debugging log, nginx needs to be configured to support debugging during the build:

要啟用調試日誌，需要將 nginx 配置為在建置期間支援調試：

> ```
> ./configure --with-debug ...
> ```

Then the `debug` level should be set with the [error\_log](#p-125) directive:

然後應該使用 [error\_log](#p-125) 指令設定 `debug` 等級：

> ```
> error_log /path/to/log debug;
>
> error_log /path/to/log 調試；
> ```

To verify that nginx is configured to support debugging, run the `nginx -V` command:

若要驗證 nginx 是否已配置為支援偵錯，請執行 `nginx -V` 命令：

> ```
> configure arguments: --with-debug ...
>
> 配置參數：--with-debug ...
> ```

Pre-built [Linux](#p-177) packages provide out-of-the-box support for debugging log with the `nginx-debug` binary (1.9.8) which can be run using commands

預先建置的 [Linux](#p-177) 軟體包透過可使用命令運行的 `nginx-debug` 二進位檔案 (1.9.8) 為偵錯日誌提供開箱即用的支持

> ```
> service nginx stop
>
> 服務 nginx 停止
> service nginx-debug start
>
> 服務 nginx-debug 啟動
> ```

and then set the `debug` level. The nginx binary version for Windows is always built with the debugging log support, so only setting the `debug` level will suffice.

然後設定`debug`級別。 Windows 的 nginx 二進位版本始終建置有偵錯日誌支持，因此只需設定 `debug` 等級就足夠了。

Note that redefining the log without also specifying the `debug` level will disable the debugging log. In the example below, redefining the log on the [server](#p-056) level disables the debugging log for this server:

請注意，重新定義日誌而不指定 `debug` 等級將停用偵錯日誌。在下面的範例中，在 [server](#p-056) 層級上重新定義日誌將停用該伺服器的偵錯日誌：

> ```
> error_log /path/to/log debug;
>
> error_log /path/to/log 調試；
> 
> http {
>
> http{
>     server {
>
>     伺服器{
>         error_log /path/to/log;
>
>         error_log /路徑/到/日誌；
>         ...
> ```

To avoid this, either the line redefining the log should be commented out, or the `debug` level specification should also be added:

為了避免這種情況，應該註解掉重新定義日誌的行，或者還應該新增 `debug` 等級規格：

> ```
> error_log /path/to/log debug;
>
> error_log /path/to/log 調試；
> 
> http {
>
> http{
>     server {
>
>     伺服器{
>         error_log /path/to/log debug;
>
>         error_log /path/to/log 調試；
>         ...
> ```

**Debugging log for selected clients｜選定客戶端的調試日誌**

It is also possible to enable the debugging log for [selected client addresses](#p-125) only:

也可以僅啟用[選定的客戶端位址](#p-125)的偵錯日誌：

> ```
> error_log /path/to/log;
>
> error_log /路徑/到/日誌；
> 
> events {
>
> 事件{
>     debug_connection 192.168.1.1;
>
>     調試連接192.168.1.1；
>     debug_connection 192.168.10.0/24;
>
>     調試連接192.168.10.0/24；
> }
> ```

**Logging to a cyclic memory buffer｜記錄到循環記憶體緩衝區**

The debugging log can be written to a cyclic memory buffer:

調試日誌可以寫入循環記憶體緩衝區：

> ```
> error_log memory:32m debug;
>
> error_log記憶體：32m調試；
> ```

Logging to the memory buffer on the `debug` level does not have significant impact on performance even under high load. In this case, the log can be extracted using a `gdb` script like the following one:

即使在高負載下，記錄到`debug`等級的記憶體緩衝區也不會對效能產生重大影響。在這種情況下，可以使用 `gdb` 腳本提取日誌，如下所示：

> ```
> set $log = ngx_cycle->log
>
> 設定 $log = ngx_cycle->log
> 
> while $log->writer != ngx_log_memory_writer
>
> 而 $log->writer != ngx_log_memory_writer
>     set $log = $log->next
>
>     設定 $log = $log->下一個
> end
>
> 結束
> 
> set $buf = (ngx_log_memory_buf_t *) $log->wdata
>
> 設定 $buf = (ngx_log_memory_buf_t *) $log->wdata
> dump binary memory debug_log.txt $buf->start $buf->end
>
> 轉儲二進位記憶體 debug_log.txt $buf->start $buf->end
> ```

Or using an `lldb` script as follows:

或使用 `lldb` 腳本，如下所示：

> ```
> expr ngx_log_t *$log = ngx_cycle->log
> expr while ($log->writer != ngx_log_memory_writer) { $log = $log->next; }
> expr ngx_log_memory_buf_t *$buf = (ngx_log_memory_buf_t *) $log->wdata
> memory read --force --outfile debug_log.txt --binary $buf->start $buf->end
>
> 記憶體讀取 --force --outfile debug_log.txt --binary $buf->start $buf->end
> ```

and Loops](#p-028)<br>     [Labels](#p-028)<br>[Debugging memory issues](#p-028)<br>[Common Pitfalls](#p-028)<br>     [Writing a C module](#p-028)<br>     [C Strings](#p-028)<br>     [Global Variables](#p-028)<br>     [Manual Memory Management](#p-028)<br>     [Threads](#p-028)<br>     [Blocking Libraries](#p-028)<br>     [HTTP Requests to External Services](#p-028) |

**Introduction｜簡介**

**Public and private API｜公共與私人API**

nginx does not formally separate its programming interface into public and private parts. All header files in the nginx source tree can be included by both standard and third-party modules. The data structure definitions, external data references, macros, and functions they declare are available for public use. Some of these, however, exist for nginx's own internal convenience, and module authors should avoid depending on them. The best way to stay within the public part of the API is to follow this guide.

nginx 並沒有正式將其程式介面分為公共部分和私有部分。 nginx 原始碼樹中的所有頭檔都可以被標準模組和第三方模組包含。它們聲明的資料結構定義、外部資料引用、巨集和函數可供公眾使用。然而，其中一些是為了 nginx 自身的內部便利而存在的，模組作者應該避免依賴它們。留在 API 公共區域的最佳方式是遵循本指南。

Accessing nginx private data defined in C source files and not exported through header files is strongly discouraged, as is copying standard nginx functions in order to alter their behavior. Such code is fragile: it may become binary incompatible with a later nginx version, and security fixes applied to the original functions will not reach the copies.

強烈建議不要存取 C 原始檔中定義的 nginx 私有數據，而不是透過頭檔匯出，就像複製標準 nginx 函數以改變其行為一樣。此類程式碼很脆弱：它可能會成為與更高版本的 nginx 版本不相容的二進位文件，並且應用於原始功能的安全修復將無法到達副本。

**Code layout｜程式碼佈局**

-   `auto` — Build scripts  
    `auto` — 建置腳本
-   `src`
    -   `core` — Basic types and functions — string, array, log, pool, etc.  
        `core` — 基本型別與函數 — 字串、陣列、日誌、池等。
    -   `event` — Event core  
        `event` — 事件核心
        -   `modules` — Event notification modules: `epoll`, `kqueue`, `select` etc.  
            `modules` — 事件通知模組：`epoll`, `kqueue`, `select`等
    -   `http` — Core HTTP module and common code  
        `http` — 核心HTTP模組與公共程式碼
        -   `modules` — Other HTTP modules  
            `modules` —其他HTTP模組
        -   `v2` — HTTP/2
    -   `mail` — Mail modules  
        `mail` — 郵件模組
    -   `os` — Platform-specific code  
        `os` — 平台特定程式碼
        -   `unix`
        -   `win32`
    -   `stream` — Stream modules  
        `stream` — 流模組

**Include files｜包含文件**

The following two `#include` statements must appear at the beginning of every nginx file:

以下兩個`#include`語句必須出現在每個nginx檔案的開頭：

> ```
> #include <ngx_config.h>
>
> #包括<ngx_config.h>
> #include <ngx_core.h>
>
> #包括<ngx_core.h>
> ```

In addition to that, HTTP code should include

除此之外，HTTP代碼應包括

> ```
> #include <ngx_http.h>
>
> #包括<ngx_http.h>
> ```

Mail code should include

郵件代碼應包括

> ```
> #include <ngx_mail.h>
>
> #包括<ngx_mail.h>
> ```

Stream code should include

流代碼應包括

> ```
> #include <ngx_stream.h>
>
> #包括<ngx_stream.h>
> ```

**Integers｜整數**

For general purposes, nginx code uses two integer types, `ngx_int_t` and `ngx_uint_t`, which are typedefs for `intptr_t` and `uintptr_t` respectively.

出於一般目的，nginx程式碼使用兩種整數類型，`ngx_int_t`和`ngx_uint_t`，它們分別是`intptr_t`和`uintptr_t`的typedef。

**Common return codes｜常見返回碼**

Most functions in nginx return the following codes:

nginx 中的大多數函數都會傳回以下程式碼：

-   `NGX_OK` — Operation succeeded.  
    `NGX_OK` — 操作成功。
-   `NGX_ERROR` — Operation failed.  
    `NGX_ERROR` — 操作失敗。
-   `NGX_AGAIN` — Operation incomplete; call the function again.  
    `NGX_AGAIN` — 操作未完成；再次呼叫該函數。
-   `NGX_DECLINED` — Operation rejected, for example, because it is disabled in the configuration. This is never an error.  
    `NGX_DECLINED` — 操作被拒絕，例如，因為它在設定中被停用。這絕對不是一個錯誤。
-   `NGX_BUSY` — Resource is not available.  
    `NGX_BUSY` — 資源不可用。
-   `NGX_DONE` — Operation complete or continued elsewhere. Also used as an alternative success code.  
    `NGX_DONE` — 作業已完成或在其他地方繼續。也用作替代成功代碼。
-   `NGX_ABORT` — Function was aborted. Also used as an alternative error code.  
    `NGX_ABORT` — 功能被中止。也用作替代錯誤代碼。

**Error handling｜錯誤處理**

The `ngx_errno` macro returns the last system error code. It's mapped to `errno` on POSIX platforms and to `GetLastError()` call in Windows. The `ngx_socket_errno` macro returns the last socket error number. Like the `ngx_errno` macro, it's mapped to `errno` on POSIX platforms. It's mapped to the `WSAGetLastError()` call on Windows. Accessing the values of `ngx_errno` or `ngx_socket_errno` more than once in a row can cause performance issues. If the error value might be used multiple times, store it in a local variable of type `ngx_err_t`. To set errors, use the `ngx_set_errno(errno)` and `ngx_set_socket_errno(errno)` macros.

`ngx_errno` 巨集傳回最後一個系統錯誤碼。它對應到 POSIX 平台上的 `errno` 以及 Windows 中的 `GetLastError()` 呼叫。 `ngx_socket_errno` 巨集傳回最後一個套接字錯誤號碼。與 `ngx_errno` 巨集一樣，它在 POSIX 平台上映射到 `errno`。它會對應到 Windows 上的 `WSAGetLastError()` 呼叫。連續多次存取 `ngx_errno` 或 `ngx_socket_errno` 的值可能會導致效能問題。如果錯誤值可能被多次使用，請將其儲存在`ngx_err_t`類型的局部變數中。若要設定錯誤，請使用 `ngx_set_errno(errno)` 和 `ngx_set_socket_errno(errno)` 巨集。

The values of `ngx_errno` and `ngx_socket_errno` can be passed to the logging functions `ngx_log_error()` and `ngx_log_debugX()`, in which case system error text is added to the log message.

`ngx_errno`和`ngx_socket_errno`的值可以傳遞給日誌記錄函數`ngx_log_error()`和`ngx_log_debugX()`，在這種情況下，系統錯誤文字將會加入日誌訊息中。

Example using `ngx_errno`:

使用 `ngx_errno` 的範例：

> ```
> ngx_int_t
> ngx_my_kill(ngx_pid_t pid, ngx_log_t *log, int signo)
>
> ngx_my_kill(ngx_pid_t pid, ngx_log_t *log, int 符號)
> {
>     ngx_err_t  err;
>
>     ngx_err_t 錯誤；
> 
>     if (kill(pid, signo) == -1) {
>
>     if (kill(pid,signo) == -1) {
>         err = ngx_errno;
>
>         錯誤= ngx_errno;
> 
>         ngx_log_error(NGX_LOG_ALERT, log, err, "kill(%P, %d) failed", pid, signo);
>
>         ngx_log_error(NGX_LOG_ALERT, log, err, "kill(%P, %d) 失敗", pid, Signo);
> 
>         if (err == NGX_ESRCH) {
>
>         如果（錯誤== NGX_ESRCH）{
>             return 2;
>
>             返回2；
>         }
> 
>         return 1;
>
>         返回1；
>     }
> 
>     return 0;
>
>     返回0；
> }
> ```

**Strings｜弦樂**

**Overview｜概述**

For C strings, nginx uses the unsigned character type pointer `u_char *`.

對於C字串，nginx使用無符號字元類型指標`u_char *`。

The nginx string type `ngx_str_t` is defined as follows:

nginx字串型別`ngx_str_t`定義如下：

> ```
> typedef struct {
>
> 類型定義結構{
>     size_t      len;
>
>     size_t 長度；
>     u_char     *data;
>
>     u_char *資料；
> } ngx_str_t;
> ```

The `len` field holds the string length and `data` holds the string data. The string, held in `ngx_str_t`, may or may not be null-terminated after the `len` bytes. In most cases it’s not. However, in certain parts of the code (for example, when parsing configuration), `ngx_str_t` objects are known to be null-terminated, which simplifies string comparison and makes it easier to pass the strings to syscalls.

`len`欄位保存字串長度，`data`保存字串資料。儲存在 `ngx_str_t` 中的字串在 `len` 位元組之後可能會或可能不會以 null 結尾。大多數情況並非如此。但是，在程式碼的某些部分（例如，解析配置時），`ngx_str_t`物件已知以空終止，這簡化了字串比較，並使將字串傳遞給系統呼叫變得更容易。

The string operations in nginx are declared in `src/core/ngx_string.h` Some of them are wrappers around standard C functions:

nginx 中的字串操作在 `src/core/ngx_string.h` 中聲明，其中一些是標準 C 函數的包裝器：

-   `ngx_strcmp()`
-   `ngx_strncmp()`
-   `ngx_strstr()`
-   `ngx_strlen()`
-   `ngx_strchr()`
-   `ngx_memcmp()`
-   `ngx_memset()`
-   `ngx_memcpy()`
-   `ngx_memmove()`

Other string functions are nginx-specific

其他字串函數是 nginx 特定的

-   `ngx_memzero()` — Fills memory with zeroes.  
    `ngx_memzero()` — 用零填滿記憶體。
-   `ngx_explicit_memzero()` — Does the same as `ngx_memzero()`, but this call is never removed by the compiler's dead store elimination optimization. This function can be used to clear sensitive data such as passwords and keys.  
    `ngx_explicit_memzero()` — 與 `ngx_memzero()` 相同，但編譯器的死儲存消除最佳化永遠不會刪除此呼叫。此功能可用於清除密碼和金鑰等敏感資料。
-   `ngx_cpymem()` — Does the same as `ngx_memcpy()`, but returns the final destination address This one is handy for appending multiple strings in a row.  
    `ngx_cpymem()` — 與 `ngx_memcpy()` 相同，但傳回最終目標位址 這對於在一行中附加多個字串非常方便。
-   `ngx_movemem()` — Does the same as `ngx_memmove()`, but returns the final destination address.  
    `ngx_movemem()` — 與 `ngx_memmove()` 相同，但回傳最終目標位址。
-   `ngx_strlchr()` — Searches for a character in a string, delimited by two pointers.  
    `ngx_strlchr()` — 搜尋字串中的字符，由兩個指針分隔。

The following functions perform case conversion and comparison:

以下函數執行大小寫轉換和比較：

-   `ngx_tolower()`
-   `ngx_toupper()`
-   `ngx_strlow()`
-   `ngx_strcasecmp()`
-   `ngx_strncasecmp()`

The following macros simplify string initialization:

以下宏簡化了字串初始化：

-   `ngx_string(text)` — static initializer for the `ngx_str_t` type from the C string literal `text`  
    `ngx_string(text)` — 來自 C 字串文字 `text` 的 `ngx_str_t` 類型的靜態初始值設定項
-   `ngx_null_string` — static empty string initializer for the `ngx_str_t` type  
    `ngx_null_string` — `ngx_str_t` 類型的靜態空字串初始值設定項
-   `ngx_str_set(str, text)` — initializes string `str` of `ngx_str_t *` type with the C string literal `text`  
    `ngx_str_set(str, text)` — 使用 C 字串文字 `text` 初始化 `ngx_str_t *` 類型的字串 `str`
-   `ngx_str_null(str)` — initializes string `str` of `ngx_str_t *` type with the empty string
