<a id="p-034"></a>

##### Why nginx doesn’t handle chunked encoding responses from my backend properly｜為什麼 nginx 無法正確處理來自後端的分塊編碼回應

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/faq/chunked_encoding_from_backend.html>

###### Why nginx doesn’t handle chunked encoding responses from my backend properly?｜為什麼 nginx 不能正確處理來自後端的分塊編碼回應？

**Q:** My backend server appears to send HTTP/1.0 responses using chunked encoding but nginx doesn’t handle it correctly. For instance, I’m using nginx as a frontend to my node.js application and instead of pure JSON from backend, nginx returns something framed in decimal numbers like

**問：** 我的後端伺服器似乎使用分塊編碼發送 HTTP/1.0 回應，但 nginx 無法正確處理它。例如，我使用 nginx 作為我的 node.js 應用程式的前端，nginx 返回的不是來自後端的純JSON，而是以十進制數字表示的內容，例如

> ```
> 47
> {"error":"query error","message":"Parameter(s) missing: user,password"}
>
> {“error”：“查詢錯誤”，“message”：“缺少參數：用戶，密碼”}
> 0
> ```

**A:** Your backend violates HTTP specification (see [RFC 2616, "3.6 Transfer Codings"](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2616#section-3.6)). The "chunked" transfer-codings must not be used with HTTP/1.0. You’d need to either fix your backend application or upgrade to nginx version 1.1.4 and newer, where an additional code was introduced to handle such erratic backend behavior.

**答：** 您的後端違反了HTTP規範（請參閱[RFC2616，「3.6傳輸編碼」](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2616#section-3.6)）。 「分塊」傳輸編碼不得與 HTTP/1.0 一起使用。您需要修復後端應用程式或升級到 nginx 版本1.1.4及更高版本，其中引入了額外的程式碼來處理這種不穩定的後端行為。

---

<a id="p-035"></a>

##### Can I run nginx with “daemon off” or “master_process off” settings in a production environment｜我可以在生產環境中使用“daemon off”或“master_process off”設定來運行 nginx

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/faq/daemon_master_process_off.html>

###### Can I run nginx with “daemon off” or “master\_process off” settings in a production environment?｜我可以在生產環境中使用「daemon off」或「master\_process off」設定來執行 nginx 嗎？

**Q:** Can I run nginx with "daemon off" or "master\_process off" settings in a production environment?

**問：** 我可以在生產環境中使用「daemon off」或「master\_process off」設定來執行 nginx 嗎？

**A:** First of all, both "daemon on|off" and "master\_process on|off" directives were intended to be used primarily for nginx code development.

**A:** 首先，「daemon on|off」和「master\_process on|off」指令主要用於 nginx 程式碼開發。

While many people use "daemon off" in production it wasn’t really meant for that. Since version 1.0.9 it is now quite safe to run nginx in production with "daemon off", though. Bear in mind that non-stop upgrade is not an option with "daemon off".

雖然許多人在生產中使用“守護進程關閉”，但這並不是真正的目的。不過，從版本 1.0.9 開始，現在在生產環境中使用「守護程式關閉」來執行 nginx 是相當安全的。請記住，不間斷升級不是「守護程序關閉」的選項。

In a development environment, using "master\_process off", nginx can run in the foreground without the master process and can be terminated simply with ^C (SIGINT). This is somewhat similar to running Apache with an 'X' command-line option. However you should NEVER run nginx in production with "master\_process off".

在開發環境中，使用“master\_process off”，nginx可以在沒有master進程的情況下在前台運行，並且可以簡單地用^C（SIGINT）終止。這有點類似於使用“X”命令列選項來運行 Apache。但是，您應該在生產環境中使用“master\_process off”運行 NEVER 。

<a id="p-036"></a>

##### How can nginx copyright be acknowledged when using nginx as part of a proprietary software distribution｜當使用 nginx 作為專有軟體發行版的一部分時，如何承認 nginx 版權

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/faq/license_copyright.html>

###### How can nginx copyright be acknowledged when using nginx as part of a proprietary software distribution?｜當使用 nginx 作為專有軟體發行版的一部分時，如何承認 nginx 版權？

**Q:** I’d like to use nginx distribution as part of my proprietary software package. How can nginx copyright be acknowledged when using nginx as part of a proprietary software distribution?

**問：** 我想使用 nginx 發行版作為我的專有軟體包的一部分。當使用 nginx 作為專有軟體發行版的一部分時，如何承認 nginx 版權？

**A:** The text below should be added to your license conditions, followed by the text of the applicable 2-clause BSD license described [here](#p-354).

**答：** 應將以下文字加入您的授權條件中，後面接著[此處](#p-354) 所描述的適用 2 條款 BSD 授權的文字。

> ```
> This product contains software provided by Nginx, Inc. and its contributors.
>
> 本產品包含 Nginx, Inc. 及其貢獻者提供的軟體。
> ```

Also, if your build of nginx includes any of the following 3rd party products: zlib, PCRE, OpenSSL — it’s worth including their copyright acknowledgements and disclaimers as well.

另外，如果您的 nginx 版本包含以下任何第 3 方产品：zlib、PCRE、OpenSSL — 也值得包含它们的版权声明和免责声明。

---

<a id="p-037"></a>

##### Is there a proper way to use nginx variables to make sections of the configuration shorter, using them as macros for mak｜有沒有正確的方法來使用 nginx 變數來縮短配置部分，將它們用作 mak 的宏

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/faq/variables_in_config.html>

###### Is there a proper way to use nginx variables to make sections of the configuration shorter, using them as macros for making parts of configuration work as templates?｜是否有正確的方法來使用 nginx 變數來縮短配置部分，將它們用作巨集以使部分配置作為模板工作？

**Q:** Is there a proper way to use nginx variables to make sections of the configuration shorter, using them as macros for making parts of configuration work as templates?

**問：** 是否有正確的方法來使用 nginx 變數來縮短配置部分，將它們用作巨集以使部分配置作為模板工作？

**A:** Variables should not be used as template macros. Variables are evaluated in the run-time during the processing of each request, so they are rather costly compared to plain static configuration. Using variables to store static strings is also a bad idea. Instead, a macro expansion and "include" directives should be used to generate configs more easily and it can be done with the external tools, e.g. sed + make or any other common template mechanism.

**A:** 變數不應該用作模板巨集。變數在處理每個請求期間在運行時進行評估，因此與普通靜態配置相比，它們的成本相當高。使用變數來儲存靜態字串也是一個壞主意。相反，應該使用巨集擴展和“include”指令來更輕鬆地產生配置，並且可以使用外部工具來完成，例如sed + make 或任何其他常見的模板機制。

---

<a id="p-038"></a>

#### Tuning FreeBSD for the highload｜調整 FreeBSD 以實現高負載

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/freebsd_tuning.html>

##### Tuning FreeBSD for the highload｜調整 FreeBSD 以實現高負載

|   |
| --- |
| [Listen queues](#p-038)<br>[Socket buffers](#p-038)<br>[mbufs, mbuf clusters, etc.](#p-038)<br>[Outgoing connections](#p-038)<br>[Finalizing connection](#p-038)<br>[監聽佇列](#p-038)<br>[套接字緩衝區](#p-038)<br>[mbuf、mbuf 叢集等](#p-038)<br>[傳出連線](#p-038)<br>[正在完成連線](#p-038) |

**Listen queues｜監聽佇列**

After the connection has been established it is placed in the listen queue of the listen socket. To see the current listen queues state, you may run the command “`netstat -Lan`”:

連接建立後，它被放置在偵聽套接字的偵聽佇列中。若要查看目前監聽佇列狀態，您可以執行指令「`netstat -Lan`」：

> ```
> Current listen queue sizes (qlen/incqlen/maxqlen)
>
> 目前監聽佇列大小 (qlen/incqlen/maxqlen)
> Proto Listen         Local Address
>
> 原型監聽本地地址
> tcp4  10/0/128       *.80
>
> TCP4 10/0/128 *.80
> tcp4  0/0/128        *.22
>
> TCP4 0/0/128 *.22
> ```

This is a normal case: the listen queue of the port \*:80 contains just 10 unaccepted connections. If the web server is not able to handle the load, you may see something like this:

這是正常情況：連接埠 \*:80 的監聽佇列僅包含 10 個未接受的連線。如果 Web 伺服器無法處理負載，您可能會看到以下內容：

> ```
> Current listen queue sizes (qlen/incqlen/maxqlen)
>
> 目前監聽佇列大小 (qlen/incqlen/maxqlen)
> Proto Listen         Local Address
>
> 原型監聽本地地址
> tcp4  192/0/128      *.80
>
> TCP4 192/0/128 *.80
> tcp4  0/0/128        *.22
>
> TCP4 0/0/128 *.22
> ```

Here are 192 unaccepted connections and most likely new coming connections are discarding. Although the limit is 128 connections, FreeBSD allows receiving 1.5 times connections than the limit before it starts to discard the new connections. You may increase the limit using

這裡有 192 個未接受的連接，很可能新的連接正在被丟棄。儘管限制為 128 個連接，但 FreeBSD 允許接收超過限制的 1.5 倍的連接，然後才會開始丟棄新連接。您可以使用以下方法增加限制

> ```
> sysctl kern.ipc.soacceptqueue=4096
> ```

However, note that the queue is only a damper to quench bursts. If it is always overflowed, this means that you need to improve the web server, but not to continue to increase the limit. You may also change the listen queue maximum size in nginx configuration:

但請注意，隊列只是抑制突發的阻尼器。如果總是溢出，這意味著你需要改進Web伺服器，但不能繼續增加限制。您也可以在 nginx 設定中變更監聽佇列最大大小：

> ```
> listen  80  backlog=1024;
>
> 聽80積壓=1024；
> ```

However, you may not set it more than the current `kern.ipc.soacceptqueue` value. By default nginx uses the maximum value of FreeBSD kernel.

但是，您不能將其設定為超過目前 `kern.ipc.soacceptqueue` 值。預設情況下，nginx 使用 FreeBSD 核心的最大值。

**Socket buffers｜套接字緩衝區**

When a client sends a data, the data first is received by the kernel which places the data in the socket receiving buffer. Then an application such as the web server may call `recv()` or `read()` system calls to get the data from the buffer. When the application wants to send a data, it calls `send()` or `write()` system calls to place the data in the socket sending buffer. Then the kernel manages to send the data from the buffer to the client. In modern FreeBSD versions the default sizes of the socket receiving and sending buffers are respectively 64K and 32K. You may change them on the fly using the sysctls `net.inet.tcp.recvspace` and `net.inet.tcp.sendspace`. Of course the bigger buffer sizes may increase throughput, because connections may use bigger TCP sliding windows sizes. And on the Internet you may see recommendations to increase the buffer sizes to one or even several megabytes. However, such large buffer sizes are suitable for local networks or for networks under your control. Since on the Internet a slow network client may ask a large file and then it will download the file during several minutes if not hours. All this time the megabyte buffer will be bound to the slow client, although we may devote just several kilobytes to it.

當客戶端發送資料時，資料首先被核心接收，並將資料放置在套接字接收緩衝區中。然後，諸如Web伺服器之類的應用程式可以呼叫`recv()`或`read()`系統呼叫來從緩衝區取得資料。當應用程式想要傳送資料時，它會呼叫`send()`或`write()`系統呼叫將資料放入套接字傳送緩衝區中。然後內核設法將資料從緩衝區發送到客戶端。在現代 FreeBSD 版本中，套接字接收和傳送緩衝區的預設大小分別為 64K 和 32K。您可以使用 sysctls `net.inet.tcp.recvspace` 和 `net.inet.tcp.sendspace` 即時變更它們。當然，更大的緩衝區大小可能會增加吞吐量，因為連接可能使用更大的TCP滑動視窗大小。在 Internet 上，您可能會看到將緩衝區大小增加到一兆甚至幾兆位元組的建議。但是，如此大的緩衝區大小適合本地網路或您控制下的網路。由於在互聯網上，慢速網路用戶端可能會要求一個大文件，然後它將在幾分鐘甚至幾小時內下載該文件。一直以來，兆位元組緩衝區都將綁定到慢速客戶端，儘管我們可能只為其分配了數千位元組。

There is one more advantage of the large sending buffers for the web servers such as Apache which use the blocking I/O system calls. The server may place a whole large response in the sending buffer, then may close the connection, and let the kernel to send the response to a slow client, while the server is ready to serve other requests. You should decide what is it better to bind to a client in your case: a tens megabytes Apache/mod\_perl process or the hundreds kilobytes socket sending buffer. Note that nginx uses non-blocking I/O system calls and devotes just tens kilobytes to connections, therefore it does not require the large buffer sizes.

對於使用阻塞 I/O 系統呼叫的 Web 伺服器（例如 Apache）來說，大發送緩衝區還有一個優點。伺服器可以將整個大響應放入發送緩衝區，然後可以關閉連接，並讓核心將回應發送到慢速客戶端，同時伺服器準備好服務其他請求。您應該決定在您的情況下綁定到客戶端哪個更好：幾十兆位元組的 Apache/mod\_perl 進程或數百千位元組的套接字發送緩衝區。請注意，nginx 使用非阻塞 I/O 系統調用，並且僅佔用數十 KB 的連接，因此它不需要大的緩衝區大小。

**mbufs, mbuf clusters, etc.｜mbuf、mbuf 簇等**

Inside the kernel the buffers are stored in the form of chains of memory chunks linked using the *mbuf* structures. The mbuf size is 256 bytes and it can be used to store a small amount of data, for example, TCP/IP header. However, the mbufs point mostly to other data stored in the *mbuf clusters* or *jumbo clusters*, and in this kind they are used as the chain links only. The mbuf cluster size is 2K. The jumbo cluster size can be equal to a CPU page size (4K for amd64), 9K, or 16K. The 9K and 16K jumbo clusters are used mainly in local networks with Ethernet frames larger than usual 1500 bytes, and they are beyond the scope of this article. The page size jumbo clusters are usually used for sending only, while the mbuf clusters are used for both sending and receiving. To see the current usage of the mbufs and clusters and their limits, you may run the command “`netstat -m`”. Here is a sample from FreeBSD 7.2/amd64 with the default settings:

在核心內部，緩衝區以使用 *mbuf* 結構連結的記憶體區塊鏈的形式儲存。 mbuf大小為256字節，可用於儲存少量數據，例如TCP/IP頭。然而，mbuf 主要指向儲存在*mbuf 簇*或*巨型簇*中的其他數據，在這種情況下，它們僅用作鏈鏈結。 mbuf簇大小為2K。巨型簇大小可以等於 CPU 頁大小（對於 amd64 為 4K）、9K 或 16K。 9K和16K巨型叢集主要用於乙太網路幀大於通常1500位元組的本地網絡，它們超出了本文的範圍。頁大小的 jumbo 簇通常僅用於傳送，而 mbuf 簇則用於傳送和接收。若要查看 mbuf 和叢集的目前使用情況及其限制，您可以執行命令「`netstat -m`」。這是來自 FreeBSD 7.2/amd64 的範例，具有預設設定：

> ```
> 1477/3773/5250 mbufs in use (current/cache/total)
>
> 1477/3773/5250 mbufs 正在使用（當前/快取/總計）
> 771/2203/2974/25600 mbuf clusters in use (current/cache/total/max)
>
> 正在使用的 771/2203/2974/25600 mbuf 叢集（目前/快取/總計/最大）
> 771/1969 mbuf+clusters out of packet secondary zone in use
>
> 771/1969 mbuf+clusters 正在使用資料包外輔助區域
>    (current/cache)
>
>    （當前/快取）
> 296/863/1159/12800 4k (page size) jumbo clusters in use
>
> 296/863/1159/12800 4k（頁面大小）正在使用的巨型簇
>    (current/cache/total/max)
>
>    （當前/快取/總計/最大）
> 0/0/0/6400 9k jumbo clusters in use (current/cache/total/max)
>
> 0/0/0/6400 正在使用的 9k 巨型叢集（當前/快取/總計/最大）
> 0/0/0/3200 16k jumbo clusters in use (current/cache/total/max)
>
> 0/0/0/3200 正在使用的 16k 巨型叢集（當前/快取/總計/最大）
> 3095K/8801K/11896K bytes allocated to network(current/cache/total)
>
> 分配給網路的 3095K/8801K/11896K 位元組（當前/快取/總計）
> 0/0/0 requests for mbufs denied (mbufs/clusters/mbuf+clusters)
>
> 0/0/0 mbuf 請求被拒絕（mbufs/clusters/mbuf+clusters）
> 0/0/0 requests for jumbo clusters denied (4k/9k/16k)
>
> 0/0/0 對巨型群集的請求被拒絕 (4k/9k/16k)
> 0/0/0 sfbufs in use (current/peak/max)
>
> 0/0/0 sfbufs 正在使用（目前/峰值/最大）
> 0 requests for sfbufs denied
>
> 0 個 sfbuf 請求被拒絕
> 0 requests for sfbufs delayed
>
> 0 個 sfbuf 請求延遲
> 523590 requests for I/O initiated by sendfile
>
> 523590 由 sendfile 發起的 I/O 請求
> 0 calls to protocol drain routines
>
> 0 次呼叫協定耗盡例程
> ```

There are 12800 page size jumbo clusters, therefore they can store only 50M of data. If you set the `net.inet.tcp.sendspace` to 1M, then merely 50 slow clients will take all jumbo clusters requesting large files.

有12800個頁面大小的巨型簇，因此它們只能儲存50M的資料。如果將`net.inet.tcp.sendspace`設定為1M，那麼只有50個慢速客戶端將佔用所有請求大檔案的巨型叢集。

You may increase the clusters limits on the fly using:

您可以使用以下命令動態增加叢集限制：

> ```
> sysctl kern.ipc.nmbclusters=200000
> sysctl kern.ipc.nmbjumbop=100000
> ```

The former command increases the mbuf clusters limit and the latter increases page size jumbo clusters limit. Note that all allocated mbufs clusters will take about 440M physical memory: (200000 × (2048 + 256)) because each mbuf cluster requires also the mbuf. All allocated page size jumbo clusters will take yet about 415M physical memory: (100000 × (4096 + 256)). And together they may take 845M.

前一個指令增加 mbuf 叢集限制，後者增加頁面大小巨型叢集限制。請注意，所有分配的 mbufs 簇將佔用約 440M 實體記憶體：(200000 × (2048 + 256))，因為每個 mbuf 簇也需要 mbuf。所有分配的頁面大小巨型簇將佔用約 415M 實體記憶體：(100000 × (4096 + 256))。它們加在一起可能需要 845M。

There is way not to use the jumbo clusters while serving static files: the *sendfile()* system call. The sendfile allows sending a file or its part to a socket directly without reading the parts in an application buffer. It creates the mbufs chain where the mbufs point to the file pages that are already present in FreeBSD cache memory, and passes the chain to the TCP/IP stack. Thus, sendfile decreases both CPU usage by omitting two memory copy operations, and memory usage by using the cached file pages.

有一種方法可以在提供靜態檔案時不使用巨型叢集：*sendfile()* 系統呼叫。 sendfile 允許直接將檔案或其部分傳送到套接字，而無需讀取應用程式緩衝區中的部分。它會建立 mbufs 鏈，其中 mbufs 指向 FreeBSD 快取記憶體中已存在的檔案頁面，並將該鏈傳遞到 TCP/IP 堆疊。因此，sendfile 透過省略兩次記憶體複製操作來減少 CPU 使用量，並透過使用快取的檔案頁面來減少記憶體使用量。

**Outgoing connections｜傳出連接**

> ```
> net.inet.ip.portrange.randomized=0
> net.inet.ip.portrange.first=1024
> net.inet.ip.portrange.last=65535
> ```

**Finalizing connection｜正在完成連接**

> ```
> net.inet.tcp.fast_finwait2_recycle=1
> ```

#### NGINX Open Source Governance｜NGINX開源治理

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/governance.html>

##### NGINX Open Source Governance｜NGINX開源治理

Open source changed the world.

開源改變了世界。

NGINX is proud to be part of that change, from our very beginning.

NGINX很榮幸能從一開始就參與這項變革。

NGINX embraces open source ethos and intends to remain an active contributor and leader in the ecosystem. This is encapsulated by our Core Commitments and Principles, which serve to help the longevity, transparency, and impact of our open source projects.

NGINX秉持開源精神，致力於成為開源生態系統的積極貢獻者和領導者。我們的核心承諾和原則體現了這一點，旨在提升開源專案的長期發展、透明度和影響力。

**Our Core Commitments｜我們的核心承諾**

-   We will be open, consistent, transparent, and fair in our acceptance of contributions.  
    我們將秉持公開、一致、透明和公平的原則接受捐款。
-   We will continue to enhance existing active projects.  
    我們將繼續推進現有正在進行的項目。
-   We will release new projects that move technology forward.  
    我們將發布推動技術進步的新項目。
-   We will continue to offer projects under OSI-approved software licenses.  
    我們將繼續提供符合OSI認證軟體授權的項目。
-   We will not remove and commercialize existing projects or features.  
    我們不會移除現有項目或功能並將其商業化。
-   We will not impose limits on the use of our projects.  
    我們不會對我們項目的使用施加任何限制。

**NGINX Open Source Principles｜NGINX開源原則**

-   All contributions are reviewed by the technical committee for that project.  
    所有投稿將由該專案的技術委員會進行審核。
-   Our contribution review discussions are available and publicly viewable to provide transparency.  
    為了確保透明度，我們的捐款審核討論內容是公開的，可以查閱。
-   Project roadmaps are public and future direction is discussed in the open.  
    專案路線圖是公開的，未來的發展方向也會公開討論。

<a id="p-040"></a>

#### Setting up hashes｜設定哈希

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/hash.html>

##### Setting up hashes｜設定哈希

To quickly process static sets of data such as server names, [map](#p-078) directive’s values, MIME types, names of request header strings, nginx uses hash tables. During the start and each re-configuration nginx selects the minimum possible sizes of hash tables such that the bucket size that stores keys with identical hash values does not exceed the configured parameter (hash bucket size). The size of a table is expressed in buckets. The adjustment is continued until the table size exceeds the hash max size parameter. Most hashes have the corresponding directives that allow changing these parameters, for example, for the server names hash they are [server\_names\_hash\_max\_size](#p-056) and [server\_names\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-056).

為了快速處理靜態資料集，例如伺服器名稱、[map](#p-078)指令值、 MIME類型、請求頭字串名稱等，nginx 使用雜湊表。在啟動和每次重新配置期間，nginx 會選擇雜湊表的最小可能大小，以確保儲存具有相同雜湊值的鍵的桶大小不超過配置的參數（雜湊桶大小）。表的大小以桶為單位。此調整會持續進行，直到表大小超過哈希表的最大大小參數。大多數哈希表都有相應的指令允許更改這些參數，例如，伺服器名稱哈希表的指令是 [server\_names\_hash\_max\_size](#p-056)和 [server\_names\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-056) 。

The hash bucket size parameter is aligned to the size that is a multiple of the processor’s cache line size. This speeds up key search in a hash on modern processors by reducing the number of memory accesses. If hash bucket size is equal to one processor’s cache line size then the number of memory accesses during the key search will be two in the worst case — first to compute the bucket address, and second during the key search inside the bucket. Therefore, if nginx emits the message requesting to increase either hash max size or hash bucket size then the first parameter should first be increased.

哈希桶大小參數設定為處理器快取行大小的倍數。這透過減少記憶體存取次數，加快了現代處理器上哈希表中的鍵查找速度。如果哈希桶大小等於一個處理器的快取行大小，那麼在最壞情況下，鍵查找期間的記憶體存取次數為兩次——第一次用於計算桶位址，第二次用於在桶內尋找鍵。因此，如果 nginx 發出訊息請求增加哈希最大大小或雜湊桶大小，則應先增加第一個參數。

|   |

**Prerequisites｜先決條件**

To build nginx on the Microsoft Win32® platform you need:

要在 Microsoft Win32® 平台上建置 nginx，您需要：

-   Microsoft Visual C compiler. Microsoft Visual Studio® 8, 10, 17 are known to work.  
    微軟 Visual C 編譯器。已知 Microsoft Visual Studio® 8、10 和 17 均可正常運作。
-   [MSYS](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mingw/files/MSYS/) or [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org/).  
    [MSYS](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mingw/files/MSYS/)或 [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org/) 。
-   Perl, if you want to build OpenSSL® and nginx with SSL support. For example [ActivePerl](http://www.activestate.com/activeperl) or [Strawberry Perl](http://strawberryperl.com/).  
    如果您想建造支援SSL的OpenSSL®和nginx，可以使用Perl。例如[ActivePerl](http://www.activestate.com/activeperl)或[Strawberry Perl](http://strawberryperl.com/) 。
-   [Git](https://cli.github.com/) client.  
    [Git](https://cli.github.com/)客戶端。
-   [PCRE](http://www.pcre.org/), [zlib](http://zlib.net/) and [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/) libraries sources.  
    [PCRE](http://www.pcre.org/) , [zlib](http://zlib.net/)和 [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/)庫原始碼。

**Build steps｜建置步驟**

Ensure that paths to Perl, Git and MSYS bin directories are added to PATH environment variable before you start build. To set Visual C environment run vcvarsall.bat script from Visual C directory.

在開始建置之前，請確保將 Perl、Git 和 bin MSYS的路徑新增至環境PATH 。若要設定 Visual C 環境，請從 Visual C 目錄執行 vcvarsall.bat 腳本。

To build nginx:

建構 nginx：

-   Start MSYS bash.  
    啟動MSYS bash。
-   Check out nginx sources from the GitHub repository:  
    從 GitHub 倉庫查看 nginx 原始碼：
    
    > ```bash
    >
    > ````bash
    > git clone https://github.com/nginx/nginx.git
    > ```
    
-   Create a build and lib directories, and unpack zlib, PCRE and OpenSSL libraries sources into lib directory:  
    建立 build 和 lib 目錄，並將 zlib、 PCRE和 OpenSSL 函式庫的源碼解壓縮到 lib 目錄中：

    >
    > ````bash
    > mkdir objs
    > mkdir objs/lib
    > cd objs/lib
    > tar -xzf ../../pcre2-10.39.tar.gz
    >

-   Run configure script:  
    運行配置腳本：
    
    > ```
    > auto/configure \

    >     --conf-path=conf/nginx.conf \

-   Run make:  
    運行 make：
    
    > ```
    > nmake

#### http

<a id="p-042"></a>

##### Configuring HTTPS servers｜配置HTTPS伺服器

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html>

###### Configuring HTTPS servers｜配置HTTPS伺服器

|   |
| --- |
| [HTTPS server optimization](#p-042)<br>[SSL certificate chains](#p-042)<br>[A single HTTP/HTTPS server](#p-042)<br>[Name-based HTTPS servers](#p-042)<br>     [An SSL certificate with several names](#p-042)<br>     [Server Name Indication](#p-042)<br>[Compatibility](#p-042)<br>[HTTPS 伺服器最佳化](#p-042)<br> [SSL 憑證鏈](#p-042)<br> [單一 HTTP/HTTPS 伺服器](#p-042)<br> [基於名稱的 HTTPS 伺服器](#p-042)<br> [具有多個名稱的(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html#name_based_https_servers)<br>憑證(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html#sni)<br> [相容性](#p-042) |

To configure an HTTPS server, the `ssl` parameter must be enabled on [listening sockets](#p-056) in the [server](#p-056) block, and the locations of the [server certificate](#p-098) and [private key](#p-098) files should be specified:

要設定HTTPS伺服器，必須在[server](#p-056)區塊中的[監聽套接字](#p-056)上啟用`ssl`參數，並且應指定[伺服器憑證](#p-098)和[私鑰](#p-098)檔案的位置：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen              443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name         www.example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.com；
>     ssl_certificate     www.example.com.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate www.example.com.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key www.example.com.key;
>     ssl_protocols       TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>
>     ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>     ssl_ciphers         HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
>
>     ssl_ciphers HIGH :!aNULL:! MD5 ;
>     ...
> }
> ```

The server certificate is a public entity. It is sent to every client that connects to the server. The private key is a secure entity and should be stored in a file with restricted access, however, it must be readable by nginx’s master process. The private key may alternately be stored in the same file as the certificate:

伺服器憑證是公開的，會傳送給每個連接到伺服器的用戶端。私鑰是安全的，應該儲存在存取受限的檔案中，但必須能夠被 nginx 的主進程讀取。私鑰也可以與憑證儲存在同一個檔案中。

> ```
>     ssl_certificate     www.example.com.cert;
>
>     ssl_certificate www.example.com.cert;
>     ssl_certificate_key www.example.com.cert;
> ```

in which case the file access rights should also be restricted. Although the certificate and the key are stored in one file, only the certificate is sent to a client.

在這種情況下，也應該限製文件存取權限。雖然憑證和金鑰儲存在同一個文件中，但只有憑證會被傳送給客戶端。

The directives [ssl\_protocols](#p-098) and [ssl\_ciphers](#p-098) can be used to limit connections to include only the strong versions and ciphers of SSL/TLS. By default nginx uses “`ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3`” and “`ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5`”, so configuring them explicitly is generally not needed. Note that default values of these directives were [changed](#p-042) several times.

指令 [ssl\_protocols](#p-098)和 [ssl\_ciphers](#p-098)可用於限制連接，使其僅包含SSL/TLS的強版本和密碼套件。 nginx 預設使用“ `ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3` ”和“ `ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5` ”，因此通常無需明確配置它們。請注意，這些指令的預設值已多次變更(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html#compatibility) 。

**HTTPS server optimization｜HTTPS伺服器優化**

SSL operations consume extra CPU resources. On multi-processor systems several [worker processes](#p-125) should be run, no less than the number of available CPU cores. The most CPU-intensive operation is the SSL handshake. There are two ways to minimize the number of these operations per client: the first is by enabling [keepalive](#p-056) connections to send several requests via one connection and the second is to reuse SSL session parameters to avoid SSL handshakes for parallel and subsequent connections. The sessions are stored in an SSL session cache shared between workers and configured by the [ssl\_session\_cache](#p-098) directive. One megabyte of the cache contains about 4000 sessions. The default cache timeout is 5 minutes. It can be increased by using the [ssl\_session\_timeout](#p-098) directive. Here is a sample configuration optimized for a multi-core system with 10 megabyte shared session cache:

SSL 操作會消耗額外的 CPU 資源。在多處理器系統上，應運行多個[工作進程](#p-125)，不少於可用的CPU核心數量。 CPU 最密集的操作是SSL 握手。有兩種方法可以最大限度地減少每個客戶端的這些操作數量：第一種是啟用 [keepalive](#p-056) 連接以透過一個連接發送多個請求，第二種是重用 SSL 會話參數以避免並行和後續連接的 SSL 握手。會話儲存在工作人員之間共用的 SSL 會話快取中，並由 [ssl\_session\_cache](#p-098) 指令配置。 1 MB 的快取包含約 4000 個會話。預設快取逾時為 5 分鐘。可以透過使用 [ssl\_session\_timeout](#p-098) 指令來增加它。以下是針對具有 10 MB 共享會話快取的多核心系統進行最佳化的範例配置：

> ```
> worker_processes auto;
>
> worker_processes 自動；
> 
> http {
>
> http{
>     ssl_session_cache   shared:SSL:10m;
>
>     ssl_session_cache 共享: SSL :10m;
>     ssl_session_timeout 10m;
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器{
>         listen              443 ssl;
>
>         監聽 443 ssl；
>         server_name         www.example.com;
>
>         伺服器名稱 www.example.com；
>         keepalive_timeout   70;
>
>         keepalive_timeout 70;
> 
>         ssl_certificate     www.example.com.crt;
>
>         ssl_certificate www.example.com.crt;
>         ssl_certificate_key www.example.com.key;
>         ssl_protocols       TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>
>         ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>         ssl_ciphers         HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
>
>         ssl_ciphers HIGH :!aNULL:! MD5 ;
>         ...
> ```

**SSL certificate chains｜SSL證書鏈**

Some browsers may complain about a certificate signed by a well-known certificate authority, while other browsers may accept the certificate without issues. This occurs because the issuing authority has signed the server certificate using an intermediate certificate that is not present in the certificate base of well-known trusted certificate authorities which is distributed with a particular browser. In this case the authority provides a bundle of chained certificates which should be concatenated to the signed server certificate. The server certificate must appear before the chained certificates in the combined file:

某些瀏覽器可能會對知名憑證授權單位簽發的憑證提出異議，而其他瀏覽器則可能毫無問題地接受該憑證。這是因為頒發機構使用了一個中間憑證對伺服器憑證進行了簽名，而該中間憑證並不存在於特定瀏覽器隨附的知名可信任憑證授權單位的憑證庫中。在這種情況下，頒發機構會提供一組鍊式證書，這些證書應與已簽署的伺服器證書連接起來。在合併後的憑證檔案中，伺服器憑證必須位於鍊式憑證之前：

> ```bash
>
> ````bash
> $ cat www.example.com.crt bundle.crt > www.example.com.chained.crt
> ```

The resulting file should be used in the [ssl\_certificate](#p-098) directive:

產生的檔案應在 [ssl\_certificate](#p-098)指令中使用：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen              443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name         www.example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.com；
>     ssl_certificate     www.example.com.chained.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate www.example.com.chained.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key www.example.com.key;
>     ...
> }
> ```

If the server certificate and the bundle have been concatenated in the wrong order, nginx will fail to start and will display the error message:

如果伺服器憑證和捆綁包的連線順序錯誤，nginx 將無法啟動並顯示錯誤訊息：

> ```
> SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file(" ... /www.example.com.key") failed
>
> SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file(" ... /www.example.com.key") 失敗
>    (SSL: error:05800074:x509 certificate routines::key values mismatch)
>
>    （ SSL ：錯誤：05800074：x509 憑證程式::金鑰值不符）
> ```

because nginx has tried to use the private key with the bundle’s first certificate instead of the server certificate.

因為 nginx 嘗試使用捆綁包的第一個憑證中的私鑰，而不是伺服器憑證。

Browsers usually store intermediate certificates which they receive and which are signed by trusted authorities, so actively used browsers may already have the required intermediate certificates and may not complain about a certificate sent without a chained bundle. To ensure the server sends the complete certificate chain, the `openssl` command-line utility may be used, for example:

瀏覽器通常會儲存接收到的、由受信任機構簽署的中間證書，因此常用的瀏覽器可能已經擁有所需的中間證書，並且可能不會對缺少完整證書鏈的證書發出警告。為了確保伺服器發送完整的憑證鏈，可以使用`openssl`命令列實用程序，例如：

> ```bash
>
> ````bash
> $ openssl s_client -connect www.godaddy.com:443
> ...
> Certificate chain
>
> 憑證鏈
>  0 s:/C=US/ST=Arizona/L=Scottsdale/1.3.6.1.4.1.311.60.2.1.3=US
>
>  0 秒:/C= US/ST =亞利桑那州/L=斯科茨代爾/ 1.3.6.1.4.1.311.60.2.1.3 = US
>      /1.3.6.1.4.1.311.60.2.1.2=AZ/O=GoDaddy.com, Inc
>
>      / 1.3.6.1.4.1.311.60.2.1.2 = AZ /O=GoDaddy.com, Inc
>      /OU=MIS Department/CN=www.GoDaddy.com
>
>      / OU = MIS部門/ CN =www.GoDaddy.com
>      /serialNumber=0796928-7/2.5.4.15=V1.0, Clause 5.(b)
>
>      /serialNumber=0796928-7/ 2.5.4.15 = V1.0 , 第 5.(b) 條
>    i:/C=US/ST=Arizona/L=Scottsdale/O=GoDaddy.com, Inc.
>
>    i:/C= US/ST =Arizona/L=Scottsdale/O=GoDaddy.com, Inc.
>      /OU=http://certificates.godaddy.com/repository
>      /CN=Go Daddy Secure Certification Authority
>
>      / CN = GoDaddy 安全認證機構
>      /serialNumber=07969287
>  1 s:/C=US/ST=Arizona/L=Scottsdale/O=GoDaddy.com, Inc.
>
>  1 s:/C= US/ST =Arizona/L=Scottsdale/O=GoDaddy.com, Inc.
>      /OU=http://certificates.godaddy.com/repository
>      /CN=Go Daddy Secure Certification Authority
>
>      / CN = GoDaddy 安全認證機構
>      /serialNumber=07969287
>    i:/C=US/O=The Go Daddy Group, Inc.
>
>    i:/C= US /O=Go Daddy集團有限公司
>      /OU=Go Daddy Class 2 Certification Authority
>
>      / OU = GoDaddy 二級認證機構
>  2 s:/C=US/O=The Go Daddy Group, Inc.
>
>  2 s:/C= US /O=Go Daddy 集團有限公司
>      /OU=Go Daddy Class 2 Certification Authority
>
>      / OU = GoDaddy 二級認證機構
>    i:/L=ValiCert Validation Network/O=ValiCert, Inc.
>
>    i:/L=ValiCert 驗證網路/O=ValiCert, Inc.
>      /OU=ValiCert Class 2 Policy Validation Authority
>
>      / OU =ValiCert 二級保單驗證機構
>      /CN=http://www.valicert.com//emailAddress=info@valicert.com
> ...
> ```

In this example the subject (“*s*”) of the `www.GoDaddy.com` server certificate #0 is signed by an issuer (“*i*”) which itself is the subject of the certificate #1, which is signed by an issuer which itself is the subject of the certificate #2, which signed by the well-known issuer *ValiCert, Inc.* whose certificate is stored in the browsers’ built-in certificate base (that lay in the house that Jack built).

在這個例子中，主題（“*s*”） `www.GoDaddy.com` 伺服器憑證 #0 由頒發者（「*i*」）簽名，該頒發者本身是證書 #1 的主題，證書 #1 由頒發者簽名，證書 #2 本身是證書 #2 的主題，證書 #2 由知名頒發者 *ValiCert, Inc.* 簽名，其證書存儲在瀏覽器的內置證書庫中（位於 Jack 建造的房子裡）。

If a certificate bundle has not been added, only the server certificate #0 will be shown.

如果尚未新增憑證包，則只會顯示伺服器憑證 #0。

**A single HTTP/HTTPS server｜單一HTTP/HTTPS伺服器**

It is possible to configure a single server that handles both HTTP and HTTPS requests:

可以設定一台伺服器來處理HTTP和HTTPS請求：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen              80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     listen              443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name         www.example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.com；
>     ssl_certificate     www.example.com.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate www.example.com.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key www.example.com.key;
>     ...
> }
> ```

> Prior to 0.7.14 SSL could not be enabled selectively for individual listening sockets, as shown above. SSL could only be enabled for the entire server using the [ssl](#p-098) directive, making it impossible to set up a single HTTP/HTTPS server. The `ssl` parameter of the [listen](#p-056) directive was added to solve this issue. The use of the [ssl](#p-098) directive in modern versions is thus discouraged; it was removed in 1.25.1.
>
> 如上所示， 0.7.14 SSL之前無法針對單一監聽套接字選擇性地啟用SSL指令只能為整個伺服器啟用(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html#ssl) ，因此無法設定單一HTTP/HTTPS伺服器。為了解決這個問題，新增了 [listen](#p-056)指令的`ssl`參數。因此，不建議在現代版本中使用 [ssl](#p-098)指令；該指令已在1.25.1中移除。

**Name-based HTTPS servers｜基於名稱的HTTPS伺服器**

A common issue arises when configuring two or more HTTPS servers listening on a single IP address:

當配置兩個或多個監聽單一IP位址的HTTPS伺服器時，會出現一個常見問題：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen          443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name     www.example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.com；
>     ssl_certificate www.example.com.crt;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen          443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name     www.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.org；
>     ssl_certificate www.example.org.crt;
>     ...
> }
> ```

With this configuration a browser receives the default server’s certificate, i.e. `www.example.com` regardless of the requested server name. This is caused by SSL protocol behaviour. The SSL connection is established before the browser sends an HTTP request and nginx does not know the name of the requested server. Therefore, it may only offer the default server’s certificate.

透過此配置，瀏覽器將接收預設伺服器的證書，即`www.example.com`，無論請求的伺服器名稱為何。這是由SSL協議行為引起的。 SSL連線是在瀏覽器發送HTTP請求之前建立的，並且nginx不知道請求的伺服器的名稱。因此，它可能只提供預設伺服器的憑證。

The oldest and most robust method to resolve the issue is to assign a separate IP address for every HTTPS server:

解決此問題的最古老、最可靠的方法是為每個HTTPS伺服器分配一個單獨的IP位址：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen          192.168.1.1:443 ssl;
>
>     監聽192.168.1.1:443 ssl;
>     server_name     www.example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.com；
>     ssl_certificate www.example.com.crt;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen          192.168.1.2:443 ssl;
>
>     監聽192.168.1.2:443 ssl;
>     server_name     www.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.org；
>     ssl_certificate www.example.org.crt;
>     ...
> }
> ```

**An SSL certificate with several names｜一份包含多個名稱的SSL證書**

There are other ways that allow sharing a single IP address between several HTTPS servers. However, all of them have their drawbacks. One way is to use a certificate with several names in the SubjectAltName certificate field, for example, `www.example.com` and `www.example.org`. However, the SubjectAltName field length is limited.

還有其他方法允許多個HTTPS伺服器共享同一個IP位址。但是，所有這些方法都有其缺點。一種方法是在憑證的 SubjectAltName 欄位中使用多個名稱，例如`www.example.com`和`www.example.org` 。但是，SubjectAltName 欄位的長度是有限制的。

Another way is to use a certificate with a wildcard name, for example, `*.example.org`. A wildcard certificate secures all subdomains of the specified domain, but only on one level. This certificate matches `www.example.org`, but does not match `example.org` and `www.sub.example.org`. These two methods can also be combined. A certificate may contain exact and wildcard names in the SubjectAltName field, for example, `example.org` and `*.example.org`.

另一種方法是使用帶有通配符名稱的證書，例如`*.example.org` 。通配符憑證可以保護指定網域的所有子網域，但僅限於一級。此證書符合`www.example.org` ，但不符`example.org`和`www.sub.example.org` 。這兩種方法也可以結合使用。憑證的 SubjectAltName 欄位可以同時包含精確名稱和通配符名稱，例如`example.org`和`*.example.org` 。

It is better to place a certificate file with several names and its private key file at the *http* level of configuration to inherit their single memory copy in all servers:

最好將包含多個憑證名稱的憑證檔案及其私密金鑰檔案放在 *http* 層級的配置中，以便在所有伺服器上繼承它們的單一記憶體副本：

> ```
> ssl_certificate     common.crt;
>
> ssl_certificate common.crt;
> ssl_certificate_key common.key;
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen          443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name     www.example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.com；
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen          443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name     www.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.org；
>     ...
> }
> ```

**Server Name Indication｜伺服器名稱指示**

A more generic solution for running several HTTPS servers on a single IP address is [TLS Server Name Indication extension](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) (SNI, RFC 6066), which allows a browser to pass a requested server name during the SSL handshake and, therefore, the server will know which certificate it should use for the connection. SNI is currently [supported](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication#Support) by most modern browsers and is a mandatory-to-implement extension in TLSv1.3, though may not be used by some old or special clients.

在單一IP上執行多個HTTPS的更通用解決方案是使用伺服器名稱指示擴充功能 ( TLS (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) ( SNI, RFC )，它允許瀏覽器在SSL期間傳遞請求的伺服器名稱，從而使伺服器知道應該使用哪個憑證進行連線。目前，大多數現代瀏覽器都支援SNI (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication#Support)而且它是 TLSv1.3 中強制實現的擴展，但某些舊版或特殊用戶端可能不支援。

> Only domain names can be passed in SNI, however some browsers may erroneously pass an IP address of the server as its name if a request includes literal IP address. One should not rely on this.
>
> SNI只能傳遞域名，但如果請求中包含字面地址IP ，某些瀏覽器可能會錯誤地將伺服器位址IP當作名稱傳遞。請勿依賴此行為。

In order to use SNI in nginx, it must be supported in both the OpenSSL library with which the nginx binary has been built as well as the library to which it is being dynamically linked at run time. OpenSSL supports SNI since 0.9.8f version if it was built with config option “--enable-tlsext”. Since OpenSSL 0.9.8j this option is enabled by default. If nginx was built with SNI support, then nginx will show this when run with the “-V” switch:

要在 nginx 中使用SNI ，nginx 二進位檔案建置時所使用的 OpenSSL 函式庫以及執行時間動態連結到的函式庫都必須支援該功能。如果 OpenSSL 在建置時使用了設定選項“--enable-tlsext”，則自0.9版本起，它支援SNI 。自 OpenSSL 0.9版本起，此選項預設為啟用。如果 nginx 在建置時使用了SNI支持，則在使用「-V」開關運行時，nginx 將顯示以下資訊：

> ```bash
>
> ````bash
> $ nginx -V
> ...
> TLS SNI support enabled
>
> TLS SNI支援已啟用
> ...
> ```

However, if the SNI-enabled nginx is linked dynamically to an OpenSSL library without SNI support, nginx displays the warning:

但是，如果啟用了SNI的nginx動態連結到不支援SNI的OpenSSL函式庫，nginx將顯示警告：

> ```
> nginx was built with SNI support, however, now it is linked
>
> nginx 最初是為SNI構建的，但是現在它已鏈接
> dynamically to an OpenSSL library which has no tlsext support,
>
> 動態地傳遞給不支援 tlsext 的 OpenSSL 函式庫，
> therefore SNI is not available
>
> 因此， SNI不可用
> ```

**Compatibility｜相容性**

-   The SNI support status has been shown by the “-V” switch since 0.8.21 and 0.7.62.  
    自0.8.21和0.7.62以來， SNI支持狀態已透過「-V」開關顯示。
-   The `ssl` parameter of the [listen](#p-056) directive has been supported since 0.7.14. Prior to 0.8.21 it could only be specified along with the `default` parameter.  
    [listen] 指令的`ssl`參數自0.7.14起就已支援。在0.8.21之前(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#listen)它只能與`default`參數一起指定。
-   SNI has been supported since 0.5.23.  
    自0.5.23以來， SNI一直受到支持。
-   The shared SSL session cache has been supported since 0.5.6.  
    自0.5.6以來，一直支援共享的SSL會話快取。

-   Version 1.27.3 and later: the default SSL protocols are TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3 (if supported by the OpenSSL library). Otherwise, when OpenSSL 1.0.0 or older is used, the default SSL protocols are TLSv1 and TLSv1.1.  
    版本1.27.3及更高版本：預設SSL協定為TLSv1.2及TLSv1.3（若OpenSSL函式庫支援）。否則，當使用1.0.0或更早版本時，預設SSL協定為TLSv1和TLSv1.1。
-   Version 1.23.4 and later: the default SSL protocols are TLSv1, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2, and TLSv1.3 (if supported by the OpenSSL library).  
    版本1.23.4及更高版本：預設SSL協定為 TLSv1、TLSv1.1、TLSv1.2 和 TLSv1.3（若 OpenSSL 函式庫支援）。
-   Version 1.9.1 and later: the default SSL protocols are TLSv1, TLSv1.1, and TLSv1.2 (if supported by the OpenSSL library).  
    版本1.9.1及更高版本：預設SSL協定為 TLSv1、TLSv1.1 和 TLSv1.2（若 OpenSSL 函式庫支援）。
-   Version 0.7.65, 0.8.19 and later: the default SSL protocols are SSLv3, TLSv1, TLSv1.1, and TLSv1.2 (if supported by the OpenSSL library).  
    版本0.7.65, 0.8.19及更高版本：預設SSL協定為 SSLv3、TLSv1、TLSv1.1 和 TLSv1.2（若 OpenSSL 函式庫支援）。
-   Version 0.7.64, 0.8.18 and earlier: the default SSL protocols are SSLv2, SSLv3, and TLSv1.  
    版本0.7.64, 0.8.18及更早版本：預設SSL協定為 SSLv2、SSLv3 和 TLSv1。

-   Version 1.0.5 and later: the default SSL ciphers are “`HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5`”.  
    版本1.0.5及更高版本：預設的SSL密碼為「 `HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5` 」。
-   Version 0.7.65, 0.8.20 and later: the default SSL ciphers are “`HIGH:!ADH:!MD5`”.  
    版本0.7.65, 0.8.20及更高版本：預設的SSL密碼為「 `HIGH:!ADH:!MD5` 」。
-   Version 0.8.19: the default SSL ciphers are “`ALL:!ADH:RC4+RSA:+HIGH:+MEDIUM`”.  
    版本0.8.19 ：預設的SSL密碼為「 `ALL:!ADH:RC4+RSA:+HIGH:+MEDIUM` 」。
-   Version 0.7.64, 0.8.18 and earlier: the default SSL ciphers are  
    版本0.7.64, 0.8.18及更早版本：預設的SSL密碼為  
    “`ALL:!ADH:RC4+RSA:+HIGH:+MEDIUM:+LOW:+SSLv2:+EXP`”.

<a id="p-043"></a>

##### Converting rewrite rules｜轉換重寫規則

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/converting_rewrite_rules.html>

###### Converting rewrite rules｜轉換重寫規則

|   |
| --- |
| [Converting Mongrel rules](#p-043)<br>[轉換雜種規則](#p-043) |

**A redirect to a main site｜重定向到主站點**

People who during their shared hosting life used to configure *everything* using *only* Apache’s .htaccess files, usually translate the following rules:

那些在共享主機時代習慣於僅使用 Apache 的 .htaccess 檔案來配置所有設定的人，通常會理解以下規則：

> ```
> RewriteCond  %{HTTP_HOST}  example.org
>
> RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} example.org
> RewriteRule  (.*)          http://www.example.org$1
>
> RewriteRule (.*) http://www.example.org$1
> ```

to something like this:

類似這樣：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  www.example.org  example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.org example.org;
>     if ($http_host = example.org) {
>
>     如果 ($http_host = example.org) {
>         rewrite  (.*)  http://www.example.org$1;
>
>         重寫 (.*) http://www.example.org$1;
>     }
>     ...
> }
> ```

This is a wrong, cumbersome, and ineffective way. The right way is to define a separate server for `example.org`:

這是一種錯誤、繁瑣且低效的方法。正確的方法是為`example.org`定義一個單獨的伺服器：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.org；
>     return       301 http://www.example.org$request_uri;
>
>     返回 301 http://www.example.org$request_uri;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  www.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 www.example.org；
>     ...
> }
> ```

> On versions prior to 0.9.1, redirects can be made with:
>
> 在0.9.1之前的版本中，可以使用以下方式進行重定向：
> 
> > ```
> >     rewrite      ^ http://www.example.org$request_uri?;
> >
> >     重寫 ^ http://www.example.org$request_uri?;
> > ```

Another example. Instead of the “upside-down” logic “all that is not `example.com` and is not `www.example.com`”:

另一個例子。與其使用「顛倒」的邏輯「所有不屬於`example.com`且不屬於`www.example.com` 」：

> ```
> RewriteCond  %{HTTP_HOST}  !example.com
>
> RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !example.com
> RewriteCond  %{HTTP_HOST}  !www.example.com
>
> RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !www.example.com
> RewriteRule  (.*)          http://www.example.com$1
>
> RewriteRule (.*) http://www.example.com$1
> ```

one should simply define `example.com`, `www.example.com`, and “everything else”:

只需定義`example.com`, `www.example.com` ，以及「其他所有內容」：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  example.com www.example.com;
>
>     server_name example.com www.example.com;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen       80 default_server;
>
>     監聽 80 埠預設伺服器；
>     server_name  _;
>
>     伺服器名稱_;
>     return       301 http://example.com$request_uri;
>
>     返回 301 http://example.com$request_uri;
> }
> ```

> On versions prior to 0.9.1, redirects can be made with:
>
> 在0.9.1之前的版本中，可以使用以下方式進行重定向：
> 
> > ```
> >     rewrite      ^ http://example.com$request_uri?;
> >
> >     重寫 ^ http://example.com$request_uri?;
> > ```

**Converting Mongrel rules｜轉換雜種規則**

Typical Mongrel rules:

典型的雜種犬法則：

> ```
> DocumentRoot /var/www/myapp.com/current/public
> 
> RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/system/maintenance.html -f
> RewriteCond %{SCRIPT_FILENAME} !maintenance.html
> RewriteRule ^.*$ %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/system/maintenance.html [L]
> 
> RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -f
> RewriteRule ^(.*)$ $1 [QSA,L]
>
> 重寫規則 ^(.*)$ $1 [ QSA ,L]
> 
> RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME}/index.html -f
> RewriteRule ^(.*)$ $1/index.html [QSA,L]
>
> RewriteRule ^(.*)$ $1/index.html [ QSA ,L]
> 
> RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME}.html -f
> RewriteRule ^(.*)$ $1.html [QSA,L]
>
> 重寫規則 ^(.*)$ $1.html [ QSA ,L]
> 
> RewriteRule ^/(.*)$ balancer://mongrel_cluster%{REQUEST_URI} [P,QSA,L]
>
> RewriteRule ^/(.*)$ balancer://mongrel_cluster%{REQUEST_URI} [P, QSA ,L]
> ```

should be converted to

應該轉換為

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     root       /var/www/myapp.com/current/public;
>
>     root /var/www/myapp.com/current/public;
> 
>     try_files  /system/maintenance.html
>
>     嘗試檔案 /system/maintenance.html
>                $uri  $uri/index.html $uri.html
>
>                $url $url/index.html $url.html
>                @mongrel;
>
>                @mongrel；
> }
> 
> location @mongrel {
>
> 位置 @mongrel {
>     proxy_pass  http://mongrel;
>
>     proxy_pass http://mongrel;
> }
> ```

---

<a id="p-044"></a>

##### Using nginx as HTTP load balancer｜使用 nginx 作為HTTP負載平衡器

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/load_balancing.html>

###### Using nginx as HTTP load balancer｜使用 nginx 作為HTTP負載平衡器

|   |
| --- |
| [Load balancing methods](#p-044)<br>[Default load balancing configuration](#p-044)<br>[Least connected load balancing](#p-044)<br>[Least time load balancing](#p-044)<br>[Session persistence](#p-044)<br>[Weighted load balancing](#p-044)<br>[Health checks](#p-044)<br>[Further reading](#p-044)<br>[負載平衡方法](#p-044)<br>[預設負載平衡配置](#p-044)<br>[連線數最少的負載平衡](#p-044)<br>[最短時間負載平衡](#p-044)<br>[會談持久性](#p-044)<br>[加權負載平衡](#p-044)<br>[健康檢查](#p-044)<br>[延伸閱讀](#p-044) |

**Introduction｜簡介**

Load balancing across multiple application instances is a commonly used technique for optimizing resource utilization, maximizing throughput, reducing latency, and ensuring fault-tolerant configurations.

跨多個應用程式實例進行負載平衡是一種常用的技術，用於最佳化資源利用率、最大化吞吐量、減少延遲和確保容錯配置。

It is possible to use nginx as a very efficient HTTP load balancer to distribute traffic to several application servers and to improve performance, scalability and reliability of web applications with nginx.

可以使用 nginx 作為非常高效的HTTP負載平衡器，將流量分配到多個應用程式伺服器，並使用 nginx 提高 Web 應用程式的效能、可擴充性和可靠性。

**Load balancing methods｜負載平衡方法**

The following load balancing mechanisms (or methods) are supported in nginx:

nginx 支援以下負載平衡機制（或方法）：

-   round-robin — requests to the application servers are distributed in a round-robin fashion,  
    輪詢－向應用程式伺服器發送的請求以輪詢方式分發。
-   least-connected — next request is assigned to the server with the least number of active connections,  
    連線數最少－下一個請求會被指派給活動連線數最少的伺服器。
-   ip-hash — a hash-function is used to determine what server should be selected for the next request (based on the client’s IP address).  
    ip-hash — 雜湊函數用於確定應為下一個請求選擇哪個伺服器（基於客戶端的IP位址）。

**Default load balancing configuration｜預設負載平衡配置**

The simplest configuration for load balancing with nginx may look like the following:

使用 nginx 進行負載平衡的最簡單設定可能如下所示：

> ```
> http {
>
> http{
>     upstream myapp1 {
>
>     上游 myapp1 {
>         server srv1.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv1.example.com；
>         server srv2.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv2.example.com；
>         server srv3.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv3.example.com；
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器{
>         listen 80;
>
>         聽 80；
> 
>         location / {
>
>         地點/{
>             proxy_pass http://myapp1;
>         }
>     }
> }
> ```

In the example above, there are 3 instances of the same application running on srv1-srv3. When the load balancing method is not specifically configured, it defaults to round-robin. All requests are [proxied](#p-085) to the server group myapp1, and nginx applies HTTP load balancing to distribute the requests.

在上面的範例中，同一個應用程式在 srv1-srv3 上運行了 3 個實例。當未明確配置負載平衡方法時，預設採用輪詢（round-robin）。所有請求都透過 [provated](#p-085)代理到伺服器群組 myapp1，然後由 nginx 應用HTTP負載平衡來分發這些請求。

Reverse proxy implementation in nginx includes load balancing for HTTP, HTTPS, FastCGI, uwsgi, SCGI, memcached, and gRPC.

nginx 中的反向代理實作包括對HTTP, HTTPS 、FastCGI、uwsgi、 SCGI 、memcached 和 gRPC 的負載平衡。

To configure load balancing for HTTPS instead of HTTP, just use “https” as the protocol.

要為HTTPS而不是HTTP配置負載平衡，只需使用「https」作為協議即可。

When setting up load balancing for FastCGI, uwsgi, SCGI, memcached, or gRPC, use [fastcgi\_pass](#p-060), [uwsgi\_pass](#p-107), [scgi\_pass](#p-091), [memcached\_pass](#p-079), and [grpc\_pass](#p-064) directives respectively.

為 FastCGI、uwsgi、 SCGI 、memcached 或 gRPC 設定負載平衡時，請分別使用 [fastcgi\_pass](#p-060) 、[uwsgi\_pass](#p-107) 、[scgi\_pass](#p-091) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_memcached_module.html#memcached_pass)和 [grpc\_pass](#p-064)指令。

**Least connected load balancing｜最少連線負載平衡**

Another load balancing discipline is least-connected. Least-connected allows controlling the load on application instances more fairly in a situation when some of the requests take longer to complete.

另一種負載平衡策略是最小連線策略。最小連接策略允許在某些請求需要較長時間才能完成的情況下，更公平地控制應用程式實例上的負載。

With the least-connected load balancing, nginx will try not to overload a busy application server with excessive requests, distributing the new requests to a less busy server instead.

在連線數最少的負載平衡模式下，nginx 會盡量避免用過多的請求使繁忙的應用程式伺服器過載，而是將新的請求分發到不太繁忙的伺服器上。

Least-connected load balancing in nginx is activated when the [least\_conn](#p-105) directive is used as part of the server group configuration:

當在伺服器群組設定中使用 [least\_conn](#p-105)指令時，nginx 中的最少連線負載平衡功能將會啟動：

> ```
>     upstream myapp1 {
>
>     上游 myapp1 {
>         least_conn;
>
>         最少連線數；
>         server srv1.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv1.example.com；
>         server srv2.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv2.example.com；
>         server srv3.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv3.example.com；
>     }
> ```

**Least time load balancing｜最短時間負載平衡**

Another load balancing discipline is least-time. Least-time selects the server with the lowest average response time and the lowest number of active connections, taking into account inflight requests.

另一種負載平衡策略是最小回應時間策略。最小回應時間策略會選擇平均回應時間最短、活動連線數最少的伺服器，同時考慮正在處理的請求。

With the least-time load balancing, nginx selects the server based on which of the following parameters is specified in the [least\_time](#p-105) directive:

使用最短時間負載平衡時，nginx 會根據 [least\_time](#p-105)指令中指定的下列哪一個參數來選擇伺服器：

-   `header` — time to receive the first byte from the server,  
    `header` — 從伺服器接收第一個位元組的時間，
-   `last_byte` — time to receive the full response from the server,  
    `last_byte` — 等待伺服器回傳完整回應，
-   `last_byte inflight` — time to receive the full response from the server, taking into account incomplete requests.  
    `last_byte inflight` — 從伺服器接收完整回應所需的時間，考慮到不完整的請求。

Least-time load balancing in nginx is activated when the [least\_time](#p-105) directive is used as part of the server group configuration:

當在伺服器群組配置中使用 [least\_time](#p-105)指令時，nginx 中的最短時間負載平衡功能將會啟動：

> ```
>     upstream myapp1 {
>
>     上游 myapp1 {
>         least_time header;
>
>         最少時間標頭；
>         server srv1.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv1.example.com；
>         server srv2.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv2.example.com；
>         server srv3.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv3.example.com；
>     }
> ```

**Session persistence｜會話持久性**

Please note that with round-robin or least-connected load balancing, each subsequent client’s request can be potentially distributed to a different server. There is no guarantee that the same client will be always directed to the same server.

請注意，使用輪詢或最少連線數負載平衡時，每個後續用戶端的請求可能會被指派到不同的伺服器。無法保證同一客戶端始終被導向到同一台伺服器。

If there is the need to tie a client to a particular application server — in other words, make the client’s session “sticky” or “persistent” in terms of always trying to select a particular server — the ip-hash load balancing mechanism can be used.

如果需要將客戶端綁定到特定的應用程式伺服器——換句話說，要使客戶端會話“粘性”或“持久性”，請始終嘗試選擇特定的伺服器——可以使用 ip-hash 負載平衡機制。

With ip-hash, the client’s IP address is used as a hashing key to determine what server in a server group should be selected for the client’s requests. This method ensures that the requests from the same client will always be directed to the same server except when this server is unavailable.

使用 IP 雜湊演算法時，客戶端的IP位址被用作雜湊金鑰，以確定應從伺服器群組中選擇哪個伺服器來處理客戶端的請求。這種方法確保來自同一客戶端的請求始終被定向到同一台伺服器，除非該伺服器不可用。

To configure ip-hash load balancing, just add the [ip\_hash](#p-105) directive to the server (upstream) group configuration:

要設定 ip-hash 負載平衡，只需將 [ip\_hash](#p-105)指令新增至伺服器（上游）群組配置中：

> ```
> upstream myapp1 {
>
> 上游 myapp1 {
>     ip_hash;
>
>     IP哈希值；
>     server srv1.example.com;
>
>     伺服器 srv1.example.com；
>     server srv2.example.com;
>
>     伺服器 srv2.example.com；
>     server srv3.example.com;
>
>     伺服器 srv3.example.com；
> }
> ```

**Weighted load balancing｜加權負載平衡**

It is also possible to influence nginx load balancing algorithms even further by using server weights.

也可以透過使用伺服器權重來進一步影響 nginx 負載平衡演算法。

In the examples above, the server weights are not configured which means that all specified servers are treated as equally qualified for a particular load balancing method.

在上面的範例中，伺服器權重沒有配置，這意味著所有指定的伺服器都被視為同樣適用於特定的負載平衡方法。

With the round-robin in particular it also means a more or less equal distribution of requests across the servers — provided there are enough requests, and when the requests are processed in a uniform manner and completed fast enough.

特別是對於輪詢調度來說，這意味著請求在各個伺服器上的分配大致相等——前提是請求足夠多，並且請求以統一的方式處理，並且完成速度足夠快。

When the [weight](#p-105) parameter is specified for a server, the weight is accounted as part of the load balancing decision.

當為伺服器指定 [weight](#p-105)參數時，該權重將作為負載平衡決策的一部分加以考慮。

> ```
>     upstream myapp1 {
>
>     上游 myapp1 {
>         server srv1.example.com weight=3;
>
>         伺服器 srv1.example.com 權重=3；
>         server srv2.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv2.example.com；
>         server srv3.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 srv3.example.com；
>     }
> ```

With this configuration, every 5 new requests will be distributed across the application instances as the following: 3 requests will be directed to srv1, one request will go to srv2, and another one — to srv3.

透過這種配置，每 5 個新請求將如下分配到應用程式實例中：3 個請求將定向到 srv1，1 個請求將定向到 srv2，另一個請求將定向到 srv3。

It is similarly possible to use weights with the least-connected and ip-hash load balancing in the recent versions of nginx.

同樣，在最新版本的 nginx 中，也可以使用權重進行最少連接和 IP 雜湊負載平衡。

**Health checks｜健康檢查**

Reverse proxy implementation in nginx includes in-band (or passive) server health checks. If the response from a particular server fails with an error, nginx will mark this server as failed, and will try to avoid selecting this server for subsequent inbound requests for a while.

nginx 中的反向代理實作包含帶內（或被動）伺服器健康檢查。如果某個伺服器的回應出現錯誤，nginx 會將該伺服器標記為故障，並在一段時間內避免選擇該伺服器處理後續的入站要求。

The [max\_fails](#p-105) directive sets the number of consecutive unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server that should happen during [fail\_timeout](#p-105). By default, [max\_fails](#p-105) is set to 1. When it is set to 0, health checks are disabled for this server. The [fail\_timeout](#p-105) parameter also defines how long the server will be marked as failed. After [fail\_timeout](#p-105) interval following the server failure, nginx will start to gracefully probe the server with the live client’s requests. If the probes have been successful, the server is marked as a live one.

[max_fails](#p-105)指令設定在 [fail_timeout](#p-105)時間段內，與伺服器通訊連續失敗的次數。預設情況下，[max_fails](#p-105)設定為 1。設定為 0 時，將停用此伺服器的健康檢查。 [fail_timeout](#p-105)參數也定義了伺服器被標記為故障的持續時間。在伺服器故障後的 [fail_timeout](#p-105)時間間隔之後，nginx 將開始使用正常客戶端的請求優雅地探測伺服器。如果探測成功，則伺服器將被標記為正常。

**Further reading｜延伸閱讀**

In addition, there are more directives and parameters that control server load balancing in nginx, e.g. [proxy\_next\_upstream](#p-085), [backup](#p-105), [down](#p-105), and [keepalive](#p-105). For more information please check our [reference documentation](https://nginx.org/en/docs/).

此外，nginx 中還有更多指令和參數用於控制伺服器負載平衡，例如 [proxy\_next\_upstream](#p-085) 、[backup](#p-105) 、[down](#p-105)和 [keepalive](#p-105) 。更多資訊請參閱我們的 [參考文件](https://nginx.org/en/docs/) 。

Last but not least, application load balancing, application health checks, activity monitoring and on-the-fly reconfiguration of server groups are available as part of our paid NGINX Plus subscriptions.

最後但同樣重要的是，應用程式負載平衡、應用程式健康檢查、活動監控和伺服器群組的即時重新配置功能均包含在我們付費的NGINX Plus 訂閱中。

---

<a id="p-045"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_access_module｜模組 ngx_http_access_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_access_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_access\_module｜模組 ngx_http_access_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-045)<br>[Directives](#p-045)<br>     [allow](#p-045)<br>     [deny](#p-045)<br>[範例設定](#p-045)<br> [指令](#p-045)<br> [允許](#p-045)<br> [拒絕](#p-045) |

The `ngx_http_access_module` module allows limiting access to certain client addresses.

`ngx_http_access_module`模組允許限制對某些客戶端位址的存取。

Access can also be limited by [password](#p-049), by the [result of subrequest](#p-051), or by [JWT](#p-050). Simultaneous limitation of access by address and by password is controlled by the [satisfy](#p-056) directive.

存取也可以透過 [密碼](#p-049) 、[子請求結果](#p-051)或 [JWT](#p-050)來限制。透過位址和密碼同時限制存取由 [滿足](#p-056)指令控制。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     deny  192.168.1.1;
>
>     否認192.168.1.1 ；
>     allow 192.168.1.0/24;
>
>     允許192.168.1.0/24 ；
>     allow 10.1.1.0/16;
>
>     允許10.1.1.0/16 ；
>     allow 2001:0db8::/32;
>
>     允許2001:0db8::/32 ；
>     deny  all;
>
>     全部否認；
> }
> ```

The rules are checked in sequence until the first match is found. In this example, access is allowed only for IPv4 networks `10.1.1.0/16` and `192.168.1.0/24` excluding the address `192.168.1.1`, and for IPv6 network `2001:0db8::/32`. In case of a lot of rules, the use of the [ngx\_http\_geo\_module](#p-062) module variables is preferable.

規則會依序檢查，直到找到第一個符合項目。在本例中，僅允許存取 IPv4 網路`10.1.1.0/16`和`192.168.1.0/24` （不包括位址`192.168.1.1` ，以及 IPv6 網路`2001:0db8::/32` 。如果規則很多，建議使用 [ngx\_http\_geo\_module](#p-062)模組變數。

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**allow** `*address*` \| `*CIDR*` \| `unix:` \| `all`;``<br>` `**allow** ` *地址* ` \| ` * CIDR * ` \| ` unix: ` \| `所有`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location`, `limit_except` |

Allows access for the specified network or address. If the special value `unix:` is specified (1.5.1), allows access for all UNIX-domain sockets.

允許對指定的網路或位址進行存取。如果指定了特殊值`unix:` （ 1.5.1 ），則允許對所有UNIX域套接字進行存取。

Several `allow` directives can be specified on the same level. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `allow` and `deny` directives defined on the current level.

同一層級可以指定多個`allow`指令。當且僅噹噹前等級未定義`allow`和`deny`指令時，這些指令才會從上一個組態等級繼承。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**deny** `*address*` \| `*CIDR*` \| `unix:` \| `all`;``<br>` `**deny** ` *地址* ` \| ` * CIDR * ` \| ` unix: ` \| `全部`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location`, `limit_except` |

Denies access for the specified network or address. If the special value `unix:` is specified (1.5.1), denies access for all UNIX-domain sockets.

拒絕指定網路或位址的存取。如果指定了特殊值`unix:` （ 1.5.1 ），則拒絕所有UNIX域套接字的存取。

Several `deny` directives can be specified on the same level. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `allow` and `deny` directives defined on the current level.

同一層級可以指定多個`deny`指令。當且僅噹噹前等級未定義`allow`和`deny`指令時，這些指令才會從上一個組態等級繼承。

<a id="p-046"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_acme_module｜模組 ngx_http_acme_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_acme_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_acme\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_acme\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-046)<br>[Directives](#p-046)<br>     [acme\_issuer](#p-046)<br>     [uri](#p-046)<br>     [account\_key](#p-046)<br>     [challenge](#p-046)<br>     [common\_name\_in\_csr](#p-046)<br>     [contact](#p-046)<br>     [external\_account\_key](#p-046)<br>     [preferred\_chain](#p-046)<br>     [profile](#p-046)<br>     [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-046)<br>     [ssl\_verify](#p-046)<br>     [state\_path](#p-046)<br>     [accept\_terms\_of\_service](#p-046)<br>     [acme\_shared\_zone](#p-046)<br>     [acme\_certificate](#p-046)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-046)<br>[範例配置](#p-046)<br>[指示](#p-046)<br>     [acme\_issuer](#p-046)<br>     [類型](#p-046)<br>     [account\_key](#p-046)<br>     [挑戰](#p-046)<br>     [common\_name\_in\_csr](#p-046)<br>     [接觸](#p-046)<br>     [外部帳戶金鑰](#p-046)<br>     [首選鏈](#p-046)<br>     [輪廓](#p-046)<br>     [ssl_trusted_certificate](#p-046)<br>     [ssl_verify](#p-046)<br>     [state\_path](#p-046)<br>     [接受服務條款](#p-046)<br>     [acme\_shared\_zone](#p-046)<br>     [acme\_certificate](#p-046)<br>[嵌入式變數](#p-046) |

The `ngx_http_acme_module` module implements the automatic certificate management ([ACMEv2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8555)) protocol.

`ngx_http_acme_module`模組實現了自動證書管理（[ACMEv2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8555) ）協定。

The source code of the module is available [here](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-acme). Download and install instructions are available [here](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-acme/blob/main/README.md).

此模組的原始碼可在此處取得：[此處](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-acme) 。下載和安裝說明可在此處取得：[此處](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-acme/blob/main/README.md) 。

The module is also available in a prebuilt `nginx-module-acme` [package](#p-177) and in `nginx-plus-module-acme` package as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx) since 1.29.0.

本模組也以預先建置的`nginx-module-acme` [軟體包](#p-177)和`nginx-plus-module-acme`軟體包的形式提供，作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，自1.29.0起提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1:53;
>
> 解127.0.0.1:53 ；
> 
> acme_issuer example {
>
> acme_issuer 範例 {
>     uri         https://acme.example.com/directory;
>
>     uri https://acme.example.com/directory;
>     contact     admin@example.test;
>
>     請聯絡 admin@example.test；
>     state_path  /var/cache/nginx/acme-example;
>
>     state_path /var/cache/nginx/acme-example;
>     accept_terms_of_service;
>
>     接受服務條款；
> }
> 
> acme_shared_zone zone=ngx_acme_shared:1M;
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen 443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name  .example.test;
>
>     server_name.example.test;
> 
>     acme_certificate example;
>
>     acme_certificate 範例；
> 
>     ssl_certificate       $acme_certificate;
>
>     ssl_certificate $acme_certificate;
>     ssl_certificate_key   $acme_certificate_key;
>
>     ssl_certificate_key $acme_certificate_key;
> 
>     # do not parse the certificate on each request｜不要在每次請求時都解析證書
>     ssl_certificate_cache max=2;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     # listener on port 80 is required to process ACME HTTP-01 challenges｜需要監聽埠 80 以處理ACME HTTP -01 挑戰
>     listen 80;
>
>     聽 80；
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         return 404;
>
>         返回 404；
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**acme_issuer** `*name*` { ... }``<br>` `**acme_issuer** ` *名稱* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Defines an ACME certificate issuer object.

定義ACME證書頒發者物件。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**uri** `*uri*`;``<br>` `**uri** ` *uri* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `acme_issuer` |

The [directory URL](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8555#section-7.1.1) of the ACME server. This directive is mandatory.

伺服器ACME的 [目錄URL](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8555#section-7.1.1) 。此指令為必填項。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**account_key** `*alg*`[:`*size*`] \| `*file*`;``<br>` `**account_key** ` *演算法* `[:` *大小* `] \| ` *檔案* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `acme_issuer` |

The account's private key used for request authentication.

用於請求身份驗證的帳戶私鑰。

Accepted values:

可接受的值：

-   `ecdsa`:`*256*`/`*384*`/`*521*` for ES256, ES384, or ES512 JSON Web Signature algorithms  
    `ecdsa`:`*256*`/`*384*`/`*521*`用於ES256, ES384或ES512 JSON網路簽章演算法
-   `rsa`:`*2048*`/`*3072*`/`*4096*` for RS256.  
    `rsa`:`*2048*`/`*3072*`/`*4096*`用於RS256 。
-   File path for an existing key, using one of the algorithms above.  
    使用上述演算法之一，取得現有金鑰的檔案路徑。

The generated account keys are preserved across reloads, but will be lost on restart unless [state\_path](#p-046) is configured.

產生的帳戶金鑰在重新載入後會保留，但除非配置了 [state\_path](#p-046)否則在重新啟動時將會遺失。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>challenge<br>挑戰</strong> <code><i>type<br>型</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>challenge http-01;<br>質詢 http-01；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>acme_issuer</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.2.0.

該指令出現在版本0.2.0 。

Specifies the ACME challenge type to be used for the issuer.

指定要用於發卡機構的ACME挑戰類型。

Accepted values:

可接受的值：

-   `http-01` (`http`)
-   `tls-alpn-01` (`tls-alpn`)

> ACME challenges are versioned. If an unversioned name is specified, the module automatically selects the latest implemented version.
>
> ACME挑戰是版本化的。如果指定了未版本化的名稱，模組會自動選擇最新實作的版本。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>common_name_in_csr</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>common_name_in_csr off;<br>關閉 csr 中的 common_name；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>acme_issuer</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.4.0.

該指令出現在版本0.4.0 。

If enabled, sets the Subject Common Name in the certificate request to the first DNS name or the first IP address provided.

如果啟用，則將憑證要求中的主題通用名稱設定為提供的第一個DNS名稱或第一個IP位址。

> Enabling this option may result in rejected certificate requests.
>
> 啟用此選項可能會導致憑證請求被拒絕。

> Prior to version 0.4.0, the Subject Common Name was always set.
>
> 在版本0.4.0之前，主題通用名稱始終已設定。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**contact** `*URL*`;``<br>` `**contact** ` * URL * `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `acme_issuer` |

Sets an array of URLs that the ACME server can use to contact the client regarding account issues. The `mailto:` scheme will be used unless specified explicitly.

設定一個 URL 數組， ACME伺服器可以使用這些 URL 聯絡用戶端以處理帳戶問題。除非明確指定，否則將使用`mailto:`方案。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**external_account_key** `*kid*` `*file*`;``<br>` `**external_account_key** ` *kid* ` ` *file* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `acme_issuer` |

This directive appeared in version 0.2.0.

該指令出現在版本0.2.0 。

Specifies a key identifier `*kid*` and a `*file*` with the MAC key for [external account authorization](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8555#section-7.3.4).

指定金鑰標識符`*kid*`和`*file*` ，以及用於[外部帳戶授權](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8555#section-7.3.4)的MAC鑰。

The value `data`:`*key*` can be specified instead of the `*file*`, which loads a key directly from the configuration without using intermediate files.

可以使用值`data`:`*key*`代替`*file*` ，這樣可以直接從設定中載入金鑰，而無需使用中間檔案。

In both cases, the key is expected to be encoded in [base64url](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4648#section-5).

在這兩種情況下，密鑰都應編碼為 [base64url](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4648#section-5) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**preferred_chain** `*name*`;``<br>` `**preferred_chain** ` *名稱* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `acme_issuer` |

This directive appeared in version 0.3.0.

該指令出現在版本0.3.0 。

Specifies the preferred certificate chain.

指定首選證書鏈。

If the ACME server offers multiple certificate chains, prefer the chain with the topmost certificate issued from the Subject Common Name `*name*`. If there are no matches, the default chain will be used.

如果ACME伺服器提供多個憑證鏈，則優先選擇由主題通用名稱`*name*`頒發的最頂層憑證鏈。如果沒有匹配項，則使用預設鏈。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**profile** `*name*` [`require`];``<br>` `**profile** ` *名稱* ` [`需要`];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `acme_issuer` |

This directive appeared in version 0.3.0.

該指令出現在版本0.3.0 。

Requests the [certificate profile](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-acme-profiles) `*name*` from the ACME server.

從ACME伺服器請求 [憑證設定檔](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-acme-profiles) `*name*` 。

The `require` parameter will cause certificate renewals to fail if the server does not support the specified profile.

如果伺服器不支援指定的設定文件， `require`參數將導致憑證續訂失敗。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_trusted_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_trusted_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `acme_issuer` |

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-046) the certificate of the ACME server.

指定一個`*file*` ACME包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-046)伺服器的憑證。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_verify</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_verify on;<br>啟用 SSL 驗證；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>acme_issuer</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables verification of the ACME server certificate.

啟用或停用對ACME伺服器憑證的驗證。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>state_path</strong> <code><i>path</i></code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>state_path acme_&lt;issuer&gt;;<br>state_path acme_<issuer>;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>acme_issuer</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a directory for storing the module data that can be persisted across restarts. This can improve the load time by skipping some requests on startup, and avoid hitting request rate limits on the ACME server.

定義一個用於儲存模組資料的目錄，該目錄的資料可以在重新啟動後保留。這可以透過跳過啟動時的一些請求來縮短載入時間，並避免達到ACME伺服器的請求速率限制。

The directory contains sensitive content, such as the account key, issued certificates, and private keys.

該目錄包含敏感內容，例如帳戶金鑰、已頒發的憑證和私鑰。

The `off` parameter (0.2.0) disables storing the account information and issued certificates on disk.

`off`參數 ( 0.2.0 ) 停用將帳戶資訊和頒發的憑證儲存在磁碟上。

> Prior to version 0.2.0, the state directory was not created by default.
>
> 在版本0.2.0之前，預設不會建立狀態目錄。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**accept_terms_of_service**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `acme_issuer` |

Agrees to the terms of service under which the ACME server will be used. Some servers require accepting the terms of service before account registration. The terms are usually available on the ACME server's website, and the URL will be printed to the error log if necessary.

同意接受使用ACME伺服器的服務條款。部分伺服器要求在註冊帳號前接受服務條款。這些條款通常可在ACME伺服器的網站上找到，如有必要， URL條款也會記錄在錯誤日誌中。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>acme_shared_zone</strong> <code>zone</code>=<code><i>name</i></code>:<code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>acme_shared_zone zone=ngx_acme_shared:256k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code></td></tr>
</table>

Allows increasing the size of in-memory storage of the module. The shared memory zone will be used to store the issued certificates, keys and challenge data for all the configured certificate issuers.

允許增加模組的記憶體儲存空間。共用記憶體區域將用於儲存所有已設定憑證授權單位的已核發憑證、金鑰和質詢資料。

The default zone size is sufficient to hold approximately 50 ECDSA prime256v1 keys or 35 RSA 2048 keys.

預設區域大小足以容納約 50 個ECDSA prime256v1 鑰匙或 35 個RSA 2048 鑰匙。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**acme_certificate** `*issuer*` [`*identifier*` ...] [`key`=`*alg*`[:`*size*`]];``<br>` `**acme_certificate** ` *issuer* ` [` *identifier* ` ...] [` key `=` *alg* `[:` *size* `]];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Defines a certificate with the list of `identifiers` requested from issuer `issuer`.

定義一個證書，其中包含從頒發者`issuer`請求的`identifiers`列表。

The explicit list of identifiers can be omitted. In this case, the identifiers will be taken from the [server\_name](#p-056) directive in the same [server](#p-056) block. Not all values accepted in the `server_name` are valid certificate identifiers: regular expressions and wildcards are not supported.

可以省略顯式標識符清單。在這種情況下，標識符將從同一 [server](#p-056)程式碼區塊中的 [server\_name](#p-056)指令中取得。並非所有`server_name`中接受的值都是有效的憑證識別碼：不支援正規表示式和通配符。

The key parameter sets the type of a generated private key. Supported key algorithms and sizes: `ecdsa:256` (default), `ecdsa:384`, `ecdsa:521`, `rsa:2048`, `rsa:3072`, `rsa:4096`.

關鍵參數設定產生的私鑰的類型。支援的金鑰演算法和大小： `ecdsa:256` （預設）， `ecdsa:384`, `ecdsa:521`, `rsa:2048`, `rsa:3072`, `rsa:4096` 。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_acme_module` module supports embedded variables, valid in the [server](#p-056) block with the [acme\_certificate](#p-046) directive:

`ngx_http_acme_module`模組支援嵌入式變量，在 [server](#p-056)區塊中，使用 [acme\_certificate](#p-046)指令時有效：

`$acme_certificate`

SSL certificate that can be passed to the [ssl\_certificate](#p-098)

SSL可傳遞給 [ssl\_certificate 的憑證](#p-098)

`$acme_certificate_key`

SSL certificate private key that can be passed to [ssl\_certificate\_key](#p-098)

SSL可傳遞給 [ssl\_certificate\_key 的憑證私鑰](#p-098)

<a id="p-047"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_addition_module｜模組 ngx_http_addition_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_addition_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_addition\_module｜模組 ngx_http_addition_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-047)<br>[Directives](#p-047)<br>     [add\_before\_body](#p-047)<br>     [add\_after\_body](#p-047)<br>     [addition\_types](#p-047)<br>[範例設定](#p-047)<br> [指令](#p-047)<br> [add\_before\_body](#p-047)<br> [add\_a​​fter\_body](#p-047)<br> [addition\_types](#p-047) |

The `ngx_http_addition_module` module is a filter that adds text before and after a response. This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_addition_module` configuration parameter.

`ngx_http_addition_module`模組是一個過濾器，用於在回應前後添加文字。此模組預設情況下未啟用，需要使用`--with-http_addition_module`配置參數啟用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     add_before_body /before_action;
>     add_after_body  /after_action;
>
>     add_after_body /after_action;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**add_before_body** `*uri*`;``<br>` `**add_before_body** ` *uri* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Adds the text returned as a result of processing a given subrequest before the response body. An empty string (`""`) as a parameter cancels addition inherited from the previous configuration level.

在回應正文之前新增處理給定子請求後傳回的文字。如果參數為空字串（ `""` ），則會取消從上一設定等級繼承的新增操作。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**add_after_body** `*uri*`;``<br>` `**add_after_body** ` *uri* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Adds the text returned as a result of processing a given subrequest after the response body. An empty string (`""`) as a parameter cancels addition inherited from the previous configuration level.

在回應正文之後新增處理給定子請求後傳回的文字。如果參數為空字串（ `""` ），則會取消從上一設定等級繼承的新增操作。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>addition_types<br>新增類型</strong> <code><i>mime-type<br>MIME 類型</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>addition_types text/html;<br>新增類型 text/html；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.7.9.

該指令出現在版本0.7.9 。

Allows adding text in responses with the specified MIME types, in addition to “`text/html`”. The special value “`*`” matches any MIME type (0.8.29).

除了“ MIME ”之外，還允許在回應中添加指定類型`*` `text/html`與任何MIME類型（ 0.8.29 ）匹配。
