###### Module ngx\_http\_api\_module｜模組 ngx_http_api_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-048)<br>[Directives](#p-048)<br>     [api](#p-048)<br>     [status\_zone](#p-048)<br>[Compatibility](#p-048)<br>[Endpoints](#p-048)<br>     [/](#p-048)<br>     [/nginx](#p-048)<br>     [/processes](#p-048)<br>     [/connections](#p-048)<br>     [/slabs/](#p-048)<br>     [/slabs/{slabZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/http/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/requests](#p-048)<br>     [/http/server\_zones/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/server\_zones/{httpServerZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/http/location\_zones/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/location\_zones/{httpLocationZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/http/caches/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/caches/{httpCacheZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/http/limit\_conns/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/limit\_conns/{httpLimitConnZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/http/limit\_reqs/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/limit\_reqs/{httpLimitReqZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/http/upstreams/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/upstreams/{httpUpstreamName}/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/upstreams/{httpUpstreamName}/servers/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/upstreams/{httpUpstreamName}/servers/{httpUpstreamServerId}](#p-048)<br>     [/http/keyvals/](#p-048)<br>     [/http/keyvals/{httpKeyvalZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/server\_zones/](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/server\_zones/{streamServerZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/limit\_conns/](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/limit\_conns/{streamLimitConnZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/upstreams/](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/upstreams/{streamUpstreamName}/](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/upstreams/{streamUpstreamName}/servers/](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/upstreams/{streamUpstreamName}/servers/{streamUpstreamServerId}](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/keyvals/](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/keyvals/{streamKeyvalZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/stream/zone\_sync/](#p-048)<br>     [/resolvers/](#p-048)<br>     [/resolvers/{resolverZoneName}](#p-048)<br>     [/ssl](#p-048)<br>     [/license](#p-048)<br>     [/workers/](#p-048)<br>     [/workers/{workerId}](#p-048)<br>[Response Objects](#p-048) |

The `ngx_http_api_module` module (1.13.3) provides REST API for accessing various status information, configuring upstream server groups on-the-fly, and managing [key-value pairs](#p-074) without the need of reconfiguring nginx.

`ngx_http_api_module`模組 ( 1.13.3 ) 提供REST API用於存取各種狀態資訊、動態配置上游伺服器群組以及管理 [鍵值對](#p-074)而無需重新配置 nginx。

> The module supersedes the [ngx\_http\_status\_module](#p-099) and [ngx\_http\_upstream\_conf\_module](#p-103) modules.
>
> 此模組取代了 [ngx\_http\_status\_module](#p-099)和 [ngx\_http\_upstream\_conf\_module](#p-103)模組。

When using the `PATCH` or `POST` methods, make sure that the payload does not exceed the [buffer size](#p-056) for reading the client request body, otherwise, the 413 (Request Entity Too Large) error may be returned.

使用`PATCH`或`POST`方法時，請確保有效負載不超過讀取客戶端請求體的 [緩衝區大小](#p-056) ，否則可能會傳回 413（請求實體過大）錯誤。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> http {
>
> http{
>     upstream backend {
>
>     上游後端 {
>         zone http_backend 64k;
>
>         區域 http_backend 64k；
> 
>         server backend1.example.com weight=5;
>
>         伺服器 backend1.example.com 權重=5；
>         server backend2.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 backend2.example.com；
>     }
> 
>     proxy_cache_path /data/nginx/cache_backend keys_zone=cache_backend:10m;
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器{
>         server_name backend.example.com;
> 
>         location / {
>
>         地點/{
>             proxy_pass  http://backend;
>
>             proxy_pass http://backend;
>             proxy_cache cache_backend;
>
>             代理緩存緩存後端；
> 
>             health_check;
>
>             健康檢查；
>         }
> 
>         status_zone server_backend;
>
>         狀態區域 server_backend；
>     }
> 
>     keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=one.keyval;
>     keyval $arg_text $text zone=one;
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器{
>         listen 127.0.0.1;
>
>         聽127.0.0.1 ;
> 
>         location /api {
>             api write=on;
>             allow 127.0.0.1;
>
>             允許127.0.0.1 ;
>             deny all;
>
>             全部否認；
>         }
>     }
> }
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     upstream backend {
>
>     上游後端 {
>         zone stream_backend 64k;
>
>         區域 stream_backend 64k；
> 
>         server backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>
>         伺服器 backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>         server backend2.example.com:12345;
>
>         伺服器 backend2.example.com:12345;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器{
>         listen      127.0.0.1:12345;
>
>         聽127.0.0.1:12345 ;
>         proxy_pass  backend;
>
>         proxy_pass 後端；
>         status_zone server_backend;
>
>         狀態區域 server_backend；
>         health_check;
>
>         健康檢查；
>     }
> }
> ```

All API requests include a supported API [version](#p-048) in the URI. Examples of API requests with this configuration:

所有API請求均包含受支援的API [版本](#p-048) 。以下URI使用此配置的API請求範例：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/nginx
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/connections
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/workers
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/http/requests
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/http/server_zones/server_backend
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/http/caches/cache_backend
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/http/upstreams/backend
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/http/upstreams/backend/servers/
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/http/upstreams/backend/servers/1
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/http/keyvals/one?key=arg1
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/stream/
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/stream/server_zones/server_backend
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/stream/upstreams/
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/stream/upstreams/backend
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/stream/upstreams/backend/servers/1
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**api** [`write`=`on`\|`off`];``<br>` `**api** [`寫入`=`開啟`\|`關閉`];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location` |

Turns on the REST API interface in the surrounding location. Access to this location should be [limited](#p-056).

開啟周圍位置的REST API介面。對該位置的存取應受到限制(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#satisfy) 。

The `write` parameter determines whether the API is read-only or read-write. By default, the API is read-only.

`write`參數決定API是唯讀還是讀寫。預設情況下， API為唯讀。

All API requests should contain a supported API version in the URI. If the request URI equals the location prefix, the list of supported API versions is returned. The current API version is “`10`”.

所有API請求都應包含受支援的API版本。如果請求URI等於位置前綴， URI傳回受支援的API版本清單。目前API版本為「 `10` 」。

The optional “`fields`” argument in the request line specifies which fields of the requested objects will be output:

請求行中的選用參數「 `fields` 」指定要輸出請求物件的哪些欄位：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/api/10/nginx?fields=version,build
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**status_zone** `*zone*`;``<br>` `**status_zone** ` *區域* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location`, `if in location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.13.12.

該指令出現在版本1.13.12 。

Enables collection of virtual [http](#p-056) or [stream](#p-142) server status information in the specified `*zone*`. Several servers may share the same zone.

允許在指定的`*zone*`中收集虛擬 [http](#p-056)或 [stream](#p-142)伺服器狀態資訊。多個伺服器可以共享同一個區域。

Starting from 1.17.0, status information can be collected per [location](#p-056). The special value `off` disables statistics collection in nested location blocks. Note that the statistics is collected in the context of a location where processing ends. It may be different from the original location, if an [internal redirect](#p-056) happens during request processing.

從1.17.0開始，可以按 [location](#p-056)收集狀態資訊。特殊值`off`會停用嵌套 location 區塊中的統計資訊收集。請注意，統計資料是在處理結束的 location 上下文中收集的。如果在請求處理期間發生 [內部重定向](#p-056) ，則該 location 可能與原始 location 不同。

**Compatibility｜相容性**

-   [Deferred autorenewal](#p-127) of JWT license tokens: the “`PUT`” method for [adding](#p-048) a JWT license token, and the “`pending_renewal`” field were added to the [/license](#p-048) data in [version](#p-048) 10.  
    [延遲自動續約](#p-127) JWT許可證令牌：在 [版本](#p-048) 10 中，將用於 [新增](#p-048) JWT令牌的「 `PUT` `pending_renewal` 」欄位加入 [/license](#p-048)資料中。
-   The “`response_time_hist`” data for each HTTP [upstream](#p-048) were added in [version](#p-048) 9 (1.29.8).  
    在 [版本](#p-048) 9 ( 1.29.8 ) 中加入了每個HTTP [上游](#p-048)的「 `response_time_hist` 」資料。
-   The “`uuid`” field was added to the [/license](#p-048) data in [version](#p-048) 9 (1.29.0).  
    在 [版本](#p-048) 9 ( 1.29.0 ) 中，向 [/license](#p-048)資料新增了「 `uuid` 」欄位。
-   The [/license](#p-048) data were added in [version](#p-048) 9 (1.27.2).  
    [/license](#p-048)資料在 [version](#p-048) 9 ( 1.27.2 ) 中加入。
-   The [/workers/](#p-048) data were added in [version](#p-048) 9.  
    [/workers/](#p-048)資料是在 [版本](#p-048) 9 中新增的。
-   Detailed failure counters were added to SSL statistics in [version](#p-048) 8 (1.23.2).  
    在 [版本](#p-048) 8 ( 1.23.2 ) 中，為SSL統計資料新增了詳細的故障計數器。
-   The `ssl` data for each HTTP [upstream](#p-048), [server zone](#p-048), and stream [upstream](#p-048), [server zone](#p-048), were added in [version](#p-048) 8 (1.21.6).  
    在 [版本](#p-048) 8 ( 1.21.6 ) 中加入了每個HTTP [上游](#p-048) 、 [伺服器區域](#p-048) 、 [伺服器區](#p-048) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_api_module.html#def_nginx_stream_server_zone) `ssl`資料。
-   The `codes` data in `responses` for each HTTP [upstream](#p-048), [server zone](#p-048), and [location zone](#p-048) were added in [version](#p-048) 7.  
    在 [版本](#p-048) 7 中，向`responses`中加入了每個HTTP [上游](#p-048) 、 [伺服器區域](#p-048)和 [位置區域(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_api_module.html#def_nginx_http_location_zone) `codes`
-   The [/stream/limit\_conns/](#p-048) data were added in [version](#p-048) 6.  
    [/stream/limit\_conns/](#p-048)資料已在 [版本](#p-048) 6 中新增。
-   The [/http/limit\_conns/](#p-048) data were added in [version](#p-048) 6.  
    [/http/limit\_conns/](#p-048)資料已在 [版本](#p-048) 6 中新增。
-   The [/http/limit\_reqs/](#p-048) data were added in [version](#p-048) 6.  
    [/http/limit\_reqs/](#p-048)資料已在 [版本](#p-048) 6 中新增。
-   The “`expire`” parameter of a [key-value](#p-074) pair can be [set](#p-048) or [changed](#p-048) since [version](#p-048) 5.  
    自 [版本](#p-048)起，[鍵值對](#p-074)的「 `expire` 」參數可以[設定](#p-048)或[更改](#p-048) 。
-   The [/resolvers/](#p-048) data were added in [version](#p-048) 5.  
    [/resolvers/](#p-048)資料是在 [version](#p-048) 5 中新增的。
-   The [/http/location\_zones/](#p-048) data were added in [version](#p-048) 5.  
    [/http/location\_zones/](#p-048)資料是在 [版本](#p-048) 5 中新增的。
-   The `path` and `method` fields of [nginx error object](#p-048) were removed in [version](#p-048) 4. These fields continue to exist in earlier api versions, but show an empty value.  
    [nginx 錯誤物件](#p-048)的`path`和`method`欄位已在 [版本](#p-048) 4 中移除。這些欄位在早期的 API 版本中仍然存在，但顯示為空值。
-   The [/stream/zone\_sync/](#p-048) data were added in [version](#p-048) 3.  
    [/stream/zone\_sync/](#p-048)資料已在 [版本](#p-048) 3 中新增。
-   The [drain](#p-048) parameter was added in [version](#p-048) 2.  
    [排水](#p-048)參數是在 [版本](#p-048) 2 中加入的。
-   The [/stream/keyvals/](#p-048) data were added in [version](#p-048) 2.  
    [/stream/keyvals/](#p-048)資料已在 [版本](#p-048) 2 中新增。

**Endpoints｜終點**

`/`

Supported methods:

支援的計算方法：

-   `GET` - Return list of root endpoints  
    `GET` - 返回根端點列表
    
    Returns a list of root endpoints.

    傳回根端點列表。
    
    Possible responses:

    可能的回答：
    
    -   200 - Success, returns an array of strings  
        200 - 成功，回傳一個字串數組
    -   404 - Unknown version (`UnknownVersion`), returns [Error](#p-048)  
        404 - 未知版本 ( `UnknownVersion` )，傳回 [錯誤](#p-048)

`/nginx`

Supported methods:

支援的計算方法：

-   `GET` - Return status of nginx running instance  
    `GET` - 傳回 nginx 運行實例的狀態
    
    Returns nginx version, build name, address, number of configuration reloads, IDs of master and worker processes.

    傳回 nginx 版本、建置名稱、位址、設定重新載入次數、主進程和工作進程的 ID。
    
    Request parameters:

    請求參數：
    
    `fields` (`string`, optional)

    `fields` ( `string` ，可選)
    
    Limits which fields of nginx running instance will be output.

    限制要輸出的 nginx 運行實例的哪些欄位。
    
    Possible responses:

    可能的回答：
    
    -   200 - Success, returns [nginx](#p-048)  
        200 - 成功，回 [nginx](#p-048)
    -   404 - Unknown version (`UnknownVersion`), returns [Error](#p-048)  
        404 - 未知版本 ( `UnknownVersion` )，傳回 [錯誤](#p-048)

`/processes`

Supported methods:

支援的計算方法：

-   `GET` - Return nginx processes status  
    `GET` - 返回 nginx 進程狀態
    
    Returns the number of abnormally terminated and respawned child processes.

    傳回異常終止並重新啟動的子進程的數量。
    
    Possible responses:

    可能的回答：
    
    -   200 - Success, returns [Processes](#p-048)  
        200 - 成功，返回 [流程](#p-048)
    -   404 - Unknown version (`UnknownVersion`), returns [Error](#p-048)  
        404 - 未知版本 ( `UnknownVersion` )，傳回 [錯誤](#p-048)
-   `DELETE` - Reset nginx processes statistics  
    `DELETE` - 重設 nginx 進程統計訊息
    
    Resets counters of abnormally terminated and respawned child processes.

    重置異常終止並重新啟動的子進程的計數器。
    
    Possible responses:

    可能的回答：
    
    -   204 - Success  
        204 - 成功
    -   404 - Unknown version (`UnknownVersion`), returns [Error](#p-048)  
        404 - 未知版本 ( `UnknownVersion` )，傳回 [錯誤](#p-048)
    -   405 - Method disabled (`MethodDisabled`), returns [Error](#p-048)  
        405 - 方法已停用 ( `MethodDisabled` )，回傳 [錯誤](#p-048)

`/connections`

Supported methods:

支援的計算方法：

-   `GET` - Return client connections statistics  
    `GET` - 傳回客戶端連線統計資訊
    
    Returns statistics of client connections.

    傳回客戶端連線統計資料。
    
    Request parameters:

    請求參數：
    
    `fields` (`string`, optional)

    `fields` （ `string` ，可選）
    
    Limits which fields of the connections statistics will be output.

    限制要輸出的連接統計資訊的欄位。
    
    Possible responses:

    可能的回答：
    
    -   200 - Success, returns [Connections](#p-048)  
        200 - 成功，返回 [連接](#p-048)
    -   404 - Unknown version (`UnknownVersion`), returns [Error](#p-048)  
        404 - 未知版本 ( `UnknownVersion` )，傳回 [錯誤](#p-048)
-   `DELETE` - Reset client connections statistics  
    `DELETE` - 重置客戶端連接統計訊息
    
    Resets statistics of accepted and dropped client connections.

    重置已接受和已丟棄的客戶端連線的統計資料。
    
    Possible responses:

    可能的回答：
    
    -   204 - Success  
        204 - 成功
    -   404 - Unknown version (`UnknownVersion`), returns [Error](#p-048)  
        404 - 未知版本 ( `UnknownVersion` )，傳回 [錯誤](#p-048)
    -   405 - Method disabled (`MethodDisabled`), returns [Error](#p-048)  
        405 - 方法已停用 ( `MethodDisabled` )，回傳 [錯誤](#p-048)

`/slabs/`

Supported methods:

Expiration time in milliseconds can be specified for a key-value pair with the `expire` parameter which overrides the [`timeout`](#p-146) parameter of the [keyval\_zone](#p-146) directive.

**Response Objects｜回應對象**

-   nginx:  
    nginx：
    
    General information about nginx:

    關於nginx的一般資訊：
    
    `version` (`string`)
    
    Version of nginx.

    nginx 版本。
    
    `build` (`string`)
    
    Name of nginx build.

    nginx 建置名稱。
    
    `address` (`string`)
    
    The address of the server that accepted status request.

    接受狀態請求的伺服器位址。
    
    `generation` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of configuration [reloads](#p-026).

    配置[重新加載 的總次數](#p-026) 。
    
    `load_timestamp` (`string`)
    
    Time of the last reload of configuration, in the ISO 8601 format with millisecond resolution.

    上次重新載入配置的時間，採用ISO 8601 格式，精確到毫秒。
    
    `timestamp` (`string`)
    
    Current time in the ISO 8601 format with millisecond resolution.

    目前時間，採用ISO 8601 格式，精確到毫秒。
    
    `pid` (`integer`)
    
    The ID of the worker process that handled status request.

    處理狀態請求的工作進程的ID 。
    
    `ppid` (`integer`)
    
    The ID of the master process that started the [worker process](#p-099).

    啟動 [工作進程](#p-099)的主進程ID 。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "nginx" : {
    >     "version" : "1.21.6",
    >
    >     "版本" : " 1.21.6 ",
    >     "build" : "nginx-plus-r27",
    >     "address" : "206.251.255.64",
    >
    >     "地址" : " 206.251.255.64 ",
    >     "generation" : 6,
    >
    >     「代數」：6，
    >     "load_timestamp" : "2022-06-28T11:15:44.467Z",
    >     "timestamp" : "2022-06-28T09:26:07.305Z",
    >     "pid" : 32212,
    >
    >     「pid」：32212，
    >     "ppid" : 32210
    >
    >     “ppid”：32210
    >   }
    > }
    > ```
    
-   Processes:  
    流程：
    
    `respawned` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of abnormally terminated and respawned child processes.

    異常終止並重新啟動的子進程總數。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "respawned" : 0
    >
    >   「已重生」：0
    > }
    > ```
    
-   Connections:  
    聯絡方式：
    
    The number of accepted, dropped, active, and idle connections.

    已接受連線數、已丟棄連線數、活動連線數和空閒連線數。
    
    `accepted` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of accepted client connections.

    已接受的客戶端連線總數。
    
    `dropped` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of dropped client connections.

    客戶端連線斷開的總數。
    
    `active` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of active client connections.

    當前活躍客戶端連線數。
    
    `idle` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of idle client connections.

    當前空閒客戶端連線數。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "accepted" : 4968119,
    >
    >   「已接受」：4968119，
    >   "dropped" : 0,
    >
    >   “已丟棄”：0，
    >   "active" : 5,
    >
    >   「活躍」：5，
    >   "idle" : 117
    >
    >   「空閒」：117
    > }
    > ```
    
-   SSL:
    
    `handshakes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of successful SSL handshakes.

    成功握手的總次數SSL 。
    
    `handshakes_failed` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of failed SSL handshakes.

    SSL握手失敗的總數。
    
    `session_reuses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of session reuses during SSL handshake.

    在SSL握手期間會話重用的總次數。
    
    `no_common_protocol` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of no common protocol.

    由於沒有通用協議， SSL握手失敗的次數很多。
    
    `no_common_cipher` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of no shared cipher.

    由於沒有共享密碼， SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `handshake_timeout` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of a timeout.

    由於超時SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `peer_rejected_cert` (`integer`)
    
    The number of failed SSL handshakes when nginx presented the certificate to the client but it was rejected with a corresponding alert message.

    當 nginx 向客戶端提供憑證但被拒絕並顯示相應的警報訊息時， SSL握手失敗的次數。
    
    `verify_failures`
    
    SSL certificate verification errors

    SSL證書驗證錯誤
    
    `no_cert` (`integer`)
    
    A client did not provide the required certificate.

    客戶未提供所需證書。
    
    `expired_cert` (`integer`)
    
    An expired or not yet valid certificate was presented by a client.

    客戶提交的證書已過期或尚未生效。
    
    `revoked_cert` (`integer`)
    
    A revoked certificate was presented by a client.

    客戶出示了一份已被吊銷的證書。
    
    `hostname_mismatch` (`integer`)
    
    Server's certificate doesn't match the hostname.

    伺服器憑證與主機名稱不符。
    
    `other` (`integer`)
    
    Other SSL certificate verification errors.

    其他SSL證書驗證錯誤。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "handshakes" : 79572,
    >
    >   「握手」：79572，
    >   "handshakes_failed" : 21025,
    >   "session_reuses" : 15762,
    >
    >   「session_reuses」：15762，
    >   "no_common_protocol" : 4,
    >   "no_common_cipher" : 2,
    >   "handshake_timeout" : 0,
    >   "peer_rejected_cert" : 0,
    >   "verify_failures" : {
    >     "no_cert" : 0,
    >     "expired_cert" : 2,
    >     "revoked_cert" : 1,
    >     "hostname_mismatch" : 2,
    >     "other" : 1
    >
    >     「其他」：1
    >   }
    > }
    > ```
    
-   Shared memory zone with slab allocator:  
    使用 slab 分配器的共享記憶體區域：
    
    Shared memory zone with slab allocator

    帶有 slab 分配器的共享記憶體區域
    
    `pages`
    
    The number of free and used memory pages.

    可用記憶體頁數和已使用記憶體頁數。
    
    `used` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of used memory pages.

    目前已使用的記憶體頁數。
    
    `free` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of free memory pages.

    目前可用記憶體頁數。
    
    `slots`
    
    Status data for memory slots (8, 16, 32, 64, 128, etc.)

    記憶體插槽狀態資料（8、16、32、64、128 等）
    
    A collection of "[Memory Slot](#p-048)" objects

    一組「[記憶體插槽](#p-048) 」對象

    >
    >       「已使用」：0，
    >       "free" : 0,
    >

-   Memory Slot:  
    記憶體插槽：
    
    `used` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of used memory slots.

    目前已使用的記憶體插槽數量。
    
    `free` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of free memory slots.

    目前可用記憶體插槽數量。
    
    `reqs` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of attempts to allocate memory of specified size.

    嘗試分配指定大小記憶體的總次數。
    
    `fails` (`integer`)
    
    The number of unsuccessful attempts to allocate memory of specified size.

    分配指定大小記憶體的失敗嘗試次數。
    
-   HTTP Requests:  
    HTTP請求：
    
    `total` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of client requests.

    客戶請求總數。
    
    `current` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of client requests.

    當前客戶端請求數量。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "total" : 10624511,
    >
    >   總計：10624511
    >   "current" : 4
    >
    >   「當前」：4
    > }
    > ```
    
-   HTTP Server Zone:  
    HTTP伺服器區域：
    
    `processing` (`integer`)
    
    The number of client requests that are currently being processed.

    目前正在處理的客戶請求數量。
    
    `requests` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of client requests received from clients.

    從客戶收到的客戶請求總數。
    
    `responses`
    
    The total number of responses sent to clients, the number of responses with status codes “`1xx`”, “`2xx`”, “`3xx`”, “`4xx`”, and “`5xx`”, and the number of responses per each status code.

    傳送給客戶的回覆總數，狀態代碼為「 `1xx` 」、「 `2xx` 」、「 `3xx` 」、「 `4xx` 」和「 `5xx` 」的回覆數量，以及每個狀態代碼的回覆數量。
    
    `1xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`1xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `1xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `2xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`2xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `2xx` 」狀態碼的回應數量。
    
    `3xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`3xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `3xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `4xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`4xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `4xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `5xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`5xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `5xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `codes`
    
    The number of responses per each status code.

    每個狀態碼對應的回應數量。
    
    `codeNumber` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with this particular status code.

    具有此特定狀態碼的回應數量。
    
    `total` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses sent to clients.

    發送給客戶的回覆總數。
    
    `discarded` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of requests completed without sending a response.

    未發送回應的請求總數。
    
    `received` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes received from clients.

    從客戶端接收到的總位元組數。
    
    `sent` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes sent to clients.

    發送給客戶端的總位元組數。
    
    `ssl`
    
    `handshakes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of successful SSL handshakes.

    成功握手的總數SSL 。
    
    `handshakes_failed` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of failed SSL handshakes.

    SSL握手失敗的總數。
    
    `session_reuses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of session reuses during SSL handshake.

    在SSL握手期間會話重用的總次數。
    
    `no_common_protocol` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of no common protocol.

    由於沒有通用協議， SSL握手失敗的次數很多。
    
    `no_common_cipher` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of no shared cipher.

    由於沒有共享密碼， SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `handshake_timeout` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of a timeout.

    由於超時SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `peer_rejected_cert` (`integer`)
    
    The number of failed SSL handshakes when nginx presented the certificate to the client but it was rejected with a corresponding alert message.

    當 nginx 向客戶端提供憑證但被拒絕並顯示相應的警告訊息時， SSL握手失敗的次數。
    
    `verify_failures`
    
    SSL certificate verification errors

    SSL證書驗證錯誤
    
    `no_cert` (`integer`)
    
    A client did not provide the required certificate.

    客戶未提供所需證書。
    
    `expired_cert` (`integer`)
    
    An expired or not yet valid certificate was presented by a client.

    客戶提交的證書已過期或尚未生效。
    
    `revoked_cert` (`integer`)
    
    A revoked certificate was presented by a client.

    客戶出示了一份已被吊銷的證書。
    
    `other` (`integer`)
    
    Other SSL certificate verification errors.

    其他SSL證書驗證錯誤。
    
    Example:

    > {

    >

    >       "200" : 699482,

    >       "404" : 907,
    >       "503" : 266
    >     },
    >     "total" : 705177
    >
    >     總計：705177
    >   },
    >   "discarded" : 1513,
    >
    >   「已丟棄」：1513，
    >   "received" : 172711587,
    >

-   HTTP Location Zone:  
    HTTP位置區域：
    
    `requests` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of client requests received from clients.

    從客戶收到的客戶請求總數。
    
    `responses`
    
    The total number of responses sent to clients, the number of responses with status codes “`1xx`”, “`2xx`”, “`3xx`”, “`4xx`”, and “`5xx`”, and the number of responses per each status code.

    傳送給客戶的回覆總數，狀態代碼為「 `1xx` 」、「 `2xx` 」、「 `3xx` 」、「 `4xx` 」和「 `5xx` 」的回復數量，以及每個狀態碼對應的數量。
    
    `1xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`1xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `1xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `2xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`2xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `2xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `3xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`3xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `3xx` 」狀態碼的回應數量。
    
    `4xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`4xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `4xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `5xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`5xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `5xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `codes`
    
    The number of responses per each status code.

    每個狀態碼對應的回應數量。
    
    `codeNumber` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with this particular status code.

    具有此特定狀態碼的回應數量。
    
    `total` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses sent to clients.

    發送給客戶的回覆總數。
    
    `discarded` (`integer`)

    `received` (`integer`)

-   HTTP Cache:  
    HTTP快取：
    
    `size` (`integer`)
    
    The current size of the cache.

    快取的當前大小。
    
    `max_size` (`integer`)
    
    The limit on the maximum size of the cache specified in the configuration.

    配置中指定的快取最大​​大小限制。
    
    `cold` (`boolean`)
    
    A boolean value indicating whether the “cache loader” process is still loading data from disk into the cache.

    一個布林值，指示「快取載入器」進程是否仍在將資料從磁碟載入到快取中。
    
    `hit`
    
    `responses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of [valid](#p-085) responses read from the cache.

    從快取中讀取的[有效](#p-085)響應總數。
    
    `bytes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes read from the cache.

    從快取中讀取的總位元組數。
    
    `stale`
    
    `responses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of expired responses read from the cache (see [proxy\_cache\_use\_stale](#p-085) and other “`*_cache_use_stale`” directives).

    從快取中讀取的過期回應總數（請參閱 [proxy\_cache\_use\_stale](#p-085)和其他「 `*_cache_use_stale` 」指令）。
    
    `bytes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes read from the cache.

    從快取中讀取的總位元組數。
    
    `updating`
    
    `responses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of expired responses read from the cache while responses were being updated (see [proxy\_cache\_use\_stale](#p-085) and other “`*_cache_use_stale`” directives).

    在更新回應期間從快取中讀取的過期回應總數（請參閱 [proxy\_cache\_use\_stale](#p-085)和其他「 `*_cache_use_stale` 」指令）。
    
    `bytes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes read from the cache.

    從快取中讀取的總位元組數。
    
    `revalidated`
    
    `responses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of expired and revalidated responses read from the cache (see [proxy\_cache\_revalidate](#p-085) and other “`*_cache_revalidate`” directives.

    從快取中讀取的過期和重新驗證的回應總數（請參閱 [proxy\_cache\_revalidate](#p-085)和其他「 `*_cache_revalidate` 」指令）。
    
    `bytes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes read from the cache.

    從快取中讀取的總位元組數。
    
    `miss`
    
    `responses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses not found in the cache.

    快取中未找到的回應總數。
    
    `bytes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes read from the proxied server.

    從代理伺服器讀取的總位元組數。
    
    `responses_written` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses written to the cache.

    寫入快取的回應總數。
    
    `bytes_written` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes written to the cache.

    寫入快取的總位元組數。
    
    `expired`
    
    `responses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of expired responses not taken from the cache.

    未從快取中取出的過期回應總數。
    
    `bytes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes read from the proxied server.

    從代理伺服器讀取的總位元組數。
    
    `responses_written` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses written to the cache.

    寫入快取的回應總數。
    
    `bytes_written` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes written to the cache.

    寫入快取的總位元組數。
    
    `bypass`
    
    `responses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses not looked up in the cache due to the [proxy\_cache\_bypass](#p-085) and other “`*_cache_bypass`” directives.

    由於 [proxy\_cache\_bypass](#p-085)和其他「 `*_cache_bypass` 」指令，未在快取中尋找的回應總數。
    
    `bytes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes read from the proxied server.

    從代理伺服器讀取的總位元組數。
    
    `responses_written` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses written to the cache.

    寫入快取的回應總數。
    
    `bytes_written` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes written to the cache.

    寫入快取的總位元組數。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json

    >   "size" : 530915328,
    >

    >   "max_size" : 536870912,

    >

    >

    >

    >   },

    >

    >

    >   },

    >

    >

    >

    >

-   HTTP Connections Limiting:  
    HTTP連接數限制：
    
    `passed` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of connections that were neither limited nor accounted as limited.

    既非受限連接也非受限連接的總數量。
    
    `rejected` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of connections that were rejected.

    被拒絕的連線總數。
    
    `rejected_dry_run` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of connections accounted as rejected in the [dry run](#p-075) mode.

    在 [dry run](#p-075)模式下被拒絕的連線總數。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "passed" : 15,
    >
    >   「通過」：15，
    >   "rejected" : 0,
    >
    >   「已拒絕」：0，
    >   "rejected_dry_run" : 2
    > }
    > ```
    
-   HTTP Requests Rate Limiting:  
    HTTP請求速率限制：
    
    `passed` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of requests that were neither limited nor accounted as limited.

    既未受限制也未被計入限制的請求總數。
    
    `delayed` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of requests that were delayed.

    延遲請求的總數。
    
    `rejected` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of requests that were rejected.

    被拒絕的請求總數。
    
    `delayed_dry_run` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of requests accounted as delayed in the [dry run](#p-076) mode.

    在 [試運轉](#p-076)模式下，被計算為延遲的請求總數。
    
    `rejected_dry_run` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of requests accounted as rejected in the [dry run](#p-076) mode.

    在 [dry run](#p-076)模式下被拒絕的請求總數。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "passed" : 15,
    >
    >   「通過」：15，
    >   "delayed" : 4,
    >
    >   「延遲」：4，
    >   "rejected" : 0,
    >
    >   「已拒絕」：0，
    >   "delayed_dry_run" : 1,
    >   "rejected_dry_run" : 2
    > }
    > ```
    
-   HTTP Upstream:  
    HTTP上游：
    
    `peers`
    
    An array of:

    一個數組：
    
    `id` (`integer`)
    
    The ID of the server.

    伺服器的ID 。
    
    `server` (`string`)
    
    An [address](#p-105) of the server.

    伺服器的 [位址](#p-105) 。
    
    `service` (`string`)
    
    The [service](#p-105) parameter value of the [server](#p-105) directive.

    [伺服器](#p-105)指令的 [服務](#p-105)參數值。
    
    `name` (`string`)
    
    The name of the server specified in the [server](#p-105) directive.

    [server](#p-105)指令中指定的伺服器名稱。
    
    `backup` (`boolean`)
    
    A boolean value indicating whether the server is a [backup](#p-105) server.

    一個布林值，指示伺服器是否為 [備份](#p-105)伺服器。
    
    `weight` (`integer`)
    
    [Weight](#p-105) of the server.

    [重量](#p-105)伺服器。
    
    `state` (`string`)
    
    Current state, which may be one of “`up`”, “`draining`”, “`down`”, “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, and “`unhealthy`”.

    目前狀態可能是「 `up` 」、「 `draining` 」、「 `down` 」、「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」和「 `unhealthy` 」之一。
    
    `active` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of active connections.

    目前活躍連線數。
    
    `ssl`
    
    `handshakes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of successful SSL handshakes.

    成功握手的總數SSL 。
    
    `handshakes_failed` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of failed SSL handshakes.

    SSL握手失敗的總數。
    
    `session_reuses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of session reuses during SSL handshake.

    在SSL握手期間會話重用的總次數。
    
    `no_common_protocol` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of no common protocol.

    由於沒有通用協議， SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `handshake_timeout` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of a timeout.

    由於超時SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `peer_rejected_cert` (`integer`)
    
    The number of failed SSL handshakes when nginx presented the certificate to the upstream server but it was rejected with a corresponding alert message.

    當 nginx 向上游伺服器提交憑證但被拒絕並收到相應的警報訊息時， SSL握手失敗的次數。
    
    `verify_failures`
    
    SSL certificate verification errors

    SSL證書驗證錯誤
    
    `expired_cert` (`integer`)
    
    An expired or not yet valid certificate was presented by an upstream server.

    上游伺服器提供的憑證已過期或尚未生效。
    
    `revoked_cert` (`integer`)
    
    A revoked certificate was presented by an upstream server.

    上游伺服器提供了已被撤銷的憑證。
    
    `hostname_mismatch` (`integer`)
    
    Server's certificate doesn't match the hostname.

    伺服器憑證與主機名稱不符。
    
    `other` (`integer`)
    
    Other SSL certificate verification errors.

    其他SSL證書驗證錯誤。
    
    `max_conns` (`integer`)
    
    The [max\_conns](#p-105) limit for the server.

    伺服器的 [max\_conns](#p-105)限制。
    
    `requests` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of client requests forwarded to this server.

    轉送至此伺服器的客戶端請求總數。
    
    `responses`
    
    `1xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`1xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `1xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `2xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`2xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `2xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `3xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`3xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `3xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `4xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`4xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `4xx` 」狀態代碼的回應數量。
    
    `5xx` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with “`5xx`” status codes.

    具有「 `5xx` 」狀態碼的回應數量。
    
    `codes`
    
    The number of responses per each status code.

    每個狀態碼對應的回應數量。
    
    `codeNumber` (`integer`)
    
    The number of responses with this particular status code.

    具有此特定狀態碼的回應數量。
    
    `total` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses obtained from this server.

    從該伺服器收到的回應總數。
    
    `sent` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes sent to this server.

    傳送到此伺服器的總位元組數。
    
    `received` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes received from this server.

    從該伺服器接收到的總位元組數。
    
    `fails` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server.

    與伺服器通訊失敗的總次數。
    
    `unavail` (`integer`)
    
    How many times the server became unavailable for client requests (state “`unavail`”) due to the number of unsuccessful attempts reaching the [max\_fails](#p-105) threshold.

    由於失敗嘗試次數達到 [max\_fails](#p-105)閾值，伺服器對客戶端請求不可用（狀態「 `unavail` 」）的次數。
    
    `health_checks`
    
    `checks` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of [health check](#p-104) requests made.

    已發出的[健康檢查](#p-104)請求總數。
    
    `fails` (`integer`)
    
    The number of failed health checks.

    健康檢查不合格的次數。
    
    `unhealthy` (`integer`)
    
    How many times the server became unhealthy (state “`unhealthy`”).

    伺服器出現不健康狀態（狀態「 `unhealthy` 」）的次數。
    
    `last_passed` (`boolean`)
    
    Boolean indicating if the last health check request was successful and passed [tests](#p-104).

    布林值，表示上次健康檢查請求是否成功並通過了[測試](#p-104) 。
    
    `downtime` (`integer`)
    
    Total time the server was in the “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, and “`unhealthy`” states.

    伺服器處於「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」和「 `unhealthy` 」狀態的總時間。
    
    `downstart` (`string`)
    
    The time when the server became “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, or “`unhealthy`”, in the ISO 8601 format with millisecond resolution.

    伺服器變成「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」或「 `unhealthy` 」的時間，採用ISO 8601 格式，精確到毫秒。
    
    `selected` (`string`)
    
    The time when the server was last selected to process a request, in the ISO 8601 format with millisecond resolution.

    伺服器上次被選取處理請求的時間，採用ISO 8601 格式，精確到毫秒。
    
    `header_time` (`integer`)
    
    The average time to get the [response header](#p-105) from the server.

    從伺服器取得 [回應頭](#p-105)的平均時間。
    
    `response_time` (`integer`)
    
    The average time to get the [full response](#p-105) from the server.

    從伺服器取得 [完整回應](#p-105)的平均時間。
    
    `response_time_hist`
    
    Histogram of upstream response times collected per upstream server.

    按上游伺服器收集的上游回應時間直方圖。
    
    `count` (`integer`)
    
    Total number of recorded responses.

    記錄的回覆總數。
    
    `sum` (`integer`)
    
    Sum of all recorded upstream response times, in milliseconds.

    所有記錄的上游響應時間的總和，單位為毫秒。
    
    `buckets`
    
    Histogram bucket counters for upstream response times, in milliseconds. Each bucket name ("5","10","25","50", etc.) is a time limit in milliseconds. Each bucket value is the number of responses within that time bucket. The "inf" bucket counts responses greater than 10000 ms.

    上游響應時間的直方圖桶計數器，單位為毫秒。每個桶名（「5」、「10」、「25」、「50」等）代表一個毫秒的時間限制。每個桶的值表示該時間段內的反應數量。 “inf”桶統計量大於 10000 毫秒的響應。
    
    `5` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time less than or equal to 5 ms.

    響應時間小於或等於 5 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `10` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 5 ms and less than or equal to 10 ms.

    響應時間大於 5 毫秒且小於等於 10 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `25` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 10 ms and less than or equal to 25 ms.

    響應時間大於 10 毫秒且小於等於 25 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `50` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 25 ms and less than or equal to 50 ms.

    反應時間大於 25 毫秒且小於等於 50 毫秒的反應總數。
    
    `75` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 50 ms and less than or equal to 75 ms.

    反應時間大於 50 毫秒且小於等於 75 毫秒的反應總數。
    
    `100` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 75 ms and less than or equal to 100 ms.

    反應時間大於 75 毫秒且小於等於 100 毫秒的反應總數。
    
    `250` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 100 ms and less than or equal to 250 ms.

    響應時間大於 100 毫秒且小於等於 250 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `500` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 250 ms and less than or equal to 500 ms.

    響應時間大於 250 毫秒且小於等於 500 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `750` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 500 ms and less than or equal to 750 ms.

    響應時間大於 500 毫秒且小於等於 750 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `1000` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 750 ms and less than or equal to 1000 ms.

    響應時間大於 750 毫秒且小於或等於 1000 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `2500` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 1000 ms and less than or equal to 2500 ms.

    響應時間大於 1000 毫秒且小於等於 2500 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `5000` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 2500 ms and less than or equal to 5000 ms.

    響應時間大於 2500 毫秒且小於或等於 5000 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `7500` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 5000 ms and less than or equal to 7500 ms.

    響應時間大於 5000 毫秒且小於或等於 7500 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `10000` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of responses with response time greater than 7500 ms and less than or equal to 10000 ms.

    響應時間大於 7500 毫秒且小於或等於 10000 毫秒的響應總數。
    
    `inf` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of observations with response time greater than 10000 ms.

    響應時間大於 10000 毫秒的觀測總數。
    
    `keepalive` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of idle [keepalive](#p-105) connections.

    目前空閒 [keepalive](#p-105)連接數。
    
    `zombies` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of servers removed from the group but still processing active client requests.

    目前已從群組中移除但仍在處理活躍用戶端請求的伺服器數量。
    
    `zone` (`string`)
    
    The name of the shared memory [zone](#p-105) that keeps the group’s configuration and run-time state.

    共享記憶體 [區域](#p-105)的名稱，用於保存群組的配置和運行時狀態。
    
    `queue`
    
    For the requests [queue](#p-105), the following data are provided:

    對於請求 [隊列](#p-105) ，提供以下資料：
    
    `size` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of requests in the queue.

    目前佇列中的請求數量。
    
    `max_size` (`integer`)
    
    The maximum number of requests that can be in the queue at the same time.

    佇列中同時可以存在的最大請求數。
    
    `overflows` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of requests rejected due to the queue overflow.

    由於佇列溢出而被拒絕的請求總數。

-   HTTP Upstream Server:  
    HTTP上游伺服器：
    
    Dynamically configurable parameters of an HTTP upstream [server](#p-105):

    HTTP上游 [伺服器](#p-105)的動態可設定參數：
    
    `id` (`integer`)
    
    The ID of the HTTP upstream server. The ID is assigned automatically and cannot be changed.

    HTTP 上游伺服器的 ID。 ID 是自動分配的且無法更改。
    
    `server` (`string`)
    
    Same as the [address](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server. When adding a server, it is possible to specify it as a domain name. In this case, changes of the IP addresses that correspond to a domain name will be monitored and automatically applied to the upstream configuration without the need of restarting nginx. This requires the [resolver](#p-056) directive in the “`http`” block. See also the [resolve](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server.

    與(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#server) HTTP的 [address] 參數相同。新增伺服器時，可以指定為網域名稱。在這種情況下，系統會監控與IP對應的位址的更改，並自動將其套用到上游配置，而無需重新啟動 nginx。這需要在`http` 」區塊中使用 [ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#resolver) ] 指令。另請參閱(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#resolve) HTTP的 [resolve] 參數。
    
    `service` (`string`)
    
    Same as the [service](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server. This parameter cannot be changed.

    與上游伺服器HTTP的[服務](#p-105)參數相同。此參數無法變更。
    
    `weight` (`integer`)
    
    Same as the [weight](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server.

    與HTTP伺服器的 [weight](#p-105)參數相同。
    
    `max_conns` (`integer`)
    
    Same as the [max\_conns](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server.

    與HTTP伺服器的 [max\_conns](#p-105)參數相同。
    
    `max_fails` (`integer`)
    
    Same as the [max\_fails](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server.

    與HTTP伺服器的 [max\_fails](#p-105)參數相同。
    
    `fail_timeout` (`string`)
    
    Same as the [fail\_timeout](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server.

    與HTTP伺服器的 [fail\_timeout](#p-105)參數相同。
    
    `slow_start` (`string`)
    
    Same as the [slow\_start](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server.

    與HTTP伺服器的 [slow\_start](#p-105)參數相同。
    
    `route` (`string`)
    
    Same as the [route](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server.

    與上游伺服器HTTP的 [route](#p-105)參數相同。
    
    `backup` (`boolean`)
    
    When `true`, adds a [backup](#p-105) server. This parameter cannot be changed.

    當`true`新增 [備份](#p-105)伺服器時，此參數無法變更。
    
    `down` (`boolean`)
    
    Same as the [down](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server.

    與上游伺服器HTTP的 [down](#p-105)參數相同。
    
    `drain` (`boolean`)
    
    Same as the [drain](#p-105) parameter of the HTTP upstream server.

    與HTTP伺服器的 [drain](#p-105)參數相同。
    
    `parent` (`string`)
    
    Parent server ID of the resolved server. The ID is assigned automatically and cannot be changed.

    已解析伺服器的ID伺服器ID是自動分配的，無法更改。
    
    `host` (`string`)
    
    Hostname of the resolved server. The hostname is assigned automatically and cannot be changed.

    已解析伺服器的主機名稱。主機名稱是自動分配的，無法變更。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "id" : 1,
    >
    >   「id」：1，
    >   "server" : "10.0.0.1:8089",
    >
    >   "伺服器" : " 10.0.0.1:8089 ",
    >   "weight" : 4,
    >
    >   「權重」：4，
    >   "max_conns" : 0,
    >
    >   “max_conns”：0，
    >   "max_fails" : 0,
    >
    >   “max_fails”：0，
    >   "fail_timeout" : "10s",
    >   "slow_start" : "10s",
    >
    >   "slow_start" : "10秒",
    >   "route" : "",
    >
    >   “路線” ： ””，
    >   "backup" : true,
    >
    >   「備份」：true，
    >   "down" : true
    >
    >   「向下」：真
    > }
    > ```
    
-   HTTP Keyval Shared Memory Zone:  
    HTTP Keyval 共享記憶體區：
    
    Contents of an HTTP keyval shared memory zone when using the GET method.

    使用GET方法時， HTTP keyval 共享記憶體區域的內容。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "key1" : "value1",
    >   "key2" : "value2",
    >   "key3" : "value3"
    > }
    > ```
    
-   HTTP Keyval Shared Memory Zone:  
    HTTP Keyval 共享記憶體區：
    
    Contents of an HTTP keyval shared memory zone when using the POST or PATCH methods.

    使用POST或PATCH方法時， HTTP keyval 共享記憶體區域的內容。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "key1" : "value1",
    >   "key2" : "value2",
    >   "key3" : {
    >     "value" : "value3",
    >     "expire" : 30000
    >
    >     “expire”：30000
    >   }
    > }
    > ```
    
-   Stream Server Zone:  
    串流媒體伺服器區域：
    
    `processing` (`integer`)
    
    The number of client connections that are currently being processed.

    目前正在處理的客戶端連線數。
    
    `connections` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of connections accepted from clients.

    客戶端接受的連線總數。
    
    `sessions`
    
    The total number of completed sessions, and the number of sessions completed with status codes “`2xx`”, “`4xx`”, or “`5xx`”.

    已完成的會話總數，以及狀態代碼為「 `2xx` 」、「 `4xx` 」或「 `5xx` 」的已完成會話數。
    
    `2xx` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of sessions completed with [status codes](#p-142) “`2xx`”.

    完成的會話總數為 [狀態代碼](#p-142) “ `2xx` ”。
    
    `4xx` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of sessions completed with [status codes](#p-142) “`4xx`”.

    完成的會話總數為 [狀態代碼](#p-142) “ `4xx` ”。
    
    `5xx` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of sessions completed with [status codes](#p-142) “`5xx`”.

    完成的會話總數為 [狀態代碼](#p-142) “ `5xx` ”。
    
    `total` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of completed client sessions.

    已完成的客戶會話總數。
    
    `discarded` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of connections completed without creating a session.

    未建立會話而完成的連線總數。
    
    `received` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes received from clients.

    從客戶端接收到的總位元組數。
    
    `sent` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes sent to clients.

    發送給客戶端的總位元組數。
    
    `ssl`
    
    `handshakes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of successful SSL handshakes.

    成功握手的總數SSL 。
    
    `handshakes_failed` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of failed SSL handshakes.

    SSL握手失敗的總數。
    
    `session_reuses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of session reuses during SSL handshake.

    在SSL握手期間會話重用的總次數。
    
    `no_common_protocol` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of no common protocol.

    由於沒有通用協議， SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `no_common_cipher` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of no shared cipher.

    由於沒有共享密碼， SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `handshake_timeout` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of a timeout.

    由於超時SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `peer_rejected_cert` (`integer`)
    
    The number of failed SSL handshakes when nginx presented the certificate to the client but it was rejected with a corresponding alert message.

    當 nginx 向客戶端提供憑證但被拒絕並顯示相應的警報訊息時， SSL握手失敗的次數。
    
    `verify_failures`
    
    SSL certificate verification errors

    SSL證書驗證錯誤
    
    `no_cert` (`integer`)
    
    A client did not provide the required certificate.

    客戶未提供所需證書。
    
    `expired_cert` (`integer`)
    
    An expired or not yet valid certificate was presented by a client.

    客戶提交的證書已過期或尚未生效。
    
    `revoked_cert` (`integer`)
    
    A revoked certificate was presented by a client.

    客戶出示了一份已被吊銷的證書。
    
    `other` (`integer`)
    
    Other SSL certificate verification errors.

    其他SSL證書驗證錯誤。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "dns" : {
    >     "processing" : 1,
    >
    >     「處理中」：1，
    >     "connections" : 155569,
    >
    >     “連接數”：155569，
    >     "sessions" : {
    >
    >     「會話」：{
    >       "2xx" : 155564,
    >
    >       「2xx」：155564，
    >       "4xx" : 0,
    >
    >       「4xx」：0，
    >       "5xx" : 0,
    >
    >       「5xx」：0，
    >       "total" : 155569
    >
    >       總計：155569
    >     },
    >     "discarded" : 0,
    >
    >     “已丟棄”：0，
    >     "received" : 4200363,
    >
    >     「已接收」：4200363，
    >     "sent" : 20489184,
    >
    >     「已發送」：20489184，
    >     "ssl" : {
    >       "handshakes" : 76455,
    >
    >       「握手」：76455，
    >       "handshakes_failed" : 432,
    >
    >       "握手失敗" : 432,
    >       "session_reuses" : 28770,
    >
    >       「session_reuses」：28770，
    >       "no_common_protocol" : 4,
    >       "no_common_cipher" : 2,
    >       "handshake_timeout" : 0,
    >       "peer_rejected_cert" : 0,
    >       "verify_failures" : {
    >         "no_cert" : 0,
    >         "expired_cert" : 2,
    >         "revoked_cert" : 1,
    >         "other" : 1
    >
    >         「其他」：1
    >       }
    >     }
    >   }
    > }
    > ```
    
-   Stream Connections Limiting:  
    流連接數限制：
    
    `passed` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of connections that were neither limited nor accounted as limited.

    既非受限連接也非受限連接的總數量。
    
    `rejected` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of connections that were rejected.

    被拒絕的連線總數。
    
    `rejected_dry_run` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of connections accounted as rejected in the [dry run](#p-147) mode.

    在 [dry run](#p-147)模式下被拒絕的連線總數。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "passed" : 15,
    >
    >   「通過」：15，
    >   "rejected" : 0,
    >
    >   「已拒絕」：0，
    >   "rejected_dry_run" : 2
    > }
    > ```
    
-   Stream Upstream:  
    向上游傳輸：
    
    `peers`
    
    An array of:

    一個數組：
    
    `id` (`integer`)
    
    The ID of the server.

    伺服器的ID 。
    
    `server` (`string`)
    
    An [address](#p-163) of the server.

    伺服器的 [位址](#p-163) 。
    
    `service` (`string`)
    
    The [service](#p-163) parameter value of the [server](#p-163) directive.

    [伺服器](#p-163)指令的 [服務](#p-163)參數值。
    
    `name` (`string`)
    
    The name of the server specified in the [server](#p-163) directive.

    [server](#p-163)指令中指定的伺服器名稱。
    
    `backup` (`boolean`)
    
    A boolean value indicating whether the server is a [backup](#p-163) server.

    一個布林值，指示伺服器是否為 [備份](#p-163)伺服器。
    
    `weight` (`integer`)
    
    [Weight](#p-163) of the server.

    [重量](#p-163)伺服器。
    
    `state` (`string`)
    
    Current state, which may be one of “`up`”, “`down`”, “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, or “`unhealthy`”.

    目前狀態可能是「 `up` 」、「 `down` 」、「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」或「 `unhealthy` 」之一。
    
    `active` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of connections.

    目前連接數。
    
    `ssl`
    
    `handshakes` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of successful SSL handshakes.

    成功握手的總數SSL 。
    
    `handshakes_failed` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of failed SSL handshakes.

    SSL握手失敗的總數。
    
    `session_reuses` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of session reuses during SSL handshake.

    在SSL握手期間會話重用的總次數。
    
    `no_common_protocol` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of no common protocol.

    由於沒有通用協議， SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `handshake_timeout` (`integer`)
    
    The number of SSL handshakes failed because of a timeout.

    由於超時SSL握手次數失敗。
    
    `peer_rejected_cert` (`integer`)
    
    The number of failed SSL handshakes when nginx presented the certificate to the upstream server but it was rejected with a corresponding alert message.

    當 nginx 向上游伺服器提交憑證但被拒絕並收到相應的警報訊息時， SSL握手失敗的次數。
    
    `verify_failures`
    
    SSL certificate verification errors

    SSL證書驗證錯誤
    
    `expired_cert` (`integer`)
    
    An expired or not yet valid certificate was presented by an upstream server.

    上游伺服器提供的憑證已過期或尚未生效。
    
    `revoked_cert` (`integer`)
    
    A revoked certificate was presented by an upstream server.

    上游伺服器提供了已被撤銷的憑證。
    
    `hostname_mismatch` (`integer`)
    
    Server's certificate doesn't match the hostname.

    伺服器憑證與主機名稱不符。
    
    `other` (`integer`)
    
    Other SSL certificate verification errors.

    其他SSL證書驗證錯誤。
    
    `max_conns` (`integer`)
    
    The [max\_conns](#p-163) limit for the server.

    伺服器的 [max\_conns](#p-163)限制。
    
    `connections` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of client connections forwarded to this server.

    轉送至此伺服器的用戶端連線總數。
    
    `connect_time` (`integer`)
    
    The average time to connect to the upstream server.

    連接到上游伺服器的平均時間。
    
    `first_byte_time` (`integer`)
    
    The average time to receive the first byte of data.

    接收到第一個位元組資料的平均時間。
    
    `response_time` (`integer`)
    
    The average time to receive the last byte of data.

    接收到最後一個位元組資料的平均時間。
    
    `sent` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes sent to this server.

    傳送到此伺服器的總位元組數。
    
    `received` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of bytes received from this server.

    從該伺服器接收到的總位元組數。
    
    `fails` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server.

    與伺服器通訊失敗的總次數。
    
    `unavail` (`integer`)
    
    How many times the server became unavailable for client connections (state “`unavail`”) due to the number of unsuccessful attempts reaching the [max\_fails](#p-163) threshold.

    由於失敗嘗試次數達到 [max\_fails](#p-163)閾值，伺服器對客戶端連線不可用（狀態「 `unavail` 」）的次數。
    
    `health_checks`
    
    `checks` (`integer`)
    
    The total number of [health check](#p-162) requests made.

    已發出的[健康檢查](#p-162)請求總數。
    
    `fails` (`integer`)
    
    The number of failed health checks.

    健康檢查不合格的次數。
    
    `unhealthy` (`integer`)
    
    How many times the server became unhealthy (state “`unhealthy`”).

    伺服器出現不健康狀態（狀態「 `unhealthy` 」）的次數。
    
    `last_passed` (`boolean`)
    
    Boolean indicating whether the last health check request was successful and passed [tests](#p-162).

    布林值，表示上次健康檢查請求是否成功並通過了[測試](#p-162) 。
    
    `downtime` (`integer`)
    
    Total time the server was in the “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, and “`unhealthy`” states.

    伺服器處於「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」和「 `unhealthy` 」狀態的總時間。
    
    `downstart` (`string`)
    
    The time when the server became “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, or “`unhealthy`”, in the ISO 8601 format with millisecond resolution.

    伺服器變成「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」或「 `unhealthy` 」的時間，採用ISO 8601 格式，精確到毫秒。
    
    `selected` (`string`)
    
    The time when the server was last selected to process a connection, in the ISO 8601 format with millisecond resolution.

    伺服器上次被選取處理連線的時間，採用ISO 8601 格式，精確到毫秒。
    
    `zombies` (`integer`)
    
    The current number of servers removed from the group but still processing active client connections.

    目前已從群組中移除但仍在處理活躍用戶端連線的伺服器數量。
    
    `zone` (`string`)
    
    The name of the shared memory [zone](#p-163) that keeps the group’s configuration and run-time state.

    共享記憶體 [區域](#p-163)的名稱，用於保存群組的配置和運行時狀態。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "dns" : {
    >     "peers" : [
    >
    >     「同行」：[
    >       {
    >         "id" : 0,
    >
    >         “id”：0，
    >         "server" : "10.0.0.1:12347",
    >
    >         "伺服器" : " 10.0.0.1:12347 ",
    >         "name" : "10.0.0.1:12347",
    >
    >         "name" : " 10.0.0.1:12347 ",
    >         "backup" : false,
    >
    >         「備份」：false，
    >         "weight" : 5,
    >
    >         「權重」：5，
    >         "state" : "up",
    >         "active" : 0,
    >
    >         “active”：0，
    >         "ssl" : {
    >           "handshakes" : 200,
    >
    >           「握手」：200，
    >           "handshakes_failed" : 4,
    >
    >           "握手失敗"：4，
    >           "session_reuses" : 189,
    >
    >           「session_reuses」：189，
    >           "no_common_protocol" : 4,
    >           "handshake_timeout" : 0,
    >           "peer_rejected_cert" : 0,
    >           "verify_failures" : {
    >             "expired_cert" : 2,
    >             "revoked_cert" : 1,
    >             "hostname_mismatch" : 2,
    >             "other" : 1
    >
    >             「其他」：1
    >           }
    >         },
    >         "max_conns" : 50,
    >
    >         “max_conns”：50，
    >         "connections" : 667231,

-   Stream Upstream Server:  
    串流媒體上游伺服器：
    
    Dynamically configurable parameters of a stream upstream [server](#p-163):

    上游流的動態可設定參數 [伺服器](#p-163) :
    
    `id` (`integer`)
    
    The ID of the stream upstream server. The ID is assigned automatically and cannot be changed.

    流上游伺服器的ID。 ID 是自動分配的且無法更改。
    
    `server` (`string`)
    
    Same as the [address](#p-163) parameter of the stream upstream server. When adding a server, it is possible to specify it as a domain name. In this case, changes of the IP addresses that correspond to a domain name will be monitored and automatically applied to the upstream configuration without the need of restarting nginx. This requires the [resolver](#p-142) directive in the “`stream`” block. See also the [resolve](#p-163) parameter of the stream upstream server.

    與流上游伺服器的 [address](#p-163)參數相同。新增伺服器時，可以指定為網域名稱。在這種情況下，系統會監控與網域名稱對應的IP位址的更改，並自動將其應用到上游配置，無需重新啟動 nginx。這需要在「 `stream` 」區塊中使用 [resolver](#p-142)指令。另請參閱流上游伺服器的 [resolve](#p-163)參數。
    
    `service` (`string`)
    
    Same as the [service](#p-163) parameter of the stream upstream server. This parameter cannot be changed.

    與流上游伺服器的 [service](#p-163)參數相同。此參數不可更改。
    
    `weight` (`integer`)
    
    Same as the [weight](#p-163) parameter of the stream upstream server.

    與流上游伺服器的 [weight](#p-163)參數相同。
    
    `max_conns` (`integer`)
    
    Same as the [max\_conns](#p-163) parameter of the stream upstream server.

    與流上游伺服器的 [max\_conns](#p-163)參數相同。
    
    `max_fails` (`integer`)
    
    Same as the [max\_fails](#p-163) parameter of the stream upstream server.

    與流上游伺服器的 [max\_fails](#p-163)參數相同。
    
    `fail_timeout` (`string`)
    
    Same as the [fail\_timeout](#p-163) parameter of the stream upstream server.

    與流上游伺服器的 [fail\_timeout](#p-163)參數相同。
    
    `slow_start` (`string`)
    
    Same as the [slow\_start](#p-163) parameter of the stream upstream server.

    與流上游伺服器的 [slow\_start](#p-163)參數相同。
    
    `backup` (`boolean`)
    
    When `true`, adds a [backup](#p-163) server. This parameter cannot be changed.

    當`true`新增 [備份](#p-163)伺服器時，此參數無法變更。
    
    `down` (`boolean`)
    
    Same as the [down](#p-163) parameter of the stream upstream server.

    與流上游伺服器的 [down](#p-163)參數相同。
    
    `parent` (`string`)
    
    Parent server ID of the resolved server. The ID is assigned automatically and cannot be changed.

    已解析伺服器的ID伺服器ID會自動分配，無法更改。
    
    `host` (`string`)
    
    Hostname of the resolved server. The hostname is assigned automatically and cannot be changed.

    已解析伺服器的主機名稱。主機名稱是自動分配的，無法變更。
    
    Example:

    例子：
    
    > ```json
    > {
    >   "id" : 0,
    >
    >   “id”：0，
    >   "server" : "10.0.0.1:12348",
    >
    >   "伺服器" : " 10.0.0.1:12348 ",
    >   "weight" : 1,
    >
    >   「權重」：1，
    >   "max_conns" : 0,
    >
    >   “max_conns”：0，
    >   "max_fails" : 1,
    >
    >   “max_fails”：1，
    >   "fail_timeout" : "10s",
    >   "slow_start" : 0,
    >   "backup" : false,
    >
    >   「備份」：false，
    >   "down" : false
    >
    >   「向下」：否
    > }
    > ```

<a id="p-049"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_auth_basic_module｜模組 ngx_http_auth_basic_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_auth_basic_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_auth\_basic\_module｜模組 ngx_http_auth_basic_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-049)<br>[Directives](#p-049)<br>     [auth\_basic](#p-049)<br>     [auth\_basic\_user\_file](#p-049)<br>[範例配置](#p-049)<br> [指令](#p-049)<br> [auth\_basic](#p-049)<br> [auth\_basic\_user\_file](#p-049) |

The `ngx_http_auth_basic_module` module allows limiting access to resources by validating the user name and password using the “HTTP Basic Authentication”（HTTP 基本驗證） protocol.

`ngx_http_auth_basic_module`模組允許透過使用“HTTP Basic Authentication”（HTTP 基本驗證）協定驗證使用者名稱和密碼來限制對資源的存取。

Access can also be limited by [address](#p-045), by the [result of subrequest](#p-051), or by [JWT](#p-050). Simultaneous limitation of access by address and by password is controlled by the [satisfy](#p-056) directive.

存取也可以透過 [地址](#p-045) 、[子請求結果](#p-051)或 [JWT](#p-050)來限制。透過位址和密碼同時限制存取由 [滿足](#p-056)指令控制。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     auth_basic           "closed site";
>
>     auth_basic "已關閉站點";
>     auth_basic_user_file conf/htpasswd;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>auth_basic</strong> <code><i>string<br>字串</i></code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>auth_basic off;<br>關閉基本驗證；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>limit_except<br>限制例外</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables validation of user name and password using the “HTTP Basic Authentication”（HTTP 基本驗證） protocol. The specified parameter is used as a `*realm*`. Parameter value can contain variables (1.3.10, 1.2.7). The special value `off` cancels the effect of the `auth_basic` directive inherited from the previous configuration level.

啟用使用“HTTP Basic Authentication”（HTTP 基本驗證）協定驗證使用者名稱和密碼。指定的參數用作`*realm*` 。參數值可以包含變數（ 1.3.10, 1.2.7 ）。特殊值`off`會取消從上一層配置繼承的`auth_basic`指令的效果。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**auth_basic_user_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**auth_basic_user_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location`, `limit_except` |

Specifies a file that keeps user names and passwords, in the following format:

指定一個用於保存使用者名稱和密碼的文件，格式如下：

> ```
> # comment｜評論
> name1:password1
>
> 使用者名稱1:密碼1
> name2:password2:comment
>
> 使用者名稱2:密碼2:評論
> name3:password3
>
> 使用者名稱3:密碼3
> ```

The `*file*` name can contain variables.

`*file*`名稱可以包含變數。

The following password types are supported:

支援以下幾種密碼類型：

-   encrypted with the `crypt()` function; can be generated using the “`htpasswd`” utility from the Apache HTTP Server distribution or the “`openssl passwd`” command;  
    使用`crypt()`函數加密；可使用 Apache HTTP伺服器發行版中的「 `htpasswd` 」公用程式或「 `openssl passwd` 」指令產生；
-   hashed with the Apache variant of the MD5-based password algorithm (apr1); can be generated with the same tools;  
    使用基於MD5的 Apache 變體密碼演算法 (apr1) 進行哈希處理；可以使用相同的工具產生；
-   specified by the “`{``*scheme*``}``*data*`” syntax (1.0.3+) as described in [RFC 2307](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2307#section-5.3); currently implemented schemes include `PLAIN` (an example one, should not be used), `SHA` (1.3.13) (plain SHA-1 hashing, should not be used) and `SSHA` (salted SHA-1 hashing, used by some software packages, notably OpenLDAP and Dovecot).  
    由「 `{``*scheme*``}``*data*` 」語法（ 1.0.3 +）指定，如[RFC 2307](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2307#section-5.3)中所述；目前實現的方案包括`PLAIN` （範例，不應使用）、 `SHA` 1.3.13 ）（普通SHA -1 哈希，不應使用）和`SSHA` （加鹽SHA -1 哈希，一些軟體包使用，特別是 OpenLDAP 和 Dovecot）。
    
    > Support for `SHA` scheme was added only to aid in migration from other web servers. It should not be used for new passwords, since unsalted SHA-1 hashing that it employs is vulnerable to [rainbow table](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rainbow_attack) attacks.
    >
    > 新增對`SHA`方案的支援僅是為了方便從其他 Web 伺服器遷移。它不應用於新密碼，因為它採用的無鹽SHA -1 哈希容易受到 [彩虹表](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rainbow_attack)攻擊。
