<a id="p-050"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_auth_jwt_module｜模組 ngx_http_auth_jwt_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_auth_jwt_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_auth\_jwt\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_auth\_jwt\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Supported Algorithms](#p-050)<br>[Example Configuration](#p-050)<br>[Directives](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_claim\_set](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_header\_set](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_key\_cache](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_key\_file](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_key\_request](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_leeway](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_type](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_require](#p-050)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-050)<br>[支援的演算法](#p-050)<br>[範例配置](#p-050)<br>[指示](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_claim\_set](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_header\_set](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_key\_cache](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_key\_file](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_key\_request](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_leeway](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_type](#p-050)<br>     [auth\_jwt\_require](#p-050)<br>[嵌入式變數](#p-050) |

The `ngx_http_auth_jwt_module` module (1.11.3) implements client authorization by validating the provided [JSON Web Token](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519) (JWT) using the specified keys. The module supports [JSON Web Signature](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7515) (JWS), [JSON Web Encryption](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7516) (JWE) (1.19.7), and Nested JWT (1.21.0). The module can be used for [OpenID Connect](http://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html) authentication.

`ngx_http_auth_jwt_module`模組 (1.11.3) 透過使用指定的金鑰驗證提供的 [JSON Web Token](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519) (JWT) 來實現客戶端授權。此模組支援 [JSON Web Signature](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7515) (JWS)、[JSON Web Encryption](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7516) (JWE) (1.19.7) 和嵌套 JWT (1.21.0)。此模組可用於 [OpenID Connect](http://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html)身份驗證。

The module may be combined with other access modules, such as [ngx\_http\_access\_module](#p-045), [ngx\_http\_auth\_basic\_module](#p-049), and [ngx\_http\_auth\_request\_module](#p-051), via the [satisfy](#p-056) directive.

此模組可透過 [satisfy (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_access_module.html) 、[ngx\_http\_auth\_basic\_module](#p-049)與 [ngx\_http73\n\SFquest\ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_auth_request_module.html) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#satisfy)組合使用。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組包含在我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)中。

**Supported Algorithms｜支援的演算法**

The module supports the following JSON Web [Algorithms](https://www.iana.org/assignments/jose/jose.xhtml#web-signature-encryption-algorithms).

此模組支援以下JSON Web [演算法](https://www.iana.org/assignments/jose/jose.xhtml#web-signature-encryption-algorithms) 。

JWS algorithms:

JWS演算法：

-   HS256, HS384, HS512
-   RS256, RS384, RS512
-   ES256, ES384, ES512
-   EdDSA (Ed25519 and Ed448 signatures) (1.15.7)  
    EdDSA（Ed25519 和 Ed448 簽名）（ 1.15.7 ）
-   PS256, PS384, PS512 (1.29.0)

> Prior to version 1.13.7, only HS256, RS256, ES256 algorithms were supported.
>
> 在版本1.13.7之前，僅支援HS256, RS256, ES256演算法。

JWE content encryption algorithms (1.19.7):

JWE內容加密演算法 ( 1.19.7 ):

-   A128CBC-HS256, A192CBC-HS384, A256CBC-HS512
-   A128GCM, A192GCM, A256GCM

JWE key management algorithms (1.19.9):

JWE金鑰管理演算法 ( 1.19.9 ):

-   A128KW, A192KW, A256KW
-   A128GCMKW, A192GCMKW, A256GCMKW
-   dir - direct use of a shared symmetric key as the content encryption key  
    dir - 直接使用共享對稱金鑰作為內容加密金鑰
-   RSA-OAEP, RSA-OAEP-256, RSA-OAEP-384, RSA-OAEP-512 (1.21.0)

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     auth_jwt          "closed site";
>
>     auth_jwt "已關閉站點";
>     auth_jwt_key_file conf/keys.json;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>auth_jwt</strong> <code><i>string<br>細繩</i></code> [<code>token=</code><code><i>$variable<br>變數</i></code>] | <code>off<br>離開</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>auth_jwt off;<br>auth_jwt 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>limit_except</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables validation of JSON Web Token. The specified `*string*` is used as a `realm`. Parameter value can contain variables.

啟用對JSON Web Token 的驗證。指定的`*string*`用作`realm` 。參數值可以包含變數。

The optional `token` parameter specifies a variable that contains JSON Web Token. By default, JWT is passed in the “Authorization”（授權） header as a [Bearer Token](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6750). JWT may be also passed as a cookie or a part of a query string:

可選的 `token` 參數指定包含 JSON Web Token 的變數。預設情況下，JWT作為[承載令牌](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6750). JWT在“Authorization”（授權）標頭中傳遞，也可以作為cookie或查詢字串的一部分傳遞：

> ```
> auth_jwt "closed site" token=$cookie_auth_token;
> ```

The special value `off` cancels the effect of the `auth_jwt` directive inherited from the previous configuration level.

特殊值`off`取消從上一個設定等級繼承的`auth_jwt`指令的效果。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**auth_jwt_claim_set** `*$variable*` `*name*` ...;``<br>` `**auth_jwt_claim_set** ` *$變數* ` ` *名稱* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.10.

該指令出現在版本1.11.10 。

Sets the `*variable*` to a JWT claim parameter identified by key names. Name matching starts from the top level of the JSON tree. For arrays, the variable keeps a list of array elements separated by commas.

將`*variable*`設定為由鍵名標識的JWT宣告參數。名稱匹配從JSON樹的頂層開始。對於數組，該變數保存一個以逗號分隔的數組元素列表。

> ```
> auth_jwt_claim_set $email info e-mail;
>
> auth_jwt_claim_set $email info 電子郵件;
> auth_jwt_claim_set $job info "job title";
>
> auth_jwt_claim_set $job info "職位名稱";
> ```

> Prior to version 1.13.7, only one key name could be specified, and the result was undefined for arrays.
>
> 在版本1.13.7之前，只能指定一個鍵名，且對於數組，結果是未定義的。

> Variable values for tokens encrypted with JWE are available only after decryption which occurs during the [Access](#p-028) phase.
>
> 使用JWE加密的令牌的變數值僅在解密後可用，解密發生在 [Access](#p-028)階段。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**auth_jwt_header_set** `*$variable*` `*name*` ...;``<br>` `**auth_jwt_header_set** ` *$變數* ` ` *名稱* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.10.

該指令出現在版本1.11.10 。

Sets the `*variable*` to a JOSE header parameter identified by key names. Name matching starts from the top level of the JSON tree. For arrays, the variable keeps a list of array elements separated by commas.

將`*variable*`設定為由鍵名標識的JOSE標頭參數。名稱匹配從JSON樹的頂層開始。對於數組，該變數保存一個以逗號分隔的數組元素列表。

> Prior to version 1.13.7, only one key name could be specified, and the result was undefined for arrays.
>
> 在版本1.13.7之前，只能指定一個鍵名，且對於數組，結果是未定義的。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>auth_jwt_key_cache</strong> <code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>auth_jwt_key_cache 0;<br>auth_jwt_key_cache 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.21.4.

該指令出現在版本1.21.4 。

Enables or disables caching of keys obtained from a [file](#p-050) or from a [subrequest](#p-050), and sets caching time for them. Caching of keys obtained from variables is not supported. By default, caching of keys is disabled.

啟用或停用從檔案（ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_auth_jwt_module.html#auth_jwt_key_file) ）或子請求(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_auth_jwt_module.html#auth_jwt_key_request) ）取得的鍵的緩存，並設定快取時間。不支援緩存從變數獲取的鍵。預設情況下，鍵的快取處於停用狀態。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**auth_jwt_key_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**auth_jwt_key_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location`, `limit_except` |

Specifies a `*file*` in [JSON Web Key Set](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7517#section-5) format for validating JWT signature. Parameter value can contain variables.

指定用於驗證JWT的 [JSON Web 金鑰集](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7517#section-5)格式的`*file*` 。參數值可以包含變數。

Several `auth_jwt_key_file` directives can be specified on the same level (1.21.1):

可以在同一層級指定多個`auth_jwt_key_file`指令（ 1.21.1 ）：

> ```
> auth_jwt_key_file conf/keys.json;
> auth_jwt_key_file conf/key.jwk;
> ```

If at least one of the specified keys cannot be loaded or processed, nginx will return the 500 (Internal Server Error) error.

如果指定的鍵中至少有一個無法載入或處理，nginx 將傳回 500（內部伺服器錯誤）錯誤。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**auth_jwt_key_request** `*uri*`;``<br>` `**auth_jwt_key_request** ` *uri* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location`, `limit_except` |

This directive appeared in version 1.15.6.

該指令出現在版本1.15.6 。

Allows retrieving a [JSON Web Key Set](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7517#section-5) file from a subrequest for validating JWT signature and sets the URI where the subrequest will be sent to. Parameter value can contain variables. To avoid validation overhead, it is recommended to cache the key file:

允許從子請求中檢索 [JSON Web 金鑰集](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7517#section-5)文件，以驗證JWT簽名，並設定子請求的URI目標位置。參數值可以包含變數。為避免驗證開銷，建議快取金鑰檔案：

> ```
> proxy_cache_path /data/nginx/cache levels=1 keys_zone=foo:10m;
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     ...
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         auth_jwt             "closed site";
>
>         auth_jwt "已關閉站點";
>         auth_jwt_key_request /jwks_uri;
>     }
> 
>     location = /jwks_uri {
>         internal;
>
>         內部的;
>         proxy_cache foo;
>         proxy_pass  http://idp.example.com/keys;
>
>         proxy_pass http://idp.example.com/keys;
>     }
> }
> ```

Several `auth_jwt_key_request` directives can be specified on the same level (1.21.1):

可以在同一層級指定多個`auth_jwt_key_request`指令（ 1.21.1 ）：

> ```
> auth_jwt_key_request /jwks_uri;
> auth_jwt_key_request /jwks2_uri;
> ```

If at least one of the specified keys cannot be loaded or processed, nginx will return the 500 (Internal Server Error) error.

如果指定的鍵中至少有一個無法載入或處理，nginx 將傳回 500（內部伺服器錯誤）錯誤。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>auth_jwt_leeway</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>auth_jwt_leeway 0s;<br>auth_jwt_leeway 0s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.13.10.

該指令出現在版本1.13.10 。

Sets the maximum allowable leeway to compensate clock skew when verifying the [exp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.4) and [nbf](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.5) JWT claims.

設定驗證 [exp](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.4)和 [nbf](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.5) JWT聲明時補償時鐘偏差的最大允許餘裕。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>auth_jwt_type</strong> <code>signed</code> | <code>encrypted</code> | <code>nested<br>encrypted</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>auth_jwt_type signed;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>limit_except</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.19.7.

該指令出現在版本1.19.7 。

Specifies which type of JSON Web Token to expect: JWS (`signed`), JWE (`encrypted`), or signed and then encrypted Nested JWT (`nested`) (1.21.0).

指定要預期的JSON Web Token 類型： JWS ( `signed` )、 JWE ( `encrypted` ) 或簽名後加密的嵌套JWT ( `nested` 23 1.21.0

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**auth_jwt_require** `*$value*` ... [`error`=`401` \| `403`] ;``<br>` `**auth_jwt_require** ` *$value* ` ... [` error `=` 401 ` \| ` 403 `] ;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location`, `limit_except` |

This directive appeared in version 1.21.2.

該指令出現在版本1.21.2 。

Specifies additional checks for JWT validation. The value can contain text, variables, and their combination, and must start with a variable (1.21.7). The authentication will succeed only if all the values are not empty and are not equal to “0”.

指定對JWT驗證的附加檢查。該值可以包含文字、變數及其組合，並且必須以變數 ( 1.21.7 ) 開頭。只有當所有值均不為空且不等於“0”時，身份驗證才會成功。

> ```
> map $jwt_claim_iss $valid_jwt_iss {
>
> 映射 $jwt_claim_iss $valid_jwt_iss {
>     "good" 1;
>
>     「好」 1；
> }
> ...
> 
> auth_jwt_require $valid_jwt_iss;
> ```

If any of the checks fails, the `401` error code is returned. The optional `error` parameter (1.21.7) allows redefining the error code to `403`.

如果任何檢查失敗，則傳回`401`錯誤代碼。可選的`error`參數 ( 1.21.7 ) 允許將錯誤代碼重新定義為`403` 。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_auth_jwt_module` module supports embedded variables:

`ngx_http_auth_jwt_module`模組支援嵌入式變數：

`$jwt_header_``*name*`

returns the value of a specified [JOSE header](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7515#section-4)

傳回指定 [JOSE標頭](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7515#section-4)的值

`$jwt_claim_``*name*`

returns the value of a specified [JWT claim](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4)

傳回指定 [JWT宣告](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4)的值

For nested claims and claims including a dot (“.”), the value of the variable cannot be evaluated; the [auth\_jwt\_claim\_set](#p-050) directive should be used instead.

對於巢狀宣告和包含點（「.」）的聲明，無法評估變數的值；應改用 [auth\_jwt\_claim\_set](#p-050)指令。

Variable values for tokens encrypted with JWE are available only after decryption which occurs during the [Access](#p-028) phase.

使用JWE加密的令牌的變數值僅在解密後可用，解密發生在 [Access](#p-028)階段。

`$jwt_payload`

returns the decrypted top-level payload of `nested` or `encrypted` tokens (1.21.2). For nested tokens returns the enclosed JWS token. For encrypted tokens returns JSON with claims.

傳回`nested`或`encrypted`令牌（ 1.21.2 ）的解密頂層有效載荷。對於嵌套令牌，傳回包含的JWS令牌。對於加密令牌，返回帶有宣告的JSON 。

---

<a id="p-051"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_auth_request_module｜模組 ngx_http_auth_request_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_auth_request_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_auth\_request\_module｜模組 ngx_http_auth_request_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-051)<br>[Directives](#p-051)<br>     [auth\_request](#p-051)<br>     [auth\_request\_set](#p-051)<br>[範例配置](#p-051)<br> [指令](#p-051)<br> [auth\_request](#p-051)<br> [auth\_request\_set](#p-051) |

The `ngx_http_auth_request_module` module (1.5.4+) implements client authorization based on the result of a subrequest. If the subrequest returns a 2xx response code, the access is allowed. If it returns 401 or 403, the access is denied with the corresponding error code. Any other response code returned by the subrequest is considered an error.

`ngx_http_auth_request_module`模組（ 1.5.4 +）基於子請求的結果實現客戶端授權。如果子請求傳回 2xx 回應代碼，則允許存取。如果傳回 401 或 403，則拒絕存取並傳回對應的錯誤代碼。子請求返回的任何其他回應代碼均視為錯誤。

For the 401 error, the client also receives the “WWW-Authenticate”（WWW-驗證） header from the subrequest response.

對於 401 錯誤，客戶端也會從子請求回應中收到“WWW-Authenticate”（WWW-驗證）標頭。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_auth_request_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_auth_request_module`配置參數啟用。

The module may be combined with other access modules, such as [ngx\_http\_access\_module](#p-045), [ngx\_http\_auth\_basic\_module](#p-049), and [ngx\_http\_auth\_jwt\_module](#p-050), via the [satisfy](#p-056) directive.

此模組可與其他存取模組組合使用，例如 [ngx\_http\_access\_module](#p-045), [ngx\_http\_auth\_basic\_module](#p-049)以及 [ngx\_http\_auth\_jwt\_module](#p-050)透過 [滿足](#p-056) 指示。

> Before version 1.7.3, responses to authorization subrequests could not be cached (using [proxy\_cache](#p-085), [proxy\_store](#p-085), etc.).
>
> 在版本1.7.3之前，無法快取授權子請求的回應（使用 [proxy\_cache](#p-085) 、 [proxy\_store](#p-085)等）。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location /private/ {
>     auth_request /auth;
>     ...
> }
> 
> location = /auth {
>     proxy_pass ...
>     proxy_pass_request_body off;
>
>     proxy_pass_request_body 關閉；
>     proxy_set_header Content-Length "";
>     proxy_set_header X-Original-URI $request_uri;
>
>     proxy_set_header X-Original- URI $request_uri;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>auth_request</strong> <code><i>uri</i></code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>auth_request off;<br>auth_request 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables authorization based on the result of a subrequest and sets the URI to which the subrequest will be sent.

啟用基於子請求結果的授權，並設定將要傳送子請求的URI 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**auth_request_set** `*$variable*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**auth_request_set** ` *$變數* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Sets the request `*variable*` to the given `*value*` after the authorization request completes. The value may contain variables from the authorization request, such as `$upstream_http_*`.

在授權請求完成後，將請求`*variable*`設定為給定的`*value*` 。該值可能包含來自授權請求的變量，例如`$upstream_http_*` 。

---

<a id="p-052"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_auth_require_module｜模組 ngx_http_auth_require_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_auth_require_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_auth\_require\_module｜模組 ngx_http_auth_require_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-052)<br>[Directives](#p-052)<br>     [auth\_require](#p-052)<br>[範例設定](#p-052)<br> [指令](#p-052)<br> [auth\_require](#p-052) |

The `ngx_http_auth_require_module` module (1.29.0) implements variable-based client authorization. It can also use variables provided by other access modules such as [ngx\_http\_auth\_request\_module](#p-051) or [ngx\_http\_auth\_oidc\_module](#p-051).

`ngx_http_auth_require_module`模組 ( 1.29.0 ) 實作了基於變數的客戶端授權。它也可以使用其他存取模組提供的變量，例如 [ngx\_http\_auth\_request\_module](#p-051)或 [ngx\_http\_auth\_oidc\_module](#p-051) 。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> http {
>
> http{
>     oidc_provider my_idp {
>         ...
>     }
> 
>     map $oidc_claim_role $admin_role {
>
>     映射 $oidc_claim_role $admin_role {
>         "admin" 1;
>
>         “管理員” 1；
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器{
>         auth_oidc my_idp;
> 
>         location /admin {
>             auth_require $admin_role;
>         }
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>auth_require</strong> <code><i>$value</i></code> ... [<code>error<br>錯誤</code>=<code>4xx</code> | <code>5xx</code>] ;<br>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>auth_require off;<br>auth_require 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>limit_except</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables authorization based on the specified variables. The access is allowed only if all the variables are not empty and are not equal to “0”. Otherwise, the module returns `403` code, which can be overridden by the `error` parameter. Several `auth_require` directives can be used to return different error codes.

啟用基於指定變數的授權。僅當所有變數均不為空且不等於“0”時，才允許存取。否則，模組將傳回`403`程式碼，該程式碼可透過`error`參數進行覆蓋。可以使用多個`auth_require`指令來傳回不同的錯誤碼。

---

<a id="p-053"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_autoindex_module｜模組 ngx_http_autoindex_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_autoindex_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_autoindex\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_autoindex\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-053)<br>[Directives](#p-053)<br>     [autoindex](#p-053)<br>     [autoindex\_exact\_size](#p-053)<br>     [autoindex\_format](#p-053)<br>     [autoindex\_localtime](#p-053)<br>[範例設定](#p-053)<br>[指令](#p-053)<br>     [自動索引](#p-053)<br>     [autoindex\_exact\_size ](#p-053)<br>     [autoindex\_format](#p-053)<br>     [autoindex\_localtime](#p-053) |

The `ngx_http_autoindex_module` module processes requests ending with the slash character (‘`/`’) and produces a directory listing. Usually a request is passed to the `ngx_http_autoindex_module` module when the [ngx\_http\_index\_module](#p-071) module cannot find an index file.

`ngx_http_autoindex_module`模組處理以斜槓字元（' `/` '）結尾的請求，並產生目錄清單。通常，當 [ngx\_http\_index\_module](#p-071)模組找不到索引檔案時，請求會傳遞給`ngx_http_autoindex_module`模組。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     autoindex on;
>
>     自動索引已開啟；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>autoindex<br>自動索引</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>autoindex off;<br>自動索引關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables the directory listing output.

啟用或停用目錄列表輸出。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>autoindex_exact_size</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>autoindex_exact_size on;<br>啟用 autoindex_exact_size;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

For the HTML [format](#p-053), specifies whether exact file sizes should be output in the directory listing, or rather rounded to kilobytes, megabytes, and gigabytes.

對於HTML [格式](#p-053) ，指定是否應在目錄清單中輸出確切的檔案大小，或是四捨五入到千位元組、兆位元組和千兆位元組。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>autoindex_format<br>自動索引格式</strong> <code>html</code> | <code>xml<br>XML</code> | <code>json<br>JSON</code> | <code>jsonp</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>autoindex_format html;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.9.

該指令出現在版本1.7.9 。

Sets the format of a directory listing.

設定目錄清單的格式。

When the JSONP format is used, the name of a callback function is set with the `callback` request argument. If the argument is missing or has an empty value, then the JSON format is used.

當使用JSONP格式時，回呼函數的名稱會透過`callback`請求參數設定。如果該參數缺失或值為空，則使用JSON格式。

The XML output can be transformed using the [ngx\_http\_xslt\_module](#p-110) module.

XML輸出可以使用 [ngx\_http\_xslt\_module](#p-110)模組進行轉換。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>autoindex_localtime</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>autoindex_localtime off;<br>關閉 autoindex_localtime；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

For the HTML [format](#p-053), specifies whether times in the directory listing should be output in the local time zone or UTC.

對於HTML [格式](#p-053) ，指定目錄清單中的時間是否應以本地時區或UTC輸出。

---

<a id="p-054"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_browser_module｜模組 ngx_http_browser_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_browser_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_browser\_module｜模組 ngx_http_browser_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-054)<br>[Directives](#p-054)<br>     [ancient\_browser](#p-054)<br>     [ancient\_browser\_value](#p-054)<br>     [modern\_browser](#p-054)<br>     [modern\_browser\_value](#p-054)<br>[範例設定](#p-054)<br> [指令](#p-054)<br> [ancient\_browser](#p-054)<br> [ancient\_browser\_value](#p-054)<br> [modern\_browrow](#p-054)<br> \3000000 (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_browser_module.html#modern_browser_value) |

The `ngx_http_browser_module` module creates variables whose values depend on the value of the “User-Agent”（使用者代理） request header field:

`ngx_http_browser_module`模組建立變量，這些變數的值取決於“User-Agent”（使用者代理）請求頭字段的值：

`$modern_browser`

equals the value set by the [modern\_browser\_value](#p-054) directive, if a browser was identified as modern;

如果瀏覽器被辨識為現代瀏覽器，則等於 [modern\_browser\_value](#p-054)指令設定的值；

`$ancient_browser`

equals the value set by the [ancient\_browser\_value](#p-054) directive, if a browser was identified as ancient;

如果瀏覽器被辨識為古老瀏覽器，則等於 [ancient\_browser\_value](#p-054)指令設定的值；

`$msie`

equals “1” if a browser was identified as MSIE of any version.

如果瀏覽器被辨識為任何版本的MSIE ，則等於「1」。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

Choosing an index file:

選擇索引檔：

> ```
> modern_browser_value "modern.";
> 
> modern_browser msie      5.5;
>
> 現代瀏覽器 msie 5.5 ;
> modern_browser gecko     1.0.0;
>
> modern_browser gecko 1.0.0 ;
> modern_browser opera     9.0;
>
> modern_browser opera 9.0 ;
> modern_browser safari    413;
>
> modern_browser Safari 413;
> modern_browser konqueror 3.0;
>
> modern_browser konqueror 3.0 ;
> 
> index index.${modern_browser}html index.html;
> ```

Redirection for old browsers:

舊版瀏覽器重定向：

> ```
> modern_browser msie      5.0;
>
> 現代_瀏覽器 msie 5.0 ;
> modern_browser gecko     0.9.1;
>
> modern_browser gecko 0.9.1 ;
> modern_browser opera     8.0;
>
> modern_browser opera 8.0 ;
> modern_browser safari    413;
>
> modern_browser Safari 413;
> modern_browser konqueror 3.0;
>
> modern_browser konqueror 3.0 ;
> 
> modern_browser unlisted;
>
> modern_browser 未列出；
> 
> ancient_browser Links Lynx netscape4;
> 
> if ($ancient_browser) {
>
> 如果 ($ancient_browser) {
>     rewrite ^ /ancient.html;
>
>     重寫 ^ /ancient.html;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**ancient_browser** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**ancient_browser** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

If any of the specified substrings is found in the “User-Agent”（使用者代理） request header field, the browser will be considered ancient. The special string “`netscape4`” corresponds to the regular expression “`^Mozilla/[1-4]`”.

如果在“User-Agent”（使用者代理）請求頭字段中找到任何指定的子字串，則該瀏覽器將被視為過時版本。特殊字串「 `netscape4` 」對應於正規表示式「 `^Mozilla/[1-4]` 」。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ancient_browser_value</strong> <code><i>string</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ancient_browser_value 1;<br>ancient_browser_value 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a value for the `$ancient_browser` variables.

設定`$ancient_browser`變數的值。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**modern_browser** `*browser*` `*version*`;``<br>``**modern_browser** `unlisted`;``<br>` `**modern_browser** ` *瀏覽器* ` ` *版本* `;``<br>``**modern_browser** `未列出`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Specifies a version starting from which a browser is considered modern. A browser can be any one of the following: `msie`, `gecko` (browsers based on Mozilla), `opera`, `safari`, or `konqueror`.

指定瀏覽器被視為現代瀏覽器的起始版本。瀏覽器可以是以下任何一種： `msie`, `gecko` （基於 Mozilla 的瀏覽器）、 `opera`, `safari`或`konqueror` 。

Versions can be specified in the following formats: X, X.X, X.X.X, or X.X.X.X. The maximum values for each of the format are 4000, 4000.99, 4000.99.99, and 4000.99.99.99, respectively.

版本可以採用以下格式指定：X、XX、XXX 或 XXXX。每種格式的最大值分別為 4000、 4000.99, 4000.99.99和4000.99.99.99 。

The special value `unlisted` specifies to consider a browser as modern if it was not listed by the `modern_browser` and [ancient\_browser](#p-054) directives. Otherwise such a browser is considered ancient. If a request does not provide the “User-Agent”（使用者代理） field in the header, the browser is treated as not being listed.

特殊值`unlisted`指定，如果瀏覽器未在`modern_browser`和 [ancient\_browser](#p-054)指令中列出，則將其視為現代瀏覽器。否則，此類瀏覽器將被視為舊版瀏覽器。如果請求頭中未提供“User-Agent”（使用者代理）字段，則該瀏覽器將被視為未列出。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>modern_browser_value</strong> <code><i>string</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>modern_browser_value 1;<br>modern_browser_value 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a value for the `$modern_browser` variables.

設定`$modern_browser`變數的值。

---

<a id="p-055"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_charset_module｜模組 ngx_http_charset_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_charset_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_charset\_module｜模組 ngx_http_charset_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-055)<br>[Directives](#p-055)<br>     [charset](#p-055)<br>     [charset\_map](#p-055)<br>     [charset\_types](#p-055)<br>     [override\_charset](#p-055)<br>     [source\_charset](#p-055)<br>[範例配置](#p-055)<br> [指令](#p-055)<br> [字符集](#p-055)<br> [字符集映射](#p-055)<br> [字符集(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_charset_module.html#charset_map)<br> ](#p-055)<br> [字符集](#p-055) |

The `ngx_http_charset_module` module adds the specified charset to the “Content-Type”（內容類型） response header field. In addition, the module can convert data from one charset to another, with some limitations:

`ngx_http_charset_module`模組會將指定的字元集加入“Content-Type”（內容類型）響應頭欄位。此外，該模組還可以將資料從一種字元集轉換為另一種字元集，但存在一些限制：

-   conversion is performed one way — from server to client,  
    轉換是單向進行的－從伺服器到客戶端，
-   only single-byte charsets can be converted  
    只能轉換單字節字符集。
-   or single-byte charsets to/from UTF-8.  
    或單字節字元集到/來自UTF -8。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> include        conf/koi-win;
>
> 包含 conf/koi-win；
> 
> charset        windows-1251;
>
> charset windows-1251;
> source_charset koi8-r;
>
> 來源字元集 koi8-r；
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>charset<br>字符集</strong> <code><i>charset<br>字符集</i></code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>charset off;<br>字元集關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>if in location<br>如果在位置中</code></td></tr>
</table>

Adds the specified charset to the “Content-Type”（內容類型） response header field. If this charset is different from the charset specified in the [source\_charset](#p-055) directive, a conversion is performed.

將指定的字元集新增至“Content-Type”（內容類型）響應頭欄位。如果此字元集與 [source\_charset](#p-055)指令中指定的字元集不同，則會執行轉換。

The parameter `off` cancels the addition of charset to the “Content-Type”（內容類型） response header field.

參數`off`取消將字元集新增至“Content-Type”（內容類型）響應頭字段。

A charset can be defined with a variable:

可以使用變數定義字元集：

> ```
> charset $charset;
>
> 字符集 $charset;
> ```

In such a case, all possible values of a variable need to be present in the configuration at least once in the form of the [charset\_map](#p-055), [charset](#p-055), or [source\_charset](#p-055) directives. For `utf-8`, `windows-1251`, and `koi8-r` charsets, it is sufficient to include the files `conf/koi-win`, `conf/koi-utf`, and `conf/win-utf` into configuration. For other charsets, simply making a fictitious conversion table works, for example:

在這種情況下，變數的所有可能值都需要在配置中至少出現一次，以 `[charset\_map](#p-055) 、`[charset](#p-055)或 `[source\_charset](#p-055)指令的形式出現。對於`utf-8`, `windows-1251`和`koi8-r`字元集，只需將檔案`conf/koi-win`, `conf/koi-utf`和`conf/win-utf`包含在設定中即可。對於其他字元集，只需建立一個虛擬的轉換表即可，例如：

> ```
> charset_map iso-8859-5 _ { }
> ```

In addition, a charset can be set in the “X-Accel-Charset”（X-Accel-字元集） response header field. This capability can be disabled using the [proxy\_ignore\_headers](#p-085), [fastcgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-060), [uwsgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-107), [scgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-091), and [grpc\_ignore\_headers](#p-064) directives.

此外，還可以在“X-Accel-Charset”（X-Accel-字元集）響應頭字段中設定字元集。可使用 [proxy\_ignore\_headers](#p-085) 、[fastcgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-060) 、[uwsgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-107) 、[scgi\_ignore\ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html#scgi_ignore_headers) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_grpc_module.html#grpc_ignore_headers)指令停用此功能。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**charset_map** `*charset1*` `*charset2*` { ... }``<br>` `**charset_map** ` *字元集1* ` ` *字元集2* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Describes the conversion table from one charset to another. A reverse conversion table is built using the same data. Character codes are given in hexadecimal. Missing characters in the range 80-FF are replaced with “`?`”. When converting from UTF-8, characters missing in a one-byte charset are replaced with “`&#XXXX;`”.

描述字符集之間的轉換表。反向轉換表使用相同的資料建構。字元代碼以十六進位表示。 80 到FF範圍內的缺失字元替換為「 `?` 」。從UTF到 8 轉換時，單字節字元集中缺少的字元會替換為「 `&#XXXX;` 」。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> charset_map koi8-r windows-1251 {
>     C0 FE ; # small yu
>
>     C0 FE ; # 小 yu
>     C1 E0 ; # small a
>
>     C1 E0;# 小 a
>     C2 E1 ; # small b
>
>     C2 E1；#小b
>     C3 F6 ; # small ts
>
>     C3 F6；#小ts
>     ...
> }
> ```

When describing a conversion table to UTF-8, codes for the UTF-8 charset should be given in the second column, for example:

在描述到UTF -8的轉換錶時，應在第二列給出UTF -8字元集的代碼，例如：

> ```
> charset_map koi8-r utf-8 {
>     C0 D18E ; # small yu
>
>     C0 D18E ; # 小 yu
>     C1 D0B0 ; # small a
>
>     C1 D0B0 ; # 小 a
>     C2 D0B1 ; # small b
>
>     C2 D0B1 ; # 小 b
>     C3 D186 ; # small ts
>
>     C3 D186；#小ts
>     ...
> }
> ```

Full conversion tables from `koi8-r` to `windows-1251`, and from `koi8-r` and `windows-1251` to `utf-8` are provided in the distribution files `conf/koi-win`, `conf/koi-utf`, and `conf/win-utf`.

分發文件`conf/koi-win`, `conf/koi-utf`和`conf/win-utf`中提供了從`koi8-r`到`windows-1251`以及從`koi8-r`和`windows-1251`到`utf-8`完整轉換錶。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>charset_types<br>字符集類型</strong> <code><i>mime-type<br>MIME 類型</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>charset_types text/html text/xml text/plain text/vnd.wap.wml application/javascript application/rss+xml;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.7.9.

該指令出現在版本0.7.9 。

Enables module processing in responses with the specified MIME types in addition to “`text/html`”. The special value “`*`” matches any MIME type (0.8.29).

除了「 `text/html` 」類型外，還允許對具有指定MIME類型的回應進行模組處理。特殊值“ `*` ”匹配任何MIME類型（ 0.8.29 ）。

> Until version 1.5.4, “`application/x-javascript`” was used as the default MIME type instead of “`application/javascript`”.
>
> 在版本1.5.4之前，「 `application/x-javascript` 」被用作預設的MIME類型，而不是「 `application/javascript` 」。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>override_charset</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>override_charset off;<br>禁用字元集覆蓋；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>if in location<br>如果在位置中</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether a conversion should be performed for answers received from a proxied or a FastCGI/uwsgi/SCGI/gRPC server when the answers already carry a charset in the “Content-Type”（內容類型） response header field. If conversion is enabled, a charset specified in the received response is used as a source charset.

決定是否要應對從代理伺服器或 FastCGI/uwsgi/ SCGI /gRPC 伺服器收到的回應執行轉換，前提是回應頭欄位“Content-Type”（內容類型）中已包含字元集。如果啟用轉換，則將接收回應中指定的字元集用作來源字元集。

> It should be noted that if a response is received in a subrequest then the conversion from the response charset to the main request charset is always performed, regardless of the `override_charset` directive setting.
>
> 需要注意的是，如果在子請求中收到回應，則無論`override_charset`指令設定如何，都會始終執行從回應字元集到主請求字元集的轉換。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**source_charset** `*charset*`;``<br>` `**source_charset** ` *字元集* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location`, `if in location` |

Defines the source charset of a response. If this charset is different from the charset specified in the [charset](#p-055) directive, a conversion is performed.

定義回應的來源字元集。如果此字元集與 [charset](#p-055)指令中指定的字元集不同，則會執行轉換。
