</table>

If possible, the transmission of client data will be postponed until nginx has at least `*size*` bytes of data to send. The zero value disables postponing data transmission.

如果可能，客戶端資料的傳輸將被延遲，直到 nginx 至少有`*size*`位元組的資料要傳送。值為零時禁用資料傳輸延遲。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>read_ahead<br>預讀</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>read_ahead 0;<br>預讀 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the amount of pre-reading for the kernel when working with file.

設定核心在處理檔案時預先讀取的檔案數量。

On Linux, the `posix_fadvise(0, 0, 0, POSIX_FADV_SEQUENTIAL)` system call is used, and so the `*size*` parameter is ignored.

在 Linux 系統中，使用`posix_fadvise(0, 0, 0, POSIX_FADV_SEQUENTIAL)`系統調用，因此忽略`*size*`參數。

On FreeBSD, the `fcntl(O_READAHEAD,` `*size*``)` system call, supported since FreeBSD 9.0-CURRENT, is used. FreeBSD 7 has to be [patched](http://sysoev.ru/freebsd/patch.readahead.txt).

在 FreeBSD 中，使用了自 FreeBSD 9.0-CURRENT起支援的`fcntl(O_READAHEAD,` `*size*``)`系統呼叫。 FreeBSD 7 需要進行 [修補](http://sysoev.ru/freebsd/patch.readahead.txt) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>recursive_error_pages<br>遞歸錯誤頁</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>recursive_error_pages off;<br>遞歸錯誤頁關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables doing several redirects using the [error\_page](#p-056) directive. The number of such redirects is [limited](#p-056).

啟用或停用使用 [error\_page](#p-056)指令進行多次重定向。此類重定向的數量是 [有限的](#p-056) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>request_pool_size<br>請求池大小</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>request_pool_size 4k;<br>請求池大小 4k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Allows accurate tuning of per-request memory allocations. This directive has minimal impact on performance and should not generally be used.

允許對每個請求的記憶體分配進行精確調整。此指令對效能的影響極小，通常不應使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>reset_timedout_connection</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>reset_timedout_connection off;<br>關閉逾時連接；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables resetting timed out connections and connections [closed](#p-090) with the non-standard code 444 (1.15.2). The reset is performed as follows. Before closing a socket, the `SO_LINGER` option is set on it with a timeout value of 0. When the socket is closed, TCP RST is sent to the client, and all memory occupied by this socket is released. This helps avoid keeping an already closed socket with filled buffers in a FIN\_WAIT1 state for a long time.

啟用或停用使用非標準代碼 444 ( 1.15.2 ) 重設逾時連線和已關閉的連線(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_rewrite_module.html#return) 。重設過程如下：在關閉套接字之前，將其`SO_LINGER`選項設為逾時值為 0。套接字關閉時，向客戶端發送TCP RST ，並釋放該套接字所佔用的所有記憶體。這有助於避免將已關閉且緩衝區已滿的套接字長時間保持在FIN \_WAIT1 狀態。

It should be noted that timed out keep-alive connections are closed normally.

需要注意的是，超時的保持連線通常會關閉。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**resolver** `*address*` ... [`valid`=`*time*`] [`ipv4`=`on`\|`off`] [`ipv6`=`on`\|`off`] [`status_zone`=`*zone*`];``<br>``**resolver** `*地址*` ... [`有效`=`*時間*`] [`ipv4`=`on`\|`o ff`] [`ipv6`=`開`\|`關`] [`status_zone`=`*區域*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Configures name servers used to resolve names of upstream servers into addresses, for example:

配置用於將上游伺服器名稱解析為位址的名稱伺服器，例如：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
>
> 解析器127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
> ```

The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, with an optional port (1.3.1, 1.2.2). If port is not specified, the port 53 is used. Name servers are queried in a round-robin fashion.

位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，連接埠號碼可選（ 1.3.1, 1.2.2 ）。如果未指定連接埠號，則使用連接埠53。名稱伺服器以輪詢方式進行查詢。

> Before version 1.1.7, only a single name server could be configured. Specifying name servers using IPv6 addresses is supported starting from versions 1.3.1 and 1.2.2.
>
> 在版本1.1.7之前，只能配置單一名稱伺服器。從版本1.3.1和1.2.2開始，支援使用IPv6位址指定名稱伺服器。

By default, nginx will look up both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses while resolving. If looking up of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses is not desired, the `ipv4=off` (1.23.1) or the `ipv6=off` parameter can be specified.

預設情況下，nginx 在解析時會同時尋找 IPv4 和 IPv6 位址。如果不需要尋找 IPv4 或 IPv6 位址，可以指定`ipv4=off` ( 1.23.1 ) 或`ipv6=off`參數。

> Resolving of names into IPv6 addresses is supported starting from version 1.5.8.
>
> 從版本1.5.8開始支援將名稱解析為IPv6位址。

By default, nginx caches answers using the TTL value of a response. An optional `valid` parameter allows overriding it:

預設情況下，nginx 使用回應的TTL值快取答案。可選的`valid`參數允許覆蓋此設定：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 valid=30s;
>
> 解析器127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 有效=30秒;
> ```

> Before version 1.1.9, tuning of caching time was not possible, and nginx always cached answers for the duration of 5 minutes.
>
> 在版本1.1.9之前，無法調整快取時間，nginx 總是快取答案 5 分鐘。

> To prevent DNS spoofing, it is recommended configuring DNS servers in a properly secured trusted local network.
>
> 為防止DNS欺騙，建議在安全可靠的本地網路中設定DNS伺服器。

The optional `status_zone` parameter (1.17.1) enables [collection](#p-048) of DNS server statistics of requests and responses in the specified `*zone*`. The parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).

可選參數`status_zone` ( 1.17.1 ) 啟用 [收集](#p-048)指定`*zone*`中請求和回應的DNS伺服器統計資訊。此參數作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>resolver_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>resolver_timeout 30s;<br>resolver_timeout 30s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a timeout for name resolution, for example:

設定名稱解析超時時間，例如：

> ```
> resolver_timeout 5s;
>
> 解析器超時時間為 5 秒；
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>root<br>根目錄</strong> <code><i>path<br>路徑</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>root html;<br>根 HTML；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>if in location<br>如果在位置中</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the root directory for requests. For example, with the following configuration

設定請求的根目錄。例如，使用以下配置

> ```
> location /i/ {
>
> 位置 /i/ {
>     root /data/w3;
>
>     根 /data/w3;
> }
> ```

The `/data/w3/i/top.gif` file will be sent in response to the “`/i/top.gif`” request.

`/data/w3/i/top.gif`檔案將作為對「 `/i/top.gif` 」請求的回應而發送。

The `*path*` value can contain variables, except `$document_root` and `$realpath_root`.

`*path*`值可以包含變量，但`$document_root`和`$realpath_root`除外。

A path to the file is constructed by merely adding a URI to the value of the `root` directive. If a URI has to be modified, the [alias](#p-056) directive should be used.

只要在`root`指令的值中加入URI即可建構檔案路徑。若需要修改URI ，則應使用 [alias](#p-056)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>satisfy<br>滿足</strong> <code>all<br>所有</code> | <code>any<br>任意</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>satisfy all;<br>滿足所有條件；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Allows access if all (`all`) or at least one (`any`) of the [ngx\_http\_access\_module](#p-045), [ngx\_http\_auth\_basic\_module](#p-049), [ngx\_http\_auth\_request\_module](#p-051), [ngx\_http\_auth\_jwt\_module](#p-050) (1.13.10), or [ngx\_http\_auth\_oidc\_module](#p-050) (1.27.4) modules allow access.

允許訪問（如果所有（`all`）或至少一個（`any`）的 [ngx\_http\_access\_module](#p-045), [ngx\_http\_auth\_basic\_module](#p-049), [ngx\_http\_auth\_request\_module](#p-051), [ngx\_http\_auth\_jwt\_module](#p-050) (1.13.10），或 [ngx\_http\_auth\_oidc\_module](#p-050) (1.27.4）模組允許存取。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     satisfy any;
>
>     滿足任何要求；
> 
>     allow 192.168.1.0/32;
>
>     允許192.168.1.0/32 ;
>     deny  all;
>
>     全部否認；
> 
>     auth_basic           "closed site";
>
>     auth_basic "已關閉站點";
>     auth_basic_user_file conf/htpasswd;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>send_lowat</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>send_lowat 0;<br>send_lowat 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

If the directive is set to a non-zero value, nginx will try to minimize the number of send operations on client sockets by using either `NOTE_LOWAT` flag of the [kqueue](#p-030) method or the `SO_SNDLOWAT` socket option. In both cases the specified `*size*` is used.

如果指令設定為非零值，nginx 將嘗試透過使用 [ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/events.html#kqueue) `NOTE_LOWAT`或`SO_SNDLOWAT`套接字選項來減少客戶端套接字上的傳送操作次數。在這兩種情況下，都會使用指定的`*size*` 。

This directive is ignored on Linux, Solaris, and Windows.

該指令在 Linux、Solaris 和 Windows 系統上會被忽略。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>send_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>send_timeout 60s;<br>發送逾時時間為 60 秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a timeout for transmitting a response to the client. The timeout is set only between two successive write operations, not for the transmission of the whole response. If the client does not receive anything within this time, the connection is closed.

設定向客戶端發送回應的超時時間。此逾時時間僅設定在兩次連續寫入操作之間，而非整個回應的傳輸時間。如果用戶端在此時間內未收到任何內容，則連線將關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>sendfile</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>sendfile off;<br>關閉發送檔案；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>if in location<br>如果在位置中</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables the use of `sendfile()`.

啟用或停用`sendfile()`的使用。

Starting from nginx 0.8.12 and FreeBSD 5.2.1, [aio](#p-056) can be used to pre-load data for `sendfile()`:

從 nginx 0.8.12和 FreeBSD 5.2.1開始，[aio](#p-056)可用於預先載入`sendfile()`的資料：

> ```
> location /video/ {
>     sendfile       on;
>
>     發送文件已開啟；
>     tcp_nopush     on;
>
>     tcp_nopush 已開啟；
>     aio            on;
>
>     我打算這樣做；
> }
> ```

In this configuration, `sendfile()` is called with the `SF_NODISKIO` flag which causes it not to block on disk I/O, but, instead, report back that the data are not in memory. nginx then initiates an asynchronous data load by reading one byte. On the first read, the FreeBSD kernel loads the first 128K bytes of a file into memory, although next reads will only load data in 16K chunks. This can be changed using the [read\_ahead](#p-056) directive.

在此配置中， `sendfile()`被呼叫時會使用`SF_NODISKIO`標誌，使其不會阻塞磁碟 I/O，而是報告資料不在記憶體中。然後，nginx 會透過讀取一個位元組來啟動非同步資料載入。在首次讀取時，FreeBSD 核心會將檔案的前 128KB 載入到記憶體中，但後續讀取將僅以 16KB 為單位載入資料。可以使用 [read\_ahead](#p-056)指令來更改此行為。

> Before version 1.7.11, pre-loading could be enabled with `aio sendfile;`.
>
> 在版本1.7.11之前，可以使用`aio sendfile;`啟用預先載入。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>sendfile_max_chunk</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>sendfile_max_chunk 2m;<br>sendfile_max_chunk 2m；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Limits the amount of data that can be transferred in a single `sendfile()` call. Without the limit, one fast connection may seize the worker process entirely.

限制單次`sendfile()`呼叫中可傳輸的資料量。如果沒有此限制，一個快速連線可能會完全佔用工作進程。

> Prior to version 1.21.4, by default there was no limit.
>
> 在版本1.21.4之前，預設情況下沒有限制。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**server** { ... }` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Sets configuration for a virtual server. There is no clear separation between IP-based (based on the IP address) and name-based (based on the “Host”（主持人） request header field) virtual servers. Instead, the [listen](#p-056) directives describe all addresses and ports that should accept connections for the server, and the [server\_name](#p-056) directive lists all server names. Example configurations are provided in the “[How nginx processes a request](#p-111)” document.

設定虛擬伺服器的配置。基於位址（ IP ）和基於名稱（ “Host”（主持人）請求頭字段） IP虛擬伺服器之間沒有明確的區分。 [listen](#p-056)指令描述了伺服器應接受連接的所有位址和端口，而 [server\_name](#p-056)指令列出了所有伺服器名稱。範例設定請參考「[nginx 如何處理請求](#p-111) 」文件。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>server_name<br>伺服器名稱</strong> <code><i>name<br>名稱</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>server_name "";<br>伺服器名稱「」；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets names of a virtual server, for example:

設定虛擬伺服器的名稱，例如：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     server_name example.com www.example.com;
> }
> ```

The first name becomes the primary server name.

名字將成為主伺服器名稱。

Server names can include an asterisk (“`*`”) replacing the first or last part of a name:

伺服器名稱可以包含星號（“ `*` ”），用於替換名稱的第一部分或最後一部分：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     server_name example.com *.example.com www.example.*;
> }
> ```

Such names are called wildcard names.

這種名稱被稱為通配符名稱。

The first two of the names mentioned above can be combined in one:

上述名稱中的前兩個可以合併為一個：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     server_name .example.com;
>
>     server_name.example.com;
> }
> ```

It is also possible to use regular expressions in server names, preceding the name with a tilde (“`~`”):

伺服器名稱中也可以使用正規表示式，在名稱前面加上波浪號（“ `~` ”）：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     server_name www.example.com ~^www\d+\.example\.com$;
> }
> ```

Regular expressions can contain captures (0.7.40) that can later be used in other directives (see [Regular expression captures](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html)):

正規表示式可以包含捕獲（ 0.7.40 ），這些捕獲稍後可以在其他指令中使用（請參閱[正規表示式捕獲](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html) ）：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     server_name ~^(www\.)?(.+)$;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         root /sites/$2;
>
>         根 /sites/$2;
>     }
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     server_name _;
>
>     伺服器名稱_;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         root /sites/default;
>
>         根 /sites/default;
>     }
> }
> ```

Named captures in regular expressions create variables (0.8.25) that can later be used in other directives:

正規表示式中的命名捕獲會建立變數（ 0.8.25 ），這些變數稍後可以在其他指令中使用：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     server_name ~^(www\.)?(?<domain>.+)$;
>
>     server_name ~^(www\.)?(? <domain> .+)$;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         root /sites/$domain;
>
>         根 /sites/$domain;
>     }
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     server_name _;
>
>     伺服器名稱_;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         root /sites/default;
>
>         根 /sites/default;
>     }
> }
> ```

If the directive’s parameter is set to “`$hostname`” (0.9.4), the machine’s hostname is inserted.

如果指令的參數設定為「 `$hostname` 」（ 0.9.4 ），則會插入機器的主機名稱。

It is also possible to specify an empty server name (0.7.11):

也可以指定一個空的伺服器名稱（ 0.7.11 ）：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     server_name www.example.com "";
> }
> ```

It allows this server to process requests without the “Host”（主持人） header field — instead of the default server — for the given address:port pair. This is the default setting.

它允許此伺服器處理不帶“Host”（主持人）標頭字段的請求（而不是使用預設伺服器），以匹配給定的位址:連接埠對。這是預設值。

> Before 0.8.48, the machine’s hostname was used by default.
>
> 在0.8.48之前，預設情況下使用機器的主機名稱。

The search is performed in the following order of priority and terminates on the first matching variant:

搜尋按以下優先順序執行，並在找到第一個符合項目時終止：

1.  the exact name  
    確切名稱
2.  the longest wildcard name starting with an asterisk, e.g. “`*.example.com`”  
    以星號開頭的最長通配符名稱，例如“ `*.example.com` ”
3.  the longest wildcard name ending with an asterisk, e.g. “`mail.*`”  
    最長的通配符名稱以星號結尾，例如“ `mail.*` ”
4.  the first matching regular expression (in order of appearance in the configuration file)  
    第一個符合的正規表示式（按在設定檔中出現的順序）

Detailed description of server names is provided in a separate [Server names](#p-112) document.

伺服器名稱的詳細說明在單獨的 [伺服器名稱](#p-112)文件中提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>server_name_in_redirect<br>伺服器名稱</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>server_name_in_redirect off;<br>server_name_in_redirect 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables the use of the primary server name, specified by the [server\_name](#p-056) directive, in [absolute](#p-056) redirects issued by nginx. When the use of the primary server name is disabled, the name from the “Host”（主持人） request header field is used. If this field is not present, the IP address of the server is used.

啟用或停用在 nginx 發出的 [absolute](#p-056)重定向中使用由 [server\_name](#p-056)指令指定的主伺服器名稱。停用主伺服器名稱時，將使用“Host”（主持人）請求頭欄位中的名稱。如果該欄位不存在，則使用伺服器的IP位址。

The use of a port in redirects is controlled by the [port\_in\_redirect](#p-056) directive.

重定向中使用連接埠由 [port\_in\_redirect](#p-056)指令控制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>server_names_hash_bucket_size<br>伺服器名稱</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>server_names_hash_bucket_size 32|64|128;<br>server_names_hash_bucket_size 32|64|128；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the bucket size for the server names hash tables. The default value depends on the size of the processor’s cache line. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定伺服器名稱哈希表的桶大小。預設值取決於處理器快取行的大小。有關設定哈希表的詳細信息，請參閱單獨的[文檔](#p-040) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>server_names_hash_max_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>server_names_hash_max_size 512;<br>server_names_hash_max_size 512；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum `*size*` of the server names hash tables. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定伺服器名稱哈希表的最大值`*size*` 。有關設定哈希表的詳細信息，請參閱單獨的[文檔](#p-040) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>server_tokens</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code> | <code>build<br>off</code>|<br>| ⦧P30<code><i>string</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>server_tokens on;<br>server_tokens 已啟用；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables emitting nginx version on error pages and in the “Server”（伺服器） response header field.

啟用或停用在錯誤頁面和“Server”（伺服器）回應標頭欄位中發出 nginx 版本。

The `build` parameter (1.11.10) enables emitting a [build name](#p-024) along with nginx version.

`build`參數 ( 1.11.10 ) 可以發出 [建置名稱](#p-024)以及 nginx 版本。

Additionally, as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx), starting from version 1.9.13 the signature on error pages and the “Server”（伺服器） response header field value can be set explicitly using the `*string*` with variables. An empty string disables the emission of the “Server”（伺服器） field.

此外，作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，從版本1.9.13開始，可以使用`*string*`中的變數明確設定錯誤頁面上的簽章和“Server”（伺服器）回應頭欄位值。空字串將禁用“Server”（伺服器）字段的發送。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>subrequest_output_buffer_size<br>請求輸出緩衝區大小</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>subrequest_output_buffer_size 4k|8k;<br>請求輸出緩衝區大小 4k|8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.13.10.

該指令出現在版本1.13.10 。

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for storing the response body of a subrequest. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform. It can be made smaller, however.

設定用於儲存子請求回應體的緩衝區的`*size*`值。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台不同，該值可以是 4K 或 8K。不過，也可以將其減小。

The directive is applicable only for subrequests with response bodies saved into memory. For example, such subrequests are created by [SSI](#p-097).

此指令僅適用於響應體已儲存到記憶體中的子請求。例如，此類子請求由 [SSI](#p-097)建立。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>tcp_nodelay</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tcp_nodelay on;<br>啟用 tcp_nodelay；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables the use of the `TCP_NODELAY` option. The option is enabled when a connection is transitioned into the keep-alive state. Additionally, it is enabled on SSL connections, for unbuffered proxying, and for [WebSocket](#p-113) proxying.

啟用或停用`TCP_NODELAY`選項。當連線進入保持活動狀態時，該選項將會啟用。此外，對於SSL連線、無緩衝代理和 [WebSocket](#p-113)代理，此選項也會啟用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>tcp_nopush</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tcp_nopush off;<br>tcp_nopush 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables the use of the `TCP_NOPUSH` socket option on FreeBSD or the `TCP_CORK` socket option on Linux. The options are enabled only when [sendfile](#p-056) is used. Enabling the option allows

啟用或停用 FreeBSD 上的`TCP_NOPUSH`套接字選項或 Linux 上的`TCP_CORK`套接字選項。這些選項僅在使用 [sendfile](#p-056)時啟用。啟用此選項允許

-   sending the response header and the beginning of a file in one packet, on Linux and FreeBSD 4.\*;  
    在 Linux 和 FreeBSD 4 上，將回應頭和檔案開頭放在一個資料包中發送。 *;
-   sending a file in full packets.  
    將文件分包發送。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**try_files** `*file*` ... `*uri*`;``<br>``**try_files** `*file*` ... =`*code*`;``<br>` `**try_files** ` *檔案* ` ... ` *uri* `;``<br>``**try_files** ` *檔案* ` ... =` *程式碼* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location` |

Checks the existence of files in the specified order and uses the first found file for request processing; the processing is performed in the current context. The path to a file is constructed from the `*file*` parameter according to the [root](#p-056) and [alias](#p-056) directives. It is possible to check directory’s existence by specifying a slash at the end of a name, e.g. “`$uri/`”. If none of the files were found, an internal redirect to the `*uri*` specified in the last parameter is made. For example:

按指定順序檢查文件是否存在，並使用找到的第一個文件進行請求處理；處理在目前上下文中執行。檔案路徑根據 [root](#p-056)和 [alias](#p-056)指令，由`*file*`參數建構。可以透過在名稱末尾加上斜線來檢查目錄是否存在，例如「 `$uri/` 」。如果未找到任何文件，則會進行內部重定向，指向最後一個參數中指定的`*uri*` 。例如：

> ```
> location /images/ {
>
> 位置/圖像/ {
>     try_files $uri /images/default.gif;
> }
> 
> location = /images/default.gif {
>     expires 30s;
>
>     有效期限30秒；
> }
> ```

The last parameter can also point to a named location, as shown in examples below. Starting from version 0.7.51, the last parameter can also be a `*code*`:

最後一個參數也可以指向一個命名位置，如下例所示。從版本0.7.51開始，最後一個參數也可以是`*code*` ：

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     try_files $uri $uri/index.html $uri.html =404;
> }
> ```

Example in proxying Mongrel:

Mongrel 代理範例：

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     try_files /system/maintenance.html
>
>     嘗試檔案 /system/maintenance.html
>               $uri $uri/index.html $uri.html
>
>               $url $url/index.html $url.html
>               @mongrel;
>
>               @mongrel；
> }
> 
> location @mongrel {
>
> 位置 @mongrel {
>     proxy_pass http://mongrel;
> }
> ```

Example for Drupal/FastCGI:

Drupal/FastCGI 範例：

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     try_files $uri $uri/ @drupal;
> }
> 
> location ~ \.php$ {
>     try_files $uri @drupal;
> 
>     fastcgi_pass ...;
> 
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /path/to$fastcgi_script_name;
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_NAME     $fastcgi_script_name;
>
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_NAME $fastcgi_script_name;
>     fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING    $args;
>
>     fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING $args;
> 
>     ... other fastcgi_param's
>
>     ……其他 fastcgi_param 參數
> }
> 
> location @drupal {
>
> 位置 @drupal {
>     fastcgi_pass ...;
> 
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /path/to/index.php;
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_NAME     /index.php;
>
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_NAME /index.php;
>     fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING    q=$uri&$args;
>
>     fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING q=$uri&$args;
> 
>     ... other fastcgi_param's
>
>     ……其他 fastcgi_param 參數
> }
> ```

In the following example,

在以下範例中，

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     try_files $uri $uri/ @drupal;
> }
> ```

the `try_files` directive is equivalent to

`try_files`指令等同於

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     error_page 404 = @drupal;
>     log_not_found off;
>
>     未找到日誌已關閉；
> }
> ```

And here,

還有這裡，

> ```
> location ~ \.php$ {
>     try_files $uri @drupal;
> 
>     fastcgi_pass ...;
> 
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /path/to$fastcgi_script_name;
> 
>     ...
> }
> ```

`try_files` checks the existence of the PHP file before passing the request to the FastCGI server.

`try_files`在將請求傳遞給 FastCGI 伺服器之前，檢查PHP檔案是否存在。

Example for Wordpress and Joomla:

WordPress 和 Joomla 的範例：

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     try_files $uri $uri/ @wordpress;
> }
> 
> location ~ \.php$ {
>     try_files $uri @wordpress;
> 
>     fastcgi_pass ...;
> 
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /path/to$fastcgi_script_name;
>     ... other fastcgi_param's
>
>     ……其他 fastcgi_param 參數
> }
> 
> location @wordpress {
>     fastcgi_pass ...;
> 
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /path/to/index.php;
>     ... other fastcgi_param's
>
>     ……其他 fastcgi_param 參數
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>types<br>型</strong> { ... }</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>types { text/html  html; image/gif  gif; image/jpeg jpg; }<br>類型 { text/html html; image/gif gif; image/jpeg jpg; }</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Maps file name extensions to MIME types of responses. Extensions are case-insensitive. Several extensions can be mapped to one type, for example:

將檔案副檔名對應到MIME類型的回應。擴展名不區分大小寫。多個擴展名可以映射到一種類型，例如：

> ```
> types {
>
> 類型 {
>     application/octet-stream bin exe dll;
>     application/octet-stream deb;
>     application/octet-stream dmg;
> }
> ```

A sufficiently full mapping table is distributed with nginx in the `conf/mime.types` file.

nginx 隨附的`conf/mime.types`檔案中包含一個足夠完整的映射表。

To make a particular location emit the “`application/octet-stream`” MIME type for all requests, the following configuration can be used:

若要讓特定位置對所有請求發出「 `application/octet-stream` 」 MIME類型，可以使用下列設定：

> ```
> location /download/ {
>
> 位置/下載/ {
>     types        { }
>
>     類型 { }
>     default_type application/octet-stream;
>
>     預設類型 application/octet-stream;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>types_hash_bucket_size<br>型_哈希桶_大小</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>types_hash_bucket_size 64;<br>types_hash_bucket_size 64；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the bucket size for the types hash tables. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定哈希表類型的桶大小。有關設定哈希表的詳細信息，請參閱單獨的[文檔](#p-040) 。

> Prior to version 1.5.13, the default value depended on the size of the processor’s cache line.
>
> 在版本1.5.13之前，預設值取決於處理器快取行的大小。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>types_hash_max_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>types_hash_max_size 1024;<br>types_hash_max_size 1024；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum `*size*` of the types hash tables. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定哈希表類型的最大值`*size*` 。有關設定哈希表的詳細信息，請參閱單獨的[文檔](#p-040) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>underscores_in_headers<br>標頭中的下劃線</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>underscores_in_headers off;<br>關閉標題中的底線；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables the use of underscores in client request header fields. When the use of underscores is disabled, request header fields whose names contain underscores are marked as invalid and become subject to the [ignore\_invalid\_headers](#p-056) directive.

啟用或停用客戶端請求標頭欄位中的下劃線。停用底線後，名稱包含底線的請求標頭欄位將被標記為無效，並受 [ignore\_invalid\_headers](#p-056)指令的約束。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-056) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-056)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>variables_hash_bucket_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>variables_hash_bucket_size 64;<br>variables_hash_bucket_size 64；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the bucket size for the variables hash table. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定變數哈希表的桶大小。有關設定哈希表的詳細信息，請參閱單獨的[文檔](#p-040) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>variables_hash_max_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>variables_hash_max_size 1024;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum `*size*` of the variables hash table. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定變數哈希表的最大值`*size*` 。設定哈希表的詳細資訊在單獨的[文件](#p-040)中提供。

> Prior to version 1.5.13, the default value was 512.
>
> 在版本1.5.13之前，預設值為512。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_core_module` module supports embedded variables with names matching the Apache Server variables. First of all, these are variables representing client request header fields, such as `$http_user_agent`, `$http_cookie`, and so on. Also there are other variables:

`ngx_http_core_module`模組支援嵌入變量，其名稱與 Apache 伺服器變數的名稱相符。首先，這些變數表示客戶端請求頭字段，例如`$http_user_agent`, `$http_cookie`等。此外，還有其他變數：

`$arg_``*name*`

argument `*name*` in the request line

請求行中的參數`*name*`

`$args`

arguments in the request line

請求行中的參數

`$binary_remote_addr`

client address in a binary form, value’s length is always 4 bytes for IPv4 addresses or 16 bytes for IPv6 addresses

客戶端位址，以二進位形式表示，IPv4 位址的長度始終為 4 位元組，IPv6 位址的長度始終為 16 位元組。

`$body_bytes_sent`

number of bytes sent to a client, not counting the response header; this variable is compatible with the “`%B`” parameter of the `mod_log_config` Apache module

傳送給客戶端的位元組數，不包括回應頭；此變數與 Apache 模組`mod_log_config`的「 `%B` 」參數相容。

`$bytes_sent`

number of bytes sent to a client (1.3.8, 1.2.5)

傳送給客戶端的位元組數（ 1.3.8, 1.2.5 ）

`$connection`

connection serial number (1.3.8, 1.2.5)

連接序號（ 1.3.8, 1.2.5 ）

`$connection_requests`

current number of requests made through a connection (1.3.8, 1.2.5)

目前透過連線發出的請求數 ( 1.3.8, 1.2.5 )

`$connection_time`

connection time in seconds with a milliseconds resolution (1.19.10)

連接時間（以秒為單位，精確到毫秒）( 1.19.10 )

`$content_length`

“Content-Length”（內容長度） request header field

“Content-Length”（內容長度）請求頭字段

`$content_type`

“Content-Type”（內容類型） request header field

“Content-Type”（內容類型）請求頭字段

`$cookie_``*name*`

the `*name*` cookie

`*name*` cookie

`$document_root`

[root](#p-056) or [alias](#p-056) directive’s value for the current request

[root](#p-056)或 [alias](#p-056)指令的目前請求值

`$document_uri`

same as `$uri`

與`$uri`相同

`$host`

in this order of precedence: host name from the request line, or host name from the “Host”（主持人） request header field, or the server name matching a request

依下列優先順序：請求行中的主機名，或“Host”（主持人）請求頭欄位中的主機名，或與請求相符的伺服器名稱

`$hostname`

host name

主機名稱

`$http_``*name*`

arbitrary request header field; the last part of a variable name is the field name converted to lower case with dashes replaced by underscores

任意請求頭字段；變數名的最後一部分是字段名，轉換為小寫，並將連字符替換為下劃線。

`$https`

“`on`” if connection operates in SSL mode, or an empty string otherwise

如果連接以SSL模式運行，則為“ `on` ”，否則為空字串。

`$is_args`

“`?`” if a request line has arguments, or an empty string otherwise

如果請求行包含參數，則為“ `?` ”，否則為空字串。

`$is_request_port`

“`:`” if [$request\_port](#p-056) is non-empty, or an empty string otherwise (1.29.3)

若 [$request\_port](#p-056)非空，則為“ `:` ”，否則為空字串（ 1.29.3 ）。

`$limit_rate`

setting this variable enables response rate limiting; see [limit\_rate](#p-056)

設定此變數可啟用回應速率限制；請參閱 [limit\_rate](#p-056)

`$msec`

current time in seconds with the milliseconds resolution (1.3.9, 1.2.6)

當前時間（以秒為單位，精確度為毫秒）( 1.3.9, 1.2.6 )

`$nginx_version`

nginx version

nginx 版本

`$pid`

PID of the worker process

PID工作進程

`$pipe`

“`p`” if request was pipelined, “`.`” otherwise (1.3.12, 1.2.7)

如果請求已透過管道處理，則為“ `p` ”，否則為“ `.` ”（ 1.3.12, 1.2.7 ）。

`$proxy_protocol_addr`

client address from the PROXY protocol header (1.5.12)

來自PROXY協定頭的客戶端位址 ( 1.5.12 )

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-056) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-056)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$proxy_protocol_port`

client port from the PROXY protocol header (1.11.0)

來自PROXY協定頭的客戶端連接埠 ( 1.11.0 )

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-056) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-056)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$proxy_protocol_server_addr`

server address from the PROXY protocol header (1.17.6)

來自PROXY協定頭的伺服器位址 ( 1.17.6 )

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-056) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-056)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$proxy_protocol_server_port`

server port from the PROXY protocol header (1.17.6)

來自PROXY協定頭的伺服器連接埠 ( 1.17.6 )

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-056) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-056)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$proxy_protocol_tlv_``*name*`

TLV from the PROXY Protocol header (1.23.2). The `name` can be a TLV type name or its numeric value. In the latter case, the value is hexadecimal and should be prefixed with `0x`:

來自 PROXY 協議頭 (1.23.2) 的TLV。 `name` 可以是TLV 型別名稱或其數值。在後一種情況下，該值是十六進制的，並且應以 `0x` 為前綴：

> ```
> $proxy_protocol_tlv_alpn
> $proxy_protocol_tlv_0x01
> ```

SSL TLVs can also be accessed by TLV type name or its numeric value, both prefixed by `ssl_`:

SSL TLV 也可以透過TLV類型名稱或其數值來訪問，兩者都以`ssl_`為前綴：

> ```
> $proxy_protocol_tlv_ssl_version
> $proxy_protocol_tlv_ssl_0x21
> ```

The following TLV type names are supported:

支援以下TLV類型名稱：

-   `alpn` (`0x01`) - upper layer protocol used over the connection  
    `alpn` ( `0x01` ) - 連接上使用的上層協議
-   `authority` (`0x02`) - host name value passed by the client  
    `authority` ( `0x02` ) - 用戶端傳遞的主機名稱值
-   `unique_id` (`0x05`) - unique connection id  
    `unique_id` ( `0x05` ) - 唯一連接 ID
-   `netns` (`0x30`) - name of the namespace  
    `netns` ( `0x30` ) - 命名空間名稱
-   `ssl` (`0x20`) - binary SSL TLV structure  
    `ssl` ( `0x20` ) - 二元SSL TLV結構

The following SSL TLV type names are supported:

支援以下SSL TLV類型名稱：

-   `ssl_version` (`0x21`) - SSL version used in client connection  
    `ssl_version` ( `0x21` ) - SSL版本用於客戶端連接
-   `ssl_cn` (`0x22`) - SSL certificate Common Name  
    `ssl_cn` ( `0x22` ) - SSL證書通用名稱
-   `ssl_cipher` (`0x23`) - name of the used cipher  
    `ssl_cipher` ( `0x23` ) - 所用密碼的名稱
-   `ssl_sig_alg` (`0x24`) - algorithm used to sign the certificate  
    `ssl_sig_alg` ( `0x24` ) - 用於簽署證書的演算法
-   `ssl_key_alg` (`0x25`) - public-key algorithm  
    `ssl_key_alg` ( `0x25` ) - 公鑰演算法

Also, the following special SSL TLV type name is supported:

此外，也支援以下特殊型別名稱SSL TLV ：

-   `ssl_verify` - client SSL certificate verification result, `0` if the client presented a certificate and it was successfully verified, non-zero otherwise.  
    `ssl_verify` - 用戶端SSL憑證驗證結果， `0`如果客戶端提供了憑證並且驗證成功，則為非零值，否則為非零值。

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-056) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-056)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$query_string`

same as `$args`

與`$args`相同

`$realpath_root`

an absolute pathname corresponding to the [root](#p-056) or [alias](#p-056) directive’s value for the current request, with all symbolic links resolved to real paths

與目前請求的 [root](#p-056)或 [alias](#p-056)指令值對應的絕對路徑名，所有符號連結均解析為實際路徑。

`$remote_addr`

client address

客戶地址

`$remote_port`

client port

客戶端連接埠

`$remote_user`

user name supplied with the Basic authentication

使用基本驗證提供的使用者名稱

`$request`

full original request line

完整原始請求行

`$request_body`

request body

請求體

The variable’s value is made available in locations processed by the [proxy\_pass](#p-085), [fastcgi\_pass](#p-060), [uwsgi\_pass](#p-107), and [scgi\_pass](#p-091) directives when the request body was read to a [memory buffer](#p-056).

此變數的值在 [proxy\_pass] 處理的位置中可用。(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_pass)[fastcgi\_pass](#p-060), [uwsgi\_pass](#p-107)，以及 [scgi\_pass](#p-091) 當請求體被讀取到[記憶體緩衝區時執行的指令](#p-056).

`$request_body_file`

name of a temporary file with the request body

請求正文的臨時檔名

At the end of processing, the file needs to be removed. To always write the request body to a file, [client\_body\_in\_file\_only](#p-056) needs to be enabled. When the name of a temporary file is passed in a proxied request or in a request to a FastCGI/uwsgi/SCGI server, passing the request body should be disabled by the [proxy\_pass\_request\_body off](#p-085), [fastcgi\_pass\_request\_body off](#p-060), [uwsgi\_pass\_request\_body off](#p-107), or [scgi\_pass\_request\_body off](#p-091) directives, respectively.

處理結束後，需要刪除該檔案。若要始終將請求體寫入文件，則需要啟用 [client\_body\_in\_file\_only](#p-056) 。當代理請求或向 FastCGI/uwsgi/ SCGI伺服器發送請求時，如果傳遞的是臨時檔案名，則應分別使用 [proxy\_pass\_request\_body off](#p-085) 、[fastcgi\_pass\_request\_body (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_fastcgi_module.html#fastcgi_pass_request_body) off](#p-107)或 [scgi\_pass\_request\_body off](#p-091)指令停用傳遞請求體。

`$request_completion`

“`OK`” if a request has completed, or an empty string otherwise

如果請求已完成，則傳回“ `OK` ”，否則傳回空字串。

`$request_filename`

file path for the current request, based on the [root](#p-056) or [alias](#p-056) directives, and the request URI

根據 [root](#p-056)或 [alias](#p-056)指令以及請求URI ，確定目前請求的檔案路徑。

`$request_id`

unique request identifier generated from 16 random bytes, in hexadecimal (1.11.0)

由 16 個隨機位元組產生的唯一請求標識符，十六進位格式為 ( 1.11.0 )

`$request_length`

request length (including request line, header, and request body) (1.3.12, 1.2.7)

請求長度（包括請求行、標頭和請求體）（ 1.3.12, 1.2.7 ）

`$request_method`

request method, usually “`GET`” or “`POST`”

請求方法，通常為“ `GET` ”或“ `POST` ”

`$request_port`

in this order of precedence: port number from the [URI](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110#section-4.2.1) authority component, or port number from the “Host”（主持人） request header field (1.29.3)

依下列優先順序：來自 [URI](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110#section-4.2.1)授權組件的連接埠號，或來自“Host”（主持人）請求頭字段的連接埠號碼 ( 1.29.3 )

`$request_time`

request processing time in seconds with a milliseconds resolution (1.3.9, 1.2.6); time elapsed since the first bytes were read from the client

請求處理時間（以秒為單位，精確到毫秒）（ 1.3.9, 1.2.6 ）；自客戶端讀取第一個字節以來經過的時間

`$request_uri`

full original request URI (with arguments)

完整原始請求URI （含論點）

`$scheme`

request scheme, “`http`” or “`https`”

請求方案，“ `http` ”或“ `https` ”

`$sent_http_``*name*`

arbitrary response header field; the last part of a variable name is the field name converted to lower case with dashes replaced by underscores

任意回應頭字段；變數名的最後一部分是字段名，轉換為小寫，並將連字符替換為下劃線。

`$sent_trailer_``*name*`

arbitrary field sent at the end of the response (1.13.2); the last part of a variable name is the field name converted to lower case with dashes replaced by underscores

回應末尾發送的任意字段（ 1.13.2 ）；變數名的最後一部分是字段名，轉換為小寫，並將連字符替換為下劃線。

`$server_addr`

an address of the server which accepted a request

接受請求的伺服器位址

Computing a value of this variable usually requires one system call. To avoid a system call, the [listen](#p-056) directives must specify addresses and use the `bind` parameter.

計算此變數的值通常需要一次系統呼叫。為避免系統調用，[listen](#p-056)指令必須指定位址並使用`bind`參數。

`$server_name`

name of the server which accepted a request

接受請求的伺服器名稱

`$server_port`

port of the server which accepted a request

接受請求的伺服器端口

`$server_protocol`

request protocol, usually “`HTTP/1.0`”, “`HTTP/1.1`”, “[HTTP/2.0](#p-108)”, or “[HTTP/3.0](#p-109)”

請求協議，通常為「 `HTTP/1.0` 」、「 `HTTP/1.1` 」、「[HTTP/2.0](#p-108) 」或「[HTTP/3.0](#p-109) 」。

`$status`

response status (1.3.2, 1.2.2)

響應狀態（ 1.3.2, 1.2.2 ）

`$tcpinfo_rtt`, `$tcpinfo_rttvar`, `$tcpinfo_snd_cwnd`, `$tcpinfo_rcv_space`

information about the client TCP connection; available on systems that support the `TCP_INFO` socket option

關於客戶端TCP連接的資訊；可在支援`TCP_INFO`套接字選項的系統上使用

`$time_iso8601`

local time in the ISO 8601 standard format (1.3.12, 1.2.7)

ISO 8601 標準格式的本地時間 ( 1.3.12, 1.2.7 )

`$time_iso8601_ms`

local time in the ISO 8601 standard format with a millisecond resolution (1.29.8)

以毫秒解析度表示的ISO 8601標準格式的本地時間（ 1.29.8 ）

> This variable is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此變數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`$time_local`

local time in the Common Log Format (1.3.12, 1.2.7)

通用日誌格式中的本地時間（ 1.3.12, 1.2.7 ）

`$uri`

current URI in request, [normalized](#p-056)

當前URI請求，[已規範化](#p-056)

The value of `$uri` may change during request processing, e.g. when doing internal redirects, or when using index files.

`$uri`的值可能會在請求處理期間發生變化，例如在進行內部重定向或使用索引檔案時。

<a id="p-057"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_dav_module｜模組 ngx_http_dav_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_dav_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_dav\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_dav\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-057)<br>[Directives](#p-057)<br>     [create\_full\_put\_path](#p-057)<br>     [dav\_access](#p-057)<br>     [dav\_methods](#p-057)<br>     [min\_delete\_depth](#p-057)<br>[範例設定](#p-057)<br>[指令](#p-057)<br>     [create\_full\_put\_path](#p-057)<br>     [dav \_access](#p-057)<br>     [dav\_methods](#p-057)<br>     [min\_delete\_深度](#p-057) |

The `ngx_http_dav_module` module is intended for file management automation via the WebDAV protocol. The module processes HTTP and WebDAV methods PUT, DELETE, MKCOL, COPY, and MOVE.

`ngx_http_dav_module`模組旨在透過 WebDAV 協定實現檔案管理自動化。此模組處理HTTP和 WebDAV 方法PUT, DELETE, MKCOL, COPY和MOVE 。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_dav_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_dav_module`配置參數啟用。

> WebDAV clients that require additional WebDAV methods to operate will not work with this module.
>
> 需要額外 WebDAV 方法才能運作的 WebDAV 用戶端將無法與此模組一起使用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     root                  /data/www;
>
>     根目錄 /data/www;
> 
>     client_body_temp_path /data/client_temp;
> 
>     dav_methods PUT DELETE MKCOL COPY MOVE;
>
>     dav_methods PUT DELETE MKCOL COPY MOVE ;
> 
>     create_full_put_path  on;
>
>     啟用 create_full_put_path；
>     dav_access            group:rw  all:r;
>
>     dav_access 群組：讀寫所有：讀寫；
> 
>     limit_except GET {
>         allow 192.168.1.0/32;
>
>         允許192.168.1.0/32 ；
>         deny  all;
>
>         全部否認；
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>create_full_put_path</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>create_full_put_path off;<br>create_full_put_path 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

The WebDAV specification only allows creating files in already existing directories. This directive allows creating all needed intermediate directories.

WebDAV規格僅允許在已存在的目錄中建立檔案。此指令允許建立所有必需的中間目錄。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>dav_access</strong> <code><i>users</i></code>:<code><i>permissions</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>dav_access user:rw;<br>dav_access 使用者：讀寫；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets access permissions for newly created files and directories, e.g.:

設定新檔案和目錄的存取權限，例如：

> ```
> dav_access user:rw group:rw all:r;
>
> dav_access 使用者：讀寫 群組：讀寫 所有：r；
> ```

If any `group` or `all` access permissions are specified then `user` permissions may be omitted:

如果指定了任何`group`或`all`存取權限，則可以省略`user`權限：

> ```
> dav_access group:rw all:r;
>
> dav_access 群組：讀寫所有：讀寫；
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>dav_methods</strong> <code>off<br>關閉</code> | <code><i>method<br>方法</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>dav_methods off;<br>dav_methods 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Allows the specified HTTP and WebDAV methods. The parameter `off` denies all methods processed by this module. The following methods are supported: `PUT`, `DELETE`, `MKCOL`, `COPY`, and `MOVE`.

允許指定的HTTP和 WebDAV 方法。參數`off`拒絕此模組處理的所有方法。支援以下方法： `PUT`, `DELETE`, `MKCOL`, `COPY`和`MOVE` 。

A file uploaded with the PUT method is first written to a temporary file, and then the file is renamed. Starting from version 0.8.9, temporary files and the persistent store can be put on different file systems. However, be aware that in this case a file is copied across two file systems instead of the cheap renaming operation. It is thus recommended that for any given location both saved files and a directory holding temporary files, set by the [client\_body\_temp\_path](#p-056) directive, are put on the same file system.

使用PUT方法上傳的文件會先寫入暫存文件，然後再重新命名。從0.8.9版本開始，暫存檔案和持久性儲存可以位於不同的檔案系統上。但是請注意，在這種情況下，檔案會被複製到兩個檔案系統上，而不是進行簡單的重新命名操作。因此，建議對於任何給定的位置，已儲存的檔案和由 [client\_body\_temp\_path](#p-056)指令設定的暫存檔案目錄都位於同一檔案系統上。

When creating a file with the PUT method, it is possible to specify the modification date by passing it in the “Date”（日期） header field.

使用PUT方法建立檔案時，可以透過在“Date”（日期）標頭欄位中傳遞來指定修改日期。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>min_delete_depth<br>最小刪除深度</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>min_delete_depth 0;<br>min_delete_depth 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Allows the DELETE method to remove files provided that the number of elements in a request path is not less than the specified number. For example, the directive

允許使用DELETE方法刪除文件，前提是請求路徑中的元素數量不少於指定的數量。例如，指令

> ```
> min_delete_depth 4;
>
> 最小刪除深度 4；
> ```

allows removing files on requests

允許根據請求刪除文件

> ```
> /users/00/00/name
> /users/00/00/name/pic.jpg
> /users/00/00/page.html
> ```

and denies the removal of

並否認移除

> ```
> /users/00/00
> ```

<a id="p-058"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_empty_gif_module｜模組 ngx_http_empty_gif_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_empty_gif_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_empty\_gif\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_empty\_gif\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-058)<br>[Directives](#p-058)<br>     [empty\_gif](#p-058)<br>[範例配置](#p-058)<br> [指令](#p-058)<br> [empty\_gif](#p-058) |

The `ngx_http_empty_gif_module` module emits single-pixel transparent GIF.

`ngx_http_empty_gif_module`模組發射單像素透明的GIF 。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location = /_.gif {
>     empty_gif;
>
>     空的gif；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**empty_gif**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location` |

Turns on module processing in a surrounding location.

開啟周圍位置的模組處理。

<a id="p-059"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_f4f_module｜模組 ngx_http_f4f_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_f4f_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_f4f\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_f4f\_模組

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-059)<br>[Directives](#p-059)<br>     [f4f](#p-059)<br>     [f4f\_buffer\_size](#p-059)<br>[範例配置](#p-059)<br> [指令](#p-059)<br> [f4f](#p-059)<br> [f4f_buffer_size](#p-059) |

The `ngx_http_f4f_module` module provides server-side support for Adobe HTTP Dynamic Streaming (HDS).

`ngx_http_f4f_module`模組為 Adob​​e HTTP動態串流媒體 ( HDS ) 提供伺服器端支援。

This module implements handling of HTTP Dynamic Streaming requests in the “`/videoSeg1-Frag1`” form — extracting the needed fragment from the `videoSeg1.f4f` file using the `videoSeg1.f4x` index file. This module is an alternative to the Adobe’s f4f module (HTTP Origin Module) for Apache.

該模組實現了對「 `/videoSeg1-Frag1` 」形式的HTTP流請求的處理——使用`videoSeg1.f4f`文件從文件中提取所需的片段。此模組是Adobe f4f模組（ HTTP模組）的替代方案`videoSeg1.f4x`適用於Apache伺服器。

Usual pre-processing with Adobe’s f4fpackager is required, see relevant documentation for details.

需要使用 Adob​​e 的 f4fpackager 進行常規預處理，詳情請參閱相關文件。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location /video/ {
>     f4f;
>     ...
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**f4f**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location` |

Turns on module processing in the surrounding location.

開啟周圍位置的模組處理。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>f4f_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>f4f_buffer_size 512k;<br>f4f_buffer_size 512k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading the `.f4x` index file.

設定用於讀取`.f4x`檔案的緩衝區的`*size*` 。
