###### Module ngx\_http\_fastcgi\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_fastcgi\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-060)<br>[Directives](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_allow\_upstream](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_bind](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_bind\_dynamic](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_buffering](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_buffers](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_busy\_buffers\_size](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_background\_update](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_bypass](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_key](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_lock](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_lock\_age](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_max\_range\_offset](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_methods](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_min\_uses](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_path](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_purge](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_revalidate](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_use\_stale](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_cache\_valid](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_catch\_stderr](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_connect\_timeout](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_force\_ranges](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_hide\_header](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_ignore\_client\_abort](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_index](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_intercept\_errors](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_keep\_conn](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_limit\_rate](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_next\_upstream](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_next\_upstream\_timeout](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_next\_upstream\_tries](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_no\_cache](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_param](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_pass](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_pass\_header](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_pass\_request\_body](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_read\_timeout](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_request\_buffering](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_request\_dynamic](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_send\_lowat](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_send\_timeout](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_socket\_keepalive](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_socket\_rcvbuf](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_socket\_sndbuf](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_split\_path\_info](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_store](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_store\_access](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-060)<br>     [fastcgi\_temp\_path](#p-060)<br>[Parameters Passed to a FastCGI Server](#p-060)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-060) |

The `ngx_http_fastcgi_module` module allows passing requests to a FastCGI server.

`ngx_http_fastcgi_module`模組允許向 FastCGI 伺服器傳遞請求。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點/{
>     fastcgi_pass  localhost:9000;
>
>     fastcgi_pass 本機：9000；
>     fastcgi_index index.php;
> 
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /home/www/scripts/php$fastcgi_script_name;
>     fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING    $query_string;
>
>     fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING $query_string;
>     fastcgi_param REQUEST_METHOD  $request_method;
>
>     fastcgi_param REQUEST_METHOD $request_method;
>     fastcgi_param CONTENT_TYPE    $content_type;
>
>     fastcgi_param CONTENT_TYPE $content_type;
>     fastcgi_param CONTENT_LENGTH  $content_length;
>
>     fastcgi_param CONTENT_LENGTH $content_length;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_allow_upstream** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**fastcgi_allow_upstream** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

Defines conditions under which access to a FastCGI server is allowed or [denied](#p-060). If all string parameters are not empty and not equal to “0” then the access is allowed. The conditions are evaluated each time before a connection to a FastCGI server is established. Parameter values can contain variables:

定義允許或拒絕存取 FastCGI 伺服器的條件(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_fastcgi_module.html#denied) 。如果所有字串參數均不為空且不等於“0”，則允許存取。每次建立與 FastCGI 伺服器的連線之前都會評估這些條件。參數值可以包含變數：

> ```
> geo $upstream_last_addr $allow {
>     volatile;
>
>     易揮發的;
>     10.10.0.0/24        1;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     listen 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>     聽127.0.0.1:8080 ;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         fastcgi_pass           localhost:9000;
>
>         fastcgi_pass localhost:9000;
>         fastcgi_allow_upstream $allow;
>         ...
>     }
> }
> ```

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_bind** `*address*` [`transparent`] \| `off`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_bind** ` *地址* ` [`透明`] \| `關閉`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 0.8.22.

該指令出現在版本0.8.22 。

Makes outgoing connections to a FastCGI server originate from the specified local IP address with an optional port (1.11.2). Parameter value can contain variables (1.3.12). The special value `off` (1.3.12) cancels the effect of the `fastcgi_bind` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows the system to auto-assign the local IP address and port.

使發送至 FastCGI 伺服器的出站連線源自指定的本機位址IP ，並可選擇指定連接埠 ( 1.11.2 )。參數值可以包含變數 ( 1.3.12 )。特殊值`off` ( 1.3.12 ) 會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`fastcgi_bind`指令的效果，該指令允許系統自動分配本地位址和連接埠IP )。

The `transparent` parameter (1.11.0) allows outgoing connections to a FastCGI server originate from a non-local IP address, for example, from a real IP address of a client:

`transparent`參數 ( 1.11.0 ) 允許從非本地IP位址（例如，用戶端的真實IP位址）發出到 FastCGI 伺服器的出站連接：

> ```
> fastcgi_bind $remote_addr transparent;
> ```

In order for this parameter to work, it is usually necessary to run nginx worker processes with the [superuser](#p-125) privileges. On Linux it is not required (1.13.8) as if the `transparent` parameter is specified, worker processes inherit the `CAP_NET_RAW` capability from the master process. It is also necessary to configure kernel routing table to intercept network traffic from the FastCGI server.

為了使此參數生效，通常需要以 [superuser](#p-125)權限執行 nginx 工作進程。在 Linux 系統上則無需此權限 ( 1.13.8 )，因為如果指定了`transparent`參數，工作進程會從主進程繼承`CAP_NET_RAW`權限。此外，還需要配置內核路由表以攔截來自 FastCGI 伺服器的網路流量。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_bind_dynamic</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_bind_dynamic off;<br>fastcgi_bind_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

When enabled, makes the [bind](#p-060) operation at each connection attempt.

啟用後，每次連線嘗試時執行 [bind](#p-060)操作。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_buffer_size 4k|8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading the first part of the response received from the FastCGI server. This part usually contains a small response header; if it exceeds the buffer size, the response is considered [invalid](#p-060). By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform. It can be made smaller, however.

設定用於讀取從 FastCGI 伺服器收到的回應第一部分的緩衝區大小`*size*` 。這部分通常包含一個較小的響應頭；如果響應頭大小超過緩衝區大小，則該響應被視為無效（ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_fastcgi_module.html#invalid_header) ）。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台的不同，該大小為 4K 或 8K。不過，緩衝區大小可以減少。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_buffering</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_buffering on;<br>啟用 fastcgi_buffering；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.6.

該指令出現在版本1.5.6 。

Enables or disables buffering of responses from the FastCGI server.

啟用或停用 FastCGI 伺服器回應的緩衝。

When buffering is enabled, nginx receives a response from the FastCGI server as soon as possible, saving it into the buffers set by the [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060) and [fastcgi\_buffers](#p-060) directives. If the whole response does not fit into memory, a part of it can be saved to a [temporary file](#p-060) on the disk. Writing to temporary files is controlled by the [fastcgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-060) and [fastcgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-060) directives.

啟用緩衝後，nginx 會盡快從 FastCGI 伺服器接收回應，並將其儲存至由 `[fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060)和 `[fastcgi\_buffers](#p-060)指令設定的緩衝區中。如果整個回應無法放入內存，則可以將其一部分儲存到磁碟上的暫存檔案 `[temporary file](#p-060)中。寫入暫存檔案的動作由 `[fastcgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-060)和 `[fastcgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-060)指令控制。

When buffering is disabled, the response is passed to a client synchronously, immediately as it is received. nginx will not try to read the whole response from the FastCGI server. The maximum size of the data that nginx can receive from the server at a time is set by the [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060) directive.

停用緩衝後，回應會同步地立即傳遞給客戶端。 nginx 不會嘗試從 FastCGI 伺服器讀取整個回應。 nginx 一次可以從伺服器接收的最大資料大小由 [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060)指令設定。

Buffering can also be enabled or disabled by passing “`yes`” or “`no`” in the “X-Accel-Buffering” response header field. This capability can be disabled using the [fastcgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-060) directive.

也可以透過在“X-Accel-Buffering”響應頭字段中傳遞「 `yes` 」或「 `no` 」來啟用或停用緩衝。可使用 [fastcgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-060)指令停用此功能。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_buffers</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_buffers 8 4k|8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*number*` and `*size*` of the buffers used for reading a response from the FastCGI server, for a single connection. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform.

設定用於從 FastCGI 伺服器讀取回應的緩衝區`*number*`和`*size*` ，適用於單一連線。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台不同，該值可以是 4K 或 8K。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_busy_buffers_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_busy_buffers_size 8k|16k;<br>fastcgi_busy_buffers_size 8k|16k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

When [buffering](#p-060) of responses from the FastCGI server is enabled, limits the total `*size*` of buffers that can be busy sending a response to the client while the response is not yet fully read. In the meantime, the rest of the buffers can be used for reading the response and, if needed, buffering part of the response to a temporary file. By default, `*size*` is limited by the size of two buffers set by the [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060) and [fastcgi\_buffers](#p-060) directives.

啟用 FastCGI 伺服器回應的 [buffering](#p-060)功能後，會限制用於向客戶端發送回應的緩衝區總數`*size*` ，直到回應完全讀取完畢。在此期間，其餘緩衝區可用於讀取回應，並在需要時將部分回應緩衝到暫存檔案。預設情況下， `*size*`受限於 [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060)和 [fastcgi\_buffers](#p-060)指令設定的兩個緩衝區的大小。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_cache</strong> <code><i>zone</i></code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_cache off;<br>關閉 fastcgi_cache；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a shared memory zone used for caching. The same zone can be used in several places. Parameter value can contain variables (1.7.9). The `off` parameter disables caching inherited from the previous configuration level.

定義用於快取的共享記憶體區域。同一區域可以在多個地方使用。參數值可以包含變數(1.7.9)。 `off` 參數停用從先前配置等級繼承的快取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_cache_background_update</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_cache_background_update off;<br>fastcgi_cache_background_update 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.11.10.

該指令出現在版本1.11.10 。

Allows starting a background subrequest to update an expired cache item, while a stale cached response is returned to the client. Note that it is necessary to [allow](#p-060) the usage of a stale cached response when it is being updated.

允許啟動後台子請求來更新已過期的快取項，同時向客戶端傳回過時的快取回應。請注意，在更新快取項目時，必須允許使用過時的快取回應（請參閱(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_fastcgi_module.html#fastcgi_cache_use_stale_updating) ）。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_cache_bypass** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**fastcgi_cache_bypass** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines conditions under which the response will not be taken from a cache. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the response will not be taken from the cache:

定義不從快取中取得回應的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則不會從快取中取得回應：

> ```
> fastcgi_cache_bypass $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment;
>
> fastcgi_cache_bypass $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment；
> fastcgi_cache_bypass $http_pragma    $http_authorization;
>
> fastcgi_cache_bypass $http_pragma $http_authorization;
> ```

Can be used along with the [fastcgi\_no\_cache](#p-060) directive.

可與 [fastcgi\_no\_cache](#p-060)指令一起使用。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_cache_key** `*string*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_cache_key** ` *字串* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines a key for caching, for example

定義一個用於快取的鍵，例如

> ```
> fastcgi_cache_key localhost:9000$request_uri;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_cache_lock</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_cache_lock off;<br>fastcgi_cache_lock 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.12.

該指令出現在版本1.1.12 。

When enabled, only one request at a time will be allowed to populate a new cache element identified according to the [fastcgi\_cache\_key](#p-060) directive by passing a request to a FastCGI server. Other requests of the same cache element will either wait for a response to appear in the cache or the cache lock for this element to be released, up to the time set by the [fastcgi\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-060) directive.

啟用此功能後，每次只允許一個請求透過向 FastCGI 伺服器傳送請求來填入根據 [fastcgi\_cache\_key](#p-060)指令標識的新快取元素。對相同快取元素的其他請求將等待快取中出現回應或該元素的快取鎖定被釋放，直到 [fastcgi\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-060)指令設定的時間結束。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_cache_lock_age</strong> <code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_cache_lock_age 5s;<br>fastcgi_cache_lock_age 5s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.8.

該指令出現在版本1.7.8 。

If the last request passed to the FastCGI server for populating a new cache element has not completed for the specified `*time*`, one more request may be passed to the FastCGI server.

如果傳遞給 FastCGI 伺服器的用於填入新快取元素的最後一個請求在指定的`*time*`內尚未完成，則可以傳送另一個請求至 FastCGI 伺服器。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_cache_lock_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_cache_lock_timeout 5s;<br>fastcgi_cache_lock_timeout 5秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.12.

該指令出現在版本1.1.12 。

Sets a timeout for [fastcgi\_cache\_lock](#p-060). When the `*time*` expires, the request will be passed to the FastCGI server, however, the response will not be cached.

設定 [fastcgi\_cache\_lock](#p-060)的逾時時間。當`*time*`過期時，請求將傳遞到 FastCGI 伺服器，但回應不會被快取。

> Before 1.7.8, the response could be cached.
>
> 在1.7.8之前，響應可以被快取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**fastcgi_cache_max_range_offset** `*number*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_cache_max_range_offset** ` *數字* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.6.

該指令出現在版本1.11.6 。

Sets an offset in bytes for byte-range requests. If the range is beyond the offset, the range request will be passed to the FastCGI server and the response will not be cached.

設定位元組範圍請求的位元組偏移量。如果範圍超出偏移量，則範圍請求將傳遞給 FastCGI 伺服器，並且回應不會被快取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_cache_methods</strong> <code>GET</code> | <code>HEAD</code> | <code>POST</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_cache_methods GET HEAD;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.7.59.

該指令出現在版本0.7.59 。

If the client request method is listed in this directive then the response will be cached. “`GET`” and “`HEAD`” methods are always added to the list, though it is recommended to specify them explicitly. See also the [fastcgi\_no\_cache](#p-060) directive.

如果客戶端請求方法列在此指令中，則回應將被快取。 「 `GET` 」和「 `HEAD` 」方法總是會加入到清單中，但建議明確指定它們。另請參閱[fastcgi\_no\_cache](#p-060)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_cache_min_uses</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_cache_min_uses 1;<br>fastcgi_cache_min_uses 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*number*` of requests after which the response will be cached.

設定`*number*`請求數，超過該請求數後回應將被快取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**fastcgi_cache_path** `*path*` [`levels`=`*levels*`] [`use_temp_path`=`on`\|`off`] `keys_zone`=`*name*`:`*size*` [`inactive`=`*time*`] [`max_size`=`*size*`] [`min_free`=`*size*`] [`manager_files`=`*number*`] [`manager_sleep`=`*time*`] [`manager_threshold`=`*time*`] [`loader_files`=`*number*`] [`loader_sleep`=`*time*`] [`loader_threshold`=`*time*`] [`purger`=`on`\|`off`] [`purger_files`=`*number*`] [`purger_sleep`=`*time*`] [`purger_threshold`=`*time*`];``<br>``**fastcgi_cache_path** `*小路*` [`等級`=`*級別*`] [`使用臨時路徑`=`在`\|`離開`] `鑰匙區`=`*姓名*`:`*尺寸*` [`不活躍`=`*時間*`] [`最大尺寸`=`*尺寸*`] [`最小空閒`=`*尺寸*`] [`管理器文件`=`*數字*`] [`經理睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`經理閾值`=`*時間*`] [`載入器文件`=`*數字*`] [`載入器睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`載入器閾值`=`*時間*`] [`清除`=`在`\|`離開`] [`清除文件`=`*數字*`] [`清除睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`淨化閾值`=`*時間*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Sets the path and other parameters of a cache. Cache data are stored in files. Both the key and file name in a cache are a result of applying the MD5 function to the proxied URL. The `levels` parameter defines hierarchy levels of a cache: from 1 to 3, each level accepts values 1 or 2. For example, in the following configuration

設定快取的路徑和其他參數。快取資料儲存在文件中。快取中的金鑰和檔案名稱都是將MD5函數應用於代理URL的結果。 `levels`參數定義了快取的層次結構層級：從1到3，每個層級接受值1或2。例如，在以下配置中

> ```
> fastcgi_cache_path /data/nginx/cache levels=1:2 keys_zone=one:10m;
> ```

file names in a cache will look like this:

快取中的檔案名稱將如下所示：

> ```
> /data/nginx/cache/c/29/b7f54b2df7773722d382f4809d65029c
>
> /data/nginx/cache/c/29/ b7f54b2df7773722d382f4809d65029c
> ```

A cached response is first written to a temporary file, and then the file is renamed. Starting from version 0.8.9, temporary files and the cache can be put on different file systems. However, be aware that in this case a file is copied across two file systems instead of the cheap renaming operation. It is thus recommended that for any given location both cache and a directory holding temporary files are put on the same file system. A directory for temporary files is set based on the `use_temp_path` parameter (1.7.10). If this parameter is omitted or set to the value `on`, the directory set by the [fastcgi\_temp\_path](#p-060) directive for the given location will be used. If the value is set to `off`, temporary files will be put directly in the cache directory.

快取回應首先寫入臨時文件，然後重新命名該文件。從版本0.8.9開始，臨時檔案和快取可以位於不同的檔案系統上。但是請注意，在這種情況下，檔案會被複製到兩個檔案系統上，而不是進行簡單的重新命名操作。因此，建議對於任何給定的位置，快取和存放臨時檔案的目錄都位於同一檔案系統上。暫存檔案目錄的設定是基於`use_temp_path`參數（ 1.7.10 ）。如果省略此參數或將其設為`on` ，則將使用 [fastcgi\_temp\_path](#p-060)指令為給定位置設定的目錄。如果將其設定為`off` ，則暫存檔案將直接放置在快取目錄中。

In addition, all active keys and information about data are stored in a shared memory zone, whose `*name*` and `*size*` are configured by the `keys_zone` parameter. One megabyte zone can store about 8 thousand keys.

此外，所有活動金鑰和資料資訊都儲存在一個共享記憶體區域中，該區域的`*name*`和`*size*`由`keys_zone`參數配置。一個兆位元組的區域大約可以儲存8000個密鑰。

> As part of [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx), the shared memory zone also stores extended cache [information](#p-048), thus, it is required to specify a larger zone size for the same number of keys. For example, one megabyte zone can store about 4 thousand keys.
>
> 作為[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，共享記憶體區域也會儲存擴充快取[資訊](#p-048) ，因此，對於相同數量的鍵，需要指定更大的區域大小。例如，1兆位元組的區域大約可以儲存4000個鍵。

Cached data that are not accessed during the time specified by the `inactive` parameter get removed from the cache regardless of their freshness. By default, `inactive` is set to 10 minutes.

在`inactive`參數指定的時間內未存取的快取資料將從快取中刪除，無論其新鮮度為何。預設情況下，`inactive` 設定為 10 分鐘。

The special “cache manager” process monitors the maximum cache size set by the `max_size` parameter, and the minimum amount of free space set by the `min_free` (1.19.1) parameter on the file system with cache. When the size is exceeded or there is not enough free space, it removes the least recently used data. The data is removed in iterations configured by `manager_files`, `manager_threshold`, and `manager_sleep` parameters (1.11.5). During one iteration no more than `manager_files` items are deleted (by default, 100). The duration of one iteration is limited by the `manager_threshold` parameter (by default, 200 milliseconds). Between iterations, a pause configured by the `manager_sleep` parameter (by default, 50 milliseconds) is made.

特殊的「快取管理器」程序會監控由`max_size`參數設定的最大快取大小，以及由`min_free` （ 1.19.1 ）參數設定的檔案系統快取的最小可用空間。當快取大小超過限製或可用空間不足時，它會刪除最近最少使用的資料。資料刪除的迭代次數由`manager_files`, `manager_threshold`和`manager_sleep`參數（ 1.11.5 ）配置。每次迭代最多刪除`manager_files`個項目（預設值為100）。每次迭代的持續時間由`manager_threshold`參數限制（預設值為200毫秒）。在兩次迭代之間，會執行由`manager_sleep`參數配置的暫停（預設值為50毫秒）。

A minute after the start the special “cache loader” process is activated. It loads information about previously cached data stored on file system into a cache zone. The loading is also done in iterations. During one iteration no more than `loader_files` items are loaded (by default, 100). Besides, the duration of one iteration is limited by the `loader_threshold` parameter (by default, 200 milliseconds). Between iterations, a pause configured by the `loader_sleep` parameter (by default, 50 milliseconds) is made.

啟動一分鐘後，特殊的「快取載入器」進程將會啟動。它會將先前儲存在檔案系統中的快取資料資訊載入到快取區域。載入過程也以迭代方式進行。每次迭代最多載入`loader_files`個項目（預設值為100）。此外，每次迭代的持續時間由`loader_threshold`參數限制（預設值為200毫秒）。在兩次迭代之間，會執行由`loader_sleep`參數配置的暫停（預設值為50毫秒）。

Additionally, the following parameters are available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx):

此外，以下參數包含在我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)中：

`purger`\=`on`|`off`

Instructs whether cache entries that match a [wildcard key](#p-060) will be removed from the disk by the cache purger (1.7.12). Setting the parameter to `on` (default is `off`) will activate the “cache purger” process that permanently iterates through all cache entries and deletes the entries that match the wildcard key.

指示是否由快取清除程序 ( 1.7.12 ) 從磁碟中刪除與 [通配符鍵](#p-060)相符的快取條目。將此參數設為`on` （預設值為`off` ）將啟動“快取清除程序”，該程式會永久遍歷所有快取條目並刪除與通配符鍵相符的條目。

`purger_files`\=`*number*`

Sets the number of items that will be scanned during one iteration (1.7.12). By default, `purger_files` is set to 10.

設定一次迭代中要掃描的物品數量（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_files`設定為 10。

`purger_threshold`\=`*number*`

Sets the duration of one iteration (1.7.12). By default, `purger_threshold` is set to 50 milliseconds.

設定一次迭代的持續時間（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_threshold`設定為 50 毫秒。

`purger_sleep`\=`*number*`

Sets a pause between iterations (1.7.12). By default, `purger_sleep` is set to 50 milliseconds.

設定迭代之間的暫停時間（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_sleep`設定為 50 毫秒。

> In versions 1.7.3, 1.7.7, and 1.11.10 cache header format has been changed. Previously cached responses will be considered invalid after upgrading to a newer nginx version.
>
> 在版本1.7.3, 1.7.7和1.11.10中，快取頭格式已變更。升級到更新的nginx版本後，先前快取的回應將被視為無效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**fastcgi_cache_purge** string ...;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Defines conditions under which the request will be considered a cache purge request. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the cache entry with a corresponding [cache key](#p-060) is removed. The result of successful operation is indicated by returning the 204 (No Content) response.

定義請求被視為快取清除請求的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則會刪除具有對應 [快取鍵](#p-060)的快取條目。操作成功後，將返回 204（無內容）回應。

If the [cache key](#p-060) of a purge request ends with an asterisk (“`*`”), all cache entries matching the wildcard key will be removed from the cache. However, these entries will remain on the disk until they are deleted for either [inactivity](#p-060), or processed by the [cache purger](#p-060) (1.7.12), or a client attempts to access them.

如果清除請求的 [快取鍵](#p-060)以星號 (“ `*` ”) 結尾，則所有與該通配符鍵相符的快取條目都會從快取中刪除。但是，這些條目將保留在磁碟上，直到因 [不活動](#p-060)而被刪除，或被 [快取清除程序](#p-060) ( 1.7.12 ) 處理，或用戶端嘗試存取它們為止。

Example configuration:

設定範例：

> ```
> fastcgi_cache_path /data/nginx/cache keys_zone=cache_zone:10m;
> 
> map $request_method $purge_method {
>
> 映射 $request_method $purge_method {
>     PURGE   1;
>     default 0;
>
>     預設值為 0；
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器{
>     ...
>     location / {
>
>     地點/{
>         fastcgi_pass        backend;
>
>         fastcgi_pass 後端；
>         fastcgi_cache       cache_zone;
>
>         fastcgi_cache 快取區；
>         fastcgi_cache_key   $uri;
>
>         fastcgi_cache_key $uri;
>         fastcgi_cache_purge $purge_method;
>     }
> }
> ```

> This functionality is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此功能作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_cache_revalidate</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_cache_revalidate off;<br>fastcgi_cache_revalidate 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Enables revalidation of expired cache items using conditional requests with the “If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自） and “If-None-Match”（如果無匹配） header fields.

允許使用帶有“If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自）和“If-None-Match”（如果無匹配）標頭欄位的條件請求重新驗證過期的快取項目。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_cache_use_stale</strong> <code>error<br>錯誤</code> | <code>timeout<br>暫停</code> | <code>invalid_header<br>無效標頭</code> | <code>updating<br>更新</code> | <code>http_500</code> | <code>http_503</code> | <code>http_403</code> | <code>http_404</code> | <code>http_429</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_cache_use_stale off;<br>fastcgi_cache_use_stale 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines in which cases a stale cached response can be used when an error occurs during communication with the FastCGI server. The directive’s parameters match the parameters of the [fastcgi\_next\_upstream](#p-060) directive.

確定在與 FastCGI 伺服器通訊期間發生錯誤時，哪些情況下可以使用過期的快取回應。此指令的參數與 [fastcgi\_next\_upstream](#p-060)指令的參數相符。

The `error` parameter also permits using a stale cached response if a FastCGI server to process a request cannot be selected.

如果無法選擇 FastCGI 伺服器來處理請求， `error`參數也允許使用過期的快取回應。

Additionally, the `updating` parameter permits using a stale cached response if it is currently being updated. This allows minimizing the number of accesses to FastCGI servers when updating cached data.

此外， `updating`參數允許在快取回應正在更新時使用過期的快取回應。這樣可以最大限度地減少更新快取資料時對 FastCGI 伺服器的存取次數。

Using a stale cached response can also be enabled directly in the response header for a specified number of seconds after the response became stale (1.11.10). This has lower priority than using the directive parameters.

在回應頭中可以直接啟用使用過期快取回應，並指定回應過期後的秒數（ 1.11.10 ）。此方法的優先權低於使用指令參數。

-   The “[stale-while-revalidate](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-3)” extension of the “Cache-Control”（快取控制） header field permits using a stale cached response if it is currently being updated.  
    「[stale-while-revalidate](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-3) 」 擴充的“Cache-Control”（快取控制）標頭欄位允許在目前正在更新時使用過期的快取回應。
-   The “[stale-if-error](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-4)” extension of the “Cache-Control”（快取控制） header field permits using a stale cached response in case of an error.  
    “Cache-Control”（快取控制）標頭字段的「[stale-if-error](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-4) 」擴充功能允許在發生錯誤時使用過期的快取回應。

To minimize the number of accesses to FastCGI servers when populating a new cache element, the [fastcgi\_cache\_lock](#p-060) directive can be used.

為了在填充新的快取元素時最大限度地減少對 FastCGI 伺服器的存取次數，可以使用 [fastcgi\_cache\_lock](#p-060)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_cache_valid** [`*code*` ...] `*time*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_cache_valid** [` *代碼* ` ...] ` *時間* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Sets caching time for different response codes. For example, the following directives

設定不同回應代碼的快取時間。例如，以下指令：

> ```
> fastcgi_cache_valid 200 302 10m;
> fastcgi_cache_valid 404      1m;
>
> fastcgi_cache_valid 404 1m;
> ```

set 10 minutes of caching for responses with codes 200 and 302 and 1 minute for responses with code 404.

對代碼為 200 和 302 的回應設定 10 分鐘的快取時間，對代碼為 404 的回應設定 1 分鐘的快取時間。

If only caching `*time*` is specified

如果僅指定快取`*time*`

> ```
> fastcgi_cache_valid 5m;
>
> fastcgi_cache_valid 5分鐘；
> ```

then only 200, 301, and 302 responses are cached.

那麼只有 200、301 和 302 回應會被快取。

In addition, the `any` parameter can be specified to cache any responses:

此外，也可以指定`any`參數來快取任何回應：

> ```
> fastcgi_cache_valid 200 302 10m;
> fastcgi_cache_valid 301      1h;
>
> fastcgi_cache_valid 301 1h;
> fastcgi_cache_valid any      1m;
>
> fastcgi_cache_valid 任意 1 分鐘；
> ```

Parameters of caching can also be set directly in the response header. This has higher priority than setting of caching time using the directive.

快取參數也可以直接在回應頭中設定。這種方法的優先權高於使用指令設定快取時間。

-   The “X-Accel-Expires” header field sets caching time of a response in seconds. The zero value disables caching for a response. If the value starts with the `@` prefix, it sets an absolute time in seconds since Epoch, up to which the response may be cached.  
    “X-Accel-Expires”標頭欄位用於設定回應的快取時間（以秒為單位）。值為零時，回應將被停用快取。如果該值以`@`前綴開頭，則表示該值設定了一個自 Unix 紀元以來的絕對時間（以秒為單位），在此時間範圍內，回應可以被快取。
-   If the header does not include the “X-Accel-Expires” field, parameters of caching may be set in the header fields “Expires”（過期） or “Cache-Control”（快取控制）.  
    如果標頭不包含“X-Accel-Expires”字段，則可以在標頭字段“Expires”（過期）或“Cache-Control”（快取控制）中設定快取參數。
-   If the header includes the “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） field, such a response will not be cached.  
    如果標頭包含“Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）字段，則此類回應將不會被快取。
-   If the header includes the “Vary”（各不相同） field with the special value “`*`”, such a response will not be cached (1.7.7). If the header includes the “Vary”（各不相同） field with another value, such a response will be cached taking into account the corresponding request header fields (1.7.7).  
    如果請求頭包含具有特殊值「 `*` 」的“Vary”（各不相同）字段，則該回應不會被快取（ 1.7.7 ）。如果請求頭包含具有其他值的“Vary”（各不相同）字段，則會根據對應的請求頭字段快取該回應（ 1.7.7 ）。

Processing of one or more of these response header fields can be disabled using the [fastcgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-060) directive.

可以使用 [fastcgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-060)指令來停用對一個或多個回應標頭欄位的處理。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_catch_stderr** `*string*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_catch_stderr** ` *字串* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Sets a string to search for in the error stream of a response received from a FastCGI server. If the `*string*` is found then it is considered that the FastCGI server has returned an [invalid response](#p-060). This allows handling application errors in nginx, for example:

設定一個字串，用於在從 FastCGI 伺服器收到的回應的錯誤流中搜尋。如果找到`*string*` ，則認為 FastCGI 伺服器回傳了 [無效回應](#p-060) 。這允許在 nginx 中處理應用程式錯誤，例如：

> ```
> location /php/ {
>     fastcgi_pass backend:9000;
>
>     fastcgi_pass 後端:9000;
>     ...
>     fastcgi_catch_stderr "PHP Fatal error";
>
>     fastcgi_catch_stderr " PHP致命錯誤";
>     fastcgi_next_upstream error timeout invalid_header;
>
>     fastcgi_next_upstream 錯誤逾時 invalid_header;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_connect_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_connect_timeout 60s;<br>fastcgi_connect_timeout 60s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for establishing a connection with a FastCGI server. It should be noted that this timeout cannot usually exceed 75 seconds.

定義與 FastCGI 伺服器建立連線的逾時時間。需要注意的是，此超時時間通常不能超過 75 秒。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_force_ranges</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_force_ranges off;<br>fastcgi_force_ranges 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.7.

該指令出現在版本1.7.7 。

Enables byte-range support for both cached and uncached responses from the FastCGI server regardless of the “Accept-Ranges”（接受範圍） field in these responses.

啟用對 FastCGI 伺服器快取和非快取回應的位元組範圍支持，而不管這些回應中的“Accept-Ranges”（接受範圍）欄位是什麼。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_hide_header** `*field*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_hide_header** ` *字段* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

By default, nginx does not pass the header fields “Status”（地位） and “X-Accel-...” from the response of a FastCGI server to a client. The `fastcgi_hide_header` directive sets additional fields that will not be passed. If, on the contrary, the passing of fields needs to be permitted, the [fastcgi\_pass\_header](#p-060) directive can be used.

預設情況下，nginx 不會將 FastCGI 伺服器回應中的標頭欄位 “Status”（地位） 和 “X-Accel-...” 傳遞給客戶端。 `fastcgi_hide_header`指令設定不會傳遞的附加欄位。相反，如果需要允許欄位傳遞，則可以使用 [fastcgi\_pass\_header](#p-060) 指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_ignore_client_abort</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_ignore_client_abort off;<br>fastcgi_ignore_client_abort 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether the connection with a FastCGI server should be closed when a client closes the connection without waiting for a response.

確定當客戶端在未等待回應的情況下關閉與 FastCGI 伺服器的連線時，是否應該關閉與 FastCGI 伺服器的連線。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**fastcgi_ignore_headers** `*field*` ...;``<br>` `**fastcgi_ignore_headers** ` *字段* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Disables processing of certain response header fields from the FastCGI server. The following fields can be ignored: “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）, “X-Accel-Expires”, “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） (1.1.6), “X-Accel-Buffering” (1.1.6), “X-Accel-Charset” (1.1.6), “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） (0.8.44), and “Vary”（各不相同） (1.7.7).

停用對 FastCGI 伺服器某些回應頭字段的處理。可忽略以下欄位1.1.6 “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）, “X-Accel-Expires”, “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） ( 1.1.6 )、 “X-Accel-Buffering” “X-Accel-Charset” 1.1.6 )、 “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） ( 0.8.44和“Vary”（各不相同） ( 1.7.7 )。

If not disabled, processing of these header fields has the following effect:

如果未停用，處理這些標頭欄位會產生以下效果：

-   “X-Accel-Expires”, “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）, and “Vary”（各不相同） set the parameters of response [caching](#p-060);  
    “X-Accel-Expires”, “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）和“Vary”（各不相同）設定響應 [快取](#p-060)的參數；
-   “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向） performs an [internal redirect](#p-056) to the specified URI;  
    “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）執行 [內部重定向](#p-056)到指定的URI ;
-   “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） sets the [rate limit](#p-056) for transmission of a response to a client;  
    “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率）設定向客戶端發送回應的 [速率限制](#p-056) ；
-   “X-Accel-Buffering” enables or disables [buffering](#p-060) of a response;  
    “X-Accel-Buffering”啟用或停用 [緩衝](#p-060)響應；
-   “X-Accel-Charset” sets the desired [charset](#p-055) of a response.  
    “X-Accel-Charset”設定響應的所需 [字元集](#p-055) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**fastcgi_index** `*name*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_index** ` *名稱* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Sets a file name that will be appended after a URI that ends with a slash, in the value of the `$fastcgi_script_name` variable. For example, with these settings

設定一個檔名，該檔名將附加到以斜線結尾的URI之後，作為`$fastcgi_script_name`變數的值。例如，使用這些設定

> ```
> fastcgi_index index.php;
> fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /home/www/scripts/php$fastcgi_script_name;
> ```

and the “`/page.php`” request, the `SCRIPT_FILENAME` parameter will be equal to “`/home/www/scripts/php/page.php`”, and with the “`/`” request it will be equal to “`/home/www/scripts/php/index.php`”.

對於“`/page.php`”請求，`SCRIPT_FILENAME`參數將等於“`/home/www/scripts/php/page.php`”，對於“`/`”請求，它將等於“`/home/www/scripts/php/index.php`”。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_intercept_errors</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_intercept_errors off;<br>fastcgi_intercept_errors 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether FastCGI server responses with codes greater than or equal to 300 should be passed to a client or be intercepted and redirected to nginx for processing with the [error\_page](#p-056) directive.

決定是否應將程式碼大於或等於 300 的 FastCGI 伺服器回應傳遞給客戶端，或攔截並重定向到 nginx 進行處理，使用 [error\_page](#p-056)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_keep_conn</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_keep_conn off;<br>fastcgi_keep_conn 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.4.

該指令出現在版本1.1.4 。

By default, a FastCGI server will close a connection right after sending the response. However, when this directive is set to the value `on`, nginx will instruct a FastCGI server to keep connections open. This is necessary, in particular, for [keepalive](#p-105) connections to FastCGI servers to function.

預設情況下，FastCGI 伺服器會在發送回應後立即關閉連線。但是，當此指令設定為值`on`時，nginx 會指示 FastCGI 伺服器保持連線開啟。這對於 [keepalive](#p-105)與 FastCGI 伺服器的連線正常運作尤其必要。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_limit_rate</strong> <code><i>rate</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_limit_rate 0;<br>fastcgi_limit_rate 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.7.

該指令出現在版本1.7.7 。

Limits the speed of reading the response from the FastCGI server. The `*rate*` is specified in bytes per second. The zero value disables rate limiting. The limit is set per a request, and so if nginx simultaneously opens two connections to the FastCFI server, the overall rate will be twice as much as the specified limit. The limitation works only if [buffering](#p-060) of responses from the FastCGI server is enabled. Parameter value can contain variables (1.27.0).

限制從 FastCGI 伺服器讀取回應的速度。 `*rate*` 以每秒位元組數指定。零值禁用速率限制。此限制是按請求設定的，因此如果 nginx 同時開啟兩個到 FastCFI 伺服器的連接，則整體速率將是指定限制的兩倍。僅當啟用 FastCGI 伺服器回應的[緩衝](#p-060) 時，此限制才會起作用。參數值可以包含變數(1.27.0)。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_max_temp_file_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_max_temp_file_size 1024m;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

When [buffering](#p-060) of responses from the FastCGI server is enabled, and the whole response does not fit into the buffers set by the [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060) and [fastcgi\_buffers](#p-060) directives, a part of the response can be saved to a temporary file. This directive sets the maximum `*size*` of the temporary file. The size of data written to the temporary file at a time is set by the [fastcgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-060) directive.

當啟用 FastCGI 伺服器回應的 [buffering](#p-060)功能時，如果整個回應無法放入 [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060)和 [fastcgi\_buffers](#p-060)指令設定的緩衝區中，則可以回應暫存。此指令設定臨時檔案的最大`*size*`大小。每次寫入暫存檔案的資料大小由 [fastcgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-060)指令設定。

The zero value disables buffering of responses to temporary files.

零值表示停用對暫存檔案的回應緩衝。

> This restriction does not apply to responses that will be [cached](#p-060) or [stored](#p-060) on disk.
>
> 此限制不適用於將被[快取](#p-060)或[儲存](#p-060)到磁碟的回應。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_next_upstream</strong> <code>error<br>錯誤</code> | <code>timeout<br>暫停</code> | <code>denied<br>否認</code> | <code>invalid_header<br>無效標頭</code> | <code>http_500</code> | <code>http_503</code> | <code>http_403</code> | <code>http_404</code> | <code>http_429</code> | <code>non_idempotent<br>不一樣</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_next_upstream error timeout;<br>fastcgi_next_upstream 錯誤逾時；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies in which cases a request should be passed to the next server:

指定在哪些情況下應將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器：

`error`

an error occurred while establishing a connection with the server, passing a request to it, or reading the response header;

與伺服器建立連線、向伺服器發送請求或讀取回應標頭時發生錯誤；

`timeout`

a timeout has occurred while establishing a connection with the server, passing a request to it, or reading the response header;

與伺服器建立連線、向伺服器發送請求或讀取回應標頭時發生逾時；

`denied`

the server [denied](#p-060) the connection (1.29.3);

伺服器[拒絕](#p-060)連線 ( 1.29.3 );

> This parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此參數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`invalid_header`

a server returned an empty or invalid response;

伺服器傳回了空響應或無效回應；

`http_500`

a server returned a response with the code 500;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 500 的回應；

`http_503`

a server returned a response with the code 503;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 503 的回應；

`http_403`

a server returned a response with the code 403;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 403 的回應；

`http_404`

a server returned a response with the code 404;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 404 的回應；

`http_429`

a server returned a response with the code 429 (1.11.13);

伺服器回傳了代碼為 429 的回應（ 1.11.13 ）；

`non_idempotent`

normally, requests with a [non-idempotent](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2) method (`POST`, `LOCK`, `PATCH`) are not passed to the next server if a request has been sent to an upstream server (1.9.13); enabling this option explicitly allows retrying such requests;

通常情況下，如果已向上游伺服器發送請求（ 1.9.13 ），則具有[非冪等](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2)方法（ `POST`, `LOCK`, `PATCH` ）的請求不會傳遞給下一個伺服器；明確啟用此選項允許重試此類請求；

`off`

disables passing a request to the next server.

禁用向下一個伺服器傳遞請求。

One should bear in mind that passing a request to the next server is only possible if nothing has been sent to a client yet. That is, if an error or timeout occurs in the middle of the transferring of a response, fixing this is impossible.

需要注意的是，只有在尚未向客戶端發送任何資料的情況下，才能將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器。也就是說，如果在傳輸回應的過程中發生錯誤或逾時，則無法修復。

The directive also defines what is considered an [unsuccessful attempt](#p-105) of communication with a server. The cases of `error`, `timeout`, `denied` and `invalid_header` are always considered unsuccessful attempts, even if they are not specified in the directive. The cases of `http_500`, `http_503`, and `http_429` are considered unsuccessful attempts only if they are specified in the directive. The cases of `http_403` and `http_404` are never considered unsuccessful attempts.

該指令也定義了與伺服器通訊的[不成功嘗試](#p-105)。 `error`, `timeout`, `denied` 和 `invalid_header` 的情況始終被視為不成功的嘗試，即使它們未在指令中指定。僅當指令中指定時，`http_500`, `http_503`和`http_429`的情況才被視為不成功的嘗試。 `http_403`和`http_404`的案例絕不被認為是不成功的嘗試。

Passing a request to the next server can be limited by [the number of tries](#p-060) and by [time](#p-060).

向下一個伺服器傳遞請求可以受到 [嘗試次數](#p-060)和 [時間](#p-060)的限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_next_upstream_timeout</strong> <code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_next_upstream_timeout 0;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.5.

該指令出現在版本1.7.5 。

Limits the time during which a request can be passed to the [next server](#p-060). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制請求可以傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-060)的時間。 `0` 值關閉此限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_next_upstream_tries</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_next_upstream_tries 0;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.5.

該指令出現在版本1.7.5 。

Limits the number of possible tries for passing a request to the [next server](#p-060). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制將請求傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-060)的可能嘗試次數。 `0` 值關閉此限制。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_no_cache** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**fastcgi_no_cache** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines conditions under which the response will not be saved to a cache. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the response will not be saved:

定義回應不保存到快取的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則回應將不會被儲存：

> ```
> fastcgi_no_cache $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment;
>
> fastcgi_no_cache $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment；
> fastcgi_no_cache $http_pragma    $http_authorization;
>
> fastcgi_no_cache $http_pragma $http_authorization;
> ```

Can be used along with the [fastcgi\_cache\_bypass](#p-060) directive.

可與 [fastcgi\_cache\_bypass](#p-060)指令一起使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_param</strong> <code><i>parameter<br>參數</i></code> <code><i>value<br>值</i></code> [<code>if_not_empty<br></code>];<br></code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_param HTTP_HOST $host$is_request_port$request_port;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a `*parameter*` that should be passed to the FastCGI server. The `*value*` can contain text, variables, and their combination. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `fastcgi_param` directives defined on the current level.

設定要傳遞給 FastCGI 伺服器的`*parameter*`可以包含文字、變數及其組合。僅噹噹前設定等級未定義`fastcgi_param`指令時`*value*`這些指令才會從上一個設定等級繼承。

The following example shows the minimum required settings for PHP:

以下範例顯示了PHP的最低所需設定：

> ```
> fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /home/www/scripts/php$fastcgi_script_name;
> fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING    $query_string;
>
> fastcgi_param QUERY_STRING $query_string;
> ```

The `SCRIPT_FILENAME` parameter is used in PHP for determining the script name, and the `QUERY_STRING` parameter is used to pass request parameters.

`SCRIPT_FILENAME`參數用於PHP中，以決定腳本名稱， `QUERY_STRING`參數用於傳遞請求參數。

For scripts that process `POST` requests, the following three parameters are also required:

對於處理`POST`請求的腳本，還需要以下三個參數：

> ```
> fastcgi_param REQUEST_METHOD  $request_method;
>
> fastcgi_param REQUEST_METHOD $request_method;
> fastcgi_param CONTENT_TYPE    $content_type;
>
> fastcgi_param CONTENT_TYPE $content_type;
> fastcgi_param CONTENT_LENGTH  $content_length;
>
> fastcgi_param CONTENT_LENGTH $content_length;
> ```

If PHP was built with the `--enable-force-cgi-redirect` configuration parameter, the `REDIRECT_STATUS` parameter should also be passed with the value “200”:

如果PHP是使用`--enable-force-cgi-redirect`配置參數建構的，則也應傳遞`REDIRECT_STATUS`參數，其值為「200」：

> ```
> fastcgi_param REDIRECT_STATUS 200;
> ```

If the directive is specified with `if_not_empty` (1.1.11) then such a parameter will be passed to the server only if its value is not empty:

如果指令使用`if_not_empty` ( 1.1.11 ) 指定，則只有當該參數的值不為空時，才會將其傳遞給伺服器：

> ```
> fastcgi_param HTTPS           $https if_not_empty;
>
> fastcgi_param HTTPS $https if_not_empty;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_pass** `*address*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_pass** ` *地址* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location`, `if in location` |

Sets the address of a FastCGI server. The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, and a port:

設定 FastCGI 伺服器的位址。位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，以及連接埠號碼：

> ```
> fastcgi_pass localhost:9000;
> ```

or as a UNIX-domain socket path:

或作為UNIX域套接字路徑：

> ```
> fastcgi_pass unix:/tmp/fastcgi.socket;
> ```

If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be used in a round-robin fashion. In addition, an address can be specified as a [server group](#p-105).

如果一個網域解析到多個位址，則所有這些位址將以輪詢方式使用。此外，可以將位址指定為 [伺服器群組](#p-105) 。

Parameter value can contain variables. In this case, if an address is specified as a domain name, the name is searched among the described [server groups](#p-105), and, if not found, is determined using a [resolver](#p-056).

參數值可以包含變數。在這種情況下，如果將位址指定為域名，則會在所描述的 [伺服器群組](#p-105)中搜尋該名稱，如果找不到，則使用 [解析器](#p-056)進行確定。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_pass_header** `*field*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_pass_header** ` *字段* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Permits passing [otherwise disabled](#p-060) header fields from a FastCGI server to a client.

允許將 [其他情況下停用的](#p-060)標頭欄位從 FastCGI 伺服器傳遞到客戶端。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_pass_request_body</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_pass_request_body on;<br>fastcgi_pass_request_body 開啟；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether the original request body is passed to the FastCGI server. See also the [fastcgi\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-060) directive.

指示是否將原始請求體傳遞給 FastCGI 伺服器。另請參閱 [fastcgi\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-060)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_pass_request_headers</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_pass_request_headers on;<br>啟用 fastcgi_pass_request_headers;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether the header fields of the original request are passed to the FastCGI server. See also the [fastcgi\_pass\_request\_body](#p-060) directive.

指示是否將原始請求的標頭欄位傳遞給 FastCGI 伺服器。另請參閱 [fastcgi\_pass\_request\_body](#p-060)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_read_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_read_timeout 60s;<br>fastcgi_read_timeout 60s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for reading a response from the FastCGI server. The timeout is set only between two successive read operations, not for the transmission of the whole response. If the FastCGI server does not transmit anything within this time, the connection is closed.

定義從 FastCGI 伺服器讀取回應的逾時時間。此逾時時間僅設定在兩次連續讀取操作之間，而非整個回應的傳輸時間。如果 FastCGI 伺服器在此時間內未發送任何內容，則連線將關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_request_buffering</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_request_buffering on;<br>fastcgi_request_buffering 已啟用；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Enables or disables buffering of a client request body.

啟用或停用客戶端請求體的緩衝。

When buffering is enabled, the entire request body is [read](#p-056) from the client before sending the request to a FastCGI server.

啟用緩衝後，在將請求傳送到 FastCGI 伺服器之前，會從用戶端(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#client_body_buffer_size)整個請求體。

When buffering is disabled, the request body is sent to the FastCGI server immediately as it is received. In this case, the request cannot be passed to the [next server](#p-060) if nginx already started sending the request body.

停用緩衝後，請求體會在接收後立即傳送到 FastCGI 伺服器。在這種情況下，如果 nginx 已經開始傳送請求體，則無法將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_fastcgi_module.html#fastcgi_next_upstream) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_request_dynamic</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_request_dynamic off;<br>fastcgi_request_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

Enables or disables creation of a separate request instance for each FastCGI server. By default, a single request is used for all FastCGI servers. If enabled, a separate request instance is created, allowing per-server request customization.

啟用或停用為每個 FastCGI 伺服器建立單獨的請求實例。預設情況下，所有 FastCGI 伺服器使用同一個請求。啟用後，將為每個伺服器建立一個單獨的請求實例，從而允許對每個伺服器的請求進行自訂。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_send_lowat</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_send_lowat 0;<br>fastcgi_send_lowat 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

If the directive is set to a non-zero value, nginx will try to minimize the number of send operations on outgoing connections to a FastCGI server by using either `NOTE_LOWAT` flag of the [kqueue](#p-030) method, or the `SO_SNDLOWAT` socket option, with the specified `*size*`.

如果指令設定為非零值，nginx 將嘗試透過使用 [kqueue](#p-030)方法的`NOTE_LOWAT`標誌或`SO_SNDLOWAT`套接字選項，以及指定的`*size*`來最小化伺服器與 FastCGI 建立的出站連線上的發送操作次數。

This directive is ignored on Linux, Solaris, and Windows.

該指令在 Linux、Solaris 和 Windows 系統上會被忽略。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_send_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_send_timeout 60s;<br>fastcgi_send_timeout 60s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a timeout for transmitting a request to the FastCGI server. The timeout is set only between two successive write operations, not for the transmission of the whole request. If the FastCGI server does not receive anything within this time, the connection is closed.

設定向 FastCGI 伺服器發送請求的逾時時間。此逾時時間僅設定在兩次連續寫入作業之間，而非整個請求的傳輸時間。如果 FastCGI 伺服器在此時間內未收到任何數據，則連線將關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_socket_keepalive</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_socket_keepalive off;<br>fastcgi_socket_keepalive 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.6.

該指令出現在版本1.15.6 。

Configures the “TCP keepalive” behavior for outgoing connections to a FastCGI server. By default, the operating system’s settings are in effect for the socket. If the directive is set to the value “`on`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` socket option is turned on for the socket.

設定與 FastCGI 伺服器建立的出站連線的「 TCP keepalive」行為。預設情況下，作業系統的設定對套接字生效。如果指令值設定為“ `on` ”，則會為套接字啟用`SO_KEEPALIVE`套接字選項。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**fastcgi_socket_rcvbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_socket_rcvbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the receive buffer size (the `SO_RCVBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a FastCGI server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `fastcgi_socket_rcvbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定與 FastCGI 伺服器建立出站連線的接收緩衝區大小（ `SO_RCVBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`fastcgi_socket_rcvbuf`指令的效果，從而允許作業系統對套接字的設定生效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**fastcgi_socket_sndbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_socket_sndbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the send buffer size (the `SO_SNDBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a FastCGI server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `fastcgi_socket_sndbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定發送至 FastCGI 伺服器的出站連線的傳送緩衝區大小（ `SO_SNDBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`fastcgi_socket_sndbuf`指令的效果，從而允許作業系統對套接字的設定生效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**fastcgi_split_path_info** `*regex*`;``<br>` `**fastcgi_split_path_info** ` *正規表示式* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location` |

Defines a regular expression that captures a value for the `$fastcgi_path_info` variable. The regular expression should have two captures: the first becomes a value of the `$fastcgi_script_name` variable, the second becomes a value of the `$fastcgi_path_info` variable. For example, with these settings

定義一個正規表示式，用於捕捉變數`$fastcgi_path_info`的值。此正規表示式應包含兩個捕獲：第一個捕獲值對應於變數`$fastcgi_script_name`的值，第二個捕獲值對應於變數`$fastcgi_path_info`的值。例如，使用這些設定

> ```
> location ~ ^(.+\.php)(.*)$ {
>     fastcgi_split_path_info       ^(.+\.php)(.*)$;
>
>     fastcgi_split_path_info ^(.+\.php)(.*)$;
>     fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /path/to/php$fastcgi_script_name;
>     fastcgi_param PATH_INFO       $fastcgi_path_info;
>
>     fastcgi_param PATH_INFO $fastcgi_path_info;
> ```

and the “`/show.php/article/0001`” request, the `SCRIPT_FILENAME` parameter will be equal to “`/path/to/php/show.php`”, and the `PATH_INFO` parameter will be equal to “`/article/0001`”.

對於“ `/show.php/article/0001` ”請求， `SCRIPT_FILENAME`參數將等於“ `/path/to/php/show.php` ”， `PATH_INFO`參數將等於“ `/article/0001` ”。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_store</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code> | <code><i>string<br></i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_store off;<br>fastcgi_store 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables saving of files to a disk. The `on` parameter saves files with paths corresponding to the directives [alias](#p-056) or [root](#p-056). The `off` parameter disables saving of files. In addition, the file name can be set explicitly using the `*string*` with variables:

允許將檔案儲存到磁碟。 `on`參數保存與指令[alias](#p-056)或[root](#p-056)相對應的路徑的檔案。 `off` 參數禁用檔案保存。此外，可以使用帶有變數的`*string*`明確設定檔名：

> ```
> fastcgi_store /data/www$original_uri;
> ```

The modification time of files is set according to the received “Last-Modified”（最後修改日期） response header field. The response is first written to a temporary file, and then the file is renamed. Starting from version 0.8.9, temporary files and the persistent store can be put on different file systems. However, be aware that in this case a file is copied across two file systems instead of the cheap renaming operation. It is thus recommended that for any given location both saved files and a directory holding temporary files, set by the [fastcgi\_temp\_path](#p-060) directive, are put on the same file system.

檔案的修改時間根據接收的“Last-Modified”（最後修改日期）回應頭字段設定。回應首先寫入臨時文件，然後重新命名該文件。從0.8.9版本開始，暫存檔案和持久化儲存可以位於不同的檔案系統上。但是請注意，在這種情況下，檔案會複製到兩個檔案系統上，而不是執行簡單的重新命名操作。因此，建議對於任何給定的位置，已儲存的檔案和由 [fastcgi\_temp\_path](#p-060)指令設定的暫存檔案目錄都位於同一檔案系統上。

This directive can be used to create local copies of static unchangeable files, e.g.:

此指令可用於建立靜態不可更改檔案的本機副本，例如：

> ```
> location /images/ {
>
> 位置/圖像/ {
>     root                 /data/www;
>
>     根目錄 /data/www;
>     error_page           404 = /fetch$uri;
>
>     error_page 404 = /fetch$uri;
> }
> 
> location /fetch/ {
>     internal;
>
>     內部的;
> 
>     fastcgi_pass         backend:9000;
>
>     fastcgi_pass 後端:9000;
>     ...
> 
>     fastcgi_store        on;
>
>     fastcgi_store 已開啟；
>     fastcgi_store_access user:rw group:rw all:r;
>
>     fastcgi_store_access 使用者：讀寫 群組：讀寫 所有：r；
>     fastcgi_temp_path    /data/temp;
>
>     fastcgi_temp_path /data/temp;
> 
>     alias                /data/www/;
>
>     別名 /data/www/;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_store_access</strong> <code><i>users<br>用戶</i></code>:<code><i>permissions<br>權限</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_store_access user:rw;<br>fastcgi_store_access 使用者：讀寫；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets access permissions for newly created files and directories, e.g.:

設定新檔案和目錄的存取權限，例如：

> ```
> fastcgi_store_access user:rw group:rw all:r;
>
> fastcgi_store_access 使用者：讀寫 群組：讀寫 所有：r；
> ```

If any `group` or `all` access permissions are specified then `user` permissions may be omitted:

如果指定了任何`group`或`all`存取權限，則可以省略`user`權限：

> ```
> fastcgi_store_access group:rw all:r;
>
> fastcgi_store_access 群組:rw all:r;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_temp_file_write_size</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_temp_file_write_size 8k|16k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Limits the `*size*` of data written to a temporary file at a time, when buffering of responses from the FastCGI server to temporary files is enabled. By default, `*size*` is limited by two buffers set by the [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060) and [fastcgi\_buffers](#p-060) directives. The maximum size of a temporary file is set by the [fastcgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-060) directive.

啟用 FastCGI 伺服器回應緩衝到暫存檔案功能時，限制每次寫入暫存檔案的資料量`*size*` 。預設情況下， `*size*`受限於 [fastcgi\_buffer\_size](#p-060)和 [fastcgi\_buffers](#p-060)指令設定的兩個緩衝區大小。暫存檔案的最大大小由 [fastcgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-060)指令設定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>fastcgi_temp_path</strong> <code><i>path</i></code> [<code><i>level1</i></code> [<code><i>level2<br></i></code> [<code><i>level3</i></code>]]];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>fastcgi_temp_path fastcgi_temp;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a directory for storing temporary files with data received from FastCGI servers. Up to three-level subdirectory hierarchy can be used underneath the specified directory. For example, in the following configuration

定義一個用於儲存從 FastCGI 伺服器接收的資料的暫存檔案的目錄。指定的目錄下最多可以使用三級子目錄結構。例如，在以下配置中

> ```
> fastcgi_temp_path /spool/nginx/fastcgi_temp 1 2;
> ```

a temporary file might look like this:

臨時文件可能如下所示：

> ```
> /spool/nginx/fastcgi_temp/7/45/00000123457
> ```

See also the `use_temp_path` parameter of the [fastcgi\_cache\_path](#p-060) directive.

另請參閱 [fastcgi\_cache\_path](#p-060)指令的`use_temp_path`參數。

**Parameters Passed to a FastCGI Server｜傳遞給 FastCGI 伺服器的參數**

HTTP request header fields are passed to a FastCGI server as parameters. In applications and scripts running as FastCGI servers, these parameters are usually made available as environment variables. For example, the “User-Agent”（使用者代理） header field is passed as the `HTTP_USER_AGENT` parameter. In addition to HTTP request header fields, it is possible to pass arbitrary parameters using the [fastcgi\_param](#p-060) directive.

HTTP請求頭字段作為參數傳遞給 FastCGI 伺服器。在作為 FastCGI 伺服器運行的應用程式和腳本中，這些參數通常以環境變數的形式提供。例如， “User-Agent”（使用者代理）請求頭字段作為`HTTP_USER_AGENT`參數傳遞。除了HTTP請求頭字段之外，還可以使用 [fastcgi\_param](#p-060)指令傳遞任意參數。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_fastcgi_module` module supports embedded variables that can be used to set parameters using the [fastcgi\_param](#p-060) directive:

`ngx_http_fastcgi_module`模組支援嵌入式變量，可以使用 [fastcgi\_param](#p-060)指令設定參數：

`$fastcgi_script_name`

request URI or, if a URI ends with a slash, request URI with an index file name configured by the [fastcgi\_index](#p-060) directive appended to it. This variable can be used to set the `SCRIPT_FILENAME` and `PATH_TRANSLATED` parameters that determine the script name in PHP. For example, for the “`/info/`” request with the following directives

請求URI ，或者，如果URI以斜槓結尾，則請求URI ，並在其後附加由 [fastcgi\_index](#p-060)指令配置的索引檔名。此變數可用於設定`SCRIPT_FILENAME`和`PATH_TRANSLATED`參數，這些參數決定了PHP中的腳本名稱。例如，對於具有以下指令的「 `/info/` 」請求：

> ```
> fastcgi_index index.php;
> fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /home/www/scripts/php$fastcgi_script_name;
> ```

the `SCRIPT_FILENAME` parameter will be equal to “`/home/www/scripts/php/info/index.php`”.

`SCRIPT_FILENAME`參數將等於「 `/home/www/scripts/php/info/index.php` 」。

When using the [fastcgi\_split\_path\_info](#p-060) directive, the `$fastcgi_script_name` variable equals the value of the first capture set by the directive.

使用 [fastcgi\_split\_path\_info](#p-060)指令時， `$fastcgi_script_name`變數等於該指令設定的第一個被捕獲的值。

`$fastcgi_path_info`

the value of the second capture set by the [fastcgi\_split\_path\_info](#p-060) directive. This variable can be used to set the `PATH_INFO` parameter.

由 [fastcgi\_split\_path\_info](#p-060)指令設定的第二個捕獲值。此變數可用於設定`PATH_INFO`參數。
