<a id="p-070"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_image_filter_module｜模組 ngx_http_image_filter_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_image_filter_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_image\_filter\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_image\_filter\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-070)<br>[Directives](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter\_buffer](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter\_interlace](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter\_jpeg\_quality](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter\_sharpen](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter\_transparency](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter\_webp\_quality](#p-070)<br>[範例設定](#p-070)<br>[指令](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter](#p-070)<br>     [image\_fil ter\_buffer](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter\_interlace](#p-070)<br>     [imag e\_filter\_jpeg\_quality](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter\_sharpen](#p-070)<br>     [i mage\_filter\_transparency](#p-070)<br>     [image\_filter\_webp\_quality](#p-070) |

The `ngx_http_image_filter_module` module (0.7.54+) is a filter that transforms images in JPEG, GIF, PNG, and WebP formats.

`ngx_http_image_filter_module`模組（0.7.54+）是一個過濾器，可以轉換JPEG, GIF, PNG和WebP格式的圖像。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_image_filter_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_image_filter_module`配置參數啟用。

> This module utilizes the [libgd](http://libgd.org/) library. It is recommended to use the latest available version of the library.
>
> 此模組使用 [libgd](http://libgd.org/) 函式庫。建議使用該庫的最新可用版本。

> The WebP format support appeared in version 1.11.6. To transform images in this format, the `libgd` library must be compiled with the WebP support.
>
> WebP 格式支援出現在版本1.11.6 中。要轉換這種格式的影像，`libgd`函式庫必須編譯為支援WebP。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location /img/ {
>
> 位置/img/ {
>     proxy_pass   http://backend;
>
>     proxy_pass http://backend;
>     image_filter resize 150 100;
>
>     image_filter 調整大小 150 100；
>     image_filter rotate 90;
>
>     image_filter旋轉90；
>     error_page   415 = /empty;
>
>     error_page 415 = /空；
> }
> 
> location = /empty {
>
> 位置=/空{
>     empty_gif;
>
>     空的gif；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>image_filter<br>影像濾鏡</strong> <code>off<br>離開</code>;</code><br><code><strong>image_filter<br>影像濾鏡</strong> <code>test<br>測試</code>;</code><br><code><strong>image_filter<br>影像濾鏡</strong> <code>size<br>尺寸</code>;</code><br><code><strong>image_filter<br>影像濾鏡</strong> <code>rotate<br>旋轉</code> <code>90</code> | <code>180</code> | <code>270</code>;</code><br><code><strong>image_filter<br>影像濾鏡</strong> <code>resize<br>調整大小</code> <code><i>width<br>寬度</i></code> <code><i>height<br>高度</i></code>;</code><br><code><strong>image_filter<br>影像濾鏡</strong> <code>crop<br>作物</code> <code><i>width<br>寬度</i></code> <code><i>height<br>高度</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設：</th><td>image_filter off;<br>image_filter關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the type of transformation to perform on images:

設定對影像執行的轉換類型：

`off`

turns off module processing in a surrounding location.

關閉周圍位置的模組處理。

`test`

ensures that responses are images in either JPEG, GIF, PNG, or WebP format. Otherwise, the 415 (Unsupported Media Type) error is returned.

確保響應是JPEG, GIF, PNG或WebP格式的圖像。否則，傳回415（不支援的媒體類型）錯誤。

`size`

outputs information about images in a JSON format, e.g.:

以 JSON 格式輸出有關影像的訊息，例如：

> ```json
> { "img" : { "width": 100, "height": 100, "type": "gif" } }
>
> {“img”：{“寬度”：100，“高度”：100，“類型”：“gif”}}
> ```

In case of an error, the output is as follows:

如果出現錯誤，輸出如下：

> ```json
> {}
> ```

`rotate` `90`|`180`|`270`

rotates images counter-clockwise by the specified number of degrees. Parameter value can contain variables. This mode can be used either alone or along with the `resize` and `crop` transformations.

將影像逆時針旋轉指定的度數。參數值可以包含變數。此模式可以單獨使用，也可以與 `resize` 和 `crop` 轉換一起使用。

`resize` `*width*` `*height*`

proportionally reduces an image to the specified sizes. To reduce by only one dimension, another dimension can be specified as “`-`”. In case of an error, the server will return code 415 (Unsupported Media Type). Parameter values can contain variables. When used along with the `rotate` parameter, the rotation happens **after** reduction.

按比例將影像縮小到指定尺寸。若要僅減少一個維度，可以將另一個維度指定為「`-`」。如果發生錯誤，伺服器將傳回代碼 415（不支援的媒體類型）。參數值可以包含變數。與 `rotate` 參數一起使用時，旋轉發生在**減少之後**。

`crop` `*width*` `*height*`

proportionally reduces an image to the larger side size and crops extraneous edges by another side. To reduce by only one dimension, another dimension can be specified as “`-`”. In case of an error, the server will return code 415 (Unsupported Media Type). Parameter values can contain variables. When used along with the `rotate` parameter, the rotation happens **before** reduction.

按比例將影像縮小到較大的邊尺寸，並裁剪另一邊的無關邊緣。若要僅減少一個維度，可以將另一個維度指定為「`-`」。如果發生錯誤，伺服器將傳回代碼 415（不支援的媒體類型）。參數值可以包含變數。當與 `rotate` 參數一起使用時，旋轉發生在**減少之前**。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>image_filter_buffer</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設：</th><td>image_filter_buffer 1M;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum size of the buffer used for reading images. When the size is exceeded the server returns error 415 (Unsupported Media Type).

設定用於讀取影像的緩衝區的最大大小。當超出大小時，伺服器會傳回錯誤 415（不支援的媒體類型）。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>image_filter_interlace</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設：</th><td>image_filter_interlace off;<br>image_filter_interlace 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.3.15.

該指令出現在版本1.3.15。

If enabled, final images will be interlaced. For JPEG, final images will be in “progressive JPEG” format.

如果啟用，最終影像將是隔行掃描的。對於JPEG，最終影像將採用「漸進式JPEG」格式。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>image_filter_jpeg_quality</strong> <code><i>quality</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設：</th><td>image_filter_jpeg_quality 75;<br>image_filter_jpeg_quality 75；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the desired `*quality*` of the transformed JPEG images. Acceptable values are in the range from 1 to 100. Lesser values usually imply both lower image quality and less data to transfer. The maximum recommended value is 95. Parameter value can contain variables.

設定轉換後的 JPEG 影像所需的 `*quality*`。可接受的值範圍為 1 到 100。較小的值通常意味著較低的影像品質和較少的資料傳輸。最大建議值為 95。參數值可以包含變數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>image_filter_sharpen</strong> <code><i>percent<br>百分比</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設：</th><td>image_filter_sharpen 0;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Increases sharpness of the final image. The sharpness percentage can exceed 100. The zero value disables sharpening. Parameter value can contain variables.

提高最終影像的清晰度。銳化百分比可以超過 100。零值會停用銳化。參數值可以包含變數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>image_filter_transparency</strong> <code>on</code>|<code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設：</th><td>image_filter_transparency on;<br>image_filter_transparency 開啟；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines whether transparency should be preserved when transforming GIF images or PNG images with colors specified by a palette. The loss of transparency results in images of a better quality. The alpha channel transparency in PNG is always preserved.

定義在轉換具有調色板指定顏色的GIF圖像或PNG圖像時是否應保留透明度。透明度的損失導致影像品質更好。 PNG 中的 Alpha 頻道透明度始終保留。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>image_filter_webp_quality</strong> <code><i>quality</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設：</th><td>image_filter_webp_quality 80;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.11.6.

該指令出現在版本1.11.6。

Sets the desired `*quality*` of the transformed WebP images. Acceptable values are in the range from 1 to 100. Lesser values usually imply both lower image quality and less data to transfer. Parameter value can contain variables.

設定轉換後的 WebP 影像所需的 `*quality*`。可接受的值範圍為 1 到 100。較小的值通常意味著較低的影像品質和較少的資料傳輸。參數值可以包含變數。

<a id="p-071"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_index_module｜模組 ngx_http_index_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_index_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_index\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_index\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-071)<br>[Directives](#p-071)<br>     [index](#p-071)<br>[設定範例](#p-071)<br>[指令](#p-071)<br>     [索引](#p-071) |

The `ngx_http_index_module` module processes requests ending with the slash character (‘`/`’). Such requests can also be processed by the [ngx\_http\_autoindex\_module](#p-053) and [ngx\_http\_random\_index\_module](#p-087) modules.

`ngx_http_index_module`模組處理以斜槓字元（‘`/`’）結尾的請求。此類請求也可以由 [ngx\_http\_autoindex\_module](#p-053) 和 [ngx\_http\_random\_index\_module](#p-087) 模組處理。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     index index.$geo.html index.html;
>
>     索引index.$geo.htmlindex.html;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>index<br>索引</strong> <code><i>file<br>檔</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設：</th><td>index index.html;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines files that will be used as an index. The `*file*` name can contain variables. Files are checked in the specified order. The last element of the list can be a file with an absolute path. Example:

定義將用作索引的檔案。 `*file*` 名稱可以包含變數。按照指定的順序檢查文件。列表的最後一個元素可以是具有絕對路徑的檔案。範例：

> ```
> index index.$geo.html index.0.html /index.html;
>
> 索引index.$geo.html index.0.html /index.html;
> ```

It should be noted that using an index file causes an internal redirect, and the request can be processed in a different location. For example, with the following configuration:

需要注意的是，使用索引檔案會導致內部重定向，並且可以在不同的位置處理請求。例如，使用以下配置：

> ```
> location = / {
>
> 位置 = / {
>     index index.html;
>
>     索引index.html；
> }
> 
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     ...
> }
> ```

a “`/`” request will actually be processed in the second location as “`/index.html`”.

「`/`」請求實際上將在第二個位置作為「`/index.html`」進行處理。

---

<a id="p-072"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_internal_redirect_module｜模組 ngx_http_internal_redirect_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_internal_redirect_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_internal\_redirect\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_internal\_redirect\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-072)<br>[Directives](#p-072)<br>     [internal\_redirect](#p-072)<br>[範例設定](#p-072)<br>[指令](#p-072)<br>     [內部\_redirect](#p-072) |

The `ngx_http_internal_redirect_module` module (1.23.4) allows making an internal redirect. In contrast to [rewriting URIs](#p-090), the redirection is made after checking [request](#p-076) and [connection](#p-075) processing limits, and [access](#p-045) limits.

`ngx_http_internal_redirect_module` 模組 (1.23.4) 允許進行內部重定向。與[重寫URI](#p-090)相反，重定向是在檢查[請求](#p-076)和[連接](#p-075)處理限制以及[訪問](#p-045)限制後進行的。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> limit_req_zone $jwt_claim_sub zone=jwt_sub:10m rate=1r/s;
>
> limit_req_zone $jwt_claim_sub zone=jwt_sub:10m 速率=1r/s;
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         auth_jwt          "realm";
>
>         auth_jwt「領域」；
>         auth_jwt_key_file key.jwk;
> 
>         internal_redirect @rate_limited;
>
>         內部重定向@rate_limited；
>     }
> 
>     location @rate_limited {
>
>     位置@rate_limited {
>         internal;
>
>         內部的;
> 
>         limit_req  zone=jwt_sub burst=10;
>
>         limit_req區域=jwt_sub突發=10；
>         proxy_pass http://backend;
>     }
> }
> ```

The example implements [per-user](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.2) [rate limiting](#p-076). Implementation without [internal\_redirect](#p-072) is vulnerable to DoS attacks by unsigned JWTs, as normally the [limit\_req](#p-076) check is performed [before](#p-028) [auth\_jwt](#p-050) check. Using [internal\_redirect](#p-072) allows reordering these checks.

此範例實現了[每位使用者](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.2)[速率限制](#p-076)。沒有 [internal\_redirect](#p-072) 的實現很容易受到未簽名 JWT 的 DoS 攻擊，因為通常 [limit\_req](#p-076) 檢查 [before](#p-028) [auth\_jwt](#p-050) 檢查執行。使用 [internal\_redirect](#p-072) 允許對這些檢查重新排序。

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**internal_redirect** `*uri*`;`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>上下文： | `server`, `location` |

Sets the URI for internal redirection of the request. It is also possible to use a [named location](#p-056) instead of the URI. The `*uri*` value can contain variables. If the `*uri*` value is empty, then the redirect will not be made.

設定請求內部重定向的URI。也可以使用[命名位置](#p-056)代替URI。 `*uri*`值可以包含變數。如果 `*uri*` 值為空，則不會進行重定向。

---

<a id="p-073"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_js_module｜模組 ngx_http_js_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_js_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_js\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_js\_module

|   |

The `ngx_http_js_module` module is used to implement location, variable, and filter handlers in JavaScript with [njs](#p-133).

`ngx_http_js_module` 模組用於透過 [njs](#p-133) 在 JavaScript 中實作位置、變數和過濾器處理程序。

Download and install instructions are available [here](#p-134).

下載和安裝說明可在[此處](#p-134)取得。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

The example works since [0.4.0](#p-129).

此範例從 [0.4.0](#p-129) 開始運行。

> ```
> http {
>     # since 0.9.1｜自從0.9.1
>     js_engine qjs;
>
>     js_engine qjs；
> 
>     js_import http.js;
>
>     js_導入http.js；
> 
>     js_set $foo     http.foo;
>
>     js_set $foo http.foo;
>     js_set $summary http.summary;
>     js_set $hash    http.hash;
>
>     js_set $hash http.hash;
> 
>     resolver 10.0.0.1;
>
>     旋轉變壓器10.0.0.1；
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 8000;
>
>         聽 8000；
> 
>         location / {
>
>         地點 / {
>             add_header X-Foo $foo;
>             js_content http.baz;
>
>             js_內容http.baz；
>         }
> 
>         location = /summary {
>
>         位置=/摘要{
>             return 200 $summary;
>
>             返回 200 $summary；
>         }
> 
>         location = /hello {
>
>         位置=/你好{
>             js_content http.hello;
>
>             js_content http.hello；
>         }
> 
>         # since 0.7.0｜從0.7.0開始
>         location = /fetch {
>
>         位置= /獲取{
>             js_content                   http.fetch;
>
>             js_content http.fetch；
>             js_fetch_trusted_certificate /path/to/ISRG_Root_X1.pem;
>         }
> 
>         # since 0.7.0｜自從0.7.0
>         location = /crypto {
>
>         位置= /加密{
>             add_header Hash $hash;
>
>             add_header 哈希 $hash;
>             return     200;
>
>             返回200；
>         }
>     }
> }
> ```

The `http.js` file:

`http.js` 文件：

> ```js
> function foo(r) {
>
> 函數 foo(r) {
>     r.log("hello from foo() handler");
>
>     r.log("來自 foo() 處理程序的你好");
>     return "foo";
>
>     返回“foo”；
> }
> 
> function summary(r) {
>
> 函數摘要(r) {
>     var a, s, h;
>
>     變數a、s、h；
> 
>     s = "JS summary\n\n";
>
>     s = "JS 摘要\n\n";
> 
>     s += "Method: " + r.method + "\n";
>
>     s += "方法：" + r.method + "\n";
>     s += "HTTP version: " + r.httpVersion + "\n";
>
>     s += "HTTP 版本:" + r.httpVersion + "\n";
>     s += "Host: " + r.headersIn.host + "\n";
>
>     s += "主機：" + r.headersIn.host + "\n";
>     s += "Remote Address: " + r.remoteAddress + "\n";
>
>     s += "遠端位址：" + r.remoteAddress + "\n";
>     s += "URI: " + r.uri + "\n";
> 
>     s += "Headers:\n";
>
>     s += "標題:\n";
>     for (h in r.headersIn) {
>         s += "  header '" + h + "' is '" + r.headersIn[h] + "'\n";
>
>         s += " header '" + h + "' is '" + r.headersIn[h] + "'\n";
>     }
> 
>     s += "Args:\n";
>
>     s += "參數:\n";
>     for (a in r.args) {
>         s += "  arg '" + a + "' is '" + r.args[a] + "'\n";
>
>         s += " arg '" + a + "' 是 '" + r.args[a] + "'\n";
>     }
> 
>     return s;
>
>     返回 s；
> }
> 
> function baz(r) {
>
> 函數 baz(r) {
>     r.status = 200;
>
>     r.狀態 = 200;
>     r.headersOut.foo = 1234;
>     r.headersOut['Content-Type'] = "text/plain; charset=utf-8";
>     r.headersOut['Content-Length'] = 15;
>
>     r.headersOut['內容長度'] = 15;
>     r.sendHeader();
>     r.send("nginx");
>     r.send("java");
>
>     r.send(“java”);
>     r.send("script");
>
>     r.send("腳本");
> 
>     r.finish();
> }
> 
> function hello(r) {
>
> 函數你好（r）{
>     r.return(200, "Hello world!");
>
>     r.return(200, "你好世界！");
> }
> 
> // since 0.7.0
>
> // 從0.7.0開始
> async function fetch(r) {
>
> 非同步函數 fetch(r) {
>     let results = await Promise.all([ngx.fetch('https://nginx.org/'),
>
>     讓結果=等待Promise.all([ngx.fetch('https://nginx.org/'),
>                                      ngx.fetch('https://nginx.org/en/')]);
> 
>     r.return(200, JSON.stringify(results, undefined, 4));
>
>     r.return(200, JSON.stringify(結果, 未定義, 4));
> }
> 
> // since 0.9.5
>
> // 從0.9.5開始
> async function hash(r) {
>
> 非同步函數 hash(r) {
>     let hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-512', r.headersIn.host);
>
>     let hash = wait crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-512', r.headersIn.host);
>     return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
> }
> 
> export default {foo, summary, baz, hello, fetch, hash};
>
> 導出預設{foo，summary，baz，hello，fetch，hash}；
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_body_filter** `*module.function*` [`*buffer_type*`=`*string*` \| `*buffer*`];``<br>``**js_body_filter** `*模組.函數*` [`*buffer_type*`=`*字串*` \| `*緩衝區*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>上下文： | `location`, `if in location`, `limit_except` |

This directive appeared in version 0.5.2.

該指令出現在版本0.5.2。

Sets an njs function as a response body filter. The filter function is called for each data chunk of a response body with the following arguments:

將 njs 函數設定為回應正文過濾器。使用以下參數為響應正文的每個資料塊呼叫過濾器函數：

`r`

the [HTTP request](#p-137) object

[HTTP請求](#p-137)對象

`data`

the incoming data chunk, may be a string or Buffer depending on the `buffer_type` value, by default is a string. Since [0.8.5](#p-129), the `data` value is implicitly converted to a valid UTF-8 string by default. For binary data, the `buffer_type` value should be set to `buffer`.

傳入的資料區塊，可能是字串或 Buffer，取決於 `buffer_type` 值，預設為字串。自 [0.8.5](#p-129) 起，`data` 值預設隱式轉換為有效的 UTF-8 字串。對於二進位數據，`buffer_type`值應設定為`buffer`。

`flags`

an object with the following properties:

具有以下屬性的物件：

`last`

a boolean value, true if data is a last buffer.

布林值，如果資料是最後一個緩衝區，則為 true。

The filter function can pass its own modified version of the input data chunk to the next body filter by calling [`r.sendBuffer()`](#p-137). For example, to transform all the lowercase letters in the response body:

過濾器函數可以透過呼叫[`r.sendBuffer()`](#p-137)將其自己的輸入資料塊的修改版本傳遞給下一個主體過濾器。例如，要轉換回應正文中的所有小寫字母：

> ```js
> function filter(r, data, flags) {
>
> 函數過濾器（r，數據，標誌）{
>     r.sendBuffer(data.toLowerCase(), flags);
> }
> ```

If the filter function changes the length of the response body, the “Content-Length”（內容長度） response header (if present) should be cleared in [`js_header_filter`](#p-073) to enforce chunked transfer encoding:

如果過濾器函數更改響應正文的長度，則應在 [`js_header_filter`](#p-073) 中清除“Content-Length”（內容長度）響應標頭（如果存在）以強制執行分塊傳輸編碼：

> ```
> example.conf:
>  location /foo {
>
>  位置/foo {
>      # proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;
> 
>     js_header_filter main.clear_content_length;
>     js_body_filter   main.filter;
>
>     js_body_filter main.filter；
>  }
> 
> example.js:
>  function clear_content_length(r) {
>
>  函數clear_content_length(r) {
>      delete r.headersOut['Content-Length'];
>
>      刪除 r.headersOut['Content-Length'];
>  }
> ```

To stop filtering and pass the data chunks to the client without calling `js_body_filter`, [`r.done()`](#p-137) can be used. For example, to prepend some data to the response body:

要停止過濾並將資料塊傳遞給客戶端而不呼叫`js_body_filter`，可以使用[`r.done()`](#p-137)。例如，要將一些資料加入到回應正文中：

> ```js
> function prepend(r, data, flags) {
>
> 函數前置（r，數據，標誌）{
>     r.sendBuffer("XXX");
>     r.sendBuffer(data, flags);
>
>     r.sendBuffer(數據, 標誌);
>     r.done();
> }
> ```

> As the `js_body_filter` handler returns its result immediately, it supports only synchronous operations. Thus, asynchronous operations such as [r.subrequest()](#p-137) or [setTimeout()](#p-137) are not supported.
>
> 由於`js_body_filter`處理程序立即返回其結果，因此它僅支援同步操作。因此，不支援 [r.subrequest()](#p-137) 或 [setTimeout()](#p-137) 等非同步操作。

> The directive can be specified inside the [if](#p-090) block since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 自 [0.7.7](#p-129) 以來，可以在 [if](#p-090) 區塊內指定該指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_access** `*module.function*`;``<br>``**js_access** `*模組.函數*`;`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>上下文： | `location`, `if in location`, `limit_except` |

This directive appeared in version 0.9.9.

該指令出現在版本0.9.9。

Sets an njs function as a handler in the [access phase](#p-028). Asynchronous operations such as [r.subrequest()](#p-137), [ngx.fetch()](#p-137), and [setTimeout()](#p-137) are supported.

在[訪問階段](#p-028)設定一個njs函數作為處理程序。支援 [r.subrequest()](#p-137)、[ngx.fetch()](#p-137)、[setTimeout()](#p-137) 等非同步操作。

A handler that returns without calling [`r.return()`](#p-137) or [`r.decline()`](#p-137) grants access. To deny access or send a custom response (for example, a redirect), the handler may call [`r.return()`](#p-137). To make the handler express no opinion, deferring the decision to other access checkers under [`satisfy any`](#p-056), the handler may call [`r.decline()`](#p-137).

不呼叫 [`r.return()`](#p-137) 或 [`r.decline()`](#p-137) 傳回的處理程序將授予存取權限。若要拒絕存取或傳送自訂回應（例如重新導向），處理程序可以呼叫 [`r.return()`](#p-137)。為了使處理程序不表達任何意見，將決定推遲給[`satisfy any`](#p-056)下的其他訪問檢查器，處理程序可以呼叫[`r.decline()`](#p-137)。

For example:

例如：

> ```
> example.conf:
>  location /protected/ {
>
>  位置/受保護/ {
>      js_access  main.auth;
>
>      js_access main.auth;
>      proxy_pass http://upstream;
>  }
> 
> example.js:
>  async function auth(r) {
>
>  非同步函數 auth(r) {
>      let reply = await ngx.fetch('http://authsvc/check', {
>
>      讓回覆 = 等待 ngx.fetch('http://authsvc/check', {
>          headers: {Authorization: r.headersIn.Authorization}
>
>          標頭：{授權：r.headersIn.Authorization}
>      });
> 
>      if (reply.status != 200) {
>          r.return(401);
>          return;
>
>          返回;
>      }
>  }
> 
>  export default {auth};
>
>  導出預設{auth}；
> ```

| Context:<br>上下文： | `location`, `if in location`, `limit_except` |

Sets an njs function as a location content handler. Since [0.4.0](#p-129), a module function can be referenced.

將 njs 函數設定為位置內容處理程序。從[0.4.0](#p-129)開始，可以引用模組函數。

> The directive can be specified inside the [if](#p-090) block since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 該指令可以在 [if](#p-090) 區塊內指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

This directive appeared in version 0.8.6.

該指令出現在版本0.8.6。

Sets a maximum number of JS context to be reused for [QuickJS engine](#p-132). Each context is used for a single request. The finished context is put into a pool of reusable contexts. If the pool is full, the context is destroyed.

設定[QuickJS引擎](#p-132)重用的JS上下文的最大數量。每個上下文用於單一請求。完成的上下文被放入可重複使用上下文池中。如果池已滿，則上下文將被破壞。

<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.8.6.

該指令出現在版本0.8.6。

Sets a [JavaScript engine](#p-132) to be used for njs scripts. The `njs` parameter sets the njs engine, also used by default. The `qjs` parameter sets the QuickJS engine.

設定用於 njs 腳本的 [JavaScript 引擎](#p-132)。 `njs`參數設定njs引擎，也是預設使用的。 `qjs`參數設定QuickJS引擎。

> The `njs` engine is deprecated since [1.0.0](#p-129); new configurations should use the `qjs` ([QuickJS](#p-132)) engine.
>
> 自 [1.0.0](#p-129) 起，`njs` 引擎已棄用；新配置應使用 `qjs` ([QuickJS](#p-132)) 引擎。

Specifies the enabled ciphers for HTTPS requests with [Fetch API](#p-137). The ciphers are specified in the format understood by the OpenSSL library.

使用 [Fetch API](#p-137) 指定HTTPS 請求啟用的密碼。密碼以 OpenSSL 函式庫可以理解的格式指定。

The full list can be viewed using the “`openssl ciphers`” command.

可以使用“`openssl ciphers`”指令查看完整清單。

This directive appeared in version 0.7.4.

該指令出現在版本0.7.4。

Defines a timeout for reading and writing for [Fetch API](#p-137). The timeout is set only between two successive read/write operations, not for the whole response. If no data is transmitted within this time, the connection is closed.

定義 [Fetch API](#p-137) 讀寫超時。超時僅在兩個連續的讀取/寫入操作之間設置，而不是在整個回應中設置。如果在此時間內沒有資料傳輸，則連線被關閉。

| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 0.7.0.

該指令出現在版本0.7.0 。

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-137) the HTTPS certificate with [Fetch API](#p-137).

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於 [驗證](#p-137) HTTPS證書，使用 [獲取API](#p-137) 。

<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>js_fetch_verify on;<br>js_fetch_verify 已啟用；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.7.4.

該指令出現在版本0.7.4 。

Enables or disables verification of the HTTPS server certificate with [Fetch API](#p-137).

啟用或停用對HTTPS伺服器憑證的驗證 [Fetch API](#p-137) 。

This directive appeared in version 0.7.0.

該指令出現在版本0.7.0 。

Sets the verification depth in the HTTPS server certificates chain with [Fetch API](#p-137).

使用 [Fetch API](#p-137)設定HTTPS伺服器憑證鏈的驗證深度。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**js_fetch_proxy** `*url*`;``<br>` `**js_fetch_proxy** ` *url* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 0.9.4.

該指令出現在版本0.9.4 。

Configures a forward proxy URL with [Fetch API](#p-137). The `*url*` supports the HTTP scheme only and can contain optional user credentials in the format `http://[user:password@]host:port` for Basic authentication. Supports both HTTP and HTTPS connections to destination servers. If the `*url*` is empty, proxy routing is disabled. The parameter value can contain variables.

設定轉送代理URL並執行 [Fetch API](#p-137)僅支援HTTP協議，並且可以包含可選的用戶憑證（格式為`http://[user:password@]host:port` `*url*`用於基本身份驗證。支援與目標伺服器建立HTTP和HTTPS連線。如果`*url*`為空，則禁用代理路由。參數值可以包含變數。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> location /fetch {
>     js_fetch_proxy http://user:pass@proxy.example.com:3128;
>     js_content main.fetch_handler;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>js_fetch_keepalive</strong> <code><i>connections<br>連接</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>js_fetch_keepalive 0;<br>js_fetch_keepalive 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.9.2.

該指令出現在版本0.9.2 。

Activates the cache for connections to destination servers. When the value is greater than `0`, enables keepalive connections for [Fetch API](#p-137).

啟動與目標伺服器連接的快取。當該值大於`0`時，啟用 [Fetch API](#p-137)的 keepalive 連線。

The `*connections*` parameter sets the maximum number of idle keepalive connections to destination servers that are preserved in the cache of each worker process. When this number is exceeded, the least recently used connections are closed.

`*connections*`參數設定每個工作進程快取中保留的與目標伺服器的空閒 keepalive 連線的最大數量。當超過此數量時，最近最少使用的連接將關閉。

In HTTP, the cache is maintained separately for each effective location configuration. A value set at the `http` or `server` level is inherited by locations, but each location uses its own cache. Cached connections are reused for requests with the same protocol, host, and port.

在HTTP中，每個有效位置配置的快取都是獨立維護的。在`http`或`server`級別設定的值會被各個位置繼承，但每個位置使用自己的快取。快取的連線會被重新用於具有相同協定、主機和連接埠的請求。

When enabled, keepalive assumes that destination servers send valid HTTP responses.

啟用 keepalive 後，會假定目標伺服器發送有效的HTTP回應。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> location /fetch {
>     js_fetch_keepalive 32;
>     js_fetch_trusted_certificate /path/to/ISRG_Root_X1.pem;
>     js_content main.fetch_handler;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>js_fetch_keepalive_requests</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>js_fetch_keepalive_requests 1000;<br>js_fetch_keepalive_requests 1000；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.9.2.

該指令出現在版本0.9.2 。

Sets the maximum number of requests that can be served through one keepalive connection with [Fetch API](#p-137). After the maximum number of requests is made, the connection is closed.

設定透過 [Fetch API](#p-137)的單一 keepalive 連線可以處理的最大請求數。達到最大請求數後，連線將關閉。

Closing connections periodically is necessary to free per-connection memory allocations. Therefore, using too high maximum number of requests could result in excessive memory usage and not recommended.

定期關閉連線對於釋放每個連線佔用的記憶體至關重要。因此，設定過高的最大請求數可能會導致記憶體使用過量，不建議這樣做。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>js_fetch_keepalive_time</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>js_fetch_keepalive_time 1h;<br>js_fetch_keepalive_time 1小時；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.9.2.

該指令出現在版本0.9.2 。

Limits the maximum time during which requests can be processed through one keepalive connection with [Fetch API](#p-137). After this time is reached, the connection is closed following the subsequent request processing.

限制透過與 [Fetch API](#p-137)的單一 keepalive 連接處理請求的最長時間。達到此時間後，連線將在後續請求處理後關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>js_fetch_keepalive_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>js_fetch_keepalive_timeout 60s;<br>js_fetch_keepalive_timeout 60秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.9.2.

該指令出現在版本0.9.2 。

Sets a timeout during which an idle keepalive connection to a destination server will stay open with [Fetch API](#p-137).

設定超時時間，在此期間，與目標伺服器的空閒 keepalive 連線將保持開啟 [Fetch API](#p-137) 。

| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_header_filter** `*module.function*`;``<br>` `**js_header_filter** ` *module.function* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location`, `if in location`, `limit_except` |

This directive appeared in version 0.5.1.

該指令出現在版本0.5.1 。

Sets an njs function as a response header filter. The directive allows changing arbitrary header fields of a response header.

將 njs 函數設定為響應頭濾波器。此指令允許更改回應頭的任意欄位。

> As the `js_header_filter` handler returns its result immediately, it supports only synchronous operations. Thus, asynchronous operations such as [r.subrequest()](#p-137) or [setTimeout()](#p-137) are not supported.
>
> 由於`js_header_filter`處理程序會立即傳回結果，因此它僅支援同步操作。因此，諸如 [r.subrequest()](#p-137)或 [setTimeout()](#p-137)之類的非同步操作不受支援。

> The directive can be specified inside the [if](#p-090) block since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 指令可以在 [if](#p-090)區塊內指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_import** `*module.js*` \| `*export_name from module.js*`;``<br>` `**js_import** ` *module.js* ` \| ` *export_name from module.js* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 0.4.0.

該指令出現在版本0.4.0 。

Imports a module that implements location, variable, and filter handlers in njs. The `export_name` is used as a namespace to access module functions. If the `export_name` is not specified, the module name will be used as a namespace.

導入一個在 njs 中實作位置、變數和過濾器處理程序的模組。 `export_name` 用作存取模組函數的命名空間。如果未指定`export_name`，則模組名稱將用作命名空間。

> ```
> js_import http.js;
> ```

Here, the module name `http` is used as a namespace while accessing exports. If the imported module exports `foo()`, `http.foo` is used to refer to it.

這裡，模組名稱`http`在訪問導出時用作命名空間。如果導入的模組導出`foo()`, `http.foo`來引用它。

Several `js_import` directives can be specified.

可以指定多個`js_import`指令。

When `js_import` is specified inside a [location](#p-056), the imported modules are visible only if no JavaScript code has been invoked earlier in the request. A single VM is created per request when a [js\_set](#p-073) variable is first accessed or when a [js\_content](#p-073), [js\_header\_filter](#p-073), [js\_body\_filter](#p-073), or [js\_access](#p-073) handler is first invoked. The VM is cloned from the configuration scope active at that moment, and all subsequent JavaScript invocations within the request reuse it. Thus, if any of the above is referenced before the request is mapped to its final location, for example from a server-level [set](#p-090), the VM is bound to the import set of the outer scope, and modules imported in the matched `location` will not be visible. To avoid this, declare such imports in a common parent scope.

當在 [location](#p-056)中指定`js_import`時，導入的模組僅在請求中之前未調用任何 JavaScript 程式碼時才可見。當首次存取 [js\_set]VM變數或首次(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_js_module.html#js_content) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_js_module.html#js_set) [js\_header\_filter](#p-073) 、[js\_body\_filter](#p-073) \ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_js_module.html#js_access)處理程序時，每個請求都會建立一個VM是從目前啟動的組態作用域複製的，而請求中所有後續的 JavaScript 呼叫都會重複使用它。因此，如果在請求映射到其最終位置之前引用了上述任何內容（例如，從伺服器級別的 [集合](#p-090)中引用），則VM將綁定到外部作用域的導入集，並且匹配的`location`中導入的模組將不可見。為避免這種情況，請在公共父作用域中聲明此類匯入。

> The directive can be specified on the `server` and `location` level since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 指令可以在`server`和`location`級別指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**js_include** `*file*`;``<br>` `**js_include** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Specifies a file that implements location and variable handlers in njs:

指定一個在 njs 中實作位置和變數處理程序的檔案：

> ```js
> nginx.conf:
> js_include http.js;
> location   /version {
>
> location /version {
>     js_content version;
>
>     js_content 版本；
> }
> 
> http.js:
> function version(r) {
>
> 函數 version(r) {
>     r.return(200, njs.version);
> }
> ```

The directive was made obsolete in version [0.4.0](#p-129) and was removed in version [0.7.1](#p-129). The [js\_import](#p-073) directive should be used instead.

該指令在版本 [0.4.0](#p-129)中已過時，並在版本 [0.7.1](#p-129)中被移除。應改用 [js\_import](#p-073)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_load_http_native_module** `*path*` [`as` `*name*`];``<br>` `**js_load_http_native_module** ` *路徑* ` [`作為` ` *名稱* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

This directive appeared in version 0.9.5.

該指令出現在版本0.9.5 。

Loads a [native module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/native_modules.html) (shared library) for use in HTTP JavaScript code. The directive is [QuickJS](#p-132)\-only and is not available when using the njs built-in JavaScript engine.

載入一個[原生模組](https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/native_modules.html) （共享函式庫），供HTTP JavaScript 程式碼使用。此指令僅適用於[QuickJS](#p-132) ，在使用 njs 內建 JavaScript 引擎時不可用。

The `*path*` parameter specifies the absolute path to the shared library file. The optional `as` `*name*` parameter provides an alias name for importing the module in JavaScript code. If not specified, the module can be imported using its filename.

`*path*`參數指定共享庫檔案的絕對路徑。可選的`as` `*name*`參數提供用於在 JavaScript 程式碼中匯入模組的別名。如果未指定，則可以使用模組的檔案名稱匯入。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> js_load_http_native_module /path/to/mylib.so;
> js_load_http_native_module /path/to/other.so as myalias;
> 
> http {
>     js_import main.js;
>     # ... rest of http configuration｜...其餘的HTTP配置
> }
> ```

In JavaScript code:

在 JavaScript 程式碼中：

> ```js
> // Import by filename
>
> // 按檔案名稱匯入
> import * as mylib from 'mylib.so';
> 
> // Import by alias
>
> // 透過別名匯入
> import * as myalias from 'myalias';
> 
> // Use exported functions
>
> // 使用匯出的函數
> let result = mylib.add(5, 10);
> ```

> For security reasons, this directive is only allowed in the `main` configuration context. Native modules run with full process privileges; use absolute paths and ensure proper code review.
>
> 出於安全考慮，此指令僅允許在`main`配置上下文中使用。原生模組以完整的進程權限運作；請使用絕對路徑並確保進行適當的程式碼審查。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_path** `*path*`;``<br>` `**js_path** ` *路徑* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 0.3.0.

該指令出現在版本0.3.0 。

Sets an additional path for njs modules.

為 njs 模組設定一個額外的路徑。

> The directive can be specified on the `server` and `location` level since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 指令可以在`server`和`location`級別指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**js_periodic** `*module.function*` [`interval`=`*time*`] [`jitter`=`*number*`] [`worker_affinity`=`*mask*`];``<br>``**js_periodic** `*模組.函數*` [`間隔`=`*時間*`] [`澆水`=`*數字*`] [`工作者親和力`=`*面具*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location` |

This directive appeared in version 0.8.1.

該指令出現在版本0.8.1 。

Specifies a content handler to run at regular interval. The handler receives a [session object](#p-137) as its first argument, it also has access to global objects such as [ngx](#p-137).

指定一個定期運行的內容處理程序。此處理程序接收一個 [會話對象](#p-137)作為其第一個參數，它還可以存取全域對象，例如 [ngx](#p-137) 。

The optional `interval` parameter sets the interval between two consecutive runs, by default, 5 seconds.

可選參數`interval`設定兩次連續運行之間的間隔，預設值為 5 秒。

The optional `jitter` parameter sets the time within which the location content handler will be randomly delayed, by default, there is no delay.

可選參數`jitter`設定位置內容處理程序隨機延遲的時間範圍，預設沒有延遲。

By default, the `js_periodic` handler is executed on worker process 0. The optional `worker_affinity` parameter allows specifying particular worker processes where the location content handler should be executed. Each worker process set is represented by a bitmask of allowed worker processes. The `all` mask allows the handler to be executed in all worker processes.

預設情況下，`js_periodic`處理程序在工作進程0上執行。可選的`worker_affinity`參數允許指定應在其中執行位置內容處理程序的特定工作進程。每個工作進程集由允許的工作進程的位元遮罩表示。 `all` 遮罩允許處理程序在所有工作進程中執行。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> example.conf:
> 
> location @periodics {
>
> 位置 @periodics {
>     # to be run at 1 minute intervals in worker process 0｜在工作流程 0 中以 1 分鐘的間隔執行
>     js_periodic main.handler interval=60s;
> 
>     # to be run at 1 minute intervals in all worker processes｜在所有工作進程中，每隔 1 分鐘運行一次。
>     js_periodic main.handler interval=60s worker_affinity=all;
> 
>     # to be run at 1 minute intervals in worker processes 1 and 3｜在工作進程 1 和 3 中以 1 分鐘的間隔運行。
>     js_periodic main.handler interval=60s worker_affinity=0101;
> 
>     resolver 10.0.0.1;
>
>     解析器10.0.0.1 ;
>     js_fetch_trusted_certificate /path/to/ISRG_Root_X1.pem;
> }
> 
> example.js:
> 
> async function handler(s) {
>
> 非同步函數處理程序 {
>     let reply = await ngx.fetch('https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/');
>
>     let reply = await ngx.fetch(' https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/' );
>     let body = await reply.text();
> 
>     ngx.log(ngx.INFO, body);
>
>     ngx.log(ngx. INFO , body);
> }
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**js_preload_object** `*name.json*` \| `*name*` from `*file.json*`;``<br>` `**js_preload_object** ` *name.json* ` \| ` *name* ` from ` *file.json* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 0.7.8.

該指令出現在版本0.7.8 。

Preloads an [immutable object](#p-136) at configure time. The `name` is used as a name of the global variable though which the object is available in njs code. If the `name` is not specified, the file name will be used instead.

在配置時預先載入一個[不可變物件](#p-136)用作全域變數的名稱`name`該物件可透過該變數在njs程式碼中使用。如果未指定`name` ，則將使用檔案名稱。

> ```
> js_preload_object map.json;
> ```

Here, the `map` is used as a name while accessing the preloaded object.

在這裡， `map`用作存取預先載入物件時的名稱。

Several `js_preload_object` directives can be specified.

可以指定多個`js_preload_object`指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_set** `*$variable*` `*module.function*` [`nocache`];``<br>` `**js_set** ` *$variable* ` ` *module.function* ` [` nocache `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Sets an njs `function` for the specified `variable`. Since [0.4.0](#p-129), a module function can be referenced.

為指定的`variable`設定 njs `function` 。由於 [0.4.0](#p-129) ，可以引用模組函數。

The function is called when the variable is referenced for the first time for a given request. The exact moment depends on a [phase](#p-028) at which the variable is referenced. This can be used to perform some logic not related to variable evaluation. For example, if the variable is referenced only in the [log\_format](#p-077) directive, its handler will not be executed until the log phase. This handler can be used to do some cleanup right before the request is freed.

當給定請求首次引用該變數時，將呼叫此函數。具體時間取決於變數被引用的 [phase](#p-028) 。這可用來執行一些與變數求值無關的邏輯。例如，如果變數僅在 [log\_format](#p-077)指令中被引用，則其處理程序將在日誌階段才會執行。此處理程序可用於在請求釋放之前執行一些清理工作。

Since [0.8.6](#p-129), if an optional argument `nocache` is specified, the handler is called every time it is referenced. Due to current limitations of the [rewrite](#p-090) module, when a `nocache` variable is referenced by the [set](#p-090) directive its handler should always return a fixed-length value.

自 [0.8.6](#p-129)起，如果指定了可選參數`nocache` ，則每次引用該參數時都會呼叫處理程序。由於 [rewrite](#p-090)模組的目前限制，當 [set](#p-090)指令引用變數`nocache`時，其處理程序應始終傳回固定長度的值。

> As the `js_set` handler returns its result immediately, it supports only synchronous operations. Thus, asynchronous operations such as [r.subrequest()](#p-137) or [setTimeout()](#p-137) are not supported.
>
> 由於`js_set`處理程序會立即傳回結果，因此它僅支援同步操作。因此，諸如 [r.subrequest()](#p-137)或 [setTimeout()](#p-137)之類的非同步操作不受支援。

> The directive can be specified on the `server` and `location` level since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 指令可以在`server`和`location`級別指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_shared_dict_zone** `zone`=`*name*`:`*size*` [`timeout`=`*time*`] [`type`=`string`\|`number`] [`evict`] [`state`=`*file*`];``<br>` `**js_shared_dict_zone** `區域`=` *名稱* `:` *大小* ` [`超時`=` *時間* `] [`型`=`字串`\|`數字`] [`驅逐`] [`狀態`=` *文件* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

This directive appeared in version 0.8.0.

該指令出現在版本0.8.0 。

Sets the `*name*` and `*size*` of the shared memory zone that keeps the key-value [dictionary](#p-137) shared between worker processes.

設定共享記憶體區域的`*name*`和`*size*` ，該區域用於保存工作進程之間共享的鍵值對 [字典](#p-137) 。

By default the shared dictionary uses a string as a key and a value. The optional `type` parameter allows redefining the value type to number.

預設情況下，共享字典使用字串作為鍵和值。可選參數`type`允許將值類型重新定義為數字。

The optional `timeout` parameter sets the time in milliseconds after which all shared dictionary entries are removed from the zone. If some entries require a different removal time, it can be set with the `timeout` argument of the [add](#p-137), [incr](#p-137), and [set](#p-137) methods ([0.8.5](#p-129)).

可選參數`timeout`設定從區域中刪除所有共享字典條目的時間（以毫秒為單位）。如果某些條目需要不同的刪除時間，則可以使用 [add](#p-137) 、[(https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/changes.html#njs0.8.5)](#p-137)和 [set](#p-137)方法的`timeout`參數進行設定（[ 0.8.5 ）。

The optional `evict` parameter removes the oldest key-value pair when the zone storage is exhausted.

可選參數`evict`在區域儲存耗盡時刪除最舊的鍵值對。

The optional `state` parameter specifies a `*file*` that keeps the shared dictionary state in JSON format and makes it persistent across nginx restarts ([0.9.1](#p-129)).

可選的`state`參數指定一個`*file*`該參數以JSON格式保持共享字典狀態，並使其在 nginx 重啟後持久存在 ([0.9.1](#p-129) )。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> example.conf:
>     # Creates a 1Mb dictionary with string values,｜建立一個包含字串值的 1MB 字典，
>     # removes key-value pairs after 60 seconds of inactivity:｜鍵值對在 60 秒無活動後刪除：
>     js_shared_dict_zone zone=foo:1M timeout=60s;
> 
>     # Creates a 512Kb dictionary with string values,｜建立一個包含字串值的 512Kb 字典，
>     # forcibly removes oldest key-value pairs when the zone is exhausted:｜當區域耗盡時，強制刪除最舊的鍵值對：
>     js_shared_dict_zone zone=bar:512K timeout=30s evict;
> 
>     # Creates a 32Kb permanent dictionary with number values:｜建立一個 32Kb 的永久字典，其中包含數值：
>     js_shared_dict_zone zone=num:32k type=number;
> 
>     # Creates a 1Mb dictionary with string values and persistent state:｜建立一個包含字串值和持久狀態的 1MB 字典：
>     js_shared_dict_zone zone=persistent:1M state=/tmp/dict.json;
> 
> example.js:
>     function get(r) {
>
>     函數 get(r) {
>         r.return(200, ngx.shared.foo.get(r.args.key));
>     }
> 
>     function set(r) {
>
>     函數 set(r) {
>         r.return(200, ngx.shared.foo.set(r.args.key, r.args.value));
>     }
> 
>     function del(r) {
>
>     函數 del(r) {
>         r.return(200, ngx.shared.bar.delete(r.args.key));
>     }
> 
>     function increment(r) {
>
>     函數 increment(r) {
>         r.return(200, ngx.shared.num.incr(r.args.key, 2));
>     }
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_var** `*$variable*` [`*value*`];``<br>` `**js_var** ` *$變數* ` [` *值* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 0.5.3.

該指令出現在版本0.5.3 。

Declares a [writable](#p-137) variable. The value can contain text, variables, and their combination. The variable is not overwritten after a redirect unlike variables created with the [set](#p-090) directive.

聲明一個(https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/reference.html#r_variables)寫的變數。此變數的值可以包含文字、變數及其組合。與使用 `[set](#p-090)指令建立的變數不同，重定向後該變數不會被覆寫。

> The directive can be specified on the `server` and `location` level since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 指令可以在`server`和`location`級別指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

**Request Argument｜請求參數**

Each HTTP njs handler receives one argument, a request [object](#p-137).

每個HTTP njs 處理程序接收一個參數，即請求 [物件](#p-137) 。

<a id="p-074"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_keyval_module｜模組 ngx_http_keyval_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_keyval_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_keyval\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_keyval\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-074)<br>[Directives](#p-074)<br>     [keyval](#p-074)<br>     [keyval\_zone](#p-074)<br>[範例設定](#p-074)<br>[指令](#p-074)<br>     [keyval](#p-074)<br>     [keyval\_zone](#p-074) |

The `ngx_http_keyval_module` module (1.13.3) creates variables with values taken from key-value pairs managed by the [API](#p-048) or a variable (1.15.10) that can also be set with [njs](https://github.com/nginx/njs-examples/#logging-the-number-of-requests-per-client-http-logging-num-requests).

`ngx_http_keyval_module`模組 (1.13.3) 建立變量，其值取自 [API](#p-048)管理的鍵值對，或也可使用 [njs](https://github.com/nginx/njs-examples/#logging-the-number-of-requests-per-client-http-logging-num-requests)設定變數 (1.15.10)。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> http {
> 
>     keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/lib/nginx/state/one.keyval;
>     keyval $arg_text $text zone=one;
>     ...
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         ...
>         location / {
>
>         地點 / {
>             return 200 $text;
>
>             返回 200 $text;
>         }
> 
>         location /api {
>             api write=on;
>         }
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**keyval** `*key*` `*$variable*` `zone`=`*name*`;``<br>``**keyval** `*鍵*` `*$變數*` `區域`=`*名稱*`;`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>上下文： | `http` |

Creates a new `*$variable*` whose value is looked up by the `*key*` in the key-value database. Matching rules are defined by the [`type`](#p-074) parameter of the [`keyval_zone`](#p-074) directive. The database is stored in a shared memory zone specified by the `zone` parameter.

建立一個新的`*$variable*`，其值由`*key*`在鍵值資料庫中尋找。匹配規則由 [`keyval_zone`](#p-074) 指令的 [`type`](#p-074) 參數定義。資料庫儲存在`zone`參數指定的共享記憶體區域。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**keyval_zone** `zone`=`*name*`:`*size*` [`state`=`*file*`] [`timeout`=`*time*`] [`type`=`string`\|`ip`\|`prefix`] [`sync`];``<br>``**keyval_zone** `區域`=`*名稱*`:`*大小*` [`狀態`=`*檔案*`] [`逾時t `=`*時間*`] [`型`=`字串`\|`ip`\|`字首`] [`同步`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>上下文： | `http` |

Sets the `*name*` and `*size*` of the shared memory zone that keeps the key-value database. Key-value pairs are managed by the [API](#p-048).

設定保存鍵值資料庫的共享記憶體區域的`*name*`和`*size*`。鍵值對由[API](#p-048)管理。

The optional `state` parameter specifies a `*file*` that keeps the current state of the key-value database in the JSON format and makes it persistent across nginx restarts. Changing the file content directly should be avoided.

可選的`state`參數指定一個`*file*`，它將鍵值資料庫的當前狀態保持為JSON格式，並使其在nginx重新啟動後保持不變。應避免直接更改文件內容。

Examples:

範例：

> ```
> keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/lib/nginx/state/one.keyval; # path for Linux
>
> keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/lib/nginx/state/one.keyval; # Linux 的路徑
> keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/db/nginx/state/one.keyval;  # path for FreeBSD
>
> keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/db/nginx/state/one.keyval; # FreeBSD 的路徑
> ```

The optional `timeout` parameter (1.15.0) sets the time after which key-value pairs are removed from the zone.

可選的 `timeout` 參數 (1.15.0) 設定從區域中刪除鍵值對之前的時間。

The optional `type` parameter (1.17.1) activates an extra index optimized for matching the key of a certain type and defines matching rules when evaluating a [keyval](#p-074) `$variable`.

可選的`type`參數（1.17.1）啟動一個額外的索引，優化用於匹配某種類型的鍵，並定義評估[keyval](#p-074) `$variable`時的匹配規則。

> The index is stored in the same shared memory zone and thus requires additional storage.
>
> 索引儲存在同一共享記憶體區域中，因此需要額外的儲存空間。

`type=string`

default, no index is enabled; variable lookup is performed using exact match of the record key and a search key

預設不啟用索引；使用記錄鍵和搜尋鍵的精確匹配來執行變數查找

`type=ip`

the search key is the textual representation of IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range; to match a record key, the search key must belong to a subnet specified by a record key or exactly match an IP address

搜尋關鍵字是 IPv4 或 IPv6 位址或CIDR範圍的文字表示；要匹配記錄鍵，搜尋鍵必須屬於記錄鍵指定的子網路或與IP位址完全匹配

`type=prefix`

variable lookup is performed using prefix match of a record key and a search key (1.17.5); to match a record key, the record key must be a prefix of the search key

使用記錄鍵和搜尋鍵的前綴匹配來執行變數查找（1.17.5）；要匹配記錄鍵，記錄鍵必須是搜尋鍵的前綴

The optional `sync` parameter (1.15.0) enables [synchronization](#p-164) of the shared memory zone. The synchronization requires the `timeout` parameter to be set.

可選的`sync`參數（1.15.0）啟用共享記憶體區域的[同步](#p-164)。同步需要設定`timeout`參數。

> If the synchronization is enabled, removal of key-value pairs (no matter [one](#p-048) or [all](#p-048)) will be performed only on a target cluster node. The same key-value pairs on other cluster nodes will be removed upon `timeout`.
>
> 如果啟用同步，則只會在目標叢集節點上刪除鍵值對（無論是[one](#p-048)或[all](#p-048)）。其他叢集節點上的相同鍵值對將在`timeout`時被刪除。
