<a id="p-084"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_perl_module｜模組 ngx_http_perl_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_perl_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_perl\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_perl\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Known Issues](#p-084)<br>[Example Configuration](#p-084)<br>[Directives](#p-084)<br>     [perl](#p-084)<br>     [perl\_modules](#p-084)<br>     [perl\_require](#p-084)<br>     [perl\_set](#p-084)<br>[Calling Perl from SSI](#p-084)<br>[The $r Request Object Methods](#p-084)<br>[已知問題](#p-084)<br>[範例設定](#p-084)<br>[指令](#p-084)<br>     [perl](#p-084)<br>     [perl\_m odules](#p-084)<br>     [perl\_require](#p-084)<br>     [perl\_set](#p-084)<br>[調用Perl來自 SSI](#p-084)<br>[$r 請求物件方法](#p-084) |

The `ngx_http_perl_module` module is used to implement location and variable handlers in Perl and insert Perl calls into SSI.

`ngx_http_perl_module`模組用於在 Perl 中實現位置和變數處理程序，並將 Perl 呼叫插入到SSI中。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_perl_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_perl_module`配置參數啟用。

> This module requires [Perl](https://www.perl.org/get.html) version 5.6.1 or higher. The C compiler should be compatible with the one used to build Perl.
>
> 本模組需要 Perl 版本(https://www.perl.org/get.html)或更高版本5.6.1編譯器應與用於建置 Perl 的編譯器相容。

**Known Issues｜已知問題**

The module is experimental, caveat emptor applies.

此模組為實驗性模組，請自行承擔風險。

In order for Perl to recompile the modified modules during reconfiguration, it should be built with the `-Dusemultiplicity=yes` or `-Dusethreads=yes` parameters. Also, to make Perl leak less memory at run time, it should be built with the `-Dusemymalloc=no` parameter. To check the values of these parameters in an already built Perl (preferred values are specified in the example), run:

為了使 Perl 在重新配置期間重新編譯修改後的模組，應該使用`-Dusemultiplicity=yes`或`-Dusethreads=yes`參數進行建置。此外，為了減少 Perl 在運行時的記憶體洩漏，應該使用`-Dusemymalloc=no`參數進行建置。若要檢查已建置的 Perl 中這些參數的值（範例中指定了建議值），請執行：

> ```bash
>
> 『`bash
> $ perl -V:usemultiplicity -V:usemymalloc
> usemultiplicity='define';
> usemymalloc='n';
> ```

Note that after rebuilding Perl with the new `-Dusemultiplicity=yes` or `-Dusethreads=yes` parameters, all binary Perl modules will have to be rebuilt as well — they will just stop working with the new Perl.

請注意，在使用新的`-Dusemultiplicity=yes`或`-Dusethreads=yes`參數重新建構 Perl 後，所有二進位 Perl 模組也必須重新建置——它們將不再與新的 Perl 一起使用。

There is a possibility that the main process and then worker processes will grow in size after every reconfiguration. If the main process grows to an unacceptable size, the [live upgrade](#p-026) procedure can be applied without changing the executable file.

每次重新配置後，主進程及其後續工作進程的大小都有可能成長。如果主進程成長到無法接受的大小，可以在不更改執行檔的情況下套用 [線上升級](#p-026)程式。

While the Perl module is performing a long-running operation, such as resolving a domain name, connecting to another server, or querying a database, other requests assigned to the current worker process will not be processed. It is thus recommended to perform only such operations that have predictable and short execution time, such as accessing the local file system.

當 Perl 模組執行耗時較長的操作（例如解析網域名稱、連接到其他伺服器或查詢資料庫）時，指派給目前工作進程的其他請求將不會被處理。因此，建議僅執行執行時間可預測且較短的操作，例如存取本機檔案系統。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> http {
> 
>     perl_modules perl/lib;
>     perl_require hello.pm;
> 
>     perl_set $msie6 '
> 
>         sub {
>
>         子 {
>             my $r = shift;
>
>             我的 $r = shift;
>             my $ua = $r->header_in("User-Agent"（使用者代理）);
>
>             my $ua = $r->header_in( "User-Agent"（使用者代理） );
> 
>             return "" if $ua =~ /Opera/;
>
>             如果 $ua =~ /Opera/，則回傳「」；
>             return "1" if $ua =~ / MSIE [6-9]\.\d+/;
>
>             如果 $ua =~ / MSIE [6-9]\.\d+/，則回傳「1」；
>             return "";
>
>             返回 ””;
>         }
> 
>     ';
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         location / {
>
>         地點 / {
>             perl hello::handler;
>         }
>     }
> ```

The `perl/lib/hello.pm` module:

`perl/lib/hello.pm`模組：

> ```
> package hello;
>
> 打包 hello;
> 
> use nginx;
>
> 使用 nginx；
> 
> sub handler {
>
> 子處理程序{
>     my $r = shift;
>
>     我的 $r = shift;
> 
>     $r->send_http_header("text/html");
>     return OK if $r->header_only;
>
>     如果 $r->header_only，則回傳OK ；
> 
>     $r->print("hello!\n<br/>");
>
>     $r->print("你好！\n <br/> ");
> 
>     if (-f $r->filename or -d _) {
>
>     如果 (-f $r->filename 或 -d _) {
>         $r->print($r->uri, " exists!\n");
>
>         $r->print($r->uri, " 存在！\n");
>     }
> 
>     return OK;
>
>     返回OK ；
> }
> 
> 1;
> __END__
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

為給定位置設定 Perl 處理程序。

為 Perl 模組設定額外的路徑。

Defines the name of a module that will be loaded during each reconfiguration. Several `perl_require` directives can be present.

定義每次重新配置期間要載入的模組的名稱。可以存在多個`perl_require`指令。

|   |   |

Installs a Perl handler for the specified variable.

為指定的變數安裝 Perl 處理程序。

**Calling Perl from SSI｜從SSI呼叫 Perl**

An SSI command calling Perl has the following format:

呼叫 Perl 的SSI指令格式如下：

> ```xml
> <!--# perl sub="module::function" arg="parameter1" arg="parameter2" ...
> -->
> ```

**The $r Request Object Methods｜$r 請求物件方法**

`$r->args`

returns request arguments.

返回請求參數。

`$r->filename`

returns a filename corresponding to the request URI.

傳回與請求URI對應的檔名。

``$r->has_request_body(`*handler*`)``

` `$r->has_request_body(` *處理程序* `)` `

returns 0 if there is no body in a request. If there is a body, the specified handler is set for the request and 1 is returned. After reading the request body, nginx will call the specified handler. Note that the handler function should be passed by reference. Example:

如果請求體為空，則傳回 0。如果請求體存在，則會為該請求設定指定的處理程序，並傳回 1。 nginx 讀取請求體後，將呼叫指定的處理程序。請注意，處理程序函數應按引用傳遞。例如：

> ```
> package hello;
>
> 打包 hello;
> 
> use nginx;
>
> 使用 nginx；
> 
> sub handler {
>
> 子處理程序{
>     my $r = shift;
>
>     我的 $r = shift;
> 
>     if ($r->request_method ne "POST"（郵政）) {
>
>     如果 ($r->request_method 不等於"POST"（郵政） ) {
>         return DECLINED;
>
>         返回DECLINED ；
>     }
> 
>     if ($r->has_request_body(\&post)) {
>         return OK;
>
>         返回OK ；
>     }
> 
>     return HTTP_BAD_REQUEST;
>
>     返回 HTTP_BAD_REQUEST；
> }
> 
> sub post {
>
> 子帖子{
>     my $r = shift;
>
>     我的 $r = shift;
> 
>     $r->send_http_header;
> 
>     $r->print("request_body: \"", $r->request_body, "\"<br/>");
>
>     $r->print("request_body: \"", $r->request_body, "\" <br/> ");
>     $r->print("request_body_file: \"", $r->request_body_file, "\"<br/>\n");
>
>     $r->print("request_body_file: \"", $r->request_body_file, "\" <br/> \n");
> 
>     return OK;
>
>     返回OK ；
> }
> 
> 1;
> 
> __END__
> ```

`$r->allow_ranges`

enables the use of byte ranges when sending responses.

允許在發送回應時使用位元組範圍。

`$r->discard_request_body`

instructs nginx to discard the request body.

指示 nginx 丟棄請求體。

``$r->header_in(`*field*`)``

` `$r->header_in(` *字段* `)` `

returns the value of the specified client request header field.

傳回指定客戶端請求頭字段的值。

`$r->header_only`

determines whether the whole response or only its header should be sent to the client.

決定是將整個回應還是僅將回應頭髮送給客戶端。

``$r->header_out(`*field*`, `*value*`)``

` `$r->header_out(` *字段* `, ` *值* `)` `

sets a value for the specified response header field.

設定指定響應頭欄位的值。

``$r->internal_redirect(`*uri*`)``

` `$r->internal_redirect(` *嘆氣* `)` `

does an internal redirect to the specified `*uri*`. An actual redirect happens after the Perl handler execution is completed.

執行內部重定向到指定的`*uri*` 。實際重定向發生在 Perl 處理程序執行完成後。

> Since version 1.17.2, the method accepts escaped URIs and supports redirections to named locations.
>
> 自版本1.17.2起，該方法接受轉義的URI，並支援重定向到命名位置。

``$r->log_error(`*errno*`, `*message*`)``

` `$r->log_error(` *errno* `, ` *message* `)` `

writes the specified `*message*` into the [error\_log](#p-125). If `*errno*` is non-zero, an error code and its description will be appended to the message.

將指定的`*message*`寫入 [error\_log](#p-125) 。如果`*errno*`非零，則會將錯誤代碼及其描述附加到訊息中。

``$r->print(`*text*`, ...)``

` `$r->print(` *文本* `, ...)` `

passes data to a client.

將資料傳遞給客戶端。

`$r->request_body`

returns the client request body if it has not been written to a temporary file. To ensure that the client request body is in memory, its size should be limited by [client\_max\_body\_size](#p-056), and a sufficient buffer size should be set using [client\_body\_buffer\_size](#p-056).

如果用戶端請求體尚未寫入臨時文件，則傳回客戶端請求體。為確保客戶端請求體位於記憶體中，其大小應受 [client\_max\_body\_size](#p-056)的限制，並且應使用 [client\_body\_buffer\_size](#p-056)設定足夠的緩衝區大小。

`$r->request_body_file`

returns the name of the file with the client request body. After the processing, the file should be removed. To always write a request body to a file, [client\_body\_in\_file\_only](#p-056) should be enabled.

傳回包含客戶端請求正文的檔案名稱。處理完成後，該文件應被刪除。若要始終將請求正文寫入文件，應啟用 [client\_body\_in\_file\_only](#p-056) 。

`$r->request_method`

returns the client request HTTP method.

返回客戶端請求HTTP方法。

`$r->remote_addr`

returns the client IP address.

返回客戶端IP位址。

`$r->flush`

immediately sends data to the client.

立即將資料傳送給客戶端。

``$r->sendfile(`*name*`[, `*offset*`[, `*length*`]])``

` `$r->sendfile(` *名稱* `[, ` *偏移量* `[, ` *長度* `]])` `

sends the specified file content to the client. Optional parameters specify the initial offset and length of the data to be transmitted. The actual data transmission happens after the Perl handler has completed.

將指定的文件內容傳送給客戶端。可選參數指定要傳輸的資料的初始偏移量和長度。實際的資料傳輸在 Perl 處理程序完成後進行。

``$r->send_http_header([`*type*`])``

` `$r->send_http_header([` *類型* `])` `

sends the response header to the client. The optional `*type*` parameter sets the value of the “Content-Type”（內容類型） response header field. If the value is an empty string, the “Content-Type”（內容類型） header field will not be sent.

向客戶端發送回應頭。可選參數`*type*`用於設定“Content-Type”（內容類型）響應頭字段的值。如果該值為空字串，則不會傳送“Content-Type”（內容類型）回應頭欄位。

``$r->status(`*code*`)``

` `$r->status(` *代碼* `)` `

sets a response code.

設定響應代碼。

``$r->sleep(`*milliseconds*`, `*handler*`)``

` `$r->sleep(` *毫秒* `, ` *處理程序* `)` `

sets the specified handler and stops request processing for the specified time. In the meantime, nginx continues to process other requests. After the specified time has elapsed, nginx will call the installed handler. Note that the handler function should be passed by reference. In order to pass data between handlers, `$r->variable()` should be used. Example:

設定指定的處理程序，並停止請求處理一段時間。在此期間，nginx 會繼續處理其他要求。指定時間過後，nginx 將呼叫已安裝的處理程序。請注意，處理程序函數應按引用傳遞。要在處理程序之間傳遞數據，應使用`$r->variable()` 。範例：

> ```
> package hello;
>
> 打包 hello;
> 
> use nginx;
>
> 使用 nginx；
> 
> sub handler {
>
> 子處理程序{
>     my $r = shift;
>
>     我的 $r = shift;
> 
>     $r->discard_request_body;
>     $r->variable("var", "OK"（好的）);
>
>     $r->variable("var", "OK"（好的） );
>     $r->sleep(1000, \&next);
> 
>     return OK;
>
>     返回OK ；
> }
> 
> sub next {
>
> 子程序下一個{
>     my $r = shift;
>
>     我的 $r = shift;
> 
>     $r->send_http_header;
>     $r->print($r->variable("var"));
> 
>     return OK;
>
>     返回OK ；
> }
> 
> 1;
> 
> __END__
> ```

``$r->unescape(`*text*`)``

` `$r->unescape(` *文本* `)` `

decodes a text encoded in the “%XX” form.

解碼以「% XX 」形式編碼的文字。

`$r->uri`

returns a request URI.

返回請求URI 。

``$r->variable(`*name*`[, `*value*`])``

` `$r->variable(` *名稱* `[, ` *值* `])` `

returns or sets the value of the specified variable. Variables are local to each request.

傳回或設定指定變數的值。變數在每個請求中都是局部的。

Variables](#p-085) |

The `ngx_http_proxy_module` module allows passing requests to another server.

`ngx_http_proxy_module`模組允許將請求傳遞給另一個伺服器。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     proxy_pass       http://localhost:8000;
>
>     proxy_pass http://localhost:8000;
>     proxy_set_header Host      $host;
>
>     proxy_set_header Host $host;
>     proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
>
>     proxy_set_header X-Real- IP $remote_addr;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_allow_upstream** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**proxy_allow_upstream** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

Defines conditions under which access to a proxied server is allowed or [denied](#p-085). If all string parameters are not empty and not equal to “0” then the access is allowed. The conditions are evaluated each time before a connection to a proxied server is established. Parameter values can contain variables:

定義允許或拒絕存取代理伺服器的條件(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#denied) 。如果所有字串參數均不為空且不等於“0”，則允許存取。每次建立與代理伺服器的連線之前都會評估這些條件。參數值可以包含變數：

> ```
> geo $upstream_last_addr $allow {
>     volatile;
>
>     易揮發的;
>     10.10.0.0/24        1;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>     聽127.0.0.1:8080 ;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         proxy_pass           localhost:8000;
>
>         proxy_pass localhost:8000;
>         proxy_allow_upstream $allow;
>         ...
>     }
> }
> ```

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_bind** `*address*` [`transparent`] \| `off`;``<br>` `**proxy_bind** ` *地址* ` [`透明`] \| `關閉`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 0.8.22.

該指令出現在版本0.8.22 。

Makes outgoing connections to a proxied server originate from the specified local IP address with an optional port (1.11.2). Parameter value can contain variables (1.3.12). The special value `off` (1.3.12) cancels the effect of the `proxy_bind` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows the system to auto-assign the local IP address and port.

使發送至代理伺服器的出站連線源自指定的本機位址IP ，並可選擇指定連接埠（ 1.11.2 ）。參數值可以包含變數（ 1.3.12 ）。特殊值`off` （ 1.3.12 ）會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`proxy_bind`指令的效果，該指令允許系統自動分配本地位址IP和連接埠。

The `transparent` parameter (1.11.0) allows outgoing connections to a proxied server originate from a non-local IP address, for example, from a real IP address of a client:

`transparent`參數 ( 1.11.0 ) 允許到代理伺服器的出站連線源自非本地IP位址，例如，源自客戶端的真實IP位址：

> ```
> proxy_bind $remote_addr transparent;
> ```

In order for this parameter to work, it is usually necessary to run nginx worker processes with the [superuser](#p-125) privileges. On Linux it is not required (1.13.8) as if the `transparent` parameter is specified, worker processes inherit the `CAP_NET_RAW` capability from the master process. It is also necessary to configure kernel routing table to intercept network traffic from the proxied server.

為了使此參數生效，通常需要以 [superuser](#p-125)權限執行 nginx 工作進程。在 Linux 系統上則無需此權限 ( 1.13.8 )，因為如果指定了`transparent`參數，工作進程會從主進程繼承`CAP_NET_RAW`權限。此外，還需要配置核心路由表以攔截來自代理伺服器的網路流量。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_bind_dynamic</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_bind_dynamic off;<br>proxy_bind_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

When enabled, makes the [bind](#p-085) operation at each connection attempt.

啟用後，每次連線嘗試時執行 [bind](#p-085)操作。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_buffer_size 4k|8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading the first part of the response received from the proxied server. This part usually contains a small response header; if it exceeds the buffer size, the response is considered [invalid](#p-085). By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform. It can be made smaller, however.

設定用於讀取從代理伺服器收到的回應第一部分的緩衝區大小`*size*` 。這部分通常包含一個較小的響應頭；如果響應頭大小超過緩衝區大小，則該響應被視為無效（ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#invalid_header) ）。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台的不同，該大小為 4K 或 8K。不過，可以將其減小。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_buffering</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_buffering on;<br>啟用代理緩衝；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables buffering of responses from the proxied server.

啟用或停用代理伺服器回應的緩衝。

When buffering is enabled, nginx receives a response from the proxied server as soon as possible, saving it into the buffers set by the [proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-085) and [proxy\_buffers](#p-085) directives. If the whole response does not fit into memory, a part of it can be saved to a [temporary file](#p-085) on the disk. Writing to temporary files is controlled by the [proxy\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-085) and [proxy\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-085) directives.

啟用緩衝後，nginx 會盡快從代理伺服器接收回應，並將其儲存到由 `[proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-085)和 `[proxy\_buffers](#p-085)指令設定的緩衝區中。如果整個回應無法放入內存，則可以將其一部分儲存到磁碟上的暫存檔案 `[temporary file](#p-085)中。寫入暫存檔案的操作由 `[proxy\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-085)和 `[proxy\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-085)指令控制。

When buffering is disabled, the response is passed to a client synchronously, immediately as it is received. nginx will not try to read the whole response from the proxied server. The maximum size of the data that nginx can receive from the server at a time is set by the [proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-085) directive.

停用緩衝後，回應會同步地立即傳遞給客戶端。 nginx 不會嘗試從代理伺服器讀取整個回應。 nginx 一次可以從伺服器接收的最大資料大小由 [proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-085)指令設定。

Buffering can also be enabled or disabled by passing “`yes`” or “`no`” in the “X-Accel-Buffering” response header field. This capability can be disabled using the [proxy\_ignore\_headers](#p-085) directive.

也可以透過在“X-Accel-Buffering”響應頭字段中傳遞「 `yes` 」或「 `no` 」來啟用或停用緩衝。可以使用 [proxy\_ignore\_headers](#p-085)指令停用此功能。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_buffers</strong> <code><i>number</i></code> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_buffers 8 4k|8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*number*` and `*size*` of the buffers used for reading a response from the proxied server, for a single connection. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform.

設定用於從代理伺服器讀取回應的緩衝區`*number*`和`*size*`的值，適用於單一連線。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台不同，該值可以是 4K 或 8K。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_busy_buffers_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_busy_buffers_size 8k|16k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

When [buffering](#p-085) of responses from the proxied server is enabled, limits the total `*size*` of buffers that can be busy sending a response to the client while the response is not yet fully read. In the meantime, the rest of the buffers can be used for reading the response and, if needed, buffering part of the response to a temporary file. By default, `*size*` is limited by the size of two buffers set by the [proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-085) and [proxy\_buffers](#p-085) directives.

啟用代理伺服器回應緩衝功能後，會限制用於向客戶端發送回應的`*size*`總數(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_buffering) ），直到客戶端完全讀取回應為止。在此期間，其餘緩衝區可用於讀取回應，並在需要時將部分回應緩衝到暫存檔案。預設情況下，緩衝區大小(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_buffer_size) `*size*` [proxy_buffers](#p-085)指令設定的兩個緩衝區大小的限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache</strong> <code><i>zone</i></code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache off;<br>代理快取關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a shared memory zone used for caching. The same zone can be used in several places. Parameter value can contain variables (1.7.9). The `off` parameter disables caching inherited from the previous configuration level.

定義用於快取的共享記憶體區域。同一區域可以在多個地方使用。參數值可以包含變數(1.7.9)。 `off` 參數停用從先前配置等級繼承的快取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_background_update</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_background_update off;<br>proxy_cache_background_update 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.11.10.

該指令出現在版本1.11.10 。

Allows starting a background subrequest to update an expired cache item, while a stale cached response is returned to the client. Note that it is necessary to [allow](#p-085) the usage of a stale cached response when it is being updated.

允許啟動後台子請求來更新已過期的快取項，同時向客戶端傳回過時的快取回應。請注意，在更新快取項目時，必須允許使用過時的快取回應（請參閱(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_cache_use_stale_updating) ）。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_cache_bypass** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**proxy_cache_bypass** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines conditions under which the response will not be taken from a cache. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the response will not be taken from the cache:

定義不從快取中取得回應的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則不會從快取中取得回應：

> ```
> proxy_cache_bypass $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment;
>
> proxy_cache_bypass $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment；
> proxy_cache_bypass $http_pragma    $http_authorization;
>
> proxy_cache_bypass $http_pragma $http_authorization;
> ```

Can be used along with the [proxy\_no\_cache](#p-085) directive.

可與 [proxy\_no\_cache](#p-085)指令一起使用。

<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_convert_head</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_convert_head on;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.9.7.

該指令出現在版本1.9.7 。

Enables or disables the conversion of the “`HEAD`” method to “`GET`” for caching. When the conversion is disabled, the [cache key](#p-085) should be configured to include the `$request_method`.

啟用或停用將“ `HEAD` ”方法轉換為“ `GET` ”以進行快取。停用轉換時，應將[快取鍵](#p-085)配置為包含`$request_method` 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_key</strong> <code><i>string</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_key $scheme$proxy_host$request_uri;</td></tr>

</table>

Defines a key for caching, for example

定義一個用於快取的鍵，例如

> ```
> proxy_cache_key "$host$request_uri $cookie_user";
> ```

By default, the directive’s value is close to the string

預設情況下，指令的值接近字串

> ```
> proxy_cache_key $scheme$proxy_host$uri$is_args$args;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_lock</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_lock off;<br>proxy_cache_lock 關閉；</td></tr>

</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.12.

該指令出現在版本1.1.12 。

When enabled, only one request at a time will be allowed to populate a new cache element identified according to the [proxy\_cache\_key](#p-085) directive by passing a request to a proxied server. Other requests of the same cache element will either wait for a response to appear in the cache or the cache lock for this element to be released, up to the time set by the [proxy\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-085) directive.

啟用此功能後，每次只允許一個請求透過向代理伺服器發送請求來填入根據 [proxy\_cache\_key](#p-085)指令標識的新快取元素。對相同快取元素的其他請求將等待快取中出現回應或該元素的快取鎖定被釋放，直到 [proxy\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-085)指令設定的逾時時間結束。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_lock_age</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_lock_age 5s;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.8.

該指令出現在版本1.7.8 。

If the last request passed to the proxied server for populating a new cache element has not completed for the specified `*time*`, one more request may be passed to the proxied server.

如果向代理伺服器發送的用於填充新快取元素的最後一個請求在指定的`*time*`時間內尚未完成，則可以向代理伺服器發送另一個請求。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_lock_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_lock_timeout 5s;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.12.

該指令出現在版本1.1.12 。

Sets a timeout for [proxy\_cache\_lock](#p-085). When the `*time*` expires, the request will be passed to the proxied server, however, the response will not be cached.

設定 [proxy\_cache\_lock](#p-085)的超時時間。當`*time*`過期時，請求將被傳遞到代理伺服器，但回應不會被快取。

> Before 1.7.8, the response could be cached.
>
> 在1.7.8之前，響應可以被快取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_cache_max_range_offset** `*number*`;``<br>` `**proxy_cache_max_range_offset** ` *數字* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.6.

該指令出現在版本1.11.6 。

Sets an offset in bytes for byte-range requests. If the range is beyond the offset, the range request will be passed to the proxied server and the response will not be cached.

設定位元組範圍請求的位元組偏移量。如果請求範圍超出偏移量，則該範圍請求將傳遞給代理伺服器，並且回應不會被快取。

<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_methods</strong> <code>GET</code> | <code>HEAD</code> | <code>POST</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_methods GET HEAD;</td></tr>
