</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.7.59.

該指令出現在版本0.7.59 。

If the client request method is listed in this directive then the response will be cached. “`GET`” and “`HEAD`” methods are always added to the list, though it is recommended to specify them explicitly. See also the [proxy\_no\_cache](#p-085) directive.

如果客戶端請求方法列在此指令中，則回應將被快取。 「 `GET` 」和「 `HEAD` 」方法總是會加入到清單中，但建議明確指定它們。另請參閱[proxy\_no\_cache](#p-085)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_min_uses</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_min_uses 1;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*number*` of requests after which the response will be cached.

設定回應快取的`*number*`請求數。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_cache_path** `*path*` [`levels`=`*levels*`] [`use_temp_path`=`on`\|`off`] `keys_zone`=`*name*`:`*size*` [`inactive`=`*time*`] [`max_size`=`*size*`] [`min_free`=`*size*`] [`manager_files`=`*number*`] [`manager_sleep`=`*time*`] [`manager_threshold`=`*time*`] [`loader_files`=`*number*`] [`loader_sleep`=`*time*`] [`loader_threshold`=`*time*`] [`purger`=`on`\|`off`] [`purger_files`=`*number*`] [`purger_sleep`=`*time*`] [`purger_threshold`=`*time*`];``<br>``**proxy_cache_path** `*小路*` [`等級`=`*級別*`] [`使用臨時路徑`=`在`\|`離開`] `鑰匙區`=`*姓名*`:`*尺寸*` [`不活躍`=`*時間*`] [`最大尺寸`=`*尺寸*`] [`最小空閒`=`*尺寸*`] [`管理器文件`=`*數字*`] [`經理睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`經理閾值`=`*時間*`] [`載入器文件`=`*數字*`] [`載入器睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`載入器閾值`=`*時間*`] [`清除`=`在`\|`離開`] [`清除文件`=`*數字*`] [`清除睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`淨化閾值`=`*時間*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Sets the path and other parameters of a cache. Cache data are stored in files. The file name in a cache is a result of applying the MD5 function to the [cache key](#p-085). The `levels` parameter defines hierarchy levels of a cache: from 1 to 3, each level accepts values 1 or 2. For example, in the following configuration

設定快取的路徑和其他參數。快取資料儲存在文件中。快取中的檔名是將MD5函數套用到[快取鍵](#p-085)的結果。 `levels`參數定義了快取的層次結構層級：從1到3，每個層級接受值1或2。例如，在以下配置中

> ```
> proxy_cache_path /data/nginx/cache levels=1:2 keys_zone=one:10m;
> ```

file names in a cache will look like this:

快取中的檔案名稱將如下所示：

> ```
> /data/nginx/cache/c/29/b7f54b2df7773722d382f4809d65029c
>
> /data/nginx/cache/c/29/ b7f54b2df7773722d382f4809d65029c
> ```

A cached response is first written to a temporary file, and then the file is renamed. Starting from version 0.8.9, temporary files and the cache can be put on different file systems. However, be aware that in this case a file is copied across two file systems instead of the cheap renaming operation. It is thus recommended that for any given location both cache and a directory holding temporary files are put on the same file system. The directory for temporary files is set based on the `use_temp_path` parameter (1.7.10). If this parameter is omitted or set to the value `on`, the directory set by the [proxy\_temp\_path](#p-085) directive for the given location will be used. If the value is set to `off`, temporary files will be put directly in the cache directory.

快取的回應首先寫入臨時文件，然後重新命名該文件。從版本0.8.9開始，臨時檔案和快取可以位於不同的檔案系統上。但是請注意，在這種情況下，檔案會被複製到兩個檔案系統上，而不是進行簡單的重新命名操作。因此，建議對於任何給定的位置，快取和存放臨時檔案的目錄都位於同一檔案系統上。暫存檔案的目錄依`use_temp_path`參數（ 1.7.10 ）設定。如果省略此參數或將其設為`on`值，則將使用 [proxy\_temp\_path](#p-085)指令為給定位置設定的目錄。如果將其設定為`off`值，則暫存檔案將直接放置在快取目錄中。

In addition, all active keys and information about data are stored in a shared memory zone, whose `*name*` and `*size*` are configured by the `keys_zone` parameter. One megabyte zone can store about 8 thousand keys.

此外，所有活動金鑰和資料資訊都儲存在一個共享記憶體區域中，該區域的`*name*`和`*size*`由`keys_zone`參數配置。一個兆位元組的區域大約可以儲存8000個密鑰。

> As part of [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx), the shared memory zone also stores extended cache [information](#p-048), thus, it is required to specify a larger zone size for the same number of keys. For example, one megabyte zone can store about 4 thousand keys.
>
> 作為[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，共享記憶體區域也會儲存擴充快取[資訊](#p-048) ，因此，對於相同數量的鍵，需要指定更大的區域大小。例如，1兆位元組的區域大約可以儲存4000個鍵。

Cached data that are not accessed during the time specified by the `inactive` parameter get removed from the cache regardless of their freshness. By default, `inactive` is set to 10 minutes.

在`inactive`參數指定的時間內未存取的快取資料將從快取中刪除，無論其新鮮度為何。預設情況下，`inactive` 設定為 10 分鐘。

The special “cache manager” process monitors the maximum cache size set by the `max_size` parameter, and the minimum amount of free space set by the `min_free` (1.19.1) parameter on the file system with cache. When the size is exceeded or there is not enough free space, it removes the least recently used data. The data is removed in iterations configured by `manager_files`, `manager_threshold`, and `manager_sleep` parameters (1.11.5). During one iteration no more than `manager_files` items are deleted (by default, 100). The duration of one iteration is limited by the `manager_threshold` parameter (by default, 200 milliseconds). Between iterations, a pause configured by the `manager_sleep` parameter (by default, 50 milliseconds) is made.

特殊的「快取管理器」進程會監控由`max_size`參數設定的最大快取大小，以及由`min_free` （ 1.19.1 ）參數設定的檔案系統快取的最小可用空間。當快取大小超過限製或可用空間不足時，它會刪除最近最少使用的資料。資料刪除的迭代次數由`manager_files`, `manager_threshold`和`manager_sleep`參數（ 1.11.5 ）配置。每次迭代最多刪除`manager_files`個項目（預設值為100）。每次迭代的持續時間由`manager_threshold`參數限制（預設值為200毫秒）。在兩次迭代之間，會執行由`manager_sleep`參數配置的暫停（預設值為50毫秒）。

A minute after the start the special “cache loader” process is activated. It loads information about previously cached data stored on file system into a cache zone. The loading is also done in iterations. During one iteration no more than `loader_files` items are loaded (by default, 100). Besides, the duration of one iteration is limited by the `loader_threshold` parameter (by default, 200 milliseconds). Between iterations, a pause configured by the `loader_sleep` parameter (by default, 50 milliseconds) is made.

啟動一分鐘後，特殊的「快取載入器」進程將會啟動。它會將先前儲存在檔案系統中的快取資料資訊載入到快取區域。載入過程也以迭代方式進行。每次迭代最多載入`loader_files`個項目（預設值為100）。此外，每次迭代的持續時間由`loader_threshold`參數限制（預設值為200毫秒）。在兩次迭代之間，會執行由`loader_sleep`參數配置的暫停（預設值為50毫秒）。

Additionally, the following parameters are available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx):

此外，以下參數包含在我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)中：

`purger`\=`on`|`off`

Instructs whether cache entries that match a [wildcard key](#p-085) will be removed from the disk by the cache purger (1.7.12). Setting the parameter to `on` (default is `off`) will activate the “cache purger” process that permanently iterates through all cache entries and deletes the entries that match the wildcard key.

指示是否由快取清除程序 ( 1.7.12 ) 從磁碟中刪除與 [通配符鍵](#p-085)相符的快取條目。將此參數設為`on` （預設值為`off` ）將啟動“快取清除程序”，該程式會永久遍歷所有快取條目並刪除與通配符鍵相符的條目。

`purger_files`\=`*number*`

Sets the number of items that will be scanned during one iteration (1.7.12). By default, `purger_files` is set to 10.

設定單次迭代中要掃描的物品數量（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_files`設定為 10。

`purger_threshold`\=`*number*`

Sets the duration of one iteration (1.7.12). By default, `purger_threshold` is set to 50 milliseconds.

設定一次迭代的持續時間（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_threshold`設定為 50 毫秒。

`purger_sleep`\=`*number*`

Sets a pause between iterations (1.7.12). By default, `purger_sleep` is set to 50 milliseconds.

設定迭代之間的暫停時間（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_sleep`設定為 50 毫秒。

> In versions 1.7.3, 1.7.7, and 1.11.10 cache header format has been changed. Previously cached responses will be considered invalid after upgrading to a newer nginx version.
>
> 在版本1.7.3, 1.7.7和1.11.10中，快取頭格式已變更。升級到更新的nginx版本後，先前快取的回應將被視為無效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**proxy_cache_purge** string ...;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Defines conditions under which the request will be considered a cache purge request. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the cache entry with a corresponding [cache key](#p-085) is removed. The result of successful operation is indicated by returning the 204 (No Content) response.

定義請求被視為快取清除請求的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則會刪除具有對應 [快取鍵](#p-085)的快取條目。操作成功後，將返回 204（無內容）回應。

If the [cache key](#p-085) of a purge request ends with an asterisk (“`*`”), all cache entries matching the wildcard key will be removed from the cache. However, these entries will remain on the disk until they are deleted for either [inactivity](#p-085), or processed by the [cache purger](#p-085) (1.7.12), or a client attempts to access them.

如果清除請求的 [快取鍵](#p-085)以星號 (“ `*` ”) 結尾，則所有與該通配符鍵相符的快取條目都會從快取中刪除。但是，這些條目將保留在磁碟上，直到因 [不活動](#p-085)而被刪除，或被 [快取清除程序](#p-085) ( 1.7.12 ) 處理，或用戶端嘗試存取它們為止。

Example configuration:

設定範例：

> ```
> proxy_cache_path /data/nginx/cache keys_zone=cache_zone:10m;
> 
> map $request_method $purge_method {
>
> 映射 $request_method $purge_method {
>     PURGE   1;
>     default 0;
>
>     預設值為 0；
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     ...
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         proxy_pass http://backend;
>         proxy_cache cache_zone;
>
>         代理緩存緩存區；
>         proxy_cache_key $uri;
>         proxy_cache_purge $purge_method;
>     }
> }
> ```

> This functionality is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此功能作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_revalidate</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_revalidate off;<br>proxy_cache_revalidate 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Enables revalidation of expired cache items using conditional requests with the “If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自） and “If-None-Match”（如果無匹配） header fields.

允許使用帶有“If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自）和“If-None-Match”（如果無匹配）標頭字段的條件請求重新驗證過期的快取項目。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cache_use_stale</strong> <code>error<br>錯誤</code> | <code>timeout<br>暫停</code> | <code>invalid_header<br>無效標頭</code> | <code>updating<br>更新</code> | <code>http_500</code> | <code>http_502</code> | <code>http_503</code> | <code>http_504</code> | <code>http_403</code> | <code>http_404</code> | <code>http_429</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cache_use_stale off;<br>proxy_cache_use_stale 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines in which cases a stale cached response can be used during communication with the proxied server. The directive’s parameters match the parameters of the [proxy\_next\_upstream](#p-085) directive.

確定在與代理伺服器通訊期間，哪些情況下可以使用過期的快取回應。此指令的參數與 [proxy\_next\_upstream](#p-085)指令的參數相符。

The `error` parameter also permits using a stale cached response if a proxied server to process a request cannot be selected.

如果無法選擇代理伺服器來處理請求， `error`參數也允許使用過期的快取回應。

Additionally, the `updating` parameter permits using a stale cached response if it is currently being updated. This allows minimizing the number of accesses to proxied servers when updating cached data.

此外， `updating`參數允許在快取回應正在更新時使用過期的快取回應。這樣可以最大限度地減少更新快取資料時對代理伺服器的存取次數。

Using a stale cached response can also be enabled directly in the response header for a specified number of seconds after the response became stale (1.11.10). This has lower priority than using the directive parameters.

使用過期的快取回應也可以直接在回應頭中啟用，持續指定的秒數，在回應過期後繼續使用（ 1.11.10 ）。這種方法的優先權低於使用指令參數。

-   The “[stale-while-revalidate](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-3)” extension of the “Cache-Control”（快取控制） header field permits using a stale cached response if it is currently being updated.  
    “Cache-Control”（快取控制）標頭欄位的「[stale-while-revalidate](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-3) 」擴充功能允許在目前正在更新時使用過期的快取回應。
-   The “[stale-if-error](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-4)” extension of the “Cache-Control”（快取控制） header field permits using a stale cached response in case of an error.  
    “Cache-Control”（快取控制）標頭字段的「[stale-if-error](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-4) 」擴充功能允許在發生錯誤時使用過期的快取回應。

To minimize the number of accesses to proxied servers when populating a new cache element, the [proxy\_cache\_lock](#p-085) directive can be used.

為了在填充新的快取元素時最大限度地減少對代理伺服器的存取次數，可以使用 [proxy\_cache\_lock](#p-085)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_cache_valid** [`*code*` ...] `*time*`;``<br>` `**proxy_cache_valid** [` *代碼* ` ...] ` *時間* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Sets caching time for different response codes. For example, the following directives

設定不同回應代碼的快取時間。例如，以下指令：

> ```
> proxy_cache_valid 200 302 10m;
> proxy_cache_valid 404      1m;
>
> proxy_cache_valid 404 1m;
> ```

set 10 minutes of caching for responses with codes 200 and 302 and 1 minute for responses with code 404.

對代碼為 200 和 302 的回應設定 10 分鐘的快取時間，對代碼為 404 的回應設定 1 分鐘的快取時間。

If only caching `*time*` is specified

如果僅指定快取`*time*`

> ```
> proxy_cache_valid 5m;
>
> proxy_cache_valid 5分鐘；
> ```

then only 200, 301, and 302 responses are cached.

那麼只有 200、301 和 302 回應會被快取。

In addition, the `any` parameter can be specified to cache any responses:

此外，也可以指定`any`參數來快取任何回應：

> ```
> proxy_cache_valid 200 302 10m;
> proxy_cache_valid 301      1h;
>
> proxy_cache_valid 301 1h;
> proxy_cache_valid any      1m;
>
> proxy_cache_valid 任意 1 分鐘；
> ```

Parameters of caching can also be set directly in the response header. This has higher priority than setting of caching time using the directive.

快取參數也可以直接在回應頭中設定。這種方法的優先權高於使用指令設定快取時間。

-   The “X-Accel-Expires” header field sets caching time of a response in seconds. The zero value disables caching for a response. If the value starts with the `@` prefix, it sets an absolute time in seconds since Epoch, up to which the response may be cached.  
    “X-Accel-Expires”標頭欄位用於設定回應的快取時間（以秒為單位）。值為零時，回應將被停用快取。如果該值以`@`前綴開頭，則表示該值設定了一個自 Unix 紀元以來的絕對時間（以秒為單位），在此時間範圍內，回應可以被快取。
-   If the header does not include the “X-Accel-Expires” field, parameters of caching may be set in the header fields “Expires”（過期） or “Cache-Control”（快取控制）.  
    如果標頭不包含“X-Accel-Expires”字段，則可以在標頭字段“Expires”（過期）或“Cache-Control”（快取控制）中設定快取參數。
-   If the header includes the “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） field, such a response will not be cached.  
    如果標頭包含“Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）字段，則此類回應將不會被快取。
-   If the header includes the “Vary”（各不相同） field with the special value “`*`”, such a response will not be cached (1.7.7). If the header includes the “Vary”（各不相同） field with another value, such a response will be cached taking into account the corresponding request header fields (1.7.7).  
    如果請求頭包含具有特殊值「 `*` 」的“Vary”（各不相同）字段，則該回應不會被快取（ 1.7.7 ）。如果請求頭包含具有其他值的“Vary”（各不相同）字段，則會根據對應的請求頭字段快取該回應（ 1.7.7 ）。

Processing of one or more of these response header fields can be disabled using the [proxy\_ignore\_headers](#p-085) directive.

可以使用 [proxy\_ignore\_headers](#p-085)指令來停用對一個或多個回應標頭欄位的處理。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_connect_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_connect_timeout 60s;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for establishing a connection with a proxied server. It should be noted that this timeout cannot usually exceed 75 seconds.

設定與代理伺服器建立連線的逾時時間。需要注意的是，此超時時間通常不能超過 75 秒。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cookie_domain</strong> <code>off</code>;</code><br><code><strong>proxy_cookie_domain</strong> <code><i>domain</i></code> <code><i>replacement</i></code>;</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> proxy_cookie_domain </strong> <code> off </code>;</code><br><code><strong> proxy_cookie_domain </strong> <code><i> </i></code>;</code></td></tr> </i></code> <code><i>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cookie_domain off;<br>代理 cookie 域關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.15.

該指令出現在版本1.1.15 。

Sets a text that should be changed in the `domain` attribute of the “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） header fields of a proxied server response. Suppose a proxied server returned the “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） header field with the attribute “`domain=localhost`”. The directive

設定代理伺服器回應的“Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）標頭欄位的`domain`屬性中應變更的文字。假設代理伺服器傳回的“Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）標頭欄位的屬性為「 `domain=localhost` 」。該指令

> ```
> proxy_cookie_domain localhost example.org;
> ```

will rewrite this attribute to “`domain=example.org`”.

將此屬性重寫為“ `domain=example.org` ”。

A dot at the beginning of the `*domain*` and `*replacement*` strings and the `domain` attribute is ignored. Matching is case-insensitive.

字串`*domain*`和`*replacement*`開頭的點號以及`domain`屬性將被忽略。匹配不區分大小寫。

The `*domain*` and `*replacement*` strings can contain variables:

`*domain*`和`*replacement*`字串可以包含變數：

> ```
> proxy_cookie_domain www.$host $host;
> ```

The directive can also be specified using regular expressions. In this case, `*domain*` should start from the “`~`” symbol. A regular expression can contain named and positional captures, and `*replacement*` can reference them:

指令也可以使用正規表示式指定。在這種情況下， `*domain*`應該從「 `~` 」符號開始。正規表示式可以包含命名捕獲和位置捕獲，而`*replacement*`可以引用它們：

> ```
> proxy_cookie_domain ~\.(?P<sl_domain>[-0-9a-z]+\.[a-z]+)$ $sl_domain;
>
> proxy_cookie_domain ~\.(?P <sl_domain> [-0-9a-z]+\.[az]+)$ $sl_domain;
> ```

Several `proxy_cookie_domain` directives can be specified on the same level:

可以在同一層級指定多個`proxy_cookie_domain`指令：

> ```
> proxy_cookie_domain localhost example.org;
> proxy_cookie_domain ~\.([a-z]+\.[a-z]+)$ $1;
>
> proxy_cookie_domain ~\.([az]+\.[az]+)$ $1;
> ```

If several directives can be applied to the cookie, the first matching directive will be chosen.

如果有多條指令可以套用於 cookie，則會選擇第一個符合的指令。

The `off` parameter cancels the effect of the `proxy_cookie_domain` directives inherited from the previous configuration level.

`off`參數取消從上一個配置等級繼承的`proxy_cookie_domain`指令的效果。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cookie_flags</strong> <code>off</code> | <code><i>cookie</i></code>[<br><code><i>flag<br>cookie</i></code>...];<br></code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cookie_flags off;<br>proxy_cookie_flags 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.19.3.

該指令出現在版本1.19.3 。

Sets one or more flags for the cookie. The `*cookie*` can contain text, variables, and their combinations. The `*flag*` can contain text, variables, and their combinations (1.19.8). The `secure`, `httponly`, `samesite=strict`, `samesite=lax`, `samesite=none` parameters add the corresponding flags. The `nosecure`, `nohttponly`, `nosamesite` parameters remove the corresponding flags.

為 cookie 設定一個或多個標誌。 `*cookie*` 可以包含文字、變數及其組合。 `*flag*` 可以包含文字、變數及其組合 (1.19.8)。 `secure`, `httponly`, `samesite=strict`, `samesite=lax`, `samesite=none`參數加入對應的標誌。 `nosecure`, `nohttponly`, `nosamesite` 參數刪除對應的標誌。

The cookie can also be specified using regular expressions. In this case, `*cookie*` should start from the “`~`” symbol.

也可以使用正規表示式指定 cookie。在這種情況下， `*cookie*`應該以「 `~` 」符號開頭。

Several `proxy_cookie_flags` directives can be specified on the same configuration level:

可以在同一組態層級指定多個`proxy_cookie_flags`指令：

> ```
> proxy_cookie_flags one httponly;
>
> proxy_cookie_flags 1 httponly;
> proxy_cookie_flags ~ nosecure samesite=strict;
> ```

If several directives can be applied to the cookie, the first matching directive will be chosen. In the example, the `httponly` flag is added to the cookie `one`, for all other cookies the `samesite=strict` flag is added and the `secure` flag is deleted.

如果多個指令可以套用於同一個 cookie，則會選擇第一個符合的指令。例如，對於 cookie `httponly` `one` ；所有其他 cookie，會新增`samesite=strict`標誌，並刪除`secure`標誌。

The `off` parameter cancels the effect of the `proxy_cookie_flags` directives inherited from the previous configuration level.

`off`參數取消從上一個配置等級繼承的`proxy_cookie_flags`指令的效果。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>proxy_cookie_path</strong> <code>off</code>;</code><br><code><strong>proxy_cookie_path</strong> <code><i>path</i></code> <code><i>replacement</i></code>;</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> </i></code>;</code></td></tr> </strong> <code>關閉</code>;</code><br><code><strong> proxy_cookie_path </strong> <code><i>路徑</i></code> <code><i>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_cookie_path off;<br>proxy_cookie_path 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.15.

該指令出現在版本1.1.15 。

Sets a text that should be changed in the `path` attribute of the “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） header fields of a proxied server response. Suppose a proxied server returned the “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） header field with the attribute “`path=/two/some/uri/`”. The directive

設定代理伺服器回應的“Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）標頭欄位的`path`屬性中應變更的文字。假設代理伺服器傳回了帶有屬性「 `path=/two/some/uri/` 」的“Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）標頭欄位。該指令

> ```
> proxy_cookie_path /two/ /;
> ```

will rewrite this attribute to “`path=/some/uri/`”.

將此屬性重寫為“ `path=/some/uri/` ”。

The `*path*` and `*replacement*` strings can contain variables:

`*path*`和`*replacement*`字串可以包含變數：

> ```
> proxy_cookie_path $uri /some$uri;
> ```

The directive can also be specified using regular expressions. In this case, `*path*` should either start from the “`~`” symbol for a case-sensitive matching, or from the “`~*`” symbols for case-insensitive matching. The regular expression can contain named and positional captures, and `*replacement*` can reference them:

指令也可以使用正規表示式指定。在這種情況下， `*path*`應從「 `~` 」符號開始以進行區分大小寫的匹配，或從「 `~*` 」符號開始以進行不區分大小寫的匹配。正規表示式可以包含命名捕獲和位置捕獲， `*replacement*`可以引用它們：

> ```
> proxy_cookie_path ~*^/user/([^/]+) /u/$1;
> ```

Several `proxy_cookie_path` directives can be specified on the same level:

可以在同一層級指定多個`proxy_cookie_path`指令：

> ```
> proxy_cookie_path /one/ /;
> proxy_cookie_path / /two/;
> ```

If several directives can be applied to the cookie, the first matching directive will be chosen.

如果有多條指令可以套用於 cookie，則會選擇第一個符合的指令。

The `off` parameter cancels the effect of the `proxy_cookie_path` directives inherited from the previous configuration level.

`off`參數取消從上一個配置等級繼承的`proxy_cookie_path`指令的效果。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_force_ranges</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_force_ranges off;<br>proxy_force_ranges 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.7.

該指令出現在版本1.7.7 。

Enables byte-range support for both cached and uncached responses from the proxied server regardless of the “Accept-Ranges”（接受範圍） field in these responses.

啟用對代理伺服器快取和非快取回應的位元組範圍支持，而不管這些回應中的“Accept-Ranges”（接受範圍）字段是什麼。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_headers_hash_bucket_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_headers_hash_bucket_size 64;<br>proxy_headers_hash_bucket_size 64；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the bucket `*size*` for hash tables used by the [proxy\_hide\_header](#p-085) and [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085) directives. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定 [proxy\_hide\_header](#p-085)和 [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085)指令使用的哈希表的儲存桶`*size*` 。設定哈希表的詳細資訊在單獨的 [文件](#p-040)中提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_headers_hash_max_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_headers_hash_max_size 512;<br>proxy_headers_hash_max_size 512；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum `*size*` of hash tables used by the [proxy\_hide\_header](#p-085) and [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085) directives. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定 [proxy\_hide\_header]`*size*`和 [proxy\_set\_header (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_set_header) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_hide_header)使用的哈希表的最大數量。有關設定哈希表的詳細信息，請參閱單獨的 [文檔](#p-040) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_hide_header** `*field*`;``<br>` `**proxy_hide_header** ` *字段* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

By default, nginx does not pass the header fields “Date”（日期）, “Server”（伺服器）, “X-Pad”, and “X-Accel-...” from the response of a proxied server to a client. The `proxy_hide_header` directive sets additional fields that will not be passed. If, on the contrary, the passing of fields needs to be permitted, the [proxy\_pass\_header](#p-085) directive can be used.

預設情況下，nginx 不會將代理伺服器回應中的“Date”（日期）, “Server”（伺服器）, “X-Pad”和“X-Accel-...”標頭欄位傳遞給客戶端`proxy_hide_header`指令可以設定其他不會被傳遞的欄位。相反，如果需要允許傳遞這些字段，可以使用 [proxy\_pass\_header](#p-085)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_http_version</strong> <code>1.0</code> | <code>1.1</code> | <code>2</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_http_version 1.1;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.4.

該指令出現在版本1.1.4 。

Sets the HTTP protocol version for proxying. Since 1.29.7, version 1.1 is used by default. Before 1.29.7, version 1.0 was used by default. Version 1.1 or 2 (1.29.4) is recommended for use with [keepalive](#p-105) connections and [NTLM authentication](#p-105).

設定代理的HTTP協定版本。自1.29.7起，預設使用1.1版本。在1.29.7之前，預設使用1.0版本。建議將1.1或2（ 1.29.4 ）版本用於[keepalive](#p-105)連接和[NTLM身份驗證](#p-105) 。

> Version 2 requires the [ngx\_http\_v2\_module](#p-108) module.
>
> 版本 2 需要 [ngx\_http\_v2\_module](#p-108)模組。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ignore_client_abort</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ignore_client_abort off;<br>proxy_ignore_client_abort 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether the connection with a proxied server should be closed when a client closes the connection without waiting for a response.

確定當客戶端在未等待回應的情況下關閉與代理伺服器的連線時，是否應關閉與代理伺服器的連線。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_ignore_headers** `*field*` ...;``<br>` `**proxy_ignore_headers** ` *字段* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Disables processing of certain response header fields from the proxied server. The following fields can be ignored: “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）, “X-Accel-Expires”, “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） (1.1.6), “X-Accel-Buffering” (1.1.6), “X-Accel-Charset” (1.1.6), “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） (0.8.44), and “Vary”（各不相同） (1.7.7).

停用對代理伺服器某些回應頭字段的處理。可忽略以下欄位： “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）, “X-Accel-Expires”, “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） ( 1.1.6 )、 “X-Accel-Buffering” ( 1.1.6 )、 “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） ( 0.8.44 “X-Accel-Charset” 1.1.6和“Vary”（各不相同） ( 1.7.7 )。

If not disabled, processing of these header fields has the following effect:

如果未停用，處理這些標頭欄位會產生以下效果：

-   “X-Accel-Expires”, “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）, and “Vary”（各不相同） set the parameters of response [caching](#p-085);  
    “X-Accel-Expires”, “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）和“Vary”（各不相同）設定響應 [快取](#p-085)的參數；
-   “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向） performs an [internal redirect](#p-056) to the specified URI;  
    “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）執行 [內部重定向](#p-056)到指定的URI ;
-   “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） sets the [rate limit](#p-056) for transmission of a response to a client;  
    “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率）設定向客戶端發送回應的 [速率限制](#p-056) ；
-   “X-Accel-Buffering” enables or disables [buffering](#p-085) of a response;  
    “X-Accel-Buffering”啟用或停用 [緩衝](#p-085)響應；
-   “X-Accel-Charset” sets the desired [charset](#p-055) of a response.  
    “X-Accel-Charset”設定響應的所需 [字元集](#p-055) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_intercept_errors</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_intercept_errors off;<br>proxy_intercept_errors 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether proxied responses with codes greater than or equal to 300 should be passed to a client or be intercepted and redirected to nginx for processing with the [error\_page](#p-056) directive.

確定是否應將程式碼大於或等於 300 的代理回應傳遞給客戶端，還是應攔截並重定向到 nginx 以使用 [error\_page](#p-056)指令進行處理。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_limit_rate</strong> <code><i>rate</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_limit_rate 0;<br>proxy_limit_rate 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.7.

該指令出現在版本1.7.7 。

Limits the speed of reading the response from the proxied server. The `*rate*` is specified in bytes per second. The zero value disables rate limiting. The limit is set per a request, and so if nginx simultaneously opens two connections to the proxied server, the overall rate will be twice as much as the specified limit. The limitation works only if [buffering](#p-085) of responses from the proxied server is enabled. Parameter value can contain variables (1.27.0).

限制從代理伺服器讀取回應的速度。 `*rate*` 以每秒位元組數指定。零值禁用速率限制。此限制是按請求設定的，因此如果 nginx 同時開啟兩個到代理伺服器的連接，則總體速率將是指定限制的兩倍。僅當啟用代理伺服器回應的[緩衝](#p-085)時，此限制才有效。參數值可以包含變數（1.27.0）。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_max_temp_file_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_max_temp_file_size 1024m;<br>proxy_max_temp_file_size 1024m；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

When [buffering](#p-085) of responses from the proxied server is enabled, and the whole response does not fit into the buffers set by the [proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-085) and [proxy\_buffers](#p-085) directives, a part of the response can be saved to a temporary file. This directive sets the maximum `*size*` of the temporary file. The size of data written to the temporary file at a time is set by the [proxy\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-085) directive.

當啟用代理伺服器回應的[buffering](#p-085)時，如果整個回應無法放入[proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-085)和[proxy\_buffers](#p-085)指令設定的緩衝區中，則可以將部分回應儲存到臨時檔案中。此指令設定臨時檔案的最大容量`*size*` 。每次寫入暫存檔案的資料大小由[proxy\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-085)指令設定。

The zero value disables buffering of responses to temporary files.

零值表示停用對暫存檔案的回應緩衝。

> This restriction does not apply to responses that will be [cached](#p-085) or [stored](#p-085) on disk.
>
> 此限制不適用於將被[快取](#p-085)或[儲存](#p-085)到磁碟的回應。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_method** `*method*`;``<br>` `**proxy_method** ` *方法* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Specifies the HTTP `*method*` to use in requests forwarded to the proxied server instead of the method from the client request. Parameter value can contain variables (1.11.6).

指定轉送至代理伺服器的請求中要使用的HTTP `*method*`而不是客戶端請求中的方法。參數值可以包含變數（ 1.11.6 ）。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_next_upstream</strong> <code>error<br>錯誤</code> | <code>timeout<br>暫停</code> | <code>denied<br>否認</code> | <code>invalid_header<br>無效標頭</code> | <code>http_500</code> | <code>http_502</code> | <code>http_503</code> | <code>http_504</code> | <code>http_403</code> | <code>http_404</code> | <code>http_429</code> | <code>non_idempotent<br>不一樣</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_next_upstream error timeout;<br>proxy_next_upstream 錯誤逾時；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies in which cases a request should be passed to the next server:

指定在哪些情況下應將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器：

`error`

an error occurred while establishing a connection with the server, passing a request to it, or reading the response header;

與伺服器建立連線、向伺服器發送請求或讀取回應標頭時發生錯誤；

`timeout`

a timeout has occurred while establishing a connection with the server, passing a request to it, or reading the response header;

與伺服器建立連線、向伺服器發送請求或讀取回應標頭時發生逾時；

`denied`

the server [denied](#p-085) the connection (1.29.3);

伺服器[拒絕](#p-085)連線 ( 1.29.3 );

> This parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此參數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`invalid_header`

a server returned an empty or invalid response;

伺服器傳回了空響應或無效回應；

`http_500`

a server returned a response with the code 500;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 500 的回應；

`http_502`

a server returned a response with the code 502;

伺服器回傳代碼為 502 的回應；

`http_503`

a server returned a response with the code 503;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 503 的回應；

`http_504`

a server returned a response with the code 504;

伺服器回傳代碼為 504 的回應；

`http_403`

a server returned a response with the code 403;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 403 的回應；

`http_404`

a server returned a response with the code 404;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 404 的回應；

`http_429`

a server returned a response with the code 429 (1.11.13);

伺服器回傳了代碼為 429 的回應（ 1.11.13 ）；

`non_idempotent`

normally, requests with a [non-idempotent](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2) method (`POST`, `LOCK`, `PATCH`) are not passed to the next server if a request has been sent to an upstream server (1.9.13); enabling this option explicitly allows retrying such requests;

通常情況下，如果已向上游伺服器 ( 1.9.13 ) 發送請求，則具有 [非冪等](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2)方法 ( `POST`, `LOCK`, `PATCH` ) 的請求不會傳遞給下一個伺服器；明確啟用此選項允許重試此類請求；

`off`

disables passing a request to the next server.

禁用向下一個伺服器傳遞請求。

One should bear in mind that passing a request to the next server is only possible if nothing has been sent to a client yet. That is, if an error or timeout occurs in the middle of the transferring of a response, fixing this is impossible.

需要注意的是，只有在尚未向客戶端發送任何資料的情況下，才能將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器。也就是說，如果在傳輸回應的過程中發生錯誤或逾時，則無法修復。

The directive also defines what is considered an [unsuccessful attempt](#p-105) of communication with a server. The cases of `error`, `timeout`, `denied` and `invalid_header` are always considered unsuccessful attempts, even if they are not specified in the directive. The cases of `http_500`, `http_502`, `http_503`, `http_504`, and `http_429` are considered unsuccessful attempts only if they are specified in the directive. The cases of `http_403` and `http_404` are never considered unsuccessful attempts.

該指令也定義了與伺服器通訊的[不成功嘗試](#p-105)。 `error`, `timeout`, `denied` 和 `invalid_header` 的情況始終被視為不成功的嘗試，即使指令中未指定。僅當指令中指定時，`http_500`, `http_502`, `http_503`, `http_504`和`http_429`的情況才被視為不成功的嘗試。 `http_403`和`http_404`的案例絕不被視為不成功的嘗試。

Passing a request to the next server can be limited by [the number of tries](#p-085) and by [time](#p-085).

向下一個伺服器傳遞請求可以受到 [嘗試次數](#p-085)和 [時間](#p-085)的限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_next_upstream_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_next_upstream_timeout 0;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.5.

該指令出現在版本1.7.5 。

Limits the time during which a request can be passed to the [next server](#p-085). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制請求可以傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-085)的時間。 `0`值關閉此限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_next_upstream_tries</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_next_upstream_tries 0;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.5.

該指令出現在版本1.7.5 。

Limits the number of possible tries for passing a request to the [next server](#p-085). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制將請求傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-085)的可能嘗試次數。 `0` 值關閉此限制。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_no_cache** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**proxy_no_cache** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines conditions under which the response will not be saved to a cache. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the response will not be saved:

定義回應不保存到快取的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則回應將不會被儲存：

> ```
> proxy_no_cache $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment;
>
> proxy_no_cache $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment；
> proxy_no_cache $http_pragma    $http_authorization;
>
> proxy_no_cache $http_pragma $http_authorization;
> ```

Can be used along with the [proxy\_cache\_bypass](#p-085) directive.

可與 [proxy\_cache\_bypass](#p-085)指令一起使用。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_pass** `*URL*`;``<br>` `**proxy_pass** ` * URL * `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location`, `if in location`, `limit_except` |

Sets the protocol and address of a proxied server and an optional URI to which a location should be mapped. As a protocol, “`http`” or “`https`” can be specified. The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, and an optional port:

設定代理伺服器的協定和位址，以及可選的URI ，用於映射位置。協議可以指定為「 `http` 」或「 `https` 」。位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，連接埠號碼也可以選擇指定。

> ```
> proxy_pass http://localhost:8000/uri/;
> ```

or as a UNIX-domain socket path specified after the word “`unix`” and enclosed in colons:

或作為「 `unix` 」之後用冒號括起來的UNIX域套接字路徑：

> ```
> proxy_pass http://unix:/tmp/backend.socket:/uri/;
> ```

If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be used in a round-robin fashion. In addition, an address can be specified as a [server group](#p-105).

如果一個網域解析到多個位址，則所有這些位址將以輪詢方式使用。此外，可以將位址指定為 [伺服器群組](#p-105) 。

Parameter value can contain variables. In this case, if an address is specified as a domain name, the name is searched among the described server groups, and, if not found, is determined using a [resolver](#p-056).

參數值可以包含變數。在這種情況下，如果將位址指定為域名，則會在所描述的伺服器群組中搜尋該名稱，如果找不到，則使用 [解析器](#p-056)進行確定。

A request URI is passed to the server as follows:

向伺服器傳遞的請求URI如下：

-   If the `proxy_pass` directive is specified with a URI, then when a request is passed to the server, the part of a [normalized](#p-056) request URI matching the location is replaced by a URI specified in the directive:  
    如果`proxy_pass`指令與URI一起指定，則當請求傳遞給伺服器時，[規範化的](#p-056)請求中與位置匹配的部分URI將被替換為指令中指定的URI ：
    
    > ```
    > location /name/ {
    >
    > 位置 /name/ {
    >     proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1/remote/;
    > }
    > ```
    
-   If `proxy_pass` is specified without a URI, the request URI is passed to the server in the same form as sent by a client when the original request is processed, or the full normalized request URI is passed when processing the changed URI:  
    如果指定了`proxy_pass`而沒有指定URI ，則在處理原始請求時，請求URI將以客戶端發送的相同形式傳遞給伺服器；或者在處理更改後的URI時，將傳遞完整的規範化請求傳遞完整的規範化請求URI完整的規範化請求傳遞完整的規範化請求傳遞完整的規範化請求傳遞完整的規範化請求。
    
    > ```
    > location /some/path/ {
    >     proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1;
    > }
    > ```
    
    > Before version 1.1.12, if `proxy_pass` is specified without a URI, the original request URI might be passed instead of the changed URI in some cases.
    >
    > 在版本1.1.12之前，如果指定了`proxy_pass`而沒有指定URI ，則在某些情況下，可能會傳遞原始請求URI而不是更改後的URI 。
    

In some cases, the part of a request URI to be replaced cannot be determined:

在某些情況下，無法確定請求URI中需要替換的部分：

-   When location is specified using a regular expression, and also inside named locations.  
    當使用正規表示式指定位置時，以及在命名位置中指定位置時。
    
    In these cases, `proxy_pass` should be specified without a URI.

    在這些情況下，應指定`proxy_pass` ，而不要指定URI 。
    
-   When the URI is changed inside a proxied location using the [rewrite](#p-090) directive, and this same configuration will be used to process a request (`break`):  
    當使用 [rewrite](#p-090)指令在代理位置更改URI時，將使用相同的配置來處理請求 ( `break` ) ：
    
    > ```
    > location /name/ {
    >
    > 位置 /name/ {
    >     rewrite    /name/([^/]+) /users?name=$1 break;
    >
    >     rewrite /name/([^/]+) /users?name=$1 break;
    >     proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1;
    > }
    > ```
    
    In this case, the URI specified in the directive is ignored and the full changed request URI is passed to the server.

    在這種情況下，指令中指定的URI將被忽略，完整的更改請求URI將被傳遞給伺服器。
    
-   When variables are used in `proxy_pass`:  
    當在`proxy_pass`中使用變數時：
    
    > ```
    > location /name/ {
    >
    > 位置 /name/ {
    >     proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1$request_uri;
    > }
    > ```
    
    In this case, if URI is specified in the directive, it is passed to the server as is, replacing the original request URI.

    在這種情況下，如果指令中指定了URI ，則會按原樣將其傳遞給伺服器，替換原始請求URI 。

[WebSocket](#p-113) proxying requires special configuration and is supported since version 1.3.13.

[WebSocket](#p-113)代理需要特殊配置，並且自版本1.3.13起支援。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_pass_header** `*field*`;``<br>` `**proxy_pass_header** ` *字段* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Permits passing [otherwise disabled](#p-085) header fields from a proxied server to a client.

允許將 [其他情況下停用的](#p-085)標頭欄位從代理伺服器傳遞到客戶端。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_pass_request_body</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_pass_request_body on;<br>proxy_pass_request_body on；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether the original request body is passed to the proxied server.

指示是否將原始請求體傳遞給代理伺服器。

> ```
> location /x-accel-redirect-here/ {
>     proxy_method GET;
>
>     proxy_method GET ;
>     proxy_pass_request_body off;
>
>     proxy_pass_request_body 關閉；
>     proxy_set_header Content-Length "";
> 
>     proxy_pass ...
> }
> ```

See also the [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085) and [proxy\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-085) directives.

另請參閱 [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085)和 [proxy\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-085)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_pass_request_headers</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_pass_request_headers on;<br>啟用 proxy_pass_request_headers;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether the header fields of the original request are passed to the proxied server.

指示是否將原始請求的標頭欄位傳遞給代理伺服器。

> ```
> location /x-accel-redirect-here/ {
>     proxy_method GET;
>
>     proxy_method GET ;
>     proxy_pass_request_headers off;
>
>     proxy_pass_request_headers 關閉；
>     proxy_pass_request_body off;
>
>     proxy_pass_request_body 關閉；
> 
>     proxy_pass ...
> }
> ```

See also the [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085) and [proxy\_pass\_request\_body](#p-085) directives.

另請參閱 [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085)和 [proxy\_pass\_request\_body](#p-085)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_pass_trailers</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_pass_trailers off;<br>proxy_pass_trailers 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Permits passing trailer fields from a proxied server to a client.

允許將尾部欄位從代理伺服器傳遞給客戶端。

> A trailer section should be [explicitly enabled](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110#section-6.5.1):
>
> 預告片部分應[明確啟用](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110#section-6.5.1) :

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     # proxy_http_version 1.1;  #for versions before 1.29.7｜proxy_http_version 1.1 ; #適用於1.29.7之前的版本
>     proxy_set_header     Connection "te";
>
>     proxy_set_header Connection "te";
>     proxy_set_header     TE "trailers";
>
>     proxy_set_header TE "trailers";
>     proxy_pass_trailers  on;
>
>     proxy_pass_trailers 已開啟；
> 
>     proxy_pass ...
> }
> ```

> Trailer fields received from an upstream server are passed to a client as is, without interpretation.
>
> 從上游伺服器接收的尾部欄位原樣傳遞給客戶端，無需解釋。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_read_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_read_timeout 60s;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for reading a response from the proxied server. The timeout is set only between two successive read operations, not for the transmission of the whole response. If the proxied server does not transmit anything within this time, the connection is closed.

定義從代理伺服器讀取回應的逾時時間。超時時間僅設定在兩次連續讀取操作之間，而非整個回應的傳輸時間。如果代理伺服器在此時間內未發送任何內容，則連線將關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_redirect</strong> <code>default</code>;</code><br><code><strong>proxy_redirect</strong> <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code><br><code><strong>proxy_redirect</strong> <code><i>redirect<br>重定向</i></code> <code><i>replacement<br>替換</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_redirect default;<br>proxy_redirect default；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the text that should be changed in the “Location”（地點） and “Refresh”（重新整理） header fields of a proxied server response. Suppose a proxied server returned the header field “`Location: http://localhost:8000/two/some/uri/`”. The directive

設定代理伺服器回應的“Location”（地點）和“Refresh”（重新整理）標頭欄位中應更改的文字。假設代理伺服器回傳了標頭欄位「 `Location: http://localhost:8000/two/some/uri/` 」。該指令

> ```
> proxy_redirect http://localhost:8000/two/ http://frontend/one/;
> ```

will rewrite this string to “`Location: http://frontend/one/some/uri/`”.

將此字串重寫為“ `Location: http://frontend/one/some/uri/` ”。

A server name may be omitted in the `*replacement*` string:

`*replacement*`字串中可以省略伺服器名稱：

> ```
> proxy_redirect http://localhost:8000/two/ /;
> ```

then the primary server’s name and port, if different from 80, will be inserted.

然後，如果主伺服器的名稱和連接埠不是 80，則會插入該主伺服器的名稱和連接埠。

The default replacement specified by the `default` parameter uses the parameters of the [location](#p-056) and [proxy\_pass](#p-085) directives. Hence, the two configurations below are equivalent:

`default`參數指定的預設替換使用 [location](#p-056)和 [proxy\_pass](#p-085)指令的參數。因此，以下兩種配置是等效的：

> ```
> location /one/ {
>
> 位置 /one/ {
>     proxy_pass     http://upstream:port/two/;
>
>     proxy_pass http://upstream:port/two/;
>     proxy_redirect default;
>
>     proxy_redirect 預設值；
> ```

> ```
> location /one/ {
>
> 位置 /one/ {
>     proxy_pass     http://upstream:port/two/;
>
>     proxy_pass http://upstream:port/two/;
>     proxy_redirect http://upstream:port/two/ /one/;
> ```

The `default` parameter is not permitted if [proxy\_pass](#p-085) is specified using variables.

如果使用變數指定了 [proxy\_pass](#p-085)則不允許使用`default`參數。

A `*replacement*` string can contain variables:

`*replacement*`字串可以包含變數：

> ```
> proxy_redirect http://localhost:8000/ http://$host:$server_port/;
> ```

A `*redirect*` can also contain (1.1.11) variables:

`*redirect*`也可以包含 ( 1.1.11 ) 變數：

> ```
> proxy_redirect http://$proxy_host:8000/ /;
> ```

The directive can be specified (1.1.11) using regular expressions. In this case, `*redirect*` should either start with the “`~`” symbol for a case-sensitive matching, or with the “`~*`” symbols for case-insensitive matching. The regular expression can contain named and positional captures, and `*replacement*` can reference them:

可以使用正規表示式指定指令 ( 1.1.11 )。在這種情況下， `*redirect*`應以「 `~` 」符號開頭以區分大小寫進行匹配，或以「 `~*` 」符號開頭以不區分大小寫進行匹配。正規表示式可以包含命名捕獲和位置捕獲， `*replacement*`可以引用它們：

> ```
> proxy_redirect ~^(http://[^:]+):\d+(/.+)$ $1$2;
>
> proxy_redirect ~^( http://[^: ]+):\d+(/.+)$ $1$2;
> proxy_redirect ~*/user/([^/]+)/(.+)$      http://$1.example.com/$2;
>
> proxy_redirect ~*/user/([^/]+)/(.+)$ http://$1.example.com/$2;
> ```

Several `proxy_redirect` directives can be specified on the same level:

可以在同一層級指定多個`proxy_redirect`指令：

> ```
> proxy_redirect default;
>
> proxy_redirect 預設值；
> proxy_redirect http://localhost:8000/  /;
>
> proxy_redirect http://localhost:8000/ /;
> proxy_redirect http://www.example.com/ /;
> ```

If several directives can be applied to the header fields of a proxied server response, the first matching directive will be chosen.

如果多個指令可以套用於代理伺服器回應的標頭字段，則會選擇第一個符合的指令。

The `off` parameter cancels the effect of the `proxy_redirect` directives inherited from the previous configuration level.

`off`參數取消從上一個配置等級繼承的`proxy_redirect`指令的效果。

Using this directive, it is also possible to add host names to relative redirects issued by a proxied server:

使用此指令，也可以向代理伺服器發出的相對重定向新增主機名稱：

> ```
> proxy_redirect / /;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_request_buffering</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_request_buffering on;<br>啟用代理請求緩衝；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Enables or disables buffering of a client request body.

啟用或停用客戶端請求體的緩衝。

When buffering is enabled, the entire request body is [read](#p-056) from the client before sending the request to a proxied server.

啟用緩衝後，在將請求傳送到代理伺服器之前，會從客戶端(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#client_body_buffer_size)整個請求體。

When buffering is disabled, the request body is sent to the proxied server immediately as it is received. In this case, the request cannot be passed to the [next server](#p-085) if nginx already started sending the request body.

停用緩衝後，請求體會在接收後立即傳送到代理伺服器。在這種情況下，如果 nginx 已經開始傳送請求體，則無法將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_next_upstream) 。

When HTTP/1.1 chunked transfer encoding is used to send the original request body, the request body will be buffered regardless of the directive value unless HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 is [enabled](#p-085) for proxying.

當使用HTTP/1.1分塊傳輸編碼發送原始請求體時，無論指令值如何，請求體都會被緩衝，除非HTTP/1.1或HTTP /2 已啟用(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_http_version)進行代理。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_request_dynamic</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_request_dynamic off;<br>proxy_request_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

Enables or disables creation of a separate request instance for each proxied server. By default, a single request is used for all proxied servers. If enabled, a separate request instance is created, allowing per-server request customization. For example, the server-specific “Host”（主持人） request header field can be set:

啟用或停用為每個代理伺服器建立單獨的請求實例。預設情況下，所有代理伺服器使用同一個請求。啟用後，將為每個伺服器建立一個單獨的請求實例，從而允許對每個伺服器的請求進行自訂。例如，可以設定伺服器特定的“Host”（主持人）請求頭字段：

> ```
> proxy_request_dynamic on;
>
> proxy_request_dynamic 已啟用；
> proxy_set_header      Host $upstream_last_server_name;
>
> proxy_set_header Host $upstream_last_server_name;
> ```

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_send_lowat</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_send_lowat 0;<br>proxy_send_lowat 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

If the directive is set to a non-zero value, nginx will try to minimize the number of send operations on outgoing connections to a proxied server by using either `NOTE_LOWAT` flag of the [kqueue](#p-030) method, or the `SO_SNDLOWAT` socket option, with the specified `*size*`.

如果指令設定為非零值，nginx 將嘗試透過使用 [kqueue](#p-030)方法的`NOTE_LOWAT`標誌或`SO_SNDLOWAT`套接字選項，以及指定的`*size*`來最小化到代理伺服器連接的出站連接的操作次數。

This directive is ignored on Linux, Solaris, and Windows.

該指令在 Linux、Solaris 和 Windows 系統上會被忽略。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_send_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_send_timeout 60s;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a timeout for transmitting a request to the proxied server. The timeout is set only between two successive write operations, not for the transmission of the whole request. If the proxied server does not receive anything within this time, the connection is closed.

設定向代理伺服器發送請求的逾時時間。超時時間僅設定在兩次連續寫入操作之間，而非整個請求的傳輸時間。如果代理伺服器在此時間內未收到任何數據，則連線將關閉。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_set_body** `*value*`;``<br>` `**proxy_set_body** ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Allows redefining the request body passed to the proxied server. The `*value*` can contain text, variables, and their combination.

允許重新定義傳遞給代理伺服器的請求正文。 `*value*` 可以包含文字、變數及其組合。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_set_header</strong> <code><i>field</i></code> <code><i>value</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_set_header Host $proxy_host;proxy_set_header Connection close;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Allows redefining or appending fields to the request header [passed](#p-085) to the proxied server. The `*value*` can contain text, variables, and their combinations. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `proxy_set_header` directives defined on the current level.

允許重新定義或附加欄位到請求標頭[傳遞](#p-085)到代理伺服器。 `*value*` 可以包含文字、變數及其組合。當且僅噹噹前層級上沒有定義 `proxy_set_header` 指令時，這些指令才會從先前的設定等級繼承。

By default, the header fields “Host”（主持人） and “Connection”（聯繫） from the original request are not passed to the proxied server. If HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1 is [enabled](#p-085) for proxying, these fields are redefined:

預設情況下，原始請求中的標頭欄位“Host”（主持人）和“Connection”（聯繫）不會傳遞給代理伺服器。如果啟用了HTTP/1.0或HTTP/1.1 (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_http_version)功能，則這些欄位將被重新定義：

> ```
> proxy_set_header Host       $proxy_host;
>
> proxy_set_header Host $proxy_host;
> proxy_set_header Connection close;
>
> proxy_set_header 連線關閉；
> ```

For HTTP/2, the “:authority” pseudo-header field with the `*$proxy_host*` value is sent by default, unless it is replaced with an explicit “Host”（主持人） header field.

對於HTTP /2，預設會傳送值為`*$proxy_host*` 「:authority」偽標頭字段，除非它被明確的“Host”（主持人）標頭字段取代。

If caching is enabled, the header fields “If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自）, “If-Unmodified-Since”（如果未修改自）, “If-None-Match”（如果無匹配）, “If-Match”（如果匹配）, “Range”（範圍）, and “If-Range”（如果範圍） from the original request are not passed to the proxied server.

如果啟用了緩存，則原始請求中的標頭字段“If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自）, “If-Unmodified-Since”（如果未修改自）, “If-None-Match”（如果無匹配）, “If-Match”（如果匹配）, “Range”（範圍）和“If-Range”（如果範圍）不會傳遞給代理伺服器。

An unchanged “Host”（主持人） request header field can be passed like this:

可以像這樣傳遞未更改的“Host”（主持人）請求頭字段：

> ```
> proxy_set_header Host       $http_host;
>
> proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
> ```

However, if this field is not present in a client request header then nothing will be passed. In such a case it is better to use the `$host` variable - its value equals the server name in the “Host”（主持人） request header field or the primary server name if this field is not present:

但是，如果客戶端請求頭中不存在此字段，則不會傳遞任何內容。在這種情況下，最好使用`$host`變數－其值等於“Host”（主持人）請求頭字段中的伺服器名稱，或者如果該欄位不存在，則等於主伺服器名稱：

> ```
> proxy_set_header Host       $host;
>
> proxy_set_header Host $host;
> ```

In addition, the server name can be passed together with the port of the proxied server:

此外，還可以將伺服器名稱與代理伺服器的連接埠一起傳遞：

> ```
> proxy_set_header Host       $host:$proxy_port;
>
> proxy_set_header Host $host:$proxy_port;
> ```

If the value of a header field is an empty string then this field will not be passed to a proxied server:

如果請求標頭欄位的值為空字串，則該欄位不會傳遞給代理伺服器：

> ```
> proxy_set_header Accept-Encoding "";
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_socket_keepalive</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_socket_keepalive off;<br>proxy_socket_keepalive 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.6.

該指令出現在版本1.15.6 。

Configures the “TCP keepalive” behavior for outgoing connections to a proxied server. By default, the operating system’s settings are in effect for the socket. If the directive is set to the value “`on`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` socket option is turned on for the socket.

設定與代理伺服器建立的出站連線的「 TCP keepalive」行為。預設情況下，作業系統的設定對套接字生效。如果指令值設定為“ `on` ”，則會為套接字啟用`SO_KEEPALIVE`選項。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_socket_rcvbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**proxy_socket_rcvbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the receive buffer size (the `SO_RCVBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a proxied server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `proxy_socket_rcvbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定與代理伺服器建立出站連線的接收緩衝區大小（ `SO_RCVBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`proxy_socket_rcvbuf`指令的效果，從而允許作業系統對套接字的設定生效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_socket_sndbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**proxy_socket_sndbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the send buffer size (the `SO_SNDBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a proxied server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `proxy_socket_sndbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定向代理伺服器發出的連線發送緩衝區大小（ `SO_SNDBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`proxy_socket_sndbuf`指令的效果，從而允許作業系統對套接字的設定生效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_ssl_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**proxy_ssl_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.8.

該指令出現在版本1.7.8 。

Specifies a `*file*` with the certificate in the PEM format used for authentication to a proxied HTTPS server.

指定一個`*file*` ，其憑證採用PEM格式，用於向代理HTTPS伺服器進行身份驗證。

Since version 1.21.0, variables can be used in the `*file*` name.

自版本1.21.0起，變數可以在`*file*`名稱中使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>off</code>;</code><br><code><strong>proxy_ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>max</code>=<code><i>N<br></i></code>[<br><code>inactive<br></code>=<br><code><i>time<br></i></code>] [<br><code>valid<br></code>=<br><code><i>time<br></i></code>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_certificate_cache off;<br>proxy_ssl_certificate_cache 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.4.

該指令出現在版本1.27.4 。

Defines a cache that stores [SSL certificates](#p-085) and [secret keys](#p-085) specified with [variables](#p-085).

定義一個緩存，用於儲存 [SSL憑證](#p-085)和 [金鑰](#p-085)金鑰由 [變數](#p-085)指定。

The directive has the following parameters:

此指令具有以下參數：

`max`

sets the maximum number of elements in the cache; on cache overflow the least recently used (LRU) elements are removed;

設定快取中元素的最大數量；當快取溢出時，刪除最近最少使用的（ LRU ）元素；

`inactive`

defines a time after which an element is removed from the cache if it has not been accessed during this time; by default, it is 10 seconds;

定義一個時間段，如果該元素在這段時間內未被訪問，則將其從快取中刪除；預設值為 10 秒；

`valid`

defines a time during which an element in the cache is considered valid and can be reused; by default, it is 60 seconds. Certificates that exceed this time will be reloaded or revalidated;

定義快取中元素被視為有效且可重複使用的時間；預設值為 60 秒。超過此時間的證書將被重新載入或重新驗證；

`off`

disables the cache.

禁用緩存。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> proxy_ssl_certificate       $proxy_ssl_server_name.crt;
>
> proxy_ssl_certificate $proxy_ssl_server_name.crt;
> proxy_ssl_certificate_key   $proxy_ssl_server_name.key;
>
> proxy_ssl_certificate_key $proxy_ssl_server_name.key;
> proxy_ssl_certificate_cache max=1000 inactive=20s valid=1m;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_ssl_certificate_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**proxy_ssl_certificate_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.8.

該指令出現在版本1.7.8 。

Specifies a `*file*` with the secret key in the PEM format used for authentication to a proxied HTTPS server.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含用於向代理HTTPS伺服器進行身份驗證的PEM格式的金鑰。

The value `engine`:`*name*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.7.9), which loads a secret key with a specified `*id*` from the OpenSSL engine `*name*`.

可以指定值`engine`:`*name*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.7.9 )，該值會從 OpenSSL 引擎`*name*`載入具有指定`*id*`的金鑰。

The value `store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.29.0), which is used to load a secret key with a specified `*id*` and OpenSSL provider registered URI `*scheme*`, such as [`pkcs11`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512).

可指定值`store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.29.0 )，該值用於載入具有指定`*id*`和已註冊 OpenSSL 提供者URI `*scheme*`的金鑰，例如 [ `pkcs11` (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512) 5

Since version 1.21.0, variables can be used in the `*file*` name.

自版本1.21.0起，變數可以在`*file*`名稱中使用。

<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_ciphers DEFAULT;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.6.

該指令出現在版本1.5.6 。

Specifies the enabled ciphers for requests to a proxied HTTPS server. The ciphers are specified in the format understood by the OpenSSL library.

指定對代理的HTTPS伺服器的請求所啟用的密碼套件。密碼套件以OpenSSL庫可識別的格式指定。

The full list can be viewed using the “`openssl ciphers`” command.

可以使用「 `openssl ciphers` 」指令查看完整清單。

| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.19.4.

該指令出現在版本1.19.4 。

Sets arbitrary OpenSSL configuration [commands](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) when establishing a connection with the proxied HTTPS server.

與HTTPS伺服器建立連線時，設定任意 OpenSSL 設定 [指令](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) 。

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，支援該指令。

Several `proxy_ssl_conf_command` directives can be specified on the same level. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `proxy_ssl_conf_command` directives defined on the current level.

同一層級可以指定多個`proxy_ssl_conf_command`指令。當且僅噹噹前等級未定義`proxy_ssl_conf_command`指令時，這些指令才會從上一個設定等級繼承。

> Note that configuring OpenSSL directly might result in unexpected behavior.
>
> 請注意，直接配置 OpenSSL 可能會導致意外行為。

| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.0.

該指令出現在版本1.7.0 。

Specifies a `*file*` with revoked certificates (CRL) in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-085) the certificate of the proxied HTTPS server. When using intermediate certificates, their CRLs should be specified in the same file.

指定一個包含已吊銷憑證（ CRL ）的`*file*`其格式為PEM HTTPS (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_ssl_verify)伺服器的憑證。使用中間憑證時，應在同一文件中指定其憑證撤銷清單 (CRL)。

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

Enables logging of proxied HTTPS server connection SSL keys and specifies the path to the key log file. Keys are logged in the [SSLKEYLOGFILE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850) format compatible with Wireshark.

啟用代理伺服器連線SSL的HTTPS記錄，並指定金鑰日誌檔案的路徑。密鑰以與 Wireshark 相容的 [ (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850) ] 格式記錄。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

This directive appeared in version 1.7.0.

該指令出現在版本1.7.0 。

Allows overriding the server name used to [verify](#p-085) the certificate of the proxied HTTPS server and to be [passed through SNI](#p-085) when establishing a connection with the proxied HTTPS server.

允許覆蓋用於[驗證](#p-085)代理HTTPS伺服器的憑證的伺服器名稱，並在與代理HTTPS伺服器建立連線時[透過SNI](#p-085)傳遞。

By default, the host part of the [proxy\_pass](#p-085) URL is used.

預設情況下，使用 [proxy\_pass](#p-085) URL的主機部分。

</table>

Determines whether SSL sessions can be reused when working with the proxied server. If the errors “`digest check failed`” appear in the logs, try disabling session reuse.

確定在使用代理伺服器時是否可以重複使用SSL會話。如果日誌中出現錯誤“ `digest check failed` ”，請嘗試停用會話​​重複使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_store<br>代理存儲</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code><i>string<br>細繩</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_store off;<br>proxy_store 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables saving of files to a disk. The `on` parameter saves files with paths corresponding to the directives [alias](#p-056) or [root](#p-056). The `off` parameter disables saving of files. In addition, the file name can be set explicitly using the `*string*` with variables:

允許將檔案儲存到磁碟。 `on`參數保存與指令[alias](#p-056)或[root](#p-056)相對應的路徑的檔案。 `off` 參數禁用檔案保存。此外，可以使用帶有變數的`*string*`明確設定檔名：

> ```
> proxy_store /data/www$original_uri;
> ```

The modification time of files is set according to the received “Last-Modified”（最後修改日期） response header field. The response is first written to a temporary file, and then the file is renamed. Starting from version 0.8.9, temporary files and the persistent store can be put on different file systems. However, be aware that in this case a file is copied across two file systems instead of the cheap renaming operation. It is thus recommended that for any given location both saved files and a directory holding temporary files, set by the [proxy\_temp\_path](#p-085) directive, are put on the same file system.

檔案的修改時間根據接收的“Last-Modified”（最後修改日期）回應頭字段設定。回應首先寫入臨時文件，然後重新命名該文件。從0.8.9版本開始，暫存檔案和持久化儲存可以位於不同的檔案系統上。但是請注意，在這種情況下，檔案會複製到兩個檔案系統上，而不是執行簡單的重新命名操作。因此，建議對於任何給定的位置，已儲存的檔案和由 [proxy\_temp\_path](#p-085)指令設定的暫存檔案目錄都位於同一檔案系統上。

This directive can be used to create local copies of static unchangeable files, e.g.:

此指令可用於建立靜態不可更改檔案的本機副本，例如：

> ```
> location /images/ {
>     root               /data/www;
>
>     根目錄 /data/www;
>     error_page         404 = /fetch$uri;
>
>     error_page 404 = /fetch$uri;
> }
> 
> location /fetch/ {
>     internal;
>
>     內部的;
> 
>     proxy_pass         http://backend/;
>
>     proxy_pass http://backend/;
>     proxy_store        on;
>
>     啟用 proxy_store；
>     proxy_store_access user:rw group:rw all:r;
>
>     proxy_store_access 使用者：rw 群組：rw 所有：r；
>     proxy_temp_path    /data/temp;
>
>     proxy_temp_path /data/temp;
> 
>     alias              /data/www/;
>
>     別名 /data/www/;
> }
> ```

or like this:

或者像這樣：

> ```
> location /images/ {
>     root               /data/www;
>
>     根目錄 /data/www;
>     error_page         404 = @fetch;
>
>     error_page 404 = @fetch;
> }
> 
> location @fetch {
>     internal;
>
>     內部的;
> 
>     proxy_pass         http://backend;
>
>     proxy_pass http://backend;
>     proxy_store        on;
>
>     啟用 proxy_store；
>     proxy_store_access user:rw group:rw all:r;
>
>     proxy_store_access 使用者：rw 群組：rw 所有：r；
>     proxy_temp_path    /data/temp;
>
>     proxy_temp_path /data/temp;
> 
>     root               /data/www;
>
>     根目錄 /data/www;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_store_access</strong> <code><i>users</i></code>:<code><i>permissions</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_store_access user:rw;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets access permissions for newly created files and directories, e.g.:

設定新檔案和目錄的存取權限，例如：

> ```
> proxy_store_access user:rw group:rw all:r;
>
> proxy_store_access 使用者：rw 群組：rw 所有：r；
> ```

If any `group` or `all` access permissions are specified then `user` permissions may be omitted:

如果指定了任何`group`或`all`存取權限，則可以省略`user`權限：

> ```
> proxy_store_access group:rw all:r;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_temp_file_write_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_temp_file_write_size 8k|16k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Limits the `*size*` of data written to a temporary file at a time, when buffering of responses from the proxied server to temporary files is enabled. By default, `*size*` is limited by two buffers set by the [proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-085) and [proxy\_buffers](#p-085) directives. The maximum size of a temporary file is set by the [proxy\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-085) directive.

啟用代理伺服器回應緩衝到暫存檔案功能時，限制每次寫入暫存檔案的資料量`*size*` 。預設情況下， `*size*`受限於由 [proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-085)和 [proxy\_buffers](#p-085)指令設定的兩個緩衝區大小。暫存檔案的最大大小由 [proxy\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-085)指令設定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>proxy_temp_path</strong> <code><i>path</i></code> [<code><i>level1</i></code> [<code><i>level2</i></code> [<code><i>level3</i></code>]]];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> proxy_temp_path </strong> <code><i> path </i></code> <code><i> <code><i> </i></code> </i></code> <code><i> level3 </i></code> ]]]; </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_temp_path proxy_temp;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a directory for storing temporary files with data received from proxied servers. Up to three-level subdirectory hierarchy can be used underneath the specified directory. For example, in the following configuration

定義一個用於儲存從代理伺服器接收的資料的暫存檔案的目錄。指定的目錄下最多可以使用三級子目錄結構。例如，在以下配置中

> ```
> proxy_temp_path /spool/nginx/proxy_temp 1 2;
> ```

a temporary file might look like this:

臨時文件可能如下所示：

> ```
> /spool/nginx/proxy_temp/7/45/00000123457
> ```

See also the `use_temp_path` parameter of the [proxy\_cache\_path](#p-085) directive.

另請參閱 [proxy\_cache\_path](#p-085)指令的`use_temp_path`參數。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_proxy_module` module supports embedded variables that can be used to compose headers using the [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085) directive:

`ngx_http_proxy_module`模組支援嵌入式變量，可以使用 [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085)指令來建立標頭：

`$proxy_host`

name and port of a proxied server as specified in the [proxy\_pass](#p-085) directive;

[proxy\_pass](#p-085)指令中指定的代理伺服器的名稱和連接埠；

`$proxy_port`

port of a proxied server as specified in the [proxy\_pass](#p-085) directive, or the protocol’s default port;

代理伺服器的連接埠（如 [proxy\_pass](#p-085)指令中所述），或協定的預設連接埠；

`$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for`

the “X-Forwarded-For”（X-轉發） client request header field with the `$remote_addr` variable appended to it, separated by a comma. If the “X-Forwarded-For”（X-轉發） field is not present in the client request header, the `$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for` variable is equal to the `$remote_addr` variable.

“X-Forwarded-For”（X-轉發）客戶端請求頭字段，並附加`$remote_addr`變量，兩者之間以逗號分隔。如果客戶端請求頭中不存在“X-Forwarded-For”（X-轉發）字段，則`$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for`變數等於`$remote_addr`變數。

<a id="p-086"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_proxy_protocol_vendor_module｜模組 ngx_http_proxy_protocol_vendor_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_protocol_vendor_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_proxy\_protocol\_vendor\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_proxy\_protocol\_vendor\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-086)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-086)<br>[範例配置](#p-086)<br> [嵌入式變數](#p-086) |

The `ngx_http_proxy_protocol_vendor_module` module (1.23.3) allows obtaining additional information about a connection in cloud platforms from application-specific TLVs of the [PROXY protocol](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) header.

`ngx_http_proxy_protocol_vendor_module`模組 ( 1.23.3 ) 允許從 [PROXY協定](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt)標頭的應用程式特定 TLV 取得有關雲端平台連接的其他資訊。

Supported cloud platforms:

支援的雲端平台：

-   Amazon Web Services  
    亞馬遜網路服務
-   Google Cloud Platform
-   Microsoft Azure

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-056) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-056)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> proxy_set_header X-Conn-ID $proxy_protocol_tlv_gcp_conn_id;
>
> proxy_set_header X-Conn- ID $proxy_protocol_tlv_gcp_conn_id;
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 80   proxy_protocol;
>
>     監聽 80 代理協議；
>     listen 443  ssl proxy_protocol;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl 代理協定；
>     ...
> }
> ```

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

`$proxy_protocol_tlv_aws_vpce_id`

TLV value from the PROXY Protocol header representing the [ID of AWS VPC endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html#proxy-protocol)

TLV值來自PROXY協議頭，表示 [ID的AWS VPC端點](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html#proxy-protocol)

`$proxy_protocol_tlv_azure_pel_id`

TLV value from the PROXY Protocol header representing the [LinkID of Azure private endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/private-link/private-link-service-overview#getting-connection-information-using-tcp-proxy-v2)

TLV值來自PROXY協定標頭，表示 [Azure 專用終端點的 LinkID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/private-link/private-link-service-overview#getting-connection-information-using-tcp-proxy-v2)

`$proxy_protocol_tlv_gcp_conn_id`

TLV value from the PROXY Protocol header representing [Google Cloud PSC connection ID](https://cloud.google.com/vpc/docs/configure-private-service-connect-producer#proxy-protocol)

來自TLV協定頭的值PROXY表示 [Google Cloud PSC連接ID](https://cloud.google.com/vpc/docs/configure-private-service-connect-producer#proxy-protocol)
