<a id="p-087"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_random_index_module｜模組 ngx_http_random_index_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_random_index_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_random\_index\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_random\_index\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-087)<br>[Directives](#p-087)<br>     [random\_index](#p-087)<br>[範例配置](#p-087)<br> [指令](#p-087)<br> [隨機索引](#p-087) |

The `ngx_http_random_index_module` module processes requests ending with the slash character (‘`/`’) and picks a random file in a directory to serve as an index file. The module is processed before the [ngx\_http\_index\_module](#p-071) module.

`ngx_http_random_index_module`模組處理以斜槓字元（' `/` '）結尾的請求，並從目錄中隨機選擇一個檔案作為索引檔案。此模組在 [ngx\_http\_index\_module](#p-071)模組之前處理。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_random_index_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_random_index_module`配置參數啟用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     random_index on;
>
>     隨機索引開啟；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>random_index<br>隨機索引</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>random_index off;<br>隨機索引關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables module processing in a surrounding location.

啟用或停用周圍位置的模組處理。

---

<a id="p-088"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_realip_module｜模組 ngx_http_realip_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_realip_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_realip\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_realip\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-088)<br>[Directives](#p-088)<br>     [set\_real\_ip\_from](#p-088)<br>     [real\_ip\_header](#p-088)<br>     [real\_ip\_recursive](#p-088)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-088)<br>[範例設定](#p-088)<br>[指令](#p-088)<br>     [set\_real\_ip\_from](#p-088)<br>     [rea l\_ip\_header](#p-088)<br>     [real\_ip\_recursive](#p-088)<br>[內嵌變數](#p-088) |

The `ngx_http_realip_module` module is used to change the client address and optional port to those sent in the specified header field.

`ngx_http_realip_module`模組用於將客戶端位址和選用連接埠變更為在指定的標頭欄位中傳送的位址和連接埠。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_realip_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_realip_module`配置參數啟用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> set_real_ip_from  192.168.1.0/24;
>
> set_real_ip_from 192.168.1.0/24 ;
> set_real_ip_from  192.168.2.1;
>
> set_real_ip_from 192.168.2.1 ;
> set_real_ip_from  2001:0db8::/32;
>
> set_real_ip_from 2001:0db8::/32 ;
> real_ip_header    X-Forwarded-For;
>
> real_ip_header X-Forwarded-For;
> real_ip_recursive on;
>
> real_ip_recursive 已開啟；
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**set_real_ip_from** `*address*` \| `*CIDR*` \| `unix:`;``<br>` `**set_real_ip_from** ` *地址* ` \| ` * CIDR * ` \| ` unix: `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines trusted addresses that are known to send correct replacement addresses. If the special value `unix:` is specified, all UNIX-domain sockets will be trusted. Trusted addresses may also be specified using a hostname (1.13.1).

定義已知會傳送正確替換位址的受信任位址。如果指定特殊值`unix:` ，則所有UNIX域套接字都會被信任。也可以使用主機名稱（ 1.13.1 ）指定受信任位址。

> IPv6 addresses are supported starting from versions 1.3.0 and 1.2.1.
>
> 從版本1.3.0和1.2.1開始支援IPv6位址。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>real_ip_header<br>真實IP報頭</strong> <code><i>field<br>場地</i></code> | <code>X-Real-IP</code> | <code>X-Forwarded-For<br>X-轉發</code> | <code>proxy_protocol<br>代理協定</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>real_ip_header X-Real-IP;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines the request header field whose value will be used to replace the client address.

定義請求頭字段，其值將用於替換客戶端地址。

The request header field value that contains an optional port is also used to replace the client port (1.11.0). The address and port should be specified according to [RFC 3986](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3986).

包含可選連接埠的請求頭字段值也用於替換客戶端連接埠（ 1.11.0 ）。位址和連接埠應依照 [RFC 3986](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3986)指定。

The `proxy_protocol` parameter (1.5.12) changes the client address to the one from the PROXY protocol header. The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-056) directive.

`proxy_protocol`參數（1.5.12）將客戶端位址改為PROXY協定頭中的位址。必須預先透過在 [listen](#p-056) 指令中設定 `proxy_protocol` 參數來啟用 PROXY 協定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>real_ip_recursive</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>real_ip_recursive off;<br>real_ip_recursive 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in versions 1.3.0 and 1.2.1.

該指令出現在版本1.3.0和1.2.1中。

If recursive search is disabled, the original client address that matches one of the trusted addresses is replaced by the last address sent in the request header field defined by the [real\_ip\_header](#p-088) directive. If recursive search is enabled, the original client address that matches one of the trusted addresses is replaced by the last non-trusted address sent in the request header field.

如果遞歸搜尋被停用，則與某個受信任位址相符的原始用戶端位址將被替換為請求頭字段中由 [real\_ip\_header](#p-088)指令定義的最後一個發送的位址。如果遞歸搜尋被啟用，則與某個受信任位址相符的原始用戶端位址將被替換為請求頭欄位中最後一個發送的非受信任位址。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

`$realip_remote_addr`

keeps the original client address (1.9.7)

保留原始客戶端位址（ 1.9.7 ）

`$realip_remote_port`

keeps the original client port (1.11.0)

保留原始客戶端連接埠（ 1.11.0 ）

<a id="p-089"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_referer_module｜模組 ngx_http_referer_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_referer_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_referer\_module｜模組 ngx_http_referer_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-089)<br>[Directives](#p-089)<br>     [referer\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-089)<br>     [referer\_hash\_max\_size](#p-089)<br>     [valid\_referers](#p-089)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-089)<br>[範例配置](#p-089)<br> [指令](#p-089)<br> [referer\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-089)<br> [referer (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_referer_module.html#referer_hash_max_size)<br> _hash\_max\_size](#p-089)<br> [Finval' (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_referer_module.html#variables) |

The `ngx_http_referer_module` module is used to block access to a site for requests with invalid values in the “Referer”（參考） header field. It should be kept in mind that fabricating a request with an appropriate “Referer”（參考） field value is quite easy, and so the intended purpose of this module is not to block such requests thoroughly but to block the mass flow of requests sent by regular browsers. It should also be taken into consideration that regular browsers may not send the “Referer”（參考） field even for valid requests.

`ngx_http_referer_module`模組用於阻止對站點的訪問，阻止請求的“Referer”（參考）標頭字段值無效。需要注意的是，偽造一個包含有效“Referer”（參考）字段值的請求非常容易，因此該模組的目的並非徹底阻止此類請求，而是阻止普通瀏覽器發送的大量此類請求。此外，還應考慮到，即使是有效的請求，普通瀏覽器也可能不會發送“Referer”（參考）字段。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> valid_referers none blocked server_names
>
> valid_referers 無 已屏蔽 server_names
>                *.example.com example.* www.example.org/galleries/
>
>                *.example.com 範例。 * www.example.org/galleries/
>                ~\.google\.;
> 
> if ($invalid_referer) {
>
> 如果 ($invalid_referer) {
>     return 403;
>
>     返回403；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>referer_hash_bucket_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>referer_hash_bucket_size 64;<br>referer_hash_bucket_size 64；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.0.5.

該指令出現在版本1.0.5 。

Sets the bucket size for the valid referers hash tables. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定有效引用哈希表的桶大小。有關設定哈希表的詳細信息，請參閱單獨的[文檔](#p-040) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>referer_hash_max_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>referer_hash_max_size 2048;<br>referer_hash_max_size 2048；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.0.5.

該指令出現在版本1.0.5 。

Sets the maximum `*size*` of the valid referers hash tables. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定有效引用哈希表的最大值`*size*` 。設定哈希表的詳細資訊在單獨的[文件](#p-040)中提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**valid_referers** `none` \| `blocked` \| `server_names` \| `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**valid_referers** `無` \| `已阻止` \| `伺服器名稱` \| ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location` |

Specifies the “Referer”（參考） request header field values that will cause the embedded `$invalid_referer` variable to be set to an empty string. Otherwise, the variable will be set to “`1`”. Search for a match is case-insensitive.

指定哪些“Referer”（參考）請求頭字段值會導致嵌入的`$invalid_referer`變數被設定為空字串。否則，該變數將被設定為“ `1` ”。搜尋匹配項不區分大小寫。

Parameters can be as follows:

參數可以如下圖所示：

`none`

the “Referer”（參考） field is missing in the request header;

請求頭中缺少“Referer”（參考）字段；

`blocked`

the “Referer”（參考） field is present in the request header, but its value has been deleted by a firewall or proxy server; such values are strings that do not start with “`http://`” or “`https://`”;

請求標頭中存在“Referer”（參考）字段，但其值已被防火牆或代理伺服器刪除；此類值是不以「 `http://` 」或「 `https://` 」開頭的字串；

`server_names`

the “Referer”（參考） request header field contains one of the server names;

“Referer”（參考）請求頭字段包含伺服器名稱之一；

arbitrary string

任意字串

defines a server name and an optional URI prefix. A server name can have an “`*`” at the beginning or end. During the checking, the server’s port in the “Referer”（參考） field is ignored;

定義伺服器名稱和一個可選的URI前綴。伺服器名稱的開頭或結尾可以有「 `*` 」。在檢查期間， “Referer”（參考）欄位中的伺服器連接埠將被忽略；

regular expression

正規表示式

the first symbol should be a “`~`”. It should be noted that an expression will be matched against the text starting after the “`http://`” or “`https://`”.

第一個符號應該是「 `~` 」。需要注意的是，表達式將與「 `http://` 」或「 `https://` 」之後的文字進行比對。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> valid_referers none blocked server_names
>
> valid_referers 無 已屏蔽 server_names
>                *.example.com example.* www.example.org/galleries/
>
>                *.example.com 範例。 * www.example.org/galleries/
>                ~\.google\.;
> ```

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

`$invalid_referer`

Empty string, if the “Referer”（參考） request header field value is considered [valid](#p-089), otherwise “`1`”.

如果“Referer”（參考）請求頭字段值被認為是 [有效的](#p-089) ，則為空字串，否則為「 `1` 」。

---

<a id="p-090"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_rewrite_module｜模組 ngx_http_rewrite_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_rewrite_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_rewrite\_module｜模組 ngx_http_rewrite_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Directives](#p-090)<br>     [break](#p-090)<br>     [if](#p-090)<br>     [return](#p-090)<br>     [rewrite](#p-090)<br>     [rewrite\_log](#p-090)<br>     [set](#p-090)<br>     [uninitialized\_variable\_warn](#p-090)<br>[Internal Implementation](#p-090)<br>[指令](#p-090)<br>     [休息](#p-090)<br>     [如果](#p-090)<br>     [返回](#p-090)<br>     [改寫](#p-090)<br>     [rewrite\_log](#p-090)<br>     [放](#p-090)<br>     [未初始化變數警告](#p-090)<br>[內部實施](#p-090) |

The `ngx_http_rewrite_module` module is used to change request URI using PCRE regular expressions, return redirects, and conditionally select configurations.

`ngx_http_rewrite_module`模組用於使用PCRE正規表示式變更請求URI ，返回重定向，並有條件地選擇配置。

The [break](#p-090), [if](#p-090), [return](#p-090), [rewrite](#p-090), and [set](#p-090) directives are processed in the following order:

[break](#p-090) 、[if](#p-090) 、[return](#p-090) 、[rewrite](#p-090)和 [set](#p-090)指令依下列順序處理：

-   the directives of this module specified on the [server](#p-056) level are executed sequentially;  
    本模組在 [伺服器](#p-056)層級指定的指令依序執行；
-   repeatedly:  
    反覆：
    -   a [location](#p-056) is searched based on a request URI;  
        根據請求URI搜尋[位置](#p-056) ；
    -   the directives of this module specified inside the found location are executed sequentially;  
        此模組中指定的指令在找到的位置內依序執行；
    -   the loop is repeated if a request URI was [rewritten](#p-090), but not more than [10 times](#p-056).  
        如果請求URI被[重寫](#p-090) ，則循環重複，但不超過[10次](#p-056) 。

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**break**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location`, `if` |

Stops processing the current set of `ngx_http_rewrite_module` directives.

停止處理目前一組`ngx_http_rewrite_module`指令。

If a directive is specified inside the [location](#p-056), further processing of the request continues in this location.

如果在 [location](#p-056)中指定了指令，則請求的進一步處理將在該位置繼續進行。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> if ($slow) {
>
> 如果 ($slow) {
>     limit_rate 10k;
>     break;
>
>     休息;
> }
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**if** (`*condition*`) { ... }``<br>` `**if** (` *條件* `) { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location` |

The specified `*condition*` is evaluated. If true, this module directives specified inside the braces are executed, and the request is assigned the configuration inside the `if` directive. Configurations inside the `if` directives are inherited from the previous configuration level.

計算指定的`*condition*`。如果為 true，則執行大括號內指定的此模組指令，並且為請求指派`if`指令內的配置。 `if`指令內的配置繼承自先前的配置等級。

A condition may be any of the following:

病症可能包括以下任何一種情況：

-   a variable name; false if the value of a variable is an empty string or “`0`”;  
    變數名稱；如果變數的值為空字串或“ `0` ”，則傳回 false；
    
    > Before version 1.0.1, any string starting with “`0`” was considered a false value.
    >
    > 在版本1.0.1之前，任何以「 `0` 」開頭的字串都被視為假值。
    
-   comparison of a variable with a string using the “`=`” and “`!=`” operators;  
    使用「 `=` 」和「 `!=` 」運算子將變數與字串進行比較；
-   matching of a variable against a regular expression using the “`~`” (for case-sensitive matching) and “`~*`” (for case-insensitive matching) operators. Regular expressions can contain captures that are made available for later reuse in the `$1`..`$9` variables (see [Regular expression captures](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html)). Negative operators “`!~`” and “`!~*`” are also available. If a regular expression includes the “`}`” or “`;`” characters, the whole expressions should be enclosed in single or double quotes.  
    使用「 `~` 」（區分大小寫匹配）和「 `~*` 」（不區分大小寫匹配）運算符，可以將變數與正規表示式進行配對。正規表示式可以包含擷取訊息，這些訊息可在`$1`..`$9` 」變數中重複使用（請參閱[正規表示式擷取](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html) ”）。此外，也可以使用否定運算子「 `!~` 」和「 `!~*` 」。如果正規表示式包含「 `}` 」或「 `;` 」字符，則整個表達式應使用單引號或雙引號括起來。
-   checking of a file existence with the “`-f`” and “`!-f`” operators;  
    使用「 `-f` 」和「 `!-f` 」運算子檢查檔案是否存在；
-   checking of a directory existence with the “`-d`” and “`!-d`” operators;  
    使用「 `-d` 」和「 `!-d` 」運算子檢查目錄是否存在；
-   checking of a file, directory, or symbolic link existence with the “`-e`” and “`!-e`” operators;  
    使用「 `-e` 」和「 `!-e` 」運算子檢查檔案、目錄或符號連結是否存在；
-   checking for an executable file with the “`-x`” and “`!-x`” operators.  
    使用「 `-x` 」和「 `!-x` 」運算子檢查可執行檔。

Examples:

範例：

> ```
> if ($http_user_agent ~ MSIE) {
>
> 如果 ($http_user_agent ~ MSIE ) {
>     rewrite ^(.*)$ /msie/$1 break;
>
>     重寫 ^(.*)$ /msie/$1 break;
> }
> 
> if ($http_cookie ~* "id=([^;]+)(?:;|$)") {
>
> 如果 ($http_cookie ~* "id=([^;]+)(?:;|$)") {
>     set $id $1;
>
>     設定 $id $1;
> }
> 
> if ($request_method = POST) {
>
> 如果 ($request_method = POST ) {
>     return 405;
>
>     返回 405；
> }
> 
> if ($slow) {
>
> 如果 ($slow) {
>     limit_rate 10k;
> }
> 
> if ($invalid_referer) {
>
> 如果 ($invalid_referer) {
>     return 403;
>
>     返回403；
> }
> ```

> A value of the `$invalid_referer` embedded variable is set by the [valid\_referers](#p-089) directive.
>
> `$invalid_referer`嵌入變數的值由 [valid\_referers](#p-089)指令設定。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**return** `*code*` [`*text*`];``<br>``**return** `*code*` `*URL*`;``<br>``**return** `*URL*`;``<br>` `**return** ` *代碼* ` [` *文本* `];``<br>``**return** ` *代碼* ` ` *URL* `;``<br>``**return** ` *URL* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location`, `if` |

Stops processing and returns the specified `*code*` to a client. The non-standard code 444 closes a connection without sending a response header.

停止處理並向客戶端傳回指定的`*code*` 。非標準代碼 444 表示關閉連線而不發送回應頭。

Starting from version 0.8.42, it is possible to specify either a redirect URL (for codes 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308) or the response body `*text*` (for other codes). A response body text and redirect URL can contain variables. As a special case, a redirect URL can be specified as a URI local to this server, in which case the full redirect URL is formed according to the request scheme (`$scheme`) and the [server\_name\_in\_redirect](#p-056) and [port\_in\_redirect](#p-056) directives.

從版本0.8.42開始，可以指定重定向URL （對應狀態碼301、302、303、307和308）或響應體`*text*` （對應其他狀態碼）。響應體文字和重定向URL可以包含變數。特殊情況下，重定向URL可以指定為本伺服器本地重定向URI ，此時完整的重定向URL將根據請求方案（ `$scheme` ）以及[server\_name\_redirect](#p-056) ）以及[server\_name\_redirect](#p-056)

In addition, a `*URL*` for temporary redirect with the code 302 can be specified as the sole parameter. Such a parameter should start with the “`http://`”, “`https://`”, or “`$scheme`” string. A `*URL*` can contain variables.

此外，可以將代碼 302 用於暫時重定向的`*URL*` 指定為唯一參數。此類參數應以「`http://`」、「`https://`」或「`$scheme`」字串開頭。 `*URL*` 可以包含變數。

> Only the following codes could be returned before version 0.7.51: 204, 400, 402 — 406, 408, 410, 411, 413, 416, and 500 — 504.
>
> 在版本0.7.51之前，只能回傳以下程式碼：204、400、402—406、408、410、411、413、416和500—504。

> The code 307 was not treated as a redirect until versions 1.1.16 and 1.0.13.
>
> 在1.1.16和1.0.13版本之前，代碼 307 不被視為重定向。

> The code 308 was not treated as a redirect until version 1.13.0.
>
> 在版本1.13.0之前，代碼 308 不被視為重定向。

See also the [error\_page](#p-056) directive.

另請參閱 [error\_page](#p-056)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**rewrite** `*regex*` `*replacement*` [`*flag*`];``<br>` `**rewrite** ` *正規表達式* ` ` *替換* ` [` *標誌* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location`, `if` |

If the specified regular expression matches a request URI, URI is changed as specified in the `*replacement*` string. The `rewrite` directives are executed sequentially in order of their appearance in the configuration file. It is possible to terminate further processing of the directives using flags. If a replacement string starts with “`http://`”, “`https://`”, or “`$scheme`”, the processing stops and the redirect is returned to a client.

如果指定的正規表示式與請求匹配，則URI, URI將按照`*replacement*`字串中的指定進行更改。 `rewrite`指令依照它們在設定檔中出現的順序依序執行。可以使用標誌終止指令的進一步處理。如果替換字串以「`http://`」、「`https://`」或「`$scheme`」開頭，則處理停止並將重定向傳回給用戶端。

An optional `*flag*` parameter can be one of:

可選參數`*flag*`可以是以下之一：

`last`

stops processing the current set of `ngx_http_rewrite_module` directives and starts a search for a new location matching the changed URI;

停止處理目前`ngx_http_rewrite_module`指令集，並開始搜尋與已更改的URI匹配的新位置；

`break`

stops processing the current set of `ngx_http_rewrite_module` directives as with the [break](#p-090) directive;

停止處理目前一組`ngx_http_rewrite_module`指令，就像 [break](#p-090)指令一樣；

`redirect`

returns a temporary redirect with the 302 code; used if a replacement string does not start with “`http://`”, “`https://`”, or “`$scheme`”;

傳回帶有 302 代碼的暫時重定向；如果替換字串不以「 `http://` 」、「 `https://` 」或「 `$scheme` 」開頭，則使用此方法；

`permanent`

returns a permanent redirect with the 301 code.

返回永久重定向，重定向代碼為 301。

The full redirect URL is formed according to the request scheme (`$scheme`) and the [server\_name\_in\_redirect](#p-056) and [port\_in\_redirect](#p-056) directives.

完整的重定向URL是根據請求方案 ( `$scheme` ) 和 [server\_name\_in\_redirect](#p-056)和 [port\_in\_redirect](#p-056)指令形成的。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     ...
>     rewrite ^(/download/.*)/media/(.*)\..*$ $1/mp3/$2.mp3 last;
>     rewrite ^(/download/.*)/audio/(.*)\..*$ $1/mp3/$2.ra  last;
>
>     rewrite ^(/download/.*)/audio/(.*)\..*$ $1/mp3/$2.ra last;
>     return  403;
>
>     返回 403；
>     ...
> }
> ```

But if these directives are put inside the “`/download/`” location, the `last` flag should be replaced by `break`, or otherwise nginx will make 10 cycles and return the 500 error:

但是，如果將這些指令放在「 `/download/` 」位置內，則應將`last`標誌替換為`break` ，否則nginx將執行10次循環並傳回500錯誤：

> ```
> location /download/ {
>     rewrite ^(/download/.*)/media/(.*)\..*$ $1/mp3/$2.mp3 break;
>     rewrite ^(/download/.*)/audio/(.*)\..*$ $1/mp3/$2.ra  break;
>
>     rewrite ^(/download/.*)/audio/(.*)\..*$ $1/mp3/$2.ra break;
>     return  403;
>
>     返回 403；
> }
> ```

If a `*replacement*` string includes the new request arguments, the previous request arguments are appended after them. If this is undesired, putting a question mark at the end of a replacement string avoids having them appended, for example:

如果`*replacement*`字串包含新的請求參數，則先前的請求參數會附加到其後。如果不希望這樣做，可以在替換字串末尾添加問號，例如：

> ```
> rewrite ^/users/(.*)$ /show?user=$1? last;
> ```

If a regular expression includes the “`}`” or “`;`” characters, the whole expressions should be enclosed in single or double quotes.

如果正規表示式包含「 `}` 」或「 `;` 」字符，則整個表達式應放在單引號或雙引號內。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>rewrite_log</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>rewrite_log off;<br>關閉 rewrite_log；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>if<br>如果</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables logging of `ngx_http_rewrite_module` module directives processing results into the [error\_log](#p-125) at the `notice` level.

啟用或停用將`ngx_http_rewrite_module`模組指令處理結果記錄到 [error\_log](#p-125)中，等級為`notice` 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**set** `*$variable*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**set** ` *$變數* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location`, `if` |

Sets a `*value*` for the specified `*variable*`. The `*value*` can contain text, variables, and their combination.

為指定的`*variable*`設定`*value*`可以包含文字、 `*value*`及其組合。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uninitialized_variable_warn</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uninitialized_variable_warn on;<br>未初始化變數警告開啟；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code>, <code>if<br>如果</code></td></tr>
</table>

Controls whether warnings about uninitialized variables are logged.

控制是否記錄有關未初始化變數的警告。

**Internal Implementation｜內部實施**

The `ngx_http_rewrite_module` module directives are compiled at the configuration stage into internal instructions that are interpreted during request processing. An interpreter is a simple virtual stack machine.

`ngx_http_rewrite_module`模組指令在配置階段被編譯成內部指令，並在請求處理期間進行解釋。解釋器是一個簡單的虛擬堆疊機器。

For example, the directives

例如，指令

> ```
> location /download/ {
>     if ($forbidden) {
>
>     如果 ($forbidden) {
>         return 403;
>
>         返回403；
>     }
> 
>     if ($slow) {
>
>     如果 ($slow) {
>         limit_rate 10k;
>     }
> 
>     rewrite ^/(download/.*)/media/(.*)\..*$ /$1/mp3/$2.mp3 break;
> }
> ```

will be translated into these instructions:

將被翻譯成以下說明：

> ```
> variable $forbidden
>
> 變數 $forbidden
> check against zero
>
> 檢查是否為零
>     return 403
>
>     返回 403
>     end of code
>
>     程式碼結束
> variable $slow
>
> 變數 $slow
> check against zero
>
> 檢查是否為零
> match of regular expression
>
> 正規表示式匹配
> copy "/"
>
> 複製 ”/”
> copy $1
>
> 複製 1 美元
> copy "/mp3/"
>
> 複製“/mp3/”
> copy $2
>
> 副本 2 美元
> copy ".mp3"
>
> 複製“.mp3”
> end of regular expression
>
> 正規表示式結束
> end of code
>
> 程式碼結束
> ```

Note that there are no instructions for the [limit\_rate](#p-056) directive above as it is unrelated to the `ngx_http_rewrite_module` module. A separate configuration is created for the [if](#p-090) block. If the condition holds true, a request is assigned this configuration where `limit_rate` equals to 10k.

請注意，上述 [limit\_rate](#p-056)指令沒有相關說明，因為它與`ngx_http_rewrite_module`模組無關。 [if](#p-090)程式碼區塊會單獨配置。如果條件成立，則請求會被指派此配置，其中`limit_rate`等於 10k。

The directive

該指令

> ```
> rewrite ^/(download/.*)/media/(.*)\..*$ /$1/mp3/$2.mp3 break;
> ```

can be made smaller by one instruction if the first slash in the regular expression is put inside the parentheses:

如果將正規表示式中的第一個斜線放在括號內，則可以透過一條指令將其縮短：

> ```
> rewrite ^(/download/.*)/media/(.*)\..*$ $1/mp3/$2.mp3 break;
> ```

The corresponding instructions will then look like this:

對應的指令如下所示：

> ```
> match of regular expression
>
> 正規表示式匹配
> copy $1
>
> 複製 1 美元
> copy "/mp3/"
>
> 複製“/mp3/”
> copy $2
>
> 副本 2 美元
> copy ".mp3"
>
> 複製“.mp3”
> end of regular expression
>
> 正規表示式結束
> end of code
>
> 程式碼結束
> ```

---

<a id="p-091"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_scgi_module｜模組 ngx_http_scgi_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_scgi\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_scgi\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-091)<br>[Directives](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_allow\_upstream](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_bind](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_bind\_dynamic](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_buffer\_size](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_buffering](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_buffers](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_busy\_buffers\_size](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_background\_update](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_bypass](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_key](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_lock](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_lock\_age](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_max\_range\_offset](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_methods](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_min\_uses](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_path](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_purge](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_revalidate](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_use\_stale](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_cache\_valid](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_connect\_timeout](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_force\_ranges](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_hide\_header](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_ignore\_client\_abort](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_intercept\_errors](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_limit\_rate](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_next\_upstream](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_next\_upstream\_timeout](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_next\_upstream\_tries](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_no\_cache](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_param](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_pass](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_pass\_header](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_pass\_request\_body](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_read\_timeout](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_request\_buffering](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_request\_dynamic](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_send\_timeout](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_socket\_keepalive](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_socket\_rcvbuf](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_socket\_sndbuf](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_store](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_store\_access](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-091)<br>     [scgi\_temp\_path](#p-091) |

The `ngx_http_scgi_module` module allows passing requests to an SCGI server.

`ngx_http_scgi_module`模組允許向SCGI伺服器傳遞請求。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     include   scgi_params;
>
>     包含 scgi_params；
>     scgi_pass localhost:9000;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**scgi_allow_upstream** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**scgi_allow_upstream** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

Defines conditions under which access to an SCGI server is allowed or [denied](#p-091). If all string parameters are not empty and not equal to “0” then the access is allowed. The conditions are evaluated each time before a connection to an SCGI server is established. Parameter values can contain variables:

定義允許或拒絕存取SCGI伺服器的條件。如果所有字串參數均不為空且不等於“0”，則允許存取。每次建立與SCGI伺服器的連線之前(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html#denied)都會評估這些條件。參數值可以包含變數：

> ```
> geo $upstream_last_addr $allow {
>     volatile;
>
>     易揮發的;
>     10.10.0.0/24        1;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>     聽127.0.0.1:8080 ;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         scgi_pass           localhost:9000;
>
>         scgi_pass localhost:9000;
>         scgi_allow_upstream $allow;
>         ...
>     }
> }
> ```

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**scgi_bind** `*address*` [`transparent`] \| `off`;``<br>` `**scgi_bind** ` *地址* ` [`透明`] \| `關閉`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Makes outgoing connections to an SCGI server originate from the specified local IP address with an optional port (1.11.2). Parameter value can contain variables (1.3.12). The special value `off` (1.3.12) cancels the effect of the `scgi_bind` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows the system to auto-assign the local IP address and port.

使發送至SCGI伺服器的出站連接源自指定的本地IP位址，並可選擇指定連接埠 ( 1.11.2 )。參數值可以包含變數 ( 1.3.12 )。特殊值`off` ( 1.3.12 ) 會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`scgi_bind`指令的效果，該指令允許系統自動分配本地IP位址和連接埠。

The `transparent` parameter (1.11.0) allows outgoing connections to an SCGI server originate from a non-local IP address, for example, from a real IP address of a client:

`transparent`參數 ( 1.11.0 ) 允許從非本地IP位址（例如，客戶端的真實IP位址）發出到SCGI伺服器的出站連接：

> ```
> scgi_bind $remote_addr transparent;
> ```

In order for this parameter to work, it is usually necessary to run nginx worker processes with the [superuser](#p-125) privileges. On Linux it is not required (1.13.8) as if the `transparent` parameter is specified, worker processes inherit the `CAP_NET_RAW` capability from the master process. It is also necessary to configure kernel routing table to intercept network traffic from the SCGI server.

為了使此參數生效，通常需要以 [superuser](#p-125)權限執行 nginx 工作進程。在 Linux 系統上則無需此權限 ( 1.13.8 )，因為如果指定了`transparent`參數，工作進程會從主進程繼承`CAP_NET_RAW`權限。此外，還需要配置核心路由表以攔截來自SCGI伺服器的網路流量。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_bind_dynamic</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_bind_dynamic off;<br>scgi_bind_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

When enabled, makes the [bind](#p-091) operation at each connection attempt.

啟用後，每次連線嘗試時執行 [bind](#p-091)操作。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_buffer_size 4k|8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading the first part of the response received from the SCGI server. This part usually contains a small response header; if it exceeds the buffer size, the response is considered [invalid](#p-091). By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform. It can be made smaller, however.

設定用於讀取從伺服器接收的回應第一部分的緩衝區大小`*size*` SCGI 。這部分通常包含一個較小的響應頭；如果響應頭大小超過緩衝區大小，則該響應被視為無效（ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html#invalid_header) ）。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台的不同，該大小為 4K 或 8K。不過，緩衝區大小可以減少。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_buffering</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_buffering on;<br>scgi_buffering on；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables buffering of responses from the SCGI server.

啟用或停用來自SCGI伺服器的回應緩衝。

When buffering is enabled, nginx receives a response from the SCGI server as soon as possible, saving it into the buffers set by the [scgi\_buffer\_size](#p-091) and [scgi\_buffers](#p-091) directives. If the whole response does not fit into memory, a part of it can be saved to a [temporary file](#p-091) on the disk. Writing to temporary files is controlled by the [scgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-091) and [scgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-091) directives.

啟用緩衝後，nginx 會盡快從SCGI接收回應，並將其儲存到由 [scgi\_buffer\_size](#p-091)和 [scgi\_buffers](#p-091)指令設定的緩衝區中。如果整個回應無法放入內存，則可以將其一部分儲存到磁碟上的暫存檔案 [scgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-091)和 [scgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-091)指令控制(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html#scgi_temp_file_write_size)檔案的寫入。

When buffering is disabled, the response is passed to a client synchronously, immediately as it is received. nginx will not try to read the whole response from the SCGI server. The maximum size of the data that nginx can receive from the server at a time is set by the [scgi\_buffer\_size](#p-091) directive.

停用緩衝後，回應會同步地立即傳遞給客戶端。 nginx 不會嘗試從伺服器讀取整個回應。 nginx 一次可以從伺服器接收的最大資料量由 [scgi\_buffer\ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html#scgi_buffer_size) ]SCGI設定。

Buffering can also be enabled or disabled by passing “`yes`” or “`no`” in the “X-Accel-Buffering” response header field. This capability can be disabled using the [scgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-091) directive.

也可以透過在“X-Accel-Buffering”響應頭字段中傳遞「 `yes` 」或「 `no` 」來啟用或停用緩衝。可以使用 [scgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-091)指令停用此功能。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_buffers</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_buffers 8 4k|8k;<br>scgi_buffers 8 4k|8k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*number*` and `*size*` of the buffers used for reading a response from the SCGI server, for a single connection. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform.

設定用於從SCGI伺服器讀取回應的緩衝區`*number*`和`*size*`的值，此設定僅適用於單一連線。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台不同，該值可以是 4K 或 8K。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_busy_buffers_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_busy_buffers_size 8k|16k;<br>scgi_busy_buffers_size 8k|16k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

When [buffering](#p-091) of responses from the SCGI server is enabled, limits the total `*size*` of buffers that can be busy sending a response to the client while the response is not yet fully read. In the meantime, the rest of the buffers can be used for reading the response and, if needed, buffering part of the response to a temporary file. By default, `*size*` is limited by the size of two buffers set by the [scgi\_buffer\_size](#p-091) and [scgi\_buffers](#p-091) directives.

啟用伺服器回應緩衝功能後，會限制用於向客戶端發送回應的`*size*`總數(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html#scgi_buffering) SCGI ，直到客戶端完全讀取回應為止。在此期間，其餘緩衝區可用於讀取回應，並在需要時將部分回應緩衝到暫存檔案。預設情況下，緩衝區大小受限於 [scgi\_buffer\_size] 和 [scgi\_buffers 指令設定的兩個緩衝區的大小](#p-091) `*size*`和(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html#scgi_buffers)指令）。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_cache</strong> <code><i>zone</i></code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_cache off;<br>scgi_cache 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a shared memory zone used for caching. The same zone can be used in several places. Parameter value can contain variables (1.7.9). The `off` parameter disables caching inherited from the previous configuration level.

定義用於快取的共享記憶體區域。同一區域可以在多個地方使用。參數值可以包含變數(1.7.9)。 `off` 參數停用從先前配置等級繼承的快取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_cache_background_update</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_cache_background_update off;<br>scgi_cache_background_update 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.11.10.

該指令出現在版本1.11.10 。

Allows starting a background subrequest to update an expired cache item, while a stale cached response is returned to the client. Note that it is necessary to [allow](#p-091) the usage of a stale cached response when it is being updated.

允許啟動後台子請求來更新已過期的快取項，同時向客戶端傳回過時的快取回應。請注意，在更新快取項目時，必須允許使用過時的快取回應（請參閱(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html#scgi_cache_use_stale_updating) ）。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**scgi_cache_bypass** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**scgi_cache_bypass** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines conditions under which the response will not be taken from a cache. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the response will not be taken from the cache:

定義不從快取中取得回應的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則不會從快取中取得回應：

> ```
> scgi_cache_bypass $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment;
>
> scgi_cache_bypass $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment；
> scgi_cache_bypass $http_pragma    $http_authorization;
>
> scgi_cache_bypass $http_pragma $http_authorization;
> ```

Can be used along with the [scgi\_no\_cache](#p-091) directive.

可與 [scgi\_no\_cache](#p-091)指令一起使用。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**scgi_cache_key** `*string*`;``<br>` `**scgi_cache_key** ` *字串* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines a key for caching, for example

定義一個用於快取的鍵，例如

> ```
> scgi_cache_key localhost:9000$request_uri;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_cache_lock</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_cache_lock off;<br>scgi_cache_lock 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.12.

該指令出現在版本1.1.12 。

When enabled, only one request at a time will be allowed to populate a new cache element identified according to the [scgi\_cache\_key](#p-091) directive by passing a request to an SCGI server. Other requests of the same cache element will either wait for a response to appear in the cache or the cache lock for this element to be released, up to the time set by the [scgi\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-091) directive.

啟用此功能後，每次只允許一個請求透過向SCGI伺服器發送請求來填入根據 [scgi\_cache\_key](#p-091)指令標識的新快取元素。對相同快取元素的其他請求將等待快取中出現回應或該元素的快取鎖定被釋放，直到 [scgi\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-091)指令設定的時間結束。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_cache_lock_age</strong> <code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_cache_lock_age 5s;<br>scgi_cache_lock_age 5秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.8.

該指令出現在版本1.7.8 。

If the last request passed to the SCGI server for populating a new cache element has not completed for the specified `*time*`, one more request may be passed to the SCGI server.

如果向SCGI伺服器傳遞的最後一個用於填充新快取元素的請求尚未針對指定的`*time*`完成，則可以向SCGI伺服器傳遞另一個請求。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_cache_lock_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_cache_lock_timeout 5s;<br>scgi_cache_lock_timeout 5秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.12.

該指令出現在版本1.1.12 。

Sets a timeout for [scgi\_cache\_lock](#p-091). When the `*time*` expires, the request will be passed to the SCGI server, however, the response will not be cached.

為 [scgi\_cache\_lock](#p-091)設定逾時時間。當`*time*`逾時時，請求將傳遞給SCGI伺服器，但回應不會被快取。

> Before 1.7.8, the response could be cached.
>
> 在1.7.8之前，響應可以被快取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**scgi_cache_max_range_offset** `*number*`;``<br>` `**scgi_cache_max_range_offset** ` *數字* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.6.

該指令出現在版本1.11.6 。

Sets an offset in bytes for byte-range requests. If the range is beyond the offset, the range request will be passed to the SCGI server and the response will not be cached.

設定位元組範圍請求的位元組偏移量。如果範圍超出偏移量，則範圍請求將傳遞給SCGI伺服器，並且回應不會被快取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_cache_methods</strong> <code>GET</code> | <code>HEAD</code> | <code>POST</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_cache_methods GET HEAD;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

If the client request method is listed in this directive then the response will be cached. “`GET`” and “`HEAD`” methods are always added to the list, though it is recommended to specify them explicitly. See also the [scgi\_no\_cache](#p-091) directive.

如果客戶端請求方法列在此指令中，則回應將被快取。 「 `GET` 」和「 `HEAD` 」方法總是會加入到清單中，但建議明確指定它們。另請參閱[scgi\_no\_cache](#p-091)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_cache_min_uses</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_cache_min_uses 1;<br>scgi_cache_min_uses 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*number*` of requests after which the response will be cached.

設定`*number*`請求數，超過該請求數後回應將被快取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**scgi_cache_path** `*path*` [`levels`=`*levels*`] [`use_temp_path`=`on`\|`off`] `keys_zone`=`*name*`:`*size*` [`inactive`=`*time*`] [`max_size`=`*size*`] [`min_free`=`*size*`] [`manager_files`=`*number*`] [`manager_sleep`=`*time*`] [`manager_threshold`=`*time*`] [`loader_files`=`*number*`] [`loader_sleep`=`*time*`] [`loader_threshold`=`*time*`] [`purger`=`on`\|`off`] [`purger_files`=`*number*`] [`purger_sleep`=`*time*`] [`purger_threshold`=`*time*`];``<br>``**scgi_cache_path** `*小路*` [`等級`=`*級別*`] [`使用臨時路徑`=`在`\|`離開`] `鑰匙區`=`*姓名*`:`*尺寸*` [`不活躍`=`*時間*`] [`最大尺寸`=`*尺寸*`] [`最小空閒`=`*尺寸*`] [`管理器文件`=`*數字*`] [`經理睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`經理閾值`=`*時間*`] [`載入器文件`=`*數字*`] [`載入器睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`載入器閾值`=`*時間*`] [`清除`=`在`\|`離開`] [`清除文件`=`*數字*`] [`清除睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`淨化閾值`=`*時間*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Sets the path and other parameters of a cache. Cache data are stored in files. The file name in a cache is a result of applying the MD5 function to the [cache key](#p-091). The `levels` parameter defines hierarchy levels of a cache: from 1 to 3, each level accepts values 1 or 2. For example, in the following configuration

設定快取的路徑和其他參數。快取資料儲存在文件中。快取中的檔名是將MD5函數套用到[快取鍵](#p-091)的結果。 `levels`參數定義了快取的層次結構層級：從1到3，每個層級接受值1或2。例如，在以下配置中

> ```
> scgi_cache_path /data/nginx/cache levels=1:2 keys_zone=one:10m;
> ```

file names in a cache will look like this:

快取中的檔案名稱將如下所示：

> ```
> /data/nginx/cache/c/29/b7f54b2df7773722d382f4809d65029c
>
> /data/nginx/cache/c/29/ b7f54b2df7773722d382f4809d65029c
> ```

A cached response is first written to a temporary file, and then the file is renamed. Starting from version 0.8.9, temporary files and the cache can be put on different file systems. However, be aware that in this case a file is copied across two file systems instead of the cheap renaming operation. It is thus recommended that for any given location both cache and a directory holding temporary files are put on the same file system. A directory for temporary files is set based on the `use_temp_path` parameter (1.7.10). If this parameter is omitted or set to the value `on`, the directory set by the [scgi\_temp\_path](#p-091) directive for the given location will be used. If the value is set to `off`, temporary files will be put directly in the cache directory.

快取回應首先寫入臨時文件，然後重新命名該文件。從版本0.8.9開始，臨時檔案和快取可以位於不同的檔案系統上。但是請注意，在這種情況下，檔案會被複製到兩個檔案系統上，而不是進行簡單的重新命名操作。因此，建議對於任何給定位置，快取和存放臨時檔案的目錄都位於同一檔案系統上。暫存檔案目錄的設定是基於`use_temp_path`參數（ 1.7.10 ）。如果省略此參數或將其設為`on`值，則將使用 [scgi\_temp\_path](#p-091)指令為給定位置設定的目錄。如果將其設定為`off`值，則暫存檔案將直接放置在快取目錄中。

In addition, all active keys and information about data are stored in a shared memory zone, whose `*name*` and `*size*` are configured by the `keys_zone` parameter. One megabyte zone can store about 8 thousand keys.

此外，所有活動金鑰和資料資訊都儲存在一個共享記憶體區域中，該區域的`*name*`和`*size*`由`keys_zone`參數配置。一個兆位元組的區域大約可以儲存8000個密鑰。

> As part of [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx), the shared memory zone also stores extended cache [information](#p-048), thus, it is required to specify a larger zone size for the same number of keys. For example, one megabyte zone can store about 4 thousand keys.
>
> 作為[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，共享記憶體區域也會儲存擴充快取[資訊](#p-048) ，因此，對於相同數量的鍵，需要指定更大的區域大小。例如，1兆位元組的區域大約可以儲存4000個鍵。

Cached data that are not accessed during the time specified by the `inactive` parameter get removed from the cache regardless of their freshness. By default, `inactive` is set to 10 minutes.

在`inactive`參數指定的時間內未存取的快取資料將從快取中刪除，無論其新鮮度為何。預設情況下，`inactive` 設定為 10 分鐘。

The special “cache manager” process monitors the maximum cache size set by the `max_size` parameter, and the minimum amount of free space set by the `min_free` (1.19.1) parameter on the file system with cache. When the size is exceeded or there is not enough free space, it removes the least recently used data. The data is removed in iterations configured by `manager_files`, `manager_threshold`, and `manager_sleep` parameters (1.11.5). During one iteration no more than `manager_files` items are deleted (by default, 100). The duration of one iteration is limited by the `manager_threshold` parameter (by default, 200 milliseconds). Between iterations, a pause configured by the `manager_sleep` parameter (by default, 50 milliseconds) is made.

特殊的「快取管理器」程序會監控由參數`max_size`設定的最大快取大小，以及由參數`min_free` （ 1.19.1 ）設定的檔案系統快取的最小可用空間。當快取大小超過限製或可用空間不足時，它會刪除最近最少使用的資料。資料刪除的迭代次數由參數`manager_files`, `manager_threshold`和`manager_sleep` （ 1.11.5 ）配置。每次迭代最多刪除`manager_files`個項目（預設值為100）。每次迭代的持續時間由參數`manager_threshold`限制（預設值為200毫秒）。在兩次迭代之間，會執行由參數`manager_sleep`配置的暫停（預設值為50毫秒）。

A minute after the start the special “cache loader” process is activated. It loads information about previously cached data stored on file system into a cache zone. The loading is also done in iterations. During one iteration no more than `loader_files` items are loaded (by default, 100). Besides, the duration of one iteration is limited by the `loader_threshold` parameter (by default, 200 milliseconds). Between iterations, a pause configured by the `loader_sleep` parameter (by default, 50 milliseconds) is made.

啟動一分鐘後，特殊的「快取載入器」進程將會啟動。它會將先前儲存在檔案系統中的快取資料資訊載入到快取區域。載入過程也以迭代方式進行。每次迭代最多載入`loader_files`個項目（預設值為100）。此外，每次迭代的持續時間由`loader_threshold`參數限制（預設值為200毫秒）。在兩次迭代之間，會執行由`loader_sleep`參數配置的暫停（預設值為50毫秒）。

Additionally, the following parameters are available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx):

此外，以下參數包含在我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)中：

`purger`\=`on`|`off`

Instructs whether cache entries that match a [wildcard key](#p-091) will be removed from the disk by the cache purger (1.7.12). Setting the parameter to `on` (default is `off`) will activate the “cache purger” process that permanently iterates through all cache entries and deletes the entries that match the wildcard key.

指示是否由快取清除程序 ( 1.7.12 ) 從磁碟中刪除與 [通配符鍵](#p-091)相符的快取條目。將此參數設為`on` （預設值為`off` ）將啟動“快取清除程序”，該程式會永久遍歷所有快取條目並刪除與通配符鍵相符的條目。

`purger_files`\=`*number*`

Sets the number of items that will be scanned during one iteration (1.7.12). By default, `purger_files` is set to 10.

設定一次迭代中要掃描的物品數量（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_files`設定為 10。

`purger_threshold`\=`*number*`

Sets the duration of one iteration (1.7.12). By default, `purger_threshold` is set to 50 milliseconds.

設定一次迭代的持續時間（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_threshold`設定為 50 毫秒。

`purger_sleep`\=`*number*`

Sets a pause between iterations (1.7.12). By default, `purger_sleep` is set to 50 milliseconds.

設定迭代之間的暫停時間（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_sleep`設定為 50 毫秒。

> In versions 1.7.3, 1.7.7, and 1.11.10 cache header format has been changed. Previously cached responses will be considered invalid after upgrading to a newer nginx version.
>
> 在版本1.7.3, 1.7.7和1.11.10中，快取頭格式已變更。升級到更新的 nginx 版本後，先前快取的回應將被視為無效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**scgi_cache_purge** string ...;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Defines conditions under which the request will be considered a cache purge request. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the cache entry with a corresponding [cache key](#p-091) is removed. The result of successful operation is indicated by returning the 204 (No Content) response.

定義請求被視為快取清除請求的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則會刪除具有對應 [快取鍵](#p-091)的快取條目。操作成功後，將返回 204（無內容）回應。

If the [cache key](#p-091) of a purge request ends with an asterisk (“`*`”), all cache entries matching the wildcard key will be removed from the cache. However, these entries will remain on the disk until they are deleted for either [inactivity](#p-091), or processed by the [cache purger](#p-091) (1.7.12), or a client attempts to access them.

如果清除請求的 [快取鍵](#p-091)以星號 (“ `*` ”) 結尾，則所有與該通配符鍵相符的快取條目都會從快取中刪除。但是，這些條目將保留在磁碟上，直到因 [不活動](#p-091)而被刪除，或被 [快取清除程序](#p-091) ( 1.7.12 ) 處理，或用戶端嘗試存取它們為止。

Example configuration:

設定範例：

> ```
> scgi_cache_path /data/nginx/cache keys_zone=cache_zone:10m;
> 
> map $request_method $purge_method {
>
> 映射 $request_method $purge_method {
>     PURGE   1;
>     default 0;
>
>     預設值為 0；
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     ...
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         scgi_pass        backend;
>
>         scgi_pass 後端；
>         scgi_cache       cache_zone;
>
>         scgi_cache 快取區；
>         scgi_cache_key   $uri;
>
>         scgi_cache_key $uri;
>         scgi_cache_purge $purge_method;
>     }
> }
> ```

> This functionality is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此功能作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_cache_revalidate</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_cache_revalidate off;<br>scgi_cache_revalidate 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Enables revalidation of expired cache items using conditional requests with the “If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自） and “If-None-Match”（如果無匹配） header fields.

允許使用帶有“If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自）和“If-None-Match”（如果無匹配）標頭字段的條件請求重新驗證過期的快取項目。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_cache_use_stale</strong> <code>error<br>錯誤</code> | <code>timeout<br>暫停</code> | <code>invalid_header<br>無效標頭</code> | <code>updating<br>更新</code> | <code>http_500</code> | <code>http_503</code> | <code>http_403</code> | <code>http_404</code> | <code>http_429</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_cache_use_stale off;<br>scgi_cache_use_stale 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines in which cases a stale cached response can be used when an error occurs during communication with the SCGI server. The directive’s parameters match the parameters of the [scgi\_next\_upstream](#p-091) directive.

確定在與SCGI伺服器通訊期間發生錯誤時，哪些情況下可以使用過期的快取回應。此指令的參數與 [scgi\_next\_upstream](#p-091)指令的參數相符。

The `error` parameter also permits using a stale cached response if an SCGI server to process a request cannot be selected.

如果無法選擇SCGI伺服器來處理請求， `error`參數也允許使用過期的快取回應。

Additionally, the `updating` parameter permits using a stale cached response if it is currently being updated. This allows minimizing the number of accesses to SCGI servers when updating cached data.

此外， `updating`參數允許在快取回應正在更新時使用過期的快取回應。這樣可以最大限度地減少更新快取資料時對SCGI伺服器的存取次數。

Using a stale cached response can also be enabled directly in the response header for a specified number of seconds after the response became stale (1.11.10). This has lower priority than using the directive parameters.

使用過期的快取回應也可以直接在回應頭中啟用，持續指定的秒數，在回應過期後繼續使用（ 1.11.10 ）。這種方法的優先權低於使用指令參數。

-   The “[stale-while-revalidate](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-3)” extension of the “Cache-Control”（快取控制） header field permits using a stale cached response if it is currently being updated.  
    “Cache-Control”（快取控制）標頭欄位的「[stale-while-revalidate](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-3) 」擴充功能允許在目前正在更新時使用過期的快取回應。
-   The “[stale-if-error](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-4)” extension of the “Cache-Control”（快取控制） header field permits using a stale cached response in case of an error.  
    “[stale-if-error](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-4) ” “Cache-Control”（快取控制）標頭字段的擴充功能允許在發生錯誤時使用過期的快取回應。

To minimize the number of accesses to SCGI servers when populating a new cache element, the [scgi\_cache\_lock](#p-091) directive can be used.

為了在填充新的快取元素時最大限度地減少對SCGI伺服器的存取次數，可以使用 [scgi\_cache\_lock](#p-091)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**scgi_cache_valid** [`*code*` ...] `*time*`;``<br>` `**scgi_cache_valid** [` *代碼* ` ...] ` *時間* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Sets caching time for different response codes. For example, the following directives

設定不同回應代碼的快取時間。例如，以下指令：

> ```
> scgi_cache_valid 200 302 10m;
> scgi_cache_valid 404      1m;
>
> scgi_cache_valid 404 1m;
> ```

set 10 minutes of caching for responses with codes 200 and 302 and 1 minute for responses with code 404.

對代碼為 200 和 302 的回應設定 10 分鐘的快取時間，對代碼為 404 的回應設定 1 分鐘的快取時間。

If only caching `*time*` is specified

如果僅指定快取`*time*`

> ```
> scgi_cache_valid 5m;
>
> scgi_cache_valid 5分鐘；
> ```

then only 200, 301, and 302 responses are cached.

那麼只有 200、301 和 302 回應會被快取。

In addition, the `any` parameter can be specified to cache any responses:

此外，也可以指定`any`參數來快取任何回應：

> ```
> scgi_cache_valid 200 302 10m;
> scgi_cache_valid 301      1h;
>
> scgi_cache_valid 301 1h;
> scgi_cache_valid any      1m;
>
> scgi_cache_valid 任意 1m；
> ```

Parameters of caching can also be set directly in the response header. This has higher priority than setting of caching time using the directive.

快取參數也可以直接在回應頭中設定。這種方法的優先權高於使用指令設定快取時間。

-   The “X-Accel-Expires” header field sets caching time of a response in seconds. The zero value disables caching for a response. If the value starts with the `@` prefix, it sets an absolute time in seconds since Epoch, up to which the response may be cached.  
    “X-Accel-Expires”標頭欄位用於設定回應的快取時間（以秒為單位）。值為零時，回應將被停用快取。如果該值以`@`前綴開頭，則表示響應可緩存的絕對時間（以秒為單位，自 Unix 紀元以來）。
-   If the header does not include the “X-Accel-Expires” field, parameters of caching may be set in the header fields “Expires”（過期） or “Cache-Control”（快取控制）.  
    如果標頭不包含“X-Accel-Expires”字段，則可以在標頭字段“Expires”（過期）或“Cache-Control”（快取控制）中設定快取參數。
-   If the header includes the “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） field, such a response will not be cached.  
    如果標頭包含“Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）字段，則此類回應將不會被快取。
-   If the header includes the “Vary”（各不相同） field with the special value “`*`”, such a response will not be cached (1.7.7). If the header includes the “Vary”（各不相同） field with another value, such a response will be cached taking into account the corresponding request header fields (1.7.7).  
    如果請求頭包含具有特殊值「 `*` 」的“Vary”（各不相同）字段，則該回應不會被快取（ 1.7.7 ）。如果請求頭包含具有其他值的“Vary”（各不相同）字段，則會根據對應的請求頭字段快取該回應（ 1.7.7 ）。

Processing of one or more of these response header fields can be disabled using the [scgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-091) directive.

可以使用 [scgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-091)指令來停用對一個或多個回應標頭欄位的處理。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_connect_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_connect_timeout 60s;<br>scgi_connect_timeout 60秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for establishing a connection with an SCGI server. It should be noted that this timeout cannot usually exceed 75 seconds.

定義與SCGI伺服器建立連線的逾時時間。需要注意的是，此超時時間通常不能超過75秒。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_force_ranges</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_force_ranges off;<br>scgi_force_ranges 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.7.

該指令出現在版本1.7.7 。

Enables byte-range support for both cached and uncached responses from the SCGI server regardless of the “Accept-Ranges”（接受範圍） field in these responses.

啟用對來自SCGI伺服器的快取和非快取回應的位元組範圍支持，而不管這些回應中的“Accept-Ranges”（接受範圍）欄位是什麼。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**scgi_hide_header** `*field*`;``<br>` `**scgi_hide_header** ` *字段* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

By default, nginx does not pass the header fields “Status”（地位） and “X-Accel-...” from the response of an SCGI server to a client. The `scgi_hide_header` directive sets additional fields that will not be passed. If, on the contrary, the passing of fields needs to be permitted, the [scgi\_pass\_header](#p-091) directive can be used.

預設情況下，nginx 不會將SCGI回應中的“Status”（地位）和“X-Accel-...”標頭欄位傳遞給客戶端。 P140 `scgi_hide_header`可以設定一些額外的字段，這些字段不會被傳遞。如果需要允許傳遞這些字段，可以使用 [scgi\_pass\_header](#p-091)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_ignore_client_abort</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_ignore_client_abort off;<br>scgi_ignore_client_abort 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether the connection with an SCGI server should be closed when a client closes the connection without waiting for a response.

確定當客戶端在未等待回應的情況下關閉與SCGI伺服器的連線時，是否應該關閉該連線。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**scgi_ignore_headers** `*field*` ...;``<br>` `**scgi_ignore_headers** ` *字段* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Disables processing of certain response header fields from the SCGI server. The following fields can be ignored: “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）, “X-Accel-Expires”, “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） (1.1.6), “X-Accel-Buffering” (1.1.6), “X-Accel-Charset” (1.1.6), “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） (0.8.44), and “Vary”（各不相同） (1.7.7).

停用對來自SCGI伺服器的某些回應頭字段的處理。可忽略以下欄位1.1.6 “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）, “X-Accel-Expires”, “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） ( 1.1.6 )、 “X-Accel-Buffering” ( 1.1.6 )、 “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） ( 0.8.44 “X-Accel-Charset”和“Vary”（各不相同） ( 1.7.7 )。

If not disabled, processing of these header fields has the following effect:

如果未停用，處理這些標頭欄位會產生以下效果：

-   “X-Accel-Expires”, “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）, and “Vary”（各不相同） set the parameters of response [caching](#p-091);  
    “X-Accel-Expires”, “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）和“Vary”（各不相同）設定響應 [快取](#p-091)的參數；
-   “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向） performs an [internal redirect](#p-056) to the specified URI;  
    “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）執行 [內部重定向](#p-056)到指定的URI ;
-   “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） sets the [rate limit](#p-056) for transmission of a response to a client;  
    “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率）設定向客戶端發送回應的 [速率限制](#p-056) ；
-   “X-Accel-Buffering” enables or disables [buffering](#p-091) of a response;  
    “X-Accel-Buffering”啟用或停用 [緩衝](#p-091)響應；
-   “X-Accel-Charset” sets the desired [charset](#p-055) of a response.  
    “X-Accel-Charset”設定響應的所需 [字元集](#p-055) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_intercept_errors</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_intercept_errors off;<br>scgi_intercept_errors 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether an SCGI server responses with codes greater than or equal to 300 should be passed to a client or be intercepted and redirected to nginx for processing with the [error\_page](#p-056) directive.

確定是否應將程式碼大於或等於 300 的SCGI伺服器回應傳遞給客戶端，或攔截並重定向到 nginx 以使用 [error\_page](#p-056)指令進行處理。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_limit_rate</strong> <code><i>rate</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_limit_rate 0;<br>scgi_limit_rate 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.7.

該指令出現在版本1.7.7 。

Limits the speed of reading the response from the SCGI server. The `*rate*` is specified in bytes per second. The zero value disables rate limiting. The limit is set per a request, and so if nginx simultaneously opens two connections to the SCGI server, the overall rate will be twice as much as the specified limit. The limitation works only if [buffering](#p-091) of responses from the SCGI server is enabled. Parameter value can contain variables (1.27.0).

限制從SCGI伺服器讀取回應的速度。 `*rate*` 以每秒位元組數指定。零值禁用速率限制。此限制是針對每個請求設定的，因此如果 nginx 同時開啟兩個到 SCGI 伺服器的連接，則總體速率將是指定限制的兩倍。僅當啟用來自 SCGI 伺服器的回應的[緩衝](#p-091) 時，此限制才有效。參數值可以包含變數(1.27.0)。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_max_temp_file_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_max_temp_file_size 1024m;<br>scgi_max_temp_file_size 1024m；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

When [buffering](#p-091) of responses from the SCGI server is enabled, and the whole response does not fit into the buffers set by the [scgi\_buffer\_size](#p-091) and [scgi\_buffers](#p-091) directives, a part of the response can be saved to a temporary file. This directive sets the maximum `*size*` of the temporary file. The size of data written to the temporary file at a time is set by the [scgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-091) directive.

當SCGI伺服器回應的[緩衝](#p-091)功能時，如果整個回應無法放入[scgi\_buffer\_size](#p-091)和[scgi\_buffers](#p-091)指令設定的緩衝區中，則可以將部分回應儲存到臨時檔案中。此指令設定臨時檔案的最大容量`*size*` 。每次寫入暫存檔案的資料大小由[scgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-091)指令設定。

The zero value disables buffering of responses to temporary files.

零值表示停用對暫存檔案的回應緩衝。

> This restriction does not apply to responses that will be [cached](#p-091) or [stored](#p-091) on disk.
>
> 此限制不適用於將被[快取](#p-091)或[儲存](#p-091)在磁碟上的回應。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_next_upstream</strong> <code>error<br>錯誤</code> | <code>timeout<br>暫停</code> | <code>denied<br>否認</code> | <code>invalid_header<br>無效標頭</code> | <code>http_500</code> | <code>http_503</code> | <code>http_403</code> | <code>http_404</code> | <code>http_429</code> | <code>non_idempotent<br>不一樣</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_next_upstream error timeout;<br>scgi_next_upstream 錯誤逾時；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies in which cases a request should be passed to the next server:

指定在哪些情況下應將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器：

`error`

an error occurred while establishing a connection with the server, passing a request to it, or reading the response header;

與伺服器建立連線、向伺服器發送請求或讀取回應標頭時發生錯誤；

`timeout`

a timeout has occurred while establishing a connection with the server, passing a request to it, or reading the response header;

與伺服器建立連線、向伺服器發送請求或讀取回應標頭時發生逾時；

`denied`

the server [denied](#p-091) the connection (1.29.3);

伺服器[拒絕](#p-091)連線 ( 1.29.3 );

> This parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此參數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`invalid_header`

a server returned an empty or invalid response;

伺服器傳回了空響應或無效回應；

`http_500`

a server returned a response with the code 500;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 500 的回應；

`http_503`

a server returned a response with the code 503;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 503 的回應；

`http_403`

a server returned a response with the code 403;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 403 的回應；

`http_404`

a server returned a response with the code 404;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 404 的回應；

`http_429`

a server returned a response with the code 429 (1.11.13);

伺服器回傳了代碼為 429 的回應（ 1.11.13 ）；

`non_idempotent`

normally, requests with a [non-idempotent](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2) method (`POST`, `LOCK`, `PATCH`) are not passed to the next server if a request has been sent to an upstream server (1.9.13); enabling this option explicitly allows retrying such requests;

通常情況下，如果已向上游伺服器 ( 1.9.13 ) 發送請求，則具有 [非冪等](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2)方法 ( `POST`, `LOCK`, `PATCH` ) 的請求不會傳遞給下一個伺服器；明確啟用此選項允許重試此類請求；

`off`

disables passing a request to the next server.

禁用向下一個伺服器傳遞請求。

One should bear in mind that passing a request to the next server is only possible if nothing has been sent to a client yet. That is, if an error or timeout occurs in the middle of the transferring of a response, fixing this is impossible.

需要注意的是，只有在尚未向客戶端發送任何資料的情況下，才能將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器。也就是說，如果在傳輸回應的過程中發生錯誤或逾時，則無法修復。

The directive also defines what is considered an [unsuccessful attempt](#p-105) of communication with a server. The cases of `error`, `timeout`, `denied` and `invalid_header` are always considered unsuccessful attempts, even if they are not specified in the directive. The cases of `http_500`, `http_503`, and `http_429` are considered unsuccessful attempts only if they are specified in the directive. The cases of `http_403` and `http_404` are never considered unsuccessful attempts.

該指令也定義了與伺服器通訊的[不成功嘗試](#p-105)。 `error`, `timeout`, `denied` 和 `invalid_header` 的情況始終被視為不成功的嘗試，即使它們未在指令中指定。僅當指令中指定時，`http_500`, `http_503`和`http_429`的情況才被視為不成功的嘗試。 `http_403`和`http_404`的案例絕不被認為是不成功的嘗試。

Passing a request to the next server can be limited by [the number of tries](#p-091) and by [time](#p-091).

向下一個伺服器傳遞請求可以受到 [嘗試次數](#p-091)和 [時間](#p-091)的限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_next_upstream_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_next_upstream_timeout 0;<br>scgi_next_upstream_timeout 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.5.

該指令出現在版本1.7.5 。

Limits the time during which a request can be passed to the [next server](#p-091). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制請求傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-091)的時間。 `0` 值關閉此限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_next_upstream_tries</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_next_upstream_tries 0;<br>scgi_next_upstream_tries 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.5.

該指令出現在版本1.7.5 。

Limits the number of possible tries for passing a request to the [next server](#p-091). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制將請求傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-091)的可能嘗試次數。 `0` 值關閉此限制。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**scgi_no_cache** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**scgi_no_cache** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines conditions under which the response will not be saved to a cache. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the response will not be saved:

定義回應不保存到快取的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則回應將不會被儲存：

> ```
> scgi_no_cache $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment;
>
> scgi_no_cache $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment；
> scgi_no_cache $http_pragma    $http_authorization;
>
> scgi_no_cache $http_pragma $http_authorization;
> ```

Can be used along with the [scgi\_cache\_bypass](#p-091) directive.

可與 [scgi\_cache\_bypass](#p-091)指令一起使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>scgi_param</strong> <code><i>parameter</i></code> <code><i>value</i></code> [<code>if_not_empty</code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> </code></td></tr> </strong> <code><i>參數</i></code> <code><i>值</i></code> [ <code> </code>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_param HTTP_HOST $host$is_request_port$request_port;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a `*parameter*` that should be passed to the SCGI server. The `*value*` can contain text, variables, and their combination. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `scgi_param` directives defined on the current level.

設定要傳遞給SCGI伺服器的`*parameter*`可以包含文字、變數及其組合。僅噹噹前設定等級未定義`scgi_param`指令時`*value*`這些指令才會從上一個設定等級繼承。

Standard [CGI environment variables](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3875#section-4.1) should be provided as SCGI headers, see the `scgi_params` file provided in the distribution:

標準 [CGI環境變數](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3875#section-4.1)應作為SCGI頭檔提供，請參閱發行版中提供的`scgi_params`檔：

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     include scgi_params;
>
>     包含 scgi_params；
>     ...
> }
> ```

If the directive is specified with `if_not_empty` (1.1.11) then such a parameter will be passed to the server only if its value is not empty:

如果指令使用`if_not_empty` ( 1.1.11 ) 指定，則只有當該參數的值不為空時，才會將其傳遞給伺服器：

> ```
> scgi_param HTTPS $https if_not_empty;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**scgi_pass** `*address*`;``<br>` `**scgi_pass** ` *地址* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location`, `if in location` |

Sets the address of an SCGI server. The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, and a port:

設定SCGI伺服器的位址。位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，以及連接埠：

> ```
> scgi_pass localhost:9000;
> ```

or as a UNIX-domain socket path:

或作為UNIX域套接字路徑：

> ```
> scgi_pass unix:/tmp/scgi.socket;
> ```

If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be used in a round-robin fashion. In addition, an address can be specified as a [server group](#p-105).

如果一個網域解析到多個位址，則所有這些位址將以輪詢方式使用。此外，可以將位址指定為 [伺服器群組](#p-105) 。

Parameter value can contain variables. In this case, if an address is specified as a domain name, the name is searched among the described [server groups](#p-105), and, if not found, is determined using a [resolver](#p-056).

參數值可以包含變數。在這種情況下，如果將位址指定為域名，則會在所描述的 [伺服器群組](#p-105)中搜尋該名稱，如果找不到，則使用 [解析器](#p-056)進行確定。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**scgi_pass_header** `*field*`;``<br>` `**scgi_pass_header** ` *字段* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Permits passing [otherwise disabled](#p-091) header fields from an SCGI server to a client.

允許將 [其他情況下禁用的](#p-091)標頭欄位從SCGI伺服器傳遞到客戶端。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_pass_request_body</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_pass_request_body on;<br>scgi_pass_request_body 開啟；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether the original request body is passed to the SCGI server. See also the [scgi\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-091) directive.

指示是否將原始請求體傳遞給SCGI伺服器。另請參閱 [scgi\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-091)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_pass_request_headers</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_pass_request_headers on;<br>啟用 scgi_pass_request_headers;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether the header fields of the original request are passed to the SCGI server. See also the [scgi\_pass\_request\_body](#p-091) directive.

指示是否將原始請求的標頭欄位傳遞給SCGI伺服器。另請參閱 [scgi\_pass\_request\_body](#p-091)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_read_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_read_timeout 60s;<br>scgi_read_timeout 60秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for reading a response from the SCGI server. The timeout is set only between two successive read operations, not for the transmission of the whole response. If the SCGI server does not transmit anything within this time, the connection is closed.

定義從SCGI伺服器讀取回應的逾時時間。此超時時間僅在兩次連續讀取操作之間設置，而非針對整個回應的傳輸。如果SCGI伺服器在此時間內未傳送任何內容，則連線將會關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_request_buffering</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_request_buffering on;<br>scgi_request_buffering on；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Enables or disables buffering of a client request body.

啟用或停用客戶端請求體的緩衝。

When buffering is enabled, the entire request body is [read](#p-056) from the client before sending the request to an SCGI server.

啟用緩衝後，在將請求傳送到SCGI之前，會從客戶端(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#client_body_buffer_size)整個請求體。

When buffering is disabled, the request body is sent to the SCGI server immediately as it is received. In this case, the request cannot be passed to the [next server](#p-091) if nginx already started sending the request body.

停用緩衝後，請求體會在接收後立即傳送到SCGI伺服器。在這種情況下，如果 nginx 已經開始傳送請求體，則無法將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_scgi_module.html#scgi_next_upstream) 。

When HTTP/1.1 chunked transfer encoding is used to send the original request body, the request body will be buffered regardless of the directive value.

當使用HTTP/1.1分塊傳送編碼傳送原始請求體時，無論指令值為何，請求體都會被緩衝。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_request_dynamic</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_request_dynamic off;<br>scgi_request_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

Enables or disables creation of a separate request instance for each SCGI server. By default, a single request is used for all SCGI servers. If enabled, a separate request instance is created, allowing per-server request customization.

啟用或停用為每個SCGI伺服器建立單獨的請求實例。預設情況下，所有SCGI伺服器使用單一請求。啟用後，將為每個伺服器建立一個單獨的請求實例，從而允許對每個伺服器的請求進行自訂。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_send_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_send_timeout 60s;<br>scgi_send_timeout 60秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a timeout for transmitting a request to the SCGI server. The timeout is set only between two successive write operations, not for the transmission of the whole request. If the SCGI server does not receive anything within this time, the connection is closed.

設定向SCGI伺服器發送請求的逾時時間。超時時間僅在兩次連續寫入操作之間設置，而非整個請求的傳輸逾時時間。如果SCGI伺服器在此時間內未收到任何數據，則連線將會關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>scgi_socket_keepalive</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>scgi_socket_keepalive off;<br>scgi_socket_keepalive 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.6.

該指令出現在版本1.15.6 。

Configures the “TCP keepalive” behavior for outgoing connections to an SCGI server. By default, the operating system’s settings are in effect for the socket. If the directive is set to the value “`on`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` socket option is turned on for the socket.

配置與伺服器建立的出SCGI連線的「 TCP keepalive」行為。預設情況下，作業系統的設定對套接字生效。如果指令值設定為“ `on` ”，則會為套接字啟用`SO_KEEPALIVE`套接字選項。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**scgi_socket_rcvbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**scgi_socket_rcvbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the receive buffer size (the `SO_RCVBUF` option) for outgoing connections to an SCGI server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `scgi_socket_rcvbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定與伺服器建立出SCGI連線的接收緩衝區大小（ `SO_RCVBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`scgi_socket_rcvbuf`指令的效果，從而允許保持作業系統對套接字的設定有效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**scgi_socket_sndbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**scgi_socket_sndbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。
