|

The `ngx_http_ssl_module` module provides the necessary support for HTTPS.

`ngx_http_ssl_module`模組為HTTPS提供必要的支援。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_ssl_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_ssl_module`配置參數啟用。

> This module requires the [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/) library.
>
> 本模組需要 [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/)函式庫。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

To reduce the processor load, it is recommended to

為了降低處理器負載，建議…

-   set the number of [worker processes](#p-125) equal to the number of processors,  
    將[工作進程](#p-125)的數量設定為等於處理器數量，
-   enable [keep-alive](#p-056) connections,  
    啟用 [保持連接](#p-056)連接，
-   enable the [shared](#p-098) session cache,  
    啟用[共享](#p-098)會話緩存，
-   disable the [built-in](#p-098) session cache,  
    停用[內建](#p-098)會話緩存，
-   and possibly increase the session [lifetime](#p-098) (by default, 5 minutes):  
    並可能增加會話[生命週期](#p-098) （預設值為 5 分鐘）：

> ```
> worker_processes auto;
>
> worker_processes 自動；
> 
> http {
> 
>     ...
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen              443 ssl;
>
>         監聽 443 ssl；
>         keepalive_timeout   70;
>
>         keepalive_timeout 70;
> 
>         ssl_protocols       TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>
>         ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>         ssl_ciphers         AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:RC4-SHA:DES-CBC3-SHA:RC4-MD5;
>
>         ssl_ciphers AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:RC4-SHA:DES-CBC3-SHA:RC4-MD5 ;
>         ssl_certificate     /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.pem;
>
>         ssl_certificate /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.pem;
>         ssl_certificate_key /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.key;
>         ssl_session_cache   shared:SSL:10m;
>
>         ssl_session_cache 共享: SSL :10m;
>         ssl_session_timeout 10m;
> 
>         ...
>     }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl off;<br>SSL 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive was made obsolete in version 1.15.0 and was removed in version 1.25.1. The `ssl` parameter of the [listen](#p-056) directive should be used instead.

該指令在版本1.15.0中已過時，並在版本1.25.1中被移除。應改用[listen](#p-056)指令的`ssl`參數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_buffer_size 16k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.9.

該指令出現在版本1.5.9 。

Sets the size of the buffer used for sending data.

設定用於傳送資料的緩衝區大小。

By default, the buffer size is 16k, which corresponds to minimal overhead when sending big responses. To minimize Time To First Byte it may be beneficial to use smaller values, for example:

預設情況下，緩衝區大小為 16k，這在發送大型回應時可以最大限度地減少開銷。為了最大限度地縮短首字節到達時間 (Time To First Byte)，使用較小的值可能更有利，例如：

> ```
> ssl_buffer_size 4k;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with the certificate in the PEM format for the given virtual server. If intermediate certificates should be specified in addition to a primary certificate, they should be specified in the same file in the following order: the primary certificate comes first, then the intermediate certificates. A secret key in the PEM format may be placed in the same file.

為給定虛擬伺服器指定具有 PEM 格式憑證的 `*file*`。如果除了主證書之外還應指定中間證書，則應按以下順序在同一文件中指定它們：首先是主證書，然後是中間證書。 PEM格式的金鑰可以放置在同一文件中。

Since version 1.11.0, this directive can be specified multiple times to load certificates of different types, for example, RSA and ECDSA:

自版本1.11.0起，可以多次指定此指令以載入不同類型的證書，例如RSA和ECDSA ：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen              443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name         example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.com；
> 
>     ssl_certificate     example.com.rsa.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate example.com.rsa.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key example.com.rsa.key;
> 
>     ssl_certificate     example.com.ecdsa.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate example.com.ecdsa.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key example.com.ecdsa.key;
> 
>     ...
> }
> ```

> Only OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher supports separate [certificate chains](#p-042) for different certificates. With older versions, only one certificate chain can be used.
>
> 只有 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本才支援為不同的憑證使用獨立的憑證鏈(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html#chains) 。舊版只能使用一條憑證鏈。

Since version 1.15.9, variables can be used in the `*file*` name when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher:

自版本1.15.9起，在使用1.0.2或更高版本時，可以在`*file*`名稱中使用變數：

> ```
> ssl_certificate     $ssl_server_name.crt;
>
> ssl_certificate $ssl_server_name.crt;
> ssl_certificate_key $ssl_server_name.key;
> ```

Note that using variables implies that a certificate will be loaded for each SSL handshake, and this may have a negative impact on performance.

請注意，使用變數意味著每次SSL握手都會載入一個證書，這可能會對效能產生負面影響。

The value `data`:`*$variable*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.15.10), which loads a certificate from a variable without using intermediate files. Note that inappropriate use of this syntax may have its security implications, such as writing secret key data to [error log](#p-125).

可以使用值`data`:`*$variable*`代替`*file*` ( 1.15.10 )，這樣就可以從變數載入憑證而無需使用中間檔案。請注意，不當使用此語法可能會帶來安全隱患，例如將金鑰資料寫入 [錯誤日誌](#p-125) 。

It should be kept in mind that due to the SSL/TLS protocol limitations, for maximum interoperability with clients that do not use [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication), virtual servers with different certificates should listen on [different IP addresses](#p-042).

需要注意的是，由於SSL/TLS協定的限制，為了與不使用 [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication)的客戶端實現最大程度的互通性，具有不同憑證的虛擬伺服器應該監聽 [不同的IP (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html#name_based_https_servers) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>off</code>;</code><br><code><strong>ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>max</code>=<code><i>N</i></code> [<code>inactive</code>=<code><i>time</i></code>] [<code>valid</code>=<code><i>time</i></code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> ssl_certificate_cache </strong> <code>關閉</code>;</code><br><code><strong> ssl_certificate_cache </strong> <code> <code><i> </code> </i></code> [ <code>無效</code> = <code><i>時間</i></code> ] [ <code>有效</code> </i></code> <code><i> </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_certificate_cache off;<br>關閉 SSL 憑證快取；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.4.

該指令出現在版本1.27.4 。

Defines a cache that stores [SSL certificates](#p-098) and [secret keys](#p-098) specified with [variables](#p-098).

定義一個緩存，用於儲存 [SSL憑證](#p-098)和 [金鑰](#p-098)金鑰由 [變數](#p-098)指定。

The directive has the following parameters:

此指令具有以下參數：

`max`

sets the maximum number of elements in the cache; on cache overflow the least recently used (LRU) elements are removed;

設定快取中元素的最大數量；當快取溢出時，刪除最近最少使用的（ LRU ）元素；

`inactive`

defines a time after which an element is removed from the cache if it has not been accessed during this time; by default, it is 10 seconds;

定義一個時間段，如果該元素在這段時間內未被訪問，則將其從快取中刪除；預設值為 10 秒；

`valid`

defines a time during which an element in the cache is considered valid and can be reused; by default, it is 60 seconds. Certificates that exceed this time will be reloaded or revalidated;

定義快取中元素被視為有效且可重複使用的時間；預設值為 60 秒。超過此時間的證書將被重新載入或重新驗證；

`off`

disables the cache.

禁用緩存。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> ssl_certificate       $ssl_server_name.crt;
>
> ssl_certificate $ssl_server_name.crt;
> ssl_certificate_key   $ssl_server_name.key;
>
> ssl_certificate_key $ssl_server_name.key;
> ssl_certificate_cache max=1000 inactive=20s valid=1m;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_certificate_compression</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_certificate_compression off;<br>關閉 SSL 憑證壓縮；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.1.

該指令出現在版本1.29.1 。

Enables TLS 1.3 [compression](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8879) of server certificates.

啟用伺服器憑證的TLS 1.3 [壓縮](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8879) 。

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 3.2 or higher; the list of supported compression algorithms is provided by the library.
>
> 當使用 OpenSSL 3.2或更高版本時，支援該指令；支援的壓縮演算法清單由函式庫提供。

> The directive is supported when using BoringSSL; the list of supported compression algorithms includes `zlib` (1.29.3).
>
> 使用 BoringSSL 時支援該指令；支援的壓縮演算法清單包括`zlib` ( 1.29.3 )。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_certificate_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_certificate_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with the secret key in the PEM format for the given virtual server.

為給定的虛擬伺服器指定一個`*file*` ，其中包含PEM格式的金鑰。

The value `engine`:`*name*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.7.9), which loads a secret key with a specified `*id*` from the OpenSSL engine `*name*`.

可以指定值`engine`:`*name*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.7.9 )，該值會從 OpenSSL 引擎`*name*`載入具有指定`*id*`的金鑰。

The value `store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.29.0), which is used to load a secret key with a specified `*id*` and OpenSSL provider registered URI `*scheme*`, such as [`pkcs11`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512).

可指定值`store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.29.0 )，用於載入具有指定`*id*`和已註冊的 OpenSSL 提供者URI `*scheme*`的金鑰，例如 [`pkcs11`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512)

The value `data`:`*$variable*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.15.10), which loads a secret key from a variable without using intermediate files. Note that inappropriate use of this syntax may have its security implications, such as writing secret key data to [error log](#p-125).

可以使用值`data`:`*$variable*`代替`*file*` ( 1.15.10 )，這樣就可以從變數中載入金鑰，而無需使用中間檔案。請注意，不當使用此語法可能會帶來安全隱患，例如將金鑰資料寫入 [錯誤日誌](#p-125) 。

Since version 1.15.9, variables can be used in the `*file*` name when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher.

自版本1.15.9起，在使用1.0.2或更高版本時，可以在`*file*`名稱中使用變數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ciphers</strong> <code><i>ciphers</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies the enabled ciphers. The ciphers are specified in the format understood by the OpenSSL library, for example:

指定啟用的密碼套件。密碼套件以 OpenSSL 庫可識別的格式指定，例如：

> ```
> ssl_ciphers ALL:!aNULL:!EXPORT56:RC4+RSA:+HIGH:+MEDIUM:+LOW:+SSLv2:+EXP;
>
> ssl_ciphers ALL :!aNULL:! EXPORT56:RC4+RSA:+HIGH:+MEDIUM:+LOW :+SSLv2:+ EXP ;
> ```

The full list can be viewed using the “`openssl ciphers`” command.

可以使用「 `openssl ciphers` 」指令查看完整清單。

> The previous versions of nginx used [different](#p-042) ciphers by default.
>
> 先前的 nginx 版本預設使用 [不同的](#p-042)密碼。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_client_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_client_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-098) client certificates and OCSP responses if [ssl\_stapling](#p-098) is enabled.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-098)客戶端證書和OCSP響應（如果啟用 [ssl\_stapling](#p-098) 。

The list of certificates will be sent to clients. If this is not desired, the [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-098) directive can be used.

證書清單將發送給客戶端。如果不需要此操作，可以使用 [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-098)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**ssl_conf_command** `*name*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**ssl_conf_command** ` *名稱* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.19.4.

該指令出現在版本1.19.4 。

Sets arbitrary OpenSSL configuration [commands](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html).

設定任意 OpenSSL 設定 [指令](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) .

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，支援該指令。

Several `ssl_conf_command` directives can be specified on the same level:

可以在同一層級指定多個`ssl_conf_command`指令：

> ```
> ssl_conf_command Options PrioritizeChaCha;
>
> ssl_conf_command 選項 PrioritizeChaCha;
> ssl_conf_command Ciphersuites TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256;
>
> ssl_conf_command 密碼套件 TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256;
> ```

These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `ssl_conf_command` directives defined on the current level.

如果目前等級沒有定義`ssl_conf_command`指令，則這些指令將從上一個設定等級繼承。

> Note that configuring OpenSSL directly might result in unexpected behavior.
>
> 請注意，直接配置 OpenSSL 可能會導致意外行為。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_crl** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_crl** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 0.8.7.

該指令出現在版本0.8.7 。

Specifies a `*file*` with revoked certificates (CRL) in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-098) client certificates. When using intermediate certificates, their CRLs should be specified in the same file.

指定一個包含已吊銷憑證（ CRL ）的`*file*`其格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-098)客戶端憑證。使用中間憑證時，應在同一文件中指定其憑證撤銷清單 (CRL)。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_dhparam** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_dhparam** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 0.7.2.

該指令出現在版本0.7.2 。

Specifies a `*file*` with DH parameters for DHE ciphers.

為DHE密碼指定`*file*`和DH參數。

By default no parameters are set, and therefore DHE ciphers will not be used.

預設不設定任何參數，因此不會使用DHE密碼。

> Prior to version 1.11.0, builtin parameters were used by default.
>
> 在版本1.11.0之前，預設使用內建參數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_early_data</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_early_data off;<br>關閉 ssl_early_data;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.3.

該指令出現在版本1.15.3 。

Enables or disables TLS 1.3 [early data](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8446#section-2.3).

啟用或停用TLS 1.3 [早期資料](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8446#section-2.3) 。

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 1.1.1 or higher (1.15.4) and [BoringSSL](https://boringssl.googlesource.com/boringssl/).
>
> 當使用 OpenSSL 1.1.1或更高版本 ( 1.15.4 ) 和 [BoringSSL](https://boringssl.googlesource.com/boringssl/)時，支援此指令。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-056) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-056)層級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

> Requests sent within early data are subject to [replay attacks](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8470). To protect against such attacks at the application layer, the [$ssl\_early\_data](#p-098) variable should be used.
>
> 早期資料中發送的請求容易受到 [重播攻擊](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8470) 。為了在應用層防止此類攻擊，應使用 [$ssl\_early\_data](#p-098)變數。

> ```
> proxy_set_header Early-Data $ssl_early_data;
> ```

> OpenSSL built-in replay protection is disabled, because it interferes with session resumption. It can be turned back if deemed necessary.
>
> OpenSSL 內建的重播保護功能已停用，因為它會幹擾會話復原。如有必要，可以重新啟用該功能。

> ```
> ssl_conf_command Options AntiReplay;
>
> ssl_conf_command 選項 AntiReplay;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ecdh_curve</strong> <code><i>curve</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ecdh_curve auto;<br>ssl_ecdh_curve 自動；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in versions 1.1.0 and 1.0.6.

該指令出現在版本1.1.0和1.0.6中。

Specifies a `*curve*` for ECDHE ciphers.

為ECDHE密碼指定`*curve*` 。

When using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher, it is possible to specify multiple curves (1.11.0), for example:

使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，可以指定多個曲線 ( 1.11.0 )，例如：

> ```
> ssl_ecdh_curve prime256v1:secp384r1;
> ```

The special value `auto` (1.11.0) instructs nginx to use a list built into the OpenSSL library when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher, or `prime256v1` with older versions.

特殊值`auto` ( 1.11.0 ) 指示 nginx 在使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時使用 OpenSSL 庫中內建的列表，或在使用舊版本時使用`prime256v1` 。

> Prior to version 1.11.0, the `prime256v1` curve was used by default.
>
> 在1.11.0版本之前，預設使用`prime256v1`曲線。

> When using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher, this directive sets the list of curves supported by the server. Thus, in order for ECDSA certificates to work, it is important to include the curves used in the certificates.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，此指令設定伺服器支援的曲線清單。因此，為了使ECDSA憑證正常運作，必須包含憑證中使用的曲線。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_ech_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_ech_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.29.4.

該指令出現在版本1.29.4 。

Specifies a `*file*` with encrypted ClientHello configuration (`ECHConfig`) in the [PEM](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9934) format used to enable TLS 1.3 [ECH](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9849) in shared mode.

指定一個`*file*`其具有加密的 ClientHello 配置 ( `ECHConfig` )，格式為 [PEM](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9934)用於在共享模式下啟用TLS 1.3 ， ECH在共享模式下啟用(https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9849)

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 4.0 or higher.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 4.0或更高版本時，支援該指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**ssl_key_log** path;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Enables logging of client connection SSL keys and specifies the path to the key log file. Keys are logged in the [SSLKEYLOGFILE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850) format compatible with Wireshark.

啟用客戶端連線SSL金鑰的日誌記錄，並指定金鑰日誌檔案的路徑。密鑰以與Wireshark相容的[SSLKEYLOGFILE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850)格式記錄。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ocsp</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code>leaf<br>葉子</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ocsp off;<br>ssl_ocsp 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.19.0.

該指令出現在版本1.19.0。

Enables OCSP validation of the client certificate chain. The `leaf` parameter enables validation of the client certificate only.

啟用客戶端憑證鏈的OCSP驗證。 `leaf` 參數僅啟用客戶端憑證的驗證。

For the OCSP validation to work, the [ssl\_verify\_client](#p-098) directive should be set to `on` or `optional`.

要使OCSP驗證生效，[ssl\_verify\_client](#p-098)指令應設定為`on`或`optional` 。

To resolve the OCSP responder hostname, the [resolver](#p-056) directive should also be specified.

若要解析OCSP響應程式主機名，還應指定 [resolver](#p-056)指令。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> ssl_verify_client on;
>
> ssl_verify_client 已啟用；
> ssl_ocsp          on;
>
> ssl_ocsp 已開啟；
> resolver          192.0.2.1;
>
> 解決192.0.2.1 ；
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ocsp_cache</strong> <code>off</code> | [<code>shared</code>:<code><i>name</i></code>:<code><i>size</i></code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> ssl_ocsp_cache </strong> <code>關閉</code> | [ <code>共享</code>:<code><i> </i></code> </i></code>:<code><i> </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ocsp_cache off;<br>關閉 ssl_ocsp_cache；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.19.0.

該指令出現在版本1.19.0 。

Sets `name` and `size` of the cache that stores client certificates status for OCSP validation. The cache is shared between all worker processes. A cache with the same name can be used in several virtual servers.

設定用於儲存客戶端憑證狀態以進行驗證OCSP快取的`name`和`size` 。該快取由所有工作進程共享。同名快取可在多個虛擬伺服器中使用。

The `off` parameter prohibits the use of the cache.

`off`參數禁止使用快取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_ocsp_responder** `*url*`;``<br>` `**ssl_ocsp_responder** ` *url* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.19.0.

該指令出現在版本1.19.0 。

Overrides the URL of the OCSP responder specified in the “[Authority Information Access](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.2.1)” certificate extension for [validation](#p-098) of client certificates.

覆寫「[權威資訊存取]OCSP 」憑證擴充中指定的URL回應程序(https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.2.1)用於客戶端憑證的 [驗證](#p-098) 。

Only “`http://`” OCSP responders are supported:

僅支援“ `http://` ” OCSP應答器：

> ```
> ssl_ocsp_responder http://ocsp.example.com/;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_password_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_password_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.3.

該指令出現在版本1.7.3 。

Specifies a `*file*` with passphrases for [secret keys](#p-098) where each passphrase is specified on a separate line. Passphrases are tried in turn when loading the key.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含 [金鑰](#p-098)的密碼短語，每個密碼短語單獨一行指定。載入金鑰時，將依序嘗試這些密碼短語。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> http {
>     ssl_password_file /etc/keys/global.pass;
>     ...
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         server_name www1.example.com;
>
>         伺服器名稱 www1.example.com；
>         ssl_certificate_key /etc/keys/first.key;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         server_name www2.example.com;
>
>         伺服器名稱 www2.example.com；
> 
>         # named pipe can also be used instead of a file｜命名管道也可以代替文件使用。
>         ssl_password_file /etc/keys/fifo;
>         ssl_certificate_key /etc/keys/second.key;
>     }
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_prefer_server_ciphers</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;<br>關閉 ssl_prefer_server_ciphers;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies that server ciphers should be preferred over client ciphers when the SSLv3 and TLS protocols are used.

規定在使用 SSLv3 和TLS協定時，應優先使用伺服器密碼而非客戶端密碼。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>ssl_protocols</strong> [<code>SSLv2</code>] [<code>SSLv3</code>] [<code>TLSv1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.2</code>] [<code>TLSv1.3</code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> ssl_protocols </strong> [ <code> SSLv2 </code> <code> [ </code> <code> ⧟ </code> ] [ <code> TLSv1.1 </code> ] [ <code> TLSv1.2 </code> ]<code> </code></td></tr> </code> ⧟
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;<br>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables the specified protocols.

啟用指定的協定。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-056) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-056)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

> The `TLSv1.1` and `TLSv1.2` parameters (1.1.13, 1.0.12) work only when OpenSSL 1.0.1 or higher is used.
>
> `TLSv1.1`和`TLSv1.2`參數 ( 1.1.13, 1.0.12 ) 僅在使用 OpenSSL 1.0.1或更高版本時有效。

> The `TLSv1.3` parameter (1.13.0) works only when OpenSSL 1.1.1 or higher is used.
>
> `TLSv1.3`參數 ( 1.13.0 ) 僅在使用 OpenSSL 1.1.1或更高版本時有效。

> The `TLSv1.3` parameter is used by default since 1.23.4.
>
> `TLSv1.3`參數預設使用1.23.4參數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_reject_handshake</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_reject_handshake off;<br>關閉 ssl_reject_handshake;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.19.4.

該指令出現在版本1.19.4 。

If enabled, SSL handshakes in the [server](#p-056) block will be rejected.

如果啟用，則 [伺服器](#p-056)區塊中的SSL握手將被拒絕。

For example, in the following configuration, SSL handshakes with server names other than `example.com` are rejected:

例如，在以下配置中，伺服器名稱不是`example.com`的SSL握手將被拒絕：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen               443 ssl default_server;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl 預設伺服器；
>     ssl_reject_handshake on;
>
>     ssl_reject_handshake 開啟；
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen              443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name         example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.com；
>     ssl_certificate     example.com.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate example.com.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key example.com.key;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_session_cache</strong> <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code>none<br>沒有任何</code> | [<code>builtin<br>內建</code>[:<code><i>size<br>尺寸</i></code>]] [<code>shared<br>共享</code>:<code><i>name<br>姓名</i></code>:<code><i>size<br>尺寸</i></code>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_session_cache none;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the types and sizes of caches that store session parameters. A cache can be of any of the following types:

設定用於儲存會話參數的快取類型和大小。快取可以是以下任何一種類型：

`off`

the use of a session cache is strictly prohibited: nginx explicitly tells a client that sessions may not be reused.

嚴禁使用會話快取：nginx 明確告知客戶端會話不得重複使用。

`none`

the use of a session cache is gently disallowed: nginx tells a client that sessions may be reused, but does not actually store session parameters in the cache.

nginx 會委婉地禁止使用會話快取：nginx 會告訴客戶端會話可以重複使用，但實際上不會將會話參數儲存在快取中。

`builtin`

a cache built in OpenSSL; used by one worker process only. The cache size is specified in sessions. If size is not given, it is equal to 20480 sessions. Use of the built-in cache can cause memory fragmentation.

OpenSSL 內建快取；僅供單一工作進程使用。快取大小以會話數 (session) 為單位指定。如果未指定大小，則預設為 20480 個會話。使用內建快取可能會導致記憶體碎片。

`shared`

a cache shared between all worker processes. The cache size is specified in bytes; one megabyte can store about 4000 sessions. Each shared cache should have an arbitrary name. A cache with the same name can be used in several virtual servers. It is also used to automatically generate, store, and periodically rotate TLS session ticket keys (1.23.2) unless configured explicitly using the [ssl\_session\_ticket\_key](#p-098) directive.

所有工作進程共享的快取。快取大小以位元組為單位；1 MB 大約可以儲存 4000 個會話。每個共享快取都應該有一個任意名稱。同名快取可以在多個虛擬伺服器中使用。它也用於自動產生、儲存和定期輪換會話票據金鑰（ TLS ）（ 1.23.2 ），除非使用 [ssl_session_ticket_key](#p-098)指令明確配置。

Both cache types can be used simultaneously, for example:

兩種快取類型可以同時使用，例如：

> ```
> ssl_session_cache builtin:1000 shared:SSL:10m;
>
> ssl_session_cache builtin:1000 shared: SSL :10m;
> ```

but using only shared cache without the built-in cache should be more efficient.

但是，如果只使用共享快取而不使用內建緩存，效率應該會更高。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-056) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-056)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_session_ticket_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_session_ticket_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Sets a `*file*` with the secret key used to encrypt and decrypt TLS session tickets. The directive is necessary if the same key has to be shared between multiple servers. By default, a randomly generated key is used.

設定用於加密和解密會話票據的金鑰TLS `*file*` 。如果需要在多個伺服器之間共用相同金鑰，則必須使用此指令。預設情況下，使用隨機產生的密鑰。

If several keys are specified, only the first key is used to encrypt TLS session tickets. This allows configuring key rotation, for example:

如果指定了多個金鑰，則僅使用第一個金鑰來加密TLS會話票證。這樣可以配置金鑰輪換，例如：

> ```
> ssl_session_ticket_key current.key;
> ssl_session_ticket_key previous.key;
> ```

The `*file*` must contain 80 or 48 bytes of random data and can be created using the following command:

`*file*`必須包含 80 或 48 位元組的隨機數據，可以使用以下命令創建：

> ```
> openssl rand 80 > ticket.key
> ```

Depending on the file size either AES256 (for 80-byte keys, 1.11.8) or AES128 (for 48-byte keys) is used for encryption.

根據檔案大小，使用AES256 （80 位元組金鑰， 1.11.8 ）或AES128 （48 位元組金鑰）進行加密。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-056) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-056)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_session_tickets</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_session_tickets on;<br>啟用 ssl_session_tickets；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.9.

該指令出現在版本1.5.9 。

Enables or disables session resumption through [TLS session tickets](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5077).

透過 [TLS會話票證](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5077)啟用或停用會話恢復。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-056) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-056)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_session_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_session_timeout 5m;<br>ssl_session_timeout 5分鐘；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies a time during which a client may reuse the session parameters.

指定客戶端可以重複使用會話參數的時間段。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-056) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-056)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_stapling</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_stapling off;<br>關閉 SSL 裝訂；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.3.7.

該指令出現在版本1.3.7 。

Enables or disables [stapling of OCSP responses](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6066#section-8) by the server. Example:

啟用或停用伺服器對OCSP回應的裝訂(https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6066#section-8) 。範例：

> ```
> ssl_stapling on;
>
> 啟用 SSL 裝訂；
> resolver 192.0.2.1;
>
> 解決192.0.2.1 ；
> ```

For the OCSP stapling to work, the certificate of the server certificate issuer should be known. If the [ssl\_certificate](#p-098) file does not contain intermediate certificates, the certificate of the server certificate issuer should be present in the [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-098) file.

要使OCSP裝訂正常運作，必須知道伺服器憑證授權者的憑證。如果 [ssl\_certificate](#p-098)檔案不包含中間證書，則伺服器證書頒發者的證書應存在於 [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-098)檔案中。

For a resolution of the OCSP responder hostname, the [resolver](#p-056) directive should also be specified.

若要解析OCSP響應程式主機名，還應指定 [resolver](#p-056)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_stapling_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_stapling_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.3.7.

該指令出現在版本1.3.7 。

When set, the stapled OCSP response will be taken from the specified `*file*` instead of querying the OCSP responder specified in the server certificate.

設定後，將從指定的`*file*`取得裝訂的OCSP回應，而不是查詢伺服器憑證中指定的OCSP回應程式。

The file should be in the DER format as produced by the “`openssl ocsp`” command.

該檔案應為「 `openssl ocsp` 」指令產生的DER格式。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_stapling_responder** `*url*`;``<br>` `**ssl_stapling_responder** ` *url* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.3.7.

該指令出現在版本1.3.7 。

Overrides the URL of the OCSP responder specified in the “[Authority Information Access](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.2.1)” certificate extension.

覆蓋「[權威資訊存取](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.2.1) 」證書擴充中指定的OCSP回應程式的URL 。

Only “`http://`” OCSP responders are supported:

僅支援“ `http://` ” OCSP應答器：

> ```
> ssl_stapling_responder http://ocsp.example.com/;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_stapling_verify</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_stapling_verify off;<br>關閉 ssl_stapling_verify；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.3.7.

該指令出現在版本1.3.7 。

Enables or disables verification of OCSP responses by the server.

啟用或停用伺服器對OCSP回應的驗證。

For verification to work, the certificate of the server certificate issuer, the root certificate, and all intermediate certificates should be configured as trusted using the [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-098) directive.

為了使驗證生效，伺服器憑證授權者的憑證、根憑證和所有中間憑證都應該使用 [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-098)指令配置為受信任。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_trusted_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_trusted_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.3.7.

該指令出現在版本1.3.7 。

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-098) client certificates and OCSP responses if [ssl\_stapling](#p-098) is enabled.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-098)客戶端證書和OCSP響應（如果啟用 [ssl\_pling](#p-098) 。

In contrast to the certificate set by [ssl\_client\_certificate](#p-098), the list of these certificates will not be sent to clients.

與 [ssl\_client\_certificate](#p-098)設定的憑證不同，這些憑證的清單不會傳送給客戶端。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_verify_client</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code>optional<br>選修的</code> | <code>optional_no_ca</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_verify_client off;<br>關閉 ssl_verify_client;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables verification of client certificates. The verification result is stored in the [$ssl\_client\_verify](#p-098) variable.

啟用客戶端憑證驗證。驗證結果儲存在 [$ssl\_client\_verify](#p-098)變數中。

The `optional` parameter (0.8.7+) requests the client certificate and verifies it if the certificate is present.

`optional`參數 ( 0.8.7 +) 請求客戶端證書，並驗證證書是否存在。

The `optional_no_ca` parameter (1.3.8, 1.2.5) requests the client certificate but does not require it to be signed by a trusted CA certificate. This is intended for the use in cases when a service that is external to nginx performs the actual certificate verification. The contents of the certificate is accessible through the [$ssl\_client\_cert](#p-098) variable.

`optional_no_ca`參數（ 1.3.8, 1.2.5 ）請求客戶端證書，但不要求其由受信任的CA證書簽署。這適用於由 nginx 外部服務執行實際憑證驗證的情況。憑證內容可透過 [$ssl\_client\_cert](#p-098)變數存取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_verify_depth</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_verify_depth 1;<br>ssl_verify_depth 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the verification depth in the client certificates chain.

設定客戶端憑證鏈的驗證深度。

**Error Processing｜錯誤處理**

The `ngx_http_ssl_module` module supports several non-standard error codes that can be used for redirects using the [error\_page](#p-056) directive:

`ngx_http_ssl_module`模組支援幾個非標準錯誤代碼，可以使用 [error\_page](#p-056)指令進行重定向：

495

an error has occurred during the client certificate verification;

客戶端證書驗證過程中發生錯誤；

496

a client has not presented the required certificate;

客戶未提供所需證明文件；

497

a regular request has been sent to the HTTPS port.

已向HTTPS連接埠發送常規請求。

The redirection happens after the request is fully parsed and the variables, such as `$request_uri`, `$uri`, `$args` and others, are available.

重定向發生在請求完全解析完畢，變數（例如`$request_uri`, `$uri`, `$args`等）可用之後。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_ssl_module` module supports embedded variables:

`ngx_http_ssl_module`模組支援嵌入式變數：

`$ssl_alpn_protocol`

returns the protocol selected by ALPN during the SSL handshake, or an empty string otherwise (1.21.4);

返回ALPN在SSL握手期間選擇的協議，否則返回空字串（ 1.21.4 ）；

`$ssl_cipher`

returns the name of the cipher used for an established SSL connection;

傳回用於已建立的SSL連線的密碼名稱；

`$ssl_ciphers`

returns the list of ciphers supported by the client (1.11.7). Known ciphers are listed by names, unknown are shown in hexadecimal, for example:

傳回客戶端支援的密碼套件清單（ 1.11.7 ）。已知密碼套件以名稱列出，未知密碼套件以十六進位顯示，例如：

> ```
> AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:0x00ff
>
> AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA :0x00ff
> ```

> The variable is fully supported only when using OpenSSL version 1.0.2 or higher. With older versions, the variable is available only for new sessions and lists only known ciphers.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本1.0.2或更高版本時，該變數才會完全支援。在舊版本中，該變數僅適用於新會話，並且僅列出已知的密碼套件。

`$ssl_client_escaped_cert`

returns the client certificate in the PEM format (urlencoded) for an established SSL connection (1.13.5);

傳回已建立的SSL連線（ 1.13.5 ）的PEM格式（urlencoded）的客戶端憑證；

`$ssl_client_cert`

returns the client certificate in the PEM format for an established SSL connection, with each line except the first prepended with the tab character; this is intended for the use in the [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085) directive;

傳回已建立的PEM連接的客戶端證書，格式為SSL ，除第一行外，每行都以製表符開頭；這是為 [proxy\_set\_header](#p-085)指令而準備的；

> The variable is deprecated, the `$ssl_client_escaped_cert` variable should be used instead.
>
> 該變數已棄用，應改用`$ssl_client_escaped_cert`變數。

`$ssl_client_fingerprint`

returns the SHA1 fingerprint of the client certificate for an established SSL connection (1.7.1);

傳回已建立連線的用戶端憑證的指紋1.7.1 SHA1 SSL

`$ssl_client_i_dn`

returns the “issuer DN” string of the client certificate for an established SSL connection according to [RFC 2253](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2253) (1.11.6);

傳回已建立連線的用戶端憑證的「核發者DN 」字串1.11.6根據 [ SSL 2253]RFC ( (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2253) ) ;

`$ssl_client_i_dn_legacy`

returns the “issuer DN” string of the client certificate for an established SSL connection;

傳回已建立SSL的用戶端憑證的「頒發者DN 」字串；

> Prior to version 1.11.6, the variable name was `$ssl_client_i_dn`.
>
> 在版本1.11.6之前，變數名為`$ssl_client_i_dn` 。

`$ssl_client_raw_cert`

returns the client certificate in the PEM format for an established SSL connection;

對於已建立的SSL連接，以PEM格式返回客戶端憑證；

`$ssl_client_s_dn`

returns the “subject DN” string of the client certificate for an established SSL connection according to [RFC 2253](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2253) (1.11.6);

傳回已建立連線的用戶端憑證的「主題DN 」字串1.11.6根據 [ SSL 2253]RFC ( (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2253) ) ;

`$ssl_client_s_dn_legacy`

returns the “subject DN” string of the client certificate for an established SSL connection;

傳回已SSL連線的用戶端憑證的「主題DN 」字串；

> Prior to version 1.11.6, the variable name was `$ssl_client_s_dn`.
>
> 在版本1.11.6之前，變數名為`$ssl_client_s_dn` 。

`$ssl_client_serial`

returns the serial number of the client certificate for an established SSL connection;

傳回已建立的SSL連線的客戶端憑證的序號；

`$ssl_client_sigalg`

returns the [signature algorithm](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) for the client certificate for an established SSL connection (1.29.3).

傳回已建立的SSL連接的客戶端憑證的 [簽章演算法](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) ( 1.29.3 )。

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 3.5 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本3.5或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

> The variable is available only for new sessions.
>
> 此變數僅適用於新會話。

`$ssl_client_v_end`

returns the end date of the client certificate (1.11.7);

傳回客戶端憑證的到期日期（ 1.11.7 ）；

`$ssl_client_v_remain`

returns the number of days until the client certificate expires (1.11.7);

傳回客戶端憑證到期前的天數（ 1.11.7 ）；

`$ssl_client_v_start`

returns the start date of the client certificate (1.11.7);

傳回客戶端憑證的起始日期（ 1.11.7 ）；

`$ssl_client_verify`

returns the result of client certificate verification: “`SUCCESS`”, “`FAILED:``*reason*`”, and “`NONE`” if a certificate was not present;

傳回客戶端憑證驗證結果：「 `SUCCESS` 」、「 `FAILED:``*reason*` 」和「 `NONE` 」（若不存在憑證）；

> Prior to version 1.11.7, the “`FAILED`” result did not contain the `*reason*` string.
>
> 在版本1.11.7之前，「 `FAILED` 」結果不包含字串`*reason*` 。

`$ssl_curve`

returns the negotiated curve used for SSL handshake key exchange process (1.21.5). Known curves are listed by names, unknown are shown in hexadecimal, for example:

返回用於SSL握手金鑰交換過程（ 1.21.5 ）的協商曲線。已知曲線以名稱列出，未知曲線以十六進位顯示，例如：

> ```
> prime256v1
> ```

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 3.0 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本3.0或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

`$ssl_curves`

returns the list of curves supported by the client (1.11.7). Known curves are listed by names, unknown are shown in hexadecimal, for example:

傳回客戶端支援的曲線清單（ 1.11.7 ）。已知曲線按名稱列出，未知曲線以十六進位顯示，例如：

> ```
> 0x001d:prime256v1:secp521r1:secp384r1
> ```

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 1.0.2 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本1.0.2或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

> The variable is available only for new sessions.
>
> 此變數僅適用於新會話。

`$ssl_early_data`

returns “`1`” if TLS 1.3 [early data](#p-098) is used and the handshake is not complete, otherwise “” (1.15.3).

如果使用了TLS 1.3 [早期數據](#p-098)且握手未完成，則返回“ `1` ”，否則返回“”（ 1.15.3 ）。

`$ssl_ech_outer_server_name`

returns the public server name requested through [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) if TLS 1.3 [ECH](#p-098) was accepted, otherwise “” (1.29.4);

如果TLS 1.3 [ECH](#p-098)被接受，則返回通過 [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication)請求的公共伺服器名稱，否則返回「」（ 1.29.4 ）；

`$ssl_ech_status`

returns the result of TLS 1.3 [ECH](#p-098) processing: “`FAILED`”, “`BACKEND`”, “`GREASE`”, “`SUCCESS`”, or “`NOT_TRIED`” (1.29.4);

回TLS 1.3 [ECH](#p-098)處理的結果：" `FAILED` 」, “ `BACKEND` ”, “ `GREASE` ”, `SUCCESS` `NOT_TRIED` 」, ⦦ ( 1.29.4 ) ;

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 4.0 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本4.0或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

`$ssl_protocol`

returns the protocol of an established SSL connection;

返回已建立的SSL連接的協定；

`$ssl_server_name`

returns the server name requested through [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) (1.7.0);

傳回透過 [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) ( 1.7.0 ) 請求的伺服器名稱；

`$ssl_session_id`

returns the session identifier of an established SSL connection;

傳回已建立的SSL連線的會話標識符；

`$ssl_session_reused`

returns “`r`” if an SSL session was reused, or “`.`” otherwise (1.5.11).

如果重用了SSL會話，則回傳“ `r` ”，否則回傳“ `.` ”（ 1.5.11 ）。

`$ssl_sigalg`

returns the [signature algorithm](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) for the server certificate for an established SSL connection (1.29.3).

傳回已建立的SSL連接的伺服器憑證的 [簽章演算法](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) ( 1.29.3 )。

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 3.5 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本3.5或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

> The variable is available only for new sessions.
>
> 此變數僅適用於新會話。

`$ssl_sigalgs`

returns the list of [signature algorithms](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) supported by the client (1.31.2). Known values are listed by names, unknown are shown in hexadecimal, for example:

傳回客戶端1.31.2 (https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16)支援的簽章演算法清單。已知值以名稱列出，未知值以十六進位顯示，例如：

> ```
> 0xfe00:rsa_pkcs1_sha256:rsa_pss_rsae_sha256:ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256
> ```

> The variable is fully supported only when using OpenSSL version 4.0 or higher. For OpenSSL versions 1.0.2+, the values are always shown in hexadecimal. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本4.0或更高版本時，該變數才會完全支援。對於 OpenSSL 版本1.0.2及更高版本，其值始終以十六進位顯示。對於更早的版本，該變數的值將為空字串。

> The variable is available only for new sessions.
>
> 此變數僅適用於新會話。

---

<a id="p-099"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_status_module｜模組 ngx_http_status_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_status_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_status\_module｜模組 ngx_http_status_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-099)<br>[Directives](#p-099)<br>     [status](#p-099)<br>     [status\_format](#p-099)<br>     [status\_zone](#p-099)<br>[Data](#p-099)<br>[Compatibility](#p-099)<br>[範例設定](#p-099)<br>[指令](#p-099)<br>     [狀態](#p-099)<br>     [狀態\_格式](#p-099)<br>     [狀態\_區域](#p-099)<br>[資料](#p-099)<br>[相容性](#p-099) |

The `ngx_http_status_module` module provides access to various status information.

`ngx_http_status_module`模組提供各種狀態資訊的存取。

> This module was available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx) until 1.13.10. It was superseded by the [ngx\_http\_api\_module](#p-048) module in 1.13.3.
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供，直至1.13.10 。它在1.13.3中被[ngx\_http\_api\_module](#p-048)模組取代。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> http {
>     upstream backend {
>
>     上游後端 {
>         zone http_backend 64k;
>
>         區域 http_backend 64k；
> 
>         server backend1.example.com weight=5;
>
>         伺服器 backend1.example.com 權重=5；
>         server backend2.example.com;
>
>         伺服器 backend2.example.com；
>     }
> 
>     proxy_cache_path /data/nginx/cache_backend keys_zone=cache_backend:10m;
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         server_name backend.example.com;
> 
>         location / {
>
>         地點 / {
>             proxy_pass  http://backend;
>
>             proxy_pass http://backend;
>             proxy_cache cache_backend;
>
>             代理緩存緩存後端；
> 
>             health_check;
>
>             健康檢查；
>         }
> 
>         status_zone server_backend;
>
>         狀態區域 server_backend；
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 127.0.0.1;
>
>         聽127.0.0.1 ;
> 
>         location /upstream_conf {
>             upstream_conf;
>
>             上游配置；
>         }
> 
>         location /status {
>
>         位置/狀態 {
>             status;
>
>             地位;
>         }
> 
>         location = /status.html {
>         }
>     }
> }
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     upstream backend {
>
>     上游後端 {
>         zone stream_backend 64k;
>
>         區域 stream_backend 64k；
> 
>         server backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>
>         伺服器 backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>         server backend2.example.com:12345;
>
>         伺服器 backend2.example.com:12345;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen      127.0.0.1:12345;
>
>         聽127.0.0.1:12345 ;
>         proxy_pass  backend;
>
>         proxy_pass 後端；
>         status_zone server_backend;
>
>         狀態區域 server_backend；
>         health_check;
>
>         健康檢查；
>     }
> }
> ```

Examples of status requests with this configuration:

以下是使用此配置的狀態請求範例：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/status
> http://127.0.0.1/status/nginx_version
> http://127.0.0.1/status/caches/cache_backend
> http://127.0.0.1/status/upstreams
> http://127.0.0.1/status/upstreams/backend
> http://127.0.0.1/status/upstreams/backend/peers/1
> http://127.0.0.1/status/upstreams/backend/peers/1/weight
> http://127.0.0.1/status/stream
> http://127.0.0.1/status/stream/upstreams
> http://127.0.0.1/status/stream/upstreams/backend
> http://127.0.0.1/status/stream/upstreams/backend/peers/1
> http://127.0.0.1/status/stream/upstreams/backend/peers/1/weight
> ```

The simple monitoring page is shipped with this distribution, accessible as “`/status.html`” in the default configuration. It requires the locations “`/status`” and “`/status.html`” to be configured as shown above.

此發行版附帶了簡單的監控頁面，在預設配置中可透過「 `/status.html` 」存取。它需要按照上述方式配置位置“ `/status` ”和“ `/status.html` ”。

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**status**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location` |

The status information will be accessible from the surrounding location. Access to this location should be [limited](#p-056).

狀態資訊可從周圍位置取得。對該位置的存取應[受限](#p-056) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>status_format</strong> <code>json</code>;</code><br><code><strong>status_format</strong> <code>jsonp</code> [<code><i>callback</i></code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> status_format </strong> <code> </i></code> </code>;</code><br><code><strong> status_format </strong> <code> jsonp </code> [ <code><i> </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>status_format json;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

By default, status information is output in the JSON format.

預設情況下，狀態資訊以JSON格式輸出。

Alternatively, data may be output as JSONP. The `*callback*` parameter specifies the name of a callback function. Parameter value can contain variables. If parameter is omitted, or the computed value is an empty string, then “`ngx_status_jsonp_callback`” is used.

或者，數據可以輸出為JSONP `*callback*`指定回呼函數的名稱。參數值可以包含變數。如果省略參數，或計算出的值為空字串，則使用「 `ngx_status_jsonp_callback` 」。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**status_zone** `*zone*`;``<br>` `**status_zone** ` *區域* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Enables collection of virtual [http](#p-056) or [stream](#p-142) (1.7.11) server status information in the specified `*zone*`. Several servers may share the same zone.

允許在指定的`*zone*`中收集虛擬 [http](#p-056)或 [stream](#p-142) ( 1.7.11 ) 伺服器狀態資訊。多個伺服器可以共享同一個區域。

**Data｜數據**

The following status information is provided:

提供以下狀態資訊：

`version`

Version of the provided data set. The current version is 8.

所提供資料集的版本。目前版本為 8。

`nginx_version`

Version of nginx.

nginx 版本。

`nginx_build`

Name of nginx build.

nginx 建置名稱。

`address`

The address of the server that accepted status request.

接受狀態請求的伺服器位址。

`generation`

The total number of configuration [reloads](#p-026).

配置[重新加載 的總次數](#p-026) 。

`load_timestamp`

Time of the last reload of configuration, in milliseconds since Epoch.

上次重新載入配置的時間，以自 Unix 紀元以來的毫秒數表示。

`timestamp`

Current time in milliseconds since Epoch.

自 Unix 紀元以來的當前時間（以毫秒為單位）。

`pid`

The ID of the worker process that handled status request.

處理狀態請求的工作進程的ID 。

`ppid`

The ID of the master process that started the [worker process](#p-099).

啟動 [工作進程](#p-099)的主進程ID 。

`processes`

`respawned`

The total number of abnormally terminated and respawned child processes.

異常終止並重新啟動的子進程總數。

`connections`

`accepted`

The total number of accepted client connections.

已接受的客戶端連線總數。

`dropped`

The total number of dropped client connections.

客戶端連線斷開的總數。

`active`

The current number of active client connections.

當前活躍客戶端連線數。

`idle`

The current number of idle client connections.

當前空閒客戶端連線數。

`ssl`

`handshakes`

The total number of successful SSL handshakes.

成功握手的總次數SSL 。

`handshakes_failed`

The total number of failed SSL handshakes.

SSL握手失敗的總數。

`session_reuses`

The total number of session reuses during SSL handshake.

在SSL握手期間會話重用的總次數。

`requests`

`total`

The total number of client requests.

客戶請求總數。

`current`

The current number of client requests.

當前客戶端請求數量。

`server_zones`

For each [status\_zone](#p-099):

對於每個 [status\_zone](#p-099) :

`processing`

The number of client requests that are currently being processed.

目前正在處理的客戶請求數量。

`requests`

The total number of client requests received from clients.

從客戶收到的客戶請求總數。

`responses`

`total`

The total number of responses sent to clients.

發送給客戶的回覆總數。

`1xx`, `2xx`, `3xx`, `4xx`, `5xx`

The number of responses with status codes 1xx, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, and 5xx.

狀態碼為 1xx、2xx、3xx、4xx 和 5xx 的回應數量。

`discarded`

The total number of requests completed without sending a response.

未發送回應的請求總數。

`received`

The total number of bytes received from clients.

從客戶端接收到的總位元組數。

`sent`

The total number of bytes sent to clients.

發送給客戶端的總位元組數。

`slabs`

For each shared memory zone that uses slab allocator:

對於每個使用 slab 分配器的共享記憶體區域：

`pages`

`used`

The current number of used memory pages.

目前已使用的記憶體頁數。

`free`

The current number of free memory pages.

目前可用記憶體頁數。

`slots`

For each memory slot size (8, 16, 32, 64, 128, etc.) the following data are provided:

對於每種記憶體插槽容量（8、16、32、64、128 等），提供以下資料：

`used`

The current number of used memory slots.

目前已使用的記憶體插槽數量。

`free`

The current number of free memory slots.

目前可用記憶體插槽數量。

`reqs`

The total number of attempts to allocate memory of specified size.

嘗試分配指定大小記憶體的總次數。

`fails`

The number of unsuccessful attempts to allocate memory of specified size.

分配指定大小記憶體的失敗嘗試次數。

`upstreams`

For each [dynamically configurable](#p-105) [group](#p-105), the following data are provided:

對於每個[動態可設定](#p-105) [群組](#p-105) ，提供以下數據：

`peers`

For each [server](#p-105), the following data are provided:

對於每個[伺服器](#p-105) ，提供以下數據：

`id`

The ID of the server.

伺服器的ID 。

`server`

An [address](#p-105) of the server.

伺服器的 [位址](#p-105) 。

`name`

The name of the server specified in the [server](#p-105) directive.

[server](#p-105)指令中指定的伺服器名稱。

`service`

The [service](#p-105) parameter value of the [server](#p-105) directive.

[server](#p-105)指令的 [service](#p-105)參數值。

`backup`

A boolean value indicating whether the server is a [backup](#p-105) server.

一個布林值，指示伺服器是否為 [備份](#p-105)伺服器。

`weight`

[Weight](#p-105) of the server.

[重量](#p-105)伺服器。

`state`

Current state, which may be one of “`up`”, “`draining`”, “`down`”, “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, or “`unhealthy`”.

目前狀態可能是「 `up` 」、「 `draining` 」、「 `down` 」、「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」或「 `unhealthy` 」之一。

`active`

The current number of active connections.

目前活躍連線數。

`max_conns`

The [max\_conns](#p-105) limit for the server.

伺服器的 [max\_conns](#p-105)限制。

`requests`

The total number of client requests forwarded to this server.

轉送至此伺服器的客戶端請求總數。

`responses`

`total`

The total number of responses obtained from this server.

從該伺服器收到的回應總數。

`1xx`, `2xx`, `3xx`, `4xx`, `5xx`

The number of responses with status codes 1xx, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, and 5xx.

狀態碼為 1xx、2xx、3xx、4xx 和 5xx 的回應數量。

`sent`

The total number of bytes sent to this server.

傳送到此伺服器的總位元組數。

`received`

The total number of bytes received from this server.

從該伺服器接收到的總位元組數。

`fails`

The total number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server.

與伺服器通訊失敗的總次數。

`unavail`

How many times the server became unavailable for client requests (state “`unavail`”) due to the number of unsuccessful attempts reaching the [max\_fails](#p-105) threshold.

由於失敗嘗試次數達到 [max\_fails](#p-105)閾值，伺服器對客戶端請求不可用（狀態「 `unavail` 」）的次數。

`health_checks`

`checks`

The total number of [health check](#p-104) requests made.

已發出的[健康檢查](#p-104)請求總數。

`fails`

The number of failed health checks.

健康檢查不合格的次數。

`unhealthy`

How many times the server became unhealthy (state “`unhealthy`”).

伺服器出現不健康狀態（狀態「 `unhealthy` 」）的次數。

`last_passed`

Boolean indicating if the last health check request was successful and passed [tests](#p-104).

布林值，表示上次健康檢查請求是否成功並通過了 [測試](#p-104) 。

`downtime`

Total time the server was in the “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, and “`unhealthy`” states.

伺服器處於「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」和「 `unhealthy` 」狀態的總時間。

`downstart`

The time (in milliseconds since Epoch) when the server became “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, or “`unhealthy`”.

伺服器變成「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」或「 `unhealthy` 」的時間（自 Epoch 以來的毫秒數）。

`selected`

The time (in milliseconds since Epoch) when the server was last selected to process a request (1.7.5).

伺服器上次被選取處理請求的時間（自 Epoch 以來的毫秒數）（ 1.7.5 ）。

`header_time`

The average time to get the [response header](#p-105) from the server (1.7.10). Prior to version 1.11.6, the field was available only when using the [least\_time](#p-105) load balancing method.

從伺服器取得 [回應頭](#p-105)的平均時間 ( 1.7.10 )。在版本1.11.6之前，此欄位僅在使用 [least\_time](#p-105)負載平衡方法時可用。

`response_time`

The average time to get the [full response](#p-105) from the server (1.7.10). Prior to version 1.11.6, the field was available only when using the [least\_time](#p-105) load balancing method.

從伺服器 ( 1.7.10 ) 取得 [完整回應](#p-105)的平均時間。在版本1.11.6之前，此欄位僅在使用 [least\_time](#p-105)負載平衡方法時可用。

`keepalive`

The current number of idle [keepalive](#p-105) connections.

目前空閒 [keepalive](#p-105)連接數。

`zombies`

The current number of servers removed from the group but still processing active client requests.

目前已從群組中移除但仍在處理活躍用戶端請求的伺服器數量。

`zone`

The name of the shared memory [zone](#p-105) that keeps the group’s configuration and run-time state.

保存群組配置和運行時狀態的共享記憶體 [區域](#p-105)的名稱。

`queue`

For the requests [queue](#p-105), the following data are provided:

對於請求 [隊列](#p-105) ，提供以下資料：

`size`

The current number of requests in the queue.

目前佇列中的請求數量。

`max_size`

The maximum number of requests that can be in the queue at the same time.

佇列中同時可以存在的最大請求數。

`overflows`

The total number of requests rejected due to the queue overflow.

由於佇列溢出而被拒絕的請求總數。

`caches`

For each cache (configured by [proxy\_cache\_path](#p-085) and the likes):

對於每個快取（由 [proxy\_cache\_path](#p-085)等配置）：

`size`

The current size of the cache.

快取的當前大小。

`max_size`

The limit on the maximum size of the cache specified in the configuration.

配置中指定的快取最大​​大小限制。

`cold`

A boolean value indicating whether the “cache loader” process is still loading data from disk into the cache.

一個布林值，指示「快取載入器」進程是否仍在將資料從磁碟載入到快取中。

`hit`, `stale`, `updating`, `revalidated`

`responses`

The total number of responses read from the cache (hits, or stale responses due to [proxy\_cache\_use\_stale](#p-085) and the likes).

從快取中讀取的總回應數（命中數，或因 [proxy\_cache\_use\_stale](#p-085)等原因導致的過期回應數）。

`bytes`

The total number of bytes read from the cache.

從快取中讀取的總位元組數。

`miss`, `expired`, `bypass`

`responses`

The total number of responses not taken from the cache (misses, expires, or bypasses due to [proxy\_cache\_bypass](#p-085) and the likes).

未從快取中取得的總回應數（由於 [proxy\_cache\_bypass](#p-085)等原因導致的未命中、過期或繞過）。

`bytes`

The total number of bytes read from the proxied server.

從代理伺服器讀取的總位元組數。

`responses_written`

The total number of responses written to the cache.

寫入快取的回應總數。

`bytes_written`

The total number of bytes written to the cache.

寫入快取的總位元組數。

`stream`

`server_zones`

For each [status\_zone](#p-099):

對於每個 [status\_zone](#p-099) :

`processing`

The number of client connections that are currently being processed.

目前正在處理的客戶端連線數。

`connections`

The total number of connections accepted from clients.

客戶端接受的連線總數。

`sessions`

`total`

The total number of completed client sessions.

已完成的客戶會話總數。

`2xx`, `4xx`, `5xx`

The number of sessions completed with [status codes](#p-142) 2xx, 4xx, or 5xx.

完成的會話數，狀態碼為(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_core_module.html#var_status) 、4xx 或 5xx。

`discarded`

The total number of connections completed without creating a session.

未建立會話而完成的連線總數。

`received`

The total number of bytes received from clients.

從客戶端接收到的總位元組數。

`sent`

The total number of bytes sent to clients.

發送給客戶端的總位元組數。

`upstreams`

For each [dynamically configurable](#p-163) [group](#p-163), the following data are provided:

對於每個[動態可設定](#p-163) [群組](#p-163) ，提供以下數據：

`peers`

For each [server](#p-163) the following data are provided:

對於每個[伺服器](#p-163)提供以下數據：

`id`

The ID of the server.

伺服器的ID 。

`server`

An [address](#p-163) of the server.

伺服器的 [位址](#p-163) 。

`name`

The name of the server specified in the [server](#p-163) directive.

[server](#p-163)指令中指定的伺服器名稱。

`service`

The [service](#p-163) parameter value of the [server](#p-163) directive.

[server](#p-163)指令的 [service](#p-163)參數值。

`backup`

A boolean value indicating whether the server is a [backup](#p-163) server.

一個布林值，指示伺服器是否為 [備份](#p-163)伺服器。

`weight`

[Weight](#p-163) of the server.

[重量](#p-163)伺服器。

`state`

Current state, which may be one of “`up`”, “`down`”, “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, or “`unhealthy`”.

目前狀態可能是「 `up` 」、「 `down` 」、「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」或「 `unhealthy` 」之一。

`active`

The current number of connections.

目前連接數。

`max_conns`

The [max\_conns](#p-163) limit for the server.

伺服器的 [max\_conns](#p-163)限制。

`connections`

The total number of client connections forwarded to this server.

轉送至此伺服器的用戶端連線總數。

`connect_time`

The average time to connect to the upstream server. Prior to version 1.11.6, the field was available only when using the [least\_time](#p-163) load balancing method.

連接到上游伺服器的平均時間。在版本1.11.6之前，此欄位僅在使用 [least\_time](#p-163)負載平衡方法時可用。

`first_byte_time`

The average time to receive the first byte of data. Prior to version 1.11.6, the field was available only when using the [least\_time](#p-163) load balancing method.

接收到第一個位元組資料的平均時間。在版本1.11.6之前，此欄位僅在使用 [least\_time](#p-163)負載平衡方法時可用。

`response_time`

The average time to receive the last byte of data. Prior to version 1.11.6, the field was available only when using the [least\_time](#p-163) load balancing method.

接收最後一個位元組資料的平均時間。在版本1.11.6之前，此欄位僅在使用 [least\_time](#p-163)負載平衡方法時可用。

`sent`

The total number of bytes sent to this server.

傳送到此伺服器的總位元組數。

`received`

The total number of bytes received from this server.

從該伺服器接收到的總位元組數。

`fails`

The total number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server.

與伺服器通訊失敗的總次數。

`unavail`

How many times the server became unavailable for client connections (state “`unavail`”) due to the number of unsuccessful attempts reaching the [max\_fails](#p-163) threshold.

由於失敗嘗試次數達到 [max\_fails](#p-163)閾值，伺服器對客戶端連線不可用（狀態「 `unavail` 」）的次數。

`health_checks`

`checks`

The total number of [health check](#p-162) requests made.

已發出的[健康檢查](#p-162)請求總數。

`fails`

The number of failed health checks.

健康檢查不合格的次數。

`unhealthy`

How many times the server became unhealthy (state “`unhealthy`”).

伺服器出現不健康狀態（狀態「 `unhealthy` 」）的次數。

`last_passed`

Boolean indicating if the last health check request was successful and passed [tests](#p-162).

布林值，表示上次健康檢查請求是否成功並通過了[測試](#p-162) 。

`downtime`

Total time the server was in the “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, and “`unhealthy`” states.

伺服器處於「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」和「 `unhealthy` 」狀態的總時間。

`downstart`

The time (in milliseconds since Epoch) when the server became “`unavail`”, “`checking`”, or “`unhealthy`”.

伺服器變成「 `unavail` 」、「 `checking` 」或「 `unhealthy` 」的時間（自 Epoch 以來的毫秒數）。

`selected`

The time (in milliseconds since Epoch) when the server was last selected to process a connection.

伺服器上次被選中處理連接的時間（自 Epoch 以來的毫秒數）。

`zombies`

The current number of servers removed from the group but still processing active client connections.

目前已從群組中移除但仍在處理活躍用戶端連線的伺服器數量。

`zone`

The name of the shared memory [zone](#p-163) that keeps the group’s configuration and run-time state.

共享記憶體 [區域](#p-163)的名稱，用於保存群組的配置和運行時狀態。

**Compatibility｜相容性**

-   The [zone](#p-099) field in [http](#p-099) and [stream](#p-099) upstreams was added in [version](#p-099) 8.  
    [http](#p-099)和 [stream](#p-099)上游中的 [zone](#p-099)字段是在 [version](#p-099) 8 中添加的。
-   The [slabs](#p-099) status data were added in [version](#p-099) 8.  
    [slabs](#p-099)狀態資料在 [版本](#p-099) 8 中加入。
-   The [checking](#p-099) state was added in [version](#p-099) 8.  
    [檢查](#p-099)狀態是在 [版本](#p-099) 8 中新增的。
-   The [name](#p-099) and [service](#p-099) fields in [http](#p-099) and [stream](#p-099) upstreams were added in [version](#p-099) 8.  
    在 [版本](#p-099) 8 中，[http](#p-099)和 [stream](#p-099)上游新增了 [name](#p-099)和 [service](#p-099)字段。
-   The [nginx\_build](#p-099) and [ppid](#p-099) fields were added in [version](#p-099) 8.  
    [nginx\_build](#p-099)和 [ppid](#p-099)字段是在 [version](#p-099) 8 中添加的。
-   The [sessions](#p-099) status data and the [discarded](#p-099) field in stream [server\_zones](#p-099) were added in [version](#p-099) 7.  
    [sessions](#p-099)狀態資料和 [discarded](#p-099)流 [server\_zones](#p-099)中的欄位已在 [version](#p-099) 7 中新增。
-   The [zombies](#p-099) field was moved from nginx [debug](#p-027) version in [version](#p-099) 6.  
    [zombies](#p-099)欄位已從 nginx [debug](#p-027)版本移至 [version](#p-099) 6。
-   The [ssl](#p-099) status data were added in [version](#p-099) 6.  
    [ssl](#p-099)狀態​​資料在 [版本](#p-099) 6 中加入。
-   The [discarded](#p-099) field in [server\_zones](#p-099) was added in [version](#p-099) 6.  
    [伺服器區域](#p-099)中的 [已丟棄](#p-099)欄位是在 [版本](#p-099) 6 中新增的。
-   The [queue](#p-099) status data were added in [version](#p-099) 6.  
    [隊列](#p-099)狀態資料已在 [版本](#p-099) 6 中新增。
-   The [pid](#p-099) field was added in [version](#p-099) 6.  
    [pid](#p-099)字段是在 [version](#p-099) 6 中新增的。
-   The list of servers in [upstreams](#p-099) was moved into [peers](#p-099) in [version](#p-099) 6.  
    [upstreams](#p-099)中的伺服器清單已在 [version](#p-099) 6 中移至 [peers](#p-099)中。
-   The `keepalive` field of an upstream server was removed in [version](#p-099) 5.  
    上游伺服器的`keepalive`字段在[版本](#p-099)中被刪除。
-   The [stream](#p-099) status data were added in [version](#p-099) 5.  
    [流](#p-099)狀態資料已在 [版本](#p-099) 5 中新增。
-   The [generation](#p-099) field was added in [version](#p-099) 5.  
    [版本](#p-099) 5 中新增了 [生成](#p-099)字段。
-   The [respawned](#p-099) field in [processes](#p-099) was added in [version](#p-099) 5.  
    [重新生成](#p-099)字段在 [進程](#p-099)中已在 [版本](#p-099) 5 中新增。
-   The [header\_time](#p-099) and [response\_time](#p-099) fields in [upstreams](#p-099) were added in [version](#p-099) 5.  
    [upstreams](#p-099)中的 [header\_time](#p-099)和 [response\_time](#p-099)字段是在 [version](#p-099) 5 中添加的。
-   The [selected](#p-099) field in [upstreams](#p-099) was added in [version](#p-099) 4.  
    [上游](#p-099)中的 [選定](#p-099)字段是在 [版本](#p-099) 4 中新增的。
-   The [draining](#p-099) state in [upstreams](#p-099) was added in [version](#p-099) 4.  
    [版本](#p-099) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_status_module.html#version)中新增了 [上游](#p-099)狀態。
-   The [id](#p-099) and [max\_conns](#p-099) fields in [upstreams](#p-099) were added in [version](#p-099) 3.  
    [upstreams](#p-099) 中的 [id](#p-099) 和 [max\_conns](#p-099) 欄位已在 [version](#p-099) 3 中新增。
-   The `revalidated` field in [caches](#p-099) was added in [version](#p-099) 3.  
    [caches](#p-099)中的`revalidated`字段是在 [version](#p-099) 3 中添加的。
-   The [server\_zones](#p-099), [caches](#p-099), and [load\_timestamp](#p-099) status data were added in [version](#p-099) 2.  
    [server\_zones](#p-099) 、[caches](#p-099)和 [load\_timestamp](#p-099)狀態資料已在 [version](#p-099) 2 中新增。

<a id="p-100"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_stub_status_module｜模組 ngx_http_stub_status_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_stub_status_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_stub\_status\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_stub\_status\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-100)<br>[Directives](#p-100)<br>     [stub\_status](#p-100)<br>[Data](#p-100)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-100)<br>[範例配置](#p-100)<br> [指令](#p-100)<br> [存根狀態](#p-100)<br> [資料](#p-100)<br> [嵌入式變數](#p-100) |

The `ngx_http_stub_status_module` module provides access to basic status information.

`ngx_http_stub_status_module`模組提供對基本狀態資訊的存取。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_stub_status_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_stub_status_module`配置參數啟用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location = /basic_status {
>     stub_status;
>
>     存根狀態；
> }
> ```

This configuration creates a simple web page with basic status data which may look like as follows:

此配置會建立一個簡單的網頁，其中包含基本狀態數據，其內容可能如下所示：

> ```yaml
> Active connections: 291
>
> 活躍連線數：291
> server accepts handled requests
>
> 伺服器接受已處理的請求
>  16630948 16630948 31070465
> Reading: 6 Writing: 179 Waiting: 106
>
> 閱讀：6 寫作：179 等待：106
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**stub_status**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location` |

The basic status information will be accessible from the surrounding location.

基本狀態資訊可從周圍位置取得。

> In versions prior to 1.7.5, the directive syntax required an arbitrary argument, for example, “`stub_status on`”.
>
> 在1.7.5之前的版本中，指令語法需要一個任意參數，例如「 `stub_status on` 」。

**Data｜數據**

The following status information is provided:

提供以下狀態資訊：

`Active connections`

The current number of active client connections including `Waiting` connections.

目前活躍客戶端連線數，包括`Waiting`連線。

`accepts`

The total number of accepted client connections.

已接受的客戶端連線總數。

`handled`

The total number of handled connections. Generally, the parameter value is the same as `accepts` unless some resource limits have been reached (for example, the [worker\_connections](#p-125) limit).

已處理的連接總數。通常，此參數值與`accepts`相同，除非達到某些資源限制（例如，[worker\_connections](#p-125)限制）。

`requests`

The total number of client requests.

客戶請求總數。

`Reading`

The current number of connections where nginx is reading the request header.

nginx 正在讀取請求頭的目前連線數。

`Writing`

The current number of connections where nginx is writing the response back to the client.

nginx 目前正在向客戶端寫入回應的連線數。

`Waiting`

The current number of idle client connections waiting for a request.

當前空閒客戶端連線數，正在等待請求。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_stub_status_module` module supports the following embedded variables (1.3.14):

`ngx_http_stub_status_module`模組支援以下嵌入式變數 ( 1.3.14 )：

`$connections_active`

same as the `Active connections` value;

與`Active connections`值相同；

`$connections_reading`

same as the `Reading` value;

與`Reading`值相同；

`$connections_writing`

same as the `Writing` value;

與`Writing`值相同；

`$connections_waiting`

same as the `Waiting` value.

與`Waiting`值相同。

<a id="p-101"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_sub_module｜模組 ngx_http_sub_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_sub_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_sub\_module｜模組 ngx_http_sub_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-101)<br>[Directives](#p-101)<br>     [sub\_filter](#p-101)<br>     [sub\_filter\_last\_modified](#p-101)<br>     [sub\_filter\_once](#p-101)<br>     [sub\_filter\_types](#p-101)<br>[範例設定](#p-101)<br>[指令](#p-101)<br>     [sub\_filter](#p-101)<br>     [sub\_filter\_最後\_修改](#p-101)<br>     [sub\_filter\_once](#p-101)<br>     [sub\_filter\_types](#p-101) |

The `ngx_http_sub_module` module is a filter that modifies a response by replacing one specified string by another.

`ngx_http_sub_module`模組是一個過濾器，它透過將一個指定的字串替換為另一個指定的字串來修改回應。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_sub_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_sub_module`配置參數啟用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     sub_filter '<a href="http://127.0.0.1:8080/'  '<a href="https://$host/';
>
>     子過濾器'<a href=" http://127.0.0.1:8080/' '<a href=" https://$host/';
>     sub_filter '<img src="http://127.0.0.1:8080/' '<img src="https://$host/';
>
>     子過濾器'<img src=" http://127.0.0.1:8080/' '<img src=" https://$host/';
>     sub_filter_once on;
>
>     子過濾器一次開啟；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**sub_filter** `*string*` `*replacement*`;``<br>` `**sub_filter** ` *字串* ` ` *替換* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Sets a string to replace and a replacement string. The string to replace is matched ignoring the case. The string to replace (1.9.4) and replacement string can contain variables. Several `sub_filter` directives can be specified on the same configuration level (1.9.4). These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `sub_filter` directives defined on the current level.

設定要替換的字串和替換字串。匹配要替換的字串時忽略大小寫。要替換的字串（ 1.9.4 ）和替換字串可以包含變數。可以在同一組態等級（ 1.9.4 ）上指定多個`sub_filter`指令。當且僅噹噹前等級未定義`sub_filter`指令時，這些指令才會從上一個配置等級繼承。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>sub_filter_last_modified</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>sub_filter_last_modified off;<br>子過濾器最後修改時間關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.1.

該指令出現在版本1.5.1 。

Allows preserving the “Last-Modified”（最後修改日期） header field from the original response during replacement to facilitate response caching.

允許在替換過程中保留原始回應中的“Last-Modified”（最後修改日期）標頭字段，以便於回應快取。

By default, the header field is removed as contents of the response are modified during processing.

預設情況下，由於回應內容在處理過程中會被修改，因此會刪除標頭欄位。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>sub_filter_once</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>sub_filter_once on;<br>啟用子過濾器；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether to look for each string to replace once or repeatedly.

指示每個要替換的字串是查找一次還是重複查找。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>sub_filter_types<br>子過濾器類型</strong> <code><i>mime-type<br>MIME 類型</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>sub_filter_types text/html;<br>篩選類型 text/html；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables string replacement in responses with the specified MIME types in addition to “`text/html`”. The special value “`*`” matches any MIME type (0.8.29).

除了「 `text/html` 」類型外，還允許對具有指定MIME類型的回應進行字串替換。特殊值“ `*` ”匹配任何MIME類型（ 0.8.29 ）。
