<a id="p-102"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_tunnel_module｜模組 ngx_http_tunnel_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_tunnel_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_tunnel\_module｜模組 ngx_http_tunnel_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-102)<br>[Directives](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_allow\_upstream](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_bind](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_bind\_dynamic](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_buffer\_size](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_connect\_timeout](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_next\_upstream](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_next\_upstream\_timeout](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_next\_upstream\_tries](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_pass](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_read\_timeout](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_send\_lowat](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_send\_timeout](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_socket\_keepalive](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_socket\_rcvbuf](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_socket\_sndbuf](#p-102)<br>[範例配置](#p-102)<br>[指示](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_allow\_upstream](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_bind](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_bind\_dynamic](#p-102)<br>     [隧道緩衝區大小](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel_connect_timeout](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_next\_upstream](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_next\_upstream\_timeout](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_next\_upstream\_trys](#p-102)<br>     [隧道通道](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel_read_timeout](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_send\_lowat](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel_send_timeout](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_socket\_keepalive](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_socket\_rcvbuf](#p-102)<br>     [tunnel\_socket\_sndbuf](#p-102) |

The `ngx_http_tunnel_module` (1.31.0) handles HTTP/1.1 [CONNECT](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110#section-9.3.6) requests and establishes an end-to-end virtual connection.

`ngx_http_tunnel_module` ( 1.31.0 ) 處理HTTP/1.1 [CONNECT](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110#section-9.3.6)請求並建立端對端虛擬連線。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> http {
> 
>     map $request_port $allow_port {
>
>     映射 $request_port $allow_port {
>         443            1;
>     }
> 
>     map $host $allow_host {
>
>     映射 $host $allow_host {
>         hostnames;
>
>         主機名；
> 
>         example.org    1;
>         *.example.org  1;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 8000;
>
>         聽 8000；
> 
>         resolver dns.example.com;
>
>         解析 dns.example.com；
> 
>         if ($allow_port != 1) {
>
>         如果 ($allow_port != 1) {
>             return 502;
>
>             返回 502；
>         }
> 
>         if ($allow_host != 1) {
>
>         如果 ($allow_host != 1) {
>             return 502;
>
>             返回 502；
>         }
> 
>         tunnel_pass;
>
>         隧道通行；
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**tunnel_allow_upstream** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**tunnel_allow_upstream** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines conditions under which access to the backend server is allowed or [denied](#p-102). If all string parameters are not empty and not equal to “0” then the access is allowed. The conditions are evaluated each time before a connection to a backend server is established. Parameter values can contain variables:

定義允許或拒絕存取後端伺服器的條件(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_tunnel_module.html#denied) 。如果所有字串參數均不為空且不等於“0”，則允許存取。每次建立與後端伺服器的連線之前都會評估這些條件。參數值可以包含變數：

> ```
> geo $upstream_last_addr $allow {
>     volatile;
>
>     易揮發的;
>     10.10.0.0/24        1;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>     聽127.0.0.1:8080 ;
> 
>     tunnel_pass;
>
>     隧道通行；
>     tunnel_allow_upstream $allow;
> }
> ```

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**tunnel_bind** `*address*` \| `off`;``<br>` `**tunnel_bind** ` *地址* ` \| `關閉`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Makes outgoing connections to a backend server originate from the specified local IP address with an optional port. Parameter value can contain variables. The special value `off` cancels the effect of the `tunnel_bind` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows the system to auto-assign the local IP address and port.

使發送到後端伺服器的出站連線源自指定的本機位址IP連接埠可選。參數值可以包含變數。特殊值`off`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`tunnel_bind`指令的效果，該指令允許系統自動分配本地位址IP和連接埠。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_bind_dynamic</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_bind_dynamic off;<br>tunnel_bind_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

When enabled, makes the [tunnel\_bind](#p-102) operation at each connection attempt:

啟用後，每次連線嘗試時都會執行 [tunnel\_bind](#p-102)操作：

> ```
> geo $upstream_last_addr $bind_addr {
>     volatile;
>
>     易揮發的;
>     10.0.0.0/24    10.0.0.1;
>     192.168.0.0/24  192.168.0.1;
> }
> 
> tunnel_bind         $bind_addr;
>
> tunnel_bind $bind_addr;
> tunnel_bind_dynamic on;
>
> tunnel_bind_dynamic 已啟用；
> ```

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_buffer_size 16k;<br>tunnel_buffer_size 16k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading data from the backend server. Also sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading data from the client.

設定用於從後端伺服器讀取資料的緩衝區的`*size*` 。同時設定用於從客戶端讀取資料的緩衝區的`*size*` 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_connect_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_connect_timeout 60s;<br>tunnel_connect_timeout 60s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for establishing a connection with a backend server. It should be noted that this timeout cannot usually exceed 75 seconds.

定義與後端伺服器建立連線的逾時時間。需要注意的是，此超時時間通常不能超過 75 秒。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_next_upstream</strong> <code>error<br>錯誤</code> | <code>timeout<br>暫停</code> | <code>denied<br>否認</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_next_upstream error timeout;<br>tunnel_next_upstream 錯誤逾時；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies in which cases a request should be passed to the next server:

指定在哪些情況下應將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器：

`error`

an error occurred while establishing a connection with the server or reading data from the server;

與伺服器建立連線或從伺服器讀取資料時發生錯誤；

`timeout`

a timeout has occurred while establishing a connection with the server, passing a request to it, or reading data from the server;

與伺服器建立連線、向伺服器發送請求或從伺服器讀取資料時發生逾時；

`denied`

the server [denied](#p-102) the connection;

伺服器[拒絕](#p-102)連線；

> This parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此參數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`off`

disables passing a request to the next server.

禁用向下一個伺服器傳遞請求。

One should bear in mind that passing a request to the next server is only possible if nothing has been sent to a client yet. That is, if an error or timeout occurs in the middle of the transferring of a response, fixing this is impossible.

需要注意的是，只有在尚未向客戶端發送任何資料的情況下，才能將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器。也就是說，如果在傳輸回應的過程中發生錯誤或逾時，則無法修復。

The directive also defines what is considered an [unsuccessful attempt](#p-105) of communication with a server. The cases of `error`, `timeout`, and `denied` are always considered unsuccessful attempts, even if they are not specified in the directive.

該指令也定義了與伺服器通訊的[失敗嘗試`denied` (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#max_fails)和`error`, `timeout`的情況始終被視為失敗嘗試，即使指令中未明確規定。

Passing a request to the next server can be limited by [the number of tries](#p-102) and by [time](#p-102).

向下一個伺服器傳遞請求可以受到[嘗試次數](#p-102)和[時間](#p-102)的限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_next_upstream_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_next_upstream_timeout 0;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Limits the time during which a request can be passed to the [next server](#p-102). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制請求傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-102)的時間。 `0`值關閉此限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_next_upstream_tries</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_next_upstream_tries 0;<br>tunnel_next_upstream_tries 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Limits the number of possible tries for passing a request to the [next server](#p-102). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制將請求傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-102)的可能嘗試次數。 `0`值關閉此限制。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**tunnel_pass** [`*address*`];``<br>` `**tunnel_pass** [` *地址* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server`, `location`, `if in location` |

Enables handling of CONNECT requests and sets the address of a backend server. By default, the `address` is `*$host:$request_port*` and is taken from the client request. In most cases, `tunnel_pass` does not require configuring any arguments.

啟用對CONNECT請求的處理，並設定後端伺服器的位址。預設情況下， `address`為`*$host:$request_port*` ，取自客戶端請求。大多數情況下， `tunnel_pass`不需要配置任何參數。

The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, and a port:

位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，以及連接埠：

> ```
> tunnel_pass localhost:9000;
> ```

or as a UNIX-domain socket path:

或作為UNIX域套接字路徑：

> ```
> tunnel_pass unix:/tmp/backend.socket;
> ```

If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be used in a round-robin fashion. In addition, an address can be specified as a [server group](#p-105).

如果一個網域解析到多個位址，則所有這些位址將以輪詢方式使用。此外，可以將位址指定為 [伺服器群組](#p-105) 。

Parameter value can contain variables. In this case, if an address is specified as a domain name, the name is searched among the described [server groups](#p-105), and, if not found, is determined using a [resolver](#p-056).

參數值可以包含變數。在這種情況下，如果將位址指定為域名，則會在所描述的 [伺服器群組](#p-105)中搜尋該名稱，如果找不到，則使用 [解析器](#p-056)進行確定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_read_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_read_timeout 60s;<br>tunnel_read_timeout 60s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the timeout between two successive read or write operations on client or backend server connections. If no data is transmitted within this time, the connection is closed.

設定客戶端或後端伺服器連線上兩次連續讀取或寫入操作之間的逾時時間。如果在此時間內沒有資料傳輸，則連線將關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_send_lowat</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_send_lowat 0;<br>tunnel_send_lowat 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

If the directive is set to a non-zero value, nginx will try to minimize the number of send operations on outgoing connections to a backend server by using either `NOTE_LOWAT` flag of the [kqueue](#p-030) method, or the `SO_SNDLOWAT` socket option, with the specified `*size*`.

如果指令設為非零值，nginx 將嘗試透過使用 [kqueue](#p-030)方法的`NOTE_LOWAT`標誌或`SO_SNDLOWAT`套接字選項，以及指定的`*size*`來最小化到後端伺服器的出站連接的發送操作次數。

This directive is ignored on Linux, Solaris, and Windows.

該指令在 Linux、Solaris 和 Windows 系統上會被忽略。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_send_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_send_timeout 60s;<br>tunnel_send_timeout 60s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a timeout for transmitting a request to the backend server. The timeout is set only between two successive write operations, not for the transmission of the whole request. If the backend server does not receive anything within this time, the connection is closed.

設定向後端伺服器發送請求的逾時時間。超時時間僅設定在兩次連續寫入操作之間，而非整個請求的傳輸時間。如果後端伺服器在此時間內未收到任何數據，則連線將關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>tunnel_socket_keepalive</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>tunnel_socket_keepalive off;<br>tunnel_socket_keepalive 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Configures the “TCP keepalive” behavior for outgoing connections to a backend server. By default, the operating system’s settings are in effect for the socket. If the directive is set to the value “`on`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` socket option is turned on for the socket.

配置與後端伺服器建立的出站連線的「 TCP keepalive」行為。預設情況下，套接字採用作業系統的設定。如果指令值設定為“ `on` ”，則會為套接字啟用`SO_KEEPALIVE`選項。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**tunnel_socket_rcvbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**tunnel_socket_rcvbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the receive buffer size (the `SO_RCVBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a backend server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `tunnel_socket_rcvbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定與後端伺服器建立出站連線的接收緩衝區大小（ `SO_RCVBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`tunnel_socket_rcvbuf`指令的效果，從而允許作業系統對套接字的設定生效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**tunnel_socket_sndbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**tunnel_socket_sndbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the send buffer size (the `SO_SNDBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a backend server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `tunnel_socket_sndbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定與後端伺服器建立出站連線的傳送緩衝區大小（ `SO_SNDBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`tunnel_socket_sndbuf`指令的效果，從而允許作業系統對套接字的設定生效。

<a id="p-103"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_upstream_conf_module｜模組 ngx_http_upstream_conf_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_conf_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_upstream\_conf\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_upstream\_conf\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-103)<br>[Directives](#p-103)<br>     [upstream\_conf](#p-103)<br>[範例設定](#p-103)<br> [指令](#p-103)<br> [上游設定](#p-103) |

The `ngx_http_upstream_conf_module` module allows configuring upstream server groups on-the-fly via a simple HTTP interface without the need of restarting nginx. The [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) server group must reside in the shared memory.

`ngx_http_upstream_conf_module`模組允許透過簡單的HTTP介面動態配置上游伺服器群組，而無需重新啟動 nginx。 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)伺服器群組必須駐留在共享記憶體中。

> This module was available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx) until 1.13.10. It was superseded by the [ngx\_http\_api\_module](#p-048) module in 1.13.3.
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供，直至1.13.10 。它在1.13.3中被[ngx\_http\_api\_module](#p-048)模組取代。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     zone upstream_backend 64k;
>
>     區域 upstream_backend 64k；
> 
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     location /upstream_conf {
>         upstream_conf;
>
>         上游配置；
>         allow 127.0.0.1;
>
>         允許127.0.0.1 ；
>         deny all;
>
>         全部否認；
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**upstream_conf**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location` |

Turns on the HTTP interface of upstream configuration in the surrounding location. Access to this location should be [limited](#p-056).

啟用周圍位置上游配置的HTTP介面。對該位置的存取應[受限](#p-056) 。

Configuration commands can be used to:

配置命令可用於：

-   view the group configuration;  
    查看組配置；
-   view, modify, or remove a server;  
    查看、修改或刪除伺服器；
-   add a new server.  
    新增伺服器。

> Since addresses in a group are not required to be unique, specific servers in a group are referenced by their IDs. IDs are assigned automatically and shown when adding a new server or viewing the group configuration.
>
> 由於群組內位址無需唯一，因此群組內的特定伺服器透過其 ID 進行引用。 ID 會自動分配，並在新增伺服器或查看群組配置時顯示。

A configuration command consists of parameters passed as request arguments, for example:

配置命令由作為請求參數傳遞的參數組成，例如：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?upstream=backend
> ```

The following parameters are supported:

支援以下參數：

`stream=`

Selects a [stream](#p-163) upstream server group. Without this parameter, selects an [http](#p-105) upstream server group.

選擇 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器群組。如果沒有此參數，則選擇 [http](#p-105)上游伺服器組。

`upstream=``*name*`

Selects a group to work with. This parameter is mandatory.

選擇要合作的群組。此參數為必填項。

`id=``*number*`

Selects a server for viewing, modifying, or removing.

選擇伺服器進行查看、修改或刪除。

`remove=`

Removes a server from the group.

從群組中移除伺服器。

`add=`

Adds a new server to the group.

在群組中新增一台新伺服器。

`backup=`

Required to add a backup server.

需要新增備份伺服器。

> Before version 1.7.2, `backup=` was also required to view, modify, or remove existing backup servers.
>
> 在版本1.7.2, `backup=`之前，還需要先查看、修改或刪除現有的備份伺服器。

`server=``*address*`

Same as the “`address`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server.

與 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器的「 `address` 」參數相同。

When adding a server, it is possible to specify it as a domain name. In this case, changes of the IP addresses that correspond to a domain name will be monitored and automatically applied to the upstream configuration without the need of restarting nginx (1.7.2). This requires the “`resolver`” directive in the [http](#p-056) or [stream](#p-142) block. See also the “`resolve`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server.

新增伺服器時，可以指定為網域名稱。在這種情況下，與網域對應的位址（ IP ）的變更將被監控，並自動套用到上游配置，無需重新啟動 nginx（ 1.7.2 ）。這需要在 [http]（ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#resolver) ）或 [stream](#p-142) ）程式碼區塊中使用「 `resolver` 」指令。另請參閱 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器的「 `resolve` 」參數。

`service=``*name*`

Same as the “`service`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server (1.9.13).

與 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器 ( 1.9.13 ) 的「 `service` 」參數相同。

`weight=``*number*`

Same as the “`weight`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server.

與 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器的「 `weight` 」參數相同。

`max_conns=``*number*`

Same as the “`max_conns`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server.

與 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器的「 `max_conns` 」參數相同。

`max_fails=``*number*`

Same as the “`max_fails`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server.

與 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器的「 `max_fails` 」參數相同。

`fail_timeout=``*time*`

Same as the “`fail_timeout`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server.

與 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器的「 `fail_timeout` 」參數相同。

`slow_start=``*time*`

Same as the “`slow_start`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server.

與上游伺服器的 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)的「 `slow_start` 」參數相同。

`down=`

Same as the “`down`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server.

與 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器的「 `down` 」參數相同。

`drain=`

Puts the [http](#p-105) upstream server into the “draining” mode (1.7.5). In this mode, only requests [bound](#p-105) to the server will be proxied to it.

將(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html)伺服器置於「排空」模式（ 1.7.5 ）。在此模式下，只有發送到該伺服器(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#sticky)請求才會被代理到該伺服器。

`up=`

The opposite of the “`down`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) upstream server.

與 [http](#p-105)或 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器的「 `down` 」參數相反。

`route=``*string*`

Same as the “`route`” parameter of the [http](#p-105) upstream server.

與 [http](#p-105)上游伺服器的「 `route` 」參數相同。

The first three parameters select an object. This can be either the whole http or stream upstream server group, or a specific server. Without other parameters, the configuration of the selected group or server is shown.

前三個參數用於選擇一個物件。這可以是整個 HTTP 或串流上游伺服器群組，也可以是特定的伺服器。如果沒有其他參數，則會顯示所選群組或伺服器的配置。

For example, to view the configuration of the whole group, send:

例如，要查看整個群組的配置，請傳送：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?upstream=backend
> ```

To view the configuration of a specific server, also specify its ID:

若要查看特定伺服器的配置，請同時指定其ID ：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?upstream=backend&id=42
> ```

To add a new server, specify its address in the “`server=`” parameter. Without other parameters specified, a server will be added with other parameters set to their default values (see the [http](#p-105) or [stream](#p-163) “`server`” directive).

若要新增伺服器，請在「 `server=` 」參數中指定其位址。如果沒有指定其他參數，則新增伺服器時，其他參數將設定為其預設值（請參閱[http](#p-105)或[stream](#p-163) “ `server` ”指令）。

For example, to add a new primary server, send:

例如，要新增的主伺服器，請傳送：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?add=&upstream=backend&server=127.0.0.1:8080
> ```

To add a new backup server, send:

若要新增新的備份伺服器，請傳送：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?add=&upstream=backend&backup=&server=127.0.0.1:8080
> ```

To add a new primary server, set its parameters to non-default values and mark it as “`down`”, send:

若要新增的主伺服器，請將其參數設為非預設值並將其標記為“ `down` ”，然後傳送：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?add=&upstream=backend&server=127.0.0.1:8080&weight=2&down=
> ```

To remove a server, specify its ID:

若要刪除伺服器，請指定其ID :

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?remove=&upstream=backend&id=42
> ```

To mark an existing server as “`down`”, send:

若要將現有伺服器標記為“ `down` ”，請傳送：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?upstream=backend&id=42&down=
> ```

To modify the address of an existing server, send:

若要修改現有伺服器的位址，請傳送：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?upstream=backend&id=42&server=192.0.2.3:8123
> ```

To modify other parameters of an existing server, send:

若要修改現有伺服器的其他參數，請傳送：

> ```
> http://127.0.0.1/upstream_conf?upstream=backend&id=42&max_fails=3&weight=4
> ```

The above examples are for an [http](#p-105) upstream server group. Similar examples for a [stream](#p-163) upstream server group require the “`stream=`” parameter.

以上範例適用於 [http](#p-105)上游伺服器群組。類似的 [stream](#p-163)上游伺服器群組範例需要「 `stream=` 」參數。

---

<a id="p-104"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_upstream_hc_module｜模組 ngx_http_upstream_hc_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_hc_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_upstream\_hc\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_upstream\_hc\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-104)<br>[Directives](#p-104)<br>     [health\_check](#p-104)<br>     [match](#p-104)<br>[範例設定](#p-104)<br> [指令](#p-104)<br> [健康檢查](#p-104)<br> [符合](#p-104) |

The `ngx_http_upstream_hc_module` module allows enabling periodic health checks of the servers in a [group](#p-105) referenced in the surrounding location. The server group must reside in the [shared memory](#p-105).

`ngx_http_upstream_hc_module`模組允許對周圍位置引用的 [群組](#p-105)中的伺服器進行定期健康檢查。伺服器群組必須位於 [共享記憶體](#p-105)中。

If a health check fails, the server will be considered unhealthy. If several health checks are defined for the same group of servers, a single failure of any check will make the corresponding server be considered unhealthy. Client requests are not passed to unhealthy servers and servers in the “checking” state.

如果健康檢查失敗，伺服器將被視為不健康。如果為同一組伺服器定義了多個健康檢查，則任何一個檢查失敗都會導致相應的伺服器被視為不健康。客戶端請求不會傳遞給不健康的伺服器和處於「檢查中」狀態的伺服器。

> Please note that most of the variables will have empty values when used with health checks.
>
> 請注意，在進行健康檢查時，大多數變數的值將為空。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> upstream dynamic {
>
> 上游動態
>     zone upstream_dynamic 64k;
>
>     區域 upstream_dynamic 64k；
> 
>     server backend1.example.com      weight=5;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com 權重=5；
>     server backend2.example.com:8080 fail_timeout=5s slow_start=30s;
>
>     伺服器 backend2.example.com:8080 fail_timeout=5s slow_start=30s;
>     server 192.0.2.1                 max_fails=3;
>
>     伺服器192.0.2.1 max_fails=3;
> 
>     server backup1.example.com:8080  backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup1.example.com:8080 備份;
>     server backup2.example.com:8080  backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup2.example.com:8080 備份;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         proxy_pass http://dynamic;
>         health_check;
>
>         健康檢查；
>     }
> }
> ```

With this configuration, nginx will send “`/`” requests to each server in the `backend` group every five seconds. If any communication error or timeout occurs, or a proxied server responds with the status code other than 2xx or 3xx, the health check will fail, and the server will be considered unhealthy.

在此配置下，nginx 將每五秒向`backend`群組中的每個伺服器發送「 `/` 」請求。如果發生任何通訊錯誤或逾時，或代理伺服器傳回的狀態碼不是 2xx 或 3xx，則健康檢查將失敗，伺服器將被視為不健康。

Health checks can be configured to test the status code of a response, presence of certain header fields and their values, and the body contents. Tests are configured separately using the [match](#p-104) directive and referenced in the `match` parameter of the [health\_check](#p-104) directive:

健康檢查可以配置為測試回應的狀態碼、特定標頭欄位及其值的存在情況以及響應體的內容。測試使用 [match](#p-104)指令單獨配置，並在 [health\_check](#p-104)指令的`match`參數中引用：

> ```
> http {
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>     ...
>         location / {
>
>         地點 / {
>             proxy_pass http://backend;
>             health_check match=welcome;
>
>             健康檢查匹配=歡迎；
>         }
>     }
> 
>     match welcome {
>
>     比賽歡迎{
>         status 200;
>
>         狀態 200；
>         header Content-Type = text/html;
>         body ~ "Welcome to nginx!";
>
>         正文 ~ "歡迎使用 nginx！";
>     }
> }
> ```

This configuration shows that in order for a health check to pass, the response to a health check request should succeed, have status 200, and contain “`Welcome to nginx!`” in the body.

此配置表明，為了使健康檢查通過，對健康檢查請求的回應應成功，狀態為 200，並且正文中包含「 `Welcome to nginx!` 」。

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**health_check** [`*parameters*`];``<br>` `**health_check** [` *參數* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location` |

Enables periodic health checks of the servers in a [group](#p-105) referenced in the surrounding location.

啟用對周圍位置引用的 [群組](#p-105)中的伺服器進行定期健康檢查。

The following optional parameters are supported:

支援以下可選參數：

`interval`\=`*time*`

sets the interval between two consecutive health checks, by default, 5 seconds.

設定兩次連續健康檢查之間的間隔，預設值為 5 秒。

`jitter`\=`*time*`

sets the time within which each health check will be randomly delayed, by default, there is no delay.

設定每次健康檢查隨機延遲的時間範圍，預設沒有延遲。

`fails`\=`*number*`

sets the number of consecutive failed health checks of a particular server after which this server will be considered unhealthy, by default, 1.

設定特定伺服器連續健康檢查失敗的次數，超過該次數後，該伺服器將被視為不健康，預設值為 1。

`passes`\=`*number*`

sets the number of consecutive passed health checks of a particular server after which the server will be considered healthy, by default, 1.

設定特定伺服器連續通過健康檢查的次數，超過該次數後，伺服器將被視為健康，預設值為 1。

`uri`\=`*uri*`

defines the URI used in health check requests, by default, “`/`”.

定義健康檢查請求中使用的URI ，預設為「 `/` 」。

`mandatory` \[`persistent`\]

sets the initial “checking” state for a server until the first health check is completed (1.11.7). Client requests are not passed to servers in the “checking” state. If the parameter is not specified, the server will be initially considered healthy.

設定伺服器的初始「檢查」狀態，直到首次健康檢查完成（ 1.11.7 ）。客戶端請求不會傳遞給處於「檢查」狀態的伺服器。如果未指定此參數，則伺服器初始狀態將被視為健康。

The `persistent` parameter (1.19.7) sets the initial “up” state for a server after reload if the server was considered healthy before reload.

`persistent`參數 ( 1.19.7 ) 設定伺服器在重新載入後的初始「運行」狀態（如果伺服器在重新載入之前被認為是健康的）。

`match`\=`*name*`

specifies the `match` block configuring the tests that a response should pass in order for a health check to pass. By default, the response should have status code 2xx or 3xx.

`match`程式碼區塊用於配置回應必須通過的測試，才能通過健康檢查。預設情況下，回應的狀態碼應為 2xx 或 3xx。

`port`\=`*number*`

defines the port used when connecting to a server to perform a health check (1.9.7). By default, equals the [server](#p-105) port.

定義連接到伺服器執行健康檢查時使用的連接埠（ 1.9.7 ）。預設情況下，等於 [伺服器](#p-105)連接埠。

`type`\=`grpc` \[`grpc_service`\=`*name*`\] \[`grpc_status`\=`*code*`\]

enables periodic [health checks](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/health-checking.md#grpc-health-checking-protocol) of a gRPC server or a particular gRPC service specified with the optional `grpc_service` parameter (1.19.5). If the server does not support the gRPC Health Checking Protocol, the optional `grpc_status` parameter can be used to specify non-zero gRPC [status](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/statuscodes.md#status-codes-and-their-use-in-grpc) (for example, status code “`12`” / “`UNIMPLEMENTED`”) that will be treated as healthy:

啟用對 gRPC 伺服器或使用可選參數`grpc_service` ( 1.19.5 ) 指定的特定 gRPC 服務的定期健康檢查(https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/health-checking.md#grpc-health-checking-protocol) 。如果伺服器不支援 gRPC 健康檢查協議，則可以使用可選參數`grpc_status`指定非零 gRPC 狀態(https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/statuscodes.md#status-codes-and-their-use-in-grpc) （例如，狀態碼“ `12` ” / “ `UNIMPLEMENTED` ”），這些狀態將被視為健康狀態：

> ```
> health_check mandatory type=grpc grpc_status=12;
> ```

The `type`\=`grpc` parameter must be specified after all other directive parameters, `grpc_service` and `grpc_status` must follow `type`\=`grpc`. The parameter is not compatible with [`uri`](#p-104) or [`match`](#p-104) parameters.

`type` \= `grpc`參數必須在所有其他指令參數之後指定， `grpc_service`和`grpc_status`必須位於`type` \= `grpc`之後。此參數與 [`uri`](#p-104)或 [`match`](#p-104)參數不相容。

`keepalive_time`\=`*time*`

enables [keepalive](#p-105) connections for health checks and specifies the time during which requests can be processed through one keepalive connection (1.21.7). By default keepalive connections are disabled.

啟用用於健康檢查的 [keepalive](#p-105)連接，並指定可透過單一 keepalive 連接 ( 1.21.7 ) 處理請求的時間。預設情況下，keepalive 連線處於停用狀態。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**match** `*name*` { ... }``<br>` `**match** ` *名稱* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Defines the named test set used to verify responses to health check requests.

定義用於驗證對健康檢查請求的回應的命名測試集。

The following items can be tested in a response:

以下內容可以在答題中測試：

`status 200;`

status is 200

狀態為 200

`status ! 500;`

status is not 500

狀態不是 500

`status 200 204;`

status is 200 or 204

狀態為 200 或 204

`status ! 301 302;`

status is neither 301 nor 302

狀態既不是 301 也不是 302

`status 200-399;`

status is in the range from 200 to 399

狀態值範圍為 200 至 399

`status ! 400-599;`

status is not in the range from 400 to 599

狀態不在 400 到 599 的範圍內

`status 301-303 307;`

status is either 301, 302, 303, or 307

狀態碼為 301、302、303 或 307。

`header Content-Type = text/html;`

header contains “Content-Type”（內容類型） with value `text/html`

標頭包含“Content-Type”（內容類型） ，值為`text/html`

`header Content-Type != text/html;`

header contains “Content-Type”（內容類型） with value other than `text/html`

標頭包含“Content-Type”（內容類型）但其值不等於`text/html`

`header Connection ~ close;`

header contains “Connection”（聯繫） with value matching regular expression `close`

標頭包含“Connection”（聯繫） ，其值與正規表示式`close`匹配

`header Connection !~ close;`

header contains “Connection”（聯繫） with value not matching regular expression `close`

標頭包含“Connection”（聯繫）但其值與正規表示式`close`不符。

`header Host;`

header contains “Host”（主持人）

標題包含“Host”（主持人）

`header ! X-Accel-Redirect;`

header lacks “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）

標題缺“X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）

`body ~ "Welcome to nginx!";`

body matches regular expression “`Welcome to nginx!`”

body 符合正規表示式“ `Welcome to nginx!` ”

`body !~ "Welcome to nginx!";`

body does not match regular expression “`Welcome to nginx!`”

正文與正規表示式「 `Welcome to nginx!` 」不符

`require` `*$variable*` `...;`

all specified variables are not empty and not equal to “0” (1.15.9).

所有指定的變數均不為空且不等於「0」（ 1.15.9 ）。

If several tests are specified, the response matches only if it matches all tests.

如果指定了多個測試，則只有當回應與所有測試都相符時，回應才會相符。

> Only the first 256k of the response body are examined.
>
> 僅檢查回應正文的前 256k。

Examples:

範例：

> ```
> # status is 200, content type is "text/html",｜狀態碼為 200，內容類型為“text/html”，
> # and body contains "Welcome to nginx!"｜正文包含“歡迎使用 nginx！”
> match welcome {
>
> 比賽歡迎{
>     status 200;
>
>     狀態 200；
>     header Content-Type = text/html;
>     body ~ "Welcome to nginx!";
>
>     正文 ~ "歡迎使用 nginx！";
> }
> ```

> ```
> # status is not one of 301, 302, 303, or 307, and header does not have "Refresh:"｜狀態碼不是 301、302、303 或 307，且請求頭中不包含「Refresh:」字樣。
> match not_redirect {
>
> 匹配 not_redirect {
>     status ! 301-303 307;
>
>     狀態！ 301-303 307；
>     header ! Refresh;
>
>     標題！重新整理;
> }
> ```

> ```
> # status ok and not in maintenance mode｜狀態正常，未處於維護模式
> match server_ok {
>
> 匹配 server_ok {
>     status 200-399;
>
>     狀態 200-399；
>     body !~ "maintenance mode";
>
>     身體！ ~「維護模式」；
> }
> ```

> ```
> # status is 200 or 204｜狀態為 200 或 204
> map $upstream_status $good_status {
>
> 映射 $upstream_status $good_status {
>     200 1;
>     204 1;
> }
> 
> match server_ok {
>
> 匹配 server_ok {
>     require $good_status;
>
>     需要 $good_status；
> }
> ```

---

<a id="p-105"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_upstream_module｜模組 ngx_http_upstream_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_upstream\_module｜模組 ngx_http_upstream_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-105)<br>[Directives](#p-105)<br>     [upstream](#p-105)<br>     [server](#p-105)<br>     [zone](#p-105)<br>     [state](#p-105)<br>     [hash](#p-105)<br>     [ip\_hash](#p-105)<br>     [keepalive](#p-105)<br>     [keepalive\_requests](#p-105)<br>     [keepalive\_time](#p-105)<br>     [keepalive\_timeout](#p-105)<br>     [ntlm](#p-105)<br>     [least\_conn](#p-105)<br>     [least\_time](#p-105)<br>     [queue](#p-105)<br>     [random](#p-105)<br>     [resolver](#p-105)<br>     [resolver\_timeout](#p-105)<br>     [sticky](#p-105)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-105)<br>[範例設定](#p-105)<br> [指令](#p-105)<br> [上游](#p-105)<br> [ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#state)<br> (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#zone)<br>區](#p-105)<br> [ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#server)<br> ](#p-105)<br> [保持連接](#p-105)<br> [保持連接請求](#p-105)<br> [保持連接時間](#p-105)<br> (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#keepalive_time)<br>保持連接超時](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#ntlm)<br> [NTLM (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#least_time)<br> (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#least_conn)<br> [最小連接數] 隊列1469 (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#queue)<br> [隨機](#p-105)<br> [解析器](#p-105)<br> [解析器逾時](#p-105)<br> [黏滯](#p-105)<br> [嵌入式變數](#p-105) |

The `ngx_http_upstream_module` module is used to define groups of servers that can be referenced by the [proxy\_pass](#p-085), [fastcgi\_pass](#p-060), [uwsgi\_pass](#p-107), [scgi\_pass](#p-091), [memcached\_pass](#p-079), and [grpc\_pass](#p-064) directives.

`ngx_http_upstream_module`模組用來定義伺服器群組，這些伺服器群組可以被 [proxy\_pass](#p-085) 、 [fastcgi\_pass](#p-060) 、 [uwsgi\_pass](#p-091) 、 [scgi_pass](#p-107) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_memcached_module.html#memcached_pass)和 [grpc\_pass](#p-064)指令引用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     server backend1.example.com       weight=5;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com 權重=5；
>     server backend2.example.com:8080;
>
>     伺服器 backend2.example.com:8080;
>     server unix:/tmp/backend3;
>
>     伺服器 unix:/tmp/backend3;
> 
>     server backup1.example.com:8080   backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup1.example.com:8080 備份;
>     server backup2.example.com:8080   backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup2.example.com:8080 備份;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         proxy_pass http://backend;
>     }
> }
> ```

Dynamically configurable group with periodic [health checks](#p-104) is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx):

動態可配置群組，並定期進行[健康檢查](#p-104) ，作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供：

> ```
> resolver 10.0.0.1;
>
> 解析器10.0.0.1 ;
> 
> upstream dynamic {
>
> 上游動態
>     zone upstream_dynamic 64k;
>
>     區域 upstream_dynamic 64k；
> 
>     server backend1.example.com      weight=5;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com 權重=5；
>     server backend2.example.com:8080 fail_timeout=5s slow_start=30s;
>
>     伺服器 backend2.example.com:8080 fail_timeout=5s slow_start=30s;
>     server 192.0.2.1                 max_fails=3;
>
>     伺服器192.0.2.1 max_fails=3;
>     server backend3.example.com      resolve;
>
>     伺服器 backend3.example.com 解析；
>     server backend4.example.com      service=http resolve;
>
>     伺服器 backend4.example.com 服務=http 解析；
> 
>     server backup1.example.com:8080  backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup1.example.com:8080 備份;
>     server backup2.example.com:8080  backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup2.example.com:8080 備份;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         proxy_pass http://dynamic;
>         health_check;
>
>         健康檢查；
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**upstream** `*name*` { ... }``<br>` `**upstream** ` *名稱* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Defines a group of servers. Servers can listen on different ports. In addition, servers listening on TCP and UNIX-domain sockets can be mixed.

定義一組伺服器。伺服器可以監聽不同的連接埠。此外，監聽TCP和UNIX域套接字的伺服器可以混合使用。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     server backend1.example.com weight=5;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com 權重=5；
>     server 127.0.0.1:8080       max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
>
>     伺服器127.0.0.1:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
>     server unix:/tmp/backend3;
>
>     伺服器 unix:/tmp/backend3;
> 
>     server backup1.example.com  backup;
>
>     伺服器備份1.example.com；
> }
> ```

By default, requests are distributed between the servers using a weighted round-robin balancing method. In the above example, each 7 requests will be distributed as follows: 5 requests go to `backend1.example.com` and one request to each of the second and third servers. If an error occurs during communication with a server, the request will be passed to the next server, and so on until all of the functioning servers will be tried. If a successful response could not be obtained from any of the servers, the client will receive the result of the communication with the last server.

預設情況下，請求會使用加權輪詢負載平衡方法在伺服器之間分配。在上面的範例中，7 個請求將按以下方式分配：5 個請求發送到`backend1.example.com` ，其餘 1 個請求分別發送到第二台和第三台伺服器。如果在與伺服器通訊過程中發生錯誤，則請求將傳遞給下一台伺服器，依此類推，直到嘗試所有可用的伺服器為止。如果無法從任何伺服器獲得成功回應，客戶端將收到與最後一台伺服器通訊的結果。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**server** `*address*` [`*parameters*`];``<br>` `**server** ` *地址* ` [` *參數* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

Defines the `*address*` and other `*parameters*` of a server. The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, with an optional port, or as a UNIX-domain socket path specified after the “`unix:`” prefix. If a port is not specified, the port 80 is used. A domain name that resolves to several IP addresses defines multiple servers at once.

定義伺服器的`*address*`及其他`*parameters*`位址。位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址（選用連接埠），也可以指定為UNIX網域套接字路徑（位於「 `unix:` 」前綴之後）。如果未指定端口，則使用端口80。解析到多個IP位址的網域名稱可以同時定義多個伺服器。

The following parameters can be defined:

可以定義以下參數：

`weight`\=`*number*`

sets the weight of the server, by default, 1.

設定伺服器權重，預設值為 1。

`max_conns`\=`*number*`

limits the maximum `*number*` of simultaneous active connections to the proxied server (1.11.5). Default value is zero, meaning there is no limit. If the server group does not reside in the [shared memory](#p-105), the limitation works per each worker process.

限制與代理伺服器 ( 1.11.5 ) 的並發活動連線數的最大值`*number*` 。預設值為零，表示沒有限制。如果伺服器群組不在共享記憶體 ( (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#zone) ) 中，則此限制針對每個工作進程生效。

> If [idle keepalive](#p-105) connections, multiple [workers](#p-125), and the [shared memory](#p-105) are enabled, the total number of active and idle connections to the proxied server may exceed the `max_conns` value.
>
> 如果啟用了 [空閒保持連接](#p-105)連接、多個 [工作進程](#p-125)和 [共享內存](#p-105) ，則代理伺服器的活動連接和空閒連接總數可能超過`max_conns`值。

> Since version 1.5.9 and prior to version 1.11.5, this parameter was available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 從版本1.5.9到版本1.11.5 ，此參數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`max_fails`\=`*number*`

sets the number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server that should happen in the duration set by the `fail_timeout` parameter to consider the server unavailable for a duration also set by the `fail_timeout` parameter. By default, the number of unsuccessful attempts is set to 1. The zero value disables the accounting of attempts. What is considered an unsuccessful attempt is defined by the [proxy\_next\_upstream](#p-085), [fastcgi\_next\_upstream](#p-060), [uwsgi\_next\_upstream](#p-107), [scgi\_next\_upstream](#p-091), [memcached\_next\_upstream](#p-079), and [grpc\_next\_upstream](#p-064) directives.

此設定用於指定在`fail_timeout`參數設定的時間段內，與伺服器通訊失敗的次數，超過此次數則視為伺服器在`fail_timeout`參數設定的時間段內不可用。預設情況下，失敗次數為 1。值為零則禁用失敗次數統計。失敗的嘗試由 [proxy\_next\_upstream](#p-085) 、 [fastcgi\_next\_upstream](#p-060) 、 [uwsgi\_next\_upstream](#p-107) 、 [uwsgi\_next\_upstream](#p-091) , [scgi_n; [memcached\_next\_upstream](#p-079)與 [grpc\_next\_upstream](#p-064)指令定義。

`fail_timeout`\=`*time*`

sets

套

-   the time during which the specified number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server should happen to consider the server unavailable;  
    在指定時間內，與伺服器通訊失敗次數達到指定值後，伺服器將被視為不可用；
-   and the period of time the server will be considered unavailable.  
    以及伺服器將被視為不可用的時間段。

By default, the parameter is set to 10 seconds.

預設情況下，此參數設定為 10 秒。

`backup`

marks the server as a backup server. It will be passed requests when the primary servers are unavailable.

將伺服器標記為備用伺服器。當主伺服器不可用時，請求將轉送給該伺服器。

> The parameter cannot be used along with the [hash](#p-105), [ip\_hash](#p-105), and [random](#p-105) load balancing methods.
>
> 此參數不能與 [hash](#p-105) 、[ip\_hash](#p-105)和 [random](#p-105)負載平衡方法一起使用。

`down`

marks the server as permanently unavailable.

將伺服器標記為永久不可用。

`resolve`

monitors changes of the IP addresses that correspond to a domain name of the server, and automatically modifies the upstream configuration without the need of restarting nginx (1.5.12). The server group must reside in the [shared memory](#p-105).

監控與伺服器網域名稱對應的IP位址的變化，並自動修改上游配置，無需重新啟動nginx（ 1.5.12 ）。伺服器群組必須位於[共享記憶體](#p-105)中。

In order for this parameter to work, the `resolver` directive must be specified in the [http](#p-056) block or in the corresponding [upstream](#p-105) block.

為了使此參數生效，必須在 [http](#p-056)區塊或對應的 [upstream](#p-105)區塊中指定`resolver`指令。

> Prior to version 1.27.3, this parameter was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.27.3之前，此參數僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`service`\=`*name*`

enables resolving of DNS [SRV](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2782) records and sets the service `*name*` (1.9.13). In order for this parameter to work, it is necessary to specify the [resolve](#p-105) parameter for the server and specify a hostname without a port number.

啟用對DNS [SRV](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2782)記錄的解析，並設定服務`*name*` ( 1.9.13 )。為了使此參數生效，必須為伺服器指定 [resolve](#p-105)參數，並指定不含連接埠號碼的主機名稱。

If the service name does not contain a dot (“`.`”), then the [RFC](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2782)\-compliant name is constructed and the TCP protocol is added to the service prefix. For example, to look up the `_http._tcp.backend.example.com` SRV record, it is necessary to specify the directive:

如果服務名稱不包含點號（「 `.` 」），則建構符合 [RFC](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2782)標準的名稱，並將TCP協定新增至服務前綴。例如，要尋找`_http._tcp.backend.example.com` SRV記錄，需要指定以下指令：

> ```
> server backend.example.com service=http resolve;
>
> 伺服器 backend.example.com 服務=http 解析；
> ```

If the service name contains one or more dots, then the name is constructed by joining the service prefix and the server name. For example, to look up the `_http._tcp.backend.example.com` and `server1.backend.example.com` SRV records, it is necessary to specify the directives:

如果服務名稱包含一個或多個點，則名稱由服務前綴和伺服器名稱連接而成。例如，要找`_http._tcp.backend.example.com`和`server1.backend.example.com` SRV記錄，需要指定以下指令：

> ```
> server backend.example.com service=_http._tcp resolve;
> server example.com service=server1.backend resolve;
>
> 伺服器 example.com 服務=server1.backend 解析；
> ```

Highest-priority SRV records (records with the same lowest-number priority value) are resolved as primary servers, the rest of SRV records are resolved as backup servers. If the [backup](#p-105) parameter is specified for the server, high-priority SRV records are resolved as backup servers, the rest of SRV records are ignored.

優先權最高的SRV記錄（優先權值最低的記錄）被解析為主伺服器，其餘的SRV記錄被解析為備份伺服器。如果為伺服器指定了[backup](#p-105)參數，則優先順序最高的SRV記錄被解析為備份伺服器，其餘的SRV記錄將被忽略。

> Prior to version 1.27.3, this parameter was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.27.3之前，此參數僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`route`\=`*string*`

sets the server route name.

設定伺服器路由名稱。

> Prior to version 1.29.6, this parameter was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.29.6之前，此參數僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`drain`

puts the server into the “draining” mode (1.13.6). In this mode, only requests [bound](#p-105) to the server will be proxied to it.

將伺服器置於「清空」模式（ 1.13.6 ）。在此模式下，只有綁定到伺服器的請求（ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#sticky) ）才會被代理到該伺服器。

> Prior to version 1.13.6, the parameter could be changed only with the [API](#p-048) module.
>
> 在版本1.13.6之前，此參數只能透過 [API](#p-048)模組進行變更。

> Prior to version 1.29.6, the parameter was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.29.6之前，此參數僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

Additionally, the following parameters are available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx):

此外，以下參數包含在我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)中：

`slow_start`\=`*time*`

sets the `*time*` during which the server will recover its weight from zero to a nominal value, when unhealthy server becomes [healthy](#p-104), or when the server becomes available after a period of time it was considered [unavailable](#p-105). Default value is zero, i.e. slow start is disabled.

設定`*time*`在此期間，伺服器的權重將從零恢復到標稱值，當不健康的伺服器變為 [健康](#p-104)時，或當伺服器在被視為 [不可用 一段時間後恢復可用時](#p-105) 。預設值為零，即禁用慢啟動。

> The parameter cannot be used along with the [hash](#p-105), [ip\_hash](#p-105), and [random](#p-105) load balancing methods.
>
> 此參數不能與 [hash](#p-105) 、[ip\_hash](#p-105)和 [random](#p-105)負載平衡方法一起使用。

> If there is only a single server in a group, `max_fails`, `fail_timeout` and `slow_start` parameters are ignored, and such a server will never be considered unavailable.
>
> 如果一個群組中只有一個伺服器，則忽略`max_fails`, `fail_timeout`和`slow_start`參數，並且這樣的伺服器永遠不會被視為不可用。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**zone** `*name*` [`*size*`];``<br>` `**zone** ` *名稱* ` [` *大小* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.9.0.

該指令出現在版本1.9.0中。

Defines the `*name*` and `*size*` of the shared memory zone that keeps the group’s configuration and run-time state that are shared between worker processes. Several groups may share the same zone. In this case, it is enough to specify the `*size*` only once.

定義共享記憶體區域的`*name*`和`*size*` ，該區域用於保存工作進程間共享的群組配置和運行時狀態。多個群組可以共享同一個區域。在這種情況下，只需指定一次`*size*`即可。

Additionally, as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx), such groups allow changing the group membership or modifying the settings of a particular server without the need of restarting nginx. The configuration is accessible via the [API](#p-048) module (1.13.3).

此外，作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，此類群組允許更改群組成員或修改特定伺服器的設置，而無需重啟nginx。可透過[API](#p-048)模組( 1.13.3 )存取配置。

> Prior to version 1.13.3, the configuration was accessible only via a special location handled by [upstream\_conf](#p-103).
>
> 在版本1.13.3之前，配置只能透過 [upstream\_conf](#p-103)處理的特殊位置存取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**state** `*file*`;``<br>` `**state** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.9.7.

該指令出現在版本1.9.7 。

Specifies a `*file*` that keeps the state of the dynamically configurable group.

指定一個`*file*` ，用於保持動態可設定群組的狀態。

Examples:

範例：

> ```
> state /var/lib/nginx/state/servers.conf; # path for Linux
>
> 狀態 /var/lib/nginx/state/servers.conf;# Linux 路徑
> state /var/db/nginx/state/servers.conf;  # path for FreeBSD
>
> 狀態 /var/db/nginx/state/servers.conf;# FreeBSD 的路徑
> ```

The state is currently limited to the list of servers with their parameters. The file is read when parsing the configuration and is updated each time the upstream configuration is [changed](#p-048). Changing the file content directly should be avoided. The directive cannot be used along with the [server](#p-105) directive.

目前狀態僅限於伺服器清單及其參數。解析配置時會讀取該文件，並且每次上游配置發生更改時都會更新該文件（ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_api_module.html#http_upstreams_http_upstream_name_servers_) ）。應避免直接更改文件內容。該指令不能與 [server](#p-105)指令同時使用。

> Changes made during [configuration reload](#p-026) or [binary upgrade](#p-026) can be lost.
>
> 在 [組態重新載入](#p-026)或 [二進位升級](#p-026)期間所做的變更可能會遺失。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**hash** `*key*` [`consistent`];``<br>` `**hash** ` *鍵* ` [`一致`];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.2.

該指令出現在版本1.7.2 。

Specifies a load balancing method for a server group where the client-server mapping is based on the hashed `*key*` value. The `*key*` can contain text, variables, and their combinations. Note that adding or removing a server from the group may result in remapping most of the keys to different servers. The method is compatible with the [Cache::Memcached](https://metacpan.org/pod/Cache::Memcached) Perl library.

指定伺服器群組的負載平衡方法`*key*`其中客戶端-伺服器映射基於哈希值`*key*`可以包含文字、變數及其組合。請注意，向群組中新增或刪除伺服器可能會導致大多數鍵重新對應到不同的伺服器。此方法與 [Cache::Memcached](https://metacpan.org/pod/Cache::Memcached) Perl 函式庫相容。

If the `consistent` parameter is specified, the [ketama](https://www.metabrew.com/article/libketama-consistent-hashing-algo-memcached-clients) consistent hashing method will be used instead. The method ensures that only a few keys will be remapped to different servers when a server is added to or removed from the group. This helps to achieve a higher cache hit ratio for caching servers. The method is compatible with the [Cache::Memcached::Fast](https://metacpan.org/pod/Cache::Memcached::Fast) Perl library with the `*ketama_points*` parameter set to 160.

如果指定了`consistent`參數，則會使用 [ketama](https://www.metabrew.com/article/libketama-consistent-hashing-algo-memcached-clients)一致性雜湊方法。此方法確保在向群組中新增或從群組中移除伺服器時，只有少數鍵會重新對應到不同的伺服器。這有助於提高快取伺服器的快取命中率。此方法與 [Cache::Memcached::Fast](https://metacpan.org/pod/Cache::Memcached::Fast) Perl 函式庫相容，前提是`*ketama_points*`參數設定為 160。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**ip_hash**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

Specifies that a group should use a load balancing method where requests are distributed between servers based on client IP addresses. The first three octets of the client IPv4 address, or the entire IPv6 address, are used as a hashing key. The method ensures that requests from the same client will always be passed to the same server except when this server is unavailable. In the latter case client requests will be passed to another server. Most probably, it will always be the same server as well.

指定群組應使用負載平衡方法，根據客戶端的IP位址將請求分配到不同的伺服器。客戶端 IPv4 位址的前三個位元組或整個 IPv6 位址用作雜湊鍵。此方法可確保來自相同客戶端的請求始終轉送到同一台伺服器，除非該伺服器無法使用。在伺服器不可用的情況下，客戶端請求將被轉送到另一台伺服器。通常情況下，轉送的仍然是同一台伺服器。

> IPv6 addresses are supported starting from versions 1.3.2 and 1.2.2.
>
> 從版本1.3.2和1.2.2開始支援IPv6位址。

If one of the servers needs to be temporarily removed, it should be marked with the `down` parameter in order to preserve the current hashing of client IP addresses.

如果需要暫時移除其中一個伺服器，則應使用`down`參數對其進行標記，以便保留客戶端IP位址的目前雜湊值。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     ip_hash;
>
>     IP哈希值；
> 
>     server backend1.example.com;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com；
>     server backend2.example.com;
>
>     伺服器 backend2.example.com；
>     server backend3.example.com down;
>
>     伺服器 backend3.example.com 已關閉；
>     server backend4.example.com;
>
>     伺服器 backend4.example.com；
> }
> ```

> Until versions 1.3.1 and 1.2.2, it was not possible to specify a weight for servers using the `ip_hash` load balancing method.
>
> 在1.3.1和1.2.2版本之前，無法使用`ip_hash`負載平衡方法為伺服器指定權重。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>keepalive</strong> <code><i>connections</i></code> [<code>local</code>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>keepalive 32 local;<br>keepalive 32 local；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>upstream<br>上游</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.4.

該指令出現在版本1.1.4 。

Enables or disables caching of keepalive connections to upstream servers. Since 1.29.7, by default the cache for connections is activated and these connections are not [shared](#p-105) between different [locations](#p-056).

啟用或停用與上游伺服器保持連線的快取。自1.29.7起，預設連接快取已激活(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#location) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#keepalive_local)共享。

The `local` parameter (1.29.7) disables sharing of cached keepalive connections across different locations even if the upstream server address matches. If the `local` parameter is not specified, any matching cached connection to the same upstream server can be reused regardless of a location.

`local`參數（ 1.29.7 ）會停用跨不同位置共享快取的 keepalive 連接，即使上游伺服器位址匹配。如果未指定`local`參數，則可以重複使用任何與相同上游伺服器匹配的快取連接，而無需考慮位置。

The `*connections*` parameter sets the maximum number of idle keepalive connections to upstream servers that are preserved in the cache of each worker process. When this number is exceeded, the least recently used connections are closed. The zero value disables keepalive connections to upstream servers.

`*connections*`參數設定每個工作進程快取中保留的與上游伺服器的空閒 keepalive 連線的最大數量。當超過此數量時，最近最少使用的連接將關閉。值為零時，將停用與上游伺服器的 keepalive 連線。

> Since 1.29.7, keepalive connections are enabled by default, with a default limit of `*32*` connections per each worker process.
>
> 自1.29.7起，預設啟用 keepalive 連接，每個工作進程的預設連線數限制為`*32*`個。

> It should be particularly noted that the `keepalive` directive does not limit the total number of connections to upstream servers that an nginx worker process can open. The `*connections*` parameter should be set to a number small enough to let upstream servers process new incoming connections as well.
>
> 需要特別注意的是，`keepalive`指令並不限制nginx工作進程可以開啟的上游伺服器的連接總數。 `*connections*` 參數應設定為足夠小的數字，以便上游伺服器也可以處理新的傳入連線。

> Before 1.29.7, when using load balancing methods other than the default round-robin method, it was necessary to activate them before the `keepalive` directive.
>
> 在1.29.7之前，當使用預設輪詢方法之外的負載平衡方法時，必須在`keepalive`指令之前啟動它們。

Example configuration of memcached upstream with keepalive connections:

memcached 上游伺服器設定範例（啟用 keepalive 連線）：

> ```
> upstream memcached_backend {
>
> 上游 memcached_backend {
>     server 127.0.0.1:11211;
>
>     伺服器127.0.0.1:11211 ;
>     server 10.0.0.2:11211;
>
>     伺服器10.0.0.2:11211 ;
> 
>     keepalive 32;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     ...
> 
>     location /memcached/ {
>         set $memcached_key $uri;
>
>         設定 $memcached_key $uri;
>         memcached_pass memcached_backend;
>
>         memcached_pa​​ss memcached_backend;
>     }
> 
> }
> ```

For HTTP, the [proxy\_http\_version](#p-085) directive should be “`1.1`” (by default since 1.29.7) or set to “`2`” and the “Connection”（聯繫） header field should be cleared. This example is for versions prior to 1.29.7:

對於HTTP ，[proxy\_http\_version](#p-085)指令應為“ `1.1` ”（自1.29.7起為預設值）或設定為“ `2` ”，並且應清除“Connection”（聯繫）個標頭欄位。此範例適用於1.29.7之前的版本：

> ```
> upstream http_backend {
>
> 上游 http_backend {
>     server 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>     伺服器127.0.0.1:8080 ;
> 
>     keepalive 16;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     ...
> 
>     location /http/ {
>         proxy_pass http://http_backend;
>         # proxy_http_version 1.1; # before version 1.29.7｜proxy_http_version 1.1 ; # 版本1.29.7之前
>         # proxy_set_header Connection ""; # before version 1.29.7｜proxy_set_header Connection ""; # 版本1.29.7之前
>         ...
>     }
> }
> ```

> Alternatively, HTTP/1.0 persistent connections can be used by passing the “Connection: Keep-Alive” header field to an upstream server, though this method is not recommended.
>
> 或者，可以透過將「Connection: Keep-Alive」標頭欄位傳遞給上游伺服器來使用HTTP/1.0持久連接，但不建議使用此方法。

For FastCGI servers, it is required to set [fastcgi\_keep\_conn](#p-060) for keepalive connections to work:

對於 FastCGI 伺服器，需要設定 [fastcgi\_keep\_conn](#p-060)才能使 keepalive 連線正常運作：

> ```
> upstream fastcgi_backend {
>
> 上游 fastcgi_backend {
>     server 127.0.0.1:9000;
>
>     伺服器127.0.0.1:9000 ;
> 
>     keepalive 8;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     ...
> 
>     location /fastcgi/ {
>         fastcgi_pass fastcgi_backend;
>         fastcgi_keep_conn on;
>
>         fastcgi_keep_conn 開啟；
>         ...
>     }
> }
> ```

> SCGI and uwsgi protocols do not have a notion of keepalive connections.
>
> SCGI和 uwsgi 協議沒有 keepalive 連接的概念。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>keepalive_requests</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>keepalive_requests 1000;<br>keepalive_requests 1000；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>upstream<br>上游</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.3.

該指令出現在版本1.15.3 。

Sets the maximum number of requests that can be served through one keepalive connection. After the maximum number of requests is made, the connection is closed.

設定透過單一 keepalive 連線可以處理的最大請求數。達到最大請求數後，連線將關閉。

Closing connections periodically is necessary to free per-connection memory allocations. Therefore, using too high maximum number of requests could result in excessive memory usage and not recommended.

定期關閉連線對於釋放每個連線佔用的記憶體至關重要。因此，設定過高的最大請求數可能會導致記憶體使用過量，不建議這樣做。

> Prior to version 1.19.10, the default value was 100.
>
> 在版本1.19.10之前，預設值為100。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>keepalive_time</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>keepalive_time 1h;<br>keepalive_time 1小時；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>upstream<br>上游</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.19.10.

該指令出現在版本1.19.10 。

Limits the maximum time during which requests can be processed through one keepalive connection. After this time is reached, the connection is closed following the subsequent request processing.

限制透過單一 keepalive 連線處理請求的最長時間。達到此時間後，連線將在後續請求處理結束後關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>keepalive_timeout</strong> <code><i>timeout</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>keepalive_timeout 60s;<br>keepalive_timeout 60秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>upstream<br>上游</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.3.

該指令出現在版本1.15.3 。

Sets a timeout during which an idle keepalive connection to an upstream server will stay open.

設定與上游伺服器保持空閒連線的時間，在此期間連線將保持開啟狀態。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**ntlm**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.9.2.

該指令出現在版本1.9.2 。

Allows proxying requests with [NTLM Authentication](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Integrated_Windows_Authentication). The upstream connection is bound to the client connection once the client sends a request with the “Authorization”（授權） header field value starting with “`Negotiate`” or “`NTLM`”. Further client requests will be proxied through the same upstream connection, keeping the authentication context.

允許代理程式帶有 [NTLM身份驗證](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Integrated_Windows_Authentication)請求。當客戶端發送的請求的“Authorization”（授權）標頭欄位值以「 `Negotiate` 」或「 `NTLM` 」開頭時，上游連線將綁定到客戶端連線。後續的客戶端請求將透過同一上游連線進行代理，並保持身份驗證上下文。

In order for NTLM authentication to work, it is necessary to enable keepalive connections to upstream servers. The [proxy\_http\_version](#p-085) directive should be “`1.1`” (by default since 1.29.7) or set to “`2`” and the “Connection”（聯繫） header field should be cleared. This example is for versions prior to 1.29.7:

為了使NTLM身份驗證正常運作，必須啟用與上游伺服器的 keepalive 連線。 [proxy\_http\_version](#p-085)指令應設定為“ `1.1` ”（自1.29.7起為預設值）或設定為“ `2` ”，並且應清除“Connection”（聯繫）標頭欄位。此範例適用於1.29.7之前的版本：

> ```
> upstream http_backend {
>
> 上游 http_backend {
>     server 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>     伺服器127.0.0.1:8080 ;
> 
>     ntlm;
>
>     ntlm；
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     ...
> 
>     location /http/ {
>         proxy_pass http://http_backend;
>         # proxy_http_version 1.1; # before version 1.29.7｜proxy_http_version 1.1 ; # 版本1.29.7之前
>         # proxy_set_header Connection ""; # before version 1.29.7｜proxy_set_header Connection ""; # 版本1.29.7之前
>         ...
>     }
> }
> ```

> When using load balancer methods other than the default round-robin method, it is necessary to activate them before the `ntlm` directive.
>
> 當使用預設輪詢方法之外的負載平衡方法時，必須在`ntlm`指令之前啟動它們。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**least_conn**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in versions 1.3.1 and 1.2.2.

該指令出現在版本1.3.1和1.2.2中。

Specifies that a group should use a load balancing method where a request is passed to the server with the least number of active connections, taking into account weights of servers. If there are several such servers, they are tried in turn using a weighted round-robin balancing method.

指定群組應使用負載平衡方法，將請求傳遞給活動連接數最少的伺服器，並考慮伺服器的權重。如果有多個這樣的伺服器，則使用加權輪詢負載平衡方法依序嘗試這些伺服器。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**least_time** `header` \| `last_byte` [`inflight`];``<br>` `**least_time** `頭部` \| `最後一個位元組` [`飛行中`];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.10.

該指令出現在版本1.7.10 。

Specifies that a group should use a load balancing method where a request is passed to the server with the least average response time and least number of active connections, taking into account weights of servers. If there are several such servers, they are tried in turn using a weighted round-robin balancing method.

指定群組應使用負載平衡方法，將請求傳遞給平均回應時間最短且活動連線數最少的伺服器，同時考慮伺服器的權重。如果有多個符合條件的伺服器，則使用加權輪詢負載平衡方法依序嘗試這些伺服器。

If the `header` parameter is specified, time to receive the [response header](#p-105) is used. If the `last_byte` parameter is specified, time to receive the [full response](#p-105) is used. If the `inflight` parameter is specified (1.11.6), incomplete requests are also taken into account.

如果指定了`header`參數，則使用接收 [回應頭](#p-105)的時間。如果指定了`last_byte`參數，則使用接收 [完整回應](#p-105)的時間。如果指定了`inflight`參數（ 1.11.6 ），則也會考慮不完整的請求。

> Prior to version 1.11.6, incomplete requests were taken into account by default.
>
> 在版本1.11.6之前，預設會考慮不完整的請求。

> Prior to version 1.31.0, this directive was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.31.0之前，此指令僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**queue** `*number*` [`timeout`=`*time*`];``<br>` `**queue** ` *數字* ` [`超時`=` *時間* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.5.12.

該指令出現在版本1.5.12 。

If an upstream server cannot be selected immediately while processing a request, the request will be placed into the queue. The directive specifies the maximum `*number*` of requests that can be in the queue at the same time. If the queue is filled up, or the server to pass the request to cannot be selected within the time period specified in the `timeout` parameter, the 502 (Bad Gateway) error will be returned to the client.

如果在處理請求時無法立即選擇上游伺服器，則該請求將放入佇列。此指令指定了佇列中同時可容納的最大請求數`*number*` 。如果佇列已滿，或在`timeout`參數指定的時間內無法選擇要將要求轉送至的伺服器，則會向客戶端傳回 502（Bad Gateway）錯誤。

The default value of the `timeout` parameter is 60 seconds.

`timeout`參數的預設值為 60 秒。

> When using load balancer methods other than the default round-robin method, it is necessary to activate them before the `queue` directive.
>
> 當使用預設輪詢方法之外的負載平衡方法時，必須在`queue`指令之前啟動它們。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**random** [`two` [`*method*`]];``<br>` `**random** [`兩個` [` *方法* `]];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.15.1.

該指令出現在版本1.15.1 。

Specifies that a group should use a load balancing method where a request is passed to a randomly selected server, taking into account weights of servers.

規定群組應使用負載平衡方法，將請求傳遞給隨機選擇的伺服器，同時考慮伺服器的權重。

The optional `two` parameter instructs nginx to randomly select [two](https://homes.cs.washington.edu/~karlin/papers/balls.pdf) servers and then choose a server using the specified `method`. The default method is `least_conn` which passes a request to a server with the least number of active connections.

可選參數`two`指示nginx隨機選擇[兩個](https://homes.cs.washington.edu/~karlin/papers/balls.pdf)伺服器，然後使用指定的`method`方法選擇其中一個伺服器。預設方法是`least_conn` ，即將請求傳遞給活動連線數最少的伺服器。

The `least_time` method passes a request to a server with the least average response time and least number of active connections. If `least_time=header` is specified, the time to receive the [response header](#p-105) is used. If `least_time=last_byte` is specified, the time to receive the [full response](#p-105) is used.

`least_time`方法將請求傳遞給平均回應時間最短且活動連線數最少的伺服器。如果指定了`least_time=header` ，則使用接收 [回應頭](#p-105)的時間。如果指定了`least_time=last_byte` ，則使用接收 [完整回應](#p-105)的時間。

> The `least_time` method is available as a part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> `least_time`方法作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**resolver** `*address*` ... [`valid`=`*time*`] [`ipv4`=`on`\|`off`] [`ipv6`=`on`\|`off`] [`status_zone`=`*zone*`];``<br>``**resolver** `*地址*` ... [`有效`=`*時間*`] [`ipv4`=`on`\|`o ff`] [`ipv6`=`開`\|`關`] [`status_zone`=`*區域*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.3.

該指令出現在版本1.27.3 。

Configures name servers used to resolve names of upstream servers into addresses, for example:

配置用於將上游伺服器名稱解析為位址的名稱伺服器，例如：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
>
> 解決127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
> ```

The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, with an optional port. If port is not specified, the port 53 is used. Name servers are queried in a round-robin fashion.

位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，連接埠號碼為可選。如果未指定連接埠號，則使用連接埠53。名稱伺服器以輪詢方式進行查詢。

By default, nginx will look up both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses while resolving. If looking up of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses is not desired, the `ipv4=off` (1.23.1) or the `ipv6=off` parameter can be specified.

預設情況下，nginx 在解析時會同時尋找 IPv4 和 IPv6 位址。如果不需要尋找 IPv4 或 IPv6 位址，可以指定`ipv4=off` ( 1.23.1 ) 或`ipv6=off`參數。

By default, nginx caches answers using the TTL value of a response. An optional `valid` parameter allows overriding it:

預設情況下，nginx 使用回應的TTL值快取答案。可選的`valid`參數允許覆蓋此設定：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 valid=30s;
>
> 解析器127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 有效=30秒;
> ```

> To prevent DNS spoofing, it is recommended configuring DNS servers in a properly secured trusted local network.
>
> 為防止DNS欺騙，建議在安全可靠的本地網路中配置DNS伺服器。

The optional `status_zone` parameter (1.17.5) enables [collection](#p-048) of DNS server statistics of requests and responses in the specified `*zone*`. The parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).

可選參數`status_zone` ( 1.17.5 ) 啟用 [收集](#p-048)指定`*zone*`中請求和回應的DNS伺服器統計資訊。此參數作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

> Since version 1.17.5 and prior to version 1.27.3, this directive was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 從版本1.17.5到版本1.27.3 ，此指令僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

This directive appeared in version 1.27.3.

該指令出現在版本1.27.3 。

Sets a timeout for name resolution, for example:

設定名稱解析超時時間，例如：

> ```
> resolver_timeout 5s;
>
> 解析器超時時間為 5 秒；
> ```

> Since version 1.17.5 and prior to version 1.27.3, this directive was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 從版本1.17.5到版本1.27.3 ，此指令僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

| Syntax:<br>語法： | ```**sticky** `cookie` `*name*` [`expires=``*time*`] [`domain=``*domain*`] [`httponly`] [`samesite=``strict`\|`lax`\|`none`\|`*$variable*`] [`secure`] [`path=``*path*`];```<br>``**sticky** `route` `*$variable*` ...;``<br>```**sticky** `learn` `create=``*$variable*` `lookup=``*$variable*` `zone=``*name*`:`*size*` [`timeout=``*time*`] [`header`] [`sync`];```<br>`` `**sticky** ` cookie ` ` *name* ` [` expires=` `*time*` ] [ `domain=``*domain*` ]`samesite=``strict`\|`lax`\|`none`\|`*$variable*` `httponly` [ `secure` `path=``*path*` ];` `timeout=``*time*` `<br>``**sticky** ` route ` ` *$variable* ` ...;``<br>` ` `**sticky** ` learn ` ` create= `*$variable*` `lookup=``*$variable*` `zone=``*name*`:`*size*` `header` ] [ `sync` ];``` |
