| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Enables session affinity, which causes requests from the same client to be passed to the same server in a group of servers. Three methods are available:

啟用會話親和性，使來自同一客戶端的請求被轉送到同一伺服器群組內的同一台伺服器。有三種方法可用：

`cookie`

When the `cookie` method is used, information about the designated server is passed in an HTTP cookie generated by nginx:

當使用`cookie`方法時，有關指定伺服器的資訊會透過nginx產生的HTTP cookie傳遞：

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     server backend1.example.com;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com；
>     server backend2.example.com;
>
>     伺服器 backend2.example.com；
> 
>     sticky cookie srv_id expires=1h domain=.example.com path=/;
>
>     黏性 cookie srv_id expires=1h domain=.example.com path=/;
> }
> ```

A request that comes from a client not yet bound to a particular server is passed to the server selected by the configured balancing method. Further requests with this cookie will be passed to the designated server. If the designated server cannot process a request, the new server is selected as if the client has not been bound yet.

來自尚未綁定到特定伺服器的客戶端的請求將被轉送到配置的負載平衡方法所選擇的伺服器。後續帶有此 cookie 的請求將被轉送到指定的伺服器。如果指定的伺服器無法處理請求，則會選擇新的伺服器，如同該用戶端尚未綁定一樣。

> As a load balancing method always tries to evenly distribute the load considering already bound requests, the server with a higher number of active bound requests has less possibility of getting new unbound requests.
>
> 由於負載平衡方法總是試圖在考慮已綁定請求的情況下均勻分配負載，因此具有較多活躍綁定請求的伺服器獲得新的未綁定請求的可能性較小。

The first parameter sets the name of the cookie to be set or inspected. The cookie value is a hexadecimal representation of the MD5 hash of the IP address and port, or of the UNIX-domain socket path. However, if the “`route`” parameter of the [server](#p-105) directive is specified, the cookie value will be the value of the “`route`” parameter:

第一個參數設定要設定或檢查的 cookie 的名稱。 cookie 值是位址和連接埠IP ）或網域套接字路徑UNIX ）的MD5值的十六進位表示。但是，如果指定了 [server](#p-105)指令的「 `route` 」參數，則 cookie 值將是「 `route` 」參數的值：

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     server backend1.example.com route=a;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com 路由=a;
>     server backend2.example.com route=b;
>
>     伺服器 backend2.example.com 路由=b;
> 
>     sticky cookie srv_id expires=1h domain=.example.com path=/;
>
>     黏性 cookie srv_id expires=1h domain=.example.com path=/;
> }
> ```

In this case, the value of the “`srv_id`” cookie will be either `*a*` or `*b*`.

在這種情況下，「 `srv_id` 」 cookie 的值將是`*a*`或`*b*` 。

Additional parameters may be as follows:

其他參數可能如下：

`expires=``*time*`

Sets the `*time*` for which a browser should keep the cookie. The special value `max` will cause the cookie to expire on “`31 Dec 2037 23:55:55 GMT`”. If the parameter is not specified, it will cause the cookie to expire at the end of a browser session.

設定瀏覽器保留 cookie 的時間`*time*` 。特殊值`max`會使 cookie 在「 `31 Dec 2037 23:55:55 GMT` 」處過期。如果未指定此參數，則 cookie 將在瀏覽器會話結束時過期。

`domain=``*domain*`

Defines the `*domain*` for which the cookie is set. Parameter value can contain variables (1.11.5).

定義要設定 cookie 的`*domain*` 。參數值可以包含變數（ 1.11.5 ）。

`httponly`

Adds the `HttpOnly` attribute to the cookie (1.7.11).

將`HttpOnly`屬性加入到 cookie ( 1.7.11 )。

`samesite=``strict` | `lax` | `none` | `*$variable*`

Adds the `SameSite` (1.19.4) attribute to the cookie with one of the following values: `Strict`, `Lax`, `None`, or using variables (1.23.3). In the latter case, if the variable value is empty, the `SameSite` attribute will not be added to the cookie, if the value is resolved to `Strict`, `Lax`, or `None`, the corresponding value will be assigned, otherwise the `Strict` value will be assigned.

使用下列值之一將 `SameSite` (1.19.4) 屬性新增至 cookie：`Strict`, `Lax`, `None`，或使用變數 (1.23.3)。在後一種情況下，如果變數值為空，則`SameSite`屬性不會加到cookie中，如果該值解析為`Strict`, `Lax`或`None`，則會指派對應的值，否則將指派`Strict`值。

`secure`

Adds the `Secure` attribute to the cookie (1.7.11).

將`Secure`屬性加入到 cookie ( 1.7.11 )。

`path=``*path*`

Defines the `*path*` for which the cookie is set.

定義設定 cookie 的`*path*` 。

If any parameters are omitted, the corresponding cookie fields are not set.

如果省略任何參數，則不會設定對應的 cookie 欄位。

`route`

When the `route` method is used, proxied server assigns client a route on receipt of the first request. All subsequent requests from this client will carry routing information in a cookie or URI. This information is compared with the “`route`” parameter of the [server](#p-105) directive to identify the server to which the request should be proxied. If the “`route`” parameter is not specified, the route name will be a hexadecimal representation of the MD5 hash of the IP address and port, or of the UNIX-domain socket path. If the designated server cannot process a request, the new server is selected by the configured balancing method as if there is no routing information in the request.

當使用`route`方法時，代理伺服器會在收到客戶端的第一個請求時為其指派一條路由。來自該客戶端的所有後續請求都將在 cookie 或URI中攜帶路由資訊。此資訊將與[server](#p-105)指令的「 `route` 」參數進行比較，以確定應將請求代理到的伺服器。如果未指定「 `route` 」參數，則路由名稱將是IP位址和連接埠或UNIX域套接字路徑的MD5雜湊值的十六進位表示。如果指定的伺服器無法處理要求，則設定的負載平衡方法會選擇新的伺服器，就好像請求中沒有路由資訊一樣。

The parameters of the `route` method specify variables that may contain routing information. The first non-empty variable is used to find the matching server.

`route`方法的參數指定了可能包含路由資訊的變數。第一個非空變數用於尋找符合的伺服器。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> map $cookie_jsessionid $route_cookie {
>
> 映射 $cookie_jsessionid $route_cookie {
>     ~.+\.(?P<route>\w+)$ $route;
>
>     ~.+\.(?P <route> \w+)$ $route;
> }
> 
> map $request_uri $route_uri {
>
> 映射 $request_uri $route_uri {
>     ~jsessionid=.+\.(?P<route>\w+)$ $route;
>
>     ~jsessionid=.+\.(?P <route> \w+)$ $route;
> }
> 
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     server backend1.example.com route=a;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com 路由=a;
>     server backend2.example.com route=b;
>
>     伺服器 backend2.example.com 路由=b;
> 
>     sticky route $route_cookie $route_uri;
>
>     黏性路由 $route_cookie $route_uri;
> }
> ```

Here, the route is taken from the “`JSESSIONID`” cookie if present in a request. Otherwise, the route from the URI is used.

此處，如果請求中存在「 `JSESSIONID` 」 cookie，則使用其中的路由；否則，請使用URI 」 cookie 中的路由。

`learn`

When the `learn` method (1.7.1) is used, nginx analyzes upstream server responses and learns server-initiated sessions usually passed in an HTTP cookie.

當使用`learn`方法 ( 1.7.1 ) 時，nginx 分析上游伺服器回應，並了解伺服器發起的會話，這些會話通常透過HTTP cookie 傳遞。

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>    server backend1.example.com:8080;
>
>    伺服器 backend1.example.com:8080;
>    server backend2.example.com:8081;
>
>    伺服器 backend2.example.com:8081;
> 
>    sticky learn
>
>    黏性學習
>           create=$upstream_cookie_examplecookie
>
>           建立=$upstream_cookie_examplecookie
>           lookup=$cookie_examplecookie
>           zone=client_sessions:1m;
> }
> ```

In the example, the upstream server creates a session by setting the cookie “`EXAMPLECOOKIE`” in the response. Further requests with this cookie will be passed to the same server. If the server cannot process the request, the new server is selected as if the client has not been bound yet.

在本例中，上游伺服器透過在回應中設定 cookie「 `EXAMPLECOOKIE` 」來建立會話。後續帶有此 cookie 的請求將被轉送到同一台伺服器。如果伺服器無法處理請求，則會選擇新的伺服器，就好像客戶端尚未綁定一樣。

The parameters `create` and `lookup` specify variables that indicate how new sessions are created and existing sessions are searched, respectively. Both parameters may be specified more than once, in which case the first non-empty variable is used.

參數`create`和`lookup`分別指定用來指示如何建立新會話和搜尋現有會話的變數。這兩個參數都可以多次指定，在這種情況下，將使用第一個非空變數。

Sessions are stored in a shared memory zone, whose `*name*` and `*size*` are configured by the `zone` parameter. One megabyte zone can store about 4000 sessions on the 64-bit platform. The sessions that are not accessed during the time specified by the `timeout` parameter get removed from the zone. By default, `timeout` is set to 10 minutes.

會話儲存在共享記憶體區域中，其`*name*`和`*size*`由`zone`參數配置。在 64 位元平台上，1 MB 的區域大約可以儲存 4000 個會話。在`timeout`參數指定的時間內未被訪問的會話將從區域中移除。預設情況下， `timeout`設定為 10 分鐘。

The `header` parameter (1.13.1) allows creating a session right after receiving response headers from the upstream server.

`header`參數 ( 1.13.1 ) 允許在從上游伺服器收到回應標頭後立即建立會話。

The `sync` parameter (1.13.8) enables [synchronization](#p-164) of the shared memory zone. The parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).

`sync`參數 ( 1.13.8 ) 啟用共享記憶體區域的 [同步](#p-164) 。此參數作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

> Prior to version 1.29.6, this directive was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.29.6之前，此指令僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_upstream_module` module supports the following embedded variables:

`ngx_http_upstream_module`模組支援以下嵌入式變數：

`$upstream_addr`

keeps the IP address and port, or the path to the UNIX-domain socket of the upstream server. If several servers were contacted during request processing, their addresses are separated by commas, e.g. “`192.168.1.1:80, 192.168.1.2:80, unix:/tmp/sock`”. If an internal redirect from one server group to another happens, initiated by “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向） or [error\_page](#p-056), then the server addresses from different groups are separated by colons, e.g. “`192.168.1.1:80, 192.168.1.2:80, unix:/tmp/sock : 192.168.10.1:80, 192.168.10.2:80`”. If a server cannot be selected, the variable keeps the name of the server group.

保留上游伺服器的位址和連接埠IP ，或指向其網域套接字的路徑（ UNIX ）。如果在請求處理期間聯繫了多個伺服器，則它們的位址會以逗號分隔，例如「 `192.168.1.1:80, 192.168.1.2:80, unix:/tmp/sock` 」。如果發生由“X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）或[error\_page](#p-056)發起的內部伺服器群組重定向，則不同伺服器群組的位址以冒號分隔，例如「 `192.168.1.1:80, 192.168.1.2:80, unix:/tmp/sock : 192.168.10.1:80, 192.168.10.2:80` 」。如果無法選擇伺服器，則該變數保留伺服器群組的名稱。

`$upstream_bytes_received`

number of bytes received from an upstream server (1.11.4). Values from several connections are separated by commas and colons like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-105) variable.

從上游伺服器接收的位元組數（ 1.11.4 ）。來自多個連接的值以逗號和冒號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-105)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_bytes_sent`

number of bytes sent to an upstream server (1.15.8). Values from several connections are separated by commas and colons like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-105) variable.

發送到上游伺服器的位元組數（ 1.15.8 ）。來自多個連接的值以逗號和冒號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-105)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_cache_status`

keeps the status of accessing a response cache (0.8.3). The status can be either “`MISS`”, “`BYPASS`”, “`EXPIRED`”, “`STALE`”, “`UPDATING`”, “`REVALIDATED`”, or “`HIT`”.

保持存取回應快取的狀態（ 0.8.3 ）。此狀態可以是「 `MISS` 」、「 `BYPASS` 」、「 `EXPIRED` 」、「 `STALE` 」、「 `UPDATING` 」、「 `REVALIDATED` `HIT` 」。

`$upstream_connect_time`

keeps time spent on establishing a connection with the upstream server (1.9.1); the time is kept in seconds with millisecond resolution. In case of SSL, includes time spent on handshake. Times of several connections are separated by commas and colons like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-105) variable.

記錄與上游伺服器建立連線所花費的時間（ 1.9.1 ）；時間以秒為單位，精確到毫秒。對於SSL ，則包含握手所花費的時間。多個連接的時間用逗號和冒號分隔，就像[$upstream\_addr](#p-105)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_cookie_``*name*`

cookie with the specified `*name*` sent by the upstream server in the “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） response header field (1.7.1). Only the cookies from the response of the last server are saved.

上游伺服器在回應頭欄位（ 1.7.1 ） “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）中發送的帶有指定`*name*`的cookie。僅保存來自最後一個伺服器回應的cookie。

`$upstream_header_time`

keeps time spent on receiving the response header from the upstream server (1.7.10); the time is kept in seconds with millisecond resolution. Times of several responses are separated by commas and colons like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-105) variable.

記錄從上游伺服器接收回應頭所花費的時間（ 1.7.10 ）；時間以秒為單位，精確到毫秒。多個回應的時間用逗號和冒號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-105)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_http_``*name*`

keep server response header fields. For example, the “Server”（伺服器） response header field is available through the `$upstream_http_server` variable. The rules of converting header field names to variable names are the same as for the variables that start with the “[$http\_](#p-056)” prefix. Only the header fields from the response of the last server are saved.

保留伺服器響應頭字段。例如， “Server”（伺服器）響應頭字段可透過`$upstream_http_server`變數存取。將回應頭欄位名稱轉換為變數名稱的規則與以「[$http\_](#p-056) 」為前綴的變數的轉換規則相同。僅保存來自最後一個伺服器回應的回應頭字段。

`$upstream_last_addr`

keeps the IP address or the path to the UNIX-domain socket of the last selected upstream server (1.29.3).

保留最後選定的上游伺服器（ 1.29.3 ）的IP位址或UNIX域套接字的路徑。

> This variable is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此變數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`$upstream_last_server_name`

keeps the name of last selected upstream server (1.25.3); allows passing it [through SNI](#p-085):

保留上次選擇的上游伺服器的名稱（ 1.25.3 ）；允許將其傳遞[透過SNI](#p-085) ：

> ```
> proxy_ssl_server_name on;
>
> proxy_ssl_server_name 已啟用；
> proxy_ssl_name        $upstream_last_server_name;
>
> proxy_ssl_name $upstream_last_server_name;
> ```

> This variable is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此變數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`$upstream_queue_time`

keeps time the request spent in the upstream [queue](#p-105) (1.13.9); the time is kept in seconds with millisecond resolution. Times of several responses are separated by commas and colons like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-105) variable.

記錄請求在上游 [隊列](#p-105) ( 1.13.9 ) 中花費的時間；時間以秒為單位，精確到毫秒。多個回應的時間用逗號和冒號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-105)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_response_length`

keeps the length of the response obtained from the upstream server (0.7.27); the length is kept in bytes. Lengths of several responses are separated by commas and colons like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-105) variable.

保存從上游伺服器獲得的回應長度（ 0.7.27 ）；長度以位元組為單位。多個回應的長度以逗號和冒號分隔，就像位址一樣，在 [$upstream\_addr](#p-105)變數中。

`$upstream_response_time`

keeps time spent on receiving the response from the upstream server; the time is kept in seconds with millisecond resolution. Times of several responses are separated by commas and colons like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-105) variable.

記錄接收上游伺服器回應所花費的時間；時間以秒為單位，精確到毫秒。多個回應的時間用逗號和冒號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-105)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_status`

keeps status code of the response obtained from the upstream server. Status codes of several responses are separated by commas and colons like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-105) variable. If a server cannot be selected, the variable keeps the 502 (Bad Gateway) status code.

保存從上游伺服器取得的回應狀態碼。多個回應的狀態碼用逗號和冒號分隔，就像位址一樣，儲存在 [$upstream\_addr](#p-105)變數中。如果無法選擇伺服器，則變數儲存 502（錯誤網關）狀態碼。

`$upstream_trailer_``*name*`

keeps fields from the end of the response obtained from the upstream server (1.13.10).

保留從上游伺服器取得的回應末尾的欄位（ 1.13.10 ）。

<a id="p-106"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_userid_module｜模組 ngx_http_userid_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_userid_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_userid\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_userid\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-106)<br>[Directives](#p-106)<br>     [userid](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_domain](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_expires](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_flags](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_mark](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_name](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_p3p](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_path](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_service](#p-106)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-106)<br>[範例設定](#p-106)<br>[指示](#p-106)<br>     [userid](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_domai n](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_expires](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_flags](#p-106)<br>     [使用者id\_mark](#p-106)<br>     [使用者id\_name](#p-106)<br>     [使用者id\_p3p ](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_path](#p-106)<br>     [userid\_service](#p-106)<br>[內嵌變數](#p-106) |

The `ngx_http_userid_module` module sets cookies suitable for client identification. Received and set cookies can be logged using the embedded variables [$uid\_got](#p-106) and [$uid\_set](#p-106). This module is compatible with the [mod\_uid](http://www.lexa.ru/programs/mod-uid-eng.html) module for Apache.

`ngx_http_userid_module`模組設定用於客戶端識別的 cookie。已接收和已設定的 cookie 可以使用內嵌變數 [$uid\_got](#p-106)和 [$uid\_set](#p-106)進行記錄。此模組與 Apache 的 [mod\_uid](http://www.lexa.ru/programs/mod-uid-eng.html)模組相容。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> userid         on;
>
> 用戶是；
> userid_name    uid;
>
> 用戶ID_名稱uid；
> userid_domain  example.com;
>
> userid_domain example.com;
> userid_path    /;
>
> 使用者 ID 路徑 /;
> userid_expires 365d;
> userid_p3p     'policyref="/w3c/p3p.xml", CP="CUR ADM OUR NOR STA NID"';
>
> userid_p3p 'policyref="/w3c/p3p.xml", CP = "CUR ADM OUR NOR STA NID" ';
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>userid<br>使用者</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>v1</code> | <code>log<br>紀錄</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>userid off;<br>用戶 ID 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables setting cookies and logging the received cookies:

啟用或停用設定 Cookie 和記錄接收到的 Cookie：

`on`

enables the setting of version 2 cookies and logging of the received cookies;

啟用設定版本 2 cookie 和記錄接收到的 cookie；

`v1`

enables the setting of version 1 cookies and logging of the received cookies;

啟用設定版本 1 cookie 和記錄接收到的 cookie；

`log`

disables the setting of cookies, but enables logging of the received cookies;

停用 cookie 設置，但啟用對已接收 cookie 的日誌記錄；

`off`

disables the setting of cookies and logging of the received cookies.

停用 cookie 的設定和接收到的 cookie 的日誌記錄。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>userid_domain<br>用戶ID_網域</strong> <code><i>name<br>名稱</i></code> | <code>none<br>無</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>userid_domain none;<br>userid_domain 無；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a domain for which the cookie is set. The `none` parameter disables setting of a domain for the cookie.

定義為其設定 cookie 的網域。 `none` 參數停用 cookie 的網域設定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>userid_expires</strong> <code><i>time</i></code> | <code>max</code> | <code>off<br></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>userid_expires off;<br>userid_expires 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a time during which a browser should keep the cookie. The parameter `max` will cause the cookie to expire on “`31 Dec 2037 23:55:55 GMT`”. The parameter `off` will cause the cookie to expire at the end of a browser session.

設定瀏覽器保留 cookie 的時間。參數`max`將使 cookie 在「 `31 Dec 2037 23:55:55 GMT` 」時過期。參數`off`將使 cookie 在瀏覽器會話結束時過期。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>userid_flags<br>用戶ID標誌</strong> <code>off<br>關閉</code> | <code><i>flag<br>標誌</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>userid_flags off;<br>用戶 ID 標誌關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.19.3.

該指令出現在版本1.19.3 。

If the parameter is not `off`, defines one or more additional flags for the cookie: `secure`, `httponly`, `samesite=strict`, `samesite=lax`, `samesite=none`.

如果參數不是`off` ，則為 cookie 定義一個或多個附加標誌： `secure`, `httponly`, `samesite=strict`, `samesite=lax`, `samesite=none` 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>userid_mark<br>用戶 ID 標記</strong> <code><i>letter<br>字母</i></code> | <code><i>digit<br>數字</i></code> | <code>=</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>userid_mark off;<br>用戶 ID 標記關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

If the parameter is not `off`, enables the cookie marking mechanism and sets the character used as a mark. This mechanism is used to add or change [userid\_p3p](#p-106) and/or a cookie expiration time while preserving the client identifier. A mark can be any letter of the English alphabet (case-sensitive), digit, or the “`=`” character.

如果參數不是`off` ，則啟用 cookie 標記機制並設定用作標記的字元。此機制用於新增或變更 [userid\_p3p](#p-106)和/或 cookie 過期時間，同時保留客戶端識別碼。標記可以是任何英文字母（區分大小寫）、數字或“ `=` ”字元。

If the mark is set, it is compared with the first padding symbol in the base64 representation of the client identifier passed in a cookie. If they do not match, the cookie is resent with the specified mark, expiration time, and “P3P” header.

如果設定了標記，則將其與 cookie 中傳遞的用戶端識別碼的 base64 表示形式中的第一個填充符號進行比較。如果不匹配，則使用指定的標記、過期時間和“P3P”標頭重新發送 cookie。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>userid_name<br>用戶ID_名稱</strong> <code><i>name<br>名稱</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>userid_name uid;<br>用戶 ID_名稱 uid；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the cookie name.

設定 cookie 名稱。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>userid_p3p</strong> <code><i>string<br>字串</i></code> | <code>none<br>無</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>userid_p3p none;<br>userid_p3p 無；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a value for the “P3P” header field that will be sent along with the cookie. If the directive is set to the special value `none`, the “P3P” header will not be sent in a response.

設定將與 cookie 一起傳送的“P3P”標頭欄位的值。如果指令設定為特殊值`none` ，則回應中不會發送“P3P”標頭。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>userid_path<br>用戶ID路徑</strong> <code><i>path<br>路徑</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>userid_path /;<br>用戶 ID 路徑 /；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a path for which the cookie is set.

定義設定 cookie 的路徑。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>userid_service<br>用戶ID_服務</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>userid_service<br>用戶服務 IDIPaddress of the server;<br>伺服器位址；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

If identifiers are issued by multiple servers (services), each service should be assigned its own `*number*` to ensure that client identifiers are unique. For version 1 cookies, the default value is zero. For version 2 cookies, the default value is the number composed from the last four octets of the server’s IP address.

如果識別碼由多個伺服器（服務）頒發，則每個服務都應分配自己的`*number*`以確保客戶端識別碼的唯一性。對於版本 1 的 cookie，預設值為零。對於版本 2 的 cookie，預設值是伺服器IP位址的最後四個位元組組成的數字。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_userid_module` module supports the following embedded variables:

`ngx_http_userid_module`模組支援以下嵌入式變數：

`$uid_got`

The cookie name and received client identifier.

cookie 名稱和接收的用戶端識別碼。

`$uid_reset`

If the variable is set to a non-empty string that is not “`0`”, the client identifiers are reset. The special value “`log`” additionally leads to the output of messages about the reset identifiers to the [error\_log](#p-125).

如果將變數設為非空字串（非“ `0` ”），則重設客戶端識別碼。特殊值「 `log` 」也會導致將重置標識符的訊息輸出到 [error\_log](#p-125) 。

`$uid_set`

The cookie name and sent client identifier.

cookie 名稱和傳送的用戶端識別碼。

##### Module ngx_http_uwsgi_module｜模組 ngx_http_uwsgi_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_uwsgi_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_uwsgi\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_uwsgi\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-107)<br>[Directives](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_allow\_upstream](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_bind](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_bind\_dynamic](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_buffering](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_buffers](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_busy\_buffers\_size](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_background\_update](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_bypass](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_key](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_lock](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_lock\_age](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_max\_range\_offset](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_methods](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_min\_uses](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_path](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_purge](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_revalidate](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_use\_stale](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_cache\_valid](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_connect\_timeout](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_force\_ranges](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_hide\_header](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ignore\_client\_abort](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_intercept\_errors](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_limit\_rate](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_modifier1](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_modifier2](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_next\_upstream](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_next\_upstream\_timeout](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_next\_upstream\_tries](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_no\_cache](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_param](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_pass](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_pass\_header](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_pass\_request\_body](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_read\_timeout](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_request\_buffering](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_request\_dynamic](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_send\_timeout](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_socket\_keepalive](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_socket\_rcvbuf](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_socket\_sndbuf](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_certificate](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_certificate\_cache](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_certificate\_key](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_ciphers](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_conf\_command](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_crl](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_key\_log](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_name](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_password\_file](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_protocols](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_server\_name](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_session\_reuse](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_verify](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_ssl\_verify\_depth](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_store](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_store\_access](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-107)<br>     [uwsgi\_temp\_path](#p-107) |

The `ngx_http_uwsgi_module` module allows passing requests to a uwsgi server.

`ngx_http_uwsgi_module`模組允許向 uwsgi 伺服器傳遞請求。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     include    uwsgi_params;
>
>     包含 uwsgi_params；
>     uwsgi_pass localhost:9000;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_allow_upstream** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**uwsgi_allow_upstream** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

Defines conditions under which access to a uwsgi server is allowed or [denied](#p-107). If all string parameters are not empty and not equal to “0” then the access is allowed. The conditions are evaluated each time before a connection to a uwsgi server is established. Parameter values can contain variables:

定義允許或拒絕存取 uwsgi 伺服器的條件(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_uwsgi_module.html#denied) 。如果所有字串參數均不為空且不等於“0”，則允許存取。每次建立與 uwsgi 伺服器的連線之前都會評估這些條件。參數值可以包含變數：

> ```
> geo $upstream_last_addr $allow {
>     volatile;
>
>     易揮發的;
>     10.10.0.0/24        1;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>     聽127.0.0.1:8080 ;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         uwsgi_pass           localhost:9000;
>
>         uwsgi_pass localhost:9000;
>         uwsgi_allow_upstream $allow;
>         ...
>     }
> }
> ```

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_bind** `*address*` [`transparent`] \| `off`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_bind** ` *地址* ` [`透明`] \| `關閉`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Makes outgoing connections to a uwsgi server originate from the specified local IP address with an optional port (1.11.2). Parameter value can contain variables (1.3.12). The special value `off` (1.3.12) cancels the effect of the `uwsgi_bind` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows the system to auto-assign the local IP address and port.

使發送至 uwsgi 伺服器的出站連線源自指定的本機位址IP ，並可選擇指定連接埠 ( 1.11.2 )。參數值可以包含變數 ( 1.3.12 )。特殊值`off` ( 1.3.12 ) 會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`uwsgi_bind`指令的效果，該指令允許系統自動分配本地位址IP和連接埠。

The `transparent` parameter (1.11.0) allows outgoing connections to a uwsgi server originate from a non-local IP address, for example, from a real IP address of a client:

`transparent`參數 ( 1.11.0 ) 允許從非本地IP位址（例如，客戶端的真實IP位址）發出到 uwsgi 伺服器的出站連接：

> ```
> uwsgi_bind $remote_addr transparent;
> ```

In order for this parameter to work, it is usually necessary to run nginx worker processes with the [superuser](#p-125) privileges. On Linux it is not required (1.13.8) as if the `transparent` parameter is specified, worker processes inherit the `CAP_NET_RAW` capability from the master process. It is also necessary to configure kernel routing table to intercept network traffic from the uwsgi server.

為了使此參數生效，通常需要以 [superuser](#p-125)權限執行 nginx 工作進程。在 Linux 系統上則無需此權限 ( 1.13.8 )，因為如果指定了`transparent`參數，工作進程會從主進程繼承`CAP_NET_RAW`權限。此外，還需要設定核心路由表以攔截來自 uwsgi 伺服器的網路流量。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_bind_dynamic</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_bind_dynamic off;<br>uwsgi_bind_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

When enabled, makes the [bind](#p-107) operation at each connection attempt.

啟用後，每次連線嘗試時執行 [bind](#p-107)操作。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_buffer_size 4k|8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading the first part of the response received from the uwsgi server. This part usually contains a small response header; if it exceeds the buffer size, the response is considered [invalid](#p-107). By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform. It can be made smaller, however.

設定用於讀取從 uwsgi 伺服器收到的回應第一部分的緩衝區大小`*size*` 。這部分通常包含一個較小的響應頭；如果響應頭大小超過緩衝區大小，則該響應被視為無效（ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_uwsgi_module.html#invalid_header) ）。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台的不同，該大小為 4K 或 8K。不過，可以將其減小。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_buffering</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_buffering on;<br>uwsgi_buffering 已啟用；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables buffering of responses from the uwsgi server.

啟用或停用來自 uwsgi 伺服器的回應緩衝。

When buffering is enabled, nginx receives a response from the uwsgi server as soon as possible, saving it into the buffers set by the [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107) and [uwsgi\_buffers](#p-107) directives. If the whole response does not fit into memory, a part of it can be saved to a [temporary file](#p-107) on the disk. Writing to temporary files is controlled by the [uwsgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-107) and [uwsgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-107) directives.

啟用緩衝後，nginx 會盡快從 uwsgi 伺服器接收回應，並將其儲存到由 `[uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107)和 `[uwsgi\_buffers](#p-107)指令設定的緩衝區中。如果整個回應無法放入內存，則可以將其一部分儲存到磁碟上的暫存檔案（`[temporary file](#p-107) ）。暫存檔案的寫入由 `[uwsgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-107)和 `[uwsgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-107)指令控制。

When buffering is disabled, the response is passed to a client synchronously, immediately as it is received. nginx will not try to read the whole response from the uwsgi server. The maximum size of the data that nginx can receive from the server at a time is set by the [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107) directive.

停用緩衝後，回應會同步地立即傳遞給客戶端。 nginx 不會嘗試從 uwsgi 伺服器讀取整個回應。 nginx 一次可以從伺服器接收的最大資料大小由 [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107)指令設定。

Buffering can also be enabled or disabled by passing “`yes`” or “`no`” in the “X-Accel-Buffering” response header field. This capability can be disabled using the [uwsgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-107) directive.

也可以透過在“X-Accel-Buffering”響應頭字段中傳遞「 `yes` 」或「 `no` 」來啟用或停用緩衝。可以使用 [uwsgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-107)指令停用此功能。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_buffers</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_buffers 8 4k|8k;<br>uwsgi_buffers 8 4k|8k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*number*` and `*size*` of the buffers used for reading a response from the uwsgi server, for a single connection. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform.

設定用於從 uWSGI 伺服器讀取回應的緩衝區`*number*`和`*size*`的值，此設定僅適用於單一連線。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台不同，該值可以是 4K 或 8K。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_busy_buffers_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_busy_buffers_size 8k|16k;<br>uwsgi_busy_buffers_size 8k|16k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

When [buffering](#p-107) of responses from the uwsgi server is enabled, limits the total `*size*` of buffers that can be busy sending a response to the client while the response is not yet fully read. In the meantime, the rest of the buffers can be used for reading the response and, if needed, buffering part of the response to a temporary file. By default, `*size*` is limited by the size of two buffers set by the [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107) and [uwsgi\_buffers](#p-107) directives.

啟用 uwsgi 伺服器回應的 [buffering](#p-107)功能後，會限制用於向客戶端發送回應的緩衝區總數`*size*` ，直到回應完全讀取完畢。在此期間，其餘緩衝區可用於讀取回應，並在需要時將部分回應緩衝到暫存檔案。預設情況下， `*size*`受限於 [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107)和 [uwsgi\_buffers](#p-107)指令設定的兩個緩衝區的大小。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_cache</strong> <code><i>zone</i></code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_cache off;<br>關閉 uwsgi_cache；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a shared memory zone used for caching. The same zone can be used in several places. Parameter value can contain variables (1.7.9). The `off` parameter disables caching inherited from the previous configuration level.

定義用於快取的共享記憶體區域。同一區域可以在多個地方使用。參數值可以包含變數(1.7.9)。 `off` 參數停用從先前配置等級繼承的快取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_cache_background_update</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_cache_background_update off;<br>關閉 uwsgi_cache_background_update；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.11.10.

該指令出現在版本1.11.10 。

Allows starting a background subrequest to update an expired cache item, while a stale cached response is returned to the client. Note that it is necessary to [allow](#p-107) the usage of a stale cached response when it is being updated.

允許啟動後台子請求來更新已過期的快取項，同時向客戶端傳回過時的快取回應。請注意，在更新快取項目時，必須允許使用過時的快取回應（請參閱(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_uwsgi_module.html#uwsgi_cache_use_stale_updating) ）。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_cache_bypass** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**uwsgi_cache_bypass** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines conditions under which the response will not be taken from a cache. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the response will not be taken from the cache:

定義不從快取中取得回應的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則不會從快取中取得回應：

> ```
> uwsgi_cache_bypass $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment;
>
> uwsgi_cache_bypass $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment；
> uwsgi_cache_bypass $http_pragma    $http_authorization;
>
> uwsgi_cache_bypass $http_pragma $http_authorization;
> ```

Can be used along with the [uwsgi\_no\_cache](#p-107) directive.

可與 [uwsgi\_no\_cache](#p-107)指令一起使用。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_cache_key** `*string*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_cache_key** ` *字串* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines a key for caching, for example

定義一個用於快取的鍵，例如

> ```
> uwsgi_cache_key localhost:9000$request_uri;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_cache_lock</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_cache_lock off;<br>uwsgi_cache_lock 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.12.

該指令出現在版本1.1.12 。

When enabled, only one request at a time will be allowed to populate a new cache element identified according to the [uwsgi\_cache\_key](#p-107) directive by passing a request to a uwsgi server. Other requests of the same cache element will either wait for a response to appear in the cache or the cache lock for this element to be released, up to the time set by the [uwsgi\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-107) directive.

啟用此功能後，每次只允許一個請求透過向 uwsgi 伺服器發送請求來填入根據 [uwsgi\_cache\_key](#p-107)指令標識的新快取元素。對相同快取元素的其他請求將等待快取中出現回應或該元素的快取鎖定被釋放，直到 [uwsgi\_cache\_lock\_timeout](#p-107)指令設定的時間結束。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_cache_lock_age</strong> <code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_cache_lock_age 5s;<br>uwsgi_cache_lock_age 5秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.8.

該指令出現在版本1.7.8 。

If the last request passed to the uwsgi server for populating a new cache element has not completed for the specified `*time*`, one more request may be passed to the uwsgi server.

如果向 uwsgi 伺服器傳遞的用於填充新快取元素的最後一個請求尚未在指定的`*time*`內完成，則可以向 uwsgi 伺服器傳遞另一個請求。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_cache_lock_timeout</strong> <code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_cache_lock_timeout 5s;<br>uwsgi_cache_lock_timeout 5秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.12.

該指令出現在版本1.1.12 。

Sets a timeout for [uwsgi\_cache\_lock](#p-107). When the `*time*` expires, the request will be passed to the uwsgi server, however, the response will not be cached.

設定 [uwsgi\_cache\_lock](#p-107)的超時時間。當`*time*`過期時，請求將傳遞給 uwsgi 伺服器，但回應將不會被快取。

> Before 1.7.8, the response could be cached.
>
> 在1.7.8之前，響應可以被快取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**uwsgi_cache_max_range_offset** `*number*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_cache_max_range_offset** ` *數字* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.6.

該指令出現在版本1.11.6 。

Sets an offset in bytes for byte-range requests. If the range is beyond the offset, the range request will be passed to the uwsgi server and the response will not be cached.

設定位元組範圍請求的位元組偏移量。如果範圍超出偏移量，則範圍請求將傳遞給 uwsgi 伺服器，並且回應不會被快取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_cache_methods</strong> <code>GET</code> | <code>HEAD</code> | <code>POST</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_cache_methods GET HEAD;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

If the client request method is listed in this directive then the response will be cached. “`GET`” and “`HEAD`” methods are always added to the list, though it is recommended to specify them explicitly. See also the [uwsgi\_no\_cache](#p-107) directive.

如果客戶端請求方法列在此指令中，則回應將被快取。 「 `GET` 」和「 `HEAD` 」方法總是會加入到清單中，但建議明確指定它們。另請參閱[uwsgi\_no\_cache](#p-107)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_cache_min_uses</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_cache_min_uses 1;<br>uwsgi_cache_min_uses 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*number*` of requests after which the response will be cached.

設定`*number*`請求數，超過該請求數後回應將被快取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**uwsgi_cache_path** `*path*` [`levels`=`*levels*`] [`use_temp_path`=`on`\|`off`] `keys_zone`=`*name*`:`*size*` [`inactive`=`*time*`] [`max_size`=`*size*`] [`min_free`=`*size*`] [`manager_files`=`*number*`] [`manager_sleep`=`*time*`] [`manager_threshold`=`*time*`] [`loader_files`=`*number*`] [`loader_sleep`=`*time*`] [`loader_threshold`=`*time*`] [`purger`=`on`\|`off`] [`purger_files`=`*number*`] [`purger_sleep`=`*time*`] [`purger_threshold`=`*time*`];``<br>``**uwsgi_cache_path** `*小路*` [`等級`=`*級別*`] [`使用臨時路徑`=`在`\|`離開`] `鑰匙區`=`*姓名*`:`*尺寸*` [`不活躍`=`*時間*`] [`最大尺寸`=`*尺寸*`] [`最小空閒`=`*尺寸*`] [`管理器文件`=`*數字*`] [`經理睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`經理閾值`=`*時間*`] [`載入器文件`=`*數字*`] [`載入器睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`載入器閾值`=`*時間*`] [`清除`=`在`\|`離開`] [`清除文件`=`*數字*`] [`清除睡眠`=`*時間*`] [`淨化閾值`=`*時間*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Sets the path and other parameters of a cache. Cache data are stored in files. The file name in a cache is a result of applying the MD5 function to the [cache key](#p-107). The `levels` parameter defines hierarchy levels of a cache: from 1 to 3, each level accepts values 1 or 2. For example, in the following configuration

設定快取的路徑和其他參數。快取資料儲存在文件中。快取中的檔名是將MD5函數套用到[快取鍵](#p-107)的結果。 `levels`參數定義了快取的層次結構層級：從1到3，每個層級接受值1或2。例如，在以下配置中

> ```
> uwsgi_cache_path /data/nginx/cache levels=1:2 keys_zone=one:10m;
> ```

file names in a cache will look like this:

快取中的檔案名稱將如下所示：

> ```
> /data/nginx/cache/c/29/b7f54b2df7773722d382f4809d65029c
>
> /data/nginx/cache/c/29/ b7f54b2df7773722d382f4809d65029c
> ```

A cached response is first written to a temporary file, and then the file is renamed. Starting from version 0.8.9, temporary files and the cache can be put on different file systems. However, be aware that in this case a file is copied across two file systems instead of the cheap renaming operation. It is thus recommended that for any given location both cache and a directory holding temporary files are put on the same file system. A directory for temporary files is set based on the `use_temp_path` parameter (1.7.10). If this parameter is omitted or set to the value `on`, the directory set by the [uwsgi\_temp\_path](#p-107) directive for the given location will be used. If the value is set to `off`, temporary files will be put directly in the cache directory.

快取回應首先寫入臨時文件，然後重新命名該文件。從版本0.8.9開始，臨時檔案和快取可以位於不同的檔案系統上。但是請注意，在這種情況下，檔案會被複製到兩個檔案系統上，而不是進行簡單的重新命名操作。因此，建議對於任何給定的位置，快取和存放臨時檔案的目錄都位於同一檔案系統上。暫存檔案目錄的設定是基於`use_temp_path`參數（ 1.7.10 ）。如果省略此參數或將其設為`on` ，則將使用 [uwsgi\_temp\_path](#p-107)指令為給定位置設定的目錄。如果將其設定為`off` ，則暫存檔案將直接放置在快取目錄中。

In addition, all active keys and information about data are stored in a shared memory zone, whose `*name*` and `*size*` are configured by the `keys_zone` parameter. One megabyte zone can store about 8 thousand keys.

此外，所有活動金鑰和資料資訊都儲存在一個共享記憶體區域中，該區域的`*name*`和`*size*`由`keys_zone`參數配置。一個兆位元組的區域大約可以儲存8000個密鑰。

> As part of [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx), the shared memory zone also stores extended cache [information](#p-048), thus, it is required to specify a larger zone size for the same number of keys. For example, one megabyte zone can store about 4 thousand keys.
>
> 作為[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，共享記憶體區域也會儲存擴充快取[資訊](#p-048) ，因此，對於相同數量的鍵，需要指定更大的區域大小。例如，1兆位元組的區域大約可以儲存4000個鍵。

Cached data that are not accessed during the time specified by the `inactive` parameter get removed from the cache regardless of their freshness. By default, `inactive` is set to 10 minutes.

在`inactive`參數指定的時間內未存取的快取資料將從快取中刪除，無論其新鮮度為何。預設情況下，`inactive` 設定為 10 分鐘。

The special “cache manager” process monitors the maximum cache size set by the `max_size` parameter, and the minimum amount of free space set by the `min_free` (1.19.1) parameter on the file system with cache. When the size is exceeded or there is not enough free space, it removes the least recently used data. The data is removed in iterations configured by `manager_files`, `manager_threshold`, and `manager_sleep` parameters (1.11.5). During one iteration no more than `manager_files` items are deleted (by default, 100). The duration of one iteration is limited by the `manager_threshold` parameter (by default, 200 milliseconds). Between iterations, a pause configured by the `manager_sleep` parameter (by default, 50 milliseconds) is made.

特殊的「快取管理器」程序會監控由`max_size`參數設定的最大快取大小，以及由`min_free` （ 1.19.1 ）參數設定的檔案系統快取的最小可用空間。當快取大小超過限製或可用空間不足時，它會刪除最近最少使用的資料。資料刪除的迭代次數由`manager_files`, `manager_threshold`和`manager_sleep`參數（ 1.11.5 ）配置。每次迭代最多刪除`manager_files`個項目（預設值為100）。每次迭代的持續時間由`manager_threshold`參數限制（預設值為200毫秒）。在兩次迭代之間，會執行由`manager_sleep`參數配置的暫停（預設值為50毫秒）。

A minute after the start the special “cache loader” process is activated. It loads information about previously cached data stored on file system into a cache zone. The loading is also done in iterations. During one iteration no more than `loader_files` items are loaded (by default, 100). Besides, the duration of one iteration is limited by the `loader_threshold` parameter (by default, 200 milliseconds). Between iterations, a pause configured by the `loader_sleep` parameter (by default, 50 milliseconds) is made.

啟動一分鐘後，特殊的「快取載入器」進程將會啟動。它會將先前儲存在檔案系統中的快取資料資訊載入到快取區域。載入過程也以迭代方式進行。每次迭代最多載入`loader_files`個項目（預設值為100）。此外，每次迭代的持續時間由`loader_threshold`參數限制（預設值為200毫秒）。在兩次迭代之間，會執行由`loader_sleep`參數配置的暫停（預設值為50毫秒）。

Additionally, the following parameters are available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx):

此外，以下參數包含在我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)中：

`purger`\=`on`|`off`

Instructs whether cache entries that match a [wildcard key](#p-107) will be removed from the disk by the cache purger (1.7.12). Setting the parameter to `on` (default is `off`) will activate the “cache purger” process that permanently iterates through all cache entries and deletes the entries that match the wildcard key.

指示是否由快取清除程序（ 1.7.12 ）從磁碟中刪除與 [通配符鍵](#p-107)相符的快取條目。將此參數設為`on` （預設值為`off` ）將啟動“快取清除程序”，該程式會永久遍歷所有快取條目並刪除與通配符鍵相符的條目。

`purger_files`\=`*number*`

Sets the number of items that will be scanned during one iteration (1.7.12). By default, `purger_files` is set to 10.

設定單次迭代中要掃描的物品數量（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_files`設定為 10。

`purger_threshold`\=`*number*`

Sets the duration of one iteration (1.7.12). By default, `purger_threshold` is set to 50 milliseconds.

設定一次迭代的持續時間（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_threshold`設定為 50 毫秒。

`purger_sleep`\=`*number*`

Sets a pause between iterations (1.7.12). By default, `purger_sleep` is set to 50 milliseconds.

設定迭代之間的暫停時間（ 1.7.12 ）。預設情況下， `purger_sleep`設定為 50 毫秒。

> In versions 1.7.3, 1.7.7, and 1.11.10 cache header format has been changed. Previously cached responses will be considered invalid after upgrading to a newer nginx version.
>
> 在版本1.7.3, 1.7.7和1.11.10中，快取頭格式已變更。升級到更新的nginx版本後，先前快取的回應將被視為無效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**uwsgi_cache_purge** string ...;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Defines conditions under which the request will be considered a cache purge request. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the cache entry with a corresponding [cache key](#p-107) is removed. The result of successful operation is indicated by returning the 204 (No Content) response.

定義請求被視為快取清除請求的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則會刪除具有對應 [快取鍵](#p-107)的快取條目。操作成功後，將返回 204（無內容）回應。

If the [cache key](#p-107) of a purge request ends with an asterisk (“`*`”), all cache entries matching the wildcard key will be removed from the cache. However, these entries will remain on the disk until they are deleted for either [inactivity](#p-107), or processed by the [cache purger](#p-107) (1.7.12), or a client attempts to access them.

如果清除請求的 [快取鍵](#p-107)以星號 (“ `*` ”) 結尾，則所有與該通配符鍵相符的快取條目都會從快取中刪除。但是，這些條目將保留在磁碟上，直到因 [不活動](#p-107)而被刪除，或被 [快取清除程序](#p-107) ( 1.7.12 ) 處理，或用戶端嘗試存取它們為止。

Example configuration:

設定範例：

> ```
> uwsgi_cache_path /data/nginx/cache keys_zone=cache_zone:10m;
> 
> map $request_method $purge_method {
>
> 映射 $request_method $purge_method {
>     PURGE   1;
>     default 0;
>
>     預設值為 0；
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     ...
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         uwsgi_pass        backend;
>
>         uwsgi_pass 後端；
>         uwsgi_cache       cache_zone;
>
>         uwsgi_cache 快取區；
>         uwsgi_cache_key   $uri;
>
>         uwsgi_cache_key $uri;
>         uwsgi_cache_purge $purge_method;
>     }
> }
> ```

> This functionality is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此功能作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_cache_revalidate</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_cache_revalidate off;<br>關閉 uwsgi_cache_revalidate；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Enables revalidation of expired cache items using conditional requests with the “If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自） and “If-None-Match”（如果無匹配） header fields.

允許使用帶有“If-Modified-Since”（如果修改自）和“If-None-Match”（如果無匹配）標頭欄位的條件請求重新驗證過期的快取項目。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_cache_use_stale</strong> <code>error<br>錯誤</code> | <code>timeout<br>暫停</code> | <code>invalid_header<br>無效標頭</code> | <code>updating<br>更新</code> | <code>http_500</code> | <code>http_503</code> | <code>http_403</code> | <code>http_404</code> | <code>http_429</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_cache_use_stale off;<br>uwsgi_cache_use_stale 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines in which cases a stale cached response can be used when an error occurs during communication with the uwsgi server. The directive’s parameters match the parameters of the [uwsgi\_next\_upstream](#p-107) directive.

確定在與 uwsgi 伺服器通訊期間發生錯誤時，哪些情況下可以使用過期的快取回應。此指令的參數與 [uwsgi\_next\_upstream](#p-107)指令的參數相符。

The `error` parameter also permits using a stale cached response if a uwsgi server to process a request cannot be selected.

如果無法選擇 uwsgi 伺服器來處理請求， `error`參數也允許使用過期的快取回應。

Additionally, the `updating` parameter permits using a stale cached response if it is currently being updated. This allows minimizing the number of accesses to uwsgi servers when updating cached data.

此外， `updating`參數允許在快取回應正在更新時使用過期的快取回應。這樣可以最大限度地減少更新快取資料時對 uwsgi 伺服器的存取次數。

Using a stale cached response can also be enabled directly in the response header for a specified number of seconds after the response became stale (1.11.10). This has lower priority than using the directive parameters.

使用過期的快取回應也可以直接在回應頭中啟用，持續指定的秒數，在回應過期後繼續使用（ 1.11.10 ）。這種方法的優先權低於使用指令參數。

-   The “[stale-while-revalidate](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-3)” extension of the “Cache-Control”（快取控制） header field permits using a stale cached response if it is currently being updated.  
    「[stale-while-revalidate](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-3) 」 “Cache-Control”（快取控制）標頭欄位的擴充功能允許在目前正在更新時使用過期的快取回應。
-   The “[stale-if-error](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-4)” extension of the “Cache-Control”（快取控制） header field permits using a stale cached response in case of an error.  
    “Cache-Control”（快取控制）標頭字段的「[stale-if-error](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5861#section-4) 」擴充功能允許在發生錯誤時使用過期的快取回應。

To minimize the number of accesses to uwsgi servers when populating a new cache element, the [uwsgi\_cache\_lock](#p-107) directive can be used.

為了在填充新的快取元素時最大限度地減少對 uwsgi 伺服器的存取次數，可以使用 [uwsgi\_cache\_lock](#p-107)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_cache_valid** [`*code*` ...] `*time*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_cache_valid** [` *代碼* ` ...] ` *時間* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Sets caching time for different response codes. For example, the following directives

設定不同回應代碼的快取時間。例如，以下指令：

> ```
> uwsgi_cache_valid 200 302 10m;
> uwsgi_cache_valid 404      1m;
>
> uwsgi_cache_valid 404 1m;
> ```

set 10 minutes of caching for responses with codes 200 and 302 and 1 minute for responses with code 404.

對代碼為 200 和 302 的回應設定 10 分鐘的快取時間，對代碼為 404 的回應設定 1 分鐘的快取時間。

If only caching `*time*` is specified

如果僅指定快取`*time*`

> ```
> uwsgi_cache_valid 5m;
>
> uwsgi_cache_valid 5分鐘；
> ```

then only 200, 301, and 302 responses are cached.

那麼只有 200、301 和 302 回應會被快取。

In addition, the `any` parameter can be specified to cache any responses:

此外，也可以指定`any`參數來快取任何回應：

> ```
> uwsgi_cache_valid 200 302 10m;
> uwsgi_cache_valid 301      1h;
>
> uwsgi_cache_valid 301 1h;
> uwsgi_cache_valid any      1m;
>
> uwsgi_cache_valid 任意 1 分鐘；
> ```

Parameters of caching can also be set directly in the response header. This has higher priority than setting of caching time using the directive.

快取參數也可以直接在回應頭中設定。這種方法的優先權高於使用指令設定快取時間。

-   The “X-Accel-Expires” header field sets caching time of a response in seconds. The zero value disables caching for a response. If the value starts with the `@` prefix, it sets an absolute time in seconds since Epoch, up to which the response may be cached.  
    “X-Accel-Expires”標頭欄位用於設定回應的快取時間（以秒為單位）。值為零時，回應將被停用快取。如果該值以`@`前綴開頭，則表示響應可緩存的絕對時間（以秒為單位，自 Unix 紀元以來）。
-   If the header does not include the “X-Accel-Expires” field, parameters of caching may be set in the header fields “Expires”（過期） or “Cache-Control”（快取控制）.  
    如果標頭不包含“X-Accel-Expires”字段，則可以在標頭字段“Expires”（過期）或“Cache-Control”（快取控制）中設定快取參數。
-   If the header includes the “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） field, such a response will not be cached.  
    如果標頭包含“Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）字段，則此類回應將不會被快取。
-   If the header includes the “Vary”（各不相同） field with the special value “`*`”, such a response will not be cached (1.7.7). If the header includes the “Vary”（各不相同） field with another value, such a response will be cached taking into account the corresponding request header fields (1.7.7).  
    如果請求頭包含具有特殊值「 `*` 」的“Vary”（各不相同）字段，則該回應不會被快取（ 1.7.7 ）。如果請求頭包含具有其他值的“Vary”（各不相同）字段，則會根據對應的請求頭字段快取該回應（ 1.7.7 ）。

Processing of one or more of these response header fields can be disabled using the [uwsgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-107) directive.

可以使用 [uwsgi\_ignore\_headers](#p-107)指令來停用對一個或多個回應標頭欄位的處理。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_connect_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_connect_timeout 60s;<br>uwsgi_connect_timeout 60秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for establishing a connection with a uwsgi server. It should be noted that this timeout cannot usually exceed 75 seconds.

定義與 uwsgi 伺服器建立連線的逾時時間。需要注意的是，此超時時間通常不能超過 75 秒。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_force_ranges</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_force_ranges off;<br>uwsgi_force_ranges 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.7.

該指令出現在版本1.7.7 。

Enables byte-range support for both cached and uncached responses from the uwsgi server regardless of the “Accept-Ranges”（接受範圍） field in these responses.

啟用對來自 uwsgi 伺服器的快取和非快取回應的位元組範圍支持，而不管這些回應中的“Accept-Ranges”（接受範圍）欄位是什麼。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_hide_header** `*field*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_hide_header** ` *字段* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

By default, nginx does not pass the header fields “Status”（地位） and “X-Accel-...” from the response of a uwsgi server to a client. The `uwsgi_hide_header` directive sets additional fields that will not be passed. If, on the contrary, the passing of fields needs to be permitted, the [uwsgi\_pass\_header](#p-107) directive can be used.

預設情況下，nginx 不會將 uwsgi 伺服器回應中的標頭欄位 “Status”（地位） 和 “X-Accel-...” 傳遞給客戶端。 `uwsgi_hide_header`指令設定不會傳遞的附加欄位。相反，如果需要允許欄位傳遞，則可以使用 [uwsgi\_pass\_header](#p-107) 指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_ignore_client_abort</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_ignore_client_abort off;<br>uwsgi_ignore_client_abort 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether the connection with a uwsgi server should be closed when a client closes the connection without waiting for a response.

確定當客戶端在未等待回應的情況下關閉與 uwsgi 伺服器的連線時，是否應該關閉與該伺服器的連線。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_ignore_headers** `*field*` ...;``<br>` `**uwsgi_ignore_headers** ` *字段* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Disables processing of certain response header fields from the uwsgi server. The following fields can be ignored: “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）, “X-Accel-Expires”, “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） (1.1.6), “X-Accel-Buffering” (1.1.6), “X-Accel-Charset” (1.1.6), “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） (0.8.44), and “Vary”（各不相同） (1.7.7).

停用對來自 uwsgi 伺服器的某些回應頭欄位的處理。可忽略以下欄位： “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）, “X-Accel-Expires”, “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） ( 1.1.6 )、 “X-Accel-Buffering” ( 1.1.6 )、 “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie） ( 0.8.44 “X-Accel-Charset” 1.1.6和“Vary”（各不相同） ( 1.7.7 )。

If not disabled, processing of these header fields has the following effect:

如果未停用，處理這些標頭欄位會產生以下效果：

-   “X-Accel-Expires”, “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）, and “Vary”（各不相同） set the parameters of response [caching](#p-107);  
    “X-Accel-Expires”, “Expires”（過期）, “Cache-Control”（快取控制）, “Set-Cookie”（設定 Cookie）和“Vary”（各不相同）設定響應 [快取](#p-107)的參數；
-   “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向） performs an [internal redirect](#p-056) to the specified URI;  
    “X-Accel-Redirect”（X-Accel-重定向）執行 [內部重定向](#p-056)到指定的URI ;
-   “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率） sets the [rate limit](#p-056) for transmission of a response to a client;  
    “X-Accel-Limit-Rate”（X-加速限制速率）設定向客戶端發送回應的 [速率限制](#p-056) ；
-   “X-Accel-Buffering” enables or disables [buffering](#p-107) of a response;  
    “X-Accel-Buffering”啟用或停用 [緩衝](#p-107)響應；
-   “X-Accel-Charset” sets the desired [charset](#p-055) of a response.  
    “X-Accel-Charset”設定響應的所需 [字元集](#p-055) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_intercept_errors</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_intercept_errors off;<br>關閉 uwsgi_intercept_errors；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether a uwsgi server responses with codes greater than or equal to 300 should be passed to a client or be intercepted and redirected to nginx for processing with the [error\_page](#p-056) directive.

確定是否應將 uwsgi 伺服器回應代碼大於或等於 300 的情況傳遞給客戶端，還是應攔截並重定向到 nginx 以使用 [error\_page](#p-056)指令進行處理。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_limit_rate</strong> <code><i>rate</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_limit_rate 0;<br>uwsgi_limit_rate 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.7.

該指令出現在版本1.7.7 。

Limits the speed of reading the response from the uwsgi server. The `*rate*` is specified in bytes per second. The zero value disables rate limiting. The limit is set per a request, and so if nginx simultaneously opens two connections to the uwsgi server, the overall rate will be twice as much as the specified limit. The limitation works only if [buffering](#p-107) of responses from the uwsgi server is enabled. Parameter value can contain variables (1.27.0).

限制從 uwsgi 伺服器讀取回應的速度。 `*rate*` 以每秒位元組數指定。零值禁用速率限制。此限制是針對每個請求設定的，因此如果 nginx 同時開啟兩個到 uwsgi 伺服器的連接，則總體速率將是指定限制的兩倍。僅當啟用了 uwsgi 伺服器回應的[緩衝](#p-107)時，此限制才會起作用。參數值可以包含變數(1.27.0)。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_max_temp_file_size</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_max_temp_file_size 1024m;<br>uwsgi_max_temp_file_size 1024m；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

When [buffering](#p-107) of responses from the uwsgi server is enabled, and the whole response does not fit into the buffers set by the [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107) and [uwsgi\_buffers](#p-107) directives, a part of the response can be saved to a temporary file. This directive sets the maximum `*size*` of the temporary file. The size of data written to the temporary file at a time is set by the [uwsgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-107) directive.

當啟用 uwsgi 伺服器回應的 [buffering](#p-107)功能時，如果整個回應無法放入 [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107)和 [uwsgi\_buffers](#p-107)在指令設定的部分緩衝區中，則可以將文件儲存到暫存區。此指令設定臨時檔案的最大`*size*`大小。每次寫入暫存檔案的資料大小由 [uwsgi\_temp\_file\_write\_size](#p-107)指令設定。

The zero value disables buffering of responses to temporary files.

零值表示停用對暫存檔案的回應緩衝。

> This restriction does not apply to responses that will be [cached](#p-107) or [stored](#p-107) on disk.
>
> 此限制不適用於將被[快取](#p-107)或[儲存](#p-107)到磁碟上的回應。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_modifier1</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_modifier1 0;<br>uwsgi_modifier1 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the value of the `modifier1` field in the [uwsgi packet header](http://uwsgi-docs.readthedocs.org/en/latest/Protocol.html#uwsgi-packet-header).

設定 [uwsgi 封包頭](http://uwsgi-docs.readthedocs.org/en/latest/Protocol.html#uwsgi-packet-header)中`modifier1`欄位的值。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_modifier2</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_modifier2 0;<br>uwsgi_modifier2 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the value of the `modifier2` field in the [uwsgi packet header](http://uwsgi-docs.readthedocs.org/en/latest/Protocol.html#uwsgi-packet-header).

設定 [uwsgi 封包頭](http://uwsgi-docs.readthedocs.org/en/latest/Protocol.html#uwsgi-packet-header)中`modifier2`欄位的值。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_next_upstream</strong> <code>error<br>錯誤</code> | <code>timeout<br>暫停</code> | <code>denied<br>否認</code> | <code>invalid_header<br>無效標頭</code> | <code>http_500</code> | <code>http_503</code> | <code>http_403</code> | <code>http_404</code> | <code>http_429</code> | <code>non_idempotent<br>不一樣</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_next_upstream error timeout;<br>uwsgi_next_upstream 錯誤逾時；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies in which cases a request should be passed to the next server:

指定在哪些情況下應將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器：

`error`

an error occurred while establishing a connection with the server, passing a request to it, or reading the response header;

與伺服器建立連線、向伺服器發送請求或讀取回應標頭時發生錯誤；

`timeout`

a timeout has occurred while establishing a connection with the server, passing a request to it, or reading the response header;

與伺服器建立連線、向伺服器發送請求或讀取回應標頭時發生逾時；

`denied`

the server [denied](#p-107) the connection (1.29.3);

伺服器[拒絕](#p-107)連線 ( 1.29.3 );

> This parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此參數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`invalid_header`

a server returned an empty or invalid response;

伺服器傳回了空響應或無效回應；

`http_500`

a server returned a response with the code 500;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 500 的回應；

`http_503`

a server returned a response with the code 503;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 503 的回應；

`http_403`

a server returned a response with the code 403;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 403 的回應；

`http_404`

a server returned a response with the code 404;

伺服器回傳了代碼為 404 的回應；

`http_429`

a server returned a response with the code 429 (1.11.13);

伺服器回傳了代碼為 429 的回應（ 1.11.13 ）；

`non_idempotent`

normally, requests with a [non-idempotent](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2) method (`POST`, `LOCK`, `PATCH`) are not passed to the next server if a request has been sent to an upstream server (1.9.13); enabling this option explicitly allows retrying such requests;

通常情況下，如果已向上游伺服器 ( 1.9.13 ) 發送請求，則具有 [非冪等](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2)方法 ( `POST`, `LOCK`, `PATCH` ) 的請求不會傳遞給下一個伺服器；明確啟用此選項允許重試此類請求；

`off`

disables passing a request to the next server.

禁用向下一個伺服器傳遞請求。

One should bear in mind that passing a request to the next server is only possible if nothing has been sent to a client yet. That is, if an error or timeout occurs in the middle of the transferring of a response, fixing this is impossible.

需要注意的是，只有在尚未向客戶端發送任何資料的情況下，才能將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器。也就是說，如果在傳輸回應的過程中發生錯誤或逾時，則無法修復。

The directive also defines what is considered an [unsuccessful attempt](#p-105) of communication with a server. The cases of `error`, `timeout`, `denied` and `invalid_header` are always considered unsuccessful attempts, even if they are not specified in the directive. The cases of `http_500`, `http_503`, and `http_429` are considered unsuccessful attempts only if they are specified in the directive. The cases of `http_403` and `http_404` are never considered unsuccessful attempts.

該指令也定義了與伺服器通訊的[不成功嘗試](#p-105)。 `error`, `timeout`, `denied` 和 `invalid_header` 的情況始終被視為不成功的嘗試，即使它們未在指令中指定。僅當指令中指定時，`http_500`, `http_503`和`http_429`的情況才被視為不成功的嘗試。 `http_403`和`http_404`的案例絕不被視為不成功的嘗試。

Passing a request to the next server can be limited by [the number of tries](#p-107) and by [time](#p-107).

向下一個伺服器傳遞請求可以受到 [嘗試次數](#p-107)和 [時間](#p-107)的限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_next_upstream_timeout</strong> <code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_next_upstream_timeout 0;<br>uwsgi_next_upstream_timeout 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.5.

該指令出現在版本1.7.5 。

Limits the time during which a request can be passed to the [next server](#p-107). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制請求傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-107)的時間。 `0` 值關閉此限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_next_upstream_tries</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_next_upstream_tries 0;<br>uwsgi_next_upstream_tries 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.5.

該指令出現在版本1.7.5 。

Limits the number of possible tries for passing a request to the [next server](#p-107). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制將請求傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-107)的可能嘗試次數。 `0` 值關閉此限制。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_no_cache** `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**uwsgi_no_cache** ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines conditions under which the response will not be saved to a cache. If at least one value of the string parameters is not empty and is not equal to “0” then the response will not be saved:

定義回應不保存到快取的條件。如果字串參數中至少有一個值不為空且不等於“0”，則回應將不會被儲存：

> ```
> uwsgi_no_cache $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment;
>
> uwsgi_no_cache $cookie_nocache $arg_nocache$arg_comment；
> uwsgi_no_cache $http_pragma    $http_authorization;
>
> uwsgi_no_cache $http_pragma $http_authorization;
> ```

Can be used along with the [uwsgi\_cache\_bypass](#p-107) directive.

可與 [uwsgi\_cache\_bypass](#p-107)指令一起使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_param</strong> <code><i>parameter<br>參數</i></code> <code><i>value<br>值</i></code> [<code>if_not_empty<br></code>];<br></code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_param HTTP_HOST $host$is_request_port$request_port;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a `*parameter*` that should be passed to the uwsgi server. The `*value*` can contain text, variables, and their combination. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `uwsgi_param` directives defined on the current level.

設定要傳遞給 uwsgi 伺服器的`*parameter*`可以包含文字、變數及其組合。僅噹噹前設定等級未定義`uwsgi_param`指令時`*value*`這些指令才會從上一個設定等級繼承。

Standard [CGI environment variables](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3875#section-4.1) should be provided as uwsgi headers, see the `uwsgi_params` file provided in the distribution:

標準 [CGI環境變數](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3875#section-4.1)應作為 uwsgi 頭檔提供，請參閱發行版中提供的`uwsgi_params`檔：

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     include uwsgi_params;
>
>     包含 uwsgi_params；
>     ...
> }
> ```

If the directive is specified with `if_not_empty` (1.1.11) then such a parameter will be passed to the server only if its value is not empty:

如果指令使用`if_not_empty` ( 1.1.11 ) 指定，則只有當該參數的值不為空時，才會將該參數傳遞給伺服器：

> ```
> uwsgi_param HTTPS $https if_not_empty;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_pass** [`*protocol*`://]`*address*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_pass** [` *協議* `://]` *地址* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `location`, `if in location` |

Sets the protocol and address of a uwsgi server. As a `*protocol*`, “`uwsgi`” or “`suwsgi`” (secured uwsgi, uwsgi over SSL) can be specified. The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, and a port:

設定 uWSGI 伺服器的協定和位址。可指定為`*protocol*` 、「 `uwsgi` 」或「 `suwsgi` 」（安全 uWSGI，基於SSL uWSGI）。位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，以及連接埠：

> ```
> uwsgi_pass localhost:9000;
> uwsgi_pass uwsgi://localhost:9000;
> uwsgi_pass suwsgi://[2001:db8::1]:9090;
>
> uwsgi_pass suwsgi://[ 2001:db8::1 ]:9090;
> ```

or as a UNIX-domain socket path:

或作為UNIX域套接字路徑：

> ```
> uwsgi_pass unix:/tmp/uwsgi.socket;
> ```

If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be used in a round-robin fashion. In addition, an address can be specified as a [server group](#p-105).

如果一個網域解析到多個位址，則所有這些位址將以輪詢方式使用。此外，可以將位址指定為 [伺服器群組](#p-105) 。

Parameter value can contain variables. In this case, if an address is specified as a domain name, the name is searched among the described [server groups](#p-105), and, if not found, is determined using a [resolver](#p-056).

參數值可以包含變數。在這種情況下，如果將位址指定為域名，則會在所描述的 [伺服器群組](#p-105)中搜尋該名稱，如果找不到，則使用 [解析器](#p-056)進行確定。

> Secured uwsgi protocol is supported since version 1.5.8.
>
> 自版本1.5.8起，支援安全的uwsgi協定。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_pass_header** `*field*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_pass_header** ` *字段* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Permits passing [otherwise disabled](#p-107) header fields from a uwsgi server to a client.

允許將 [其他停用](#p-107)標頭欄位從 uwsgi 伺服器傳遞到客戶端。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_pass_request_body</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_pass_request_body on;<br>uwsgi_pass_request_body 已啟用；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether the original request body is passed to the uwsgi server. See also the [uwsgi\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-107) directive.

指示是否將原始請求正文傳遞給 uwsgi 伺服器。另請參閱 [uwsgi\_pass\_request\_headers](#p-107)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_pass_request_headers</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_pass_request_headers on;<br>啟用 uwsgi_pass_request_headers;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether the header fields of the original request are passed to the uwsgi server. See also the [uwsgi\_pass\_request\_body](#p-107) directive.

指示是否將原始請求的標頭欄位傳遞給 uwsgi 伺服器。另請參閱 [uwsgi\_pass\_request\_body](#p-107)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_read_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_read_timeout 60s;<br>uwsgi_read_timeout 60秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for reading a response from the uwsgi server. The timeout is set only between two successive read operations, not for the transmission of the whole response. If the uwsgi server does not transmit anything within this time, the connection is closed.

定義從 uwsgi 伺服器讀取回應的逾時時間。此逾時時間僅設定在兩次連續讀取操作之間，而非整個回應的傳輸時間。如果 uwsgi 伺服器在此時間內未發送任何內容，則連線將關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_request_buffering</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_request_buffering on;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Enables or disables buffering of a client request body.

啟用或停用客戶端請求體的緩衝。

When buffering is enabled, the entire request body is [read](#p-056) from the client before sending the request to a uwsgi server.

啟用緩衝後，在將請求傳送到 uwsgi 伺服器之前，會從用戶端(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#client_body_buffer_size)整個請求體。

When buffering is disabled, the request body is sent to the uwsgi server immediately as it is received. In this case, the request cannot be passed to the [next server](#p-107) if nginx already started sending the request body.

停用緩衝後，請求體會在接收後立即傳送到 uwsgi 伺服器。在這種情況下，如果 nginx 已經開始傳送請求體，則無法將請求傳遞給下一個伺服器(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_uwsgi_module.html#uwsgi_next_upstream) 。

When HTTP/1.1 chunked transfer encoding is used to send the original request body, the request body will be buffered regardless of the directive value.

當使用HTTP/1.1分塊傳送編碼傳送原始請求體時，無論指令值為何，請求體都會被緩衝。

<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_request_dynamic</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_request_dynamic off;<br>uwsgi_request_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

Enables or disables creation of a separate request instance for each uwsgi server. By default, a single request is used for all uwsgi servers. If enabled, a separate request instance is created, allowing per-server request customization.

啟用或停用為每個 uwsgi 伺服器建立單獨的請求實例。預設情況下，所有 uwsgi 伺服器使用同一個請求。啟用後，將為每個伺服器建立一個單獨的請求實例，從而允許對每個伺服器的請求進行自訂。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_send_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_send_timeout 60s;<br>uwsgi_send_timeout 60秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a timeout for transmitting a request to the uwsgi server. The timeout is set only between two successive write operations, not for the transmission of the whole request. If the uwsgi server does not receive anything within this time, the connection is closed.

設定向 uwsgi 伺服器發送請求的逾時時間。此逾時時間僅設定在兩次連續寫入作業之間，而非整個請求的傳輸時間。如果 uwsgi 伺服器在此時間內未收到任何數據，則連線將關閉。

<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_socket_keepalive off;<br>uwsgi_socket_keepalive 關閉；</td></tr>
