This directive appeared in version 1.15.6.

該指令出現在版本1.15.6 。

Configures the “TCP keepalive” behavior for outgoing connections to a uwsgi server. By default, the operating system’s settings are in effect for the socket. If the directive is set to the value “`on`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` socket option is turned on for the socket.

配置與 uWSGI 伺服器的出站連接的「 TCP keepalive」行為。預設情況下，作業系統的設定對套接字生效。如果指令值設定為“ `on` ”，則會為套接字啟用`SO_KEEPALIVE`選項。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**uwsgi_socket_rcvbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_socket_rcvbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the receive buffer size (the `SO_RCVBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a uwsgi server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `uwsgi_socket_rcvbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定與 uwsgi 伺服器建立出站連線的接收緩衝區大小（ `SO_RCVBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`uwsgi_socket_rcvbuf`指令的效果，從而允許作業系統對套接字的設定生效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**uwsgi_socket_sndbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_socket_sndbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the send buffer size (the `SO_SNDBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a uwsgi server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `uwsgi_socket_sndbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定與 uwsgi 伺服器建立出站連線的傳送緩衝區大小（ `SO_SNDBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`uwsgi_socket_sndbuf`指令的效果，從而允許作業系統對套接字的設定生效。

| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.8.

該指令出現在版本1.7.8 。

Specifies a `*file*` with the certificate in the PEM format used for authentication to a secured uwsgi server.

指定一個`*file*` ，其憑證採用PEM格式，用於對受保護的 uwsgi 伺服器進行身份驗證。

Since version 1.21.0, variables can be used in the `*file*` name.

自版本1.21.0起，變數可以在`*file*`名稱中使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>off<br>離開</code>;</code><br><code><strong>uwsgi_ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>max<br>最大</code>=<code><i>N</i></code> [<code>inactive<br>不活躍</code>=<code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>] [<code>valid<br>有效的</code>=<code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_ssl_certificate_cache off;<br>關閉 uwsgi_ssl_certificate_cache；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.4.

該指令出現在版本1.27.4 。

Defines a cache that stores [SSL certificates](#p-107) and [secret keys](#p-107) specified with [variables](#p-107).

定義一個緩存，用於儲存 [SSL憑證](#p-107)和 [金鑰](#p-107)金鑰由 [變數](#p-107)指定。

The directive has the following parameters:

此指令具有以下參數：

`max`

sets the maximum number of elements in the cache; on cache overflow the least recently used (LRU) elements are removed;

設定快取中元素的最大數量；當快取溢出時，刪除最近最少使用的（ LRU ）元素；

`inactive`

defines a time after which an element is removed from the cache if it has not been accessed during this time; by default, it is 10 seconds;

定義一個時間段，如果該元素在這段時間內未被訪問，則將其從快取中刪除；預設值為 10 秒；

`valid`

defines a time during which an element in the cache is considered valid and can be reused; by default, it is 60 seconds. Certificates that exceed this time will be reloaded or revalidated;

定義快取中元素被視為有效且可重複使用的時間；預設值為 60 秒。超過此時間的證書將被重新載入或重新驗證；

`off`

disables the cache.

禁用緩存。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> uwsgi_ssl_certificate       $uwsgi_ssl_server_name.crt;
>
> uwsgi_ssl_certificate $uwsgi_ssl_server_name.crt;
> uwsgi_ssl_certificate_key   $uwsgi_ssl_server_name.key;
>
> uwsgi_ssl_certificate_key $uwsgi_ssl_server_name.key;
> uwsgi_ssl_certificate_cache max=1000 inactive=20s valid=1m;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**uwsgi_ssl_certificate_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_ssl_certificate_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.8.

該指令出現在版本1.7.8 。

Specifies a `*file*` with the secret key in the PEM format used for authentication to a secured uwsgi server.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含用於對受保護的 uwsgi 伺服器進行身份驗證PEM格式的金鑰。

The value `engine`:`*name*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.7.9), which loads a secret key with a specified `*id*` from the OpenSSL engine `*name*`.

可以指定值`engine`:`*name*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.7.9 )，該值會從 OpenSSL 引擎`*name*`載入具有指定`*id*`的金鑰。

The value `store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.29.0), which is used to load a secret key with a specified `*id*` and OpenSSL provider registered URI `*scheme*`, such as [`pkcs11`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512).

可指定值`store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.29.0 )，用於載入具有指定`*id*`和已註冊 OpenSSL 提供(https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512) URI `*scheme*`的金鑰，例如 [ `pkcs11`

Since version 1.21.0, variables can be used in the `*file*` name.

自版本1.21.0起，變數可以在`*file*`名稱中使用。

</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.8.

該指令出現在版本1.5.8 。

Specifies the enabled ciphers for requests to a secured uwsgi server. The ciphers are specified in the format understood by the OpenSSL library.

指定對受保護的 uwsgi 伺服器發出請求時啟用的加密套件。加密套件以 OpenSSL 庫可識別的格式指定。

The full list can be viewed using the “`openssl ciphers`” command.

可以使用「 `openssl ciphers` 」指令查看完整清單。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**uwsgi_ssl_conf_command** `*name*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**uwsgi_ssl_conf_command** ` *名稱* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |

This directive appeared in version 1.19.4.

該指令出現在版本1.19.4 。

Sets arbitrary OpenSSL configuration [commands](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) when establishing a connection with the secured uwsgi server.

在與受保護的 uwsgi 伺服器建立連線時，設定任意 OpenSSL 設定 [指令](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) 。

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，支援該指令。

Several `uwsgi_ssl_conf_command` directives can be specified on the same level. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `uwsgi_ssl_conf_command` directives defined on the current level.

同一層級可以指定多個`uwsgi_ssl_conf_command`指令。當且僅噹噹前等級未定義`uwsgi_ssl_conf_command`指令時，這些指令才會從上一個設定等級繼承。

> Note that configuring OpenSSL directly might result in unexpected behavior.
>
> 請注意，直接配置 OpenSSL 可能會導致意外行為。

| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.0.

該指令出現在版本1.7.0 。

Specifies a `*file*` with revoked certificates (CRL) in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-107) the certificate of the secured uwsgi server. When using intermediate certificates, their CRLs should be specified in the same file.

指定一個包含已吊銷憑證（ CRL ）的`*file*`其格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-107)受保護的uwsgi伺服器的憑證。使用中間憑證時，應在同一文件中指定其憑證撤銷清單（CRL）。

Enables logging of secured uwsgi server connection SSL keys and specifies the path to the key log file. Keys are logged in the [SSLKEYLOGFILE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850) format compatible with Wireshark.

啟用對安全 uwsgi 伺服器連線的金鑰進行日誌記錄SSL ，並指定金鑰日誌檔案的路徑。密鑰以與 Wireshark 相容的 [SSLKEYLOGFILE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850) ）格式記錄。

This directive appeared in version 1.7.0.

Allows overriding the server name used to [verify](#p-107) the certificate of the secured uwsgi server and to be [passed through SNI](#p-107) when establishing a connection with the secured uwsgi server.

允許覆蓋用於[驗證](#p-107)受保護的 uwsgi 伺服器憑證的伺服器名稱，並在與受保護的 uwsgi 伺服器建立連接時[透過SNI](#p-107)傳遞。

By default, the host part from [uwsgi\_pass](#p-107) is used.

預設情況下，使用 [uwsgi\_pass](#p-107)中的主機部分。

<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_ssl_verify_depth</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_ssl_verify_depth 1;<br>uwsgi_ssl_verify_depth 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.0.

該指令出現在版本1.7.0 。

Sets the verification depth in the secured uwsgi server certificates chain.

設定受保護的 uwsgi 伺服器憑證鏈中的驗證深度。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_store</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code> | <code><i>string<br></i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_store off;<br>uwsgi_store 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables saving of files to a disk. The `on` parameter saves files with paths corresponding to the directives [alias](#p-056) or [root](#p-056). The `off` parameter disables saving of files. In addition, the file name can be set explicitly using the `*string*` with variables:

允許將檔案儲存到磁碟。 `on`參數保存與指令[alias](#p-056)或[root](#p-056)相對應的路徑的檔案。 `off` 參數禁用檔案保存。此外，可以使用帶有變數的`*string*`明確設定檔名：

> ```
> uwsgi_store /data/www$original_uri;
> ```

The modification time of files is set according to the received “Last-Modified”（最後修改日期） response header field. The response is first written to a temporary file, and then the file is renamed. Starting from version 0.8.9, temporary files and the persistent store can be put on different file systems. However, be aware that in this case a file is copied across two file systems instead of the cheap renaming operation. It is thus recommended that for any given location both saved files and a directory holding temporary files, set by the [uwsgi\_temp\_path](#p-107) directive, are put on the same file system.

檔案的修改時間根據接收的“Last-Modified”（最後修改日期）回應頭字段設定。回應首先寫入臨時文件，然後重新命名該文件。從0.8.9版本開始，暫存檔案和持久化儲存可以位於不同的檔案系統上。但是請注意，在這種情況下，檔案會複製到兩個檔案系統上，而不是執行簡單的重新命名操作。因此，建議對於任何給定的位置，已儲存的檔案和由 [uwsgi\_temp\_path](#p-107)指令設定的暫存檔案目錄都位於同一檔案系統上。

This directive can be used to create local copies of static unchangeable files, e.g.:

此指令可用於建立靜態不可更改檔案的本機副本，例如：

> ```
> location /images/ {
>     root               /data/www;
>
>     根目錄 /data/www;
>     error_page         404 = /fetch$uri;
>
>     error_page 404 = /fetch$uri;
> }
> 
> location /fetch/ {
>     internal;
>
>     內部的;
> 
>     uwsgi_pass         backend:9000;
>
>     uwsgi_pass backend:9000;
>     ...
> 
>     uwsgi_store        on;
>
>     uwsgi_store 已開啟；
>     uwsgi_store_access user:rw group:rw all:r;
>
>     uwsgi_store_access 使用者:rw 群組:rw 所有:r;
>     uwsgi_temp_path    /data/temp;
>
>     uwsgi_temp_path /data/temp;
> 
>     alias              /data/www/;
>
>     別名 /data/www/;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_store_access</strong> <code><i>users<br>用戶</i></code>:<code><i>permissions<br>權限</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_store_access user:rw;<br>uwsgi_store_access 使用者：讀寫；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets access permissions for newly created files and directories, e.g.:

設定新檔案和目錄的存取權限，例如：

> ```
> uwsgi_store_access user:rw group:rw all:r;
>
> uwsgi_store_access 使用者:rw 群組:rw 所有:r;
> ```

If any `group` or `all` access permissions are specified then `user` permissions may be omitted:

如果指定了任何`group`或`all`存取權限，則可以省略`user`權限：

> ```
> uwsgi_store_access group:rw all:r;
>
> uwsgi_store_access 群組:rw 所有:r;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_temp_file_write_size</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_temp_file_write_size 8k|16k;<br>uwsgi_temp_file_write_size 8k|16k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Limits the `*size*` of data written to a temporary file at a time, when buffering of responses from the uwsgi server to temporary files is enabled. By default, `*size*` is limited by two buffers set by the [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107) and [uwsgi\_buffers](#p-107) directives. The maximum size of a temporary file is set by the [uwsgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-107) directive.

啟用 uwsgi 伺服器回應緩衝到臨時檔案功能時，限制每次寫入暫存檔案的資料量`*size*` 。預設情況下， `*size*`受限於 [uwsgi\_buffer\_size](#p-107)和 [uwsgi\_buffers](#p-107)指令設定的兩個緩衝區大小。暫存檔案的最大大小由 [uwsgi\_max\_temp\_file\_size](#p-107)指令設定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>uwsgi_temp_path</strong> <code><i>path<br>小路</i></code> [<code><i>level1<br>一級</i></code> [<code><i>level2<br>二級</i></code> [<code><i>level3<br>3級</i></code>]]];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>uwsgi_temp_path uwsgi_temp;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a directory for storing temporary files with data received from uwsgi servers. Up to three-level subdirectory hierarchy can be used underneath the specified directory. For example, in the following configuration

定義一個用於儲存從 uwsgi 伺服器接收的資料的暫存檔案的目錄。指定的目錄下最多可以使用三級子目錄結構。例如，在以下配置中

> ```
> uwsgi_temp_path /spool/nginx/uwsgi_temp 1 2;
> ```

a temporary file might look like this:

臨時文件可能如下所示：

> ```
> /spool/nginx/uwsgi_temp/7/45/00000123457
> ```

See also the `use_temp_path` parameter of the [uwsgi\_cache\_path](#p-107) directive.

另請參閱 [uwsgi\_cache\_path](#p-107)指令的`use_temp_path`參數。

##### Module ngx_http_v2_module｜模組 ngx_http_v2_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_v2_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_v2\_module｜模組 ngx_http_v2_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Known Issues](#p-108)<br>[Example Configuration](#p-108)<br>[Directives](#p-108)<br>     [http2](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_body\_preread\_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_chunk\_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_idle\_timeout](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_max\_concurrent\_pushes](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_max\_concurrent\_streams](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_max\_field\_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_max\_header\_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_max\_requests](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_push](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_push\_preload](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_recv\_buffer\_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_recv\_timeout](#p-108)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-108)<br>[已知問題](#p-108)<br>[範例配置](#p-108)<br>[指示](#p-108)<br>     [http2](#p-108)<br>     [http2_body_preread_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2_chunk_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2_idle_timeout](#p-108)<br>     [http2_max_concurrent_pushes](#p-108)<br>     [http2_max_concurrent_streams](#p-108)<br>     [http2_max_field_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2_max_header_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2_max_requests](#p-108)<br>     [http2\_push](#p-108)<br>     [http2_push_preload](#p-108)<br>     [http2_recv_buffer_size](#p-108)<br>     [http2_recv_timeout](#p-108)<br>[嵌入式變數](#p-108) |

The `ngx_http_v2_module` module (1.9.5) provides support for [HTTP/2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7540).

`ngx_http_v2_module`模組 ( 1.9.5 ) 為 [HTTP /2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7540)提供支援。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_v2_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_v2_module`配置參數啟用。

**Known Issues｜已知問題**

Before version 1.9.14, buffering of a client request body could not be disabled regardless of [proxy\_request\_buffering](#p-085), [fastcgi\_request\_buffering](#p-060), [uwsgi\_request\_buffering](#p-107), and [scgi\_request\_buffering](#p-091) directive values.

之前的版本 1.9.14無論 [proxy\_request\_buffering] 設定如何，都無法停用客戶端請求體的緩衝。(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_request_buffering)[fastcgi_request_buffering](#p-060), [uwsgi\_request\_buffering](#p-107)以及 [scgi\_request\_buffering](#p-091) 指令值。

Before version 1.19.1, the [lingering\_close](#p-056) mechanism was not used to control closing HTTP/2 connections.

在版本1.19.1之前，[lingering\_close](#p-056)機制未用於控制關閉HTTP /2 連接。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
> 
>     http2 on;
>
>     http2 已開啟；
> 
>     ssl_certificate server.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key server.key;
> }
> ```

Note that accepting HTTP/2 connections over TLS requires the “Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation”（應用層協定協商） (ALPN) TLS extension support, which is available since [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/) version 1.0.2.

請注意，接受透過TLS HTTP /2 連接需要“Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation”（應用層協定協商） ( ALPN (http://www.openssl.org/) TLS 1.0.2起可用。

Also note that if the [ssl\_prefer\_server\_ciphers](#p-098) directive is set to the value “`on`”, the [ciphers](#p-098) should be configured to comply with [RFC 9113, Appendix A](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9113#appendix-A) black list and supported by clients.

另請注意，如果 [ssl\_prefer\_server\_ciphers](#p-098)指令設定為值“ `on` ”，則 [ciphers](#p-098)應配置為符合 [ RFC 9113，附錄 A (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9113#appendix-A)

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2 off;<br>HTTP/2 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.25.1.

該指令出現在版本1.25.1 。

Enables the [HTTP/2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9113) protocol.

啟用 [HTTP /2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9113)協定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_body_preread_size</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_body_preread_size 64k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.11.0.

該指令出現在版本1.11.0 。

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer per each request in which the request body may be saved before it is started to be processed.

設定每個請求的緩衝區`*size*` ，請求體可以在開始處理之前儲存。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_chunk_size</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_chunk_size 8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum size of chunks into which the response body is sliced. A too low value results in higher overhead. A too high value impairs prioritization due to [HOL blocking](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Head-of-line_blocking).

設定響應體被切分成的最大塊大小。值太小會導致開銷過大。值太大會因為 [HOL阻塞](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Head-of-line_blocking)而影響優先權。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_idle_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_idle_timeout 3m;<br>http2_idle_timeout 3分鐘；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

> This directive is obsolete since version 1.19.7. The [keepalive\_timeout](#p-056) directive should be used instead.
>
> 此指令自版本1.19.7起已過時。應改用[keepalive\_timeout](#p-056)指令。

Sets the timeout of inactivity after which the connection is closed.

設定連線在無活動逾時時間後關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_max_concurrent_pushes</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_max_concurrent_pushes 10;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.13.9.

該指令出現在版本1.13.9 。

> This directive is obsolete since version 1.25.1.
>
> 該指令自版本1.25.1起已過時。

Limits the maximum number of concurrent [push](#p-108) requests in a connection.

限制連線中並發 [push](#p-108)請求的最大數量。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_max_concurrent_streams</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_max_concurrent_streams 128;<br>http2_max_concurrent_streams 128；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum number of concurrent HTTP/2 streams in a connection.

設定連接中並發HTTP /2 流的最大數量。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_max_field_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_max_field_size 4k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

> This directive is obsolete since version 1.19.7. The [large\_client\_header\_buffers](#p-056) directive should be used instead.
>
> 此指令自版本1.19.7起已過時。應改用[large\_client\_header\_buffers](#p-056)指令。

Limits the maximum size of an [HPACK](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7541)\-compressed request header field. The limit applies equally to both name and value. Note that if Huffman encoding is applied, the actual size of decompressed name and value strings may be larger. For most requests, the default limit should be enough.

限制 [HPACK](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7541)壓縮請求頭字段的最大長度。此限制同樣適用於名稱和值。請注意，如果應用了霍夫曼編碼，則解壓縮後的名稱和值字串的實際長度可能會更大。對於大多數請求，預設限制應該足夠了。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_max_header_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_max_header_size 16k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

> This directive is obsolete since version 1.19.7. The [large\_client\_header\_buffers](#p-056) directive should be used instead.
>
> 此指令自版本1.19.7起已過時。應改用[large\_client\_header\_buffers](#p-056)指令。

Limits the maximum size of the entire request header list after [HPACK](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7541) decompression. For most requests, the default limit should be enough.

限制 [HPACK](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7541)解壓縮後整個請求頭列表的最大長度。對於大多數請求，預設限制應該足夠了。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_max_requests</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_max_requests 1000;<br>http2_max_requests 1000；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.11.6.

該指令出現在版本1.11.6 。

> This directive is obsolete since version 1.19.7. The [keepalive\_requests](#p-056) directive should be used instead.
>
> 此指令自版本1.19.7起已過時。應改用[keepalive\_requests](#p-056)指令。

Sets the maximum number of requests (including [push](#p-108) requests) that can be served through one HTTP/2 connection, after which the next client request will lead to connection closing and the need of establishing a new connection.

設定一個HTTP /2 連線可以處理的最大請求數（包括 [push](#p-108)請求），之後下一個客戶端請求將導致連線關閉，需要建立新的連線。

Closing connections periodically is necessary to free per-connection memory allocations. Therefore, using too high maximum number of requests could result in excessive memory usage and not recommended.

定期關閉連線對於釋放每個連線佔用的記憶體至關重要。因此，設定過高的最大請求數可能會導致記憶體使用過量，不建議這樣做。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_push</strong> <code><i>uri</i></code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_push off;<br>http2_push 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.13.9.

該指令出現在版本1.13.9 。

> This directive is obsolete since version 1.25.1. The [early\_hints](#p-056) directive can be used instead.
>
> 此指令自版本1.25.1起已過時。可改用[early\_hints](#p-056)指令。

Pre-emptively sends ([pushes](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9113#section-8.4)) a request to the specified `*uri*` along with the response to the original request. Only relative URIs with absolute path will be processed, for example:

預先向指定的`*uri*`發送請求（[推送](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9113#section-8.4) ），同時發送對原始請求的回應。僅處理具有絕對路徑的相對 URI，例如：

> ```
> http2_push /static/css/main.css;
> ```

The `*uri*` value can contain variables.

`*uri*`值可以包含變數。

Several `http2_push` directives can be specified on the same configuration level. The `off` parameter cancels the effect of the `http2_push` directives inherited from the previous configuration level.

可以在同一組態層級上指定多個 `http2_push` 指令。 `off` 參數取消了從先前設定等級繼承的 `http2_push` 指令的效果。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_push_preload</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_push_preload off;<br>http2_push_preload 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.13.9.

該指令出現在版本1.13.9 。

> This directive is obsolete since version 1.25.1.
>
> 該指令自版本1.25.1起已過時。

Enables automatic conversion of [preload links](https://www.w3.org/TR/preload/#server-push-http-2) specified in the “Link”（關聯） response header fields into [push](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9113#section-8.4) requests.

啟用將“Link”（關聯）回應頭欄位中指定的 [預先載入連結](https://www.w3.org/TR/preload/#server-push-http-2)自動轉換為 [推送](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9113#section-8.4)請求。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_recv_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_recv_buffer_size 256k;<br>http2_recv_buffer_size 256k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the size of the per [worker](#p-125) input buffer.

設定每個 [worker](#p-125)輸入緩衝區的大小。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http2_recv_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http2_recv_timeout 30s;<br>http2_recv_timeout 30秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

> This directive is obsolete since version 1.19.7. The [client\_header\_timeout](#p-056) directive should be used instead.
>
> 此指令自版本1.19.7起已過時。應改用[client\_header\_timeout](#p-056)指令。

Sets the timeout for expecting more data from the client, after which the connection is closed.

設定等待客戶端傳回更多資料的逾時時間，逾時後連線將會關閉。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_v2_module` module supports the following embedded variables:

`ngx_http_v2_module`模組支援以下嵌入式變數：

`$http2`

negotiated protocol identifier: “`h2`” for HTTP/2 over TLS, “`h2c`” for HTTP/2 over cleartext TCP, or an empty string otherwise.

協商協議標識符：「 `h2` 」表示透過HTTP進行TLS /2傳輸，「 `h2c` 」表示透過明文HTTP進行TCP /2，否則為空。

<a id="p-109"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_v3_module｜模組 ngx_http_v3_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_v3_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_v3\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_v3\_模組

|   |
| --- |
| [Known Issues](#p-109)<br>[Example Configuration](#p-109)<br>[Directives](#p-109)<br>     [http3](#p-109)<br>     [http3\_hq](#p-109)<br>     [http3\_max\_concurrent\_streams](#p-109)<br>     [http3\_stream\_buffer\_size](#p-109)<br>     [quic\_active\_connection\_id\_limit](#p-109)<br>     [quic\_bpf](#p-109)<br>     [quic\_gso](#p-109)<br>     [quic\_host\_key](#p-109)<br>     [quic\_retry](#p-109)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-109)<br>[已知問題](#p-109)<br>[範例配置](#p-109)<br>[指示](#p-109)<br>     [http3](#p-109)<br>     [http3\_hq](#p-109)<br>     [http3_max_concurrent_streams](#p-109)<br>     [http3_stream_buffer_size](#p-109)<br>     [快速活動連線 ID 限制](#p-109)<br>     [quic\_bpf](#p-109)<br>     [quic\_gso](#p-109)<br>     [quic\_host\_key](#p-109)<br>     [快速重試](#p-109)<br>[嵌入式變數](#p-109) |

The `ngx_http_v3_module` module (1.25.0) provides experimental support for [HTTP/3](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9114).

`ngx_http_v3_module`模組 ( 1.25.0 ) 為 [HTTP /3](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9114)提供實驗支援。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_v3_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_v3_module`配置參數啟用。

> This module requires the [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/) library version 1.1.1 or higher.
>
> 本模組需要 [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/)函式庫版本1.1.1或更高版本。

> 0-RTT support requires the [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/) library version 3.5.1 or higher. Alternatively, [BoringSSL](https://boringssl.googlesource.com/boringssl), [LibreSSL](https://www.libressl.org/), or [QuicTLS](https://github.com/quictls/openssl) libraries can be used to build and run this module.
>
> 0- RTT支援需要 [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/)函式庫版本3.5.1或更高版本。或者，可以使用 [BoringSSL](https://boringssl.googlesource.com/boringssl) 、[LibreSSL](https://www.libressl.org/)或 [QuicTLS](https://github.com/quictls/openssl)函式庫來建置和運行此模組。

**Known Issues｜已知問題**

The module is experimental, caveat emptor applies.

此模組為實驗性模組，請自行承擔風險。

Before version 1.29.1, 0-RTT support could not be enabled with OpenSSL regardless of the [ssl\_early\_data](#p-098) directive value.

在版本1.29.1之前，無論 [ssl\_early\_data](#p-098)指令值為何，都無法使用 OpenSSL 啟用 0- RTT支援。

The module cannot be built on the Win32 platform.

該模組無法在 Win32 平台上建置。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> http {
>     log_format quic '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] '
>                     '"$request" $status $body_bytes_sent '
>                     '"$http_referer" "$http_user_agent" "$http3"';
> 
>     access_log logs/access.log quic;
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         # for better compatibility it's recommended｜為了獲得更好的兼容性，建議這樣做。
>         # to use the same port for http/3 and https｜HTTP/3 和 HTTPS 使用相同的連接埠
>         listen 8443 quic reuseport;
>
>         監聽 8443 快速重複使用連接埠；
>         listen 8443 ssl;
>
>         監聽 8443 ssl；
> 
>         ssl_certificate     certs/example.com.crt;
>
>         ssl_certificate certs/example.com.crt;
>         ssl_certificate_key certs/example.com.key;
> 
>         location / {
>
>         地點 / {
>             # used to advertise the availability of HTTP/3｜用於宣傳HTTP /3 的供應情況
>             add_header Alt-Svc 'h3=":8443"; ma=86400';
>
>             add_header Alt-Svc 'h3=":8443";馬=86400'；
>         }
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http3</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http3 on;<br>啟用 HTTP3；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables [HTTP/3](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9114) protocol negotiation.

啟用 [HTTP /3](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9114)協議協商。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http3_hq</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http3_hq off;<br>http3_hq 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables HTTP/0.9 protocol negotiation used in [QUIC interoperability tests](https://github.com/marten-seemann/quic-interop-runner).

啟用 [QUIC互通性測試](https://github.com/marten-seemann/quic-interop-runner)中使用的HTTP/0.9協定協商。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>http3_max_concurrent_streams</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http3_max_concurrent_streams 128;<br>http3_max_concurrent_streams 128；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum number of concurrent HTTP/3 request streams in a connection.

設定連線中並發HTTP /3 請求流的最大數量。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>http3_stream_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>http3_stream_buffer_size 64k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the size of the buffer used for reading and writing of the QUIC streams.

設定用於讀取和寫入QUIC流的緩衝區大小。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>quic_active_connection_id_limit</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>quic_active_connection_id_limit 2;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the QUIC `active_connection_id_limit` transport parameter value. This is the maximum number of client connection IDs which can be stored on the server.

設定QUIC `active_connection_id_limit`傳輸參數值。這是伺服器上可以儲存的客戶端連接ID的最大數量。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>quic_bpf</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>quic_bpf off;<br>quic_bpf 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables routing of QUIC packets using [eBPF](https://ebpf.io/). When enabled, this allows supporting QUIC connection migration.

啟用使用 [eBPF](https://ebpf.io/)路由QUIC封包。啟用後，即可支援QUIC連線遷移。

> The directive is only supported on Linux 5.7+.
>
> 該指令僅在 Linux 5.7 + 上支援。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>quic_gso</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>quic_gso off;<br>quic_gso 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables sending in optimized batch mode using segmentation offloading.

啟用分段卸載功能，以最佳化的批次模式發送資料。

> Optimized sending is supported only on Linux featuring `UDP_SEGMENT`.
>
> 優化發送僅在配備`UDP_SEGMENT`的 Linux 系統上支援。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**quic_host_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**quic_host_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server` |

Sets a `*file*` with the secret key used to encrypt stateless reset and address validation tokens. By default, a random key is generated on each reload. Tokens generated with old keys are not accepted.

設定一個`*file*`其中包含用於加密無狀態重設令牌和地址驗證令牌的金鑰。預設情況下，每次重新載入時都會產生一個隨機金鑰。使用舊密鑰產生的令牌將不被接受。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>quic_retry<br>快速重試</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>quic_retry off;<br>快速重試關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables the [QUIC Address Validation](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9000#name-address-validation) feature. This includes sending a new token in a `Retry` packet or a `NEW_TOKEN` frame and validating a token received in the `Initial` packet.

啟用 [QUIC位址驗證](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9000#name-address-validation)功能。這包括在`Retry`封包或`NEW_TOKEN`幀中發送新令牌，並驗證在`Initial`封包中收到的令牌。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_http_v3_module` module supports the following embedded variables:

`ngx_http_v3_module`模組支援以下嵌入式變數：

`$http3`

negotiated protocol identifier: “`h3`” for HTTP/3 connections, “`hq`” for hq connections, or an empty string otherwise.

協商的協議標識符：「 `h3` 」用於HTTP /3 連接，「 `hq` 」用於總部連接，否則為空字串。

<a id="p-110"></a>

##### Module ngx_http_xslt_module｜模組 ngx_http_xslt_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_xslt_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_http\_xslt\_module｜模組 ngx\_http\_xslt\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-110)<br>[Directives](#p-110)<br>     [xml\_entities](#p-110)<br>     [xml\_external\_entities](#p-110)<br>     [xslt\_last\_modified](#p-110)<br>     [xslt\_param](#p-110)<br>     [xslt\_string\_param](#p-110)<br>     [xslt\_stylesheet](#p-110)<br>     [xslt\_types](#p-110)<br>[範例配置](#p-110)<br>[指示](#p-110)<br>     [xml_entities](#p-110)<br>     [xml\_external\_entities](#p-110)<br>     [xslt\_last\_modified](#p-110)<br>     [xslt\_param](#p-110)<br>     [xslt\_string\_param](#p-110)<br>     [xslt_stylesheet](#p-110)<br>     [xslt_types](#p-110) |

The `ngx_http_xslt_module` (0.7.8+) is a filter that transforms XML responses using one or more XSLT stylesheets.

`ngx_http_xslt_module` ( 0.7.8 +) 是一個過濾器，它使用一個或多個XSLT樣式表轉換XML響應。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-http_xslt_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-http_xslt_module`配置參數啟用。

> This module requires the [libxml2](http://xmlsoft.org/) and [libxslt](http://xmlsoft.org/XSLT/) libraries.
>
> 本模組需要 [libxml2](http://xmlsoft.org/)和 [libxslt](http://xmlsoft.org/XSLT/)函式庫。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     xml_entities    /site/dtd/entities.dtd;
>
>     xml_entities /site/dtd/entities.dtd;
>     xslt_stylesheet /site/xslt/one.xslt param=value;
>     xslt_stylesheet /site/xslt/two.xslt;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**xml_entities** `*path*`;``<br>` `**xml_entities** ` *路徑* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Specifies the DTD file that declares character entities. This file is compiled at the configuration stage. For technical reasons, the module is unable to use the external subset declared in the processed XML, so it is ignored and a specially defined file is used instead. This file should not describe the XML structure. It is enough to declare just the required character entities, for example:

指定聲明字元實體的DTD檔案。此文件在配置階段編譯。由於技術原因，模組無法使用已處理的XML中聲明的外部子集，因此該檔案將被忽略，並改用一個專門定義的檔案。此文件不應描述XML結構。只需聲明所需的字元實體即可，例如：

> ```xml
> <!ENTITY nbsp "&#xa0;">
>
> <! ENTITY nbsp "&#xa0;">
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>xml_external_entities</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>xml_external_entities off;<br>關閉 xml_external_entities;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Enables or disables loading of external entities declared in the internal DTD subset of the processed XML. Only loading of file-based external entities is supported.

啟用或停用載入在已處理的DTD的內部XML子集中聲明的外部實體。僅支援載入基於檔案的外部實體。

> To prevent reading arbitrary local files accessible to the worker process, it is recommended to enable external entities only when the processed XML is trusted.
>
> 為防止讀取工作進程可存取的任意本機文件，建議僅在受信任處理的XML時才啟用外部實體。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>xslt_last_modified</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>xslt_last_modified off;<br>xslt_last_modified 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.1.

該指令出現在版本1.5.1 。

Allows preserving the “Last-Modified”（最後修改日期） header field from the original response during XSLT transformations to facilitate response caching.

允許在XSLT轉換期間保留原始回應的“Last-Modified”（最後修改日期）標頭字段，以方便回應快取。

By default, the header field is removed as contents of the response are modified during transformations and may contain dynamically generated elements or parts that are changed independently of the original response.

預設情況下，標頭欄位會被刪除，因為回應的內容在轉換過程中會被修改，並且可能包含動態產生的元素或部分，這些元素或部分會獨立於原始回應而變更。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**xslt_param** `*parameter*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**xslt_param** ` *參數* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.1.18.

該指令出現在版本1.1.18 。

Defines the parameters for XSLT stylesheets. The `*value*` is treated as an XPath expression. The `*value*` can contain variables. To pass a string value to a stylesheet, the [xslt\_string\_param](#p-110) directive can be used.

定義XSLT表的參數。 `*value*`將被視為 XPath 表達式。 `*value*`可以包含變數。要將字串值傳遞給樣式表，可以使用(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_xslt_module.html#xslt_string_param) [xslt\_string\_param]。

There could be several `xslt_param` directives. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `xslt_param` and [xslt\_string\_param](#p-110) directives defined on the current level.

可能存在多個`xslt_param`指令。當且僅噹噹前等級未定義`xslt_param`和 [xslt\_string\_param](#p-110)指令時，這些指令才會從上一個設定等級繼承。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**xslt_string_param** `*parameter*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**xslt_string_param** ` *參數* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

This directive appeared in version 1.1.18.

該指令出現在版本1.1.18 。

Defines the string parameters for XSLT stylesheets. XPath expressions in the `*value*` are not interpreted. The `*value*` can contain variables.

定義 XSLT 樣式表的字串參數。 `*value*` 中的 XPath 表達式不會被解釋。 `*value*` 可以包含變數。

There could be several `xslt_string_param` directives. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no [xslt\_param](#p-110) and `xslt_string_param` directives defined on the current level.

可能存在多個`xslt_string_param`指令。當且僅噹噹前等級未定義 [xslt\_param](#p-110)和`xslt_string_param`指令時，這些指令才會從上一個組態等級繼承。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**xslt_stylesheet** `*stylesheet*` [`*parameter*`=`*value*` ...];``<br>` `**xslt_stylesheet** ` *樣式表* ` [` *參數* `=` *值* ` ...];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>上下文： | `location` |

Defines the XSLT stylesheet and its optional parameters. A stylesheet is compiled at the configuration stage.

定義XSLT樣式表及其可選參數。樣式表在配置階段編譯。

Parameters can either be specified separately, or grouped in a single line using the “`:`” delimiter. If a parameter includes the “`:`” character, it should be escaped as “`%3A`”. Also, `libxslt` requires to enclose parameters that contain non-alphanumeric characters into single or double quotes, for example:

參數可以單獨指定，也可以使用「 `:` 」分隔符號將它們分組到一行中。如果參數包含「 `:` 」字符，則應將其轉義為「 `%3A` 」。此外， `libxslt`要求將包含非字母數字字元的參數以單引號或雙引號括起來，例如：

> ```
> param1='http%3A//www.example.com':param2=value2
> ```

The parameters description can contain variables, for example, the whole line of parameters can be taken from a single variable:

參數描述可以包含變量，例如，整行參數都可以取自單一變數：

> ```
> location / {
>
> 地點 / {
>     xslt_stylesheet /site/xslt/one.xslt
>                     $arg_xslt_params
>                     param1='$value1':param2=value2
>                     param3=value3;
> }
> ```

It is possible to specify several stylesheets. They will be applied sequentially in the specified order.

可以指定多個樣式表。它們將按照指定的順序依次應用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>xslt_types</strong> <code><i>mime-type</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>xslt_types text/xml;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables transformations in responses with the specified MIME types in addition to “`text/xml`”. The special value “`*`” matches any MIME type (0.8.29). If the transformation result is an HTML response, its MIME type is changed to “`text/html`”.

除了「 `text/xml` 」類型外，還允許對具有指定MIME類型的回應進行轉換。特殊值“ `*` ”匹配任何MIME類型（ 0.8.29 ）。如果轉換結果是HTML響應，則其MIME類型將變更為「 `text/html` 」。

---

<a id="p-111"></a>

##### How nginx processes a request｜nginx 如何處理請求

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/request_processing.html>

###### How nginx processes a request｜nginx 如何處理請求

|   |
| --- |
| [How to prevent processing requests with undefined server names](#p-111)<br>[Mixed name-based and IP-based virtual servers](#p-111)<br>[A simple PHP site configuration](#p-111)<br>[如何防止處理未定義伺服器名稱的請求](#p-111)<br> [混合使用基於名稱和IP的虛擬伺服器](#p-111)<br> [簡單的PHP網站設定](#p-111) |

**Name-based virtual servers｜基於名稱的虛擬伺服器**

nginx first decides which *server* should process the request. Let’s start with a simple configuration where all three virtual servers listen on port \*:80:

nginx 首先決定由哪個伺服器處理請求。我們先來看一個簡單的配置，其中三個虛擬伺服器都監聽 \*:80 連接埠：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name example.org www.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.org www.example.org;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name example.net www.example.net;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.net www.example.net;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name example.com www.example.com;
>     ...
> }
> ```

In this configuration nginx tests only the request’s header field “Host”（主持人） to determine which server the request should be routed to. If its value does not match any server name, or the request does not contain this header field at all, then nginx will route the request to the default server for this port. In the configuration above, the default server is the first one — which is nginx’s standard default behaviour. It can also be set explicitly which server should be default, with the `default_server` parameter in the [listen](#p-056) directive:

在此配置中，nginx 僅檢查請求頭中的“Host”（主持人）欄位來決定請求應路由到哪個伺服器。如果其值與任何伺服器名稱都不匹配，或者請求根本不包含此請求頭字段，則 nginx 會將請求路由到該連接埠的預設伺服器。在上面的設定中，預設伺服器是第一個伺服器——這是 nginx 的標準預設行為。也可以在 [listen](#p-056)指令中使用`default_server`參數明確設定預設伺服器：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      80 default_server;
>
>     監聽 80 埠預設伺服器；
>     server_name example.net www.example.net;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.net www.example.net;
>     ...
> }
> ```

> The `default_server` parameter has been available since version 0.8.21. In earlier versions the `default` parameter should be used instead.
>
> `default_server`參數自0.8.21版本起可用。在早期版本中，應使用`default`參數。

Note that the default server is a property of the listen port and not of the server name. More about this later.

請注意，預設伺服器是監聽連接埠的屬性，而不是伺服器名稱的屬性。稍後會詳細介紹。

**How to prevent processing requests with undefined server names｜如何防止處理包含未定義伺服器名稱的請求**

If requests without the “Host”（主持人） header field should not be allowed, a server that just drops the requests can be defined:

如果不應該允許缺少“Host”（主持人）標頭欄位的請求，可以定義一個直接丟棄這些請求的伺服器：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name "";
>
>     伺服器名稱“”；
>     return      444;
>
>     返回 444；
> }
> ```

Here, the server name is set to an empty string that will match requests without the “Host”（主持人） header field, and a special nginx’s non-standard code 444 is returned that closes the connection.

在這裡，伺服器名稱被設定為空字串，這將匹配沒有“Host”（主持人）標頭欄位的請求，並傳回一個特殊的 nginx 非標準代碼 444，以關閉連線。

> Since version 0.8.48, this is the default setting for the server name, so the `server_name ""` can be omitted. In earlier versions, the machine’s *hostname* was used as a default server name.
>
> 自版本0.8.48起，伺服器名稱的預設設定已啟用，因此可以省略`server_name ""` 。在早期版本中，預設伺服器名稱使用機器的*主機名稱*。

**Mixed name-based and IP-based virtual servers｜混合基於名稱和IP的虛擬伺服器**

Let’s look at a more complex configuration where some virtual servers listen on different addresses:

讓我們來看一個更複雜的配置，其中一些虛擬伺服器監聽不同的位址：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      192.168.1.1:80;
>
>     列表192.168.1.1:80 ;
>     server_name example.org www.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.org www.example.org;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      192.168.1.1:80;
>
>     聽192.168.1.1:80 ;
>     server_name example.net www.example.net;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.net www.example.net;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      192.168.1.2:80;
>
>     聽192.168.1.2:80 ;
>     server_name example.com www.example.com;
>     ...
> }
> ```

In this configuration, nginx first tests the IP address and port of the request against the [listen](#p-056) directives of the [server](#p-056) blocks. It then tests the “Host”（主持人） header field of the request against the [server\_name](#p-056) entries of the [server](#p-056) blocks that matched the IP address and port. If the server name is not found, the request will be processed by the default server. For example, a request for `www.example.com` received on the 192.168.1.1:80 port will be handled by the default server of the 192.168.1.1:80 port, i.e., by the first server, since there is no `www.example.com` defined for this port.

在此設定中，nginx 首先IP請求的位址和連接埠與 [server] 區塊中的 [listen](#p-056)進行比對。然後，它將請求的“Host”（主持人）欄位與 [server] 區塊中匹配IP和連接埠的 [ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#server_name)  條目](#p-056)比對。如果找不到符合的伺服器名稱，則請求將由預設伺服器處理。例如， `www.example.com`收到對192.168.1.1:80的請求(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#server)則該請求將由連接埠的192.168.1.1:80伺服器（即第一個伺服器）處理，因為該連接埠沒有定義`www.example.com`伺服器。

As already stated, a default server is a property of the listen port, and different default servers may be defined for different ports:

如前所述，預設伺服器是監聽連接埠的一個屬性，不同的連接埠可以定義不同的預設伺服器：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      192.168.1.1:80;
>
>     聽192.168.1.1:80 ;
>     server_name example.org www.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.org www.example.org;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      192.168.1.1:80 default_server;
>
>     監聽192.168.1.1:80預設伺服器；
>     server_name example.net www.example.net;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.net www.example.net;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      192.168.1.2:80 default_server;
>
>     監聽192.168.1.2:80預設伺服器；
>     server_name example.com www.example.com;
>     ...
> }
> ```

**A simple PHP site configuration｜一個簡單的PHP站點配置**

Now let’s look at how nginx chooses a *location* to process a request for a typical, simple PHP site:

現在讓我們來看看nginx如何為一個典型的、簡單的PHP網站選擇一個*location*來處理請求：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name example.org www.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.org www.example.org;
>     root        /data/www;
>
>     根目錄 /data/www;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         index   index.html index.php;
>
>         index index.html index.php;
>     }
> 
>     location ~* \.(gif|jpg|png)$ {
>         expires 30d;
>
>         有效期限30天；
>     }
> 
>     location ~ \.php$ {
>         fastcgi_pass  localhost:9000;
>
>         fastcgi_pass localhost:9000;
>         fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME
>
>         fastcgi_param 腳本檔名
>                       $document_root$fastcgi_script_name;
>         include       fastcgi_params;
>
>         包含 fastcgi_params；
>     }
> }
> ```

nginx first searches for the most specific prefix location given by literal strings regardless of the listed order. In the configuration above the only prefix location is “`/`” and since it matches any request it will be used as a last resort. Then nginx checks locations given by regular expression in the order listed in the configuration file. The first matching expression stops the search and nginx will use this location. If no regular expression matches a request, then nginx uses the most specific prefix location found earlier.

nginx 首先會搜尋由字串字面值指定的最具體的前綴位置，而不管其列出的順序為何。在上面的配置中，唯一的前綴位置是“ `/` ”，由於它匹配任何請求，因此將作為最後的選擇。然後，nginx 會按照設定檔中列出的順序檢查正規表示式指定的位置。第一個匹配的表達式將停止搜索，nginx 將使用該位置。如果沒有正規表示式來符合任何請求，則 nginx 將使用先前找到的最具體的前綴位置。

Note that locations of all types test only a URI part of request line without arguments. This is done because arguments in the query string may be given in several ways, for example:

請注意，所有類型的位置僅測試請求行中不帶參數的部分URI 。這是因為查詢字串中的參數可以透過多種方式提供，例如：

> ```
> /index.php?user=john&page=1
> /index.php?page=1&user=john
> ```

Besides, anyone may request anything in the query string:

此外，任何人都可以在查詢字串中請求任何內容：

> ```
> /index.php?page=1&something+else&user=john
> ```

Now let’s look at how requests would be processed in the configuration above:

現在讓我們來看看在上述配置下請求將如何處理：

-   A request “`/logo.gif`” is matched by the prefix location “`/`” first and then by the regular expression “`\.(gif|jpg|png)$`”, therefore, it is handled by the latter location. Using the directive “`root /data/www`” the request is mapped to the file `/data/www/logo.gif`, and the file is sent to the client.  
    請求“ `/logo.gif` ”首先與前綴位置“ `/` ”匹配，然後與正則表達式“ `\.(gif|jpg|png)$` ”匹配，因此，它由後一個位置處理。使用指令“ `root /data/www` ”，該請求被對應到檔案`/data/www/logo.gif` ”，並將該檔案傳送給客戶端。
-   A request “`/index.php`” is also matched by the prefix location “`/`” first and then by the regular expression “`\.(php)$`”. Therefore, it is handled by the latter location and the request is passed to a FastCGI server listening on localhost:9000. The [fastcgi\_param](#p-060) directive sets the FastCGI parameter `SCRIPT_FILENAME` to “`/data/www/index.php`”, and the FastCGI server executes the file. The variable `$document_root` is equal to the value of the [root](#p-056) directive and the variable `$fastcgi_script_name` is equal to the request URI, i.e. “`/index.php`”.  
    請求“ `/index.php` ”首先匹配前綴位置“ `/` ”，然後匹配正規表示式“ `\.(php)$` ”。因此，它由後一個位置處理，並將請求傳遞給監聽 localhost:9000 的 FastCGI 伺服器。 [fastcgi\_param](#p-060)指令將 FastCGI 參數`SCRIPT_FILENAME`設定為“ `/data/www/index.php` ”，FastCGI 伺服器執行此檔案。變數`$document_root`等於 [root](#p-056)指令的值，變數`$fastcgi_script_name`等於請求URI ，即「 `/index.php` 」。
-   A request “`/about.html`” is matched by the prefix location “`/`” only, therefore, it is handled in this location. Using the directive “`root /data/www`” the request is mapped to the file `/data/www/about.html`, and the file is sent to the client.  
    請求“ `/about.html` ”僅與前綴位置“ `/` ”匹配，因此，它將在該位置處理。使用指令“ `root /data/www` ”，該請求被對應到檔案`/data/www/about.html` ，並將該檔案傳送給客戶端。
-   Handling a request “`/`” is more complex. It is matched by the prefix location “`/`” only, therefore, it is handled by this location. Then the [index](#p-071) directive tests for the existence of index files according to its parameters and the “`root /data/www`” directive. If the file `/data/www/index.html` does not exist, and the file `/data/www/index.php` exists, then the directive does an internal redirect to “`/index.php`”, and nginx searches the locations again as if the request had been sent by a client. As we saw before, the redirected request will eventually be handled by the FastCGI server.  
    處理請求「 `/` 」更為複雜。它僅與前綴位置“ `/` ”匹配，因此由該位置處理。然後，[index](#p-071)指令會根據其參數和「 `root /data/www` 」指令檢查索引檔案是否存在。如果檔案「 `/data/www/index.html` 」不存在，而檔案`/data/www/index.php` 」存在，則該指令會將請求內部重定向到“ `/index.php` ”，nginx 會再次搜尋這些位置，就好像該請求是由客戶端發送的一樣。如前所述，重定向後的請求最終將由 FastCGI 伺服器處理。

|   |
| --- |
| written by Igor Sysoev<br>edited by Brian Mercer<br>作者：Igor Sysoev <br>編輯：Brian Mercer |

---

<a id="p-112"></a>

##### Server names｜伺服器名稱

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/server_names.html>

###### Server names｜伺服器名稱

|   |
| --- |
| [Wildcard names](#p-112)<br>[Regular expressions names](#p-112)<br>[Miscellaneous names](#p-112)<br>[Internationalized names](#p-112)<br>[Virtual server selection](#p-112)<br>[Optimization](#p-112)<br>[Compatibility](#p-112)<br>[通配符名稱](#p-112)<br>[正規表示式名稱](#p-112)<br>[其他名稱](#p-112)<br>[國際化名稱](#p-112)<br>【虛擬伺服器選擇】(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/server_names.html#virtual_server_selection)<br>[最佳化](#p-112)<br>[相容性](#p-112) |

Server names are defined using the [server\_name](#p-056) directive and determine which [server](#p-056) block is used for a given request. See also “[How nginx processes a request](#p-111)”. They may be defined using exact names, wildcard names, or regular expressions:

伺服器名稱使用 `[server\_name](#p-056)指令定義，並決定給定請求使用哪個 `[server](#p-056)程式碼區塊。另請參閱「[nginx 如何處理請求](#p-111) 」。伺服器名稱可以使用精確名稱、通配符名稱或正規表示式定義：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  example.org  www.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.org www.example.org;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  *.example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 *.example.org;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  mail.*;
>
>     伺服器名稱 mail.*;
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  ~^(?<user>.+)\.example\.net$;
>
>     server_name ~^(? <user> .+)\.example\.net$;
>     ...
> }
> ```

The search is performed in the following order of priority and terminates on the first matching variant:

搜尋按以下優先順序執行，並在找到第一個符合項目時終止：

1.  the exact name  
    確切名稱
2.  the longest wildcard name starting with an asterisk, e.g. “`*.example.org`”  
    以星號開頭的最長通配符名稱，例如“ `*.example.org` ”
3.  the longest wildcard name ending with an asterisk, e.g. “`mail.*`”  
    最長的通配符名稱以星號結尾，例如“ `mail.*` ”
4.  the first matching regular expression (in order of appearance in the configuration file)  
    第一個符合的正規表示式（按在設定檔中出現的順序）

**Wildcard names｜通配符名稱**

A wildcard name may contain an asterisk only on the name’s start or end, and only on a dot border. The names “`www.*.example.org`” and “`w*.example.org`” are invalid. However, these names can be specified using regular expressions, for example, “`~^www\..+\.example\.org$`” and “`~^w.*\.example\.org$`”. An asterisk can match several name parts. The name “`*.example.org`” matches not only `www.example.org` but `www.sub.example.org` as well.

通配符名稱只能在名稱的開頭或結尾包含星號，且星號只能位於點狀邊框內。名稱「 `www.*.example.org` 」和「 `w*.example.org` 」無效。但是，可以使用正規表示式指定這些名稱，例如「 `~^www\..+\.example\.org$` 」和「 `~^w.*\.example\.org$` 」。一個星號可以匹配名稱的多個部分。名稱「 `*.example.org` 」不僅符合`www.example.org` ，還符合`www.sub.example.org` 。

A special wildcard name in the form “`.example.org`” can be used to match both the exact name “`example.org`” and the wildcard name “`*.example.org`”.

可以使用特殊通配符名稱“ `.example.org` ”來匹配精確名稱“ `example.org` ”和通配符名稱“ `*.example.org` ”。

**Regular expressions names｜正規表示式名稱**

The regular expressions used by nginx are compatible with those used by the Perl programming language (PCRE). To use a regular expression, the server name must start with the tilde character:

nginx 使用的正規表示式與 Perl 程式語言 ( PCRE ) 使用的正規表示式相容。若要使用正規表示式，伺服器名稱必須以波浪號 (~) 開頭：

> ```
> server_name  ~^www\d+\.example\.net$;
>
> server_name ~^www\d+\.example\.net$;
> ```

otherwise it will be treated as an exact name, or if the expression contains an asterisk, as a wildcard name (and most likely as an invalid one). Do not forget to set “`^`” and “`$`” anchors. They are not required syntactically, but logically. Also note that domain name dots should be escaped with a backslash. A regular expression containing the characters “`{`” and “`}`” should be quoted:

否則，它將被視為精確名稱；如果表達式包含星號，則會被視為通配符名稱（很可能被視為無效名稱）。請務必設定「 `^` 」和「 `$` 」錨點。它們在語法上並非必需，但在邏輯上是必要的。另請注意，網域中的點號應使用反斜線進行轉義。包含字元「 `{` 」和「 `}` 」的正規表示式應使用引號括起來。

> ```
> server_name  "~^(?<name>\w\d{1,3}+)\.example\.net$";
>
> server_name "~^(? <name> \w\d{1,3}+)\.example\.net$";
> ```

otherwise nginx will fail to start and display the error message:

否則 nginx 將無法啟動並顯示錯誤訊息：

> ```
> directive "server_name" is not terminated by ";" in ...
>
> 指令“server_name”未以“;”結尾…
> ```

A named regular expression capture can be used later as a variable:

命名後的正規表示式捕獲結果可以稍後用作變數：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     server_name   ~^(www\.)?(?<domain>.+)$;
>
>     server_name ~^(www\.)?(? <domain> .+)$;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         root   /sites/$domain;
>
>         根 /sites/$domain;
>     }
> }
> ```

The captures can also be used in positional form:

捕獲也可以以位置形式使用：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     server_name   ~^(www\.)?(.+)$;
>
>     server_name ~^(www\.)?(.+)$;
> 
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         root   /sites/$2;
>
>         根 /sites/$2;
>     }
> }
> ```

However, such usage should be limited to simple cases (like the above), since positional captures are easily overwritten by other regular expressions. See “[Regular expression captures](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html)” for the named capture syntax and for details on how long captured values stay available.

然而，這種用法應僅限於簡單情況（如上例），因為位置捕獲很容易被其他正規表示式覆蓋。有關命名捕獲語法以及捕獲值保留時間的詳細信息，請參閱“[正則表達式捕獲](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html) ”。

**Miscellaneous names｜雜項名稱**

There are some server names that are treated specially.

有些伺服器名稱會被特殊處理。

If it is required to process requests without the “Host”（主持人） header field in a [server](#p-056) block which is not the default, an empty name should be specified:

如果需要在 [server](#p-056)區塊中處理不包含“Host”（主持人）標頭欄位（非預設值）的請求，則應指定一個空名稱：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  example.org  www.example.org  "";
>
>     server_name example.org www.example.org "";
>     ...
> }
> ```

If no [server\_name](#p-056) is defined in a [server](#p-056) block then nginx uses the empty name as the server name.

如果 [server](#p-056)區塊中沒有定義 [server\_name](#p-056) ，則 nginx 使用空名稱作為伺服器名稱。

> nginx versions up to 0.8.48 used the machine’s hostname as the server name in this case.
>
> 在這種情況下，nginx 版本0.8.48使用機器的主機名稱作為伺服器名稱。

If a server name is defined as “`$hostname`” (0.9.4), the machine’s hostname is used.

如果伺服器名稱定義為「 `$hostname` 」（ 0.9.4 ），則使用機器的主機名稱。

If someone makes a request using an IP address instead of a server name, the “Host”（主持人） request header field will contain the IP address and the request can be handled using the IP address as the server name:

如果有人使用IP位址而不是伺服器名稱發出請求，則“Host”（主持人）請求頭字段將包含IP位址，並且可以使用IP位址作為伺服器名稱來處理該請求：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  example.org
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.org
>                  www.example.org
>                  ""
>                  192.168.1.1
>                  ;
>     ...
> }
> ```

In catch-all server examples the strange name “`_`” can be seen:

在通用伺服器範例中，可以看到奇怪的名稱「 `_` 」：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80  default_server;
>
>     監聽 80 埠預設伺服器；
>     server_name  _;
>
>     伺服器名稱_;
>     return       444;
>
>     返回 444；
> }
> ```

There is nothing special about this name, it is just one of a myriad of invalid domain names which never intersect with any real name. Other invalid names like “`--`” and “`!@#`” may equally be used.

這個網域沒什麼特別的，它只是無數無效網域中的一個，這些無效網域永遠不會與任何真實名稱相交。其他無效域名，例如“ `--` ”和“ `!@#` ”，也可以使用。

nginx versions up to 0.6.25 supported the special name “`*`” which was erroneously interpreted to be a catch-all name. It never functioned as a catch-all or wildcard server name. Instead, it supplied the functionality that is now provided by the [server\_name\_in\_redirect](#p-056) directive. The special name “`*`” is now deprecated and the [server\_name\_in\_redirect](#p-056) directive should be used. Note that there is no way to specify the catch-all name or the default server using the [server\_name](#p-056) directive. This is a property of the [listen](#p-056) directive and not of the [server\_name](#p-056) directive. See also “[How nginx processes a request](#p-111)”. It is possible to define servers listening on ports \*:80 and \*:8080, and direct that one will be the default server for port \*:8080, while the other will be the default for port \*:80:

nginx 版本直至0.6.25支援特殊名稱“ `*` ”，該名稱曾被錯誤地解釋為通配符名稱。它從未用作通配符或通用伺服器名稱。相反，它提供的功能現在由 [server_name_in_redirect](#p-056)指令提供。特殊名稱「 `*` 」現已棄用，應使用 [server_name_in_redirect](#p-056)指令。請注意，無法使用 [server_name](#p-056)指令指定通配符名稱或預設伺服器。這是 [listen](#p-056)指令的屬性，而不是 [server_name](#p-056)指令的屬性。另請參閱「[nginx 如何處理請求](#p-111) 」。可定義監聽連接埠 \*:80 和 \*:8080 的伺服器，並指定其中一個伺服器為連接埠 \*:8080 的預設伺服器，而另一個伺服器作為連接埠 \*:80 的預設伺服器：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     listen       8080  default_server;
>
>     監聽 8080 預設伺服器；
>     server_name  example.net;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.net；
>     ...
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80  default_server;
>
>     監聽 80 埠預設伺服器；
>     listen       8080;
>
>     聽 8080；
>     server_name  example.org;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.org；
>     ...
> }
> ```

**Internationalized names｜國際化名稱**

Internationalized domain names ([IDNs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internationalized_domain_name)) should be specified using an ASCII (Punycode) representation in the [server\_name](#p-056) directive:

國際化網域名稱（[IDN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internationalized_domain_name) ）應在 [server\_name](#p-056)指令中使用ASCII （Punycode）表示形式指定：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  xn--e1afmkfd.xn--80akhbyknj4f;  # пример.испытание
>
>     server_name xn--e1afmkfd.xn--80akhbyknj4f; # example.test
>     ...
> }
> ```

**Virtual server selection｜虛擬伺服器選擇**

First, a connection is created in a default server context. Then, the server name can be determined in the following request processing stages, each involved in server configuration selection:

首先，在預設伺服器上下文中建立連線。然後，可以在以下請求處理階段確定伺服器名稱，每個階段都涉及伺服器設定選擇：

-   during SSL handshake, in advance, according to [SNI](#p-042)  
    在SSL握手期間，提前根據[SNI](#p-042)
    
-   after processing the request line  
    處理完請求行後
    
-   after processing the `Host` header field  
    處理完`Host`標頭欄位後
    
-   if the server name was not determined after processing the request line or from the `Host` header field, nginx will use the empty name as the server name.  
    如果在處理請求行或從`Host`標頭欄位中未確定伺服器名稱，nginx 將使用空名稱作為伺服器名稱。
    

At each of these stages, different server configurations can be applied. As such, certain directives should be specified with caution:

在每個階段，都可以套用不同的伺服器配置。因此，某些指令的指定應格外謹慎：

-   in case of the [ssl\_protocols](#p-098) directive, the protocol list can be applied from a virtual server configuration only if supported by the underlying library (OpenSSL 1.1.1 or higher, BoringSSL, AWS-LC). For the libraries not listed above, the protocol list is set before the server configuration could be applied according to SNI, thus, protocols should be specified only for a default server;  
    對於 [ssl\_protocols](#p-098)指令，協定清單只能在底層函式庫（OpenSSL 1.1.1或更高版本、BoringSSL AWS-LC ）支援的情況下，才能從虛擬伺服器設定中套用。對於未列出的庫，協議列表需要在應用伺服器配置之前根據SNI進行設置，因此，協議應該只針對預設伺服器指定；
-   in case of the [ssl\_session\_cache](#p-098), [ssl\_session\_tickets](#p-098), [ssl\_session\_timeout](#p-098), and, consequently, [ssl\_early\_data](#p-098) directives, SSL sessions are always resumed from the default server context, thus, the directives should be specified only for a default server;  
    對於 [ssl\_session\_cache](#p-098) 、[ssl\_session\_tickets](#p-098) 、[ssl\_session\_timeout](#p-098)以及對應的 [ssl\_early\_data](#p-098) SSL會話始終從預設伺服器上下文恢復，因此，這些指令應該只針對預設伺服器指定；
-   the [client\_header\_buffer\_size](#p-056) and [merge\_slashes](#p-056) directives are involved before reading the request line, thus, such directives use a default server configuration or the server configuration chosen by SNI;  
    [client\_header\_buffer\_size](#p-056)和 [merge\_slashes](#p-056)指令在讀取請求行之前執行，因此，此類指令使用預設伺服器設定或SNI選擇的伺服器設定；
-   in case of the [ignore\_invalid\_headers](#p-056), [large\_client\_header\_buffers](#p-056), and [underscores\_in\_headers](#p-056) directives involved in processing request header fields, it additionally depends whether the server configuration was updated according to the request line or the `Host` header field;  
    對於處理請求標頭欄位時涉及的 [ignore\_invalid\_headers](#p-056) 、 [large\_client\_header\_buffers](#p-056)和 [underscores\_in `Host` (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#underscores_in_headers)指示
-   an error response will be handled with the [error\_page](#p-056) directive in the server that currently fulfills the request.  
    錯誤回應將使用目前執行請求的伺服器中的 [error\_page](#p-056)指令進行處理。

**Optimization｜最佳化**

Exact names, wildcard names starting with an asterisk, and wildcard names ending with an asterisk are stored in three hash tables bound to the listen ports. The sizes of hash tables are optimized at the configuration phase so that a name can be found with the fewest CPU cache misses. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

精確名稱、以星號開頭的通配符名稱和以星號結尾的通配符名稱儲存在綁定到監聽連接埠的三個雜湊表中。哈希表的大小在配置階段進行最佳化，以便以最少的CPU未命中次數找到名稱。哈希表的設定詳情請參閱(https://nginx.org/en/docs/hash.html)的文件。

The exact names hash table is searched first. If a name is not found, the hash table with wildcard names starting with an asterisk is searched. If the name is not found there, the hash table with wildcard names ending with an asterisk is searched.

首先搜尋精確名稱哈希表。如果找不到該名稱，則搜尋以星號開頭的通配符名稱雜湊表。如果仍然找不到該名稱，則搜尋以星號結尾的通配符名稱雜湊表。

Searching wildcard names hash table is slower than searching exact names hash table because names are searched by domain parts. Note that the special wildcard form “`.example.org`” is stored in a wildcard names hash table and not in an exact names hash table.

搜尋通配符名稱哈希表比搜尋精確名稱哈希表要慢，因為名稱是按網域部分進行搜尋的。請注意，特殊通配符形式「 `.example.org` 」儲存在通配符名稱雜湊表中，而不是精確名稱雜湊表中。

Regular expressions are tested sequentially and therefore are the slowest method and are non-scalable.

正規表示式是按順序測試的，因此是最慢的方法，而且不具備可擴展性。

For these reasons, it is better to use exact names where possible. For example, if the most frequently requested names of a server are `example.org` and `www.example.org`, it is more efficient to define them explicitly:

因此，最好盡可能使用確切的名稱。例如，如果伺服器最常被要求的名稱是`example.org`和`www.example.org` ，那麼明確定義它們會更有效率：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  example.org  www.example.org  *.example.org;
>
>     server_name example.org www.example.org *.example.org;
>     ...
> }
> ```

than to use the simplified form:

而不是使用簡化形式：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       80;
>
>     聽 80；
>     server_name  .example.org;
>
>     server_name.example.org;
>     ...
> }
> ```

If a large number of server names are defined, or unusually long server names are defined, tuning the [server\_names\_hash\_max\_size](#p-056) and [server\_names\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-056) directives at the *http* level may become necessary. The default value of the [server\_names\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-056) directive may be equal to 32, or 64, or another value, depending on CPU cache line size. If the default value is 32 and server name is defined as “`too.long.server.name.example.org`” then nginx will fail to start and display the error message:

如果定義了大量伺服器名稱，或伺服器名稱異常長，則可能需要在 *http* 層級調整 [server\_names\_hash\_max\_size](#p-056)和 [server\_names\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-056)指令。 [server\_names\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-056)指令的預設值可能等於 32、64 或其他值，取決於CPU快取行大小。如果預設值為 32 且伺服器名稱定義為“ `too.long.server.name.example.org` ”，則 nginx 將無法啟動並顯示錯誤訊息：

> ```
> could not build the server_names_hash,
>
> 無法建置 server_names_hash，
> you should increase server_names_hash_bucket_size: 32
>
> 您應該將 server_names_hash_bucket_size 的值增加到 32。
> ```

In this case, the directive value should be increased to the next power of two:

在這種情況下，指令值應該會增加到下一個 2 的冪：

> ```
> http {
>     server_names_hash_bucket_size  64;
>
>     server_names_hash_bucket_size 64;
>     ...
> ```

If a large number of server names are defined, another error message will appear:

如果定義了大量伺服器名稱，則會出現另一個錯誤訊息：

> ```
> could not build the server_names_hash,
>
> 無法建置 server_names_hash，
> you should increase either server_names_hash_max_size: 512
>
> 您應該增加 server_names_hash_max_size: 512
> or server_names_hash_bucket_size: 32
>
> 或 server_names_hash_bucket_size: 32
> ```

In such a case, first try to set [server\_names\_hash\_max\_size](#p-056) to a number close to the number of server names. Only if this does not help, or if nginx’s start time is unacceptably long, try to increase [server\_names\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-056).

在這種情況下，首先嘗試將 [server\_names\_hash\_max\_size](#p-056)設定為接近伺服器名稱數量的數字。只有當這沒有幫助，或 nginx 的啟動時間過長時，才嘗試增加 [server\_names\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-056) 。

If a server is the only server for a listen port, then nginx will not test server names at all (and will not build the hash tables for the listen port). However, there is one exception. If a server name is a regular expression with captures, then nginx has to execute the expression to get the captures.

如果某個伺服器是監聽連接埠的唯一伺服器，那麼 nginx 將完全不會測試伺服器名稱（也不會為該監聽連接埠建立雜湊表）。但是，有一種例外情況。如果伺服器名稱是包含捕獲資訊的正規表示式，那麼 nginx 必須執行該表達式才能取得捕獲資訊。

**Compatibility｜相容性**

-   The special server name “`$hostname`” has been supported since 0.9.4.  
    自0.9.4以來，已支援特殊伺服器名稱「 `$hostname` 」。
-   A default server name value is an empty name “” since 0.8.48.  
    預設伺服器名稱值為空名稱“”，因為0.8.48 。
-   Named regular expression server name captures have been supported since 0.8.25.  
    自0.8.25起，已支援命名正規表示式伺服器名稱擷取。
-   Regular expression server name captures have been supported since 0.7.40.  
    自0.7.40起，已支援正規表示式伺服器名稱擷取。
-   An empty server name “” has been supported since 0.7.12.  
    自0.7.12起，已支援空伺服器名稱「」。
-   A wildcard server name or regular expression has been supported for use as the first server name since 0.6.25.  
    自0.6.25起，支援使用通配符伺服器名稱或正規表示式作為第一個伺服器名稱。
-   Regular expression server names have been supported since 0.6.7.  
    自0.6.7以來，一直支援正規表示式伺服器名稱。
-   Wildcard form `example.*` has been supported since 0.6.0.  
    自0.6.0起，已支援通配符形式`example.*` 。
-   The special form `.example.org` has been supported since 0.3.18.  
    自0.3.18起，已支持特殊形式`.example.org` 。
-   Wildcard form `*.example.org` has been supported since 0.1.13.  
    自0.1.13起，已支援通配符形式`*.example.org` 。

<a id="p-113"></a>

##### WebSocket proxying｜WebSocket代理

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/websocket.html>

###### WebSocket proxying｜WebSocket代理

To turn a connection between a client and server from HTTP/1.1 into WebSocket, the [protocol switch](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2616#section-14.42) mechanism available in HTTP/1.1 is used.

要將客戶端與伺服器之間的連線從HTTP/1.1轉換為 WebSocket，可以使用HTTP/1.1中提供的 [協定切換](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2616#section-14.42)機制。

There is one subtlety however: since the “Upgrade”（升級） is a [hop-by-hop](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2616#section-13.5.1) header, it is not passed from a client to proxied server. With forward proxying, clients may use the `CONNECT` method to circumvent this issue. This does not work with reverse proxying however, since clients are not aware of any proxy servers, and special processing on a proxy server is required.

然而，這裡有一個微妙之處：由於“Upgrade”（升級）是逐跳(https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2616#section-13.5.1)頭部，它不會從客戶端傳遞到代理伺服器。對於正向代理，客戶端可以使用`CONNECT`方法來規避這個問題。但是，這在反向代理中行不通，因為客戶端不知道任何代理伺服器，而且需要在代理伺服器上進行特殊處理。

Since version 1.3.13, nginx implements special mode of operation that allows setting up a tunnel between a client and proxied server if the proxied server returned a response with the code 101 (Switching Protocols), and the client asked for a protocol switch via the “Upgrade”（升級） header in a request.

自版本1.3.13起，nginx 實現了一種特殊的運行模式，允許在客戶端和代理伺服器之間建立隧道，前提是代理伺服器回傳了程式碼為 101（切換協定）的回應，並且客戶端透過請求中的“Upgrade”（升級）標頭請求了協定切換。

As noted above, hop-by-hop headers including “Upgrade”（升級） and “Connection”（聯繫） are not passed from a client to proxied server, therefore in order for the proxied server to know about the client’s intention to switch a protocol to WebSocket, these headers have to be passed explicitly:

如上所述，包括“Upgrade”（升級）和“Connection”（聯繫）在內的逐跳標頭不會從客戶端傳遞到代理伺服器，因此，為了讓代理伺服器知道客戶端打算將協定切換到WebSocket，必須明確地傳遞這些標頭：

> ```
> location /chat/ {
>     proxy_pass http://backend;
>     # proxy_http_version 1.1; # before version 1.29.7｜proxy_http_version 1.1 ; # 版本1.29.7之前
>     proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
>     proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
>
>     proxy_set_header Connection "升級";
> }
> ```

A more sophisticated example in which a value of the “Connection”（聯繫） header field in a request to the proxied server depends on the presence of the “Upgrade”（升級） field in the client request header:

一個更複雜的例子是，發送到代理伺服器的請求中“Connection”（聯繫）標頭欄位的值取決於客戶端請求標頭中“Upgrade”（升級）欄位是否存在：

> ```
> http {
>     map $http_upgrade $connection_upgrade {
>
>     映射 $http_upgrade $connection_upgrade {
>         default upgrade;
>
>         預設升級；
>         ''      close;
>
>         '' 關閉;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         ...
> 
>         location /chat/ {
>             proxy_pass http://backend;
>             # proxy_http_version 1.1; # before version 1.29.7｜proxy_http_version 1.1 ; # 版本1.29.7之前
>             proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
>             proxy_set_header Connection $connection_upgrade;
>         }
>     }
> ```

By default, the connection will be closed if the proxied server does not transmit any data within 60 seconds. This timeout can be increased with the [proxy\_read\_timeout](#p-085) directive. Alternatively, the proxied server can be configured to periodically send WebSocket ping frames to reset the timeout and check if the connection is still alive.

預設情況下，如果代理伺服器在 60 秒內未發送任何數據，連線將關閉。可以使用 `[proxy\_read\_timeout](#p-085)指令增加此逾時時間。或者，可以將代理伺服器配置為定期發送 WebSocket ping 幀來重置逾時時間並檢查連線是否仍然有效。

<a id="p-115"></a>

#### Installing nginx｜安裝 nginx

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/install.html>

##### Installing nginx｜安裝 nginx

nginx can be installed differently, depending on the operating system.

依作業系統不同，nginx 的安裝方式也不同。

**Installation on Linux｜Linux 系統安裝**

For Linux, nginx [packages](#p-177) from nginx.org can be used.

對於 Linux 系統，可以使用來自 nginx.org 的 nginx [軟體包](#p-177) 。

**Installation on FreeBSD｜在 FreeBSD 上安裝**

On FreeBSD, nginx can be installed either from the [packages](https://docs.freebsd.org/en/books/handbook/ports/#pkgng-intro) or through the [ports](https://docs.freebsd.org/en/books/handbook/ports/#ports-using) system. The ports system provides greater flexibility, allowing selection among a wide range of options. The port will compile nginx with the specified options and install it.

在 FreeBSD 系統中，nginx 可以透過 [packages](https://docs.freebsd.org/en/books/handbook/ports/#pkgng-intro)或 [ports](https://docs.freebsd.org/en/books/handbook/ports/#ports-using)系統安裝。 ports 系統提供了更大的靈活性，讓使用者可以選擇更多選項。 port 會使用指定的選項編譯 nginx 並進行安裝。

**Building from Sources｜從資源中汲取靈感**

If some special functionality is required, not available with packages and ports, nginx can also be compiled from source files. While more flexible, this approach may be complex for a beginner. For more information, see [Building nginx from Sources](#p-024).

如果需要一些軟體包和連接埠無法提供的特殊功能，也可以從原始碼編譯 nginx。雖然這種方法更靈活，但對於初學者來說可能比較複雜。更多信息，請參閱 [從源代碼構建 nginx](#p-024) 。
