#### mail｜郵件

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-116"></a>

##### Module ngx_mail_auth_http_module｜模組 ngx_mail_auth_http_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_auth_http_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_mail\_auth\_http\_module｜模組 ngx_mail_auth_http_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Directives](#p-116)<br>     [auth\_http](#p-116)<br>     [auth\_http\_header](#p-116)<br>     [auth\_http\_pass\_client\_cert](#p-116)<br>     [auth\_http\_timeout](#p-116)<br>[Protocol](#p-116)<br>[指令](#p-116)<br>     [auth\_http](#p-116)<br>     [auth\_http\_header](#p-116)<br>     [auth h\_http\_pass\_client\_cert](#p-116)<br>     [auth\_http\_timeout](#p-116)<br>[協定](#p-116) |

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**auth_http** `*URL*`;``<br>` `**auth_http** ` * URL * `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

Sets the URL of the HTTP authentication server. The protocol is described [below](#p-116).

設定HTTP伺服器的URL 。該協議描述如下(https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_auth_http_module.html#protocol) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**auth_http_header** `*header*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**auth_http_header** ` *頭部* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

Appends the specified header to requests sent to the authentication server. This header can be used as the shared secret to verify that the request comes from nginx. For example:

將指定的標頭附加到傳送到身份驗證伺服器的請求中。此標頭可用作共用金鑰，以驗證請求是否來自 nginx。例如：

> ```
> auth_http_header X-Auth-Key "secret_string";
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>auth_http_pass_client_cert</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>auth_http_pass_client_cert off;<br>關閉 auth_http_pass_client_cert；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Appends the “Auth-SSL-Cert”（身份驗證 SSL 憑證） header with the [client](#p-123) certificate in the PEM format (urlencoded) to requests sent to the authentication server.

將“Auth-SSL-Cert”（身份驗證 SSL 憑證）標頭與 [client](#p-123)憑證以PEM格式（urlencoded）附加到傳送到驗證伺服器的請求。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>auth_http_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>auth_http_timeout 60s;<br>auth_http_timeout 60s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the timeout for communication with the authentication server.

設定與認證伺服器通訊的逾時時間。

**Protocol｜協定**

The HTTP protocol is used to communicate with the authentication server. The data in the response body is ignored, the information is passed only in the headers.

HTTP協定用於與認證伺服器通訊。響應體中的資料將被忽略，訊息僅透過回應頭傳遞。

Examples of requests and responses:

請求和回應範例：

Request:

要求：

> ```yaml
> GET /auth HTTP/1.0
> Host: localhost
>
> 主機：localhost
> Auth-Method: plain # plain/apop/cram-md5/external
>
> 身份驗證方法：plain # plain/apop/cram-md5/external
> Auth-User: user
>
> Auth-User：用戶
> Auth-Pass: password
>
> 授權碼：密碼
> Auth-Protocol: imap # imap/pop3/smtp
>
> 身份驗證協定：imap # imap/pop3/smtp
> Auth-Login-Attempt: 1
>
> 身份驗證登入嘗試：1
> Client-IP: 192.0.2.42
>
> 客戶- IP: 192.0.2.42
> Client-Host: client.example.org
>
> 用戶端主機：client.example.org
> ```

Good response:

回覆良好：

> ```yaml
> HTTP/1.0 200 OK
> Auth-Status: OK
>
> 身份驗證狀態： OK
> Auth-Server: 198.51.100.1
>
> 認證伺服器： 198.51.100.1
> Auth-Port: 143
>
> 認證埠：143
> ```

Bad response:

錯誤回覆：

> ```yaml
> HTTP/1.0 200 OK
> Auth-Status: Invalid login or password
>
> 身份驗證狀態：登入名稱或密碼無效
> Auth-Wait: 3
>
> 授權等待：3
> ```

If there is no “Auth-Wait”（授權等待） header, an error will be returned and the connection will be closed. The current implementation allocates memory for each authentication attempt. The memory is freed only at the end of a session. Therefore, the number of invalid authentication attempts in a single session must be limited — the server must respond without the “Auth-Wait”（授權等待） header after 10-20 attempts (the attempt number is passed in the “Auth-Login-Attempt”（身份驗證登入嘗試） header).

如果沒有“Auth-Wait”（授權等待）標頭，則會傳回錯誤並關閉連線。目前實作會為每次身份驗證嘗試分配記憶體。記憶體僅在會話結束時釋放。因此，單一會話中的無效身分驗證嘗試次數必須受到限制－伺服器必須在 10-20 次嘗試後不包含“Auth-Wait”（授權等待）標頭（嘗試次數在“Auth-Login-Attempt”（身份驗證登入嘗試）標頭中傳遞）。

When the APOP or CRAM-MD5 are used, request-response will look as follows:

當使用APOP或CRAM-MD5時，請求-回應將如下所示：

> ```yaml
> GET /auth HTTP/1.0
> Host: localhost
>
> 主機：localhost
> Auth-Method: apop
>
> 身份驗證方法：apop
> Auth-User: user
>
> Auth-User：用戶
> Auth-Salt: <238188073.1163692009@mail.example.com>
>
> 驗證鹽：< 238188073.1163692009 @mail.example.com>
> Auth-Pass: auth_response
>
> 身份驗證密碼：auth_response
> Auth-Protocol: imap
>
> 身份驗證協定：IMAP
> Auth-Login-Attempt: 1
>
> 身份驗證登入嘗試：1
> Client-IP: 192.0.2.42
>
> 客戶- IP: 192.0.2.42
> Client-Host: client.example.org
>
> 用戶端主機：client.example.org
> ```

Good response:

回覆良好：

> ```yaml
> HTTP/1.0 200 OK
> Auth-Status: OK
>
> 身份驗證狀態： OK
> Auth-Server: 198.51.100.1
>
> 認證伺服器： 198.51.100.1
> Auth-Port: 143
>
> 認證埠：143
> Auth-Pass: plain-text-pass
>
> 身份驗證密碼：明文密碼
> ```

If the “Auth-User”（認證用戶） header exists in the response, it overrides the username used to authenticate with the backend.

如果回應中存在“Auth-User”（認證用戶）標頭，則會覆寫用於向後端進行身份驗證的使用者名稱。

For the SMTP, the response additionally takes into account the “Auth-Error-Code”（身份驗證錯誤代碼） header — if exists, it is used as a response code in case of an error. Otherwise, the 535 5.7.0 code will be added to the “Auth-Status”（身份驗證狀態） header.

對於SMTP ，回應也會考慮“Auth-Error-Code”（身份驗證錯誤代碼）標頭－如果存在，則將其用作錯誤時的回應碼。否則，將5.7.0程式碼加入“Auth-Status”（身份驗證狀態）標頭中。

For example, if the following response is received from the authentication server:

例如，如果從身份驗證伺服器收到以下回應：

> ```yaml
> HTTP/1.0 200 OK
> Auth-Status: Temporary server problem, try again later
>
> 身份驗證狀態：伺服器暫時出現問題，請稍後重試。
> Auth-Error-Code: 451 4.3.0
>
> 驗證錯誤碼：451 4.3.0
> Auth-Wait: 3
>
> 授權等待：3
> ```

then the SMTP client will receive an error

然後SMTP客戶端將收到錯誤

> ```
> 451 4.3.0 Temporary server problem, try again later
>
> 451 4.3.0伺服器暫時出現問題，請稍後再試。
> ```

If proxying SMTP does not require authentication, the request will look as follows:

如果代理SMTP不需要身份驗證，則請求將如下所示：

> ```yaml
> GET /auth HTTP/1.0
> Host: localhost
>
> 主機：localhost
> Auth-Method: none
>
> 身份驗證方法：無
> Auth-User:
>
> Auth-User：
> Auth-Pass:
>
> 授權碼：
> Auth-Protocol: smtp
>
> 身份驗證協定：smtp
> Auth-Login-Attempt: 1
>
> 身份驗證登入嘗試：1
> Client-IP: 192.0.2.42
>
> 客戶- IP: 192.0.2.42
> Client-Host: client.example.org
>
> 用戶端主機：client.example.org
> Auth-SMTP-Helo: client.example.org
>
> Auth- SMTP -Helo: client.example.org
> Auth-SMTP-From: MAIL FROM: <>
>
> 授權- SMTP -寄件者： MAIL FROM : <>
> Auth-SMTP-To: RCPT TO: <postmaster@mail.example.com>
>
> 授權- SMTP -至: RCPT TO: <postmaster@mail.example.com>
> ```

For the SSL/TLS client connection (1.7.11), the “Auth-SSL”（認證-SSL） header is added, and “Auth-SSL-Verify”（身份驗證-SSL驗證） will contain the result of client certificate verification, if [enabled](#p-123): “`SUCCESS`”, “`FAILED:``*reason*`”, and “`NONE`” if a certificate was not present.

對於 SSL/TLS 客戶端連線（1.7.11）， 這 “Auth-SSL”（認證-SSL） 添加標題，並且 “Auth-SSL-Verify”（身份驗證-SSL驗證） 如果啟用，將包含用戶端憑證驗證結果(https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_ssl_module.html#ssl_verify_client): “`SUCCESS`”, “`FAILED:``*reason*`“， 和 ”`NONE`“如果沒有證書的話。”

> Prior to version 1.11.7, the “`FAILED`” result did not contain the `*reason*` string.
>
> 在版本1.11.7之前，「 `FAILED` 」結果不包含字串`*reason*` 。

When the client certificate was present, its details are passed in the following request headers: “Auth-SSL-Subject”, “Auth-SSL-Issuer”（身份驗證 SSL 頒發者）, “Auth-SSL-Serial”, and “Auth-SSL-Fingerprint”（身份驗證 SSL 指紋）. If [auth\_http\_pass\_client\_cert](#p-116) is enabled, the certificate itself is passed in the “Auth-SSL-Cert”（身份驗證 SSL 憑證） header. The protocol and cipher of the established connection are passed in the “Auth-SSL-Protocol”（身份驗證 SSL 協議） and “Auth-SSL-Cipher”（身份驗證 SSL 密碼） headers (1.21.2). The request will look as follows:

當客戶端憑證存在時，其詳細資訊會透過以下請求頭傳遞： “Auth-SSL-Subject”, “Auth-SSL-Issuer”（身份驗證 SSL 頒發者）, “Auth-SSL-Serial”和“Auth-SSL-Fingerprint”（身份驗證 SSL 指紋） 。如果啟用了 [auth\_http\_pass\_client\_cert](#p-116) ，則憑證本身會透過“Auth-SSL-Cert”（身份驗證 SSL 憑證）標頭傳遞。已建立連線的協定和密碼套件會透過“Auth-SSL-Protocol”（身份驗證 SSL 協議）和“Auth-SSL-Cipher”（身份驗證 SSL 密碼）標頭（ 1.21.2 ）傳遞。請求將如下所示：

> ```yaml
> GET /auth HTTP/1.0
> Host: localhost
>
> 主機：localhost
> Auth-Method: plain
>
> 身份驗證方法：plain
> Auth-User: user
>
> Auth-User：用戶
> Auth-Pass: password
>
> 授權碼：密碼
> Auth-Protocol: imap
>
> 身份驗證協定：IMAP
> Auth-Login-Attempt: 1
>
> 身份驗證登入嘗試：1
> Client-IP: 192.0.2.42
>
> 客戶- IP: 192.0.2.42
> Auth-SSL: on
>
> 授權- SSL : 開啟
> Auth-SSL-Protocol: TLSv1.3
>
> 身份驗證SSL -協定：TLSv1.3
> Auth-SSL-Cipher: TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
>
> 身份驗證SSL - 密碼：TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
> Auth-SSL-Verify: SUCCESS
>
> 驗證： SSL -驗證： SUCCESS
> Auth-SSL-Subject: /CN=example.com
>
> 授權- SSL -主題: / CN =example.com
> Auth-SSL-Issuer: /CN=example.com
>
> 授權碼 - SSL - 發卡方：/ CN =example.com
> Auth-SSL-Serial: C07AD56B846B5BFF
>
> 授權碼： SSL -序號： C07AD56B846B5BFF
> Auth-SSL-Fingerprint: 29d6a80a123d13355ed16b4b04605e29cb55a5ad
>
> 驗證SSL -指紋： 29d6a80a123d13355ed16b4b04605e29cb55a5ad
> ```

When the [PROXY protocol](#p-117) is used, its details are passed in the following request headers: “Proxy-Protocol-Addr”（代理協定地址）, “Proxy-Protocol-Port”（代理協定連接埠）, “Proxy-Protocol-Server-Addr”（代理協定伺服器位址）, and “Proxy-Protocol-Server-Port”（代理協定伺服器連接埠） (1.19.8).

當使用 [PROXY協議](#p-117)時，其詳細資訊透過以下請求標頭傳遞： “Proxy-Protocol-Addr”（代理協定地址）, “Proxy-Protocol-Port”（代理協定連接埠）, “Proxy-Protocol-Server-Addr”（代理協定伺服器位址）和“Proxy-Protocol-Server-Port”（代理協定伺服器連接埠） ( 1.19.8 )。

###### Module ngx\_mail\_core\_module｜模組 ngx\_mail\_core\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-117)<br>[Directives](#p-117)<br>     [listen](#p-117)<br>     [mail](#p-117)<br>     [max\_errors](#p-117)<br>     [protocol](#p-117)<br>     [resolver](#p-117)<br>     [resolver\_timeout](#p-117)<br>     [server](#p-117)<br>     [server\_name](#p-117)<br>     [timeout](#p-117)<br>[範例配置](#p-117)<br> [指令](#p-117)<br> [監聽](#p-117)<br> [郵件](#p-117)<br> [最大錯誤數](#p-117)<br> [協議](#p-117)<br> [399] 解析器(https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_core_module.html#protocol)<br> (https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_core_module.html#resolver_timeout)<br> [伺服器](#p-117)<br> [伺服器名稱](#p-117)<br> [逾時](#p-117) |

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-mail` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-mail`配置參數啟用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> worker_processes auto;
>
> worker_processes 自動；
> 
> error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log info;
>
> 錯誤日誌 /var/log/nginx/error.log 訊息;
> 
> events {
>
> 事件 {
>     worker_connections  1024;
>
>     工作連線數 1024；
> }
> 
> mail {
>
> 郵件 {
>     server_name       mail.example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 mail.example.com；
>     auth_http         localhost:9000/cgi-bin/nginxauth.cgi;
>
>     auth_http localhost:9000/cgi-bin/nginxauth.cgi;
> 
>     imap_capabilities IMAP4rev1 UIDPLUS IDLE LITERAL+ QUOTA;
>
>     imap_capabilities IMAP4rev1 UIDPLUS IDLE LITERAL+ QUOTA ;
> 
>     pop3_auth         plain apop cram-md5;
>
>     pop3_auth plain apop cram-md5;
>     pop3_capabilities LAST TOP USER PIPELINING UIDL;
>
>     pop3_capabilities LAST TOP USER管道UIDL ;
> 
>     smtp_auth         login plain cram-md5;
>
>     smtp_auth 登入 plain cram-md5;
>     smtp_capabilities "SIZE 10485760"（尺寸 10485760） ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES 8BITMIME DSN;
>
>     smtp_capabilities "SIZE 10485760"（尺寸 10485760） ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES 8BITMIME DSN ;
>     xclient           off;
>
>     xclient 關閉；
> 
>     server {
>

>
>         聽 25；

>

>
>         聽 110；
>         protocol pop3;

>         協議 pop3；
>         proxy_pass_error_message on;
>
>         proxy_pass_error_message 開啟；
>     }

>

>         聽 143；

>
>         聽 587；

>
>         協議 smtp；

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**listen** `*address*`:`*port*` [`ssl`] [`proxy_protocol`] [`backlog`=`*number*`] [`rcvbuf`=`*size*`] [`sndbuf`=`*size*`] [`bind`] [`ipv6only`=`on`\|`off`] [`multipath`] [`so_keepalive`=`on`\|`off`\|[`*keepidle*`]:[`*keepintvl*`]:[`*keepcnt*`]];``<br>``**listen** `*位址*`:`*埠*` [`ssl`] [`proxy_protocol`] [`backlog`=`*數量*`] [`rcvbuf`=`*大小*`] [`sndbuf`=`*大小*`] [`綁定`] [`ipv6only`=`on`\|`off`] [`multipath`] [`so_keepalive`=`開`\|`關`\|[`*keepidle*`]:[`*keepintvl*`]:[`*keepcnt*`]];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Sets the `*address*` and `*port*` for the socket on which the server will accept requests. It is possible to specify just the port. The address can also be a hostname, for example:

設定伺服器接受請求的套接字的`*address*`和`*port*` 。也可以只指定連接埠。位址也可以是主機名，例如：

> ```
> listen 127.0.0.1:110;
>
> 聽127.0.0.1:110 ;
> listen *:110;
>
> 監聽 *:110;
> listen 110;     # same as *:110
>
> 監聽埠 110；# 等同於 *:110
> listen localhost:110;
>
> 監聽 localhost:110;
> ```

IPv6 addresses (0.7.58) are specified in square brackets:

IPv6 位址（ 0.7.58 ）以方括號指定：

> ```
> listen [::1]:110;
>
> 監聽 [::1]:110;
> listen [::]:110;
>
> 監聽 [::]:110;
> ```

UNIX-domain sockets (1.3.5) are specified with the “`unix:`” prefix:

UNIX -域套接字（ 1.3.5 ）以「 `unix:` 」前綴指定：

> ```
> listen unix:/var/run/nginx.sock;
>
> 監聽unix:/var/run/nginx.sock;
> ```

Different servers must listen on different `*address*`:`*port*` pairs.

不同的伺服器必須監聽不同的`*address*`:`*port*`對。

The `ssl` parameter allows specifying that all connections accepted on this port should work in SSL mode.

`ssl`參數允許指定在此連接埠上接受的所有連接都應以SSL模式工作。

The `proxy_protocol` parameter (1.19.8) allows specifying that all connections accepted on this port should use the [PROXY protocol](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt). Obtained information is passed to the [authentication server](#p-116) and can be used to [change the client address](#p-121).

`proxy_protocol`參數 ( 1.19.8 ) 允許指定在此連接埠上接受的所有連接都應使用 [PROXY協定](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) 。所取得的資訊將傳遞給 [驗證伺服器](#p-116) ，並可用於 [更改客戶端位址](#p-121) 。

The `listen` directive can have several additional parameters specific to socket-related system calls.

`listen`指令可以有幾個與套接字相關的系統呼叫特有的附加參數。

`backlog`\=`*number*`

sets the `backlog` parameter in the `listen()` call that limits the maximum length for the queue of pending connections (1.9.2). By default, `backlog` is set to -1 on FreeBSD, DragonFly BSD, and macOS, and to 511 on other platforms.

在限制1.9.2處理連線佇列最大長度的`listen()`呼叫中設定`backlog`參數。預設情況下，在 FreeBSD、DragonFly BSD和 macOS 上， `backlog`設定為 -1，在其他平台上設定為 511。

`rcvbuf`\=`*size*`

sets the receive buffer size (the `SO_RCVBUF` option) for the listening socket (1.11.13).

設定監聽套接字的接收緩衝區大小（ `SO_RCVBUF`選項）（ 1.11.13 ）。

`sndbuf`\=`*size*`

sets the send buffer size (the `SO_SNDBUF` option) for the listening socket (1.11.13).

設定監聽套接字（ 1.11.13 ）的傳送緩衝區大小（ `SO_SNDBUF`選項）。

`bind`

this parameter instructs to make a separate `bind()` call for a given address:port pair. The fact is that if there are several `listen` directives with the same port but different addresses, and one of the `listen` directives listens on all addresses for the given port (`*:``*port*`), nginx will `bind()` only to `*:``*port*`. It should be noted that the `getsockname()` system call will be made in this case to determine the address that accepted the connection. If the `backlog`, `rcvbuf`, `sndbuf`, `ipv6only`, `multipath`, or `so_keepalive` parameters are used then for a given `*address*`:`*port*` pair a separate `bind()` call will always be made.

此參數指示針對給定的位址:埠對分別發起一次`bind()`呼叫。事實上，如果存在多個`listen`指令使用相同的連接埠但不同的位址，並且其中一個`listen`指令監聽給定連接埠的所有位址（ `*:``*port*` ），則 nginx 將僅對`*:``*port*`發起`bind()` 。需要注意的是，在這種情況下，將發起`getsockname()`系統呼叫來確定接受連接的位址。如果使用`backlog`, `rcvbuf`, `sndbuf`, `ipv6only`, `multipath`或`so_keepalive`參數，則對於給定的`*address*`:`*port*`對，將始終發起一次單獨的`bind()`呼叫。

`ipv6only`\=`on`|`off`

this parameter determines (via the `IPV6_V6ONLY` socket option) whether an IPv6 socket listening on a wildcard address `[::]` will accept only IPv6 connections or both IPv6 and IPv4 connections. This parameter is turned on by default. It can only be set once on start.

此參數（透過套接字選項`IPV6_V6ONLY` ）決定監聽通配符位址`[::]`的 IPv6 套接字是否僅接受 IPv6 連接，還是同時接受 IPv6 和 IPv4 連接。此參數預設啟用，且只能在啟動時設定一次。

`multipath`

this parameter (1.29.7) configures the [Multipath TCP](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8684) protocol (`IPPROTO_MPTCP`) for the listening socket. This currently works only on Linux 5.6+.

此參數（ 1.29.7 ）配置監聽套接字的[多路徑TCP](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8684)協定（ `IPPROTO_MPTCP` ）。目前僅適用於5.6 +。

> Adding or removing this parameter will also enable the `SO_REUSEPORT` socket option, which may have its security [implications](http://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/socket.7.html).
>
> 新增或刪除此參數還將啟用`SO_REUSEPORT`套接字選項，這可能會帶來安全方面的[影響](http://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/socket.7.html) 。

`so_keepalive`\=`on`|`off`|\[`*keepidle*`\]:\[`*keepintvl*`\]:\[`*keepcnt*`\]

this parameter configures the “TCP keepalive” behavior for the listening socket. If this parameter is omitted then the operating system’s settings will be in effect for the socket. If it is set to the value “`on`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` option is turned on for the socket. If it is set to the value “`off`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` option is turned off for the socket. Some operating systems support setting of TCP keepalive parameters on a per-socket basis using the `TCP_KEEPIDLE`, `TCP_KEEPINTVL`, and `TCP_KEEPCNT` socket options. On such systems (currently, Linux, NetBSD, Dragonfly, FreeBSD, and macOS), they can be configured using the `*keepidle*`, `*keepintvl*`, and `*keepcnt*` parameters. One or two parameters may be omitted, in which case the system default setting for the corresponding socket option will be in effect. For example,

此參數配置監聽套接字的「 TCP keepalive」行為。如果省略此參數，則套接字將使用作業系統的設定。如果將其設為“ `on` ”，則會為套接字啟用`SO_KEEPALIVE` ”選項。如果將其設為“ `off` ”，則會為套接字停用`SO_KEEPALIVE` ”選項。某些作業系統支援使用套接字選項`TCP_KEEPIDLE`, `TCP_KEEPINTVL`和`TCP_KEEPCNT`為每個套接字單獨設定TCP keepalive」參數。在這些系統（目前包括 Linux、NetBSD、Dragonfly、FreeBSD 和 macOS）上，可以使用`*keepidle*`, `*keepintvl*`和`*keepcnt*`參數進行設定。可以省略一個或兩個參數，在這種情況下，將使用對應套接字選項的系統預設。例如：

> ```
> so_keepalive=30m::10
>
> 所以保持存活=30分鐘::10
> ```

will set the idle timeout (`TCP_KEEPIDLE`) to 30 minutes, leave the probe interval (`TCP_KEEPINTVL`) at its system default, and set the probes count (`TCP_KEEPCNT`) to 10 probes.

將空閒逾時（ `TCP_KEEPIDLE` ）設定為 30 分鐘，將探測間隔（ `TCP_KEEPINTVL` ）保持為系統預設值，並將探測次數（ `TCP_KEEPCNT` ）設為 10 次探測。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**mail** { ... }` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Provides the configuration file context in which the mail server directives are specified.

提供指定郵件伺服器指令的設定檔上下文。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>max_errors<br>最大錯誤數</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>max_errors 5;<br>最大錯誤數 5；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.21.0.

該指令出現在版本1.21.0 。

Sets the number of protocol errors after which the connection is closed.

設定連線關閉前協定錯誤次數的上限。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**protocol** `imap` \| `pop3` \| `smtp`;``<br>` `**protocol** ` imap ` \| ` pop3 ` \| ` smtp `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Sets the protocol for a proxied server. Supported protocols are [IMAP](#p-118), [POP3](#p-119), and [SMTP](#p-122).

設定代理伺服器的協定。支持的協議有 [IMAP](#p-118) 、 [POP3](#p-119)和 [SMTP](#p-122) 。

If the directive is not set, the protocol can be detected automatically based on the well-known port specified in the [listen](#p-117) directive:

如果未設定指令，則可根據 [listen](#p-117)指令中指定的已知連接埠自動偵測協定：

-   `imap`: 143, 993
-   `pop3`: 110, 995
-   `smtp`: 25, 587, 465

Unnecessary protocols can be disabled using the [configuration](#p-024) parameters `--without-mail_imap_module`, `--without-mail_pop3_module`, and `--without-mail_smtp_module`.

可以使用 [設定](#p-024)參數`--without-mail_imap_module`, `--without-mail_pop3_module`和`--without-mail_smtp_module`停用不必要的協定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>resolver<br>解決</strong> <code><i>address<br>地址</i></code> ... [<code>valid<br>有效的</code>=<code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>] [<code>ipv4<br>IPv4</code>=<code>on<br>在</code>|<code>off<br>離開</code>] [<code>ipv6<br>IPv6</code>=<code>on<br>在</code>|<code>off<br>離開</code>] [<code>status_zone<br>狀態區</code>=<code><i>zone<br>區</i></code>];</code><br><code><strong>resolver<br>解決</strong> <code>off<br>離開</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>resolver off;<br>解析器關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Configures name servers used to find the client’s hostname to pass it to the [authentication server](#p-116), and in the [XCLIENT](#p-120) command when proxying SMTP. For example:

配置用於尋找客戶端主機名稱的名稱伺服器，以便將其傳遞給[身份驗證伺服器](#p-116) ，並在代理SMTP時用於[XCLIENT](#p-120)命令。例如：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
>
> 解析器127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
> ```

The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, with an optional port (1.3.1, 1.2.2). If port is not specified, the port 53 is used. Name servers are queried in a round-robin fashion.

位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，連接埠號碼可選（ 1.3.1, 1.2.2 ）。如果未指定連接埠號，則使用連接埠53。名稱伺服器以輪詢方式進行查詢。

> Before version 1.1.7, only a single name server could be configured. Specifying name servers using IPv6 addresses is supported starting from versions 1.3.1 and 1.2.2.
>
> 在版本1.1.7之前，只能配置單一名稱伺服器。從版本1.3.1和1.2.2開始，支援使用IPv6位址指定名稱伺服器。

By default, nginx will look up both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses while resolving. If looking up of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses is not desired, the `ipv4=off` (1.23.1) or the `ipv6=off` parameter can be specified.

預設情況下，nginx 在解析時會同時尋找 IPv4 和 IPv6 位址。如果不需要尋找 IPv4 或 IPv6 位址，可以指定`ipv4=off` ( 1.23.1 ) 或`ipv6=off`參數。

> Resolving of names into IPv6 addresses is supported starting from version 1.5.8.
>
> 從版本1.5.8開始支援將名稱解析為IPv6位址。

By default, nginx caches answers using the TTL value of a response. An optional `valid` parameter allows overriding it:

預設情況下，nginx 使用回應的TTL值快取答案。可選的`valid`參數允許覆蓋此設定：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 valid=30s;
>
> 解析器127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 有效=30秒;
> ```

> Before version 1.1.9, tuning of caching time was not possible, and nginx always cached answers for the duration of 5 minutes.
>
> 在版本1.1.9之前，無法調整快取時間，nginx 總是快取答案 5 分鐘。

> To prevent DNS spoofing, it is recommended configuring DNS servers in a properly secured trusted local network.
>
> 為防止DNS欺騙，建議在安全可靠的本地網路中設定DNS伺服器。

The optional `status_zone` parameter (1.17.1) enables [collection](#p-048) of DNS server statistics of requests and responses in the specified `*zone*`. The parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).

可選參數`status_zone` ( 1.17.1 ) 啟用 [收集](#p-048)指定`*zone*`中請求和回應的DNS伺服器統計資訊。此參數作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

The special value `off` disables resolving.

特殊值`off`禁用解析。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>resolver_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>resolver_timeout 30s;<br>resolver_timeout 30s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets a timeout for DNS operations, for example:

設定DNS操作的超時時間，例如：

> ```
> resolver_timeout 5s;
>
> 解析器超時時間為 5 秒；
> ```

| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**server** { ... }` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail` |

Sets the configuration for a server.

設定伺服器配置。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>server_name<br>伺服器名稱</strong> <code><i>name<br>名稱</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>server_name hostname;<br>伺服器名稱 主機名稱；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the server name that is used:

設定使用的伺服器名稱：

-   in the initial POP3/SMTP server greeting;  
    在初始POP3/SMTP伺服器問候中；
-   in the salt during the SASL CRAM-MD5 authentication;  
    在SASL CRAM-MD5認證過程中的鹽中；
-   in the `EHLO` command when connecting to the SMTP backend, if the passing of the [XCLIENT](#p-120) command is enabled.  
    在連接到SMTP後端時，如果啟用了 [XCLIENT](#p-120)命令的傳遞，則在`EHLO`命令中。

If the directive is not specified, the machine’s hostname is used.

如果未指定指令，則使用機器的主機名稱。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>timeout<br>超時</strong> <code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>timeout 60s;<br>超時時間 60 秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the timeout that is used before proxying to the backend starts.

設定代理到後端之前使用的超時時間。

##### Module ngx_mail_imap_module｜模組 ngx_mail_imap_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_imap_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_mail\_imap\_module｜模組 ngx_mail_imap_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Directives](#p-118)<br>     [imap\_auth](#p-118)<br>     [imap\_capabilities](#p-118)<br>     [imap\_client\_buffer](#p-118)<br>[指令](#p-118)<br> [imap_auth](#p-118)<br> [imap_capabilities](#p-118)<br> [imap_client_buffer](#p-118) |

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>imap_auth</strong> <code><i>method<br>方法</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>imap_auth plain;<br>imap_auth plain；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets permitted methods of authentication for IMAP clients. Supported methods are:

設定IMAP客戶端允許的身份驗證方法。支援的方法包括：

`plain`

[LOGIN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3501), [AUTH=PLAIN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4616)

`login`

[AUTH=LOGIN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-murchison-sasl-login-00)

`cram-md5`

[AUTH=CRAM-MD5](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2195). In order for this method to work, the password must be stored unencrypted.

[AUTH = CRAM-MD5](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2195) 。為了使此方法有效，密碼必須以未加密的形式儲存。

`external`

[AUTH=EXTERNAL](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4422) (1.11.6).

Plain text authentication methods (the `LOGIN` command, `AUTH=PLAIN`, and `AUTH=LOGIN`) are always enabled, though if the `plain` and `login` methods are not specified, `AUTH=PLAIN` and `AUTH=LOGIN` will not be automatically included in [imap\_capabilities](#p-118).

純文字驗證方法（ `LOGIN` 命令， `AUTH=PLAIN`， 和 `AUTH=LOGIN`）始終啟用，但如果 `plain` 和 `login` 方法未作具體說明。 `AUTH=PLAIN` 和 `AUTH=LOGIN` 不會自動包含在 [imap\_capabilities 中](#p-118).

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>imap_capabilities</strong> <code><i>extension<br>擴充</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>imap_capabilities IMAP4 IMAP4rev1 UIDPLUS;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the [IMAP protocol](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3501) extensions list that is passed to the client in response to the `CAPABILITY` command. The authentication methods specified in the [imap\_auth](#p-118) directive and [STARTTLS](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2595) are automatically added to this list depending on the [starttls](#p-123) directive value.

設定傳遞給客戶端以回應 `CAPABILITY` 指令的 [IMAP 協定](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3501) 擴充清單。 [imap\_auth](#p-118) 指令與 [STARTTLS](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2595) 中指定的驗證方法會根據 [starttls](#p-123) 指令值自動新增至此清單。

It makes sense to specify the extensions supported by the IMAP backends to which the clients are proxied (if these extensions are related to commands used after the authentication, when nginx transparently proxies a client connection to the backend).

如果這些擴充與身份驗證後使用的命令相關，那麼指定客戶端代理到的IMAP後端支援的擴充就很有意義（當 nginx 透明地將客戶端連接代理到後端時）。

The current list of standardized extensions is published at [www.iana.org](http://www.iana.org/assignments/imap4-capabilities).

目前標準化擴充清單發佈在 [www.iana.org](http://www.iana.org/assignments/imap4-capabilities) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>imap_client_buffer</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>imap_client_buffer 4k|8k;<br>imap_client_buffer 4k|8k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading IMAP commands. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform.

設定用於讀取IMAP指令的緩衝區`*size*` 。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台不同，該值可以是 4K 或 8K。

**Directives｜指令**

<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>pop3_auth plain;<br>pop3_auth plain；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>

Sets permitted methods of authentication for POP3 clients. Supported methods are:

設定POP3客戶端允許的身份驗證方法。支援的方法包括：

`plain`

[USER/PASS](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc1939), [AUTH PLAIN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4616), [AUTH LOGIN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-murchison-sasl-login-00)

`apop`

[APOP](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc1939). In order for this method to work, the password must be stored unencrypted.

[APOP](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc1939) 。為了使此方法有效，密碼必須以未加密的形式儲存。

`cram-md5`

[AUTH CRAM-MD5](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2195). In order for this method to work, the password must be stored unencrypted.

[AUTH CRAM-MD5](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2195) 。為了使此方法有效，密碼必須以未加密的形式儲存。

`external`

[AUTH EXTERNAL](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4422) (1.11.6).

Plain text authentication methods (`USER/PASS`, `AUTH PLAIN`, and `AUTH LOGIN`) are always enabled, though if the `plain` method is not specified, `AUTH PLAIN` and `AUTH LOGIN` will not be automatically included in [pop3\_capabilities](#p-119).

純文字驗證方法（ `USER/PASS`, `AUTH PLAIN`和`AUTH LOGIN` ）始終啟用，但如果未指定`plain`方法，則`AUTH PLAIN`和`AUTH LOGIN`將不會自動包含在 [pop3\_capabilities](#p-119)中。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>pop3_capabilities</strong> <code><i>extension<br>擴充</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>pop3_capabilities TOP USER UIDL;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the [POP3 protocol](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2449) extensions list that is passed to the client in response to the `CAPA` command. The authentication methods specified in the [pop3\_auth](#p-119) directive ([SASL](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2449) extension) and [STLS](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2595) are automatically added to this list depending on the [starttls](#p-123) directive value.

設定回應`CAPA`指令而傳遞給客戶端的 [POP3 協定](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2449)擴充清單。根據 [starttls (https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_pop3_module.html#pop3_auth)指令中指定的(https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_ssl_module.html#starttls)方法（[SASL](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2449)擴充）和 [STLS](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2595)會自動加入此清單。

It makes sense to specify the extensions supported by the POP3 backends to which the clients are proxied (if these extensions are related to commands used after the authentication, when nginx transparently proxies the client connection to the backend).

如果這些擴充與身份驗證後使用的命令相關，那麼指定客戶端代理到的POP3後端支援的擴充就很有意義（當 nginx 透明地將客戶端連接代理到後端時）。

The current list of standardized extensions is published at [www.iana.org](http://www.iana.org/assignments/pop3-extension-mechanism).

目前標準化擴充清單發佈在 [www.iana.org](http://www.iana.org/assignments/pop3-extension-mechanism) 。

##### Module ngx_mail_proxy_module｜模組 ngx_mail_proxy_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_proxy_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_mail\_proxy\_module｜模組 ngx_mail_proxy_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Directives](#p-120)<br>     [proxy\_buffer](#p-120)<br>     [proxy\_pass\_error\_message](#p-120)<br>     [proxy\_protocol](#p-120)<br>     [proxy\_smtp\_auth](#p-120)<br>     [proxy\_timeout](#p-120)<br>     [xclient](#p-120)<br>[指令](#p-120)<br>     [代理緩衝區](#p-120)<br>     [代理_通過_錯誤訊息](#p-120)<br>     [代理協定](#p-120)<br>     [proxy\_smtp\_auth](#p-120)<br>     [代理超時](#p-120)<br>     [xclient](#p-120) |

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_buffer<br>代理緩衝區</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_buffer 4k|8k;<br>proxy_buffer 4k|8k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the size of the buffer used for proxying. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. Depending on a platform, it is either 4K or 8K.

設定代理所用緩衝區的大小。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。依平台不同，緩衝區大小可能為 4K 或 8K。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_pass_error_message</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_pass_error_message off;<br>proxy_pass_error_message 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Indicates whether to pass the error message obtained during the authentication on the backend to the client.

指示是否將後端身份驗證期間獲得的錯誤訊息傳遞給客戶端。

Usually, if the authentication in nginx is a success, the backend cannot return an error. If it nevertheless returns an error, it means some internal error has occurred. In such case the backend message can contain information that should not be shown to the client. However, responding with an error for the correct password is a normal behavior for some POP3 servers. For example, CommuniGatePro informs a user about [mailbox overflow](http://www.stalker.com/CommuniGatePro/Alerts.html#Quota) or other events by periodically outputting the [authentication error](http://www.stalker.com/CommuniGatePro/POP.html#Alerts). The directive should be enabled in this case.

通常情況下，如果 nginx 中的身份驗證成功，後端不會回傳錯誤。但如果後端仍然回傳錯誤，則表示發生了某些內部錯誤。在這種情況下，後端訊息可能包含不應向客戶端顯示的資訊。然而，對於某些POP3來說，即使密碼正確也回傳錯誤是正常行為。例如，CommuniGatePro 會定期輸出「驗證錯誤」來通知使用者郵箱(http://www.stalker.com/CommuniGatePro/Alerts.html#Quota)或其他事件。在這種情況下，應該啟用相應(http://www.stalker.com/CommuniGatePro/POP.html#Alerts)指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_protocol<br>代理協定</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code>v2</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_protocol off;<br>代理協定關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.19.8.

該指令出現在版本1.19.8 。

Enables the [PROXY protocol](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) for connections to a backend. The `on` parameter enables version 1 of the PROXY protocol (text format). The `v2` parameter (1.31.4) enables version 2 of the PROXY protocol (binary format).

啟用 [PROXY 協定](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) 以連接到後端。 `on` 參數啟用PROXY 協定的版本 1（文字格式）。 `v2` 參數 (1.31.4) 啟用PROXY 協定的版本 2（二進位格式）。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_smtp_auth</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_smtp_auth off;<br>proxy_smtp_auth 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.19.4.

該指令出現在版本1.19.4 。

Enables or disables user authentication on the SMTP backend using the `AUTH` command.

使用`AUTH`指令啟用或停用SMTP後端的使用者驗證。

If [XCLIENT](#p-120) is also enabled, then the `XCLIENT` command will not send the `LOGIN` parameter.

如果 [XCLIENT](#p-120)也已啟用，則`XCLIENT`指令不會傳送`LOGIN`參數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_timeout</strong> <code><i>timeout</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_timeout 24h;<br>proxy_timeout 24h；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*timeout*` between two successive read or write operations on client or proxied server connections. If no data is transmitted within this time, the connection is closed.

設定客戶端或代理伺服器連線上兩次連續讀取或寫入操作之間的`*timeout*` 。如果在該時間內沒有資料傳輸，則連線關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>xclient</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>xclient on;<br>xclient 已開啟；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables the passing of the [XCLIENT](http://www.postfix.org/XCLIENT_README.html) command with client parameters when connecting to the SMTP backend.

啟用或停用在連接到SMTP後端時傳遞帶有客戶端參數的 [XCLIENT](http://www.postfix.org/XCLIENT_README.html)指令。

With `XCLIENT`, the MTA is able to write client information to the log and apply various limitations based on this data.

借助`XCLIENT` ， MTA能夠將客戶端資訊寫入日誌，並根據這些資料應用各種限制。

If `XCLIENT` is enabled then nginx passes the following commands when connecting to the backend:

如果啟用了`XCLIENT` ，則nginx在連接到後端時會傳遞以下命令：

-   `EHLO` with the [server name](#p-117)  
    `EHLO`與 [伺服器名稱](#p-117)
-   `XCLIENT`
-   `EHLO` or `HELO`, as passed by the client  
    `EHLO`或`HELO` ，由客戶端傳遞

If the name [found](#p-117) by the client IP address points to the same address, it is passed in the `NAME` parameter of the `XCLIENT` command. If the name could not be found, points to a different address, or [resolver](#p-117) is not specified, the `[UNAVAILABLE]` is passed in the `NAME` parameter. If an error has occurred in the process of resolving, the `[TEMPUNAVAIL]` value is used.

如果客戶端位址 [found](#p-117)指向相同位址，則將其傳遞給IP指令的`NAME`參數。如果找不到名稱、名稱指向不同的位址，或未指定 [resolver](#p-117) ，則將`[UNAVAILABLE]`傳遞給`NAME`參數。如果在解析過程中發生錯誤， `[TEMPUNAVAIL]` `XCLIENT` 。

If `XCLIENT` is disabled then nginx passes the `EHLO` command with the [server name](#p-117) when connecting to the backend if the client has passed `EHLO`, or `HELO` with the server name, otherwise.

如果`XCLIENT`被停用，則當客戶端連接到後端時，nginx 會傳遞`EHLO`命令，其中包含 [伺服器名稱](#p-117) （如果客戶端已傳遞`EHLO` ，否則會傳遞伺服器`HELO`命令P20⧟命令，其中包含伺服器名稱。

<a id="p-121"></a>

##### Module ngx_mail_realip_module｜模組 ngx_mail_realip_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_realip_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_mail\_realip\_module｜模組 ngx\_mail\_realip\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-121)<br>[Directives](#p-121)<br>     [set\_real\_ip\_from](#p-121)<br>[範例設定](#p-121)<br> [指令](#p-121)<br> [set\_real\_ip\_from](#p-121) |

The `ngx_mail_realip_module` module is used to change the client address and port to the ones sent in the PROXY protocol header (1.19.8). The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the [proxy\_protocol](#p-117) parameter in the `listen` directive.

`ngx_mail_realip_module`模組用於將客戶端位址和連接埠變更為PROXY協定頭（ 1.19.8 ）中傳送的位址和連接埠。必須事先透過在`listen`指令中設定 [proxy\_protocol](#p-117)參數來啟用PROXY協定。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> listen 110 proxy_protocol;
>
> 監聽 110 代理協議；
> 
> set_real_ip_from  192.168.1.0/24;
>
> set_real_ip_from 192.168.1.0/24 ;
> set_real_ip_from  192.168.2.1;
>
> set_real_ip_from 192.168.2.1 ;
> set_real_ip_from  2001:0db8::/32;
>
> set_real_ip_from 2001:0db8::/32 ;
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**set_real_ip_from** `*address*` \| `*CIDR*` \| `unix:`;``<br>` `**set_real_ip_from** ` *地址* ` \| ` * CIDR * ` \| ` unix: `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>上下文： | `mail`, `server` |

Defines trusted addresses that are known to send correct replacement addresses. If the special value `unix:` is specified, all UNIX-domain sockets will be trusted.

定義已知會傳送正確替換位址的可信任位址。如果指定特殊值`unix:` ，則所有UNIX域套接字都將被信任。

<a id="p-122"></a>

##### Module ngx_mail_smtp_module｜模組 ngx_mail_smtp_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_smtp_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_mail\_smtp\_module｜模組 ngx_mail_smtp_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Directives](#p-122)<br>     [smtp\_auth](#p-122)<br>     [smtp\_capabilities](#p-122)<br>     [smtp\_client\_buffer](#p-122)<br>     [smtp\_greeting\_delay](#p-122)<br>[指令](#p-122)<br> [smtp_auth](#p-122)<br> [smtp_capabilities](#p-122)<br> [smtp_client_buffer](#p-122)<br> [smtp_greeting_delay](#p-122) |

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>smtp_auth</strong> <code><i>method<br>方法</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>smtp_auth plain login;<br>smtp_auth 明文登入；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets permitted methods of [SASL authentication](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2554) for SMTP clients. Supported methods are:

設定客戶SMTP允許的[SASL認證](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2554)方法。支持的方法有：

`plain`

[AUTH PLAIN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4616)

`login`

[AUTH LOGIN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-murchison-sasl-login-00)

`cram-md5`

[AUTH CRAM-MD5](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2195). In order for this method to work, the password must be stored unencrypted.

[AUTH CRAM-MD5](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2195) 。為了使此方法有效，密碼必須以未加密的形式儲存。

`external`

[AUTH EXTERNAL](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4422) (1.11.6).

`none`

Authentication is not required.

無需身份驗證。

Plain text authentication methods (`AUTH PLAIN` and `AUTH LOGIN`) are always enabled, though if the `plain` and `login` methods are not specified, `AUTH PLAIN` and `AUTH LOGIN` will not be automatically included in [smtp\_capabilities](#p-122).

純文字驗證方法（ `AUTH PLAIN`和`AUTH LOGIN` ）始終啟用，但如果未指定`plain`和`login`方法，則`AUTH PLAIN`和`AUTH LOGIN`將不會自動包含在 [smtp\_capabilities](#p-122)中。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**smtp_capabilities** `*extension*` ...;``<br>` `**smtp_capabilities** ` *擴充* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

Sets the SMTP protocol extensions list that is passed to the client in response to the `EHLO` command. The authentication methods specified in the [smtp\_auth](#p-122) directive and [STARTTLS](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3207) are automatically added to this list depending on the [starttls](#p-123) directive value.

設定回應`EHLO`指令而傳遞給客戶端的SMTP協定擴充清單。根據 [starttls](#p-123)指令的值，[smtp\_auth](#p-122)指令和 [STARTTLS](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3207)指令中指定的身份驗證方法會自動新增至此清單。

It makes sense to specify the extensions supported by the MTA to which the clients are proxied (if these extensions are related to commands used after the authentication, when nginx transparently proxies the client connection to the backend).

如果這些擴充與身份驗證後使用的命令相關，那麼指定客戶端代理到的MTA支援的擴充就很有意義（當 nginx 透明地將客戶端連接代理到後端時）。

The current list of standardized extensions is published at [www.iana.org](http://www.iana.org/assignments/mail-parameters).

目前標準化擴充清單發佈在 [www.iana.org](http://www.iana.org/assignments/mail-parameters) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>smtp_client_buffer</strong> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>smtp_client_buffer 4k|8k;<br>smtp_client_buffer 4k|8k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading SMTP commands. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform.

設定用於讀取指令的緩衝區大小SMTP `*size*` 。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台不同，該大小為 4K 或 8K。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>smtp_greeting_delay</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>smtp_greeting_delay 0;<br>smtp_greeting_delay 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Allows setting a delay before sending an SMTP greeting in order to reject clients who fail to wait for the greeting before sending SMTP commands.

允許在發送SMTP問候語之前設定延遲，以便拒絕在發送SMTP命令之前未等待問候語的客戶端。

<a id="p-123"></a>

##### Module ngx_mail_ssl_module｜模組 ngx_mail_ssl_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_ssl_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_mail\_ssl\_module｜模組 ngx_mail_ssl_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-123)<br>[Directives](#p-123)<br>     [ssl](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_certificate](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_certificate\_compression](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_certificate\_key](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_ciphers](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_client\_certificate](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_conf\_command](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_crl](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_dhparam](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_ecdh\_curve](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_password\_file](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_prefer\_server\_ciphers](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_protocols](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_session\_cache](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_session\_ticket\_key](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_session\_tickets](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_session\_timeout](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_verify\_client](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_verify\_depth](#p-123)<br>     [starttls](#p-123)<br>[範例配置](#p-123)<br>[指示](#p-123)<br>     [ssl](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_certificate](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_certificate_compression](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_certificate_key](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_ciphers](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_client_certificate](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_conf_command](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_crl](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_dhparam](#p-123)<br>     [ssl\_ecdh\_curve](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_password_file](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_prefer_server_ciphers](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_protocols](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_session_cache](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_session_ticket_key](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_session_tickets](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_session_timeout](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_trusted_certificate](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_verify_client](#p-123)<br>     [ssl_verify_depth](#p-123)<br>     [starttls](#p-123) |

The `ngx_mail_ssl_module` module provides the necessary support for a mail proxy server to work with the SSL/TLS protocol.

`ngx_mail_ssl_module`模組為郵件代理伺服器與SSL/TLS協定配合使用提供了必要的支援。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-mail_ssl_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-mail_ssl_module`配置參數啟用。

> This module requires the [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/) library.
>
> 本模組需要 [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/)函式庫。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

To reduce the processor load, it is recommended to

為了降低處理器負載，建議…

-   set the number of [worker processes](#p-125) equal to the number of processors,  
    將[工作進程](#p-125)的數量設定為等於處理器數量，
-   enable the [shared](#p-123) session cache,  
    啟用[共享](#p-123)會話緩存，
-   disable the [built-in](#p-123) session cache,  
    停用[內建](#p-123)會話緩存，
-   and possibly increase the session [lifetime](#p-123) (by default, 5 minutes):  
    並可能增加會話[生命週期](#p-123) （預設值為 5 分鐘）：

> ```
> worker_processes auto;
>
> worker_processes 自動；
> 
> mail {
>
> 郵件 {
> 
>     ...
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen              993 ssl;
>
>         監聽 993 ssl；
> 
>         ssl_protocols       TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>
>         ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>         ssl_ciphers         AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:RC4-SHA:DES-CBC3-SHA:RC4-MD5;
>
>         ssl_ciphers AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:RC4-SHA:DES-CBC3-SHA:RC4-MD5 ;
>         ssl_certificate     /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.pem;
>
>         ssl_certificate /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.pem;
>         ssl_certificate_key /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.key;
>         ssl_session_cache   shared:SSL:10m;
>
>         ssl_session_cache 共享: SSL :10m;
>         ssl_session_timeout 10m;
> 
>         ...
>     }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl off;<br>SSL 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive was made obsolete in version 1.15.0 and was removed in version 1.25.1. The `ssl` parameter of the [listen](#p-117) directive should be used instead.

該指令在版本1.15.0中已過時，並在版本1.25.1中被移除。應改用[listen](#p-117)指令的`ssl`參數。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with the certificate in the PEM format for the given server. If intermediate certificates should be specified in addition to a primary certificate, they should be specified in the same file in the following order: the primary certificate comes first, then the intermediate certificates. A secret key in the PEM format may be placed in the same file.

為給定伺服器指定具有 PEM 格式憑證的 `*file*`。如果除了主證書之外還應指定中間證書，則應按以下順序在同一文件中指定它們：首先是主證書，然後是中間證書。 PEM 格式的金鑰可以放置在同一文件中。

Since version 1.11.0, this directive can be specified multiple times to load certificates of different types, for example, RSA and ECDSA:

自版本1.11.0起，可以多次指定此指令以載入不同類型的證書，例如RSA和ECDSA ：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen              993 ssl;
>
>     監聽 993 ssl；
> 
>     ssl_certificate     example.com.rsa.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate example.com.rsa.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key example.com.rsa.key;
> 
>     ssl_certificate     example.com.ecdsa.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate example.com.ecdsa.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key example.com.ecdsa.key;
> 
>     ...
> }
> ```

> Only OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher supports separate [certificate chains](#p-042) for different certificates. With older versions, only one certificate chain can be used.
>
> 只有 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本才支援為不同的憑證使用獨立的憑證鏈(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html#chains) 。舊版只能使用一條憑證鏈。

The value `data`:`*certificate*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.15.10), which loads a certificate without using intermediate files. Note that inappropriate use of this syntax may have its security implications, such as writing secret key data to [error log](#p-125).

可以使用值`data`:`*certificate*`代替`*file*` ( 1.15.10 )，這樣無需使用中間文件即可載入證書。請注意，不當使用此語法可能會帶來安全隱患，例如將金鑰資料寫入 [錯誤日誌](#p-125) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_certificate_compression</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_certificate_compression off;<br>關閉 SSL 憑證壓縮；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.1.

該指令出現在版本1.29.1 。

Enables TLS 1.3 [compression](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8879) of server certificates.

啟用伺服器憑證的TLS 1.3 [壓縮](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8879) 。

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 3.2 or higher; the list of supported compression algorithms is provided by the library.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 3.2或更高版本時支援此指令；支援的壓縮演算法清單由函式庫提供。

> The directive is supported when using BoringSSL; the list of supported compression algorithms includes `zlib` (1.29.3).
>
> 使用 BoringSSL 時支援該指令；支援的壓縮演算法清單包括`zlib` ( 1.29.3 )。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_certificate_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_certificate_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with the secret key in the PEM format for the given server.

指定一個`*file*` ，其中包含給定伺服器的PEM格式的金鑰。

The value `engine`:`*name*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.7.9), which loads a secret key with a specified `*id*` from the OpenSSL engine `*name*`.

可指定值`engine`:`*name*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.7.9 )，該值會從 OpenSSL 引擎`*name*`載入具有指定`*id*`的金鑰。

The value `store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.29.0), which is used to load a secret key with a specified `*id*` and OpenSSL provider registered URI `*scheme*`, such as [`pkcs11`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512).

可指定值`store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.29.0 )，該值用於載入具有指定`*id*`和已註冊 OpenSSL 提供者URI `*scheme*`的金鑰，例如 [ `pkcs11` (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512)

The value `data`:`*key*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.15.10), which loads a secret key without using intermediate files. Note that inappropriate use of this syntax may have its security implications, such as writing secret key data to [error log](#p-125).

可以使用值`data`:`*key*`代替`*file*` ( 1.15.10 )，這樣無需使用中間檔案即可載入金鑰。請注意，不當使用此語法可能會帶來安全隱患，例如將金鑰資料寫入 [錯誤日誌](#p-125) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ciphers</strong> <code><i>ciphers</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies the enabled ciphers. The ciphers are specified in the format understood by the OpenSSL library, for example:

指定啟用的密碼套件。密碼套件以 OpenSSL 庫可識別的格式指定，例如：

> ```
> ssl_ciphers ALL:!aNULL:!EXPORT56:RC4+RSA:+HIGH:+MEDIUM:+LOW:+SSLv2:+EXP;
>
> ssl_ciphers ALL :!aNULL:! EXPORT56:RC4+RSA:+HIGH:+MEDIUM:+LOW :+SSLv2:+ EXP ;
> ```

The full list can be viewed using the “`openssl ciphers`” command.

可以使用「 `openssl ciphers` 」指令查看完整清單。

> The previous versions of nginx used [different](#p-042) ciphers by default.
>
> 先前的 nginx 版本預設使用 [不同的](#p-042)密碼。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_client_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_client_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-123) client certificates.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-123)客戶端證書。

The list of certificates will be sent to clients. If this is not desired, the [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-123) directive can be used.

證書清單將發送給客戶端。如果不需要此操作，可以使用 [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-123)指令。

| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.19.4.

該指令出現在版本1.19.4 。

Sets arbitrary OpenSSL configuration [commands](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html).

設定任意 OpenSSL 設定 [指令](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) .

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，支援該指令。

Several `ssl_conf_command` directives can be specified on the same level:

可以在同一層級指定多個`ssl_conf_command`指令：

> ```
> ssl_conf_command Options PrioritizeChaCha;
>
> ssl_conf_command 選項 PrioritizeChaCha;
> ssl_conf_command Ciphersuites TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256;
>
> ssl_conf_command 密碼套件 TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256;
> ```

These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `ssl_conf_command` directives defined on the current level.

如果目前等級沒有定義`ssl_conf_command`指令，則這些指令將從上一個設定等級繼承。

> Note that configuring OpenSSL directly might result in unexpected behavior.
>
> 請注意，直接配置 OpenSSL 可能會導致意外行為。

|   |   |

| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_crl** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_crl** ` *文件* `;` ` |

| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Specifies a `*file*` with revoked certificates (CRL) in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-123) client certificates. When using intermediate certificates, their CRLs should be specified in the same file.

指定一個包含已吊銷憑證（ CRL ）的`*file*`其格式為PEM用於[驗證](#p-123)客戶端憑證。使用中間憑證時，應在同一文件中指定其憑證撤銷清單 (CRL)。

| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 0.7.2.

該指令出現在版本0.7.2 。

Specifies a `*file*` with DH parameters for DHE ciphers.

為DHE密碼指定`*file*`和DH參數。

By default no parameters are set, and therefore DHE ciphers will not be used.

預設不設定任何參數，因此不會使用DHE密碼。

> Prior to version 1.11.0, builtin parameters were used by default.
>
> 在版本1.11.0之前，預設使用內建參數。

<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ecdh_curve</strong> <code><i>curve</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ecdh_curve auto;<br>ssl_ecdh_curve 自動；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in versions 1.1.0 and 1.0.6.

該指令出現在版本1.1.0和1.0.6中。

Specifies a `*curve*` for ECDHE ciphers.

為ECDHE密碼指定`*curve*` 。

When using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher, it is possible to specify multiple curves (1.11.0), for example:

使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，可以指定多個曲線 ( 1.11.0 )，例如：

> ```
> ssl_ecdh_curve prime256v1:secp384r1;
> ```

The special value `auto` (1.11.0) instructs nginx to use a list built into the OpenSSL library when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher, or `prime256v1` with older versions.

特殊值`auto` ( 1.11.0 ) 指示 nginx 在使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，或在舊版本中使用`prime256v1`時，使用 OpenSSL 庫中內建的清單。

> Prior to version 1.11.0, the `prime256v1` curve was used by default.
>
> 在1.11.0版本之前，預設使用`prime256v1`曲線。

> When using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher, this directive sets the list of curves supported by the server. Thus, in order for ECDSA certificates to work, it is important to include the curves used in the certificates.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，此指令設定伺服器支援的曲線清單。因此，為了使ECDSA憑證正常運作，必須包含憑證中使用的曲線。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_password_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_password_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.3.

該指令出現在版本1.7.3 。

Specifies a `*file*` with passphrases for [secret keys](#p-123) where each passphrase is specified on a separate line. Passphrases are tried in turn when loading the key.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含 [金鑰](#p-123)的密碼短語，每個密碼短語單獨一行指定。載入金鑰時，將依序嘗試這些密碼短語。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> mail {
>
> 郵件 {
>     ssl_password_file /etc/keys/global.pass;
>     ...
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         server_name mail1.example.com;
>
>         伺服器名稱 mail1.example.com；
>         ssl_certificate_key /etc/keys/first.key;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         server_name mail2.example.com;
>
>         伺服器名稱 mail2.example.com；
> 
>         # named pipe can also be used instead of a file｜命名管道也可以代替文件使用。
>         ssl_password_file /etc/keys/fifo;
>         ssl_certificate_key /etc/keys/second.key;
>     }
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_prefer_server_ciphers</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;<br>關閉 ssl_prefer_server_ciphers；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies that server ciphers should be preferred over client ciphers when the SSLv3 and TLS protocols are used.

規定在使用 SSLv3 和TLS協定時，應優先使用伺服器密碼而非客戶端密碼。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>ssl_protocols</strong> [<code>SSLv2</code>] [<code>SSLv3</code>] [<code>TLSv1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.2</code>] [<code>TLSv1.3</code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> ssl_protocols </strong> [ <code> SSLv2 </code> <code> [ <code> SSLv3 </code> </code> ] [ <code> TLSv1.1 </code> ] [ <code> TLSv1.2 </code> ] [ <code> </code> </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;<br>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables the specified protocols.

啟用指定的協定。

> The `TLSv1.1` and `TLSv1.2` parameters (1.1.13, 1.0.12) work only when OpenSSL 1.0.1 or higher is used.
>
> `TLSv1.1`和`TLSv1.2`參數 ( 1.1.13, 1.0.12 ) 僅在使用 OpenSSL 1.0.1或更高版本時有效。

> The `TLSv1.3` parameter (1.13.0) works only when OpenSSL 1.1.1 or higher is used.
>
> `TLSv1.3`參數 ( 1.13.0 ) 僅在使用 OpenSSL 1.1.1或更高版本時有效。

> The `TLSv1.3` parameter is used by default since 1.23.4.
>
> `TLSv1.3`參數預設使用，因為1.23.4參數預設使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_session_cache</strong> <code>off<br>關閉</code> | <code>none<br>無</code> | [<code>builtin<br>[</code>[:<br><code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>]] [<code>shared<br>共享</code>:<code><i>name<br>名稱</i></code>:<code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_session_cache none;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the types and sizes of caches that store session parameters. A cache can be of any of the following types:

設定用於儲存會話參數的快取類型和大小。快取可以是以下任何一種類型：

`off`

the use of a session cache is strictly prohibited: nginx explicitly tells a client that sessions may not be reused.

嚴禁使用會話快取：nginx 明確告知客戶端會話不得重複使用。

`none`

the use of a session cache is gently disallowed: nginx tells a client that sessions may be reused, but does not actually store session parameters in the cache.

nginx 會委婉地禁止使用會話快取：nginx 會告訴客戶端會話可以重複使用，但實際上不會將會話參數儲存在快取中。

`builtin`

a cache built in OpenSSL; used by one worker process only. The cache size is specified in sessions. If size is not given, it is equal to 20480 sessions. Use of the built-in cache can cause memory fragmentation.

OpenSSL 內建快取；僅供單一工作進程使用。快取大小以會話數 (session) 為單位指定。如果未指定大小，則預設為 20480 個會話。使用內建快取可能會導致記憶體碎片。

`shared`

a cache shared between all worker processes. The cache size is specified in bytes; one megabyte can store about 4000 sessions. Each shared cache should have an arbitrary name. A cache with the same name can be used in several servers. It is also used to automatically generate, store, and periodically rotate TLS session ticket keys (1.23.2) unless configured explicitly using the [ssl\_session\_ticket\_key](#p-123) directive.

一個在所有工作進程之間共享的快取。快取大小以位元組為單位指定；1 MB 大約可以儲存 4000 個會話。每個共享快取都應該有一個任意名稱。同名快取可以在多個伺服器上使用。它也用於自動產生、儲存和定期輪換會話票據金鑰（ TLS ）（ 1.23.2 ），除非使用 [ssl_session_ticket_key](#p-123)指令明確配置。

Both cache types can be used simultaneously, for example:

兩種快取類型可以同時使用，例如：

> ```
> ssl_session_cache builtin:1000 shared:SSL:10m;
>
> ssl_session_cache builtin:1000 shared: SSL :10m;
> ```

but using only shared cache without the built-in cache should be more efficient.

但是，如果只使用共享快取而不使用內建緩存，效率應該會更高。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_session_ticket_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_session_ticket_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.5.7.

該指令出現在版本1.5.7 。

Sets a `*file*` with the secret key used to encrypt and decrypt TLS session tickets. The directive is necessary if the same key has to be shared between multiple servers. By default, a randomly generated key is used.

設定用於加密和解密TLS會話票證的私鑰`*file*` 。如果需要在多個伺服器之間共用相同金鑰，則此指令是必需的。預設情況下，使用隨機產生的密鑰。

If several keys are specified, only the first key is used to encrypt TLS session tickets. This allows configuring key rotation, for example:

如果指定了多個金鑰，則僅使用第一個金鑰來加密TLS會話票證。這樣可以配置金鑰輪換，例如：

> ```
> ssl_session_ticket_key current.key;
> ssl_session_ticket_key previous.key;
> ```

The `*file*` must contain 80 or 48 bytes of random data and can be created using the following command:

`*file*`必須包含 80 或 48 位元組的隨機數據，可以使用以下命令創建：

> ```
> openssl rand 80 > ticket.key
> ```

Depending on the file size either AES256 (for 80-byte keys, 1.11.8) or AES128 (for 48-byte keys) is used for encryption.

根據檔案大小，使用AES256 （80 位元組金鑰）、 1.11.8或AES128 （48 位元組金鑰）進行加密。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_session_tickets</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_session_tickets on;<br>啟用 ssl_session_tickets；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.5.9.

該指令出現在版本1.5.9 。

Enables or disables session resumption through [TLS session tickets](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5077).

透過 [TLS會話票證](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5077)啟用或停用會話恢復。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_session_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_session_timeout 5m;<br>ssl_session_timeout 5分鐘；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies a time during which a client may reuse the session parameters.

指定客戶端可以重複使用會話參數的時間段。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_trusted_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_trusted_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mail`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-123) client certificates.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-123)客戶端證書。

In contrast to the certificate set by [ssl\_client\_certificate](#p-123), the list of these certificates will not be sent to clients.

與 [ssl\_client\_certificate](#p-123)設定的憑證不同，這些憑證的清單不會傳送給客戶端。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_verify_client</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code>optional<br>選修的</code> | <code>optional_no_ca</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_verify_client off;<br>關閉 ssl_verify_client;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Enables verification of client certificates. The verification result is passed in the “Auth-SSL-Verify”（身份驗證-SSL驗證） header of the [authentication](#p-116) request.

啟用客戶端憑證驗證。驗證結果透過 [authentication](#p-116)請求的“Auth-SSL-Verify”（身份驗證-SSL驗證）標頭傳遞。

The `optional` parameter requests the client certificate and verifies it if the certificate is present.

`optional`參數請求客戶端證書，並驗證證書是否存在。

The `optional_no_ca` parameter requests the client certificate but does not require it to be signed by a trusted CA certificate. This is intended for the use in cases when a service that is external to nginx performs the actual certificate verification. The contents of the certificate is accessible through requests [sent](#p-116) to the authentication server.

`optional_no_ca`參數請求客戶端證書，但不要求該證書必須由受信任的CA證書簽署。這適用於由 nginx 外部服務執行實際憑證驗證的情況。證書內容可透過向身份驗證伺服器發送的(https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_auth_http_module.html#auth_http_pass_client_cert)請求存取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_verify_depth</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_verify_depth 1;<br>ssl_verify_depth 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Sets the verification depth in the client certificates chain.

設定客戶端憑證鏈的驗證深度。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>starttls<br>啟動tls</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code>only<br>僅有的</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>starttls off;<br>啟動關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

`on`

allow usage of the `STLS` command for the POP3 and the `STARTTLS` command for the IMAP and SMTP;

允許對POP3使用`STLS`命令，對IMAP和SMTP使用`STARTTLS`命令；

`off`

deny usage of the `STLS` and `STARTTLS` commands;

禁止使用`STLS`和`STARTTLS`命令；

`only`

require preliminary TLS transition.

需要初步的TLS過渡。

<a id="p-124"></a>

#### Debugging nginx with DTrace pid provider｜使用 DTrace pid 提供者調試 nginx

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/nginx_dtrace_pid_provider.html>

##### Debugging nginx with DTrace pid provider｜使用 DTrace pid 提供者調試 nginx

This article assumes the reader has a general knowledge of nginx internals and [DTrace](#p-124).

本文假設讀者對 nginx 內部機制和 [DTrace](#p-124)有一般了解。

Although nginx built with the [\--with-debug](#p-027) option already provides a lot of information about request processing, it is sometimes desirable to trace particular parts of code path more thoroughly and at the same time omit the rest of debugging output. DTrace pid provider (available on Solaris, macOS) is a useful tool to explore userland program’s internals, since it doesn’t require any code changes and it can help with the task. A simple DTrace script to trace and print nginx function calls may look like this:

儘管使用 `--with-debug](https://nginx.org/en/docs/debugging_log.html)選項建立的 nginx 已經提供了大量關於請求處理的信息，但有時我們仍然需要更徹底地追蹤程式碼路徑的特定部分，同時忽略其餘的偵錯輸出。 DTrace 進程 ID 提供者（可在 Solaris 和 macOS 上使用）是一個用於探索使用者空間程式內部結構的實用工具，因為它無需任何程式碼變更即可完成這項任務。一個簡單的 DTrace 腳本，用於追蹤和列印 nginx 函數調用，可能如下所示：

> ```
> #pragma D option flowindent
> 
> pid$target:nginx::entry {
> }
> 
> pid$target:nginx::return {
> }
> ```

DTrace capabilities for function calls tracing provide only a limited amount of useful information, though. Real-time inspection of function arguments is typically more interesting, but also a bit more complicated. Examples below are intended to help the reader become more familiar with DTrace and the process of analyzing nginx behavior using DTrace.

DTrace 的函數呼叫追蹤功能雖然可以提供有限的有用信息，但即時檢查函數參數通常更有意義，但也更複雜一些。以下範例旨在幫助讀者更了解 DTrace 以及如何使用 DTrace 分析 nginx 的行為。

One of the common scenarios for using DTrace with nginx is the following: attach to the nginx worker process to log request lines and request start times. The corresponding function to attach is `ngx_http_process_request()`, and the argument in question is a pointer to the `ngx_http_request_t` structure. DTrace script for such request logging can be as simple as:

DTrace 與 nginx 配合使用的常見場景之一是：附加到 nginx 工作進程以記錄請求行和請求開始時間。對應的附加函數是`ngx_http_process_request()` ，其參數是指向`ngx_http_request_t`結構的指標。用於此類請求日誌記錄的 DTrace 腳本可以非常簡單，如下所示：

> ```
> pid$target::*ngx_http_process_request:entry
> {
>     this->request = (ngx_http_request_t *)copyin(arg0, sizeof(ngx_http_request_t));
>     this->request_line = stringof(copyin((uintptr_t)this->request->request_line.data,
>                                          this->request->request_line.len));
>     printf("request line = %s\n", this->request_line);
>
>     printf("請求行 = %s\n", this->request_line);
>     printf("request start sec = %d\n", this->request->start_sec);
>
>     printf("請求開始時間 = %d\n", this->request->start_sec);
> }
> ```

It should be noted that in the example above DTrace requires some knowledge about the `ngx_http_request_t` structure. Unfortunately while it is possible to use a specific `#include` directive in the DTrace script and then pass it to a C preprocessor (with the `-C` flag), that doesn’t really work. Due to a lot of cross dependencies, almost all nginx header files have to be included. In turn, based on `configure` script settings, nginx headers will include PCRE, OpenSSL and a variety of system header files. While in theory all those header files related to a specific nginx build might be included in DTrace script preprocessing and compilation, in reality DTrace script most probably will fail to compile because of unknown syntax in some header files.

需要注意的是，在上面的範例中，DTrace 需要一些關於`ngx_http_request_t`結構的知識。遺憾的是，雖然可以在 DTrace 腳本中使用特定的`#include`指令，然後將其傳遞給 C 預處理器（使用`-C`標誌），但這實際上行不通。由於存在大量的交叉依賴關係，幾乎所有 nginx 頭檔都必須包含在內。反過來，根據`configure`腳本設置，nginx 頭檔將包含PCRE 、OpenSSL 和各種系統頭檔。雖然理論上與特定 nginx 建置相關的所有頭檔都可以包含在 DTrace 腳本的預處理和編譯過程中，但實際上，由於某些頭檔中存在未知的語法，DTrace 腳本很可能會編譯失敗。

The problem above can be solved by including only the relevant and necessary structure and type definitions in the DTrace script. DTrace has to know sizes of structures, types, and fields offsets. Thus dependencies can be further reduced by manually optimizing structure definitions for use with DTrace.

上述問題可以透過在 DTrace 腳本中僅包含相關且必要的結構和類型定義來解決。 DTrace 需要知道結構、型別和欄位偏移量的大小。因此，透過手動優化結構定義以供 DTrace 使用，可以進一步減少依賴關係。

Let’s use DTrace script example above and see what structure definitions it needs to work properly.

讓我們以上面的 DTrace 腳本範例為例，看看它需要哪些結構定義才能正常運作。

First of all `objs/ngx_auto_config.h` file generated by configure should be included, because it defines a number of constants affecting various `#ifdef`’s. After that, some basic types and definitions like `ngx_str_t`, `ngx_table_elt_t`, `ngx_uint_t` etc. should be put at the beginning of the DTrace script. These definitions are compact, commonly used and unlikely to be frequently changed.

首先，應該包含 configure 產生的`objs/ngx_auto_config.h`文件，因為它定義了許多影響各種`#ifdef`的常數。之後，應該在 DTrace 腳本的開頭添加一些基本類型和定義，例如`ngx_str_t`, `ngx_table_elt_t`, `ngx_uint_t`等。這些定義簡潔明了，常用且不太可能頻繁更改。

Then there’s the `ngx_http_request_t` structure that contains a lot of pointers to other structures. Because these pointers are really irrelevant to this script, and because they have the same size, it is possible to just replace them with void pointers. Instead of changing definitions, it is better to add appropriate typedefs, though:

然後是`ngx_http_request_t`結構體，它包含許多指向其他結構的指標。由於這些指標與本腳本無關，且它們的大小相同，因此可以直接用 void 指標取代它們。不過，與其修改定義，不如加入適當的 typedef：

> ```
> typedef ngx_http_upstream_t     void;
>
> typedef ngx_http_upstream_t void;
> typedef ngx_http_request_body_t void;
> ```

Last but not least it is necessary to add definitions of two member structures (`ngx_http_headers_in_t`, `ngx_http_headers_out_t`), declarations of callback functions and definitions of constants.

最後，還需要加入兩個成員結構（ `ngx_http_headers_in_t`, `ngx_http_headers_out_t` ）的定義、回呼函數的宣告和常數的定義。

The final DTrace script can be downloaded from [here](http://nginx.org/download/trace_process_request.d).

最終的 DTrace 腳本可以從[這裡](http://nginx.org/download/trace_process_request.d)下載。

The following example shows the output of running this script:

以下範例顯示了執行此腳本的輸出結果：

> ```yaml
> # dtrace -C -I ./objs -s trace_process_request.d -p 4848
> dtrace: script 'trace_process_request.d' matched 1 probe
>
> dtrace：腳本“trace_process_request.d”匹配到 1 個探針
> CPU     ID                    FUNCTION:NAME
>   1      4 .XAbmO.ngx_http_process_request:entry request line = GET / HTTP/1.1
>
>   1 4 .XAbmO.ngx_http_process_request:entry 請求行 = GET / HTTP/1.1
> request start sec = 1349162898
>
> 請求開始時間（秒）= 1349162898
> 
>   0      4 .XAbmO.ngx_http_process_request:entry request line = GET /en/docs/nginx_dtrace_pid_provider.html HTTP/1.1
>
>   0 4 .XAbmO.ngx_http_process_request:entry 請求行 = GET /en/docs/nginx_dtrace_pid_provider.html HTTP/1.1
> request start sec = 1349162899
>
> 請求開始時間（秒）= 1349162899
> ```

Using similar techniques the reader should be able to trace other nginx function calls.

使用類似的技術，讀者應該能夠追蹤其他 nginx 函數呼叫。

**See also｜參見**

-   [Solaris Dynamic Tracing Guide](http://docs.oracle.com/cd/E19253-01/817-6223/index.html)  
    [Solaris 動態追蹤指南](http://docs.oracle.com/cd/E19253-01/817-6223/index.html)
-   [Introduction article on DTrace pid provider](http://dtrace.org/blogs/brendan/2011/02/09/dtrace-pid-provider/)  
    [DTrace pid 提供程式介紹文章](http://dtrace.org/blogs/brendan/2011/02/09/dtrace-pid-provider/)
