| [Example Configuration](#p-125)<br>[Directives](#p-125)<br>     [accept\_mutex](#p-125)<br>     [accept\_mutex\_delay](#p-125)<br>     [daemon](#p-125)<br>     [debug\_connection](#p-125)<br>     [debug\_points](#p-125)<br>     [env](#p-125)<br>     [error\_log](#p-125)<br>     [events](#p-125)<br>     [include](#p-125)<br>     [load\_module](#p-125)<br>     [lock\_file](#p-125)<br>     [master\_process](#p-125)<br>     [multi\_accept](#p-125)<br>     [pcre\_jit](#p-125)<br>     [pid](#p-125)<br>     [ssl\_engine](#p-125)<br>     [ssl\_object\_cache\_inheritable](#p-125)<br>     [stall\_threshold](#p-125)<br>     [thread\_pool](#p-125)<br>     [timer\_resolution](#p-125)<br>     [use](#p-125)<br>     [user](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_aio\_requests](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_connections](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_cpu\_affinity](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_priority](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_processes](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_rlimit\_core](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_rlimit\_nofile](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_shutdown\_timeout](#p-125)<br>     [working\_directory](#p-125)<br>[範例配置](#p-125)<br>[指示](#p-125)<br>     [接受互斥鎖](#p-125)<br>     [接受互斥鎖延遲](#p-125)<br>     [守護程式](#p-125)<br>     [debug\_connection](#p-125)<br>     [debug\_points](#p-125)<br>     [環境](#p-125)<br>     [error\_log](#p-125)<br>     [事件](#p-125)<br>     [包括](#p-125)<br>     [載入模組](#p-125)<br>     [lock\_file](#p-125)<br>     [主進程](#p-125)<br>     [多接受](#p-125)<br>     [pcre\_jit](#p-125)<br>     [pid](#p-125)<br>     [ssl_engine](#p-125)<br>     [ssl\_object\_cache\_inheritable](#p-125)<br>     [停滯閾值](#p-125)<br>     [線程池](#p-125)<br>     [timer\_resolution](#p-125)<br>     [使用](#p-125)<br>     [使用者](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_aio\_requests](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_connections](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_cpu\_affinity](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_priority](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_processes](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_rlimit\_core](#p-125)<br>     [worker\_rlimit\_nofile](#p-125)<br>     [worker_shutdown_timeout](#p-125)<br>     [工作目錄](#p-125) |

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> user www www;
>
> 使用者 www www;
> worker_processes 2;
>
> 工作進程 2；
> 
> error_log /var/log/nginx-error.log info;
>
> 錯誤日誌 /var/log/nginx-error.log 訊息;
> 
> events {
>
> 事件 {
>     use kqueue;
>
>     使用 kqueue；
>     worker_connections 2048;
>
>     工作連線數 2048；
> }
> 
> ...
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>accept_mutex</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>accept_mutex off;<br>關閉互斥鎖；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>events<br>事件</code></td></tr>
</table>

If `accept_mutex` is enabled, worker processes will accept new connections by turn. Otherwise, all worker processes will be notified about new connections, and if volume of new connections is low, some of the worker processes may just waste system resources.

如果啟用`accept_mutex` ，工作進程將輪流接受新連線。否則，所有工作流程都會收到新連線的通知，如果新連線數量較少，部分工作流程可能會浪費系統資源。

> There is no need to enable `accept_mutex` on systems that support the [EPOLLEXCLUSIVE](#p-030) flag (1.11.3) or when using [reuseport](#p-056).
>
> 在支援 [EPOLLEXCLUSIVE](#p-030)標誌 ( 1.11.3 ) 的系統上，或在使用 [reuseport](#p-056)時，無需啟用`accept_mutex` 。

> Prior to version 1.11.3, the default value was `on`.
>
> 在版本1.11.3之前，預設值為`on` 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>accept_mutex_delay</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>accept_mutex_delay 500ms;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>events<br>事件</code></td></tr>
</table>

If [accept\_mutex](#p-125) is enabled, specifies the maximum time during which a worker process will try to restart accepting new connections if another worker process is currently accepting new connections.

如果啟用了 [accept\_mutex](#p-125) ，則指定當另一個工作進程目前正在接受新連線時，工作進程會嘗試重新接受新連線的最大時間。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>daemon<br>守護程式</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>daemon on;<br>守護程式開啟；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether nginx should become a daemon. Mainly used during development.

決定nginx是否應作為守護程式運行。主要用於開發階段。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**debug_connection** `*address*` \| `*CIDR*` \| `unix:`;``<br>` `**debug_connection** ` *地址* ` \| ` * CIDR * ` \| ` unix: `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `events` |

Enables debugging log for selected client connections. Other connections will use logging level set by the [error\_log](#p-125) directive. Debugged connections are specified by IPv4 or IPv6 (1.3.0, 1.2.1) address or network. A connection may also be specified using a hostname. For connections using UNIX-domain sockets (1.3.0, 1.2.1), debugging log is enabled by the “`unix:`” parameter.

啟用選定客戶端連線的偵錯日誌。其他連線將使用 [error\_log](#p-125)指令設定的日誌等級。調試連線透過 IPv4 或 IPv6 ( 1.3.0, 1.2.1 ) 位址或網路指定。也可以使用主機名稱指定連線。對於使用UNIX域套接字 ( 1.3.0, 1.2.1 ) 的連接，偵錯日誌由「 `unix:` 」參數啟用。

> ```
> events {
>
> 事件 {
>     debug_connection 127.0.0.1;
>
>     debug_connection 127.0.0.1 ;
>     debug_connection localhost;
>     debug_connection 192.0.2.0/24;
>
>     debug_connection 192.0.2.0/24 ;
>     debug_connection ::1;
>     debug_connection 2001:0db8::/32;
>
>     debug_connection 2001:0db8::/32 ;
>     debug_connection unix:;
>     ...
> }
> ```

> For this directive to work, nginx needs to be built with `--with-debug`, see “[A debugging log](#p-027)”.
>
> 若要使此指令生效，nginx 需要使用`--with-debug`構建，請參閱「[偵錯日誌](#p-027) 」。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**debug_points** `abort` \| `stop`;``<br>` `**debug_points** `中止` \| `停止`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

This directive is used for debugging.

此指令用於調試。

When internal error is detected, e.g. the leak of sockets on restart of working processes, enabling `debug_points` leads to a core file creation (`abort`) or to stopping of a process (`stop`) for further analysis using a system debugger.

當偵測到內部錯誤時，例如在工作進程重新啟動時套接字洩漏，啟用`debug_points`會導致建立核心檔案 ( `abort` ) 或停止進程 ( `stop` ) 以便使用系統偵錯器進行進一步分析。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>env<br>環境變數</strong> <code><i>variable<br>變數</i></code>[=<code><i>value<br>值</i></code>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>env<br>環境TZ;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

By default, nginx removes all environment variables inherited from its parent process except the TZ variable. This directive allows preserving some of the inherited variables, changing their values, or creating new environment variables. These variables are then:

預設情況下，nginx 會移除從父進程繼承的所有環境變量，但TZ變數除外。此指令允許保留部分繼承的變數、更改其值或建立新的環境變數。這些變數包括：

-   inherited during a [live upgrade](#p-026) of an executable file;  
    在可執行檔的 [即時升級](#p-026)過程中繼承；
-   used by the [ngx\_http\_perl\_module](#p-084) module;  
    由 [ngx\_http\_perl\_module](#p-084)模組使用；
-   used by worker processes. One should bear in mind that controlling system libraries in this way is not always possible as it is common for libraries to check variables only during initialization, well before they can be set using this directive. An exception from this is an above mentioned [live upgrade](#p-026) of an executable file.  
    供工作進程使用。需要注意的是，並非總是能夠以這種方式控制系統庫，因為庫通常只在初始化期間檢查變量，而此時遠未達到可以通過此指令設置變量的程度。上述可執行檔的 [live upgrade](#p-026)是一個例外。

The TZ variable is always inherited and available to the [ngx\_http\_perl\_module](#p-084) module, unless it is configured explicitly.

除非明確配置，否則TZ變數總是會被 [ngx\_http\_perl\_module](#p-084)模組繼承和使用。

Usage example:

使用範例：

> ```
> env MALLOC_OPTIONS;
> env PERL5LIB=/data/site/modules;
>
> env PERL5LIB =/data/site/modules;
> env OPENSSL_ALLOW_PROXY_CERTS=1;
> ```

> The NGINX environment variable is used internally by nginx and should not be set directly by the user.
>
> NGINX環境變數由 nginx 內部使用，使用者不應直接設定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>error_log<br>錯誤日誌</strong> <code><i>file<br>文件</i></code> [<code><i>level<br>等級</i></code>] [<code>json<br>JSON</code>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>error_log logs/error.log error;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主伺服器</code>, <code>http</code>, <code>mail<br>郵件</code>, <code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Configures logging. Several logs can be specified on the same configuration level (1.5.2). If on the `main` configuration level writing a log to a file is not explicitly defined, the default file will be used.

配置日誌記錄。可以在相同配置等級（ 1.5.2 ）指定多個日誌。如果在`main`配置層級未明確定義將日誌寫入文件，則將使用預設檔。

The first parameter defines a `*file*` that will store the log. The special value `stderr` selects the standard error file. Logging to [syslog](#p-169) can be configured by specifying the “`syslog:`” prefix. Logging to a [cyclic memory buffer](#p-027) can be configured by specifying the “`memory:`” prefix and buffer `*size*`, and is generally used for debugging (1.7.11).

第一個參數定義了一個用於儲存日誌的`*file*` 。特殊值`stderr`選擇標準錯誤檔案。可以透過指定前綴「 `syslog:` 」配置將日誌記錄到 [syslog](#p-169) 。可以透過指定前綴「 `memory:` 」和緩衝區(https://nginx.org/en/docs/debugging_log.html#memory)配置將日誌記錄到 [循環記憶體緩衝區]`*size*` ，這通常用於偵錯 ( 1.7.11 )。

The second parameter determines the `*level*` of logging, and can be one of the following: `debug`, `info`, `notice`, `warn`, `error`, `crit`, `alert`, or `emerg`. Log levels above are listed in the order of increasing severity. Setting a certain log level will cause all messages of the specified and more severe log levels to be logged. For example, the default level `error` will cause `error`, `crit`, `alert`, and `emerg` messages to be logged. If this parameter is omitted then `error` is used.

第二個參數決定日誌等級`*level*` ，可以是下列數值之一： `debug`, `info`, `notice`, `warn`, `error`, `crit`, `alert`或`emerg` 。以上日誌等級依嚴重程度遞增的順序排列。設定某個日誌等級將導致記錄所有指定等級及更高等級的訊息。例如，預設等級`error`將導致記錄`error`, `crit`, `alert`和`emerg`訊息。如果省略此參數，則使用`error` 。

> For `debug` logging to work, nginx needs to be built with `--with-debug`, see “[A debugging log](#p-027)”.
>
> 若要使`debug`日誌記錄正常運作，需要使用`--with-debug`建置 nginx，請參閱「[偵錯日誌](#p-027) 」。

The `json` parameter (1.29.8) enables writing a log in the JSON format, with support for [context tags](#p-056):

`json`參數 ( 1.29.8 ) 允許以JSON格式寫入日誌，並支援 [上下文標籤](#p-056) :

> ```json
> {
>   "level": "error",
>
>   "等級": "錯誤",
>   "timestamp": "2026-05-13T10:30:15.042+00:00",
>
>   "timestamp": "2026-05-13T10:30: 15.042 +00:00",
>   "pid": 12345,  "tid": 12345,  "cnum": 3,
>
>   「pid」：12345，「tid」：12345，「cnum」：3，
>   "msg": "connect() failed",
>
>   "msg": "connect() 失敗",
>   "client": "192.168.1.10",  "server": "example.com",
>
>   "客戶端": " 192.168.1.10 ", "伺服器": "example.com",
>   "request": "GET /api HTTP/1.1",
>
>   "請求": " GET /api HTTP/1.1 ",
>   "upstream": "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api",
>
>   「上游」： http://127.0.0.1:8080/api",
>   "errno": 111,
>   "errtext": "Connection refused"
>
>   "errtext": "連線被拒絕"
> }
> ```

A log entry cannot exceed 2 KB, data beyond this limit is truncated to `“truncated”:1`. Debug logging is not supported for JSON.

日誌條目不能超過 2 KB ，超出此限制的資料將被截斷為`“truncated”:1` 。調試日誌記錄不支援JSON 。

> This parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此參數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

> The directive can be specified on the `stream` level starting from version 1.7.11, and on the `mail` level starting from version 1.9.0.
>
> 從版本1.7.11開始，可以在`stream`層級指定該指令；從版本1.9.0開始，可以在`mail`層級指定該指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**events** { ... }` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Provides the configuration file context in which the directives that affect connection processing are specified.

提供設定檔上下文，其中指定了影響連線處理的指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**include** `*file*` \| `*mask*`;``<br>` `**include** ` *檔案* ` \| ` *遮罩* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `any` |

Includes another `*file*`, or files matching the specified `*mask*`, into configuration. Included files should consist of syntactically correct directives and blocks.

將另一個`*file*`或與指定的`*mask*`匹配的檔案加入配置中。包含的檔案應包含語法正確的指令和程式碼區塊。

Usage example:

使用範例：

> ```
> include mime.types;
>
> 包含 mime.types；
> include vhosts/*.conf;
>
> 包含 vhosts/*.conf；
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**load_module** `*file*`;``<br>` `**load_module** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

This directive appeared in version 1.9.11.

該指令出現在版本1.9.11 。

Loads a dynamic module.

載入動態模組。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> load_module modules/ngx_mail_module.so;
>
> 載入模組 modules/ngx_mail_module.so;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>lock_file</strong> <code><i>file</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>lock_file logs/nginx.lock;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

nginx uses the locking mechanism to implement [accept\_mutex](#p-125) and serialize access to shared memory. On most systems the locks are implemented using atomic operations, and this directive is ignored. On other systems the “lock file” mechanism is used. This directive specifies a prefix for the names of lock files.

nginx 使用鎖定機制來實作 [accept\_mutex](#p-125)並且串列化對共享記憶體的存取。在大多數系統中，鎖是透過原子操作實現的，因此該指令會被忽略。在其他系統中，則會使用「鎖定檔案」機制。此指令指定鎖定檔案名稱的前綴。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>master_process<br>主進程</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>master_process on;<br>主進程開啟；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether worker processes are started. This directive is intended for nginx developers.

決定是否啟動工作進程。此指令面向 Nginx 開發人員。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>multi_accept</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>multi_accept off;<br>多設備接受關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>events<br>事件</code></td></tr>
</table>

If `multi_accept` is disabled, a worker process will accept one new connection at a time. Otherwise, a worker process will accept all new connections at a time.

如果`multi_accept`被停用，則工作進程一次只接受一個新連線。否則，工作進程一次接受所有新連線。

> The directive is ignored if [kqueue](#p-030) connection processing method is used, because it reports the number of new connections waiting to be accepted.
>
> 如果使用 [kqueue](#p-030)連接處理方法，則會忽略該指令，因為它會報告等待接受的新連接數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>pcre_jit</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>pcre_jit off;<br>pcre_jit 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.1.12.

該指令出現在版本1.1.12 。

Enables or disables the use of “just-in-time compilation” (PCRE JIT) for the regular expressions known by the time of configuration parsing.

啟用或停用「即時編譯」（ PCRE JIT ）功能，用於解析配置時已知的正規表示式。

PCRE JIT can speed up processing of regular expressions significantly.

PCRE JIT可以顯著加快正規表示式的處理速度。

> The JIT is available in PCRE libraries starting from version 8.20 built with the `--enable-jit` configuration parameter. When the PCRE library is built with nginx (`--with-pcre=`), the JIT support is enabled via the `--with-pcre-jit` configuration parameter.
>
> 從使用設定參數`--enable-jit`建構的8.20版本開始， JIT在PCRE庫中可用。當使用 nginx ( `--with-pcre=` ) 建構PCRE函式庫時，透過設定參數`--with-pcre-jit`啟用JIT支援。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>pid</strong> <code><i>file<br>文件</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>pid logs/nginx.pid;<br>pid logs/nginx.pid；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a `*file*` that will store the process ID of the main process.

定義一個`*file*` ，用於儲存主進程的進程ID 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**ssl_engine** `*device*`;``<br>` `**ssl_engine** ` *設備* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Defines the name of the hardware SSL accelerator.

定義硬體SSL加速器的名稱。

> The module may be dynamically loaded by OpenSSL during configuration testing.
>
> 此模組可能在配置測試期間由 OpenSSL 動態載入。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_object_cache_inheritable</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_object_cache_inheritable on;<br>ssl_object_cache_inheritable 已啟用；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.4.

該指令出現在版本1.27.4 。

If enabled, SSL objects (SSL certificates, secret keys, trusted CA certificates, CRL lists) will be inherited across configuration reloads.

若啟用， SSL物件（ SSL憑證、金鑰、受信任的CA憑證、 CRL清單）將在設定重新載入時繼承。

SSL objects loaded from a file are inherited if the modification time and file index has not been changed since the previous configuration load. Secret keys specified as `engine:name:id` are never inherited. Secret keys specified as `data:value` are always inherited.

如果自上次設定載入以來修改時間和檔案索引未更改，則繼承從檔案載入的SSL物件。指定為 `engine:name:id` 的金鑰永遠不會被繼承。指定為 `data:value` 的金鑰總是會被繼承。

> SSL objects loaded from variables cannot be inherited.
>
> SSL從變數載入的物件不能被繼承。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> ssl_object_cache_inheritable on;
>
> ssl_object_cache_inheritable 已啟用；
> 
> http {
>     ...
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         ...
>         ssl_certificate     example.com.crt;
>
>         ssl_certificate example.com.crt;
>         ssl_certificate_key example.com.key;
>     }
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>stall_threshold<br>停滯閾值</strong> <code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>stall_threshold 1000ms;<br>停滯閾值 1000 毫秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>events<br>事件</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.0.

該指令出現在版本1.29.0 。

Allows overriding the default time threshold for the event loop iteration before a stall is reported. By default, a stall is reported when an event loop iteration exceeds `*1000ms*`. If the [timer\_resolution](#p-125) directive is enabled, the time threshold will be ignored.

允許在報告停頓之前覆蓋事件循環迭代的預設時間閾值。預設情況下，當事件循環迭代超過 `*1000ms*` 時，會報告停頓。如果啟用 [timer\_resolution](#p-125) 指令，則時間閾值將被忽略。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>thread_pool</strong> <code><i>name</i></code> <code>threads</code>=<code><i>number</i></code> [<code>max_queue</code>=<code><i>number</i></code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong>線程池</strong> <code><i>名稱</i></code> <code> <code><i>數</code> = </i></code> <code>數量</code> ⧟ <code><i>數</i></code> ]; </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>thread_pool default threads=32 max_queue=65536;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Defines the `*name*` and parameters of a thread pool used for multi-threaded reading and sending of files [without blocking](#p-056) worker processes.

定義用於多執行緒讀取和傳送檔案的執行緒池的`*name*`和參數 [不阻塞](#p-056)工作進程。

The `threads` parameter defines the number of threads in the pool.

`threads`參數定義執行緒池中的執行緒數。

In the event that all threads in the pool are busy, a new task will wait in the queue. The `max_queue` parameter limits the number of tasks allowed to be waiting in the queue. By default, up to 65536 tasks can wait in the queue. When the queue overflows, the task is completed with an error.

如果池中的所有執行緒都忙碌，則新任務將在佇列中等待。 `max_queue`參數限制允許在佇列中等待的任務數量。預設情況下，佇列中最多可以等待 65536 個任務。當佇列溢出時，任務完成但出現錯誤。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**timer_resolution** `*interval*`;``<br>` `**timer_resolution** ` *間隔* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Reduces timer resolution in worker processes, thus reducing the number of `gettimeofday()` system calls made. By default, `gettimeofday()` is called each time a kernel event is received. With reduced resolution, `gettimeofday()` is only called once per specified `*interval*`.

降低工作進程中的定時器分辨率，從而減少`gettimeofday()`系統呼叫的次數。預設情況下，每次收到內核事件時都會呼叫`gettimeofday()` 。降低解析度後，每個指定的`gettimeofday()`只會呼叫一次`*interval*` 。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> timer_resolution 100ms;
>
> 定時器解析度 100 毫秒；
> ```

Internal implementation of the interval depends on the method used:

區間內部實作取決於所使用的方法：

-   the `EVFILT_TIMER` filter if `kqueue` is used;  
    若使用`kqueue` ，則使用`EVFILT_TIMER`過濾器；
-   `timer_create()` if `eventport` is used;  
    若使用`eventport` ，則`timer_create()` ；
-   `setitimer()` otherwise.  
    `setitimer()`否則。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**use** `*method*`;``<br>` `**use** ` *方法* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `events` |

Specifies the [connection processing](#p-030) `*method*` to use. There is normally no need to specify it explicitly, because nginx will by default use the most efficient method.

指定要使用的 [連接處理](#p-030) `*method*` 。通常無需明確指定，因為 nginx 預設會使用最高效的方法。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>user<br>用戶</strong> <code><i>user<br>用戶</i></code> [<code><i>group<br>組</i></code>];<br>​​];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>user nobody nobody;<br>用戶 nobody nobody；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines `*user*` and `*group*` credentials used by worker processes. If `*group*` is omitted, a group whose name equals that of `*user*` is used.

定義工作進程使用的`*user*`和`*group*`憑證。如果省略`*group*` ，則使用名稱與`*user*`相同的群組。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>worker_aio_requests</strong> <code><i>number</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>worker_aio_requests 32;<br>worker_aio_requests 32；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>events<br>事件</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in versions 1.1.4 and 1.0.7.

該指令出現在版本1.1.4和1.0.7 。

When using [aio](#p-056) with the [epoll](#p-030) connection processing method, sets the maximum `*number*` of outstanding asynchronous I/O operations for a single worker process.

當使用 [aio](#p-056)和 [epoll](#p-030)連接處理方法時，設定單一工作進程未完成非同步 I/O 操作的最大數量`*number*` 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>worker_connections</strong> <code><i>number</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>worker_connections 512;<br>工作連線數 512；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>events<br>事件</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum number of simultaneous connections that can be opened by a worker process.

設定工作進程可以同時開啟的最大連線數。

It should be kept in mind that this number includes all connections (e.g. connections with proxied servers, among others), not only connections with clients. Another consideration is that the actual number of simultaneous connections cannot exceed the current limit on the maximum number of open files, which can be changed by [worker\_rlimit\_nofile](#p-125).

需要注意的是，此數字包含所有連接（例如與代理伺服器的連接等），而不僅僅是與客戶端的連接。另一個需要考慮的因素是，實際的並發連接數不能超過目前開啟檔案的最大數量限制，該限制可以透過 [worker\_rlimit\_nofile](#p-125)進行更改。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**worker_cpu_affinity** `*cpumask*` ...;``<br>``**worker_cpu_affinity** `auto` [`*cpumask*`];``<br>` `**worker_cpu_affinity** ` *cpumask* ` ...;``<br>``**worker_cpu_affinity** ` auto ` [` *cpumask* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Binds worker processes to the sets of CPUs. Each CPU set is represented by a bitmask of allowed CPUs. There should be a separate set defined for each of the worker processes. By default, worker processes are not bound to any specific CPUs.

將工作進程綁定到 CPU 集合。每個CPU集合都由允許使用的 CPU 位元遮罩表示。每個工作進程都應該定義一個單獨的集合。預設情況下，工作進程不綁定到任何特定的 CPU。

For example,

例如，

> ```
> worker_processes    4;
>
> 工作進程 4；
> worker_cpu_affinity 0001 0010 0100 1000;
> ```

binds each worker process to a separate CPU, while

將每個工作進程綁定到單獨的CPU ，而

> ```
> worker_processes    2;
>
> 工作進程 2；
> worker_cpu_affinity 0101 1010;
> ```

binds the first worker process to CPU0/CPU2, and the second worker process to CPU1/CPU3. The second example is suitable for hyper-threading.

將第一個工作進程綁定到CPU0/CPU2 ，將第二個工作進程綁定到CPU1/CPU3 。第二個範例適用於超線程。

The special value `auto` (1.9.10) allows binding worker processes automatically to available CPUs:

特殊值`auto` ( 1.9.10 ) 允許將工作進程自動綁定到可用的 CPU：

> ```
> worker_processes auto;
>
> worker_processes 自動；
> worker_cpu_affinity auto;
>
> worker_cpu_affinity 自動；
> ```

The optional mask parameter can be used to limit the CPUs available for automatic binding:

可選的遮罩參數可用於限制可用於自動綁定的 CPU：

> ```
> worker_cpu_affinity auto 01010101;
>
> worker_cpu_affinity 自動 01010101;
> ```

> The directive is only available on FreeBSD and Linux.
>
> 此指令僅適用於 FreeBSD 和 Linux 系統。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>worker_priority<br>工作優先級</strong> <code><i>number<br>編號</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>worker_priority 0;<br>worker_priority 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines the scheduling priority for worker processes like it is done by the `nice` command: a negative `*number*` means higher priority. Allowed range normally varies from -20 to 20.

定義工作進程的調度優先權，類似`nice`指令：負的`*number*`值表示優先權較高。允許的範圍通常為 -20 到 20。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> worker_priority -10;
>
> 工作優先級 -10；
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>worker_processes</strong> <code><i>number</i></code> | <code>auto</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>worker_processes 1;<br>工作進程數 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>main<br>主要</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines the number of worker processes.

定義工作進程的數量。

The optimal value depends on many factors including (but not limited to) the number of CPU cores, the number of hard disk drives that store data, and load pattern. When one is in doubt, setting it to the number of available CPU cores would be a good start (the value “`auto`” will try to autodetect it).

最佳值取決於多種因素，包括（但不限於） CPU核心數、儲存資料的硬碟數量以及負載模式。如有疑問，可先將其設定為可用CPU核心數（值「 `auto` 」將嘗試自動偵測）。

> The `auto` parameter is supported starting from versions 1.3.8 and 1.2.5.
>
> 從版本1.3.8和1.2.5開始支援`auto`參數。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**worker_rlimit_core** `*size*`;``<br>` `**worker_rlimit_core** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Changes the limit on the largest size of a core file (`RLIMIT_CORE`) for worker processes. Used to increase the limit without restarting the main process.

更改工作進程核心轉儲檔案（ `RLIMIT_CORE` ）的最大大小限制。用於在不重啟主進程的情況下提高此限制。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**worker_rlimit_nofile** `*number*`;``<br>` `**worker_rlimit_nofile** ` *數字* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Changes the limit on the maximum number of open files (`RLIMIT_NOFILE`) for worker processes. Used to increase the limit without restarting the main process.

更改工作進程可開啟檔案的最大數量限制（ `RLIMIT_NOFILE` ）。用於在不重啟主進程的情況下增加此限制。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**worker_shutdown_timeout** `*time*`;``<br>` `**worker_shutdown_timeout** ` *時間* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.11.

該指令出現在版本1.11.11 。

Configures a timeout for a graceful shutdown of worker processes. When the `*time*` expires, nginx will try to close all the connections currently open to facilitate shutdown.

配置工作進程優雅關閉的逾時時間。當`*time*`逾時時，nginx 將嘗試關閉所有目前開啟的連接，以便順利關閉進程。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**working_directory** `*directory*`;``<br>` `**working_directory** ` *目錄* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Defines the current working directory for a worker process. It is primarily used when writing a core-file, in which case a worker process should have write permission for the specified directory.

定義工作進程的目前工作目錄。它主要用於寫入核心轉儲檔案時，此時工作進程必須對指定的目錄具有寫入權限。

<a id="p-126"></a>

#### Module ngx_google_perftools_module｜模組 ngx_google_perftools_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/ngx_google_perftools_module.html>

##### Module ngx\_google\_perftools\_module｜模組 ngx\_google\_perftools\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-126)<br>[Directives](#p-126)<br>     [google\_perftools\_profiles](#p-126)<br>[範例設定](#p-126)<br> [指令](#p-126)<br> [google\_perftools\_profiles](#p-126) |

The `ngx_google_perftools_module` module (0.6.29) enables profiling of nginx worker processes using [Google Performance Tools](https://github.com/gperftools/gperftools). The module is intended for nginx developers.

`ngx_google_perftools_module`模組（ 0.6.29 ）支援使用 [Google Performance Tools](https://github.com/gperftools/gperftools)對 nginx 工作進程進行效能分析。此模組面向 nginx 開發人員。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-google_perftools_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-google_perftools_module`配置參數啟用。

> This module requires the [gperftools](https://github.com/gperftools/gperftools) library.
>
> 本模組需要 [gperftools](https://github.com/gperftools/gperftools)函式庫。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> google_perftools_profiles /path/to/profile;
> ```

Profiles will be stored as `/path/to/profile.<worker_pid>`.

設定檔將儲存為`/path/to/profile.<worker_pid>` 。

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**google_perftools_profiles** `*file*`;``<br>` `**google_perftools_profiles** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Sets a file name that keeps profiling information of nginx worker process. The ID of the worker process is always a part of the file name and is appended to the end of the file name, after a dot.

設定一個檔案名，用於保存 nginx 工作進程的效能分析資訊。工作進程的ID始終是檔案名稱的一部分，並附加在檔案名稱末尾，以點號 (.) 結尾。

<a id="p-127"></a>

#### Module ngx_mgmt_module｜模組 ngx_mgmt_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/ngx_mgmt_module.html>

##### Module ngx\_mgmt\_module｜模組 ngx\_mgmt\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-127)<br>[Directives](#p-127)<br>     [mgmt](#p-127)<br>     [enforce\_initial\_report](#p-127)<br>     [license\_token](#p-127)<br>     [license\_pending\_token](#p-127)<br>     [proxy](#p-127)<br>     [proxy\_username](#p-127)<br>     [proxy\_password](#p-127)<br>     [resolver](#p-127)<br>     [ssl\_crl](#p-127)<br>     [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-127)<br>     [ssl\_verify](#p-127)<br>     [state\_path](#p-127)<br>     [usage\_report](#p-127)<br>[範例配置](#p-127)<br>[指示](#p-127)<br>     [管理](#p-127)<br>     [強制初始報告](#p-127)<br>     [license\_token](#p-127)<br>     [license\_pending\_token](#p-127)<br>     [代理人](#p-127)<br>     [代理用戶名](#p-127)<br>     [代理密碼](#p-127)<br>     [解決](#p-127)<br>     [ssl\_crl](#p-127)<br>     [ssl_trusted_certificate](#p-127)<br>     [ssl_verify](#p-127)<br>     [state\_path](#p-127)<br>     [使用情況報告](#p-127) |

The `ngx_mgmt_module` module enables NGINX Plus license verification and usage reporting. This is mandatory for each NGINX Plus instance since 1.27.2 ( [NGINX Plus R33](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx/releases/#r33)).

`ngx_mgmt_module`模組啟用NGINX Plus 許可證驗證和使用情況報告。自1.27.2 ( [NGINX Plus R33](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx/releases/#r33) ) 起，每個NGINX Plus 實例都必須啟用此功能。

A JWT license file named `license.jwt` should be located at `/etc/nginx/` for Linux or `/usr/local/etc/nginx/` for FreeBSD or at the path specified by the [license\_token](#p-127) directive. The license file is available from [MyF5](https://my.f5.com/).

名為`license.jwt`的JWT許可證檔案應位於 Linux 的`/etc/nginx/`或 FreeBSD 的`/usr/local/etc/nginx/`處，或位於 [license\_token](#p-127)指令指定的路徑處。許可證文件可向 [MyF5](https://my.f5.com/)取得。

Usage report is sent directly or via [proxy](#p-127) to F5 licensing endpoint [every hour](#p-127) using the [secure](#p-127) connection. Optionally, in network-restricted environments reporting can be [configured](#p-127) to [F5 NGINX Instance Manager](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-management-suite/about/) from which the report can be sent to F5 licensing endpoint.

使用情況報告將透過 [安全性](#p-127)連接，每小時直接或透過 [代理](#p-127)發送至 F5 許可端點(https://nginx.org/en/docs/ngx_mgmt_module.html#usage_report) 。此外，在網路受限的環境中，報表可以 [設定](#p-127)傳送至 [F5 NGINX實例管理器](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-management-suite/about/) ，然後從該執行個體管理器傳送至 F5 授權端點。

By default, if the [initial usage report](#p-127) is not received by F5 licensing endpoint, nginx will stop processing traffic.

預設情況下，如果 F5 許可端點未收到 [初始使用情況報告](#p-127) ，nginx 將停止處理流量。

Automatic license renewal is supported since 1.29.0 ([NGINX Plus R35](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx/releases/#r35)) for instances that report directly to the F5 licensing endpoint. On renewal, NGINX downloads the updated JWT from F5 licensing endpoint and applies it without configuration [reload](#p-166). The updated license is stored in the [state\_path](#p-127) directory.

自1.29.0 ([NGINX Plus R35](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx/releases/#r35) ) 起，對於直接向 F5 授權端點報告的實例，支援自動許可證續約。續訂時， NGINX會從 F5 授權端點下載更新後的JWT並套用，無需設定 [reload](#p-166) 。更新後的授權儲存在 [state\_path](#p-127)目錄中。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> mgmt {
>
> 管理{
>     # in case if custom path is required｜如果需要自訂路徑
>     license_token custom/file/path/license.jwt;
> 
>     # in case of reporting to NGINX Instance Manager｜如果需要向NGINX實例管理器報告，請提供相關資訊。
>     usage_report endpoint=NIM_FQDN;
>
>     使用情況報告端點=NIM_FQDN；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**mgmt** { ... }` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `main` |

Provides the configuration file context in which usage reporting and license management directives are specified.

提供設定檔上下文，其中指定了使用情況報告和許可證管理指令。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>enforce_initial_report</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>enforce_initial_report on;<br>啟用初始報告；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>mgmt<br>管理</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Enables or disables the 180-day grace period for sending the initial usage report.

啟用或停用發送初始使用情況報告的 180 天寬限期。

The initial usage report is sent immediately upon nginx first start after installation. By default, if the initial report is not received by F5 licensing endpoint, nginx stops processing traffic until the report is successfully delivered. Setting the directive value to `off` enables the 180-day grace period during which the initial usage report must be received by F5 licensing endpoint.

nginx 安裝完成後首次啟動時，會立即發送初始使用報告。預設情況下，如果 F5 許可端點未收到初始報告，nginx 將停止處理流量，直到報告成功送達。將指令值設為`off`可啟用 180 天的寬限期，在此期間 F5 許可端點必須收到初始使用報告。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>license_token</strong> <code><i>file</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>license_token license.jwt;<br>license_token license.jwt；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>mgmt<br>管理</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Specifies a JWT license `*file*`. By default, the `*license.jwt*` file is expected to be at `/etc/nginx/` for Linux or at `/usr/local/etc/nginx/` for FreeBSD.

指定JWT許可證`*file*` 。預設情況下， `*license.jwt*`檔案應位於 Linux 的`/etc/nginx/`或 FreeBSD 的`/usr/local/etc/nginx/` 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**license_pending_token** `*file*` \| `off`;``<br>` `**license_pending_token** ` *檔案* ` \| `關閉`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mgmt` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Controls how a renewed JWT license token is handled after it is received from the F5 licensing endpoint. By default, the renewed token is saved and applied immediately.

控制從 F5 許可端點收到續訂的JWT許可證令牌後如何處理。預設情況下，續訂的令牌會立即儲存並套用。

When set to a `*file*` path, the renewed token is saved to the specified file but not applied. The path is relative to [`state_path`](#p-127). The token can be copied to the active license token file or applied using the `PUT` method of the `/api/10/license` API endpoint.

當設定為`*file*`路徑時，更新後的令牌將儲存到指定文件，但不會套用。此路徑相對於 [`state_path`](#p-127) 。令牌可以複製到活動許可證令牌文件，也可以使用`/api/10/license` API端點的`PUT`方法應用。

When set to `off`, the renewal event is logged but the token is discarded. In this case, JWT license renewal is managed entirely through the `PUT` method of the `/api/10/license` API endpoint.

當設定為`off`時，續訂事件會被記錄，但令牌會被丟棄。在這種情況下， JWT許可證續訂完全透過`/api/10/license` API端點的`PUT`方法進行管理。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy** `*host*`:`*port*`;``<br>` `**proxy** ` *主機* `:` *埠* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>上下文： | `mgmt` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.4.

該指令出現在版本1.27.4 。

Sets the HTTP CONNECT proxy used for sending the usage report.

設定用於發送使用情況報告的HTTP CONNECT代理。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_username** `*string*`;``<br>` `**proxy_username** ` *字串* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mgmt` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.4.

該指令出現在版本1.27.4 。

Sets the user name used for authentication on the [proxy](#p-127).

設定用於 [proxy](#p-127)上驗證的使用者名稱。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_password** `*string*`;``<br>` `**proxy_password** ` *字串* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>上下文： | `mgmt` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.4.

該指令出現在版本1.27.4 。

Sets the password used for authentication on the [proxy](#p-127).

設定用於 [代理](#p-127)身份驗證的密碼。

The password is sent unencrypted by default. If the proxy supports TLS, the connection to the proxy can be protected with the [stream](#p-154) module:

預設情況下，密碼以未加密方式發送。如果代理程式支援TLS ，則可以使用[stream](#p-154)模組保護與代理程式的連接：

> ```
> mgmt {
>
> 管理{
>     proxy          127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>     代理127.0.0.1:8080 ;
>     proxy_username <name>;
>
>     proxy_username <name> ;
>     proxy_password <password>;
>
>     proxy_password <password> ;
> }
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>         聽127.0.0.1:8080 ;
>         
>         proxy_ssl                     on;
>
>         proxy_ssl on;
>         proxy_ssl_verify              on;
>
>         proxy_ssl_verify 已啟用；
>         proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate <proxy_ca_file>;
>
>         proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate <proxy_ca_file> ;
> 
>         proxy_pass <proxy_host>:<proxy_port>;
>
>         proxy_pass <proxy_host>:<proxy_port> ;
>     }
> }
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**resolver** `*address*` ... [`valid`=`*time*`] [`ipv4`=`on`\|`off`] [`ipv6`=`on`\|`off`] [`status_zone`=`*zone*`];``<br>` `**resolver** ` *位址* ` ... [`有效`=` *時間* `] [` IPv4 `=`開啟`\|`關閉`] [` `=`開啟`\|`關閉`] [`狀態區域`=` *區域* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mgmt` |

Configures name servers used to resolve usage reporting endpoint name. By default, the system resolver is used.

配置用於解析使用狀況報告端點名稱的名稱伺服器。預設情況下，使用系統解析器。

See [resolver](#p-056) for details.

詳情請參閱[解析器](#p-056) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**ssl_crl** `*file*`;``<br>``**ssl_crl** `*檔*`;`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mgmt` |

Specifies a `*file*` with revoked certificates (CRL) in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-127) the certificate of the usage reporting endpoint. When using intermediate certificates, their CRLs should be specified in the same file.

指定一個包含已吊銷憑證（ CRL ）的`*file*`其格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-127)使用情況報告端點的憑證。使用中間憑證時，應在同一文件中指定其憑證撤銷清單 (CRL)。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_trusted_certificate</strong> <code><i>file<br>文件</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_trusted_certificate system<br>ssl_trusted_certificate 系統CAbundle;<br>捆綁包；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>mgmt<br>管理</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-127) the certificate of the usage reporting endpoint.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-127)使用情況報告端點的證書。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_verify</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_verify on;<br>啟用 SSL 驗證；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>mgmt<br>管理</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables verification of the usage reporting endpoint certificate.

啟用或停用使用情況報告端點憑證的驗證。

> Before 1.27.2, the default value was `off`.
>
> 在1.27.2之前，預設值為`off` 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**state_path** `*path*`;``<br>` `**state_path** ` *路徑* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `mgmt` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Defines a directory for storing state files (`nginx-mgmt-*`) created by the `ngx_mgmt_module` module. The default directory for Linux is `/var/lib/nginx/state`, for FreeBSD is `/var/db/nginx/state`.

定義一個用於儲存由`ngx_mgmt_module`模組建立的狀態檔案 ( `nginx-mgmt-*` ) 的目錄。 Linux 的預設目錄為`/var/lib/nginx/state` ，FreeBSD 的預設目錄為`/var/db/nginx/state` 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>usage_report</strong> [<code>endpoint<br>端點</code>=<code><i>address<br>地址</i></code>] [<code>interval<br>間隔</code>=<code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>usage_report endpoint=product.connect.nginx.com interval=1h;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>背景：</th><td><code>mgmt<br>管理</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*address*` and `*port*` of the usage reporting endpoint. The `interval` parameter sets an interval between two consecutive reports.

設定使用狀況報告端點的`*address*`和`*port*`。 `interval` 參數設定兩個連續報告之間的間隔。

> Before 1.27.2, the default values were `nginx-mgmt.local` and `30m`.
>
> 在1.27.2之前，預設值為`nginx-mgmt.local`和`30m` 。

<a id="p-128"></a>

#### Module ngx_otel_module｜模組 ngx_otel_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/ngx_otel_module.html>

##### Module ngx\_otel\_module｜模組 ngx\_otel\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-128)<br>[Directives](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_exporter](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_service\_name](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_resource\_attr](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_trace](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_trace\_context](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_span\_name](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_span\_attr](#p-128)<br>[Default span attributes](#p-128)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-128)<br>[範例配置](#p-128)<br>[指示](#p-128)<br>     [飯店出口商](#p-128)<br>     [飯店服務名稱](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_resource\_attr](#p-128)<br>     [飯店追蹤](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_trace\_context](#p-128)<br>     [otel\_span\_name](#p-128)<br>     [hotel\_span\_attr](#p-128)<br>[預設跨距屬性](#p-128)<br>[嵌入式變數](#p-128) |

The `ngx_otel_module` module provides [OpenTelemetry](https://opentelemetry.io/) distributed tracing support. The module supports [W3C](https://w3c.github.io/trace-context) context propagation and OTLP/gRPC export protocol.

`ngx_otel_module`模組提供 [OpenTelemetry](https://opentelemetry.io/)分散式追蹤支援。本模組支援 [W3C](https://w3c.github.io/trace-context)上下文傳播和OTLP /gRPC 導出協定。

The source code of the module is available [here](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-otel). Download and install instructions are available [here](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-otel/blob/main/README.md).

此模組的原始碼可在[此處](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-otel)取得。下載和安裝說明可在[此處](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-otel/blob/main/README.md)取得。

The module is also available in a prebuilt `nginx-module-otel` [package](#p-177) since 1.25.3 and in `nginx-plus-module-otel` package as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx) since 1.23.4.

本模組也以預先建構的`nginx-module-otel` [軟體包](#p-177)的形式提供，自1.25.3起，並以`nginx-plus-module-otel`軟體包的形式提供，作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，自1.23.4

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> load_module modules/ngx_otel_module.so;
>
> 載入模組 modules/ngx_otel_module.so;
> 
> events {
>
> 事件 {
> }
> 
> http {
> 
>     otel_exporter {
>
>     hotel_exporter {
>         endpoint localhost:4317;
>
>         端點 localhost:4317;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>         聽127.0.0.1:8080 ;
> 
>         location / {
>
>         地點 / {
>             otel_trace         on;
>
>             otel_trace 已開啟；
>             otel_trace_context inject;
>
>             otel_trace_context 注入；
> 
>             proxy_pass http://backend;
>         }
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**otel_exporter** { ... }` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

Specifies OTel data export parameters:

指定OTel資料導出參數：

`endpoint [(http|https)://]host:port;`

OTLP/gRPC endpoint that will accept telemetry data. TLS is supported since 0.1.2.

OTLP /gRPC 端點0.1.2 TLS受支持。

`trusted_certificate path;`

the CA certificates file in PEM format used to verify TLS endpoint (since 0.1.2). Defaults to OS provided CA bundle.

用於驗證端點（自TLS起） 0.1.2 CA憑證檔案PEM格式）。預設為OS提供的CA捆綁包。

`header name value;`

a custom HTTP header to add to telemetry export request (since 0.1.2).

要新增到遙測導出請求的自訂HTTP標頭（因為0.1.2 ）。

`interval time;`

the maximum interval between two exports, by default is `5` seconds.

兩次導出之間的最大間隔預設為`5`秒。

`batch_size number;`

the maximum number of spans to be sent in one batch per worker, by default is `512`.

每個工作進程一次發送的最大跨度數為`512` 。

`batch_count number;`

the number of pending batches per worker, spans exceeding the limit are dropped, by default is `4`.

每個工作進程的待處理批次數量，超過限制的跨度將被丟棄，預設值為`4` 。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> otel_exporter {
>
> hotel_exporter {
>     endpoint https://otel-example.nginx.com:4317;
>
>     端點https://otel-example.nginx.com:4317;
> 
>     header X-API-Token "my-token-value";
>
>     標頭 X- API -Token“my-token-value”;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>otel_service_name<br>飯店服務名稱</strong> <code><i>name<br>名稱</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>otel_service_name unknown_service:nginx;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the “[`service.name`](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/reference/specification/resource/semantic_conventions/#service)” attribute of the OTel resource.

設定 OTel 資源的「[`service.name`](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/reference/specification/resource/semantic_conventions/#service) 」屬性。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**otel_resource_attr** `*name*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**otel_resource_attr** ` *名稱* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http` |

This directive appeared in version 0.1.2.

該指令出現在版本0.1.2。

Sets a custom OTel resource attribute.

設定自訂 OTel 資源屬性。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>otel_trace</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code>$variable<br>變數</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>otel_trace off;<br>otel_trace 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables OpenTelemetry tracing. The directive can also be enabled by specifying a variable:

啟用或停用 OpenTelemetry 追蹤。也可以透過指定變數來啟用該指令：

> ```
> split_clients "$otel_trace_id" $ratio_sampler {
>               10%              on;
>
>               10%；
>               *                off;  
                                 離開;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     location / {
>
>     地點 / {
>         otel_trace         $ratio_sampler;
>
>         otel_trace $ratio_sampler;
>         otel_trace_context inject;
>
>         otel_trace_context 注入；
>         proxy_pass         http://backend;
>
>         proxy_pass http://backend;
>     }
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>otel_trace_context</strong> <code>extract<br>提煉</code> | <code>inject<br>注入</code> | <code>propagate<br>傳播</code> | <code>ignore<br>忽略</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>otel_trace_context ignore;<br>忽略 otel_trace_context;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>http</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code>, <code>location<br>位置</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies how to propagate [traceparent/tracestate](https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/#design-overview) headers:

指定如何傳播 [traceparent/tracestate](https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/#design-overview)標頭：

`extract`

uses an existing trace context from the request, so that the identifiers of a [trace](#p-128) and the [parent span](#p-128) are inherited from the incoming request.

使用請求中已有的追蹤上下文，以便從傳入的請求繼承 [追蹤](#p-128)和 [父級 span](#p-128)的標識符。

`inject`

adds a new context to the request, overwriting existing headers, if any.

在請求中新增新的上下文，覆蓋現有的標頭（如果有）。

`propagate`

updates the existing context (combines [extract](#p-128) and [inject](#p-128)).

更新現有上下文（合併 [提取](#p-128)和 [注入](#p-128) ）。

`ignore`

skips context headers processing.

跳過上下文標頭處理。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**otel_span_name** `*name*`;``<br>` `**otel_span_name** ` *名稱* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Defines the name of the OTel [span](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/concepts/observability-primer/#spans). By default, it is a name of the location for a request. The name can contain variables.

定義 OTel [span](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/concepts/observability-primer/#spans)的名稱。預設情況下，它是請求位置的名稱。該名稱可以包含變數。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**otel_span_attr** `*name*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**otel_span_attr** ` *名稱* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `http`, `server`, `location` |

Adds a custom OTel span attribute. The value can contain variables.

新增一個自訂的 OTel span 屬性。該屬性值可以包含變數。

**Default span attributes｜預設跨度屬性**

The following [span attributes](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/registry/attributes/http/) are added automatically:

以下 [span 屬性](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/registry/attributes/http/)會自動新增：

-   `http.method`
-   `http.target`
-   `http.route`
-   `http.scheme`
-   `http.flavor`
-   `http.user_agent`
-   `http.request_content_length`
-   `http.response_content_length`
-   `http.status_code`
-   `net.host.name`
-   `net.host.port`
-   `net.sock.peer.addr`
-   `net.sock.peer.port`

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

`$otel_trace_id`

the identifier of the trace the current span belongs to, for example, `56552bc4daa3bf39c08362527e1dd6c4`

當前跨距所屬軌跡的標識符，例如`56552bc4daa3bf39c08362527e1dd6c4`

`$otel_span_id`

the identifier of the current span, for example, `4c0b8531ec38ca59`

當前跨度的標識符，例如`4c0b8531ec38ca59`

`$otel_parent_id`

the identifier of the parent span, for example, `dc94d281b0f884ea`

父級 span 的標識符，例如`dc94d281b0f884ea`

`$otel_parent_sampled`

the “`sampled`” flag of the parent span, can be “`1`” or “`0`”

父級 span 的「 `sampled` 」標誌可以是「 `1` 」或「 `0` 」。

<a id="c-7"></a>

#### njs｜紐澤西州

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-129"></a>

##### Changes｜變化

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/changes.html>

###### Changes｜變化

**Changes with njs 1.0.1｜與 njs 的變更1.0.1**

Release Date: 2 September 2026

發售日期：2026年9月2日

nginx modules:

nginx 模組：

-   Security: fixed an access control bypass in [js\_access](#p-073) when an asynchronous request body continuation threw an exception or produced an unhandled rejection ([CVE-2026-18329](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-18329)). Previously, nginx could continue processing the request as though the js\_access check had succeeded. The issue was introduced in [0.9.9](#p-129). Thanks to Ta Duc Thien.  
    安全性：修正了 [js\_access](#p-073)中的存取控制繞過問題。當非同步請求體延續拋出異常或產生未處理的拒絕時（[CVE -2026-18329](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-18329) ），nginx 可以繼續處理請求，就好像 js\_access 檢查已成功一樣。此問題最初由 [0.9.9](#p-129)引入。感謝 Ta Duc Thien 的貢獻。
    
-   Security: fixed a worker process crash when reading [Response.statusText](#p-137) after an upstream server returned a status line with an empty reason phrase ([CVE-2026-78222](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-78222)). The issue was introduced in [73c75e41](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/73c75e41) ([0.5.1](#p-129)).  
    安全性：修正了上游伺服器回傳空原因短語的狀態行後，讀取 [Response.statusText](#p-137)時工作進程崩潰的問題（[CVE -2026-78222](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-78222) ）。此問題在 [73c75e41](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/73c75e41) ([0.5.1](#p-129) ) 中引入。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed unhandled promise rejection tracking in reused [QuickJS](#p-132) contexts.  
    Bugfix：修正了重複使用 [QuickJS](#p-132)上下文中未處理的 promise 拒絕追蹤。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed [SharedDict.pop()](#p-137) returning `undefined` for unexpired entries in [shared dictionaries](#p-073) with a timeout.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [SharedDict.pop()](#p-137)在 [shared dictionaries](#p-073)中未過期條目超時時返回`undefined`的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed validation and replacement of [Fetch Headers](#p-137) values. This also fixed dangling header names in the QuickJS engine.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [Fetch Headers](#p-137)值的驗證和替換問題。這也修復了 QuickJS 引擎中懸空的標頭名稱。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed missing validation of [r.headersOut](#p-137) names and values, and of redirect targets passed to [r.return()](#p-137).  
    Bugfix：修正了 [r.headersOut](#p-137)名稱和值以及傳遞給 [r.return()](#p-137)的重定向目標的缺失驗證。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed use-after-free, worker aborts, and leaks caused by cyclic references involving [Fetch](#p-137), HTTP request, and Stream session objects in the QuickJS engine.  
    Bugfix：修正了 QuickJS 引擎中涉及 [Fetch](#p-137), HTTP請求和 Stream 會話物件的循環引用導致的釋放後使用、工作進程中止和洩漏問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed QuickJS context reuse after [internal redirects](#p-137) and when pending jobs remained after request teardown.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [內部重定向](#p-137)之後以及請求清理後仍有待處理作業時 QuickJS 上下文重用的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed cleanup of partially initialized JavaScript contexts when request setup failed.  
    Bugfix：修正了請求設定失敗時部分初始化的 JavaScript 上下文的清理問題。
    

Core:

核：

-   Security: fixed a heap buffer overflow while parsing namespace prefix lists passed to [xml.exclusiveC14n()](#p-137) ([CVE-2026-78689](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-78689)). The issue was introduced in [9161a840](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/9161a840) ([0.7.10](#p-129)). Thanks to Vladimir Vulnerability Research Tech Lead @ Cyera, evilgensec.  
    安全性：修正了解析傳遞給 [xml.exclusiveC14n()] 的命名空間前綴列表時發生的堆緩衝區溢位漏洞(https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/reference.html#xml_exclusivec14n) ([CVE -2026-78689](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-78689) )。此問題最初由 [9161a840](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/9161a840) ([0.7.10](#p-129) ) 所引入。感謝 Cyera 和 evilgensec 的漏洞研究技術主管 Vladimir。
    
-   Feature: added [btoa()](#p-137) and [atob()](#p-137) global functions to the QuickJS engine and aligned their behavior between both engines.  
    功能：為 QuickJS 引擎添加了 [btoa()](#p-137)和 [atob()](#p-137)全局函數，並使兩個引擎的行為保持一致。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed a stack buffer overflow when exporting RSA keys larger than 4096 bits to JWK in [crypto.subtle.exportKey()](#p-137). Thanks to Vaibhav Rajput.  
    Bugfix：修正了在 [ RSA ()] 中將大於 4096 位元的金鑰JWK到 [ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/reference.html#crypto_subtle_export_key) ()] 時發生的堆疊緩衝區溢位問題。感謝 Vaibhav Rajput。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed RSA-OAEP [encryption](#p-137) and [decryption](#p-137) with SHA-256 and SHA-384 digests in WebCrypto.  
    Bugfix：修正了 WebCrypto 中RSA-OAEP [加密](#p-137)和 [解密](#p-137)與SHA -256 和SHA -384 摘要的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed compatibility with quickjs-ng 0.16.0 and later.  
    Bugfix：修復了與 quickjs-ng 0.16.0及更高版本的兼容性。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed empty stack traces for QuickJS errors created by host callbacks.  
    Bugfix：修正了主機回呼導致的 QuickJS 錯誤堆疊追蹤為空的問題。
    

**Changes with njs 1.0.0｜與 njs 的變更1.0.0**

Release Date: 23 June 2026

發售日期：2026年6月23日

nginx modules:

nginx 模組：

-   Improvement: aligned HTTP, Stream, and [Fetch](#p-137) exception classes between the njs and QuickJS engines. API misuse is now reported as `TypeError` and status bounds violations as `RangeError`.  
    改進：在 njs 和 QuickJS 引擎之間對齊 HTTP、Stream 和 [Fetch](#p-137) 異常類別。 API 濫用現在報告為 `TypeError`，狀態邊界違規報告為 `RangeError`。
    
-   Improvement: rejected unsafe request targets, methods, and header values in [ngx.fetch()](#p-137) before request serialization.  
    改進：在請求序列化之前，拒絕 [ngx.fetch()](#p-137)中的不安全請求目標、方法和標頭值。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed a heap use-after-free in [r.subrequest()](#p-137) when the client closed the connection before the background subrequest completed. The issue was introduced in [75d6b61](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/75d6b61) ([0.9.5](#p-129)).  
    Bugfix：修正了 [r.subrequest()](#p-137)中當客戶端在後台子請求完成之前關閉連接時出現的堆釋放後使用問題。此問題是在 [75d6b61](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/75d6b61) ([0.9.5](#p-129) ) 中引入的。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed a worker segfault while reading a request header that nginx registers without a dedicated slot, such as `Proxy-Connection`, via [r.headersIn](#p-137).  
    Bugfix：修正了讀取 nginx 註冊的沒有專用槽的請求頭（例如`Proxy-Connection`時工作進程段錯誤的問題，透過 [r.headersIn](#p-137) 。
    
-   Bugfix: excluded unverified-TLS and dynamic-proxy connections from the [ngx.fetch()](#p-137) [keepalive](#p-073) cache and validated cached connections before reuse.  
    Bugfix：從 [ngx.fetch()](#p-137) [keepalive](#p-073)快取中排除未驗證的TLS和動態代理連接，並在重複使用之前驗證快取的連接。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed Content-Length truncation for very large request bodies and a missing CONNECT terminator for proxies configured without credentials in [ngx.fetch()](#p-137).  
    Bugfix：修正了請求體非常大時 Content-Length 截斷的問題，以及 [ngx.fetch()] 中未配置憑證的代理缺少CONNECT (https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/reference.html#ngx_fetch)符的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed leaks of promises, events, and init property values on [ngx.fetch()](#p-137) failure paths in the QuickJS engine.  
    Bugfix：修正了 QuickJS 引擎中 [ngx.fetch()](#p-137)失敗路徑上的 promises、事件和 init 屬性值的洩漏。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed missing fetch event cleanup when the resolver failed to start.  
    Bugfix：修正了解析器啟動失敗時缺少 fetch 事件清理的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed an out-of-bounds read of a short fetch proxy URL.  
    Bugfix：修正了對短獲取代理的越界讀取問題URL 。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed request body truncation in [r.readRequestJSON()](#p-137) for bodies containing invalid UTF-8 in the QuickJS engine.  
    Bugfix：修正了 QuickJS 引擎中 [r.readRequestJSON()](#p-137)包含無效UTF -8 的請求體截斷問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed an out-of-bounds read while loading a shared dictionary state file.  
    Bugfix：修正了載入共享字典狀態檔案時發生的越界讀取問題。
    
-   Bugfix: set a pending exception when `sendHeader()`, `send()`, and `finish()` fail in the njs HTTP handlers.  
    Bugfix：當 njs HTTP處理程序中的`sendHeader()`, `send()`和`finish()`失敗時，設定一個待處理的異常。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed the variable value state after a stream variable storage allocation failure.  
    錯誤修復：修復了流變數儲存分配失敗後變數值的狀態。
    

Core:

核：

-   Improvement: bounded string-producing chained-buffer growth, so that exceeding the maximum string length raises a catchable `RangeError("invalid string length")` instead of exhausting worker memory.  
    改進：限製字串產生鍊式緩衝區的成長，使得超過最大字串長度時會引發可捕獲的`RangeError("invalid string length")`異常，而不是耗盡工作記憶體。
    
-   Improvement: aligned built-in exception classes (XML, console, TextEncoder, TextDecoder, Buffer, fs.Stats) between the njs and QuickJS engines.  
    改進：統一了 njs 和 QuickJS 引擎之間的內建異常類別（ XML 、console、TextEncoder、TextDecoder、Buffer、fs.Stats）。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed an infinite loop while inflating a zlib stream that requires a dictionary in the QuickJS engine.  
    Bugfix：修正了在 QuickJS 引擎中載入需要字典的 zlib 流時出現的無限迴圈問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed an infinite loop in `Buffer.prototype.fill()` with a zero-length typed array source.  
    Bugfix：修正了`Buffer.prototype.fill()`中長度為零的類型化陣列來源的無限循環。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed a use-after-free in `Array.prototype.sort()` when a getter invoked for a hole grows the array.  
    Bugfix：修正了`Array.prototype.sort()`中當呼叫 getter 處理空洞時數組增大導致的 use-after-free 問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed type confusion in `Buffer.concat()` when a list element getter returns a typed array during validation but not during the copy.  
    Bugfix：修正了`Buffer.concat()`中的類型混淆問題，即當列表元素 getter 在驗證期間傳回類型化數組，但在複製期間不傳回類型化數組時。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed an out-of-bounds access in the variable-length Buffer `readInt`/`writeInt` methods with a zero byteLength.  
    Bugfix：修正了可變長度 Buffer `readInt`/`writeInt`方法中位元組長度為零時發生的越界存取問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed an out-of-bounds read in `Buffer.prototype.toString()` when start was greater than end.  
    Bugfix：修正了當起始值大於結束值時`Buffer.prototype.toString()`中的越界讀取問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed `Array.prototype.slice()` of large arrays returning wrong results in the non-fast keys path.  
    Bugfix：修正了`Array.prototype.slice()`在非快速鍵路徑中大數組傳回錯誤結果的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed the typed array constructor, `slice()`, `toReversed()`, and `toSorted()` ignoring the source view byte offset in the same-type fast path.  
    Bugfix：修正了類型化陣列建構子`slice()`, `toReversed()`和`toSorted()`忽略同類型快速路徑中的來源視圖位元組偏移的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed Buffer allocation length checks for lengths greater than or equal to 2^32 on 32-bit platforms.  
    Bugfix：修正了 32 位元平台上長度大於或等於 2^32 的緩衝區分配長度檢查。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed the `Buffer.from()` typed-array source offset for multi-byte element types in the QuickJS engine.  
    Bugfix：修正了 QuickJS 引擎中多位元組元素類型的`Buffer.from()` typed-array 來源偏移量。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed Buffer float access alignment.  
    Bugfix：修正了緩衝區浮點存取對齊問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed an out-of-bounds read in a parser string escape lookahead.  
    Bugfix：修正了解析器字串轉義預讀中的越界讀取問題。
    

**Changes with njs 0.9.9｜與 njs 的變更0.9.9**

Release Date: 19 May 2026

發售日期：2026年5月19日

nginx modules:

nginx 模組：

-   Security: a heap buffer overflow might occur in a worker process when the [js\_fetch\_proxy](#p-073) directive value contains nginx variables derived from the client request ( [`$http_*`](#p-056), [`$arg_*`](#p-056), [`$cookie_*`](#p-056), etc.) and the location's JS handler invokes [ngx.fetch()](#p-137) ([CVE-2026-8711](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-8711)). The issue was introduced in [dea83189](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/dea83189) ([0.9.4](#p-129)).  
    安全性：當 [js\_fetch\_proxy] 在工作進程中執行時，可能會發生堆疊緩衝區溢位。(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_js_module.html#js_fetch_proxy) 指令值包含從客戶端請求派生的 nginx 變數（[`$http_*`](#p-056), [`$arg_*`](#p-056), [`$cookie_*`](#p-056)等等）以及位置的 JS 處理程序呼叫 [ngx.fetch()](#p-137) ([CVE-2026-8711](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-8711)）該問題在[dea83189]中提出。(https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/dea83189) ([0.9.4](#p-129)).
    
-   Feature: added [js\_access](#p-073) directive.  
    功能：新增了 [js\_access](#p-073)指令。
    
-   Feature: added [r.readRequestText()](#p-137), [r.readRequestArrayBuffer()](#p-137), and [r.readRequestJSON()](#p-137) async methods that read the request body, available in [js\_access](#p-073) and [js\_content](#p-073) directives.  
    功能：新增了 [r.readRequestText( (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_js_module.html#js_access)](#p-137) 、 [r.readRequestArrayBuffer()](#p-137)和 [r.readRequestJSON()](#p-137)異步方法，用於請求體，可在 [jsn_access](#p-073)指令中使用。
    
-   Feature: added [r.readRequestForm()](#p-137) async method that parses the request body submitted from an HTML form (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded` and `multipart/form-data`) and returns a structured accessor object. The method is available in [js\_access](#p-073) and [js\_content](#p-073) directives.  
    新增功能：新增了 [r.readRequestForm()](#p-137)非同步方法，用於解析從HTML表單（ `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`和`multipart/form-data` ）提交的請求體，並傳回一個結構化的存取器物件。此方法可在 [js\_access](#p-073)和 [js\_content](#p-073)指令中使用。
    
-   Feature: added [jsVarNames()](#p-137) method. The method returns the names of variables declared with [js\_var](#p-073).  
    功能：新增了 [jsVarNames()](#p-137)方法。此方法傳回使用 [js\_var](#p-073)宣告的變數的名稱。
    

Core:

核：

-   Bugfix: fixed evaluation order of call arguments with side effects. Previously, an earlier argument could observe a later argument's mutation, e.g. `f(a, a = 2)` passed `2` as both arguments. The issue was introduced in [fd5e523f](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/fd5e523f) ([0.9.7](#p-129)).  
    Bugfix：修正了具有副作用的呼叫參數的求值順序。先前，較早的參數可能會觀察到較晚參數的變化，例如， `f(a, a = 2)`會將`2`同時作為兩個參數傳遞。此問題在 [fd5e523f](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/fd5e523f) ([0.9.7](#p-129) ) 中引入。

**Changes with njs 0.9.7｜與 njs 的變更0.9.7**

Release Date: 21 April 2026

發售日期：2026年4月21日

nginx modules:

nginx 模組：

**Changes with njs 0.9.6｜與 njs 的變更0.9.6**

Release Date: 3 March 2026

發售日期：2026年3月3日

nginx modules:

nginx 模組：

-   Bugfix: fixed expire field truncation in [shared dict](#p-073) state files. Millisecond timestamps were silently truncated to 10 digits, making restored entries appear expired on restart.  
    錯誤修復：修正了 [共享字典](#p-073)狀態檔案中過期字段截斷的問題。毫秒時間戳會被靜默截斷為 10 位數字，導致恢復的條目在重新啟動後顯​​示為過期。
    
-   Bugfix: suppressed slab log\_nomem for evict [shared dict](#p-073) zones. When evict is enabled, memory allocation failures are expected and handled by evicting old entries.  
    錯誤修復：抑制了 evict [共享字典](#p-073)區域的 slab log\_nomem 日誌。啟用 evict 後，預期會出現記憶體分配失敗，並透過驅逐舊條目來處理這些失敗。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed stack trace for [ngx.fetch()](#p-137) exceptions for [qjs](#p-132) engine.  
    Bugfix：修復了 [ngx.fetch()](#p-137)引擎異常(https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/engine.html#quickjs_engine)堆疊追蹤。
    

Core:

核：

-   Feature: added optional chaining support.  
    新增功能：增加了可選的鍊式呼叫支援。
    
-   Feature: added nullish coalescing assignment operator (`??=`).  
    特性：新增了空合併賦值運算子（ `??=` ）。
    
-   Feature: added logical assignment operators (`||=` and `&&=`).  
    功能：新增了邏輯賦值運算子（ `||=`和`&&=` ）。
    
-   Improvement: aligned `SyntaxError` reporting with other JS engines. Previously, file name was a part of the error message. Now it is reported as "stack" property.  
    改進：使`SyntaxError`報告與其他JS引擎保持一致。之前，檔案名稱是錯誤訊息的一部分。現在，它作為“堆疊”屬性進行報告。
    
-   Improvement: improved `Error.stack` traces. Stack traces are now attached in error constructors. Performance of `Error.stack` is improved by ~100 times.  
    改進：改進了`Error.stack`痕跡。堆疊追蹤現在附加在錯誤構造函數中。 `Error.stack`的性能提高了約100倍。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed string offset map corruption in scope values hash. The issue caused SEGV/SIGBUS crashes for multi-byte UTF-8 string constants with more than 32 characters when accessing a character at index >= 32 (e.g. via `.replace()` or bracket notation). The issue was introduced in [e7caa46d](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/e7caa46d) ([0.9.5](#p-129)).  
    錯誤修復：修復了作​​用域值雜湊中的字串偏移映射損壞問題。此問題導致當存取索引 >= 32 的字元時（例如透過`.replace()`或方括號表示法），對於長度超過 32 個字元的多位元組SEGV/SIGBUS -8 字串常數UTF程式崩潰。此問題最初在 [e7caa46d](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/e7caa46d) ([0.9.5](#p-129) ) 中引入。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed heap-buffer-overflow in atom hash caused by `Symbol()`.  
    Bugfix：修正了由`Symbol()`引起的原子哈希中的堆緩衝區溢位問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed WebCrypto [importKey()](#p-137) crash with mismatched JWK key type.  
    Bugfix：修正了 WebCrypto [importKey()](#p-137)因JWK類型不符而導致的崩潰問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed interactive mode detection for piped stdin.  
    Bugfix：修復了管道輸入 stdin 的交互模式檢測。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed build on MacOS.  
    Bugfix：修復了MacOS上的建置問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed PTR macro compatibility with newer BFD library.  
    Bugfix：修正了PTR宏與較新的BFD庫的兼容性問題。
    
-   Bugfix: auto/cc: use portable `command -v` instead of `which`. Thanks to Zurab Kvachadze.  
    錯誤修復：auto/cc：使用隨身版`command -v`代替`which` 。感謝Zurab Kvachadze。

nginx modules:

nginx 模組：

-   Feature: added native module support for [qjs](#p-132) engine for [http](#p-073) and [stream](#p-145).  
    功能：為 [http](#p-073)和 [stream](#p-145)引擎添加了 [qjs](#p-132)的原生模組支援。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed [js\_body\_filter](#p-073) with multiple chunks for [qjs](#p-132) engine.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [js\_body\ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/engine.html#quickjs_engine) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_js_module.html#js_body_filter)的多個程式碼區塊問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed `buffer_type` inheritance in if blocks for [js\_body\_filter](#p-073). Previously, when `js_body_filter` was used inside an if block, the data parameter received `Buffer` type instead of the expected `String` type.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [js\_body\_filter](#p-073)中 if 程式碼區塊的`buffer_type`繼承問題。先前，當在 if 程式碼區塊中使用`js_body_filter`時，資料參數接收到的是`Buffer`類型，而不是預期的`String`類型。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed [js\_body\_filter](#p-073) when data is not in memory. Previously, when upstream data was delivered from nginx cache, `js_body_filter` was not able to process it correctly.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [js\_body\_filter](#p-073)當資料不在記憶體中時出現的問題。此前，當上游資料從 nginx 快取提供時， `js_body_filter`無法正確處理。
    
-   Bugfix: improved [r.subrequest()](#p-137) error handling. Fixed a problem of a lost write event when the njs handler making `r.subrequest()` is called from a lua handler as a subrequest.  
    Bugfix：改進了 [r.subrequest()](#p-137)錯誤處理。修正了當 njs 處理程序發出`r.subrequest()`時，由於 lua 處理程序作為子請求呼叫而導致的寫入事件遺失的問題。

核：

-   Bugfix: fixed `XMLAttr` object. Pointer to `xmlAttr` could become invalid when the parent `XMLNode` was modified.  
    錯誤修復：修復了`XMLAttr`物件。當父物件`XMLNode`被修改時，指向`xmlAttr`的指標可能會失效。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed `XMLNode` update.  
    錯誤修復：修復了`XMLNode`更新。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed `ArrayBuffer` with detached buffers.  
    Bugfix：修正了`ArrayBuffer`分離緩衝區的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: added missing detached array checks.  
    Bugfix：新增了缺失的分離數組檢查。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed [fs.mkdir()](#p-137) and friends.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [fs.mkdir()](#p-137)及其他問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed path restoration in [fs.mkdir()](#p-137) and friends on error.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [fs.mkdir()](#p-137)及其相關程式出錯時的路徑恢復問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed missed allocation check in promise code.  
    錯誤修復：修復了 Promise 程式碼中遺漏的記憶體分配檢查。

nginx modules:

nginx 模組：

nginx modules:

    Bugfix：修正了處理`If-Match`和`If-Unmodified-Since`標頭時NULL指標解引用的問題。
    

Core:

核：

-   Feature: added ECDH support for [WebCrypto](#p-137).  
    功能：新增了對 [WebCrypto](#p-137)的ECDH支援。
    
-   Improvement: reduced memory consumption by the object hash. The new hash uses 42% less memory per element.  
    改進：降低了物件哈希的記憶體消耗。新的哈希演算法每個元素的記憶體使用量減少了 42%。
    
-   Improvement: reduced memory consumption for concatenation of numbers and strings.  
    改進：降低了數字和字串連接時的記憶體消耗。
    
-   Improvement: reduced memory consumption of `String.prototype.concat()` with scalar values.  
    改進：降低了`String.prototype.concat()`的標量值記憶體消耗。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed segfault in `njs_property_query()`. The issue was introduced in [b28e50b1](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/b28e50b1) (0.9.0).  
    Bugfix：修正了`njs_property_query()`中的段錯誤。此問題是在 [b28e50b1](https://github.com/nginx/njs/commit/b28e50b1) ( 0.9.0 ) 中引入的。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed Function constructor template injection.  
    錯誤修復：修復了函數構造函數模板注入問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed GCC compilation with O3 optimization level.  
    Bugfix：修正了GCC使用 O3 最佳化等級編譯的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed `constant is too large` for 'long' warning on MIPS `-mabi=n32`.  
    Bugfix: 修正了`constant is too large`中關於MIPS `-mabi=n32`的「長」警告。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed compilation with GCC 4.1.  
    Bugfix：修正了使用GCC 4.1進行編譯的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed `%TypedArray%.from()` with the buffer is detached by the mapper.  
    Bugfix：修正了`%TypedArray%.from()`緩衝區被映射器分離的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed `%TypedArray%.prototype.slice()` with overlapping buffers.  
    Bugfix：修正了`%TypedArray%.prototype.slice()`緩衝區重疊的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed handling of detached buffers for typed arrays.  
    Bugfix：修正了類型化陣列的分離緩衝區處理問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed frame saving for async functions with closures.  
    Bugfix：修正了帶有閉包的非同步函數的幀保存問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed RegExp compilation of patterns with escaped '\[' characters.  
    Bugfix：修正了轉義字元「\[」的模式的正規表示式編譯問題。

**Changes with njs 0.8.10｜與 njs 的變更0.8.10**

Release Date: 08 April 2025

發售日期：2025年4月8日

nginx modules:

nginx 模組：

-   Feature: reading [`r.requestText`](#p-137) or [`r.requestBuffer`](#p-137) from a temporary file. Previously, an exception was thrown when accessing [`r.requestText`](#p-137) or [`r.requestBuffer`](#p-137) if the size of the client request body exceeded [`client_body_buffer_size`](#p-056).  
    功能：從暫存檔案讀取 [`r.requestText`](#p-137)或 [`r.requestBuffer`](#p-137) 。先前，如果客戶端請求體的大小超過 [`client_body_buffer_size`](#p-056) ，則訪問 [`r.requestText`](#p-137)或 [`r.requestBuffer`](#p-137)時會拋出異常。
    
-   Improvement: improved reporting of unhandled promise rejections.  
    改進：改進了對未處理的承諾拒絕的報告。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed name corruption in variables and headers processing.  
    Bugfix：修正了變數和標頭處理中的名稱損壞問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed [`incr()`](#p-137) method of a shared dictionary with an empty init argument for the [QuickJS](#p-132) engine.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [`incr()`](#p-137)共享字典的 init 參數為空的問題，該問題與 [QuickJS](#p-132)引擎有關。
    
-   Bugfix: accepting response headers with underscore characters in [Fetch API](#p-137).  
    Bugfix：接受帶有下劃線字元的回應標頭 [Fetch API](#p-137) 。
    

Core:

核：

-   Change: fixed [`serializeToString()`](#p-137). Previously, [`serializeToString()`](#p-137) was [`exclusiveC14n()`](#p-137) which returned a string instead of Buffer. According to the published documentation, it should be [`c14n()`](#p-137).  
    更改：已修復 [`serializeToString()`](#p-137) 。之前，[`serializeToString()`](#p-137)為 [`exclusiveC14n()`](#p-137) ，回傳的是字串而非 Buffer。根據已發布的文檔，它應該是 [`c14n()`](#p-137) 。
    
-   Feature: added [`WebCrypto`](#p-137) API for the [QuickJS](#p-132) engine.  
    功能：為 [QuickJS](#p-132)引擎添加了 [ `WebCrypto` ](#p-137) API 。
    
-   Feature: added [`TextEncoder`](#p-137) and [`TextDecoder`](#p-137) for the [QuickJS](#p-132) engine.  
    功能：為 [QuickJS](#p-132)引擎添加了 [`TextEncoder`](#p-137)和 [`TextDecoder`](#p-137) 。
    
-   Feature: added [`querystring`](#p-137) module for the [QuickJS](#p-132) engine.  
    功能：為 [QuickJS](#p-132)引擎添加了 [`querystring`](#p-137)模組。
    
-   Feature: added [`crypto`](#p-137) module for the [QuickJS](#p-132) engine.  
    功能：為 [QuickJS](#p-132)引擎添加了 [`crypto`](#p-137)模組。
    
-   Feature: added [`xml`](#p-137) module for the [QuickJS](#p-132) engine.  
    功能：為 [QuickJS](#p-132)引擎添加了 [`xml`](#p-137)模組。
    
-   Feature: added support for the `QuickJS-NG` library.  
    新增功能：增加了對`QuickJS-NG`庫的支援。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed [`Buffer.concat()`](#p-137) with a single argument in [QuickJS](#p-132).  
    Bugfix：修正了 [`Buffer.concat()`](#p-137)在 [QuickJS](#p-132)中只有一個參數的問題。
    
-   Bugfix: added missed syntax error for `await` in template literal.  
    Bugfix：新增了模板字面量中`await`的缺失語法錯誤。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed non-NULL terminated strings formatting in exceptions for the [QuickJS](#p-132) engine.  
    Bugfix：修正了 [QuickJS](#p-132)引擎異常中非NULL結尾字串的格式化問題。
    
-   Bugfix: fixed compatibility with recent change in [QuickJS](#p-132) and `QuickJS-NG`.  
    Bugfix：修復了與 [QuickJS](#p-132)和`QuickJS-NG`中最近的更改的兼容性。
    

**Changes with njs 0.8.9｜與 njs 的變更0.8.9**

Release Date: 14 January 2025

發售日期：2025年1月14日

nginx modules:

nginx 模組：

-   Bugfix: removed extra VM creation per server. Previously, when `js_import` was declared in [http](#p-073) or [stream](#p-145) blocks, an extra copy of the VM instance was created for each server block. This was not needed and consumed a lot of memory for configurations with many server blocks. This issue was introduced in [0.8.6](#p-129) and was partially fixed for location blocks only in [0.8.7](#p-129).  
    錯誤修復：移除了每個伺服器額外建立的VM 。先前，當在 [http](#p-073)或 [stream](#p-145)程式碼區塊中宣告`js_import`時，每個伺服器程式碼區塊都會建立一個額外的VM實例副本。這沒有必要，並且在伺服器程式碼區塊較多的配置中會消耗大量記憶體。此問題最初在 [0.8.6](#p-129)中引入，並在 [0.8.7](#p-129)中僅針對 location 程式碼區塊進行了部分修復。
    

Core:

核：

-   Feature: implemented [fs](#p-137) for the [QuickJS](#p-132) engine.  
    特性：為 [QuickJS](#p-132)引擎實現了 [fs](#p-137) 。
