<a id="p-142"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_core_module｜模組 ngx_stream_core_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_core_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_core\_module｜模組 ngx\_stream\_core\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-142)<br>[Directives](#p-142)<br>     [listen](#p-142)<br>     [preread\_buffer\_size](#p-142)<br>     [preread\_timeout](#p-142)<br>     [proxy\_protocol\_timeout](#p-142)<br>     [resolver](#p-142)<br>     [resolver\_timeout](#p-142)<br>     [server](#p-142)<br>     [server\_name](#p-142)<br>     [server\_names\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-142)<br>     [server\_names\_hash\_max\_size](#p-142)<br>     [stream](#p-142)<br>     [tcp\_nodelay](#p-142)<br>     [variables\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-142)<br>     [variables\_hash\_max\_size](#p-142)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-142)<br>[範例設定](#p-142)<br> [指令](#p-142)<br> [監聽](#p-142)<br> [預讀緩衝區大小](#p-142)<br> [預讀逾時](#p-142)<br> [ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_core_module.html#resolver)<br> (https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_core_module.html#preread_buffer_size)<br> [解析器逾時](#p-142)<br> [伺服器](#p-142)<br> [伺服器名稱](#p-142)<br> [伺服器名稱雜湊儲存桶大小](#p-142)<br> [ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_core_module.html#server_names_hash_bucket_size)<br>名稱雜湊最大大小](#p-142)<br> [流](#p-142)<br> [variables\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-142)<br> [variables\_hash\_max\_size](#p-142)<br> [Embedded Variables](#p-142) |

The `ngx_stream_core_module` module is available since version 1.9.0. This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-stream` configuration parameter.

自版本1.9.0起， `ngx_stream_core_module`模組可用。此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-stream`配置參數啟用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> worker_processes auto;
>
> worker_processes 自動；
> 
> error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log info;
>
> 錯誤日誌 /var/log/nginx/error.log 訊息;
> 
> events {
>
> 事件 {
>     worker_connections  1024;
>
>     工作連線數 1024；
> }
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     upstream backend {
>
>     上游後端 {
>         hash $remote_addr consistent;
>
>         哈希 $remote_addr 一致；
> 
>         server backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>
>         伺服器 backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>         server 127.0.0.1:12345            max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
>
>         伺服器127.0.0.1:12345 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
>         server unix:/tmp/backend3;
>
>         伺服器 unix:/tmp/backend3;
>     }
> 
>     upstream dns {
>
>     上游 DNS {
>        server 192.168.0.1:53535;
>
>        伺服器192.168.0.1:53535 ;
>        server dns.example.com:53;
>
>        伺服器 dns.example.com:53;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 12345;
>
>         聽 12345；
>         proxy_connect_timeout 1s;
>         proxy_timeout 3s;
>         proxy_pass backend;
>
>         proxy_pass 後端；
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 127.0.0.1:53 udp reuseport;
>
>         監聽127.0.0.1:53 udp 重複使用埠；
>         proxy_timeout 20s;
>         proxy_pass dns;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen [::1]:12345;
>
>         監聽 [::1]:12345;
>         proxy_pass unix:/tmp/stream.socket;
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**listen** `*address*`:`*port*` [`default_server`] [`ssl`] [`udp`] [`proxy_protocol`] [`setfib`=`*number*`] [`fastopen`=`*number*`] [`backlog`=`*number*`] [`rcvbuf`=`*size*`] [`sndbuf`=`*size*`] [`accept_filter`=`*filter*`] [`deferred`] [`bind`] [`ipv6only`=`on`\|`off`] [`reuseport`] [`multipath`] [`so_keepalive`=`on`\|`off`\|[`*keepidle*`]:[`*keepintvl*`]:[`*keepcnt*`]];``<br>``**listen** `*地址*`:`*港口*` [`預設伺服器`] [`SSL`] [`UDP`] [`代理協定`] [`塞特菲布`=`*數字*`] [`快速打開`=`*數字*`] [`積壓`=`*數字*`] [`rcvbuf`=`*尺寸*`] [`sndbuf`=`*尺寸*`] [`accept_filter`=`*篩選*`] [`延期`] [`綁定`] [`僅限IPv6`=`在`\|`離開`] [`重用港`] [`多路徑`] [`所以保持活著`=`在`\|`離開`\|[`*保持空閒*`]:[`*keepintvl*`]:[`*保持*`]];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Sets the `*address*` and `*port*` for the socket on which the server will accept connections. It is possible to specify just the port. The address can also be a hostname, for example:

設定伺服器接受連接的套接字的`*address*`和`*port*` 。也可以只指定連接埠。位址也可以是主機名，例如：

> ```
> listen 127.0.0.1:12345;
>
> 聽127.0.0.1:12345 ;
> listen *:12345;
>
> 監聽 *:12345;
> listen 12345;     # same as *:12345
>
> 監聽 12345；# 等同於 *:12345
> listen localhost:12345;
>
> 監聽 localhost:12345;
> ```

IPv6 addresses are specified in square brackets:

IPv6 位址用方括號括起來：

> ```
> listen [::1]:12345;
>
> 監聽 [::1]:12345;
> listen [::]:12345;
>
> 監聽 [::]:12345;
> ```

UNIX-domain sockets are specified with the “`unix:`” prefix:

UNIX域套接字以「 `unix:` 」前綴指定：

> ```
> listen unix:/var/run/nginx.sock;
>
> 監聽unix:/var/run/nginx.sock;
> ```

Port ranges (1.15.10) are specified with the first and last port separated by a hyphen:

連接埠範圍（ 1.15.10 ）的指定方式為：第一個連接埠和最後一個連接埠之間以連字號分隔。

> ```
> listen 127.0.0.1:12345-12399;
>
> 聽127.0.0.1:12345 -12399;
> listen 12345-12399;
>
> 收聽 12345-12399；
> ```

The `default_server` parameter, if present, will cause the server to become the default server for the specified `*address*`:`*port*` pair (1.25.5). If none of the directives have the `default_server` parameter then the first server with the `*address*`:`*port*` pair will be the default server for this pair.

如果存在`default_server`參數，則該伺服器將成為指定`*address*`:`*port*`對（ 1.25.5 ）的預設伺服器。如果所有指令均未包含`default_server`參數，則第一個包含`*address*`:`*port*`對的伺服器將成為該對的預設伺服器。

The `ssl` parameter allows specifying that all connections accepted on this port should work in SSL mode.

`ssl`參數允許指定在此連接埠上接受的所有連接都應以SSL模式工作。

The `udp` parameter configures a listening socket for working with datagrams (1.9.13). In order to handle packets from the same address and port in the same session, the [`reuseport`](#p-142) parameter should also be specified.

`udp`參數配置用於處理資料封包的監聽套接字 ( 1.9.13 )。為了在同一會話中處理來自相同位址和連接埠的封包，也應指定 [`reuseport`](#p-142)參數。

The `proxy_protocol` parameter (1.11.4) allows specifying that all connections accepted on this port should use the [PROXY protocol](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt).

`proxy_protocol`參數 ( 1.11.4 ) 允許指定在此連接埠上接受的所有連接都應使用 [PROXY協定](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) 。

> The PROXY protocol version 2 is supported since version 1.13.11.
>
> 自版本1.13.11起，支援PROXY協定版本 2。

The `listen` directive can have several additional parameters specific to socket-related system calls. These parameters can be specified in any `listen` directive, but only once for a given `*address*`:`*port*` pair.

`listen`指令可以包含幾個與套接字相關的系統呼叫特有的附加參數。這些參數可以在任何`listen`指令中指定，但對於給定的`*address*`:`*port*`對只能指定一次。

`setfib`\=`*number*`

this parameter (1.25.5) sets the associated routing table, FIB (the `SO_SETFIB` option) for the listening socket. This currently works only on FreeBSD.

此參數（ 1.25.5 ）設定監聽套接字的關聯路由表（ FIB ，即`SO_SETFIB`選項）。目前此功能僅適用於FreeBSD系統。

`fastopen`\=`*number*`

enables “[TCP Fast Open](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TCP_Fast_Open)” for the listening socket (1.21.0) and [limits](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7413#section-5.1) the maximum length for the queue of connections that have not yet completed the three-way handshake.

為監聽套接字啟用「[TCP快速開啟](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TCP_Fast_Open) 」 ( 1.21.0 )，並[限制](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7413#section-5.1)尚未完成三次握手的連接隊列的最大長度。

> Do not enable this feature unless the server can handle receiving the [same SYN packet with data](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7413#section-6.1) more than once.
>
> 除非伺服器能夠處理多次接收相同的 [帶有資料的SYN封包](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7413#section-6.1) ，否則請勿啟用此功能。

`backlog`\=`*number*`

sets the `backlog` parameter in the `listen()` call that limits the maximum length for the queue of pending connections (1.9.2). By default, `backlog` is set to -1 on FreeBSD, DragonFly BSD, and macOS, and to 511 on other platforms.

在限制1.9.2處理連線佇列最大長度的`listen()`呼叫中設定`backlog`參數。預設情況下，在 FreeBSD、DragonFly BSD和 macOS 上， `backlog`設定為 -1，在其他平台上設定為 511。

`rcvbuf`\=`*size*`

sets the receive buffer size (the `SO_RCVBUF` option) for the listening socket (1.11.13).

設定監聽套接字（ 1.11.13 ）的接收緩衝區大小（ `SO_RCVBUF`選項）。

`sndbuf`\=`*size*`

sets the send buffer size (the `SO_SNDBUF` option) for the listening socket (1.11.13).

設定監聽套接字（ 1.11.13 ）的傳送緩衝區大小（ `SO_SNDBUF`選項）。

`accept_filter`\=`*filter*`

sets the name of accept filter (the `SO_ACCEPTFILTER` option) for the listening socket that filters incoming connections before passing them to `accept()` (1.25.5). This works only on FreeBSD and NetBSD 5.0+. Possible values are [dataready](http://man.freebsd.org/accf_data) and [httpready](http://man.freebsd.org/accf_http).

設定監聽套接字的接受過濾器（ `SO_ACCEPTFILTER`選項）的名稱，該過濾器會在將傳入連接傳遞給`accept()` ( 1.25.5 ) 之前對其進行過濾。此功能僅適用於 FreeBSD 和 NetBSD 5.0及更高版本。可選值為 [dataready](http://man.freebsd.org/accf_data)和 [httpready](http://man.freebsd.org/accf_http) 。

`deferred`

instructs to use a deferred `accept()` (the `TCP_DEFER_ACCEPT` socket option) on Linux (1.25.5).

指示在 Linux 上使用延遲的`accept()` （ `TCP_DEFER_ACCEPT`套接字選項）（ 1.25.5 ）。

`bind`

this parameter instructs to make a separate `bind()` call for a given address:port pair. The fact is that if there are several `listen` directives with the same port but different addresses, and one of the `listen` directives listens on all addresses for the given port (`*:``*port*`), nginx will `bind()` only to `*:``*port*`. It should be noted that the `getsockname()` system call will be made in this case to determine the address that accepted the connection. If the `setfib`, `fastopen`, `backlog`, `rcvbuf`, `sndbuf`, `accept_filter`, `deferred`, `ipv6only`, `reuseport`, `multipath`, or `so_keepalive` parameters are used then for a given `*address*`:`*port*` pair a separate `bind()` call will always be made.

此參數指示針對給定的位址:埠對分別發起一次`bind()`呼叫。事實上，如果存在多個`listen`指令使用相同的連接埠但不同的位址，並且其中一個`listen`指令監聽給定連接埠的所有位址（ `*:``*port*` ），則 nginx 將僅對`*:``*port*`發起`bind()` 。需要注意的是，在這種情況下，將發起`getsockname()`系統呼叫來確定接受連接的位址。如果使用`setfib`, `fastopen`, `backlog`, `rcvbuf`, `sndbuf`, `accept_filter`, `deferred`, `ipv6only`, `reuseport`, `multipath`或`so_keepalive`參數，則對於給定的`*address*`:`*port*`對，始終會發起一次單獨的`bind()`呼叫。

`ipv6only`\=`on`|`off`

this parameter determines (via the `IPV6_V6ONLY` socket option) whether an IPv6 socket listening on a wildcard address `[::]` will accept only IPv6 connections or both IPv6 and IPv4 connections. This parameter is turned on by default. It can only be set once on start.

此參數（透過套接字選項`IPV6_V6ONLY` ）決定監聽通配符位址`[::]`的 IPv6 套接字是否僅接受 IPv6 連接，還是同時接受 IPv6 和 IPv4 連接。此參數預設啟用，且只能在啟動時設定一次。

`reuseport`

this parameter (1.9.1) instructs to create an individual listening socket for each worker process (using the `SO_REUSEPORT` socket option on Linux 3.9+ and DragonFly BSD, or `SO_REUSEPORT_LB` on FreeBSD 12+), allowing a kernel to distribute incoming connections between worker processes. This currently works only on Linux 3.9+, DragonFly BSD, and FreeBSD 12+ (1.15.1).

此參數 (1.9.1) 指示為每個工作進程建立一個單獨的監聽套接字（在 Linux 3.9+ 和 DragonFly BSD 上使用`SO_REUSEPORT`套接字選項，或在 FreeBSD 12+ 上使用`SO_REUSEPORT_LB` ），從而允許在工作進程之間分配傳入核心連接。目前，此功能僅適用於 Linux 3.9+、DragonFly BSD 和 FreeBSD 12+ (1.15.1)。

> Inappropriate use of this option may have its security [implications](http://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/socket.7.html).
>
> 不當使用此選項可能會帶來安全隱患(http://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/socket.7.html) 。

`multipath`

this parameter (1.29.7) configures the [Multipath TCP](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8684) protocol (`IPPROTO_MPTCP`) for the listening socket. This currently works only on Linux 5.6+.

此參數（ 1.29.7 ）配置監聽套接字的[多路徑TCP](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8684)協定（ `IPPROTO_MPTCP` ）。目前僅適用於5.6 +。

> Adding or removing this parameter will also enable the `SO_REUSEPORT` socket option, which may have its security [implications](http://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/socket.7.html).
>
> 新增或刪除此參數還將啟用`SO_REUSEPORT`套接字選項，這可能會帶來安全方面的[影響](http://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/socket.7.html) 。

`so_keepalive`\=`on`|`off`|\[`*keepidle*`\]:\[`*keepintvl*`\]:\[`*keepcnt*`\]

this parameter configures the “TCP keepalive” behavior for the listening socket. If this parameter is omitted then the operating system’s settings will be in effect for the socket. If it is set to the value “`on`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` option is turned on for the socket. If it is set to the value “`off`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` option is turned off for the socket. Some operating systems support setting of TCP keepalive parameters on a per-socket basis using the `TCP_KEEPIDLE`, `TCP_KEEPINTVL`, and `TCP_KEEPCNT` socket options. On such systems (currently, Linux, NetBSD, Dragonfly, FreeBSD, and macOS), they can be configured using the `*keepidle*`, `*keepintvl*`, and `*keepcnt*` parameters. One or two parameters may be omitted, in which case the system default setting for the corresponding socket option will be in effect. For example,

此參數配置監聽套接字的「TCP keepalive」行為。如果省略此參數，則作業系統的設定將對套接字生效。如果設定為值“`on`”，則為套接字開啟`SO_KEEPALIVE`選項。如果設定為值“`off`”，則為套接字關閉`SO_KEEPALIVE`選項。某些作業系統支援使用 `TCP_KEEPIDLE`, `TCP_KEEPINTVL` 和 `TCP_KEEPCNT` 套接字選項以套接字設定 TCP keepalive 參數。在此類系統（目前為 Linux、NetBSD、Dragonfly、FreeBSD 和 macOS）上，可以使用 `*keepidle*`, `*keepintvl*` 和 `*keepcnt*` 參數進行設定。可以省略一兩個參數，在這種情況下，對應套接字選項的系統預設設定將生效。例如，

> ```
> so_keepalive=30m::10
>
> 所以保持存活=30分鐘::10
> ```

will set the idle timeout (`TCP_KEEPIDLE`) to 30 minutes, leave the probe interval (`TCP_KEEPINTVL`) at its system default, and set the probes count (`TCP_KEEPCNT`) to 10 probes.

將空閒逾時（ `TCP_KEEPIDLE` ）設定為 30 分鐘，將探測間隔（ `TCP_KEEPINTVL` ）保持為系統預設值，並將探測次數（ `TCP_KEEPCNT` ）設為 10 次探測。

> Before version 1.25.5, different servers must listen on different `*address*`:`*port*` pairs.
>
> 在版本1.25.5之前，不同的伺服器必須監聽不同的`*address*`:`*port*`對。

Specifies a `*timeout*` for reading the PROXY protocol header to complete. If no entire header is transmitted within this time, the connection is closed.

指定讀取協定頭PROXY以完成讀取的`*timeout*` 。如果在規定時間內未傳輸完整的協定頭，則連線關閉。

This directive appeared in version 1.11.3.

該指令出現在版本1.11.3 。

Configures name servers used to resolve names of upstream servers into addresses, for example:

配置用於將上游伺服器名稱解析為位址的名稱伺服器，例如：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
>
> 解析127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
> ```

The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, with an optional port. If port is not specified, the port 53 is used. Name servers are queried in a round-robin fashion.

位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，連接埠號碼為可選。如果未指定連接埠號，則使用連接埠53。名稱伺服器以輪詢方式進行查詢。

By default, nginx will look up both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses while resolving. If looking up of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses is not desired, the `ipv4=off` (1.23.1) or the `ipv6=off` parameter can be specified.

預設情況下，nginx 在解析時會同時尋找 IPv4 和 IPv6 位址。如果不需要尋找 IPv4 或 IPv6 位址，可以指定`ipv4=off` ( 1.23.1 ) 或`ipv6=off`參數。

By default, nginx caches answers using the TTL value of a response. The optional `valid` parameter allows overriding it:

預設情況下，nginx 使用回應的TTL值快取答案。可選的`valid`參數允許覆蓋此設定：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 valid=30s;
>
> 解析器127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 有效=30秒;
> ```

> To prevent DNS spoofing, it is recommended configuring DNS servers in a properly secured trusted local network.
>
> 為防止DNS欺騙，建議在安全可靠的本地網路中設定DNS伺服器。

The optional `status_zone` parameter (1.17.1) enables [collection](#p-048) of DNS server statistics of requests and responses in the specified `*zone*`. The parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).

可選參數`status_zone` ( 1.17.1 ) 啟用 [收集](#p-048)指定`*zone*`中請求和回應的DNS伺服器統計資訊。此參數作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

> Before version 1.11.3, this directive was available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.11.3之前，此指令作為我們的 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Sets the configuration for a virtual server. There is no clear separation between IP-based (based on the IP address) and name-based (based on the [TLS Server Name Indication extension](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) (SNI, RFC 6066)) (1.25.5) virtual servers. Instead, the [listen](#p-142) directives describe all addresses and ports that should accept connections for the server, and the [server\_name](#p-142) directive lists all server names.

設定虛擬伺服器的配置。基於位址（ IP ）的IP伺服器和基於名稱（ TLS伺服器名稱指示擴充(http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) ( SNI, RFC 6066)）的虛擬伺服器之間沒有明確的區分。 [listen]1.25.5指令描述了所有應接受伺服器連接的位址和端口，而 [server\_name (https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_core_module.html#server_name) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_core_module.html#listen)列出了所有伺服器名稱。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>server_name<br>伺服器名稱</strong> <code><i>name<br>名稱</i></code> ...;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>server_name "";<br>伺服器名稱「」；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.25.5.

該指令出現在版本1.25.5 。

Sets names of a virtual server, for example:

設定虛擬伺服器的名稱，例如：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     server_name example.com www.example.com;
> }
> ```

The first name becomes the primary server name.

名字將成為主伺服器名稱。

Server names can include an asterisk (“`*`”) replacing the first or last part of a name:

伺服器名稱可以包含星號（“ `*` ”），用於替換名稱的第一部分或最後一部分：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     server_name example.com *.example.com www.example.*;
> }
> ```

Such names are called wildcard names.

這種名稱被稱為通配符名稱。

The first two of the names mentioned above can be combined in one:

上述名稱中的前兩個可以合併為一個：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     server_name .example.com;
>
>     server_name.example.com;
> }
> ```

It is also possible to use regular expressions in server names, preceding the name with a tilde (“`~`”):

伺服器名稱中也可以使用正規表示式，在名稱前面加上波浪號（“ `~` ”）：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     server_name www.example.com ~^www\d+\.example\.com$;
> }
> ```

Regular expressions can contain captures that can later be used in other directives (see [Regular expression captures](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html)):

正規表示式可以包含捕獲訊息，這些訊息稍後可以在其他指令中使用（參見[正規表示式捕獲](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html) ）：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     server_name ~^(www\.)?(.+)$;
> 
>     proxy_pass www.$2:12345;
> }
> ```

Named captures in regular expressions create variables that can later be used in other directives:

正規表示式中的命名捕獲會建立變量，這些變數隨後可以在其他指令中使用：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     server_name ~^(www\.)?(?<domain>.+)$;
>
>     server_name ~^(www\.)?(? <domain> .+)$;
> 
>     proxy_pass www.$domain:12345;
> }
> ```

If the directive’s parameter is set to “`$hostname`”, the machine’s hostname is inserted.

如果指令的參數設定為“ `$hostname` ”，則會插入機器的主機名稱。

The search is performed in the following order of priority and terminates on the first matching variant:

搜尋按以下優先順序執行，並在找到第一個符合項目時終止：

1.  the exact name  
    確切名稱
2.  the longest wildcard name starting with an asterisk, e.g. “`*.example.com`”  
    以星號開頭的最長通配符名稱，例如“ `*.example.com` ”
3.  the longest wildcard name ending with an asterisk, e.g. “`mail.*`”  
    最長的通配符名稱以星號結尾，例如“ `mail.*` ”
4.  the first matching regular expression (in order of appearance in the configuration file)  
    第一個符合的正規表示式（按在設定檔中出現的順序）

該指令出現在版本1.11.2 。

Sets the maximum `*size*` of the variables hash table. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定變數哈希表的最大值`*size*` 。設定哈希表的詳細資訊在單獨的[文件](#p-040)中提供。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_stream_core_module` module supports variables since 1.11.2.

`ngx_stream_core_module`模組自1.11.2起支持變數。

`$binary_remote_addr`

client address in a binary form, value’s length is always 4 bytes for IPv4 addresses or 16 bytes for IPv6 addresses

客戶端位址，以二進位形式表示，IPv4 位址的長度始終為 4 位元組，IPv6 位址的長度始終為 16 位元組。

`$bytes_received`

number of bytes received from a client (1.11.4)

從客戶端接收的位元組數（ 1.11.4 ）

`$bytes_sent`

number of bytes sent to a client

發送給客戶端的位元組數

`$connection`

connection serial number

連接序號

`$hostname`

host name

主機名稱

`$msec`

current time in seconds with the milliseconds resolution

當前時間（以秒為單位，精確到毫秒）

`$nginx_version`

nginx version

nginx 版本

`$pid`

PID of the worker process

PID工作進程

`$protocol`

protocol used to communicate with the client: `TCP` or `UDP` (1.11.4)

用於與客戶端通訊的協定： `TCP`或`UDP` ( 1.11.4 )

`$proxy_protocol_addr`

client address from the PROXY protocol header (1.11.4)

來自PROXY協定頭的客戶端位址 ( 1.11.4 )

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-142) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-142)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$proxy_protocol_port`

client port from the PROXY protocol header (1.11.4)

來自PROXY協定頭 ( 1.11.4 ) 的客戶端端口

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-142) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-142)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$proxy_protocol_server_addr`

server address from the PROXY protocol header (1.17.6)

來自PROXY協定頭（ 1.17.6 ）的伺服器位址

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-142) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-142)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$proxy_protocol_server_port`

server port from the PROXY protocol header (1.17.6)

來自PROXY協定頭 ( 1.17.6 ) 的伺服器端口

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-142) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-142)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$proxy_protocol_tlv_``*name*`

TLV from the PROXY Protocol header (1.23.2). The `name` can be a TLV type name or its numeric value. In the latter case, the value is hexadecimal and should be prefixed with `0x`:

TLV來自PROXY協議頭 ( 1.23.2 )。 `name`可以是TLV型別名稱或其數值。在後一種情況下，該值為十六進制，並且應以`0x`為前綴：

> ```
> $proxy_protocol_tlv_alpn
> $proxy_protocol_tlv_0x01
> ```

SSL TLVs can also be accessed by TLV type name or its numeric value, both prefixed by `ssl_`:

SSL TLV 也可以透過TLV類型名稱或其數值來訪問，兩者都以`ssl_`為前綴：

> ```
> $proxy_protocol_tlv_ssl_version
> $proxy_protocol_tlv_ssl_0x21
> ```

The following TLV type names are supported:

支援以下TLV類型名稱：

-   `alpn` (`0x01`) - upper layer protocol used over the connection  
    `alpn` ( `0x01` ) - 連接上使用的上層協議
-   `authority` (`0x02`) - host name value passed by the client  
    `authority` ( `0x02` ) - 用戶端傳遞的主機名稱值
-   `unique_id` (`0x05`) - unique connection id  
    `unique_id` ( `0x05` ) - 唯一連接 ID
-   `netns` (`0x30`) - name of the namespace  
    `netns` ( `0x30` ) - 命名空間名稱
-   `ssl` (`0x20`) - binary SSL TLV structure  
    `ssl` ( `0x20` ) - 二元SSL TLV結構

The following SSL TLV type names are supported:

支援以下SSL TLV類型名稱：

-   `ssl_version` (`0x21`) - SSL version used in client connection  
    `ssl_version` ( `0x21` ) - SSL版本用於客戶端連接
-   `ssl_cn` (`0x22`) - SSL certificate Common Name  
    `ssl_cn` ( `0x22` ) - SSL證書通用名稱
-   `ssl_cipher` (`0x23`) - name of the used cipher  
    `ssl_cipher` ( `0x23` ) - 所用密碼的名稱
-   `ssl_sig_alg` (`0x24`) - algorithm used to sign the certificate  
    `ssl_sig_alg` ( `0x24` ) - 用於簽署憑證的演算法
-   `ssl_key_alg` (`0x25`) - public-key algorithm  
    `ssl_key_alg` ( `0x25` ) - 公鑰演算法

Also, the following special SSL TLV type name is supported:

此外，也支援以下特殊型別名稱SSL TLV ：

-   `ssl_verify` - client SSL certificate verification result, zero if the client presented a certificate and it was successfully verified, and non-zero otherwise  
    `ssl_verify` - 用戶端SSL憑證驗證結果，如果用戶端提供了憑證且驗證成功，則為零；否則為非零值。

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-142) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-142)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

`$remote_addr`

client address

客戶地址

`$remote_port`

client port

客戶端連接埠

`$server_addr`

an address of the server which accepted a connection

接受連線的伺服器位址

Computing a value of this variable usually requires one system call. To avoid a system call, the [listen](#p-142) directives must specify addresses and use the `bind` parameter.

計算此變數的值通常需要一次系統呼叫。為了避免系統調用，[listen](#p-142)指令必須指定地址並使用`bind`參數。

`$server_port`

port of the server which accepted a connection

接受連接的伺服器端口

`$session_time`

session duration in seconds with a milliseconds resolution (1.11.4);

會話持續時間（以秒為單位，解析度為毫秒）（ 1.11.4 ）；

`$status`

session status (1.11.4), can be one of the following:

會話狀態（ 1.11.4 ）可以是以下幾種之一：

`200`

session completed successfully

會話已成功完成

`400`

client data could not be parsed, for example, the [PROXY protocol](#p-142) header

客戶端資料無法解析，例如 [PROXY協定](#p-142)標頭。

`403`

access forbidden, for example, when access is limited for [certain client addresses](#p-141)

例如，當[某些客戶端位址]的存取權限受到限制時，存取將被禁止(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_access_module.html)

`500`

internal server error

內部伺服器錯誤

`502`

bad gateway, for example, if an upstream server could not be selected or reached.

例如，如果無法選擇或連接到上游伺服器，則會出現網關錯誤。

`503`

service unavailable, for example, when access is limited by the [number of connections](#p-147)

服務不可用，例如，當存取受限於[連線數時](#p-147)

`$time_iso8601`

local time in the ISO 8601 standard format

ISO 8601 標準格式的本地時間

`$time_iso8601_ms`

local time in the ISO 8601 standard format with a millisecond resolution (1.29.8)

以毫秒解析度表示的ISO 8601標準格式的本地時間（ 1.29.8 ）

> This variable is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此變數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`$time_local`

local time in the Common Log Format

通用日誌格式中的本機時間

<a id="p-143"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_geo_module｜模組 ngx_stream_geo_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_geo_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_geo\_module｜模組 ngx\_stream\_geo\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-143)<br>[Directives](#p-143)<br>     [geo](#p-143)<br>[範例設定](#p-143)<br> [指令](#p-143)<br> [地理](#p-143) |

The `ngx_stream_geo_module` module (1.11.3) creates variables with values depending on the client IP address.

`ngx_stream_geo_module`模組 ( 1.11.3 ) 根據客戶端IP位址建立具有對應值的變數。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> geo $geo {
>
> 地理 $geo {
>     default        0;
>
>     預設值為 0；
> 
>     127.0.0.1      2;
>     192.168.1.0/24 1;
>     10.1.0.0/16    1;
> 
>     ::1            2;
>     2001:0db8::/32 1;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**geo** [`*$address*`] `*$variable*` { ... }``<br>` `**geo** [` *$address* `] ` *$variable* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Describes the dependency of values of the specified variable on the client IP address. By default, the address is taken from the `$remote_addr` variable, but it can also be taken from another variable, for example:

描述指定變數的值對客戶端IP位址的依賴關係。預設情況下，位址取自`$remote_addr`變量，但也可以從其他變數中獲取，例如：

> ```
> geo $arg_remote_addr $geo {
>     ...;
> }
> ```

> Since variables are evaluated only when used, the mere existence of even a large number of declared “`geo`” variables does not cause any extra costs for connection processing.
>
> 由於變數僅在使用時才進行評估，因此即使存在大量已聲明的「 `geo` 」變數也不會給連接處理帶來任何額外的成本。

If the value of a variable does not represent a valid IP address then the “`255.255.255.255`” address is used.

如果變數的值不代表有效的IP位址，則使用「 `255.255.255.255` 」位址。

Addresses are specified either as prefixes in CIDR notation (including individual addresses) or as ranges.

位址可以指定為CIDR表示法中的前綴（包括單一位址）或範圍。

The following special parameters are also supported:

此外，也支援以下特殊參數：

`delete`

deletes the specified network.

刪除指定的網路。

`default`

a value set to the variable if the client address does not match any of the specified addresses. When addresses are specified in CIDR notation, “`0.0.0.0/0`” and “`::/0`” can be used instead of `default`. When `default` is not specified, the default value will be an empty string.

如果用戶端位址與任何指定的位址都不匹配，則將一個值賦給該變數。當地址以CIDR表示法指定時，可以使用“ `0.0.0.0/0` ”和“ `::/0` ”代替`default` 。如果未指定`default` ，則預設值為空字串。

`include`

includes a file with addresses and values. There can be several inclusions.

包含一個帶有地址和值的檔案。可以包含多個文件。

`ranges`

indicates that addresses are specified as ranges. This parameter should be the first. To speed up loading of a geo base, addresses should be put in ascending order.

表示位址以範圍形式指定。此參數應放在首位。為加快地理資料庫載入速度，位址應依升序排列。

`volatile`

indicates that the variable is not cacheable (1.29.3).

表示該變數不可緩存（ 1.29.3 ）。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> geo $country {
>
> 地理 $country {
>     default        ZZ;
>
>     預設ZZ ;
>     include        conf/geo.conf;
>
>     包含 conf/geo.conf；
>     delete         127.0.0.0/16;
>
>     刪除127.0.0.0/16 ;
> 
>     127.0.0.0/24   US;
>     127.0.0.1/32   RU;
>     10.1.0.0/16    RU;
>     192.168.1.0/24 UK;
> }
> ```

The `conf/geo.conf` file could contain the following lines:

`conf/geo.conf`文件可能包含以下幾行：

> ```
> 10.2.0.0/16    RU;
> 192.168.2.0/24 RU;
> ```

A value of the most specific match is used. For example, for the 127.0.0.1 address the value “`RU`” will be chosen, not “`US`”.

使用最精確匹配的值。例如，對於位址127.0.0.1 ，將選擇值“ `RU` ”，而不是“ `US` ”。

Example with ranges:

使用範圍的範例：

> ```
> geo $country {
>
> 地理 $country {
>     ranges;
>
>     範圍；
>     default                   ZZ;
>
>     預設ZZ ;
>     127.0.0.0-127.0.0.0       US;
>     127.0.0.1-127.0.0.1       RU;
>     127.0.0.1-127.0.0.255     US;
>     10.1.0.0-10.1.255.255     RU;
>     192.168.1.0-192.168.1.255 UK;
> }
> ```

##### Module ngx_stream_geoip_module｜模組 ngx_stream_geoip_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_geoip_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_geoip\_module｜模組 ngx\_stream\_geoip\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-144)<br>[Directives](#p-144)<br>     [geoip\_country](#p-144)<br>     [geoip\_city](#p-144)<br>     [geoip\_org](#p-144)<br>[範例設定](#p-144)<br> [指令](#p-144)<br> [geoip_country](#p-144)<br> [geoip_city](#p-144)<br> [geoip_org](#p-144) |

The `ngx_stream_geoip_module` module (1.11.3) creates variables with values depending on the client IP address, using the precompiled [MaxMind](http://www.maxmind.com/) databases.

`ngx_stream_geoip_module`模組 ( 1.11.3 ) 使用預先編譯的 [MaxMind](http://www.maxmind.com/)資料庫，根據客戶端IP位址建立具有對應值的變數。

When using the databases with IPv6 support, IPv4 addresses are looked up as IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses.

使用支援 IPv6 的資料庫時，IPv4 位址會被尋找為 IPv4 所對應的 IPv6 位址。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-stream_geoip_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-stream_geoip_module`配置參數啟用。

> This module requires the [MaxMind GeoIP](http://www.maxmind.com/app/c) library.
>
> 本模組需要 [MaxMind GeoIP](http://www.maxmind.com/app/c)函式庫。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     geoip_country         GeoIP.dat;
>
>     geoip_country GeoIP.dat；
>     geoip_city            GeoLiteCity.dat;
>
>     geoip_city GeoLiteCity.dat;
> 
>     map $geoip_city_continent_code $nearest_server {
>
>     映射 $geoip_city_continent_code $nearest_server {
>         default        example.com;
>
>         預設範例.com；
>         EU          eu.example.com;
>         NA          na.example.com;
>         AS          as.example.com;
>     }
>    ...
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**geoip_country** `*file*`;``<br>` `**geoip_country** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Specifies a database used to determine the country depending on the client IP address. The following variables are available when using this database:

指定用於根據客戶端IP位址確定國家/地區的資料庫。使用此資料庫時，可以使用以下變數：

`$geoip_country_code`

two-letter country code, for example, “`RU`”, “`US`”.

兩位字母的國家代碼，例如「 `RU` 」、「 `US` 」。

`$geoip_country_code3`

three-letter country code, for example, “`RUS`”, “`USA`”.

三個字母的國家代碼，例如「 `RUS` 」、「 `USA` 」。

`$geoip_country_name`

country name, for example, “`Russian Federation`”, “`United States`”.

國家名稱，例如「 `Russian Federation` 」、「 `United States` 」。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**geoip_city** `*file*`;``<br>` `**geoip_city** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Specifies a database used to determine the country, region, and city depending on the client IP address. The following variables are available when using this database:

指定一個資料庫，用於根據客戶端IP地址確定國家/地區、區域和城市。使用此資料庫時，可以使用以下變數：

`$geoip_area_code`

telephone area code (US only).

電話區號（僅限US ）。

> This variable may contain outdated information since the corresponding database field is deprecated.
>
> 由於相應的資料庫欄位已棄用，因此該變數可能包含過時的資訊。

`$geoip_city_continent_code`

two-letter continent code, for example, “`EU`”, “`NA`”.

兩位字母的大洲代碼，例如“ `EU` ”、“ `NA` ”。

`$geoip_city_country_code`

two-letter country code, for example, “`RU`”, “`US`”.

兩位字母的國家代碼，例如“ `RU` ”、“ `US` ”。

`$geoip_city_country_code3`

three-letter country code, for example, “`RUS`”, “`USA`”.

三個字母的國家代碼，例如「 `RUS` 」、「 `USA` 」。

`$geoip_city_country_name`

country name, for example, “`Russian Federation`”, “`United States`”.

國家名稱，例如「 `Russian Federation` 」、「 `United States` 」。

`$geoip_dma_code`

DMA region code in US (also known as “metro code”), according to the [geotargeting](https://developers.google.com/adwords/api/docs/appendix/cities-DMAregions) in Google AdWords API.

根據 Google AdWords 中的 [地理定位](https://developers.google.com/adwords/api/docs/appendix/cities-DMAregions) ， DMA區域代碼位於US （也稱為「都會代碼」） API 。

`$geoip_latitude`

latitude.

緯度。

`$geoip_longitude`

longitude.

經度。

`$geoip_region`

two-symbol country region code (region, territory, state, province, federal land and the like), for example, “`48`”, “`DC`”.

雙符號國家區域代碼（地區、領土、州、省、聯邦領土等），例如「 `48` 」、「 `DC` 」。

`$geoip_region_name`

country region name (region, territory, state, province, federal land and the like), for example, “`Moscow City`”, “`District of Columbia`”.

國家名稱（地區、領土、州、省、聯邦土地等），例如「 `Moscow City` 」、「 `District of Columbia` 」。

`$geoip_city`

city name, for example, “`Moscow`”, “`Washington`”.

城市名稱，例如「 `Moscow` 」、「 `Washington` 」。

`$geoip_postal_code`

postal code.

郵遞區號.

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**geoip_org** `*file*`;``<br>` `**geoip_org** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Specifies a database used to determine the organization depending on the client IP address. The following variable is available when using this database:

指定用於根據客戶端IP位址確定組織的資料庫。使用此資料庫時，可以使用以下變數：

`$geoip_org`

organization name, for example, “The University of Melbourne”（墨爾本大學）.

組織名稱，例如“The University of Melbourne”（墨爾本大學） 。

|   |

| [Example Configuration](#p-145)<br>[Directives](#p-145)<br>     [js\_access](#p-145)<br>     [js\_context\_reuse](#p-145)<br>     [js\_engine](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_buffer\_size](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_ciphers](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_max\_response\_buffer\_size](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_protocols](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_timeout](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_trusted\_certificate](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_verify](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_verify\_depth](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_proxy](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_keepalive](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_keepalive\_requests](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_keepalive\_time](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_keepalive\_timeout](#p-145)<br>     [js\_filter](#p-145)<br>     [js\_import](#p-145)<br>     [js\_include](#p-145)<br>     [js\_load\_stream\_native\_module](#p-145)<br>     [js\_path](#p-145)<br>     [js\_periodic](#p-145)<br>     [js\_preload\_object](#p-145)<br>     [js\_preread](#p-145)<br>     [js\_set](#p-145)<br>     [js\_shared\_dict\_zone](#p-145)<br>     [js\_var](#p-145)<br>[Session Object Properties](#p-145)<br>[範例配置](#p-145)<br>[指示](#p-145)<br>     [js\_access](#p-145)<br>     [js_context_reuse](#p-145)<br>     [js_engine](#p-145)<br>     [js_fetch_buffer_size](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_ciphers](#p-145)<br>     [js_fetch_max_response_buffer_size](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_protocols](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_timeout](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_trusted\_certificate](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_verify](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_verify\_depth](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_proxy](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_keepalive](#p-145)<br>     [js_fetch_keepalive_requests](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_keepalive\_time](#p-145)<br>     [js\_fetch\_keepalive\_timeout](#p-145)<br>     [js_filter](#p-145)<br>     [js_import](#p-145)<br>     [js\_include](#p-145)<br>     [js_load_stream_native_module](#p-145)<br>     [js\_path](#p-145)<br>     [js\_periodic](#p-145)<br>     [js_preload_object](#p-145)<br>     [js\_preread](#p-145)<br>     [js\_set](#p-145)<br>     [js\_shared\_dict\_zone](#p-145)<br>     [js_var](#p-145)<br>[會話物件屬性](#p-145) |

The `ngx_stream_js_module` module is used to implement session and variable handlers in JavaScript with [njs](#p-133).

`ngx_stream_js_module`模組用於在 JavaScript 中實作會話和變數處理程序，[njs](#p-133) 。

Download and install instructions are available [here](#p-134).

下載和安裝說明可在此處取得(https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/install.html) 。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

The example works since [0.4.0](#p-129).

此範例有效，因為 [0.4.0](#p-129) 。

> ```
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     # since 0.9.1｜自0.9.1
>     js_engine qjs;
>
>     js_engine qjs；
> 
>     js_import stream.js;
> 
>     js_set $bar stream.bar;
>     js_set $req_line stream.req_line;
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 12345;
>
>         聽 12345；
> 
>         js_preread stream.preread;
>         return     $req_line;
>
>         返回 $req_line；
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 12346;
>
>         聽 12346；
> 
>         js_access  stream.access;
>
>         js_access stream.access;
>         proxy_pass 127.0.0.1:8000;
>
>         proxy_pass 127.0.0.1:8000 ;
>         js_filter  stream.header_inject;
>
>         js_filter stream.header_inject;
>     }
> }
> 
> http {
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 8000;
>
>         聽 8000；
>         location / {
>
>         地點 / {
>             return 200 $http_foo\n;
>
>             返回 200 $http_foo\n;
>         }
>     }
> }
> ```

The `stream.js` file:

`stream.js`文件：

> ```js
> var line = '';
> 
> function bar(s) {
>
> 函數 bar(s) {
>     var v = s.variables;
>     s.log("hello from bar() handler!");
>
>     s.log("來自 bar() 處理程序的問候！");
>     return "bar-var" + v.remote_port + "; pid=" + v.pid;
>
>     返回“bar-var” + v.remote_port + "; pid=" + v.pid;
> }
> 
> function preread(s) {
>
> 函數 preread(s) {
>     s.on('upload', function (data, flags) {
>         var n = data.indexOf('\n');
>         if (n != -1) {
>
>         如果 (n != -1) {
>             line = data.substr(0, n);
>             s.done();
>         }
>     });
> }
> 
> function req_line(s) {
>
> 函數 req_line(s) {
>     return line;
>
>     返回線；
> }
> 
> // Read HTTP request line.
>
> // 讀取HTTP請求行。
> // Collect bytes in 'req' until
>
> // 收集 'req' 中的位元組直到
> // request line is read.
>
> // 讀取請求行。
> // Injects HTTP header into a client's request
>
> // 將HTTP標頭注入到客戶端請求中
> 
> var my_header =  'Foo: foo';
>
> var my_header = 'Foo: foo';
> function header_inject(s) {
>
> 函數 header_inject(s) {
>     var req = '';
>     s.on('upload', function(data, flags) {
>         req += data;
>         var n = req.search('\n');
>         if (n != -1) {
>
>         如果 (n != -1) {
>             var rest = req.substr(n + 1);
>             req = req.substr(0, n + 1);
>             s.send(req + my_header + '\r\n' + rest, flags);
>             s.off('upload');
>
>             s.off('上傳');
>         }
>     });
> }
> 
> function access(s) {
>
> 函數訪問(s) {
>     if (s.remoteAddress.match('^192.*')) {
>
>     如果 (s.remoteAddress.match('^192.*')) {
>         s.deny();
>         return;
>
>         返回;
>     }
> 
>     s.allow();
> }
> 
> export default {bar, preread, req_line, header_inject, access};
> ```

Sets an njs function which will be called at the [access](#p-165) phase. Since [0.4.0](#p-129), a module function can be referenced.

設定一個 njs 函數，該函數將在 [access](#p-165)階段呼叫。自 [0.4.0](#p-129)起，可引用模組函數。

The function is called once at the moment when the stream session reaches the [access](#p-165) phase for the first time. The function is called with the following arguments:

此函數在串流會話首次到達 [access](#p-165)階段時呼叫一次。呼叫函數時會傳遞以下參數：

`s`

the [Stream Session](#p-137) object

[串流會話](#p-137)對象

At this phase, it is possible to perform initialization or register a callback with the [`s.on()`](#p-137) method for each incoming data chunk until one of the following methods are called: [`s.allow()`](#p-137), [`s.decline()`](#p-137), [`s.done()`](#p-137). As soon as one of these methods is called, the stream session processing switches to the [next phase](#p-165) and all current [`s.on()`](#p-137) callbacks are dropped.

在此階段，可以使用 [`s.on()`](#p-137)方法對每個傳入的資料塊執行初始化或註冊回調，直到呼叫以下方法之一：[`s.allow()`](#p-137) 、[`s.decline()`](#p-137) `s.done()` (https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/reference.html#s_done) 。一旦呼叫這些方法之一，流會話處理就會切換到 [下一階段](#p-165) ，並且所有當前的 [`s.on()`](#p-137)回調都將被丟棄。

This directive appeared in version 0.9.4.

該指令出現在版本0.9.4 。

Configures a forward proxy URL with [Fetch API](#p-137). The `*url*` supports the HTTP scheme only and can contain optional user credentials in the format `http://[user:password@]host:port` for Basic authentication. Supports both HTTP and HTTPS connections to destination servers. If the `*url*` is empty, proxy routing is disabled. The parameter value can contain variables.

設定一個轉送代理程式URL HTTP [Fetch API](#p-137)僅支援`*url*`協議，並且可以包含可選的用戶憑證，格式為`http://[user:password@]host:port`用於基本身份驗證。支援與目標伺服器的HTTP和HTTPS連接。如果`*url*`為空，則停用代理路由。參數值可以包含變數。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 12345;
>
>     聽 12345；
>     js_fetch_proxy http://user:pass@proxy.example.com:3128;
>     js_preread main.fetch_handler;
> }
> ```

This directive appeared in version 0.9.2.

該指令出現在版本0.9.2 。

Activates the cache for connections to destination servers. When the value is greater than `0`, enables keepalive connections for [Fetch API](#p-137).

啟動與目標伺服器連接的快取。當該值大於`0`時，啟用 [Fetch API](#p-137)的 keepalive 連線。

The `*connections*` parameter sets the maximum number of idle keepalive connections to destination servers that are preserved in the cache of each worker process. When this number is exceeded, the least recently used connections are closed.

`*connections*`參數設定每個工作進程快取中保留的與目標伺服器的空閒 keepalive 連線的最大數量。當超過此數量時，最近最少使用的連接將關閉。

In Stream, the cache is maintained separately for each server configuration. A value set at the `stream` level is inherited by servers, but each server uses its own cache. Cached connections are reused for requests with the same protocol, host, and port.

在 Stream 中，每個伺服器配置的快取都是獨立維護的。伺服器會繼承在`stream`層級設定的值，但每個伺服器使用自己的快取。對於具有相同協定、主機和連接埠的請求，快取的連線會被重複使用。

When enabled, keepalive assumes that destination servers send valid HTTP responses.

啟用 keepalive 後，會假定目標伺服器發送有效的HTTP回應。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 12345;
>
>     聽 12345；
>     js_fetch_keepalive 32;
>     js_fetch_trusted_certificate /path/to/ISRG_Root_X1.pem;
>     js_preread main.fetch_handler;
> }
> ```

<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>js_fetch_keepalive_requests 1000;<br>js_fetch_keepalive_requests 1000；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 0.9.2.

該指令出現在版本0.9.2 。

Sets the maximum number of requests that can be served through one keepalive connection with [Fetch API](#p-137). After the maximum number of requests is made, the connection is closed.

設定透過 [Fetch API](#p-137)的單一 keepalive 連線可以處理的最大請求數。達到最大請求數後，連線將關閉。

Closing connections periodically is necessary to free per-connection memory allocations. Therefore, using too high maximum number of requests could result in excessive memory usage and not recommended.

定期關閉連線對於釋放每個連線佔用的記憶體至關重要。因此，設定過高的最大請求數可能會導致記憶體使用過量，不建議這樣做。

</table>

Sets a data filter. Since [0.4.0](#p-129), a module function can be referenced. The filter function is called once at the moment when the stream session reaches the [content](#p-165) phase.

設定數據過濾器。自 [0.4.0](#p-129)起，可引用模組函數。過濾器函數在串流會話到達 [content](#p-165)階段時呼叫一次。

The filter function is called with the following arguments:

呼叫篩選函數時，會傳入下列參數：

`s`

the [Stream Session](#p-137) object

[串流會話](#p-137)對象

At this phase, it is possible to perform initialization or register a callback with the [`s.on()`](#p-137) method for each incoming data chunk. The [`s.off()`](#p-137) method may be used to unregister a callback and stop filtering.

在此階段，可以使用 [`s.on()`](#p-137)方法對每個傳入的資料塊執行初始化或註冊回呼。可以使用 [`s.off()`](#p-137)方法取消註冊回呼並停止過濾。

> As the `js_filter` handler returns its result immediately, it supports only synchronous operations. Thus, asynchronous operations such as [`ngx.fetch()`](#p-137) or [`setTimeout()`](#p-137) are not supported.
>
> 由於`js_filter`處理程序會立即傳回結果，因此它僅支援同步操作。因此，諸如 [`ngx.fetch()`](#p-137)或 [`setTimeout()`](#p-137)之類的非同步操作不受支援。

This directive appeared in version 0.4.0.

該指令出現在版本0.4.0 。

Imports a module that implements session and variable handlers in njs. The `export_name` is used as a namespace to access module functions. If the `export_name` is not specified, the module name will be used as a namespace.

導入一個在 njs 中實作會話和變數處理程序的模組。 `export_name` 用作訪問模組函數的命名空間。如果未指定`export_name`，則模組名稱將用作命名空間。

> ```
> js_import stream.js;
> ```

Here, the module name `stream` is used as a namespace while accessing exports. If the imported module exports `foo()`, `stream.foo` is used to refer to it.

這裡，模組名稱`stream`在訪問導出時用作命名空間。如果匯入的模組導出則使用`foo()`, `stream.foo`來引用。

Several `js_import` directives can be specified.

可以指定多個`js_import`指令。

> The directive can be specified on the `server` level since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 指令可以在`server`級別指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**js_include** `*file*`;``<br>` `**js_include** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Specifies a file that implements server and variable handlers in njs:

指定一個在 njs 中實作伺服器和變數處理程序的檔案：

> ```php
> nginx.conf:
> js_include stream.js;
> js_set     $js_addr address;
>
> js_set $js_addr 位址；
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 127.0.0.1:12345;
>
>     聽127.0.0.1:12345 ;
>     return $js_addr;
>
>     返回 $js_addr；
> }
> 
> stream.js:
> function address(s) {
>
> 函數位址（們）{
>     return s.remoteAddress;
>
>     返回 s.remoteAddress；
> }
> ```

The directive was made obsolete in version [0.4.0](#p-129) and was removed in version [0.7.1](#p-129). The [js\_import](#p-145) directive should be used instead.

該指令在版本 [0.4.0](#p-129)中已過時，並在版本 [0.7.1](#p-129)中被移除。應改用 [js\_import](#p-145)指令。

| Default:<br>預設值： | — |

This directive appeared in version 0.9.5.

該指令出現在版本0.9.5 。

Loads a [native module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/native_modules.html) (shared library) for use in Stream JavaScript code. The directive is [QuickJS](#p-132)\-only and is not available when using the njs built-in JavaScript engine.

載入一個[原生模組](https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/native_modules.html) （共享函式庫），供 Stream JavaScript 程式碼使用。此指令僅適用於[QuickJS](#p-132) ，在使用 njs 內建 JavaScript 引擎時不可用。

The `*path*` parameter specifies the absolute path to the shared library file. The optional `as` `*name*` parameter provides an alias name for importing the module in JavaScript code. If not specified, the module can be imported using its filename.

`*path*`參數指定共享庫檔案的絕對路徑。可選的`as` `*name*`參數提供用於在 JavaScript 程式碼中匯入模組的別名。如果未指定，則可以使用模組的檔案名稱匯入。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> js_load_stream_native_module /path/to/mylib.so;
> js_load_stream_native_module /path/to/other.so as myalias;
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     js_import main.js;
>     # ... rest of stream configuration｜...其餘流配置
> }
> ```

In JavaScript code:

在 JavaScript 程式碼中：

> ```js
> // Import by filename
>
> // 按檔案名稱匯入
> import * as mylib from 'mylib.so';
> 
> // Import by alias
>
> // 透過別名匯入
> import * as myalias from 'myalias';
> 
> // Use exported functions
>
> // 使用匯出的函數
> let result = mylib.add(5, 10);
> ```

> For security reasons, this directive is only allowed in the `main` configuration context. Native modules run with full process privileges; use absolute paths and ensure proper code review.
>
> 出於安全考慮，此指令僅允許在`main`配置上下文中使用。原生模組以完整的進程權限運作；請使用絕對路徑並確保進行適當的程式碼審查。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_path** `*path*`;``<br>` `**js_path** ` *路徑* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 0.3.0.

該指令出現在版本0.3.0 。

Sets an additional path for njs modules.

為 njs 模組設定一個額外的路徑。

> The directive can be specified on the `server` level since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 指令可以在`server`級別指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**js_periodic** `*module.function*` [`interval`=`*time*`] [`jitter`=`*number*`] [`worker_affinity`=`*mask*`];``<br>``**js_periodic** `*模組.函數*` [`間隔`=`*時間*`] [`澆水`=`*數字*`] [`工作者親和力`=`*面具*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

This directive appeared in version 0.8.1.

該指令出現在版本0.8.1 。

Specifies a content handler to run at regular interval. The handler receives a [session object](#p-137) as its first argument, it also has access to global objects such as [ngx](#p-137).

指定一個定期運行的內容處理程序。此處理程序接收一個 [會話對象](#p-137)作為其第一個參數，它還可以存取全域對象，例如 [ngx](#p-137) 。

The optional `interval` parameter sets the interval between two consecutive runs, by default, 5 seconds.

可選參數`interval`設定兩次連續運行之間的間隔，預設值為 5 秒。

The optional `jitter` parameter sets the time within which the location content handler will be randomly delayed, by default, there is no delay.

可選參數`jitter`設定位置內容處理程序隨機延遲的時間範圍，預設沒有延遲。

By default, the `js_periodic` handler is executed on worker process 0. The optional `worker_affinity` parameter allows specifying particular worker processes where the location content handler should be executed. Each worker process set is represented by a bitmask of allowed worker processes. The `all` mask allows the handler to be executed in all worker processes.

預設情況下，`js_periodic`處理程序在工作進程0上執行。可選的`worker_affinity`參數允許指定應在其中執行位置內容處理程序的特定工作進程。每個工作進程集由允許的工作進程的位元遮罩表示。 `all` 遮罩允許處理程序在所有工作進程中執行。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> example.conf:
> 
> location @periodics {
>
> 位置 @periodics {
>     # to be run at 1 minute intervals in worker process 0｜在工作流程 0 中以 1 分鐘的間隔執行
>     js_periodic main.handler interval=60s;
> 
>     # to be run at 1 minute intervals in all worker processes｜在所有工作進程中，每隔 1 分鐘運行一次。
>     js_periodic main.handler interval=60s worker_affinity=all;
> 
>     # to be run at 1 minute intervals in worker processes 1 and 3｜在工作進程 1 和 3 中以 1 分鐘的間隔運行。
>     js_periodic main.handler interval=60s worker_affinity=0101;
> 
>     resolver 10.0.0.1;
>
>     解10.0.0.1 ；
>     js_fetch_trusted_certificate /path/to/ISRG_Root_X1.pem;
> }
> 
> example.js:
> 
> async function handler(s) {
>
> 非同步函數處理程序 {
>     let reply = await ngx.fetch('https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/');
>
>     let reply = await ngx.fetch(' https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/' );
>     let body = await reply.text();
> 
>     ngx.log(ngx.INFO, body);
>
>     ngx.log(ngx. INFO , body);
> }
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**js_preload_object** `*name.json*` \| `*name*` from `*file.json*`;``<br>` `**js_preload_object** ` *name.json* ` \| ` *name* ` from ` *file.json* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 0.7.8.

該指令出現在版本0.7.8 。

Preloads an [immutable object](#p-136) at configure time. The `name` is used as a name of the global variable though which the object is available in njs code. If the `name` is not specified, the file name will be used instead.

在配置時預先載入一個[不可變物件](#p-136)用作全域變數的名稱`name`該物件可透過該變數在njs程式碼中使用。如果未指定`name` ，則將使用檔案名稱。

> ```
> js_preload_object map.json;
> ```

Here, the `map` is used as a name while accessing the preloaded object.

在這裡， `map`用作存取預先載入物件時的名稱。

Several `js_preload_object` directives can be specified.

可以指定多個`js_preload_object`指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**js_preread** `*module.function*`;``<br>` `**js_preread** ` *module.function* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Sets an njs function which will be called at the [preread](#p-165) phase. Since [0.4.0](#p-129), a module function can be referenced.

設定一個 njs 函數，該函數將在 [preread](#p-165)階段呼叫。自 [0.4.0](#p-129)起，可引用模組函數。

The function is called once at the moment when the stream session reaches the [preread](#p-165) phase for the first time. The function is called with the following arguments:

此函數在串流會話首次到達 [preread](#p-165)階段時呼叫一次。呼叫函數時會傳遞以下參數：

`s`

the [Stream Session](#p-137) object

[串流會話](#p-137)對象

At this phase, it is possible to perform initialization or register a callback with the [`s.on()`](#p-137) method for each incoming data chunk until one of the following methods are called: [`s.allow()`](#p-137), [`s.decline()`](#p-137), [`s.done()`](#p-137). When one of these methods is called, the stream session switches to the [next phase](#p-165) and all current [`s.on()`](#p-137) callbacks are dropped.

在此階段，可以執行初始化或註冊回呼函數[`s.on()`](#p-137) 對每個傳入的資料塊執行對應的方法，直到呼叫以下方法之一：[`s.allow()`](#p-137), [`s.decline()`](#p-137), [`s.done()`](#p-137)當呼叫這些方法之一時，串流會話將切換到[下一階段]。(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/stream_processing.html) 以及所有當前的[`s.on()`](#p-137) 回調函數被丟棄。

> As the `js_preread` handler returns its result immediately, it supports only synchronous callbacks. Thus, asynchronous callbacks such as [`ngx.fetch()`](#p-137) or [`setTimeout()`](#p-137) are not supported. Nevertheless, asynchronous operations are supported in [`s.on()`](#p-137) callbacks in the [preread](#p-165) phase. See [this example](https://github.com/nginx/njs-examples#authorizing-connections-using-ngx-fetch-as-auth-request-stream-auth-request) for more information.
>
> 由於`js_preread`處理程序會立即傳回結果，因此它僅支援同步回呼。因此，不支援非同步回調，例如 [`ngx.fetch()`](#p-137)或 [`setTimeout()`](#p-137) 。但是，在 [preread](#p-165)階段的 [`s.on()`](#p-137)回調中支援非同步操作。有關更多信息，請參閱 [此範例](https://github.com/nginx/njs-examples#authorizing-connections-using-ngx-fetch-as-auth-request-stream-auth-request) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_set** `*$variable*` `*module.function*` [`nocache`];``<br>` `**js_set** ` *$variable* ` ` *module.function* ` [` nocache `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Sets an njs `function` for the specified `variable`. Since [0.4.0](#p-129), a module function can be referenced.

為指定的`variable`設定 njs `function` 。由於 [0.4.0](#p-129) ，可以引用模組函數。

The function is called when the variable is referenced for the first time for a given request. The exact moment depends on a [phase](#p-165) at which the variable is referenced. This can be used to perform some logic not related to variable evaluation. For example, if the variable is referenced only in the [log\_format](#p-148) directive, its handler will not be executed until the log phase. This handler can be used to do some cleanup right before the request is freed.

當給定請求首次引用該變數時，將呼叫此函數。具體時間取決於變數被引用的 [phase](#p-165)階段。這可用來執行一些與變數求值無關的邏輯。例如，如果變數僅在 [log\_format](#p-148)指令中被引用，則其處理程序將在日誌階段才會執行。此處理程序可用於在請求釋放之前執行一些清理工作。

Since [0.8.6](#p-129), when optional argument `nocache` is provided the handler is called every time it is referenced. Due to current limitations of the [ngx\_stream\_set\_module](#p-158) module, when a `nocache` variable is referenced by the [set](#p-158) directive its handler should always return a fixed-length value.

由於 [0.8.6](#p-129) ，當提供可選參數`nocache`時，每次引用該參數都會呼叫處理程序。由於 [ngx\_stream\_set\_module](#p-158)模組的目前限制，當 [set](#p-158)指令引用`nocache`變數時，其處理程序應始終傳回固定長度的值。

> As the `js_set` handler returns its result immediately, it supports only synchronous callbacks. Thus, asynchronous callbacks such as [ngx.fetch()](#p-137) or [setTimeout()](#p-137) are not supported.
>
> 由於`js_set`處理程序會立即傳回結果，因此它僅支援同步回呼。因此，不支援非同步回調，例如 [ngx.fetch()](#p-137)或 [setTimeout()](#p-137) 。

> The directive can be specified on the `server` level since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 指令可以在`server`級別指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_shared_dict_zone** `zone`=`*name*`:`*size*` [`timeout`=`*time*`] [`type`=`string`\|`number`] [`evict`] [`state`=`*file*`];``<br>` `**js_shared_dict_zone** `區域`=` *名稱* `:` *大小* ` [`超時`=` *時間* `] [`型`=`字串`\|`數字`] [`驅逐`] [`狀態`=` *文件* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

This directive appeared in version 0.8.0.

該指令出現在版本0.8.0 。

Sets the `*name*` and `*size*` of the shared memory zone that keeps the key-value [dictionary](#p-137) shared between worker processes.

設定共享記憶體區域的`*name*`和`*size*` ，該區域用於保存工作進程之間共享的鍵值對 [字典](#p-137) 。

By default the shared dictionary uses a string as a key and a value. The optional `type` parameter allows redefining the value type to number.

預設情況下，共享字典使用字串作為鍵和值。可選參數`type`允許將值類型重新定義為數字。

The optional `timeout` parameter sets the time in milliseconds after which all shared dictionary entries are removed from the zone. If some entries require a different removal time, it can be set with the `timeout` argument of the [add](#p-137), [incr](#p-137), and [set](#p-137) methods ([0.8.5](#p-129)).

可選參數`timeout`設定從區域中刪除所有共享字典條目的時間（以毫秒為單位）。如果某些條目需要不同的刪除時間，則可以使用 [add](#p-137) 、[incr](#p-137)和 [(https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/changes.html#njs0.8.5)](#p-137)方法的`timeout`參數進行設定（[ 0.8.5 ）。

The optional `evict` parameter removes the oldest key-value pair when the zone storage is exhausted.

可選參數`evict`在區域儲存耗盡時刪除最舊的鍵值對。

The optional `state` parameter specifies a `*file*` that keeps the shared dictionary state in JSON format and makes it persistent across nginx restarts ([0.9.1](#p-129)).

可選的`state`參數指定一個`*file*`該參數以JSON格式保持共享字典狀態，並使其在 nginx 重啟後持久存在 ([0.9.1](#p-129) )。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> example.conf:
>     # Creates a 1Mb dictionary with string values,｜建立一個包含字串值的 1MB 字典，
>     # removes key-value pairs after 60 seconds of inactivity:｜鍵值對在 60 秒無活動後刪除：
>     js_shared_dict_zone zone=foo:1M timeout=60s;
> 
>     # Creates a 512Kb dictionary with string values,｜建立一個包含字串值的 512Kb 字典，
>     # forcibly removes oldest key-value pairs when the zone is exhausted:｜當區域耗盡時，強制刪除最舊的鍵值對：
>     js_shared_dict_zone zone=bar:512K timeout=30s evict;
> 
>     # Creates a 32Kb permanent dictionary with number values:｜建立一個 32Kb 的永久字典，其中包含數值：
>     js_shared_dict_zone zone=num:32k type=number;
> 
>     # Creates a 1Mb dictionary with string values and persistent state:｜建立一個包含字串值和持久狀態的 1MB 字典：
>     js_shared_dict_zone zone=persistent:1M state=/tmp/dict.json;
> 
> example.js:
>     function get(r) {
>
>     函數 get(r) {
>         r.return(200, ngx.shared.foo.get(r.args.key));
>     }
> 
>     function set(r) {
>
>     函數 set(r) {
>         r.return(200, ngx.shared.foo.set(r.args.key, r.args.value));
>     }
> 
>     function del(r) {
>
>     函數 del(r) {
>         r.return(200, ngx.shared.bar.delete(r.args.key));
>     }
> 
>     function increment(r) {
>
>     函數 increment(r) {
>         r.return(200, ngx.shared.num.incr(r.args.key, 2));
>     }
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**js_var** `*$variable*` [`*value*`];``<br>` `**js_var** ` *$變數* ` [` *值* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 0.5.3.

該指令出現在版本0.5.3 。

Declares a [writable](#p-137) variable. The value can contain text, variables, and their combination.

宣告一個可寫的(https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/reference.html#r_variables)變數。該值可以包含文字、變數及其組合。

> The directive can be specified on the `server` level since [0.7.7](#p-129).
>
> 指令可以在`server`級別指定，因為 [0.7.7](#p-129) 。

**Session Object Properties｜會話物件屬性**

Each stream njs handler receives one argument, a stream session [object](#p-137).

每個流 njs 處理程序接收一個參數，即流會話 [物件](#p-137) 。

<a id="p-146"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_keyval_module｜模組 ngx_stream_keyval_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_keyval_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_keyval\_module｜模組 ngx\_stream\_keyval\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-146)<br>[Directives](#p-146)<br>     [keyval](#p-146)<br>     [keyval\_zone](#p-146)<br>[範例設定](#p-146)<br> [指令](#p-146)<br> [keyval](#p-146)<br> [keyval\_zone](#p-146) |

The `ngx_stream_keyval_module` module (1.13.7) creates variables with values taken from key-value pairs managed by the [API](#p-048) or a variable that can also be set with [njs](https://github.com/nginx/njs-examples/).

`ngx_stream_keyval_module`模組 ( 1.13.7 ) 建立變數，其值取自 [API](#p-048)管理的鍵值對，或也可使用 [njs](https://github.com/nginx/njs-examples/)設定的變數。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> http {
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         ...
>         location /api {
>             api write=on;
>         }
>     }
> }
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
> 
>     keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/lib/nginx/state/one.keyval;
>     keyval      $ssl_server_name $name zone=one;
>
>     keyval $ssl_server_name $name zone=one;
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen              12345 ssl;
>
>         監聽 12345 ssl;
>         proxy_pass          $name;
>
>         proxy_pass $name;
>         ssl_certificate     /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.pem;
>
>         ssl_certificate /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.pem;
>         ssl_certificate_key /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.key;
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**keyval** `*key*` `*$variable*` `zone`=`*name*`;``<br>` `**keyval** ` *鍵* ` ` *$變數* ` `區域`=` *名稱* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Creates a new `*$variable*` whose value is looked up by the `*key*` in the key-value database. Matching rules are defined by the [`type`](#p-146) parameter of the [`keyval_zone`](#p-146) directive. The database is stored in a shared memory zone specified by the `zone` parameter.

建立一個新的`*$variable*`其值由`*key*`在鍵值資料庫中尋找。匹配規則由 [`type`](#p-146)指令的 [`keyval_zone`](#p-146)參數定義。資料庫儲存在由`zone`參數指定的共享記憶體區域。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**keyval_zone** `zone`=`*name*`:`*size*` [`state`=`*file*`] [`timeout`=`*time*`] [`type`=`string`\|`ip`\|`prefix`] [`sync`];``<br>` `**keyval_zone** `區域`=` *名稱* `:` *大小* ` [`狀態`=` *檔案* `] [`超時`=` *時間 * `] [`類型`=`字串`\|` IP 位址`\|`前綴`] [`同步`];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Sets the `*name*` and `*size*` of the shared memory zone that keeps the key-value database. Key-value pairs are managed by the [API](#p-048).

設定用於保存鍵值資料庫的共享記憶體區域的`*name*`和`*size*` 。鍵值對由 [API](#p-048)管理。

The optional `state` parameter specifies a `*file*` that keeps the current state of the key-value database in the JSON format and makes it persistent across nginx restarts. Changing the file content directly should be avoided.

可選參數`state`指定一個`*file*` ，該參數以JSON格式儲存鍵值資料庫的目前狀態，並使其在 nginx 重新啟動後仍然有效。應避免直接更改文件內容。

Examples:

例如：

> ```
> keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/lib/nginx/state/one.keyval; # path for Linux
>
> keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/lib/nginx/state/one.keyval; # Linux 路徑
> keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/db/nginx/state/one.keyval;  # path for FreeBSD
>
> keyval_zone zone=one:32k state=/var/db/nginx/state/one.keyval; # FreeBSD 的路徑
> ```

The optional `timeout` parameter (1.15.0) sets the time after which key-value pairs are removed from the zone.

可選參數`timeout` ( 1.15.0 ) 設定鍵值對從區域移除的時間。

The optional `type` parameter (1.17.1) activates an extra index optimized for matching the key of a certain type and defines matching rules when evaluating a [keyval](#p-146) `$variable`.

可選的`type`參數 ( 1.17.1 ) 啟動一個額外的索引，該索引針對匹配特定類型的鍵進行了最佳化，並在評估 [keyval](#p-146) `$variable`時定義了匹配規則。

> The index is stored in the same shared memory zone and thus requires additional storage.
>
> 索引儲存在同一個共享記憶體區域中，因此需要額外的儲存空間。

`type=string`

default, no index is enabled; variable lookup is performed using exact match of the record key and a search key

預設情況下，未啟用索引；變數尋找使用記錄鍵和搜尋鍵的精確匹配。

`type=ip`

the search key is the textual representation of IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range; to match a record key, the search key must belong to a subnet specified by a record key or exactly match an IP address

搜尋鍵是 IPv4 或 IPv6 位址或CIDR位址範圍的文字表示；若要符合記錄鍵，搜尋鍵必須屬於記錄鍵指定的子網，或與IP位址完全相符。

`type=prefix`

variable lookup is performed using prefix match of a record key and a search key (1.17.5); to match a record key, the record key must be a prefix of the search key

變數尋找使用記錄鍵和搜尋鍵的前綴匹配（ 1.17.5 ）；要匹配記錄鍵，記錄鍵必須是搜尋鍵的前綴。

The optional `sync` parameter (1.15.0) enables [synchronization](#p-164) of the shared memory zone. The synchronization requires the `timeout` parameter to be set.

可選參數`sync` （ 1.15.0 ）啟用共享記憶體區域的[同步](#p-164) 。同步需要設定參數`timeout` 。

> If the synchronization is enabled, removal of key-value pairs (no matter [one](#p-048) or [all](#p-048)) will be performed only on a target cluster node. The same key-value pairs on other cluster nodes will be removed upon `timeout`.
>
> 如果啟用同步，則鍵值對的刪除（無論是[一個](#p-048)或[所有](#p-048) ）僅在目標叢集節點上執行。其他叢集節點上的相同鍵值對將在`timeout`時刪除。

---

<a id="p-147"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_limit_conn_module｜模組 ngx_stream_limit_conn_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_limit_conn_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_limit\_conn\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_limit_conn_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-147)<br>[Directives](#p-147)<br>     [limit\_conn](#p-147)<br>     [limit\_conn\_dry\_run](#p-147)<br>     [limit\_conn\_log\_level](#p-147)<br>     [limit\_conn\_zone](#p-147)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-147)<br>[範例配置](#p-147)<br>[指示](#p-147)<br>     [limit\_conn](#p-147)<br>     [limit\_conn\_dry\_run](#p-147)<br>     [limit\_conn\_log\_level](#p-147)<br>     [limit_conn_zone](#p-147)<br>[嵌入式變數](#p-147) |

The `ngx_stream_limit_conn_module` module (1.9.3) is used to limit the number of connections per the defined key, in particular, the number of connections from a single IP address.

`ngx_stream_limit_conn_module`模組 ( 1.9.3 ) 用於限制每個已定義鍵的連接數，特別是來自單一IP位址的連接數。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=addr:10m;
> 
>     ...
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
> 
>         ...
> 
>         limit_conn           addr 1;
>
>         limit_conn addr 1;
>         limit_conn_log_level error;
>
>         limit_conn_log_level 錯誤；
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**limit_conn** `*zone*` `*number*`;``<br>` `**limit_conn** ` *區域* ` ` *編號* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Sets the shared memory zone and the maximum allowed number of connections for a given key value. When this limit is exceeded, the server will close the connection. For example, the directives

設定共享記憶體區域以及給定鍵值允許的最大連接數。當超過此限制時，伺服器將關閉連線。例如，指令如下：

> ```
> limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=addr:10m;
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     ...
>     limit_conn addr 1;
> }
> ```

allow only one connection per an IP address at a time.

一次只允許一個IP位址連接一個連接。

When several `limit_conn` directives are specified, any configured limit will apply.

當指定多個`limit_conn`指令時，任何配置的限制都將適用。

These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `limit_conn` directives defined on the current level.

如果目前等級沒有定義`limit_conn`指令，則這些指令將從上一個設定等級繼承。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>limit_conn_dry_run</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>limit_conn_dry_run off;<br>limit_conn_dry_run 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.17.6.

該指令出現在版本1.17.6 。

Enables the dry run mode. In this mode, the number of connections is not limited, however, in the shared memory zone, the number of excessive connections is accounted as usual.

啟用試運轉模式。在此模式下，連接數不受限制，但共享記憶體區域中過多的連接數仍會像往常一樣被統計。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>limit_conn_log_level<br>限制連線日誌級別</strong> <code>info<br>資訊</code> | <code>notice<br>注意</code> | <code>warn<br>警告</code> | <code>error<br>錯誤</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>limit_conn_log_level error;<br>limit_conn_log_level error；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the desired logging level for cases when the server limits the number of connections.

設定伺服器限制連線數時所需的日誌等級。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**limit_conn_zone** `*key*` `zone`=`*name*`:`*size*`;``<br>` `**limit_conn_zone** ` *鍵* ` `區域`=` *名稱* `:` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Sets parameters for a shared memory zone that will keep states for various keys. In particular, the state includes the current number of connections. The `*key*` can contain text, variables, and their combinations (1.11.2). Connections with an empty key value are not accounted. Usage example:

設定共享記憶體區域的參數，該區域將保留各個鍵的狀態。特別是，狀態包括當前的連線數。 `*key*` 可以包含文字、變數及其組合 (1.11.2)。不考慮具有空鍵值的連接。使用範例：

> ```
> limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=addr:10m;
> ```

Here, the key is a client IP address set by the `$binary_remote_addr` variable. The size of `$binary_remote_addr` is 4 bytes for IPv4 addresses or 16 bytes for IPv6 addresses. The stored state always occupies 32 or 64 bytes on 32-bit platforms and 64 bytes on 64-bit platforms. One megabyte zone can keep about 32 thousand 32-byte states or about 16 thousand 64-byte states. If the zone storage is exhausted, the server will close the connection.

關鍵在於客戶。 IP 由以下地址設定 `$binary_remote_addr` 變數。大小 `$binary_remote_addr` IPv4 位址佔用 4 位元組，IPv6 位址佔用 16 位元組。儲存的狀態在 32 位元平台上始終佔用 32 或 64 字節，在 64 位元平台上始終佔用 64 位元組。 1 MB 的區域大約可以儲存 32,000 個 32 位元組的狀態，或大約 16,000 個 64 個位元組的狀態。如果區域儲存空間耗盡，伺服器將關閉連線。

> Additionally, as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx), the [status information](#p-048) for each such shared memory zone can be [obtained](#p-048) or [reset](#p-048) with the [API](#p-048) since 1.17.7.
>
> 此外，作為我們1.17.7商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，每個此類共享記憶體區域的[狀態資訊](#p-048)可以[取得](#p-048)或[重設](#p-048) (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_api_module.html)因為API 。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

`$limit_conn_status`

keeps the result of limiting the number of connections (1.17.6): `PASSED`, `REJECTED`, or `REJECTED_DRY_RUN`

保留限制連接數的結果（ 1.17.6 ）： `PASSED`, `REJECTED`或`REJECTED_DRY_RUN`
