<a id="p-148"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_log_module｜模組 ngx_stream_log_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_log_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_log\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_log_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-148)<br>[Directives](#p-148)<br>     [access\_log](#p-148)<br>     [log\_format](#p-148)<br>     [open\_log\_file\_cache](#p-148)<br>[範例設定](#p-148)<br> [指令](#p-148)<br> [存取日誌](#p-148)<br> [日誌格式](#p-148)<br> [開啟日誌檔案快取](#p-148) |

The `ngx_stream_log_module` module (1.11.4) writes session logs in the specified format.

`ngx_stream_log_module`模組 ( 1.11.4 ) 以指定的格式寫入會話日誌。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> log_format basic '$remote_addr [$time_local] '
>                  '$protocol $status $bytes_sent $bytes_received '
>
>                  '$protocol $status $bytes_sent $bytes_received'
>                  '$session_time';
>
>                  '$session_time'；
> 
> access_log /spool/logs/nginx-access.log basic buffer=32k;
>
> access_log /spool/logs/nginx-access.log 基本緩衝區=32k;
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>access_log</strong> <code><i>path</i></code> <code><i>format</i></code> [<code>buffer</code>=<code><i>size</i></code>] [<code>gzip[=<code><i>level</i></code>]</code>] [<code>flush</code>=<code><i>time</i></code>] [<code>if</code>=<code><i>condition</i></code>];</code><br><code><strong>access_log</strong> <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong>訪問日誌</strong> <code><i>路徑</i></code> <code><i>格式</i></code> [ <code>緩衝區<code><i> </code> </i></code> [ <code> gzip[= <code><i>等級</i></code> ]</code> ] [ <code>刷新</code> </code> </i></code> <code> <code><i> <code><i>條件</i></code> ]; </code><br><code><strong>訪問日誌</strong> <code>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>access_log off;<br>關閉訪問日誌；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the path, [format](#p-148), and configuration for a buffered log write. Several logs can be specified on the same configuration level. Logging to [syslog](#p-169) can be configured by specifying the “`syslog:`” prefix in the first parameter. The special value `off` cancels all `access_log` directives on the current level.

設定緩衝日誌寫入的路徑、格式（ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_log_module.html#log_format) ）和配置。可以在相同配置等級指定多個日誌。透過在第一個參數中指定前綴“ `syslog:` ”，可以設定日誌寫入（[syslog](#p-169) ）。特殊值`off`會取消目前層級的所有`access_log`指令。

If either the `buffer` or `gzip` parameter is used, writes to log will be buffered.

如果使用`buffer`或`gzip`參數，則寫入日誌的操作將會被緩衝。

> The buffer size must not exceed the size of an atomic write to a disk file. For FreeBSD this size is unlimited.
>
> 緩衝區大小不得超過原子寫入磁碟檔案的大小。對於 FreeBSD 系統，此大小沒有限制。

When buffering is enabled, the data will be written to the file:

啟用緩衝後，資料將被寫入檔案：

-   if the next log line does not fit into the buffer;  
    如果下一行日誌無法放入緩衝區；
-   if the buffered data is older than specified by the `flush` parameter;  
    如果緩衝的資料比`flush`參數指定的資料更舊；
-   when a worker process is [re-opening](#p-026) log files or is shutting down.  
    當工作進程[重新開啟](#p-026)日誌檔案或關閉時。

If the `gzip` parameter is used, then the buffered data will be compressed before writing to the file. The compression level can be set between 1 (fastest, less compression) and 9 (slowest, best compression). By default, the buffer size is equal to 64K bytes, and the compression level is set to 1. Since the data is compressed in atomic blocks, the log file can be decompressed or read by “`zcat`” at any time.

如果使用`gzip`參數，則緩衝的資料會在寫入檔案之前被壓縮。壓縮等級可以設定為 1（速度最快，壓縮率最低）到 9（速度最慢，壓縮率最高）。預設情況下，緩衝區大小為 64KB，壓縮等級設定為 1。由於資料以原子塊的形式壓縮，因此可以隨時使用`zcat`解壓縮或讀取日誌檔。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> access_log /path/to/log.gz basic gzip flush=5m;
> ```

> For gzip compression to work, nginx must be built with the zlib library.
>
> 要讓 gzip 壓縮正常運作，nginx 必須使用 zlib 函式庫進行建置。

The file path can contain variables, but such logs have some constraints:

文件路徑可以包含變量，但此類日誌有一些限制：

-   the [user](#p-125) whose credentials are used by worker processes should have permissions to create files in a directory with such logs;  
    工作進程使用的憑證對應的 [使用者](#p-125)應該具有在包含此類日誌的目錄中建立檔案的權限；
-   buffered writes do not work;  
    緩衝寫入不起作用；
-   the file is opened and closed for each log write. However, since the descriptors of frequently used files can be stored in a [cache](#p-148), writing to the old file can continue during the time specified by the [open\_log\_file\_cache](#p-148) directive’s `valid` parameter  
    每次寫入日誌時，檔案都會被開啟和關閉。但是，由於常用檔案的描述子可以儲存在 [cache](#p-148)中，因此在 [open\_log\_file\_cache](#p-148)指令的`valid`參數指定的時間內，可以繼續寫入舊檔案。

The `if` parameter enables conditional logging. A session will not be logged if the `*condition*` evaluates to “0” or an empty string.

`if`參數啟用條件日誌記錄。如果`*condition*`的值為「0」或空字串，則不會記錄會話日誌。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**log_format** `*name*` [`escape`=`default`\|`json`\|`none`] `*string*` ...;``<br>` `**log_format** ` *名稱* ` [`轉義`=`預設值`\|` json `\|`無`] ` *字串* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Specifies the log format, for example:

指定日誌格式，例如：

> ```
> log_format proxy '$remote_addr [$time_local] '
>                  '$protocol $status $bytes_sent $bytes_received '
>
>                  '$protocol $status $bytes_sent $bytes_received'
>                  '$session_time "$upstream_addr" '
>                  '"$upstream_bytes_sent" "$upstream_bytes_received" "$upstream_connect_time"';
> ```

The `escape` parameter (1.11.8) allows setting `json` or `default` characters escaping in variables, by default, `default` escaping is used. The `none` parameter (1.13.10) disables escaping.

`escape`參數（1.11.8）允許設定變數中的`json`或`default`字元轉義，預設使用`default`轉義。 `none` 參數 (1.13.10) 停用轉義。

For `default` escaping, characters “`"`”, “`\`”, and other characters with values less than 32 or above 126 are escaped as “`\xXX`”. If the variable value is not found, a hyphen (“`-`”) will be logged.

對於`default`轉義，字元「 `"` 」、「 `\` 」以及值小於32或大於126的其他字元將被轉義為「 `\xXX` 」。如果未找到變數值，則會記錄一個連字號（“ `-` ”）。

For `json` escaping, all characters not allowed in JSON [strings](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8259#section-7) will be escaped: characters “`"`” and “`\`” are escaped as “`\"`” and “`\\`”, characters with values less than 32 are escaped as “`\n`”, “`\r`”, “`\t`”, “`\b`”, “`\f`”, or “`\u00XX`”.

為了 `json` 轉義字符，所有不允許出現的字符 JSON [字串](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8259#section-7) 將被逃脫：字元“`"`“ 和 ”`\`”被轉義為“`\"`“ 和 ”`\\`”，值小於 32 的字元將被轉義為“`\n`”, “`\r`”, “`\t`”, “`\b`”, “`\f`“， 或者 ”`\u00XX`”.

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>open_log_file_cache<br>打開日誌檔案緩存</strong> <code>max<br>最大限度</code>=<code><i>N</i></code> [<code>inactive<br>不活躍</code>=<code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>] [<code>min_uses<br>最小使用次數</code>=<code><i>N</i></code>] [<code>valid<br>有效的</code>=<code><i>time<br>時間</i></code>];</code><br><code><strong>open_log_file_cache<br>打開日誌檔案緩存</strong> <code>off<br>離開</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>open_log_file_cache off;<br>關閉 open_log_file_cache；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a cache that stores the file descriptors of frequently used logs whose names contain variables. The directive has the following parameters:

定義一個緩存，用於儲存名稱包含變數的常用日誌檔案的檔案描述符。此指令具有以下參數：

`max`

sets the maximum number of descriptors in a cache; if the cache becomes full the least recently used (LRU) descriptors are closed

設定快取中描述符的最大數量；如果快取已滿，則最近最少使用的（ LRU ）描述符將關閉。

`inactive`

sets the time after which the cached descriptor is closed if there were no access during this time; by default, 10 seconds

設定快取描述符在無存取後關閉的時間；預設值為 10 秒。

`min_uses`

sets the minimum number of file uses during the time defined by the `inactive` parameter to let the descriptor stay open in a cache; by default, 1

設定`inactive`參數定義的時間段內，檔案使用次數的最小值，以使描述符在快取中保持開啟；預設值為1。

`valid`

sets the time after which it should be checked that the file still exists with the same name; by default, 60 seconds

設定檢查同名檔案是否存在的時間間隔；預設值為 60 秒。

`off`

disables caching

禁用快取

Usage example:

使用範例：

> ```
> open_log_file_cache max=1000 inactive=20s valid=1m min_uses=2;
> ```

---

<a id="p-149"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_map_module｜模組 ngx_stream_map_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_map_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_map\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_map_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-149)<br>[Directives](#p-149)<br>     [map](#p-149)<br>     [map\_hash\_bucket\_size](#p-149)<br>     [map\_hash\_max\_size](#p-149)<br>[範例設定](#p-149)<br> [指令](#p-149)<br> [映射](#p-149)<br> [映射_哈希_桶_大小](#p-149)<br> [映射_哈希_最大_大小](#p-149) |

The `ngx_stream_map_module` module (1.11.2) creates variables whose values depend on values of other variables.

`ngx_stream_map_module`模組 ( 1.11.2 ) 建立變量，這些變數的值取決於其他變數的值。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> map $remote_addr $limit {
>
> 映射 $remote_addr $limit {
>     127.0.0.1    "";
>     default      $binary_remote_addr;
>
>     預設值 $binary_remote_addr；
> }
> 
> limit_conn_zone $limit zone=addr:10m;
> limit_conn addr 1;
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**map** `*string*` `*$variable*` { ... }``<br>` `**map** ` *字串* ` ` *$變數* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Creates a new variable whose value depends on values of one or more of the source variables specified in the first parameter.

建立一個新變量，其值取決於第一個參數中指定的一個或多個來源變數的值。

> Since variables are evaluated only when they are used, the mere declaration even of a large number of “`map`” variables does not add any extra costs to connection processing.
>
> 由於變數僅在使用時才進行求值，因此即使宣告大量的「 `map` 」變數也不會為連接處理增加任何額外的成本。

Parameters inside the `map` block specify a mapping between source and resulting values.

`map`區塊內的參數指定來源值和結果值之間的對應。

Source values are specified as strings or regular expressions.

來源值可以指定為字串或正規表示式。

Strings are matched ignoring the case.

字串匹配時忽略大小寫。

A regular expression should either start from the “`~`” symbol for a case-sensitive matching, or from the “`~*`” symbols for case-insensitive matching. A regular expression can contain named and positional captures that can later be used in other directives along with the resulting variable. The regular expressions are matched when the resulting variable is evaluated, and a successful match replaces the positional captures “`$1`”...“`$9`” set by previously matched regular expressions, see [Regular expression captures](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html).

正規表示式應以「 `~` 」符號開頭以區分大小寫進行匹配，或以「 `~*` 」符號開頭以不區分大小寫進行匹配。正規表示式可以包含命名捕獲和位置捕獲，這些捕獲可以與結果變數一起用於其他指令。正規表示式在計算結果變數時進行匹配，匹配成功會替換先前匹配的正則表達式設定的位置捕獲“ `$1` ”...“ `$9` ”，請參閱[正則表達式捕獲](https://nginx.org/en/docs/regex_captures.html) 。

If a source value matches one of the names of special parameters described below, it should be prefixed with the “`\`” symbol.

如果來源值與下面描述的特殊參數名稱之一匹配，則應在其前面加上「 `\` 」符號。

The resulting value can contain text, variable, and their combination.

結果值可以包含文字、變數及其組合。

The following special parameters are also supported:

此外，也支援以下特殊參數：

`default` `*value*`

sets the resulting value if the source value matches none of the specified variants. When `default` is not specified, the default resulting value will be an empty string.

如果來源值與任何指定的變體都不匹配，則設定結果值。如果未指定`default` ，則預設結果值為空字串。

`hostnames`

indicates that source values can be hostnames with a prefix or suffix mask:

表示來源值可以是帶有前綴或後綴掩碼的主機名稱：

> ```
> *.example.com 1;
> example.*     1;
>
> 例如* 1；
> ```

The following two records

以下兩筆記錄

> ```
> example.com   1;
> *.example.com 1;
> ```

can be combined:

可以組合使用：

> ```
> .example.com  1;
> ```

This parameter should be specified before the list of values.

此參數應在值列表之前指定。

`include` `*file*`

includes a file with values. There can be several inclusions.

包含一個帶有值的檔案。可以包含多個文件。

`volatile`

indicates that the variable is not cacheable (1.11.7).

表示該變數不可緩存（ 1.11.7 ）。

The search is performed in the following order of priority and terminates on the first matching variant:

搜尋按以下優先順序執行，並在找到第一個符合項目時終止：

1.  the string value without a mask  
    不含遮罩的字串值
2.  the longest string value with a prefix mask, e.g. “`*.example.com`”  
    最長的字串值，帶有前綴掩碼，例如“ `*.example.com` ”
3.  the longest string value with a suffix mask, e.g. “`mail.*`”  
    最長的字串值，帶有後綴掩碼，例如“ `mail.*` ”
4.  the first matching regular expression (in order of appearance in the configuration file)  
    第一個符合的正規表示式（按在設定檔中出現的順序）
5.  the default value  
    預設值

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>map_hash_bucket_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>map_hash_bucket_size 32|64|128;<br>map_hash_bucket_size 32|64|128；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the bucket size for the [map](#p-149) variables hash tables. Default value depends on the processor’s cache line size. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定 [map](#p-149)變數哈希表的桶大小。預設值取決於處理器的快取行大小。有關設定哈希表的詳細信息，請參閱單獨的 [文檔](#p-040) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>map_hash_max_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>map_hash_max_size 2048;<br>map_hash_max_size 2048；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the maximum `*size*` of the [map](#p-149) variables hash tables. The details of setting up hash tables are provided in a separate [document](#p-040).

設定 [映射](#p-149)變數哈希表的最大值`*size*` 。設定哈希表的詳細資訊在單獨的 [文檔](#p-040)中提供。

<a id="p-150"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_mqtt_filter_module｜模組 ngx_stream_mqtt_filter_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_mqtt_filter_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_mqtt\_filter\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_mqtt_filter_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-150)<br>[Directives](#p-150)<br>     [mqtt](#p-150)<br>     [mqtt\_buffers](#p-150)<br>     [mqtt\_rewrite\_buffer\_size](#p-150)<br>     [mqtt\_set\_connect](#p-150)<br>[範例設定](#p-150)<br>[指令](#p-150)<br>     [mqtt](#p-150)<br>     [mqtt\_buffers](#p-150)<br>     [mqtt\_rewrite\_buffer\_size](#p-150)<br>     [mqtt\_set\_connect](#p-150) |

The `ngx_stream_mqtt_filter_module` module (1.23.4) provides support for Message Queuing Telemetry Transport protocol (MQTT) versions [3.1.1](https://docs.oasis-open.org/mqtt/mqtt/v3.1.1/mqtt-v3.1.1.html) and [5.0](https://docs.oasis-open.org/mqtt/mqtt/v5.0/mqtt-v5.0.html).

`ngx_stream_mqtt_filter_module`模組 ( 1.23.4 ) 提供對訊息佇列遙測傳輸協定 ( MQTT ) 版本 [3.1.1](https://docs.oasis-open.org/mqtt/mqtt/v3.1.1/mqtt-v3.1.1.html)與 [5.0](https://docs.oasis-open.org/mqtt/mqtt/v5.0/mqtt-v5.0.html) 。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> listen            127.0.0.1:18883;
>
> 聽127.0.0.1:18883 ;
> proxy_pass        backend;
>
> proxy_pass 後端；
> proxy_buffer_size 16k;
> 
> mqtt             on;
>
> MQTT開啟；
> mqtt_set_connect clientid "$client";
> mqtt_set_connect username "$name";
>
> mqtt_set_connect 使用者名稱 "$name";
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>mqtt</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>mqtt off;<br>MQTT 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables the MQTT protocol for the given virtual server.

為給定的虛擬伺服器啟用MQTT協定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>mqtt_buffers</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code> <code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>mqtt_buffers 100 1k;<br>mqtt_buffers 100 1k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.25.1.

該指令出現在版本1.25.1 。

Sets the `*number*` and `*size*` of the buffers used for handling MQTT messages, for a single connection.

設定用於處理MQTT訊息的緩衝區的`*number*`和`*size*` ，適用於單一連接。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>mqtt_rewrite_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>mqtt_rewrite_buffer_size 4k|8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

> This directive is obsolete since version 1.25.1. The [mqtt\_buffers](#p-150) directive should be used instead.
>
> 此指令自版本1.25.1起已過時。應改用[mqtt\_buffers](#p-150)指令。

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for writing a modified message. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform. It can be made smaller, however.

設定用於寫入修改後訊息的緩衝區的`*size*`值。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台不同，該值可以是 4K 或 8K。不過，也可以將其減小。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**mqtt_set_connect** `field` `*value*`;``<br>` `**mqtt_set_connect** `字段` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Sets the message `field` to the given `value` for CONNECT message. The following fields are supported: `clientid`, `username`, and `password`. The value can contain text, variables, and their combination.

將訊息`field`設定為給定的`value` ，對應訊息CONNECT 。支援以下欄位： `clientid`, `username`和`password` 。該值可以包含文字、變數及其組合。

Several `mqtt_set_connect` directives can be specified on the same level:

可以在同一層級指定多個`mqtt_set_connect`指令：

> ```
> mqtt_set_connect clientid "$client";
> mqtt_set_connect username "$name";
>
> mqtt_set_connect 使用者名稱 "$name";
> ```

<a id="p-151"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_mqtt_preread_module｜模組 ngx_stream_mqtt_preread_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_mqtt_preread_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_mqtt\_preread\_module｜模組 ngx\_stream\_mqtt\_preread\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-151)<br>[Directives](#p-151)<br>     [mqtt\_preread](#p-151)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-151)<br>[範例設定](#p-151)<br> [指令](#p-151)<br> [mqtt\_preread](#p-151)<br> [嵌入式變數](#p-151) |

The `ngx_stream_mqtt_preread_module` module (1.23.4) allows extracting information from the CONNECT message of the Message Queuing Telemetry Transport protocol (MQTT) versions [3.1.1](https://docs.oasis-open.org/mqtt/mqtt/v3.1.1/mqtt-v3.1.1.html) and [5.0](https://docs.oasis-open.org/mqtt/mqtt/v5.0/mqtt-v5.0.html), for example, a username or a client ID.

`ngx_stream_mqtt_preread_module`模塊 ( 1.23.4 ) 允許從消息CONNECT遙測傳輸協議 ( MQTT ) 版本 [3.1.1](https://docs.oasis-open.org/mqtt/mqtt/v3.1.1/mqtt-v3.1.1.html)和 [5.0](https://docs.oasis-open.org/mqtt/mqtt/v5.0/mqtt-v5.0.html)訊息中提取訊息，例如使用者名稱或客戶端ID 。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> mqtt_preread on;
>
> mqtt_preread 已開啟；
> return       $mqtt_preread_clientid;
>
> 返回 $mqtt_preread_clientid；
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>mqtt_preread</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>mqtt_preread off;<br>mqtt_preread 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables extracting information from the MQTT CONNECT message at the [preread](#p-165) phase.

能夠在 [預讀](#p-165)階段從MQTT CONNECT訊息中擷取訊息。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

`$mqtt_preread_clientid`

the `clientid` value from the CONNECT message

來自CONNECT訊息的`clientid`值

`$mqtt_preread_username`

the `username` value from the CONNECT message

來自CONNECT訊息的`username`值

<a id="p-152"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_num_map_module｜模組 ngx_stream_num_map_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_num_map_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_num\_map\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_num_map_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-152)<br>[Directives](#p-152)<br>     [num\_map](#p-152)<br>[範例設定](#p-152)<br> [指令](#p-152)<br> [num\_map](#p-152) |

The `ngx_stream_num_map_module` module (1.29.3) creates variables whose values depend on numeric values or numeric value ranges.

`ngx_stream_num_map_module`模組 ( 1.29.3 ) 建立變量，其值取決於數值或數值範圍。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> num_map $remote_port $port_allow {
>     default    0;
>
>     預設值為 0；
> 
>     80         1;
>     443        1;
>     <=1023     0;
>     8080-8090  1;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**num_map** [`*$number*`] `*$variable*` { ... }``<br>` `**num_map** [` *$number* `] ` *$variable* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Describes how the values of the specified variable depend on numeric values or numeric value ranges.

描述指定變數的值如何取決於數值或數值範圍。

> Since variables are evaluated only when used, the mere existence of even a large number of declared “`num_map`” variables does not cause any extra costs for connection processing.
>
> 由於變數僅在使用時才進行評估，因此即使存在大量已聲明的「 `num_map` 」變數也不會給連接處理帶來任何額外的成本。

Parameters inside the `num_map` block specify a mapping between source and resulting values.

`num_map`區塊內的參數指定來源值和結果值之間的對應。

Source values are specified as numbers or as numeric ranges.

源值以數字或數值範圍的形式指定。

The following special parameters are also supported:

此外，也支援以下特殊參數：

`default`

sets the resulting value if the source value matches none of the specified variants. When `default` is not specified, the default resulting value will be an empty string.

如果來源值與任何指定的變體都不匹配，則設定結果值。如果未指定`default` ，則預設結果值為空字串。

`include`

includes a file with values. There can be several inclusions.

包含一個帶有值的檔案。可以包含多個文件。

`volatile`

indicates that the variable is not cacheable.

表示該變數不可緩存。

<a id="p-153"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_pass_module｜模組 ngx_stream_pass_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_pass_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_pass\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_pass_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-153)<br>[Directives](#p-153)<br>     [pass](#p-153)<br>[範例設定](#p-153)<br> [指令](#p-153)<br> [通行](#p-153) |

The `ngx_stream_pass_module` module (1.25.5) allows passing the accepted connection directly to any configured listening socket in `http`, `stream`, `mail`, and other similar modules.

`ngx_stream_pass_module`模組（ 1.25.5 ）允許將已接受的連接直接傳遞給`http`, `stream`, `mail`中任何已配置的監聽套接字，以及其他類似的模組。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> http {
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 8000;
>
>         聽 8000；
> 
>         location / {
>
>         地點 / {
>             root html;
>
>             根 html；
>         }
>     }
> }
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 12345 ssl;
>
>         監聽 12345 ssl;
> 
>         ssl_certificate     domain.crt;
>
>         ssl_certificate domain.crt;
>         ssl_certificate_key domain.key;
> 
>         pass 127.0.0.1:8000;
>
>         通過127.0.0.1:8000 ；
>     }
> }
> ```

In the example, after terminating SSL/TLS in the `stream` module the connection is passed to the `http` module.

在該範例中，在`stream`模組中終止SSL/TLS後，連接將傳遞給`http`模組。

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**pass** `*address*`;``<br>` `**pass** ` *地址* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Sets server address to pass client connection to. The address can be specified as an IP address and a port:

設定客戶端連線要轉送到的伺服器位址。該位址可以指定為IP位址和連接埠：

> ```
> pass 127.0.0.1:12345;
>
> 通過127.0.0.1:12345 ；
> ```

or as a UNIX-domain socket path:

或作為UNIX域套接字路徑：

> ```
> pass unix:/tmp/stream.socket;
>
> 傳遞 unix:/tmp/stream.socket；
> ```

The address can also be specified using variables:

也可以使用變數指定位址：

> ```
> pass $upstream;
>
> 傳遞上游；
> ```

<a id="p-154"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_proxy_module｜模組 ngx_stream_proxy_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_proxy_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_proxy\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_proxy_module

|   |

The `ngx_stream_proxy_module` module (1.9.0) allows proxying data streams over TCP, UDP (1.9.13), and UNIX-domain sockets.

`ngx_stream_proxy_module`模組 ( 1.9.0 ) 允許透過TCP, UDP ( 1.9.13 ) 和UNIX域套接字代理資料流。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 127.0.0.1:12345;
>
>     聽127.0.0.1:12345 ;
>     proxy_pass 127.0.0.1:8080;
>
>     proxy_pass 127.0.0.1:8080 ;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 12345;
>
>     聽 12345；
>     proxy_connect_timeout 1s;
>     proxy_timeout 1m;
>     proxy_pass example.com:12345;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 53 udp reuseport;
>
>     監聽 53 UDP 重複使用連接埠；
>     proxy_timeout 20s;
>     proxy_pass dns.example.com:53;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen [::1]:12345;
>
>     監聽 [::1]:12345;
>     proxy_pass unix:/tmp/stream.socket;
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_bind** `*address*` [`transparent`] \| `off`;``<br>` `**proxy_bind** ` *地址* ` [`透明`] \| `關閉`;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.9.2.

該指令出現在版本1.9.2 。

Makes outgoing connections to a proxied server originate from the specified local IP `*address*`. Parameter value can contain variables (1.11.2). The special value `off` cancels the effect of the `proxy_bind` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows the system to auto-assign the local IP address.

使發送至代理伺服器的出站連線源自指定的本機位址IP `*address*` 。參數值可以包含變數 ( 1.11.2 )。特殊值`off`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`proxy_bind`指令的效果，從而允許系統自動分配本地位址IP 。

The `transparent` parameter (1.11.0) allows outgoing connections to a proxied server originate from a non-local IP address, for example, from a real IP address of a client:

`transparent`參數 ( 1.11.0 ) 允許到代理伺服器的出站連線源自非本地IP位址，例如，源自客戶端的真實IP位址：

> ```
> proxy_bind $remote_addr transparent;
> ```

In order for this parameter to work, it is usually necessary to run nginx worker processes with the [superuser](#p-125) privileges. On Linux it is not required (1.13.8) as if the `transparent` parameter is specified, worker processes inherit the `CAP_NET_RAW` capability from the master process. It is also necessary to configure kernel routing table to intercept network traffic from the proxied server.

為了使此參數生效，通常需要以 [superuser](#p-125)權限執行 nginx 工作進程。在 Linux 系統上則無需此權限 ( 1.13.8 )，因為如果指定了`transparent`參數，工作進程會從主進程繼承`CAP_NET_RAW`權限。此外，還需要配置核心路由表以攔截來自代理伺服器的網路流量。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_bind_dynamic</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_bind_dynamic off;<br>proxy_bind_dynamic 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.3.

該指令出現在版本1.29.3 。

When enabled, makes the [bind](#p-154) operation at each connection attempt.

啟用後，每次連線嘗試時執行 [bind](#p-154)操作。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_buffer_size 16k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.9.4.

該指令出現在版本1.9.4 。

Sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading data from the proxied server. Also sets the `*size*` of the buffer used for reading data from the client.

設定用於從代理伺服器讀取資料的緩衝區的`*size*` 。同時設定用於從客戶端讀取資料的緩衝區的`*size*` 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_connect_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_connect_timeout 60s;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for establishing a connection with a proxied server.

定義與代理伺服器建立連線的逾時時間。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_download_rate</strong> <code><i>rate</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_download_rate 0;<br>proxy_download_rate 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.9.3.

該指令出現在版本1.9.3 。

Limits the speed of reading the data from the proxied server. The `*rate*` is specified in bytes per second. The zero value disables rate limiting. The limit is set per a connection, so if nginx simultaneously opens two connections to the proxied server, the overall rate will be twice as much as the specified limit.

限制從代理伺服器讀取資料的速度。 `*rate*` 以每秒位元組數指定。零值禁用速率限制。此限制是針對每個連接設定的，因此如果 nginx 同時開啟兩個到代理伺服器的連接，則總體速率將是指定限制的兩倍。

Parameter value can contain variables (1.17.0). It may be useful in cases where rate should be limited depending on a certain condition:

參數值可以包含變數（ 1.17.0 ）。在需要根據特定條件限制速率的情況下，這可能很有用：

> ```
> map $slow $rate {
>
> 映射 $slow $rate {
>     1     4k;
>     2     8k;
> }
> 
> proxy_download_rate $rate;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_half_close</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_half_close off;<br>proxy_half_close 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.21.4.

該指令出現在版本1.21.4中。

Enables or disables closing each direction of a TCP connection independently (“TCP half-close”). If enabled, proxying over TCP will be kept until both sides close the connection.

啟用或停用獨立關閉TCP連接的每個方向（「 TCP半關閉」）。如果啟用，則透過TCP的代理將保持連接，直到連接雙方都關閉為止。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_next_upstream</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_next_upstream on;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

When a connection to the proxied server cannot be established, determines whether a client connection will be passed to the next server.

當無法建立與代理伺服器的連線時，確定是否將客戶端連線傳遞給下一個伺服器。

Passing a connection to the next server can be limited by [the number of tries](#p-154) and by [time](#p-154).

向下一個伺服器傳遞連線可能會受到 [嘗試次數](#p-154)和 [時間](#p-154)的限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_next_upstream_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_next_upstream_timeout 0;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Limits the time allowed to pass a connection to the [next server](#p-154). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

限制允許將連線傳遞到[下一個伺服器](#p-154)。 `0` 值關閉此限制。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_next_upstream_tries</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_next_upstream_tries 0;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Limits the number of possible tries for passing a connection to the [next server](#p-154). The `0` value turns off this limitation.

`0`嘗試連線到[下一個伺服器的次數](#p-154)值關閉此限制。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_pass** `*address*`;``<br>` `**proxy_pass** ` *地址* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Sets the address of a proxied server. The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, and a port:

設定代理伺服器的位址。位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，以及連接埠：

> ```
> proxy_pass localhost:12345;
> ```

or as a UNIX-domain socket path:

或作為UNIX域套接字路徑：

> ```
> proxy_pass unix:/tmp/stream.socket;
> ```

If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be used in a round-robin fashion. In addition, an address can be specified as a [server group](#p-163).

如果一個網域解析到多個位址，則所有這些位址將以輪詢方式使用。此外，可以將位址指定為 [伺服器群組](#p-163) 。

The address can also be specified using variables (1.11.3):

也可以使用變數指定位址（ 1.11.3 ）：

> ```
> proxy_pass $upstream;
> ```

In this case, the server name is searched among the described [server groups](#p-163), and, if not found, is determined using a [resolver](#p-142).

在這種情況下，會在所描述的 [伺服器群組](#p-163)中搜尋伺服器名稱，如果找不到，則使用 [解析器](#p-142)進行確定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_protocol<br>代理協議</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code> | <code>v2</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_protocol off;<br>代理協定關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.9.2.

該指令出現在版本1.9.2 。

Enables the [PROXY protocol](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) for connections to a proxied server. The `on` parameter enables version 1 of the PROXY protocol (text format). The `v2` parameter (1.31.4) enables version 2 of the PROXY protocol (binary format).

啟用 [PROXY 協定](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) 以連接到代理伺服器。 `on` 參數啟用PROXY 協定的版本 1（文字格式）。 `v2` 參數 (1.31.4) 啟用PROXY 協定的版本 2（二進位格式）。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_requests</strong> <code><i>number</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_requests 0;<br>proxy_requests 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.7.

該指令出現在版本1.15.7 。

Sets the number of client datagrams at which binding between a client and existing UDP stream session is dropped. After receiving the specified number of datagrams, next datagram from the same client starts a new session. The session terminates when all client datagrams are transmitted to a proxied server and the expected number of [responses](#p-154) is received, or when it reaches a [timeout](#p-154).

設定客戶端資料封包的數量，超過該數量後，客戶端與現有UDP流會話之間的綁定將被斷開。收到指定數量的資料封包後，來自同一客戶端的下一個資料封包將啟動一個新的會話。當所有客戶端資料封包都已傳送至代理伺服器並收到預期數量的[回應](#p-154) ，或達到[逾時](#p-154)時，會話終止。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_responses** `*number*`;``<br>` `**proxy_responses** ` *數字* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.9.13.

該指令出現在版本1.9.13 。

Sets the number of datagrams expected from the proxied server in response to a client datagram if the [UDP](#p-142) protocol is used. The number serves as a hint for session termination. By default, the number of datagrams is not limited.

設定使用 [UDP](#p-142)協定時，代理伺服器回應客戶端資料封包所期望傳回的資料封包數量。此數量用作會話終止的提示。預設情況下，資料報數量沒有限制。

If zero value is specified, no response is expected. However, if a response is received and the session is still not finished, the response will be handled.

如果指定值為零，則不期望收到任何回應。但是，如果收到回應且會話尚未結束，則會處理該回應。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_session_drop</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_session_drop off;<br>proxy_session_drop off；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.8.

該指令出現在版本1.15.8中。

Enables terminating all sessions to a proxied server after it was removed from the group or marked as permanently unavailable. This can occur because of [re-resolve](#p-142) or with the API [`DELETE`](#p-048) command. A server can be marked as permanently unavailable if it is considered [unhealthy](#p-162) or with the API [`PATCH`](#p-048) command. Each session is terminated when the next read or write event is processed for the client or proxied server.

此功能允許在代理伺服器從群組中移除或被標記為永久不可用後，終止與其的所有會話。這可能是由於 [re-resolve](#p-142)或使用API [`DELETE`](#p-048)指令導致的。如果伺服器被認為 [unhealthy](#p-162)或使用API [`PATCH`](#p-048)命令，則該伺服器可能被標記為永久不可用。當客戶端或代理伺服器的下一個讀取或寫入事件被處理時，每個會話都會終止。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_socket_keepalive</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_socket_keepalive off;<br>proxy_socket_keepalive 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.6.

該指令出現在版本1.15.6 。

Configures the “TCP keepalive” behavior for outgoing connections to a proxied server. By default, the operating system’s settings are in effect for the socket. If the directive is set to the value “`on`”, the `SO_KEEPALIVE` socket option is turned on for the socket.

設定與代理伺服器建立的出站連線的「 TCP keepalive」行為。預設情況下，作業系統的設定對套接字生效。如果指令值設定為“ `on` ”，則會為套接字啟用`SO_KEEPALIVE`選項。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_socket_rcvbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**proxy_socket_rcvbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the receive buffer size (the `SO_RCVBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a proxied server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `proxy_socket_rcvbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定與代理伺服器建立出站連線的接收緩衝區大小（ `SO_RCVBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一配置等級繼承的`proxy_socket_rcvbuf`指令的效果，從而允許作業系統對套接字的設定生效。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_socket_sndbuf** `*size*`;``<br>` `**proxy_socket_sndbuf** ` *大小* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.3.

該指令出現在版本1.31.3 。

Sets the send buffer size (the `SO_SNDBUF` option) for outgoing connections to a proxied server. The special value `0` cancels the effect of the `proxy_socket_sndbuf` directive inherited from the previous configuration level, which allows keeping the operating system’s settings in effect for the socket.

設定向代理伺服器發出的連線發送緩衝區大小（ `SO_SNDBUF`選項）。特殊值`0`會取消從上一個配置等級繼承的`proxy_socket_sndbuf`指令的效果，從而允許保持作業系統對套接字的設定有效。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl off;<br>proxy_ssl 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables the SSL/TLS protocol for connections to a proxied server.

啟用SSL/TLS協定以連接到代理伺服器。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_ssl_alpn** `*protocol*` ...;``<br>` `**proxy_ssl_alpn** ` *協定* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.31.0.

該指令出現在版本1.31.0 。

Specifies the list of protocols to advertise via the [ALPN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7301) extension when establishing a connection with the proxied server. For example:

指定與代理伺服器建立連線時，要透過 [ALPN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7301)擴充通告的協定清單。例如：

> ```
> proxy_ssl_alpn h2 http/1.1;
>
> proxy_ssl_alpn h2 http/ 1.1 ;
> ```

Parameter value can contain variables:

參數值可以包含變數：

> ```
> proxy_ssl_alpn $ssl_alpn_protocol;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_ssl_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**proxy_ssl_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with the certificate in the PEM format used for authentication to a proxied server.

指定一個`*file*` ，其憑證採用PEM格式，用於向代理伺服器進行驗證。

Since version 1.21.0, variables can be used in the `*file*` name.

自版本1.21.0起，變數可以在`*file*`名稱中使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>off</code>;</code><br><code><strong>proxy_ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>max</code>=<code><i>N</i></code> [<code>inactive</code>=<code><i>time</i></code>] [<code>valid</code>=<code><i>time</i></code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> proxy_ssl_certificate_cache </strong> <code> off </code>;</code><br><code><strong> proxy_ssl_certificate_cache </strong> <code> <code><i> </code> </i></code> [ <code> inactive </code> = <code><i> time </i></code> ] [ <code> valid </code> ] [ <code><i> </i></code> ]; </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_certificate_cache off;<br>proxy_ssl_certificate_cache 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.4.

該指令出現在版本1.27.4 。

Defines a cache that stores [SSL certificates](#p-154) and [secret keys](#p-154) specified with [variables](#p-154).

定義一個緩存，用於儲存 [SSL憑證](#p-154)和 [金鑰](#p-154)金鑰由 [變數](#p-154)指定。

The directive has the following parameters:

此指令具有以下參數：

`max`

sets the maximum number of elements in the cache; on cache overflow the least recently used (LRU) elements are removed;

設定快取中元素的最大數量；當快取溢出時，刪除最近最少使用的（ LRU ）元素；

`inactive`

defines a time after which an element is removed from the cache if it has not been accessed during this time; by default, it is 10 seconds;

定義一個時間段，如果該元素在這段時間內未被訪問，則將其從快取中刪除；預設值為 10 秒；

`valid`

defines a time during which an element in the cache is considered valid and can be reused; by default, it is 60 seconds. Certificates that exceed this time will be reloaded or revalidated;

定義快取中元素被視為有效且可重複使用的時間；預設值為 60 秒。超過此時間的證書將被重新載入或重新驗證；

`off`

disables the cache.

禁用緩存。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> proxy_ssl_certificate       $proxy_ssl_server_name.crt;
>
> proxy_ssl_certificate $proxy_ssl_server_name.crt;
> proxy_ssl_certificate_key   $proxy_ssl_server_name.key;
>
> proxy_ssl_certificate_key $proxy_ssl_server_name.key;
> proxy_ssl_certificate_cache max=1000 inactive=20s valid=1m;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_ssl_certificate_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**proxy_ssl_certificate_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

The value `store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.29.0), which is used to load a secret key with a specified `*id*` and OpenSSL provider registered URI `*scheme*`, such as [`pkcs11`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512).

可指定值`store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.29.0 )，該值用於載入具有指定`*id*`和已註冊的 OpenSSL 提供者URI `*scheme*`的金鑰，例如 [ `pkcs11` (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512) 。

Specifies a `*file*` with the secret key in the PEM format used for authentication to a proxied server.

指定一個`*file*` ，其中包含用於向代理伺服器進行身份驗證的PEM格式的金鑰。

Since version 1.21.0, variables can be used in the `*file*` name.

自版本1.21.0起，變數可以在`*file*`名稱中使用。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl_ciphers</strong> <code><i>ciphers</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_ciphers DEFAULT;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies the enabled ciphers for connections to a proxied server. The ciphers are specified in the format understood by the OpenSSL library.

指定與代理伺服器連線時啟用的加密套件。加密套件以 OpenSSL 庫可識別的格式指定。

The full list can be viewed using the “`openssl ciphers`” command.

可以使用「 `openssl ciphers` 」指令查看完整清單。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**proxy_ssl_conf_command** `*name*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**proxy_ssl_conf_command** ` *名稱* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.19.4.

該指令出現在版本1.19.4 。

Sets arbitrary OpenSSL configuration [commands](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) when establishing a connection with the proxied server.

與代理伺服器建立連線時，設定任意 OpenSSL 設定 [指令](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) 。

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，支援該指令。

Several `proxy_ssl_conf_command` directives can be specified on the same level. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `proxy_ssl_conf_command` directives defined on the current level.

同一層級可以指定多個`proxy_ssl_conf_command`指令。當且僅噹噹前等級未定義`proxy_ssl_conf_command`指令時，這些指令才會從上一個設定等級繼承。

> Note that configuring OpenSSL directly might result in unexpected behavior.
>
> 請注意，直接配置 OpenSSL 可能會導致意外行為。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_ssl_crl** `*file*`;``<br>` `**proxy_ssl_crl** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with revoked certificates (CRL) in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-154) the certificate of the proxied server. When using intermediate certificates, their CRLs should be specified in the same file.

指定一個包含已吊銷憑證（ CRL ）的`*file*`其格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-154)代理伺服器的憑證。使用中間憑證時，應在同一文件中指定其憑證撤銷清單 (CRL)。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**proxy_ssl_key_log** path;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Enables logging of proxied server connection SSL keys and specifies the path to the key log file. Keys are logged in the [SSLKEYLOGFILE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850) format compatible with Wireshark.

啟用代理伺服器連線SSL金鑰的日誌記錄，並指定金鑰日誌檔案的路徑。密鑰以與Wireshark相容的[SSLKEYLOGFILE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850)格式記錄。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl_name</strong> <code><i>name</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_name host from proxy_pass;<br>proxy_ssl_name host 來自 proxy_pass;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Allows overriding the server name used to [verify](#p-154) the certificate of the proxied server and to be [passed through SNI](#p-154) when establishing a connection with the proxied server. The server name can also be specified using variables (1.11.3).

允許覆蓋用於驗證(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_proxy_module.html#proxy_ssl_verify)伺服器憑證的伺服器名稱，並在與代理伺服器建立連線時將其(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_proxy_module.html#proxy_ssl_server_name)給SNI伺服器。也可以使用變數指定伺服器名稱（ 1.11.3 ）。

By default, the host part of the [proxy\_pass](#p-154) address is used.

預設情況下，使用 [proxy\_pass](#p-154)位址的主機部分。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_ssl_password_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**proxy_ssl_password_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with passphrases for [secret keys](#p-154) where each passphrase is specified on a separate line. Passphrases are tried in turn when loading the key.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含 [金鑰](#p-154)的密碼短語，每個密碼短語單獨一行指定。載入金鑰時，將依序嘗試這些密碼短語。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl_protocols</strong> [<code>SSLv2</code>] [<code>SSLv3</code>] [<code>TLSv1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.2</code>] [<code>TLSv1.3</code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> proxy_ssl_protocols </strong> [ <code> SSLv2 </code> <code> [ </code> <code> TLSv1 </code> ] [ <code> TLSv1.1 </code> ] [ <code> </code> </code> ] [ <code> . </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables the specified protocols for connections to a proxied server.

啟用與代理伺服器連線的指定協定。

> The `TLSv1.3` parameter is used by default since 1.23.4.
>
> `TLSv1.3`參數預設使用1.23.4 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl_server_name</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_server_name off;<br>proxy_ssl_server_name 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables passing of the server name through [TLS Server Name Indication extension](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) (SNI, RFC 6066) when establishing a connection with the proxied server.

啟用或停用在與代理伺服器建立連線時透過 [TLS伺服器名稱指示擴充](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) ( SNI, RFC 6066) 傳遞伺服器名稱。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl_session_reuse</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_session_reuse on;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Determines whether SSL sessions can be reused when working with the proxied server. If the errors “`digest check failed`” appear in the logs, try disabling session reuse.

確定在使用代理伺服器時是否可以重複使用SSL會話。如果日誌中出現錯誤“ `digest check failed` ”，請嘗試停用會話​​重複使用。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-154) the certificate of the proxied server.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-154)代理伺服器的證書。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl_verify</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_verify off;<br>proxy_ssl_verify 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables verification of the proxied server certificate.

啟用或停用代理伺服器憑證的驗證。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_ssl_verify_depth</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_ssl_verify_depth 1;<br>proxy_ssl_verify_depth 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the verification depth in the proxied server certificates chain.

設定代理伺服器憑證鏈的驗證深度。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_timeout</strong> <code><i>timeout</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_timeout 10m;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*timeout*` between two successive read or write operations on client or proxied server connections. If no data is transmitted within this time, the connection is closed.

設定客戶端或代理伺服器連線上兩次連續讀取或寫入操作之間的`*timeout*`值。如果在該時間內沒有資料傳輸，則連線關閉。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>proxy_upload_rate</strong> <code><i>rate</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>proxy_upload_rate 0;<br>proxy_upload_rate 0；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.9.3.

該指令出現在版本1.9.3 。

Limits the speed of reading the data from the client. The `*rate*` is specified in bytes per second. The zero value disables rate limiting. The limit is set per a connection, so if the client simultaneously opens two connections, the overall rate will be twice as much as the specified limit.

限制從客戶端讀取資料的速度。 `*rate*` 以每秒位元組數指定。零值禁用速率限制。此限制是針對每個連接設定的，因此如果客戶端同時開啟兩個連接，則總體速率將是指定限制的兩倍。

Parameter value can contain variables (1.17.0). It may be useful in cases where rate should be limited depending on a certain condition:

參數值可以包含變數（ 1.17.0 ）。在需要根據特定條件限制速率的情況下，這可能很有用：

> ```
> map $slow $rate {
>
> 映射 $slow $rate {
>     1     4k;
>     2     8k;
> }
> 
> proxy_upload_rate $rate;
> ```

<a id="p-155"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_proxy_protocol_vendor_module｜模組 ngx_stream_proxy_protocol_vendor_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_proxy_protocol_vendor_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_proxy\_protocol\_vendor\_module｜模組 ngx\_stream\_proxy\_protocol\_vendor\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-155)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-155)<br>[範例配置](#p-155)<br> [嵌入式變數](#p-155) |

The `ngx_stream_proxy_protocol_vendor_module` module (1.23.3) allows obtaining additional information about a connection in cloud platforms from application-specific TLVs of the [PROXY protocol](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) header.

`ngx_stream_proxy_protocol_vendor_module`模組 ( 1.23.3 ) 允許從 [PROXY協定](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt)標頭的應用程式特定 TLV 取得有關雲端平台連接的其他資訊。

Supported cloud platforms:

支援的雲端平台：

-   Amazon Web Services  
    亞馬遜網路服務
-   Google Cloud Platform
-   Microsoft Azure

The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the `proxy_protocol` parameter in the [listen](#p-142) directive.

必須先在 [listen](#p-142)指令中設定`proxy_protocol`參數來啟用PROXY協定。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 12345 proxy_protocol;
>
>     監聽 12345 代理協議；
>     return $proxy_protocol_tlv_gcp_conn_id;
>
>     返回 $proxy_protocol_tlv_gcp_conn_id;
> }
> ```

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

`$proxy_protocol_tlv_aws_vpce_id`

TLV value from the PROXY Protocol header representing the [ID of AWS VPC endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html#proxy-protocol)

TLV來自PROXY協議頭的值，表示 [ID的AWS VPC端點](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html#proxy-protocol)

`$proxy_protocol_tlv_azure_pel_id`

TLV value from the PROXY Protocol header representing the [LinkID of Azure private endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/private-link/private-link-service-overview#getting-connection-information-using-tcp-proxy-v2)

TLV值來自PROXY協定標頭，表示 [Azure 專用終端點的 LinkID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/private-link/private-link-service-overview#getting-connection-information-using-tcp-proxy-v2)

`$proxy_protocol_tlv_gcp_conn_id`

TLV value from the PROXY Protocol header representing [Google Cloud PSC connection ID](https://cloud.google.com/vpc/docs/configure-private-service-connect-producer#proxy-protocol)

來自TLV協定頭的值PROXY表示 [Google Cloud PSC連接ID](https://cloud.google.com/vpc/docs/configure-private-service-connect-producer#proxy-protocol)

<a id="p-156"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_realip_module｜模組 ngx_stream_realip_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_realip_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_realip\_module｜模組 ngx\_stream\_realip\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-156)<br>[Directives](#p-156)<br>     [set\_real\_ip\_from](#p-156)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-156)<br>[範例設定](#p-156)<br> [指令](#p-156)<br> [set\_real\_ip\_from](#p-156)<br> [嵌入式變數](#p-156) |

The `ngx_stream_realip_module` module is used to change the client address and port to the ones sent in the PROXY protocol header (1.11.4). The PROXY protocol must be previously enabled by setting the [proxy\_protocol](#p-142) parameter in the `listen` directive.

`ngx_stream_realip_module`模組用於將客戶端位址和連接埠變更為PROXY協定頭（ 1.11.4 ）中傳送的位址和連接埠PROXY協定必須事先啟用，方法是在`listen`指令中設定 [proxy\_protocol](#p-142)參數。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-stream_realip_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-stream_realip_module`配置參數啟用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> listen 12345 proxy_protocol;
>
> 監聽 12345 代理協議；
> 
> set_real_ip_from  192.168.1.0/24;
>
> set_real_ip_from 192.168.1.0/24 ;
> set_real_ip_from  192.168.2.1;
>
> set_real_ip_from 192.168.2.1 ;
> set_real_ip_from  2001:0db8::/32;
>
> set_real_ip_from 2001:0db8::/32 ;
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**set_real_ip_from** `*address*` \| `*CIDR*` \| `unix:`;``<br>` `**set_real_ip_from** ` *地址* ` \| ` * CIDR * ` \| ` unix: `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Defines trusted addresses that are known to send correct replacement addresses. If the special value `unix:` is specified, all UNIX-domain sockets will be trusted.

定義已知會傳送正確替換位址的受信任位址。如果指定特殊值`unix:` ，則所有UNIX域套接字都會被信任。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

`$realip_remote_addr`

keeps the original client address

保留原始客戶端位址

`$realip_remote_port`

keeps the original client port

保留原始客戶端端口

##### Module ngx_stream_return_module｜模組 ngx_stream_return_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_return\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_return_module

| [Example Configuration](#p-157)<br>[Directives](#p-157)<br>     [return](#p-157)<br>[範例設定](#p-157)<br> [指令](#p-157)<br> [返回](#p-157) |

The `ngx_stream_return_module` module (1.11.2) allows sending a specified value to the client and then closing the connection.

`ngx_stream_return_module`模組（ 1.11.2 ）允許向客戶端發送指定的值，然後關閉連接。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 12345;
>
>     聽 12345；
>     return $time_iso8601;
>
>     返回 $time_iso8601；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**return** `*value*`;``<br>` `**return** ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Specifies a `*value*` to send to the client. The value can contain text, variables, and their combination.

指定要傳送給客戶端的`*value*` 。該值可以包含文字、變數及其組合。

The `ngx_stream_set_module` module (1.19.3) allows setting a value for a variable.

`ngx_stream_set_module`模組（ 1.19.3 ）允許設定變數的值。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 12345;
>
>     聽 12345；
>     set    $true 1;
>
>     設定 $true 為 1；
> }
> ```

| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**set** `*$variable*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**set** ` *$變數* ` ` *值* `;` ` |

| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Sets a `*value*` for the specified `*variable*`. The `*value*` can contain text, variables, and their combination.

為指定的`*variable*`設定`*value*`可以包含文字、 `*value*`及其組合。

<a id="p-159"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_split_clients_module｜模組 ngx_stream_split_clients_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_split_clients_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_split\_clients\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_split_clients_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-159)<br>[Directives](#p-159)<br>     [split\_clients](#p-159)<br>[範例設定](#p-159)<br> [指令](#p-159)<br> [split\_clients](#p-159) |

The `ngx_stream_split_clients_module` module (1.11.3) creates variables suitable for A/B testing, also known as split testing.

`ngx_stream_split_clients_module`模組 ( 1.11.3 ) 建立適用於 A/B 測試（也稱為拆分測試）的變數。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     ...
>     split_clients "${remote_addr}AAA" $upstream {
>
>     split_clients "${remote_addr} AAA " $upstream {
>                   0.5%                feature_test1;
>
>                   0.5 % feature_test1;
>                   2.0%                feature_test2;
>
>                   2.0 % feature_test2;
>                   *                   production;  
                                        生產;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         ...
>         proxy_pass $upstream;
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**split_clients** `*string*` `*$variable*` { ... }``<br>` `**split_clients** ` *字串* ` ` *$變數* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Creates a variable for A/B testing, for example:

建立一個用於 A/B 測試的變量，例如：

> ```
> split_clients "${remote_addr}AAA" $variant {
>
> split_clients "${remote_addr} AAA " $variant {
>                0.5%               .one;
>
>                0.5 % .one;
>                2.0%               .two;
>
>                2.0 %.two;
>                *                  "";
> }
> ```

The value of the original string is hashed using MurmurHash2. In the example given, hash values from 0 to 21474835 (0.5%) correspond to the value `".one"` of the `$variant` variable, hash values from 21474836 to 107374180 (2%) correspond to the value `".two"`, and hash values from 107374181 to 4294967295 correspond to the value `""` (an empty string).

使用 MurmurHash2 對原始字串的值進行哈希處理。在給定的範例中，雜湊值從 0 到 21474835 ( 0.5 %) 對應於變數`$variant`的值`".one"` ，雜湊值從 21474836 到 107374180 (2%) 對應於`".two"`到 4294967295 對應於值`""` （空字串）。

| [Example Configuration](#p-160)<br>[Directives](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_alpn](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_certificate](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_certificate\_cache](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_certificate\_compression](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_certificate\_key](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ciphers](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_client\_certificate](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_conf\_command](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_crl](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_dhparam](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ecdh\_curve](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ech\_file](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_handshake\_timeout](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_key\_log](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ocsp](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ocsp\_cache](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ocsp\_responder](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_password\_file](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_prefer\_server\_ciphers](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_protocols](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_reject\_handshake](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_session\_cache](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_session\_ticket\_key](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_session\_tickets](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_session\_timeout](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_stapling](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_stapling\_file](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_stapling\_responder](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_stapling\_verify](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_verify\_client](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_verify\_depth](#p-160)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-160)<br>[範例配置](#p-160)<br>[指示](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_alpn](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_certificate](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_certificate_cache](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_certificate_compression](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_certificate_key](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_ciphers](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_client_certificate](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_conf_command](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_crl](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_dhparam](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ecdh\_curve](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ech\_file](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_handshake_timeout](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_key_log](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ocsp](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ocsp\_cache](#p-160)<br>     [ssl\_ocsp\_responder](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_password_file](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_prefer_server_ciphers](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_protocols](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_reject_handshake](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_session_cache](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_session_ticket_key](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_session_tickets](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_session_timeout](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_stapling](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_stapling_file](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_stapling_responder](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_stapling_verify](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_trusted_certificate](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_verify_client](#p-160)<br>     [ssl_verify_depth](#p-160)<br>[嵌入式變數](#p-160) |

The `ngx_stream_ssl_module` module (1.9.0) provides the necessary support for a stream proxy server to work with the SSL/TLS protocol.

`ngx_stream_ssl_module`模組 ( 1.9.0 ) 為流代理伺服器與SSL/TLS協定配合使用提供了必要的支援。

This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-stream_ssl_module` configuration parameter.

此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-stream_ssl_module`配置參數啟用。

> This module requires the [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/) library.
>
> 本模組需要 [OpenSSL](http://www.openssl.org/)函式庫。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

To reduce the processor load, it is recommended to

為了降低處理器負載，建議…

-   set the number of [worker processes](#p-125) equal to the number of processors,  
    將[工作進程](#p-125)的數量設定為等於處理器數量，
-   enable the [shared](#p-160) session cache,  
    啟用[共享](#p-160)會話緩存，
-   disable the [built-in](#p-160) session cache,  
    停用[內建](#p-160)會話緩存，
-   and possibly increase the session [lifetime](#p-160) (by default, 5 minutes):  
    並可能增加會話[生命週期](#p-160) （預設值為 5 分鐘）：

> ```
> worker_processes auto;
>
> worker_processes 自動；
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
> 
>     ...
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen              12345 ssl;
>
>         監聽 12345 ssl;
> 
>         ssl_protocols       TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>
>         ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
>         ssl_ciphers         AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:RC4-SHA:DES-CBC3-SHA:RC4-MD5;
>
>         ssl_ciphers AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:RC4-SHA:DES-CBC3-SHA:RC4-MD5 ;
>         ssl_certificate     /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.pem;
>
>         ssl_certificate /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.pem;
>         ssl_certificate_key /usr/local/nginx/conf/cert.key;
>         ssl_session_cache   shared:SSL:10m;
>
>         ssl_session_cache 共享: SSL :10m;
>         ssl_session_timeout 10m;
> 
>         ...
>     }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**ssl_alpn** `*protocol*` ...;``<br>` `**ssl_alpn** ` *協定* ` ...;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.21.4.

該指令出現在版本1.21.4 。

Specifies the list of supported [ALPN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7301) protocols. One of the protocols must be [negotiated](#p-160) if the client uses ALPN:

指定支援的協定清單 [ALPN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7301) 。如果客戶端使用ALPN ，則其中一個協定必須是 [協商的](#p-160) ：

> ```
> map $ssl_alpn_protocol $proxy {
>
> 映射 $ssl_alpn_protocol $proxy {
>     h2                127.0.0.1:8001;
>     http/1.1          127.0.0.1:8002;
>
>     http/ 1.1          127.0.0.1:8002 ;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      12346;
>
>     聽 12346；
>     proxy_pass  $proxy;
>
>     proxy_pass $proxy;
>     ssl_alpn    h2 http/1.1;
>
>     ssl_alpn h2 http/ 1.1 ;
> }
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with the certificate in the PEM format for the given virtual server. If intermediate certificates should be specified in addition to a primary certificate, they should be specified in the same file in the following order: the primary certificate comes first, then the intermediate certificates. A secret key in the PEM format may be placed in the same file.

為給定的虛擬伺服器指定一個`*file*`其中包含格式為PEM憑證。如果除了主證書之外還需要指定中間證書，則應將它們按以下順序放在同一個文件中：先是主證書，然後是中間證書。格式為PEM金鑰也可以放在同一個檔案中。

Since version 1.11.0, this directive can be specified multiple times to load certificates of different types, for example, RSA and ECDSA:

自版本1.11.0起，可以多次指定此指令以載入不同類型的證書，例如RSA和ECDSA ：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen              12345 ssl;
>
>     監聽 12345 ssl;
> 
>     ssl_certificate     example.com.rsa.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate example.com.rsa.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key example.com.rsa.key;
> 
>     ssl_certificate     example.com.ecdsa.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate example.com.ecdsa.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key example.com.ecdsa.key;
> 
>     ...
> }
> ```

> Only OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher supports separate [certificate chains](#p-042) for different certificates. With older versions, only one certificate chain can be used.
>
> 只有 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本才支援為不同的憑證使用獨立的憑證鏈(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html#chains) 。舊版只能使用一條憑證鏈。

Since version 1.15.9, variables can be used in the `*file*` name when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher:

自版本1.15.9起，在使用1.0.2或更高版本時，可以在`*file*`名稱中使用變數：

> ```
> ssl_certificate     $ssl_server_name.crt;
>
> ssl_certificate $ssl_server_name.crt;
> ssl_certificate_key $ssl_server_name.key;
> ```

Note that using variables implies that a certificate will be loaded for each SSL handshake, and this may have a negative impact on performance.

請注意，使用變數意味著每次SSL握手都會載入一個證書，這可能會對效能產生負面影響。

The value `data`:`*$variable*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.15.10), which loads a certificate from a variable without using intermediate files. Note that inappropriate use of this syntax may have its security implications, such as writing secret key data to [error log](#p-125).

可以使用值`data`:`*$variable*`代替`*file*` ( 1.15.10 )，這樣就可以從變數載入憑證而無需使用中間檔案。請注意，不當使用此語法可能會帶來安全隱患，例如將金鑰資料寫入 [錯誤日誌](#p-125) 。

It should be kept in mind that due to the SSL/TLS protocol limitations, for maximum interoperability with clients that do not use [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication), virtual servers with different certificates should listen on [different IP addresses](#p-042).

需要注意的是，由於SSL/TLS協定的限制，為了與不使用 [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication)的客戶端實現最大程度的互通性，具有不同憑證的虛擬伺服器應該監聽 [不同的IP (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/configuring_https_servers.html#name_based_https_servers) 。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>off</code>;</code><br><code><strong>ssl_certificate_cache</strong> <code>max</code>=<code><i>N</i></code> [<code>inactive</code>=<code><i>time</i></code>] [<code>valid</code>=<code><i>time</i></code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th> </code> ： </th><td><code><strong> <code><i> </strong> <code>關閉</code>;</code><br><code><strong> ssl_certificate_cache </strong> <code> </i></code> [ <code>無效</code> = <code><i>時間</i></code> ] [ <code>有效</code> = <code><i>時間</i></code> </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_certificate_cache off;<br>關閉 SSL 憑證快取；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.4.

該指令出現在版本1.27.4 。

Defines a cache that stores [SSL certificates](#p-160) and [secret keys](#p-160) specified with [variables](#p-160).

定義一個緩存，用於儲存 [SSL憑證](#p-160)和 [金鑰](#p-160)金鑰由 [變數](#p-160)指定。

The directive has the following parameters:

此指令具有以下參數：

`max`

sets the maximum number of elements in the cache; on cache overflow the least recently used (LRU) elements are removed;

設定快取中元素的最大數量；當快取溢出時，刪除最近最少使用的（ LRU ）元素；

`inactive`

defines a time after which an element is removed from the cache if it has not been accessed during this time; by default, it is 10 seconds;

定義一個時間段，如果該元素在這段時間內未被訪問，則將其從快取中刪除；預設值為 10 秒；

`valid`

defines a time during which an element in the cache is considered valid and can be reused; by default, it is 60 seconds. Certificates that exceed this time will be reloaded or revalidated;

定義快取中元素被視為有效且可重複使用的時間；預設值為 60 秒。超過此時間的證書將被重新載入或重新驗證；

`off`

disables the cache.

禁用緩存。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> ssl_certificate       $ssl_server_name.crt;
>
> ssl_certificate $ssl_server_name.crt;
> ssl_certificate_key   $ssl_server_name.key;
>
> ssl_certificate_key $ssl_server_name.key;
> ssl_certificate_cache max=1000 inactive=20s valid=1m;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_certificate_compression</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_certificate_compression off;<br>關閉 SSL 憑證壓縮；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.29.1.

該指令出現在版本1.29.1 。

Enables TLS 1.3 [compression](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8879) of server certificates.

啟用伺服器憑證的TLS 1.3 [壓縮](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8879) 。

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 3.2 or higher; the list of supported compression algorithms is provided by the library.
>
> 當使用 OpenSSL 3.2或更高版本時，支援該指令；支援的壓縮演算法清單由函式庫提供。

> The directive is supported when using BoringSSL; the list of supported compression algorithms includes `zlib` (1.29.3).
>
> 使用 BoringSSL 時支援此指令；支援的壓縮演算法清單包括`zlib` ( 1.29.3 )。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_certificate_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_certificate_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with the secret key in the PEM format for the given virtual server.

為給定的虛擬伺服器指定一個`*file*` ，其中包含PEM格式的金鑰。

The value `engine`:`*name*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*`, which loads a secret key with a specified `*id*` from the OpenSSL engine `*name*`.

可以指定值`engine`:`*name*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ，它會從 OpenSSL 引擎`*name*`載入具有指定`*id*`的金鑰。

The value `store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.29.0), which is used to load a secret key with a specified `*id*` and OpenSSL provider registered URI `*scheme*`, such as [`pkcs11`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512).

可指定值`store`:`*scheme*`:`*id*`代替`*file*` ( 1.29.0 )，該值用於載入具有指定`*id*`和已註冊的 OpenSSL 提供者URI `*scheme*`的金鑰，例如 [ `pkcs11` (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7512) 。

The value `data`:`*$variable*` can be specified instead of the `*file*` (1.15.10), which loads a secret key from a variable without using intermediate files. Note that inappropriate use of this syntax may have its security implications, such as writing secret key data to [error log](#p-125).

可以使用值`data`:`*$variable*`代替`*file*` ( 1.15.10 )，這樣就可以從變數中載入金鑰，而無需使用中間檔案。請注意，不當使用此語法可能會帶來安全隱患，例如將金鑰資料寫入 [錯誤日誌](#p-125) 。

Since version 1.15.9, variables can be used in the `*file*` name when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher.

自版本1.15.9起，在使用1.0.2或更高版本時，可以在`*file*`名稱中使用變數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ciphers</strong> <code><i>ciphers</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies the enabled ciphers. The ciphers are specified in the format understood by the OpenSSL library, for example:

指定啟用的密碼套件。密碼套件以 OpenSSL 庫可識別的格式指定，例如：

> ```
> ssl_ciphers ALL:!aNULL:!EXPORT56:RC4+RSA:+HIGH:+MEDIUM:+LOW:+SSLv2:+EXP;
>
> ssl_ciphers ALL :!aNULL:! EXPORT56:RC4+RSA:+HIGH:+MEDIUM:+LOW :+SSLv2:+ EXP ;
> ```

The full list can be viewed using the “`openssl ciphers`” command.

可以使用「 `openssl ciphers` 」指令查看完整清單。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_client_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_client_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.8.

該指令出現在版本1.11.8 。

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-160) client certificates and OCSP responses if [ssl\_stapling](#p-160) is enabled.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於 [驗證](#p-160)客戶端證書和OCSP響應（如果啟用 [ssl\_stapling](#p-160) 。

The list of certificates will be sent to clients. If this is not desired, the [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-160) directive can be used.

證書清單將發送給客戶端。如果不需要此操作，可以使用 [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-160)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**ssl_conf_command** `*name*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**ssl_conf_command** ` *名稱* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.19.4.

該指令出現在版本1.19.4 。

Sets arbitrary OpenSSL configuration [commands](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html).

設定任意 OpenSSL 設定 [指令](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) .

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，支援該指令。

Several `ssl_conf_command` directives can be specified on the same level:

可以在同一層級指定多個`ssl_conf_command`指令：

> ```
> ssl_conf_command Options PrioritizeChaCha;
>
> ssl_conf_command 選項 PrioritizeChaCha;
> ssl_conf_command Ciphersuites TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256;
>
> ssl_conf_command 密碼套件 TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256;
> ```

These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `ssl_conf_command` directives defined on the current level.

如果目前等級沒有定義`ssl_conf_command`指令，則這些指令將從上一個設定等級繼承。

> Note that configuring OpenSSL directly might result in unexpected behavior.
>
> 請注意，直接配置 OpenSSL 可能會導致意外行為。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_crl** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_crl** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.8.

該指令出現在版本1.11.8 。

Specifies a `*file*` with revoked certificates (CRL) in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-160) client certificates. When using intermediate certificates, their CRLs should be specified in the same file.

指定一個包含已吊銷憑證（ CRL ）的`*file*`其格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-160)客戶端憑證。使用中間憑證時，應在同一文件中指定其憑證撤銷清單 (CRL)。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_dhparam** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_dhparam** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with DH parameters for DHE ciphers.

為DHE密碼指定`*file*`和DH參數。

By default no parameters are set, and therefore DHE ciphers will not be used.

預設不設定任何參數，因此不會使用DHE密碼。

> Prior to version 1.11.0, builtin parameters were used by default.
>
> 在版本1.11.0之前，預設使用內建參數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ecdh_curve</strong> <code><i>curve<br>曲線</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ecdh_curve auto;<br>ssl_ecdh_curve 自動；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies a `*curve*` for ECDHE ciphers.

為ECDHE密碼指定`*curve*` 。

When using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher, it is possible to specify multiple curves (1.11.0), for example:

使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，可以指定多個曲線 ( 1.11.0 )，例如：

> ```
> ssl_ecdh_curve prime256v1:secp384r1;
> ```

The special value `auto` (1.11.0) instructs nginx to use a list built into the OpenSSL library when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher, or `prime256v1` with older versions.

特殊值`auto` ( 1.11.0 ) 指示 nginx 在使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時使用 OpenSSL 庫中內建的列表，或使用舊版本時使用`prime256v1` 。

> Prior to version 1.11.0, the `prime256v1` curve was used by default.
>
> 在1.11.0版本之前，預設使用`prime256v1`曲線。

> When using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher, this directive sets the list of curves supported by the server. Thus, in order for ECDSA certificates to work, it is important to include the curves used in the certificates.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，此指令設定伺服器支援的曲線清單。因此，為了使ECDSA憑證正常運作，必須包含憑證中使用的曲線。

|   |   |

| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.29.4.

該指令出現在版本1.29.4 。

Specifies a `*file*` with encrypted ClientHello configuration (`ECHConfig`) in the [PEM](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9934) format used to enable TLS 1.3 [ECH](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9849) in shared mode.

指定一個`*file*`其具有加密的 ClientHello 配置 ( `ECHConfig` )，格式為 [PEM](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9934)用於在共享模式下啟用TLS 1.3 ， ECH在共享模式下啟用(https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9849)

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 4.0 or higher.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 4.0或更高版本時，支援該指令。

<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_handshake_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
