<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies a timeout for the SSL handshake to complete.

指定SSL握手完成的超時時間。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**ssl_key_log** path;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Enables logging of client connection SSL keys and specifies the path to the key log file. Keys are logged in the [SSLKEYLOGFILE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850) format compatible with Wireshark.

啟用客戶端連線SSL金鑰的日誌記錄，並指定金鑰日誌檔案的路徑。密鑰以與Wireshark相容的[SSLKEYLOGFILE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9850)格式記錄。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ocsp</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code>leaf<br>葉子</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ocsp off;<br>ssl_ocsp 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Enables OCSP validation of the client certificate chain. The `leaf` parameter enables validation of the client certificate only.

啟用客戶端憑證鏈的OCSP驗證。 `leaf` 參數僅啟用客戶端憑證的驗證。

For the OCSP validation to work, the [ssl\_verify\_client](#p-160) directive should be set to `on` or `optional`.

要使OCSP驗證生效，[ssl\_verify\_client](#p-160)指令應設定為`on`或`optional` 。

To resolve the OCSP responder hostname, the [resolver](#p-142) directive should also be specified.

若要解析OCSP響應程式主機名，還應指定 [resolver](#p-142)指令。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> ssl_verify_client on;
>
> ssl_verify_client 已啟用；
> ssl_ocsp          on;
>
> ssl_ocsp 已開啟；
> resolver          192.0.2.1;
>
> 解析器192.0.2.1 ;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>ssl_ocsp_cache</strong> <code>off</code> | [<code>shared</code>:<code><i>name</i></code>:<code><i>size</i></code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> ssl_ocsp_cache </strong> <code>關閉</code> | [ <code>共享</code>:<code><i> </i></code> </i></code>:<code><i> </code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_ocsp_cache off;<br>關閉 ssl_ocsp_cache；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Sets `name` and `size` of the cache that stores client certificates status for OCSP validation. The cache is shared between all worker processes. A cache with the same name can be used in several virtual servers.

設定用於儲存客戶端憑證狀態以進行驗證OCSP快取的`name`和`size` 。該快取由所有工作進程共享。同名快取可在多個虛擬伺服器中使用。

The `off` parameter prohibits the use of the cache.

`off`參數禁止使用快取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_ocsp_responder** `*url*`;``<br>` `**ssl_ocsp_responder** ` *url* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Overrides the URL of the OCSP responder specified in the “[Authority Information Access](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.2.1)” certificate extension for [validation](#p-160) of client certificates.

覆寫「[權威資訊存取]OCSP 」憑證擴充中指定的URL回應程序(https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.2.1)用於客戶端憑證的 [驗證](#p-160) 。

Only “`http://`” OCSP responders are supported:

僅支援“ `http://` ” OCSP應答器：

> ```
> ssl_ocsp_responder http://ocsp.example.com/;
> ```

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_password_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_password_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with passphrases for [secret keys](#p-160) where each passphrase is specified on a separate line. Passphrases are tried in turn when loading the key.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含 [金鑰](#p-160)的密碼短語，每個密碼短語單獨一行指定。載入金鑰時，將依序嘗試這些密碼短語。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     ssl_password_file /etc/keys/global.pass;
>     ...
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 127.0.0.1:12345;
>
>         聽127.0.0.1:12345 ;
>         ssl_certificate_key /etc/keys/first.key;
>     }
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         listen 127.0.0.1:12346;
>
>         聽127.0.0.1:12346 ;
> 
>         # named pipe can also be used instead of a file｜命名管道也可以代替文件使用。
>         ssl_password_file /etc/keys/fifo;
>         ssl_certificate_key /etc/keys/second.key;
>     }
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_prefer_server_ciphers</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;<br>關閉 ssl_prefer_server_ciphers;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies that server ciphers should be preferred over client ciphers when the SSLv3 and TLS protocols are used.

規定在使用 SSLv3 和TLS協定時，應優先使用伺服器密碼而非客戶端密碼。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>ssl_protocols</strong> [<code>SSLv2</code>] [<code>SSLv3</code>] [<code>TLSv1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.2</code>] [<code>TLSv1.3</code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> ssl_protocols </strong> [ <code> SSLv2 </code> <code> [ </code> <code> ⧟ </code> ] [ <code> TLSv1.1 </code> ] [ <code> TLSv1.2 </code> ]<code> </code></td></tr> </code> ⧟
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;<br>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables the specified protocols.

啟用指定的協定。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-142) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-142)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

> The `TLSv1.1` and `TLSv1.2` parameters work only when OpenSSL 1.0.1 or higher is used.
>
> `TLSv1.1`和`TLSv1.2`參數僅在使用 OpenSSL 1.0.1或更高版本時有效。

> The `TLSv1.3` parameter (1.13.0) works only when OpenSSL 1.1.1 or higher is used.
>
> `TLSv1.3`參數 ( 1.13.0 ) 僅在使用 OpenSSL 1.1.1或更高版本時有效。

> The `TLSv1.3` parameter is used by default since 1.23.4.
>
> `TLSv1.3`參數預設使用1.23.4參數。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_reject_handshake</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_reject_handshake off;<br>關閉 ssl_reject_handshake;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.25.5.

該指令出現在版本1.25.5 。

If enabled, SSL handshakes in the [server](#p-142) block will be rejected.

如果啟用，則 [伺服器](#p-142)區塊中的SSL握手將被拒絕。

For example, in the following configuration, SSL handshakes with server names other than `example.com` are rejected:

例如，在以下配置中，伺服器名稱不是`example.com`的SSL握手將被拒絕：

> ```
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen               443 ssl default_server;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl 預設伺服器；
>     ssl_reject_handshake on;
>
>     ssl_reject_handshake 開啟；
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen              443 ssl;
>
>     監聽 443 ssl；
>     server_name         example.com;
>
>     伺服器名稱 example.com；
>     ssl_certificate     example.com.crt;
>
>     ssl_certificate example.com.crt;
>     ssl_certificate_key example.com.key;
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_session_cache</strong> <code>off<br>關閉</code> | <code>none<br>無</code> | [<code>builtin<br></code>[:<br><code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>]] [<code>shared<br>共享</code>:<code><i>name<br>名稱</i></code>:<code><i>size<br>大小</i></code>];</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_session_cache none;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the types and sizes of caches that store session parameters. A cache can be of any of the following types:

設定用於儲存會話參數的快取類型和大小。快取可以是以下任何一種類型：

`off`

the use of a session cache is strictly prohibited: nginx explicitly tells a client that sessions may not be reused.

嚴禁使用會話快取：nginx 明確告知客戶端會話不得重複使用。

`none`

the use of a session cache is gently disallowed: nginx tells a client that sessions may be reused, but does not actually store session parameters in the cache.

nginx 會委婉地禁止使用會話快取：nginx 會告訴客戶端會話可以重複使用，但實際上不會將會話參數儲存在快取中。

`builtin`

a cache built in OpenSSL; used by one worker process only. The cache size is specified in sessions. If size is not given, it is equal to 20480 sessions. Use of the built-in cache can cause memory fragmentation.

OpenSSL 內建快取；僅供單一工作進程使用。快取大小以會話數 (session) 為單位指定。如果未指定大小，則預設為 20480 個會話。使用內建快取可能會導致記憶體碎片。

`shared`

a cache shared between all worker processes. The cache size is specified in bytes; one megabyte can store about 4000 sessions. Each shared cache should have an arbitrary name. A cache with the same name can be used in several virtual servers. It is also used to automatically generate, store, and periodically rotate TLS session ticket keys (1.23.2) unless configured explicitly using the [ssl\_session\_ticket\_key](#p-160) directive.

所有工作進程共享的快取。快取大小以位元組為單位；1 MB 大約可以儲存 4000 個會話。每個共享快取都應該有一個任意名稱。同名快取可以在多個虛擬伺服器中使用。它也用於自動產生、儲存和定期輪換TLS票據金鑰（ 1.23.2 ），除非使用 [ssl_session_ticket_key](#p-160)指令明確配置。

Both cache types can be used simultaneously, for example:

兩種快取類型可以同時使用，例如：

> ```
> ssl_session_cache builtin:1000 shared:SSL:10m;
>
> ssl_session_cache builtin:1000 shared: SSL :10m;
> ```

but using only shared cache without the built-in cache should be more efficient.

但是，如果只使用共享快取而不使用內建緩存，效率應該會更高。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-142) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-142)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_session_ticket_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_session_ticket_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Sets a `*file*` with the secret key used to encrypt and decrypt TLS session tickets. The directive is necessary if the same key has to be shared between multiple servers. By default, a randomly generated key is used.

設定用於加密和TLS會話票據的金鑰`*file*` 。如果需要在多個伺服器之間共用相同金鑰，則此指令是必需的。預設情況下，使用隨機產生的密鑰。

If several keys are specified, only the first key is used to encrypt TLS session tickets. This allows configuring key rotation, for example:

如果指定了多個金鑰，則僅使用第一個金鑰來加密TLS會話票證。這樣可以配置金鑰輪換，例如：

> ```
> ssl_session_ticket_key current.key;
> ssl_session_ticket_key previous.key;
> ```

The `*file*` must contain 80 or 48 bytes of random data and can be created using the following command:

`*file*`必須包含 80 或 48 位元組的隨機數據，可以使用以下命令創建：

> ```
> openssl rand 80 > ticket.key
> ```

Depending on the file size either AES256 (for 80-byte keys, 1.11.8) or AES128 (for 48-byte keys) is used for encryption.

根據檔案大小，加密時使用AES256 （80 位元組金鑰）、 1.11.8或AES128 （48 位元組金鑰）。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-142) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-142)層級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_session_tickets</strong> <code>on<br>開啟</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_session_tickets on;<br>啟用 ssl_session_tickets；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables or disables session resumption through [TLS session tickets](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5077).

透過 [TLS會話票證](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5077)啟用或停用會話恢復。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-142) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-142)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_session_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_session_timeout 5m;<br>ssl_session_timeout 5分鐘；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies a time during which a client may reuse the session parameters.

指定客戶端可以重複使用會話參數的時間段。

If the directive is specified on the [server](#p-142) level, the value from the default server can be used. Details are provided in the “[Virtual server selection](#p-112)” section.

如果指令是在 [伺服器](#p-142)等級指定的，則可以使用預設伺服器的值。詳細資訊請參閱「[虛擬伺服器選擇](#p-112) 」部分。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_stapling</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off<br>關閉</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_stapling off;<br>關閉 SSL 裝訂；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Enables or disables [stapling of OCSP responses](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6066#section-8) by the server. Example:

啟用或停用伺服器對OCSP回應的裝訂(https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6066#section-8) 。範例：

> ```
> ssl_stapling on;
>
> 啟用 SSL 裝訂；
> resolver 192.0.2.1;
>
> 解決192.0.2.1 ；
> ```

For the OCSP stapling to work, the certificate of the server certificate issuer should be known. If the [ssl\_certificate](#p-160) file does not contain intermediate certificates, the certificate of the server certificate issuer should be present in the [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-160) file.

要使OCSP裝訂正常運作，必須知道伺服器憑證授權者的憑證。如果 [ssl\_certificate](#p-160)檔案不包含中間證書，則伺服器證書頒發者的證書應存在於 [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-160)檔案中。

For a resolution of the OCSP responder hostname, the [resolver](#p-142) directive should also be specified.

若要解析OCSP響應程式主機名，還應指定 [resolver](#p-142)指令。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_stapling_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_stapling_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

When set, the stapled OCSP response will be taken from the specified `*file*` instead of querying the OCSP responder specified in the server certificate.

設定後，將從指定的`*file*`取得裝訂的OCSP回應，而不是查詢伺服器憑證中指定的OCSP回應程式。

The file should be in the DER format as produced by the “`openssl ocsp`” command.

該檔案應為「 `openssl ocsp` 」指令產生的DER格式。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_stapling_responder** `*url*`;``<br>` `**ssl_stapling_responder** ` *url* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Overrides the URL of the OCSP responder specified in the “[Authority Information Access](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.2.1)” certificate extension.

覆蓋「[權威資訊存取](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.2.1) 」證書擴充中指定的OCSP回應程式的URL 。

Only “`http://`” OCSP responders are supported:

僅支援“ `http://` ” OCSP應答器：

> ```
> ssl_stapling_responder http://ocsp.example.com/;
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_stapling_verify</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_stapling_verify off;<br>關閉 ssl_stapling_verify；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.2.

該指令出現在版本1.27.2 。

Enables or disables verification of OCSP responses by the server.

啟用或停用伺服器對OCSP回應的驗證。

For verification to work, the certificate of the server certificate issuer, the root certificate, and all intermediate certificates should be configured as trusted using the [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-160) directive.

為了使驗證生效，伺服器憑證授權者的憑證、根憑證和所有中間憑證都應該使用 [ssl\_trusted\_certificate](#p-160)指令配置為受信任。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**ssl_trusted_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**ssl_trusted_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.11.8.

該指令出現在版本1.11.8 。

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-160) client certificates and OCSP responses if [ssl\_stapling](#p-160) is enabled.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-160)客戶端證書和OCSP響應（如果啟用 [ssl\_pling](#p-160) 。

In contrast to the certificate set by [ssl\_client\_certificate](#p-160), the list of these certificates will not be sent to clients.

與 [ssl\_client\_certificate](#p-160)設定的憑證不同，這些憑證的清單不會傳送給客戶端。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>句法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_verify_client</strong> <code>on<br>在</code> | <code>off<br>離開</code> | <code>optional<br>選修的</code> | <code>optional_no_ca</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_verify_client off;<br>關閉 ssl_verify_client;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.11.8.

該指令出現在版本1.11.8 。

Enables verification of client certificates. The verification result is stored in the [$ssl\_client\_verify](#p-160) variable. If an error has occurred during the client certificate verification or a client has not presented the required certificate, the connection is closed.

啟用客戶端憑證驗證。驗證結果儲存在變數 [$ssl\_client\_verify](#p-160)中。如果在用戶端證書驗證過程中發生錯誤，或用戶端未提供所需的證書，則連線將關閉。

The `optional` parameter requests the client certificate and verifies it if the certificate is present.

`optional`參數請求客戶端證書，並驗證證書是否存在。

The `optional_no_ca` parameter requests the client certificate but does not require it to be signed by a trusted CA certificate. This is intended for the use in cases when a service that is external to nginx performs the actual certificate verification. The contents of the certificate is accessible through the [$ssl\_client\_cert](#p-160) variable.

`optional_no_ca`參數請求客戶端證書，但不要求該證書必須由受信任的CA證書簽署。這適用於由 nginx 外部服務執行實際憑證驗證的情況。憑證內容可透過 [$ssl\_client\_cert](#p-160)變數存取。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_verify_depth</strong> <code><i>number<br>數字</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_verify_depth 1;<br>ssl_verify_depth 1；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.11.8.

該指令出現在版本1.11.8 。

Sets the verification depth in the client certificates chain.

設定客戶端憑證鏈的驗證深度。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_stream_ssl_module` module supports variables since 1.11.2.

`ngx_stream_ssl_module`模組自1.11.2起支持變數。

`$ssl_alpn_protocol`

returns the protocol selected by ALPN during the SSL handshake, or an empty string otherwise (1.21.4);

返回ALPN在SSL握手期間選擇的協議，否則返回空字串（ 1.21.4 ）；

`$ssl_cipher`

returns the name of the cipher used for an established SSL connection;

傳回用於已建立的SSL連線的密碼名稱；

`$ssl_ciphers`

returns the list of ciphers supported by the client (1.11.7). Known ciphers are listed by names, unknown are shown in hexadecimal, for example:

傳回客戶端支援的密碼套件清單（ 1.11.7 ）。已知密碼套件以名稱列出，未知密碼套件以十六進位顯示，例如：

> ```
> AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:0x00ff
>
> AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA :0x00ff
> ```

> The variable is fully supported only when using OpenSSL version 1.0.2 or higher. With older versions, the variable is available only for new sessions and lists only known ciphers.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本1.0.2或更高版本時，該變數才完全支援。在舊版本中，該變數僅適用於新會話，並且僅列出已知的密碼套件。

`$ssl_client_cert`

returns the client certificate in the PEM format for an established SSL connection, with each line except the first prepended with the tab character (1.11.8);

對於已建立的SSL連接，以PEM格式返回客戶端證書，除第一行外，每行都以製表符 ( 1.11.8 ) 開頭；

`$ssl_client_fingerprint`

returns the SHA1 fingerprint of the client certificate for an established SSL connection (1.11.8);

傳回已建立的SSL連接的客戶端憑證的SHA1指紋 ( 1.11.8 ) ;

`$ssl_client_i_dn`

returns the “issuer DN” string of the client certificate for an established SSL connection according to [RFC 2253](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2253) (1.11.8);

傳回已建立連線的用戶端憑證的「核發者DN 」字串1.11.8依據 [ SSL 2253]RFC ( (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2253) ) ;

`$ssl_client_raw_cert`

returns the client certificate in the PEM format for an established SSL connection (1.11.8);

對於已建立的SSL連線（ 1.11.8 ），返回PEM格式的客戶端憑證；

`$ssl_client_s_dn`

returns the “subject DN” string of the client certificate for an established SSL connection according to [RFC 2253](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2253) (1.11.8);

傳回已建立連線的用戶端憑證的「主題DN 」字串1.11.8根據 [ SSL 2253]RFC ( (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2253) ) ;

`$ssl_client_serial`

returns the serial number of the client certificate for an established SSL connection (1.11.8);

傳回已建立的SSL連線的客戶端憑證的序號（ 1.11.8 ）；

`$ssl_client_sigalg`

returns the [signature algorithm](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) for the client certificate for an established SSL connection (1.29.3).

傳回已建立的SSL連接的客戶端憑證的 [簽章演算法](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) ( 1.29.3 )。

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 3.5 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本3.5或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

> The variable is available only for new sessions.
>
> 此變數僅適用於新會話。

`$ssl_client_v_end`

returns the end date of the client certificate (1.11.8);

傳回客戶端憑證的到期日期（ 1.11.8 ）；

`$ssl_client_v_remain`

returns the number of days until the client certificate expires (1.11.8);

傳回客戶端憑證到期前的天數（ 1.11.8 ）；

`$ssl_client_v_start`

returns the start date of the client certificate (1.11.8);

傳回客戶端憑證的起始日期（ 1.11.8 ）；

`$ssl_client_verify`

returns the result of client certificate verification (1.11.8): “`SUCCESS`”, “`FAILED:``*reason*`”, and “`NONE`” if a certificate was not present;

傳回客戶端證書驗證結果（ 1.11.8 ）：如果不存在證書，則回傳「 `SUCCESS` 」、「 `FAILED:``*reason*` 」和「 `NONE` 」；

`$ssl_curve`

returns the negotiated curve used for SSL handshake key exchange process (1.21.5). Known curves are listed by names, unknown are shown in hexadecimal, for example:

返回用於SSL握手金鑰交換過程（ 1.21.5 ）的協商曲線。已知曲線以名稱列出，未知曲線以十六進位顯示，例如：

> ```
> prime256v1
> ```

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 3.0 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本3.0或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

`$ssl_curves`

returns the list of curves supported by the client (1.11.7). Known curves are listed by names, unknown are shown in hexadecimal, for example:

傳回客戶端支援的曲線清單（ 1.11.7 ）。已知曲線按名稱列出，未知曲線以十六進位顯示，例如：

> ```
> 0x001d:prime256v1:secp521r1:secp384r1
> ```

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 1.0.2 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本1.0.2或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

> The variable is available only for new sessions.
>
> 此變數僅適用於新會話。

`$ssl_ech_outer_server_name`

returns the public server name requested through [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) if TLS 1.3 [ECH](#p-160) was accepted, otherwise “” (1.29.4);

如果TLS 1.3 [ECH](#p-160)被接受，則返回通過 [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication)請求的公共伺服器名稱，否則返回「」（ 1.29.4 ）；

`$ssl_ech_status`

returns the result of TLS 1.3 [ECH](#p-160) processing: “`FAILED`”, “`BACKEND`”, “`GREASE`”, “`SUCCESS`”, or “`NOT_TRIED`” (1.29.4);

回TLS 1.3 [ECH](#p-160)處理的結果：" `FAILED` `NOT_TRIED` , “ `BACKEND` ”, “ `SUCCESS` ”, “ `GREASE` ( 1.29.4 );

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 4.0 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本4.0或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

`$ssl_protocol`

returns the protocol of an established SSL connection;

返回已建立的SSL連接的協定；

`$ssl_server_name`

returns the server name requested through [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication);

傳回透過 [SNI](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication)請求的伺服器名稱；

`$ssl_session_id`

returns the session identifier of an established SSL connection;

傳回已建立的SSL連線的會話標識符；

`$ssl_session_reused`

returns “`r`” if an SSL session was reused, or “`.`” otherwise.

如果重複使用了SSL會話，則傳回“ `r` ”，否則回傳“ `.` ”。

`$ssl_sigalg`

returns the [signature algorithm](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) for the server certificate for an established SSL connection (1.29.3).

傳回已建立的SSL連接的伺服器憑證的 [簽章演算法](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) ( 1.29.3 )。

> The variable is supported only when using OpenSSL version 3.5 or higher. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本3.5或更高版本時才支援此變數。在舊版本中，該變數的值將為空字串。

> The variable is available only for new sessions.
>
> 此變數僅適用於新會話。

`$ssl_sigalgs`

returns the list of [signature algorithms](https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) supported by the client (1.31.2). Known values are listed by names, unknown are shown in hexadecimal, for example:

傳回客戶端（ 1.31.2 ）支援的簽章演算法清單（ (https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml#tls-parameters-16) ）。已知值以名稱列出，未知值以十六進位顯示，例如：

> ```
> 0xfe00:rsa_pkcs1_sha256:rsa_pss_rsae_sha256:ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256
> ```

> The variable is fully supported only when using OpenSSL version 4.0 or higher. For OpenSSL versions 1.0.2+, the values are always shown in hexadecimal. With older versions, the variable value will be an empty string.
>
> 僅在使用 OpenSSL 版本4.0或更高版本時，該變數才完全支援。對於 OpenSSL 版本1.0.2及更高版本，其值始終以十六進位顯示。對於更早的版本，該變數的值將為空字串。

> The variable is available only for new sessions.
>
> 此變數僅適用於新會話。

<a id="p-161"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module｜模組 ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_ssl\_preread\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-161)<br>[Directives](#p-161)<br>     [ssl\_preread](#p-161)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-161)<br>[範例設定](#p-161)<br> [指令](#p-161)<br> [ssl\_preread](#p-161)<br> [嵌入式變數](#p-161) |

The `ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module` module (1.11.5) allows extracting information from the [ClientHello](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5246#section-7.4.1.2) message without terminating SSL/TLS, for example, the server name requested through [SNI](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6066#section-3) or protocols advertised in [ALPN](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7301). This module is not built by default, it should be enabled with the `--with-stream_ssl_preread_module` configuration parameter.

`ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module`模組（ 1.11.5 ）允許從 [ClientHello](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5246#section-7.4.1.2)訊息中提取信息，而無需終止SSL/TLS ，例如，透過 [SNI](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6066#section-3)請求的伺服器名稱或在 [ ALPN (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7301)中通告的協議。此模組預設未構建，應使用`--with-stream_ssl_preread_module`配置參數啟用。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

Selecting an upstream based on server name:

根據伺服器名稱選擇上游伺服器：

> ```
> map $ssl_preread_server_name $name {
>
> 映射 $ssl_preread_server_name $name {
>     backend.example.com      backend;
>
>     backend.example.com 後端；
>     default                  backend2;
>
>     預設後端2；
> }
> 
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     server 192.168.0.1:12345;
>
>     伺服器192.168.0.1:12345 ;
>     server 192.168.0.2:12345;
>
>     伺服器192.168.0.2:12345 ;
> }
> 
> upstream backend2 {
>
> 上游後端2 {
>     server 192.168.0.3:12345;
>
>     伺服器192.168.0.3:12345 ;
>     server 192.168.0.4:12345;
>
>     伺服器192.168.0.4:12345 ;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      12346;
>
>     聽 12346；
>     proxy_pass  $name;
>
>     proxy_pass $name;
>     ssl_preread on;
>
>     ssl_preread 已開啟；
> }
> ```

Selecting an upstream based on protocol:

根據協定選擇上游伺服器：

> ```
> map $ssl_preread_alpn_protocols $proxy {
>
> 映射 $ssl_preread_alpn_protocols $proxy {
>     ~\bh2\b           127.0.0.1:8001;
>
>     ~\bh2\b 127.0.0.1:8001 ;
>     ~\bhttp/1.1\b     127.0.0.1:8002;
>
>     ~\bhttp/ 1.1 \b 127.0.0.1:8002 ;
>     ~\bxmpp-client\b  127.0.0.1:8003;
>
>     ~\bxmpp-client\b 127.0.0.1:8003 ;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      9000;
>
>     聽 9000；
>     proxy_pass  $proxy;
>
>     proxy_pass $proxy;
>     ssl_preread on;
>
>     ssl_preread 已開啟；
> }
> ```

Selecting an upstream based on SSL protocol version:

根據SSL協定版本選擇上游伺服器：

> ```
> map $ssl_preread_protocol $upstream {
>
> 映射 $ssl_preread_protocol $upstream {
>     ""        ssh.example.com:22;
>     "TLSv1.2" new.example.com:443;
>     default   tls.example.com:443;
>
>     預設 tls.example.com:443;
> }
> 
> # ssh and https on the same port｜SSH 和 HTTPS 使用相同連接埠
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen      192.168.0.1:443;
>
>     聽192.168.0.1:443 ;
>     proxy_pass  $upstream;
>
>     proxy_pass $upstream;
>     ssl_preread on;
>
>     ssl_preread 已開啟；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>ssl_preread</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>ssl_preread off;<br>關閉 ssl_preread；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables extracting information from the ClientHello message at the [preread](#p-165) phase.

允許在 [preread](#p-165)階段從 ClientHello 訊息中提取資訊。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

`$ssl_preread_protocol`

the highest SSL protocol version supported by the client (1.15.2)

客戶端支援的最高SSL協定版本（ 1.15.2 ）

`$ssl_preread_server_name`

server name requested through SNI

透過SNI請求伺服器名稱

`$ssl_preread_alpn_protocols`

list of protocols advertised by the client through ALPN (1.13.10). The values are separated by commas.

客戶端透過ALPN ( 1.13.10 ) 通告的協定清單。值之間用逗號分隔。

---

<a id="p-162"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_upstream_hc_module｜模組 ngx_stream_upstream_hc_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_upstream_hc_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_upstream\_hc\_module｜模組 ngx\_stream\_upstream\_hc\_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-162)<br>[Directives](#p-162)<br>     [health\_check](#p-162)<br>     [health\_check\_timeout](#p-162)<br>     [match](#p-162)<br>[範例設定](#p-162)<br> [指令](#p-162)<br> [health\_check](#p-162)<br> [health\_check\_timeout](#p-162)<br> [match](#p-162) |

The `ngx_stream_upstream_hc_module` module (1.9.0) allows enabling periodic health checks of the servers in a [group](#p-163). The server group must reside in the [shared memory](#p-163).

`ngx_stream_upstream_hc_module`模組 ( 1.9.0 ) 允許對 [群組](#p-163)中的伺服器進行定期健康檢查。伺服器群組必須位於 [共享記憶體](#p-163)中。

If a health check fails, the server will be considered unhealthy. If several health checks are defined for the same group of servers, a single failure of any check will make the corresponding server be considered unhealthy. Client connections are not passed to unhealthy servers and servers in the “checking” state.

如果健康檢查失敗，伺服器將被視為不健康。如果為同一組伺服器定義了多個健康檢查，則任何一個檢查失敗都會導致相應的伺服器被視為不健康。客戶端連線不會傳遞給不健康的伺服器和處於「檢查中」狀態的伺服器。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> upstream tcp {
>
> 上游 TCP {
>     zone upstream_tcp 64k;
>
>     區域 upstream_tcp 64k；
> 
>     server backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>     server backend2.example.com:12345 fail_timeout=5s slow_start=30s;
>     server 192.0.2.1:12345            max_fails=3;
>
>     伺服器192.0.2.1:12345 max_fails=3;
> 
>     server backup1.example.com:12345  backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup1.example.com:12345 備份;
>     server backup2.example.com:12345  backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup2.example.com:12345 備份;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen     12346;
>
>     聽 12346；
>     proxy_pass tcp;
>     health_check;
>
>     健康檢查；
> }
> ```

With this configuration, nginx will check the ability to establish a TCP connection to each server in the `tcp` group every five seconds. When a connection to the server cannot be established, the health check will fail, and the server will be considered unhealthy.

在此配置下，nginx 將每五秒鐘檢查一次與`tcp`組中的每個伺服器建立TCP連接的能力。如果無法與伺服器建立連接，則健康檢查失敗，伺服器將被視為不健康。

Health checks can be configured for the UDP protocol:

可以對UDP協議配置健康檢查：

> ```
> upstream dns_upstream {
>
> 上游 dns_upstream {
> 
>     zone   dns_zone 64k;
>
>     區域 dns_zone 64k；
> 
>     server dns1.example.com:53;
>
>     伺服器 dns1.example.com:53;
>     server dns2.example.com:53;
>
>     伺服器 dns2.example.com:53;
>     server dns3.example.com:53;
>
>     伺服器 dns3.example.com:53;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       53 udp;
>
>     列表 53 UDP；
>     proxy_pass   dns_upstream;
>
>     proxy_pass dns_upstream;
>     health_check udp;
>
>     健康檢查 UDP；
> }
> ```

In this case, the absence of ICMP “`Destination Unreachable`” message is expected in reply to the sent string “`nginx health check`”.

在這種情況下，對於發送的字串“ `nginx health check` ”，預期不會收到“ ICMP “ `Destination Unreachable` ””訊息的回應。

Health checks can also be configured to test data obtained from the server. Tests are configured separately using the [match](#p-162) directive and referenced in the `match` parameter of the [health\_check](#p-162) directive.

健康檢查還可以配置為測試從伺服器取得的資料。測試使用 [match](#p-162)指令單獨配置，並在 [health\_check](#p-162)指令的`match`參數中引用。

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**health_check** [`*parameters*`];``<br>` `**health_check** [` *參數* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Enables periodic health checks of the servers in a [group](#p-163).

啟用對 [群組](#p-163)中的伺服器進行定期健康檢查。

The following optional parameters are supported:

支援以下可選參數：

`interval`\=`*time*`

sets the interval between two consecutive health checks, by default, 5 seconds.

設定兩次連續健康檢查之間的間隔，預設值為 5 秒。

`jitter`\=`*time*`

sets the time within which each health check will be randomly delayed, by default, there is no delay.

設定每次健康檢查隨機延遲的時間範圍，預設沒有延遲。

`fails`\=`*number*`

sets the number of consecutive failed health checks of a particular server after which this server will be considered unhealthy, by default, 1.

設定特定伺服器連續健康檢查失敗的次數，超過該次數後，該伺服器將被視為不健康，預設值為 1。

`passes`\=`*number*`

sets the number of consecutive passed health checks of a particular server after which the server will be considered healthy, by default, 1.

設定特定伺服器連續通過健康檢查的次數，超過該次數後，伺服器將被視為健康，預設值為 1。

`mandatory` \[`persistent`\]

sets the initial “checking” state for a server until the first health check is completed (1.11.7). Client connections are not passed to servers in the “checking” state. If the parameter is not specified, the server will be initially considered healthy.

設定伺服器的初始「檢查」狀態，直到首次健康檢查完成（ 1.11.7 ）。客戶端連線不會傳遞給處於「檢查」狀態的伺服器。如果未指定此參數，則伺服器初始狀態將被視為健康。

The `persistent` parameter (1.21.1) sets the initial “up” state for a server after reload if the server was considered healthy before reload.

`persistent`參數 ( 1.21.1 ) 設定伺服器在重新載入後的初始「運行」狀態（如果伺服器在重新載入之前被認為是健康的）。

`match`\=`*name*`

specifies the `match` block configuring the tests that a successful connection should pass in order for a health check to pass. By default, for TCP, only the ability to establish a TCP connection with the server is checked. For [UDP](#p-162), the absence of ICMP “`Destination Unreachable`” message is expected in reply to the sent string “`nginx health check`”.

`match`程式碼區塊用於配置成功連接必須通過的測試，才能通過健康檢查。預設情況下，對於TCP ，僅檢查能否與伺服器建立TCP連線。對於 [UDP](#p-162) ，預期在發送的字符串“ `nginx health check` ”的回復中不存在ICMP “ `Destination Unreachable` ” 訊息。

> Prior to version 1.11.7, by default, UDP health check required a [match](#p-162) block with the [send](#p-162) and [expect](#p-162) parameters.
>
> 在版本1.11.7之前，預設情況下， UDP健康檢查需要一個 [match](#p-162)塊，其中包含 [send](#p-162)和 [expect](#p-162)參數。

`port`\=`*number*`

defines the port used when connecting to a server to perform a health check (1.9.7). By default, equals the [server](#p-163) port.

定義連接到伺服器執行健康檢查時使用的連接埠（ 1.9.7 ）。預設情況下，等於 [伺服器](#p-163)連接埠。

`udp`

specifies that the `UDP` protocol should be used for health checks instead of the default `TCP` protocol (1.9.13).

指定應使用`UDP`協議進行健康檢查，而不是預設的`TCP`協議（ 1.9.13 ）。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>文法：</th><td><code><strong>health_check_timeout</strong> <code><i>timeout</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>health_check_timeout 5s;<br>健康檢查超時時間為 5 秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Overrides the [proxy\_timeout](#p-154) value for health checks.

覆蓋健康檢查的 [proxy\_timeout](#p-154)值。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**match** `*name*` { ... }``<br>` `**match** ` *名稱* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Defines the named test set used to verify server responses to health checks.

定義用於驗證伺服器對健康檢查的回應的命名測試集。

The following parameters can be configured:

可配置以下參數：

`send` `*string*`;

sends a `*string*` to the server;

向伺服器發送`*string*` ；

`expect` `*string*` | `~` `*regex*`;

a literal string (1.9.12) or a regular expression that the data obtained from the server should match. The regular expression is specified with the preceding “`~*`” modifier (for case-insensitive matching), or the “`~`” modifier (for case-sensitive matching).

一個字面字串（ 1.9.12 ）或一個正規表示式，用於匹配從伺服器取得的資料。正規表示式前面有「 `~*` 」修飾符（用於不區分大小寫的匹配），或「 `~` 」修飾符（用於區分大小寫的匹配）。

Both `send` and `expect` parameters can contain hexadecimal literals with the prefix “`\x`” followed by two hex digits, for example, “`\x80`” (1.9.12).

`send`和`expect`參數都可以包含以「 `\x` 」為前綴，後面跟著兩個十六進位數字的十六進位文字，例如「 `\x80` 」（ 1.9.12 ）。

Health check is passed if:

健康檢查合格的標準為：

-   the TCP connection was successfully established;  
    TCP連線已成功建立；
-   the `*string*` from the `send` parameter, if specified, was sent;  
    如果指定了參數`send` ，則發送`*string*` ；
-   the data obtained from the server matched the string or regular expression from the `expect` parameter, if specified;  
    如果指定了`expect`參數，則從伺服器獲得的資料與該參數中的字串或正規表示式相符；
-   the time elapsed does not exceed the value specified in the [health\_check\_timeout](#p-162) directive.  
    經過的時間不超過 [health\_check\_timeout](#p-162)指令中指定的值。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     zone     upstream_backend 10m;
>
>     上游後端區域 10 公尺；
>     server   127.0.0.1:12345;
>
>     伺服器127.0.0.1:12345 ;
> }
> 
> match http {
>
> 匹配 http {
>     send     "GET / HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n";
>
>     發送“ GET / HTTP/1.0 \r\n主機：localhost\r\n\r\n”；
>     expect ~ "200 OK";
>
>     預計~「200 OK 」；
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen       12346;
>
>     聽 12346；
>     proxy_pass   backend;
>
>     proxy_pass 後端；
>     health_check match=http;
>
>     健康檢查匹配=http；
> }
> ```

> Only the first [proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-154) bytes of data obtained from the server are examined.
>
> 僅檢查從伺服器取得的前 [proxy\_buffer\_size](#p-154)位元組的資料。

---

<a id="p-163"></a>

##### Module ngx_stream_upstream_module｜模組 ngx_stream_upstream_module

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_upstream_module.html>

###### Module ngx\_stream\_upstream\_module｜模組 ngx_stream_upstream_module

|   |
| --- |
| [Example Configuration](#p-163)<br>[Directives](#p-163)<br>     [upstream](#p-163)<br>     [server](#p-163)<br>     [zone](#p-163)<br>     [state](#p-163)<br>     [hash](#p-163)<br>     [least\_conn](#p-163)<br>     [least\_time](#p-163)<br>     [random](#p-163)<br>     [resolver](#p-163)<br>     [resolver\_timeout](#p-163)<br>[Embedded Variables](#p-163)<br>[範例配置](#p-163)<br>[指示](#p-163)<br>     [上游](#p-163)<br>     [伺服器](#p-163)<br>     [區](#p-163)<br>     [狀態](#p-163)<br>     [雜湊](#p-163)<br>     [least\_conn](#p-163)<br>     [最少時間](#p-163)<br>     [隨機的](#p-163)<br>     [解決](#p-163)<br>     [resolver\_timeout](#p-163)<br>[嵌入式變數](#p-163) |

The `ngx_stream_upstream_module` module (1.9.0) is used to define groups of servers that can be referenced by the [proxy\_pass](#p-154) directive.

`ngx_stream_upstream_module`模組 ( 1.9.0 ) 用於定義可透過 [proxy\_pass](#p-154)指令引用的伺服器群組。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     hash $remote_addr consistent;
>
>     哈希 $remote_addr 一致；
> 
>     server backend1.example.com:12345  weight=5;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>     server backend2.example.com:12345;
>
>     伺服器 backend2.example.com:12345;
>     server unix:/tmp/backend3;
>
>     伺服器 unix:/tmp/backend3;
> 
>     server backup1.example.com:12345   backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup1.example.com:12345 備份;
>     server backup2.example.com:12345   backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup2.example.com:12345 備份;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 12346;
>
>     聽 12346；
>     proxy_pass backend;
>
>     proxy_pass 後端；
> }
> ```

Dynamically configurable group with periodic [health checks](#p-162) is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx):

動態可設定群組，並定期進行[健康檢查](#p-162)是我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分：

> ```
> resolver 10.0.0.1;
>
> 解10.0.0.1 ；
> 
> upstream dynamic {
>
> 上游動態
>     zone upstream_dynamic 64k;
>
>     區域 upstream_dynamic 64k；
> 
>     server backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>     server backend2.example.com:12345 fail_timeout=5s slow_start=30s;
>     server 192.0.2.1:12345            max_fails=3;
>
>     伺服器192.0.2.1:12345 max_fails=3;
>     server backend3.example.com:12345 resolve;
>
>     伺服器 backend3.example.com:12345 解析；
>     server backend4.example.com       service=http resolve;
>
>     伺服器 backend4.example.com 服務=http 解析；
> 
>     server backup1.example.com:12345  backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup1.example.com:12345 備份;
>     server backup2.example.com:12345  backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup2.example.com:12345 備份;
> }
> 
> server {
>
> 伺服器 {
>     listen 12346;
>
>     聽 12346；
>     proxy_pass dynamic;
>
>     proxy_pass 動態；
>     health_check;
>
>     健康檢查；
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**upstream** `*name*` { ... }``<br>` `**upstream** ` *名稱* ` { ... }` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream` |

Defines a group of servers. Servers can listen on different ports. In addition, servers listening on TCP and UNIX-domain sockets can be mixed.

定義一組伺服器。伺服器可以監聽不同的連接埠。此外，監聽TCP和UNIX域套接字的伺服器可以混合使用。

Example:

例子：

> ```
> upstream backend {
>
> 上游後端 {
>     server backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>
>     伺服器 backend1.example.com:12345 weight=5;
>     server 127.0.0.1:12345            max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
>
>     伺服器127.0.0.1:12345 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
>     server unix:/tmp/backend2;
>
>     伺服器 unix:/tmp/backend2;
>     server backend3.example.com:12345 resolve;
>
>     伺服器 backend3.example.com:12345 解析；
> 
>     server backup1.example.com:12345  backup;
>
>     伺服器 backup1.example.com:12345 備份;
> }
> ```

By default, connections are distributed between the servers using a weighted round-robin balancing method. In the above example, each 7 connections will be distributed as follows: 5 connections go to `backend1.example.com:12345` and one connection to each of the second and third servers. If an error occurs during communication with a server, the connection will be passed to the next server, and so on until all of the functioning servers will be tried. If communication with all servers fails, the connection will be closed.

預設情況下，連線使用加權輪詢負載平衡方法在伺服器之間分配。在上面的範例中，7 個連接將按以下方式分配：5 個連接分配給`backend1.example.com:12345` ，其餘 1 個連接分別分配給第二台和第三台伺服器。如果在與某個伺服器通訊時發生錯誤，則連線將傳遞給下一台伺服器，依此類推，直到嘗試所有可用的伺服器為止。如果與所有伺服器的通訊都失敗，則連線將關閉。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**server** `*address*` [`*parameters*`];``<br>` `**server** ` *地址* ` [` *參數* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

Defines the `*address*` and other `*parameters*` of a server. The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address with an obligatory port, or as a UNIX-domain socket path specified after the “`unix:`” prefix. A domain name that resolves to several IP addresses defines multiple servers at once.

定義伺服器的`*address*`及其他`*parameters*`位址。位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址（必須包含連接埠），也可以指定為UNIX網域套接字路徑（位於「 `unix:` 」前綴之後）。一個網域名稱如果解析到多個IP位址，則同時定義多個伺服器。

The following parameters can be defined:

可以定義以下參數：

`weight`\=`*number*`

sets the weight of the server, by default, 1.

設定伺服器權重，預設值為 1。

`max_conns`\=`*number*`

limits the maximum `*number*` of simultaneous connections to the proxied server (1.11.5). Default value is zero, meaning there is no limit. If the server group does not reside in the [shared memory](#p-163), the limitation works per each worker process.

限制與1.11.5 `*number*`的並發連線數上限。預設值為零，表示沒有限制。如果伺服器群組不在共享記憶體 ( (https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_upstream_module.html#zone) ) 中，則此限制針對每個工作進程生效。

> Prior to version 1.11.5, this parameter was available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.11.5之前，此參數是作為我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供的。

`max_fails`\=`*number*`

sets the number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server that should happen in the duration set by the `fail_timeout` parameter to consider the server unavailable for a duration also set by the `fail_timeout` parameter. By default, the number of unsuccessful attempts is set to 1. The zero value disables the accounting of attempts. Here, an unsuccessful attempt is an error or timeout while establishing a connection with the server.

此參數設定了在`fail_timeout`參數設定的時間段內，與伺服器通訊失敗的次數，以此判定伺服器在`fail_timeout`參數設定的時間內不可用。預設情況下，失敗次數為 1。值為 0 則停用失敗次數統計。此處，失敗次數指的是與伺服器建立連線時發生的錯誤或逾時。

`fail_timeout`\=`*time*`

sets

套

-   the time during which the specified number of unsuccessful attempts to communicate with the server should happen to consider the server unavailable;  
    在指定時間內，與伺服器通訊失敗次數達到指定值後，伺服器將被視為不可用；
-   and the period of time the server will be considered unavailable.  
    以及伺服器將被視為不可用的時間段。

By default, the parameter is set to 10 seconds.

預設情況下，此參數設定為 10 秒。

`backup`

marks the server as a backup server. Connections to the backup server will be passed when the primary servers are unavailable.

將伺服器標記為備用伺服器。當主伺服器不可用時，將透過備用伺服器建立連線。

> The parameter cannot be used along with the [hash](#p-163) and [random](#p-163) load balancing methods.
>
> 此參數不能與 [hash](#p-163)和 [random](#p-163)負載平衡方法一起使用。

`down`

marks the server as permanently unavailable.

將伺服器標記為永久不可用。

`resolve`

monitors changes of the IP addresses that correspond to a domain name of the server, and automatically modifies the upstream configuration without the need of restarting nginx. The server group must reside in the [shared memory](#p-163).

監控與伺服器網域名稱對應的IP位址的變化，並自動修改上游配置，無需重新啟動nginx。伺服器群組必須位於[共享記憶體](#p-163)中。

In order for this parameter to work, the `resolver` directive must be specified in the [stream](#p-142) block or in the corresponding [upstream](#p-163) block.

為了使此參數生效，必須在 [stream](#p-142)區塊或對應的 [upstream](#p-163)區塊中指定`resolver`指令。

> Prior to version 1.27.3, this parameter was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.27.3之前，此參數僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`service`\=`*name*`

enables resolving of DNS [SRV](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2782) records and sets the service `*name*` (1.9.13). In order for this parameter to work, it is necessary to specify the [resolve](#p-163) parameter for the server and specify a hostname without a port number.

啟用對DNS [SRV](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2782)記錄的解析，並設定服務`*name*` ( 1.9.13 )。為了使此參數生效，必須為伺服器指定 [resolve](#p-163)參數，並指定不含連接埠號碼的主機名稱。

If the service name does not contain a dot (“`.`”), then the [RFC](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2782)\-compliant name is constructed and the TCP protocol is added to the service prefix. For example, to look up the `_http._tcp.backend.example.com` SRV record, it is necessary to specify the directive:

如果服務名稱不包含點號（「 `.` 」），則建構符合 [RFC](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2782)標準的名稱，並將TCP協定新增至服務前綴。例如，要尋找`_http._tcp.backend.example.com` SRV記錄，需要指定以下指令：

> ```
> server backend.example.com service=http resolve;
>
> 伺服器 backend.example.com 服務=http 解析；
> ```

If the service name contains one or more dots, then the name is constructed by joining the service prefix and the server name. For example, to look up the `_http._tcp.backend.example.com` and `server1.backend.example.com` SRV records, it is necessary to specify the directives:

如果服務名稱包含一個或多個點，則名稱由服務前綴和伺服器名稱連接而成。例如，要找`_http._tcp.backend.example.com`和`server1.backend.example.com` SRV記錄，需要指定以下指令：

> ```
> server backend.example.com service=_http._tcp resolve;
> server example.com service=server1.backend resolve;
>
> 伺服器 example.com 服務=server1.backend 解析；
> ```

Highest-priority SRV records (records with the same lowest-number priority value) are resolved as primary servers, the rest of SRV records are resolved as backup servers. If the [backup](#p-163) parameter is specified for the server, high-priority SRV records are resolved as backup servers, the rest of SRV records are ignored.

優先順序最高的SRV記錄（優先值最低的記錄）解析為主伺服器，其餘的SRV記錄解析為備份伺服器。如果為伺服器指定了[backup](#p-163)參數，則優先順序最高的SRV記錄被解析為備份伺服器，其餘的SRV記錄將被忽略。

> Prior to version 1.27.3, this parameter was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.27.3之前，此參數僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

Additionally, the following parameters are available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx):

此外，以下參數包含在我們的[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)中：

`slow_start`\=`*time*`

sets the `*time*` during which the server will recover its weight from zero to a nominal value, when unhealthy server becomes [healthy](#p-162), or when the server becomes available after a period of time it was considered [unavailable](#p-163). Default value is zero, i.e. slow start is disabled.

設定`*time*`在此期間，伺服器的權重將從零恢復到標稱值，當不健康的伺服器變為 [健康](#p-162)時，或當伺服器在被視為 [不可用 一段時間後恢復可用時](#p-163) 。預設值為零，即禁用慢啟動。

> The parameter cannot be used along with the [hash](#p-163) and [random](#p-163) load balancing methods.
>
> 此參數不能與 [hash](#p-163)和 [random](#p-163)負載平衡方法一起使用。

> If there is only a single server in a group, `max_fails`, `fail_timeout` and `slow_start` parameters are ignored, and such a server will never be considered unavailable.
>
> 如果一個群組中只有一個伺服器，則忽略`max_fails`, `fail_timeout`和`slow_start`參數，並且這樣的伺服器永遠不會被視為不可用。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**zone** `*name*` [`*size*`];``<br>` `**zone** ` *名稱* ` [` *大小* `];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

Defines the `*name*` and `*size*` of the shared memory zone that keeps the group’s configuration and run-time state that are shared between worker processes. Several groups may share the same zone. In this case, it is enough to specify the `*size*` only once.

定義共享記憶體區域的`*name*`和`*size*` ，該區域用於保存工作進程間共享的群組配置和運行時狀態。多個群組可以共享同一個區域。在這種情況下，只需指定一次`*size*`即可。

Additionally, as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx), such groups allow changing the group membership or modifying the settings of a particular server without the need of restarting nginx. The configuration is accessible via the [API](#p-048) module (1.13.3).

此外，作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分，此類群組允許更改群組成員或修改特定伺服器的設置，而無需重啟nginx。可透過[API](#p-048)模組( 1.13.3 )存取配置。

> Prior to version 1.13.3, the configuration was accessible only via a special location handled by [upstream\_conf](#p-103).
>
> 在版本1.13.3之前，配置只能透過 [upstream\_conf](#p-103)處理的特殊位置存取。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**state** `*file*`;``<br>` `**state** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.9.7.

該指令出現在版本1.9.7 。

Specifies a `*file*` that keeps the state of the dynamically configurable group.

指定一個`*file*` ，用於保持動態可設定群組的狀態。

Examples:

例如：

> ```
> state /var/lib/nginx/state/servers.conf; # path for Linux
>
> 狀態 /var/lib/nginx/state/servers.conf;# Linux 路徑
> state /var/db/nginx/state/servers.conf;  # path for FreeBSD
>
> 狀態 /var/db/nginx/state/servers.conf;# FreeBSD 的路徑
> ```

The state is currently limited to the list of servers with their parameters. The file is read when parsing the configuration and is updated each time the upstream configuration is [changed](#p-048). Changing the file content directly should be avoided. The directive cannot be used along with the [server](#p-163) directive.

目前狀態僅限於伺服器清單及其參數。解析配置時會讀取該文件，並且每次(https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_api_module.html#stream_upstreams_stream_upstream_name_servers_)配置發生更改時都會更新該文件。應避免直接更改文件內容。該指令不能與 [server](#p-163)同時使用。

> Changes made during [configuration reload](#p-026) or [binary upgrade](#p-026) can be lost.
>
> 在 [組態重新載入](#p-026)或 [二進位升級](#p-026)期間所做的變更可能會遺失。

> This directive is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本指令作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**hash** `*key*` [`consistent`];``<br>` `**hash** ` *鍵* ` [`一致性`];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

Specifies a load balancing method for a server group where the client-server mapping is based on the hashed `*key*` value. The `*key*` can contain text, variables, and their combinations (1.11.2). Usage example:

指定伺服器群組的負載平衡方法`*key*`其中客戶端-伺服器映射基於哈希值`*key*`可以包含文字、變數及其組合 ( 1.11.2 )。使用範例：

> ```
> hash $remote_addr;
>
> 哈希 $remote_addr；
> ```

Note that adding or removing a server from the group may result in remapping most of the keys to different servers. The method is compatible with the [Cache::Memcached](https://metacpan.org/pod/Cache::Memcached) Perl library.

請注意，向群組中新增或刪除伺服器可能會導致大部分鍵重新對應到不同的伺服器。此方法與 [Cache::Memcached](https://metacpan.org/pod/Cache::Memcached) Perl 函式庫相容。

If the `consistent` parameter is specified, the [ketama](https://www.metabrew.com/article/libketama-consistent-hashing-algo-memcached-clients) consistent hashing method will be used instead. The method ensures that only a few keys will be remapped to different servers when a server is added to or removed from the group. This helps to achieve a higher cache hit ratio for caching servers. The method is compatible with the [Cache::Memcached::Fast](https://metacpan.org/pod/Cache::Memcached::Fast) Perl library with the `*ketama_points*` parameter set to 160.

如果指定了`consistent`參數，則會使用 [ketama](https://www.metabrew.com/article/libketama-consistent-hashing-algo-memcached-clients)一致性雜湊方法。此方法確保在向群組中新增或從群組中移除伺服器時，只有少數鍵會重新對應到不同的伺服器。這有助於提高快取伺服器的快取命中率。此方法與 [Cache::Memcached::Fast](https://metacpan.org/pod/Cache::Memcached::Fast) Perl 函式庫相容，前提是`*ketama_points*`參數設定為 160。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**least_conn**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

Specifies that a group should use a load balancing method where a connection is passed to the server with the least number of active connections, taking into account weights of servers. If there are several such servers, they are tried in turn using a weighted round-robin balancing method.

指定群組應使用負載平衡方法，將連線傳遞給活動連線數最少的伺服器，並考慮伺服器的權重。如果存在多個這樣的伺服器，則使用加權輪詢負載平衡方法依序嘗試這些伺服器。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**least_time** `connect` \| `first_byte` \| `last_byte` [`inflight`];``<br>` `**least_time** `連接` \| `第一個位元組` \| `最後一個位元組` [`飛行中`];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.7.11.

該指令出現在版本1.7.11 。

Specifies that a group should use a load balancing method where a connection is passed to the server with the least average time and least number of active connections, taking into account weights of servers. If there are several such servers, they are tried in turn using a weighted round-robin balancing method.

指定群組應使用負載平衡方法，將連線傳遞給平均連線時間最短且活動連線數最少的伺服器，同時考慮伺服器的權重。如果有多個符合條件的伺服器，則使用加權輪詢負載平衡方法依序嘗試這些伺服器。

If the `connect` parameter is specified, time to [connect](#p-163) to the upstream server is used. If the `first_byte` parameter is specified, time to receive the [first byte](#p-163) of data is used. If the `last_byte` is specified, time to receive the [last byte](#p-163) of data is used. If the `inflight` parameter is specified (1.11.6), incomplete connections are also taken into account.

如果指定了`connect`參數，則使用連接到上游伺服器所需的時間(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_upstream_module.html#var_upstream_connect_time) 。如果指定了`first_byte`參數，則使用接收資料的第一個位元組(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_upstream_module.html#var_upstream_first_byte_time)所需的時間。如果指定了`last_byte`參數，則使用接收資料的最後一位元組(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_upstream_module.html#var_upstream_session_time)所需的時間。如果指定了`inflight`參數（ 1.11.6 ），則也會考慮未完成的連接。

> Prior to version 1.11.6, incomplete connections were taken into account by default.
>
> 在版本1.11.6之前，預設會考慮不完整的連線。

> Prior to version 1.31.0, this directive was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 在版本1.31.0之前，此指令僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**random** [`two` [`*method*`]];``<br>` `**random** [`兩個` [` *方法* `]];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.15.1.

該指令出現在版本1.15.1 。

Specifies that a group should use a load balancing method where a connection is passed to a randomly selected server, taking into account weights of servers.

規定群組應使用負載平衡方法，將連線傳遞給隨機選擇的伺服器，同時考慮伺服器的權重。

The optional `two` parameter instructs nginx to randomly select [two](https://homes.cs.washington.edu/~karlin/papers/balls.pdf) servers and then choose a server using the specified `method`. The default method is `least_conn` which passes a connection to a server with the least number of active connections.

可選參數`two`指示nginx隨機選擇[兩個](https://homes.cs.washington.edu/~karlin/papers/balls.pdf)伺服器，然後使用指定的`method`方法選擇其中一個伺服器。預設方法是`least_conn` ，即將連線傳遞給活動連線數最少的伺服器。

The `least_time` method passes a connection to a server with the least average time and least number of active connections. If `least_time=connect` parameter is specified, time to [connect](#p-163) to the upstream server is used. If `least_time=first_byte` parameter is specified, time to receive the [first byte](#p-163) of data is used. If `least_time=last_byte` is specified, time to receive the [last byte](#p-163) of data is used.

`least_time`方法會將連線傳遞給平均連線時間最短且活動連線數最少的伺服器。如果指定了`least_time=connect`參數，則使用連接到上游伺服器所需的時間(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_upstream_module.html#var_upstream_connect_time) 。如果指定了`least_time=first_byte`參數，則使用接收第一位元組(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_upstream_module.html#var_upstream_first_byte_time)資料所需的時間。如果指定了`least_time=last_byte` ，則使用接收最後一個位元組(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_upstream_module.html#var_upstream_session_time)資料所需的時間。

> The `least_time` method is available as a part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> `least_time`方法作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**resolver** `*address*` ... [`valid`=`*time*`] [`ipv4`=`on`\|`off`] [`ipv6`=`on`\|`off`] [`status_zone`=`*zone*`];``<br>``**resolver** `*地址*` ... [`有效`=`*時間*`] [`ipv4`=`on`\|`o ff`] [`ipv6`=`開`\|`關`] [`status_zone`=`*區域*`];`` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `upstream` |

This directive appeared in version 1.27.3.

該指令出現在版本1.27.3 。

Configures name servers used to resolve names of upstream servers into addresses, for example:

配置用於將上游伺服器名稱解析為位址的名稱伺服器，例如：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
>
> 解析器127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
> ```

The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address, with an optional port. If port is not specified, the port 53 is used. Name servers are queried in a round-robin fashion.

位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址，連接埠號碼為可選。如果未指定連接埠號，則使用連接埠53。名稱伺服器以輪詢方式進行查詢。

By default, nginx will look up both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses while resolving. If looking up of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses is not desired, the `ipv4=off` (1.23.1) or the `ipv6=off` parameter can be specified.

預設情況下，nginx 在解析時會同時尋找 IPv4 和 IPv6 位址。如果不需要尋找 IPv4 或 IPv6 位址，可以指定`ipv4=off` ( 1.23.1 ) 或`ipv6=off`參數。

By default, nginx caches answers using the TTL value of a response. The optional `valid` parameter allows overriding it:

預設情況下，nginx 使用回應的TTL值快取答案。可選的`valid`參數允許覆蓋此設定：

> ```
> resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 valid=30s;
>
> 解析器127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 有效=30秒;
> ```

> To prevent DNS spoofing, it is recommended configuring DNS servers in a properly secured trusted local network.
>
> 為防止DNS欺騙，建議在安全可靠的本地網路中設定DNS伺服器。

The optional `status_zone` parameter (1.17.5) enables [collection](#p-048) of DNS server statistics of requests and responses in the specified `*zone*`. The parameter is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).

可選參數`status_zone` ( 1.17.5 ) 啟用 [收集](#p-048)指定`*zone*`中請求和回應的DNS伺服器統計資訊。此參數作為我們 [商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

> Since version 1.17.5 and prior to version 1.27.3, this directive was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 自版本1.17.5起，在版本1.27.3之前，此指令僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>resolver_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>resolver_timeout 30s;<br>resolver_timeout 30s；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>upstream<br>上游</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.27.3.

該指令出現在版本1.27.3 。

Sets a timeout for name resolution, for example:

設定名稱解析超時時間，例如：

> ```
> resolver_timeout 5s;
>
> 解析器超時時間為 5 秒；
> ```

> Since version 1.17.5 and prior to version 1.27.3, this directive was available only as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 自版本1.17.5起，在版本1.27.3之前，此指令僅作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Embedded Variables｜嵌入變數**

The `ngx_stream_upstream_module` module supports the following embedded variables:

`ngx_stream_upstream_module`模組支援以下嵌入式變數：

`$upstream_addr`

keeps the IP address and port, or the path to the UNIX-domain socket of the upstream server (1.11.4). If several servers were contacted during proxying, their addresses are separated by commas, e.g. “`192.168.1.1:12345, 192.168.1.2:12345, unix:/tmp/sock`”. If a server cannot be selected, the variable keeps the name of the server group.

保留上游伺服器（ 1.11.4 ）的IP位址和端口，或UNIX域套接字的路徑。如果在代理過程中聯繫了多個伺服器，則它們的位址以逗號分隔，例如「 `192.168.1.1:12345, 192.168.1.2:12345, unix:/tmp/sock` 」。如果無法選擇伺服器，則該變數保留伺服器群組的名稱。

`$upstream_bytes_received`

number of bytes received from an upstream server (1.11.4). Values from several connections are separated by commas like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-163) variable.

從上游伺服器接收的位元組數（ 1.11.4 ）。來自多個連接的值以逗號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-163)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_bytes_sent`

number of bytes sent to an upstream server (1.11.4). Values from several connections are separated by commas like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-163) variable.

傳送到上游伺服器的位元組數（ 1.11.4 ）。來自多個連接的值以逗號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-163)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_connect_time`

time to connect to the upstream server (1.11.4); the time is kept in seconds with millisecond resolution. Times of several connections are separated by commas like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-163) variable.

連接到上游伺服器所需時間（ 1.11.4 ）；時間以秒為單位，精確到毫秒。多個連接的時間用逗號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-163)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_first_byte_time`

time to receive the first byte of data (1.11.4); the time is kept in seconds with millisecond resolution. Times of several connections are separated by commas like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-163) variable.

接收第一個位元組資料的時間（ 1.11.4 ）；時間以秒為單位，精確到毫秒。多個連接的時間用逗號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-163)變數中的位址一樣。

`$upstream_last_addr`

keeps the IP address or the path to the UNIX-domain socket of the last selected upstream server (1.29.3).

保留最後選定的上游伺服器（ 1.29.3 ）的IP位址或UNIX域套接字的路徑。

> This variable is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 此變數作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

`$upstream_session_time`

session duration in seconds with millisecond resolution (1.11.4). Times of several connections are separated by commas like addresses in the [$upstream\_addr](#p-163) variable.

會話持續時間以秒為單位，精確到毫秒（ 1.11.4 ）。多個連接的持續時間用逗號分隔，就像 [$upstream\_addr](#p-163)變數中的位址一樣。

###### Module ngx\_stream\_zone\_sync\_module｜模組 ngx\_stream\_zone\_sync\_module

端點](#p-164)<br>[啟動、停止、移除叢集節點](#p-164) |

The `ngx_stream_zone_sync_module` module (1.13.8) provides the necessary support for synchronizing contents of [shared memory zones](#p-163) between nodes of a cluster. To enable synchronization for a particular zone, a corresponding module must support this feature. Currently, it is possible to synchronize HTTP [sticky](#p-105) sessions, information about [excessive HTTP requests](#p-076), and key-value pairs both in [http](#p-074) and [stream](#p-146).

`ngx_stream_zone_sync_module`模組 ( 1.13.8 ) 為群集節點間 [共享記憶體區域](#p-163)內容的同步提供了必要的支援。若要啟用特定區域的同步，對應的模組必須支援此功能。目前，可以同步 [ (https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html#sticky) ]HTTP會話、[過多請求]HTTP資訊以及 [http](#p-076)和 [串流](#p-074)中的鍵值(https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_keyval_module.html) 。

> This module is available as part of our [commercial subscription](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx).
>
> 本模組作為我們[商業訂閱](https://www.f5.com/products/nginx)的一部分提供。

**Example Configuration｜範例配置**

Minimal configuration:

最低配置：

> ```
> http {
>     ...
> 
>     upstream backend {
>
>     上游後端 {
>        server backend1.example.com:8080;
>
>        伺服器 backend1.example.com:8080;
>        server backend2.example.com:8081;
>
>        伺服器 backend2.example.com:8081;
> 
>        sticky learn
>
>        黏性學習
>               create=$upstream_cookie_examplecookie
>
>               建立=$upstream_cookie_examplecookie
>               lookup=$cookie_examplecookie
>               zone=client_sessions:1m sync;
>
>               zone=client_sessions:1m 同步;
>     }
> 
>     ...
> }
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     ...
> 
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         zone_sync;
>
>         區域同步；
> 
>         listen 127.0.0.1:12345;
>
>         聽127.0.0.1:12345 ;
> 
>         # cluster of 2 nodes｜由 2 個節點組成的集群
>         zone_sync_server a.example.com:12345;
>         zone_sync_server b.example.com:12345;
> 
>     }
> ```

A more complex configuration with SSL enabled and with cluster members defined by DNS:

啟用SSL並由DNS定義叢集成員的更複雜配置：

> ```
> ...
> 
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     ...
> 
>     resolver 127.0.0.1 valid=10s;
>
>     解析器127.0.0.1有效期=10秒；
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         zone_sync;
>
>         區域同步；
> 
>         # the name resolves to multiple addresses that correspond to cluster nodes｜此名稱解析為多個位址，這些位址對應於叢集節點。
>         zone_sync_server cluster.example.com:12345 resolve;
>
>         zone_sync_server cluster.example.com:12345 解析;
> 
>         listen 127.0.0.1:4433 ssl;
>
>         監聽127.0.0.1:4433 ssl;
> 
>         ssl_certificate     localhost.crt;
>
>         ssl_certificate localhost.crt;
>         ssl_certificate_key localhost.key;
> 
>         zone_sync_ssl on;
>
>         zone_sync_ssl 已開啟；
> 
>         zone_sync_ssl_certificate     localhost.crt;
>
>         zone_sync_ssl_certificate localhost.crt;
>         zone_sync_ssl_certificate_key localhost.key;
>     }
> }
> ```

**Directives｜指令**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | `**zone_sync**;` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Enables the synchronization of shared memory zones between cluster nodes. Cluster nodes are defined using [zone\_sync\_server](#p-164) directives.

啟用叢集節點間共​​享記憶體區域的同步。叢集節點使用 [zone\_sync\_server](#p-164)指令定義。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_buffers</strong> <code><i>number</i></code> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_buffers 8 4k|8k;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets the `*number*` and `*size*` of the per-zone buffers used for pushing zone contents. By default, the buffer size is equal to one memory page. This is either 4K or 8K, depending on a platform.

設定用於推送區域內容的每個區域緩衝區的`*number*`和`*size*`值。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於一個記憶體頁。根據平台的不同，該值可以是 4K 或 8K。

> A single buffer must be large enough to hold any entry of each zone being synchronized.
>
> 單一緩衝區必須足夠大，能夠容納每個同步區域的任何條目。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_connect_retry_interval</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_connect_retry_interval 1s;<br>zone_sync_connect_retry_interval 1秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines an interval between connection attempts to another cluster node.

定義與叢集中另一個節點建立連線嘗試之間的間隔。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_connect_timeout</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_connect_timeout 5s;<br>zone_sync_connect_timeout 5秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines a timeout for establishing a connection with another cluster node.

定義與另一個叢集節點建立連線的逾時時間。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_interval</strong> <code><i>time</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_interval 1s;<br>zone_sync_interval 1秒；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Defines an interval for polling updates in a shared memory zone.

定義共享記憶體區域中輪詢更新的間隔。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_recv_buffer_size</strong> <code><i>size</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_recv_buffer_size 4k|8k;<br>zone_sync_recv_buffer_size 4k|8k；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Sets `*size*` of a per-connection receive buffer used to parse incoming stream of synchronization messages. The buffer size must be equal or greater than one of the [zone\_sync\_buffers](#p-164). By default, the buffer size is equal to [zone\_sync\_buffers](#p-164) `*size*` multiplied by `*number*`.

設定用於解析傳入同步訊息流的每個連線的接收緩衝區`*size*` 。緩衝區大小必須等於或大於 [zone\_sync\_buffers](#p-164)中的一個值。預設情況下，緩衝區大小等於 [zone\_sync\_buffers](#p-164) `*size*`乘以`*number*` 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**zone_sync_server** `*address*` [`resolve`];``<br>` `**zone_sync_server** ` *地址* ` [`解析`];` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `server` |

Defines the `*address*` of a cluster node. The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address with a mandatory port, or as a UNIX-domain socket path specified after the “`unix:`” prefix. A domain name that resolves to several IP addresses defines multiple nodes at once.

定義叢集節點的`*address*`位址。該位址可以指定為網域名稱或IP位址（必須包含連接埠），也可以指定為UNIX網域套接字路徑（位於「 `unix:` 」前綴之後）。一個網域名稱如果解析為多個IP位址，則同時定義多個節點。

The `resolve` parameter instructs nginx to monitor changes of the IP addresses that correspond to a domain name of the node and automatically modify the configuration without the need of restarting nginx.

`resolve`參數指示 nginx 監視與節點網域對應的IP位址的變化，並自動修改配置，而無需重新啟動 nginx。

Cluster nodes are specified either dynamically as a single `zone_sync_server` directive with the `resolve` parameter, or statically as a series of several directives without the parameter.

叢集節點既可以動態地指定為具有`resolve`參數的單一`zone_sync_server`指令，也可以靜態地指定為一系列不帶參數的指令。

> Each cluster node should be specified only once.
>
> 每個叢集節點只能指定一次。

> All cluster nodes should use the same configuration.
>
> 所有叢集節點應使用相同的配置。

In order for the `resolve` parameter to work, the [resolver](#p-142) directive must be specified in the [stream](#p-142) block. Example:

為了使`resolve`參數生效，必須在 [stream](#p-142)碼區塊中指定 [resolver](#p-142)指令。例如：

> ```
> stream {
>
> 溪流 {
>     resolver 10.0.0.1;
>
>     解析器10.0.0.1 ;
> 
>     server {
>
>     伺服器 {
>         zone_sync;
>
>         區域同步；
>         zone_sync_server cluster.example.com:12345 resolve;
>
>         zone_sync_server cluster.example.com:12345 解析;
>         ...
>     }
> }
> ```

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_ssl</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_ssl off;<br>zone_sync_ssl 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables the SSL/TLS protocol for connections to another cluster server.

啟用SSL/TLS協議，以便連接到另一個叢集伺服器。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**zone_sync_ssl_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**zone_sync_ssl_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with the certificate in the PEM format used for authentication to another cluster server.

指定一個`*file*` ，其憑證採用PEM格式，用於向另一個叢集伺服器進行驗證。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**zone_sync_ssl_certificate_key** `*file*`;``<br>` `**zone_sync_ssl_certificate_key** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with the secret key in the PEM format used for authentication to another cluster server.

指定一個`*file*` ，其中包含用於向另一個叢集伺服器進行身份驗證的PEM格式的金鑰。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_ssl_ciphers</strong> <code><i>ciphers<br>密碼</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_ssl_ciphers DEFAULT;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Specifies the enabled ciphers for connections to another cluster server. The ciphers are specified in the format understood by the OpenSSL library.

指定連接到另一集群伺服器時啟用的加密演算法。加密演算法以 OpenSSL 庫可識別的格式指定。

The full list can be viewed using the “`openssl ciphers`” command.

可以使用「 `openssl ciphers` 」指令查看完整清單。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>語法： | ``**zone_sync_ssl_conf_command** `*name*` `*value*`;``<br>` `**zone_sync_ssl_conf_command** ` *名稱* ` ` *值* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

This directive appeared in version 1.19.4.

該指令出現在版本1.19.4 。

Sets arbitrary OpenSSL configuration [commands](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) when establishing a connection with another cluster server.

與另一群集伺服器建立連線時，設定任意 OpenSSL 設定 [指令](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man3/SSL_CONF_cmd.html) 。

> The directive is supported when using OpenSSL 1.0.2 or higher.
>
> 使用 OpenSSL 1.0.2或更高版本時，支援該指令。

Several `zone_sync_ssl_conf_command` directives can be specified on the same level. These directives are inherited from the previous configuration level if and only if there are no `zone_sync_ssl_conf_command` directives defined on the current level.

同一層級可以指定多個`zone_sync_ssl_conf_command`指令。當且僅噹噹前等級未定義`zone_sync_ssl_conf_command`指令時，這些指令才會從上一個設定等級繼承。

> Note that configuring OpenSSL directly might result in unexpected behavior.
>
> 請注意，直接配置 OpenSSL 可能會導致意外行為。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**zone_sync_ssl_crl** `*file*`;``<br>` `**zone_sync_ssl_crl** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with revoked certificates (CRL) in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-164) the certificate of another cluster server. When using intermediate certificates, their CRLs should be specified in the same file.

指定一個包含已吊銷憑證（ CRL ）的`*file*`其格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-164)另一個叢集伺服器的憑證。使用中間憑證時，應在同一文件中指定其憑證撤銷清單 (CRL)。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_ssl_name</strong> <code><i>name</i></code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_ssl_name host from zone_sync_server;<br>zone_sync_ssl_name host 來自 zone_sync_server;</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.7.

該指令出現在版本1.15.7 。

Allows overriding the server name used to [verify](#p-164) the certificate of a cluster server and to be [passed through SNI](#p-164) when establishing a connection with the cluster server.

允許覆蓋用於[驗證](#p-164)叢集伺服器憑證的伺服器名稱，並在與叢集伺服器建立連線時[透過SNI](#p-164)傳遞。

By default, the host part of the [zone\_sync\_server](#p-164) address is used, or resolved IP address if the [resolve](#p-164) parameter is specified.

預設情況下，使用 [zone\_sync\_server](#p-164)位址的主機部分，如果指定了 [resolve](#p-164)參數，則使用解析後的IP位址。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**zone_sync_ssl_password_file** `*file*`;``<br>` `**zone_sync_ssl_password_file** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with passphrases for [secret keys](#p-164) where each passphrase is specified on a separate line. Passphrases are tried in turn when loading the key.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含 [金鑰](#p-164)的密碼短語，每個密碼短語單獨一行指定。載入金鑰時，將依序嘗試這些密碼短語。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_ssl_protocols</strong> [<code>SSLv2</code>] [<code>SSLv3</code>] [<code>TLSv1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.1</code>] [<code>TLSv1.2</code>] [<code>TLSv1.3</code>];</code></td></tr>

<tr><th>語法： </th><td><code><strong> zone_sync_ssl_protocols </strong> [ <code> </code> </code> [ <code> <code> TLSv1 </code> ] [ <code> TLSv1.1 </code> ] [ <code> <code> </code> ] [ </code></td></tr> </code>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;<br>zone_sync_ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

Enables the specified protocols for connections to another cluster server.

啟用與另一群集伺服器連線的指定協定。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_ssl_server_name</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_ssl_server_name off;<br>zone_sync_ssl_server_name 關閉；</td></tr>
<tr><th>Context:<br>上下文：</th><td><code>stream<br>流</code>, <code>server<br>伺服器</code></td></tr>
</table>

This directive appeared in version 1.15.7.

該指令出現在版本1.15.7中。

Enables or disables passing of the server name through [TLS Server Name Indication extension](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) (SNI, RFC 6066) when establishing a connection with another cluster server.

啟用或停用透過 [TLS伺服器名稱指示擴充](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication) ( SNI, RFC 6066) 傳遞伺服器名稱，以便在與另一個叢集伺服器建立連線時使用。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax:<br>文法： | ``**zone_sync_ssl_trusted_certificate** `*file*`;``<br>` `**zone_sync_ssl_trusted_certificate** ` *文件* `;` ` |
| Default:<br>預設值： | — |
| Context:<br>背景： | `stream`, `server` |

Specifies a `*file*` with trusted CA certificates in the PEM format used to [verify](#p-164) the certificate of another cluster server.

指定一個`*file*`其中包含受信任的CA證書，格式為PEM ，用於[驗證](#p-164)另一個集群伺服器的證書。

<table>
<tr><th>Syntax:<br>語法：</th><td><code><strong>zone_sync_ssl_verify</strong> <code>on</code> | <code>off</code>;</code></td></tr>
<tr><th>Default:<br>預設值：</th><td>zone_sync_ssl_verify off;<br>zone_sync_ssl_verify 關閉；</td></tr>
